papers.title: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: The memory-bound nature of the decoding stage of large language model (LLM) inference incurs significant latency. Layer-wise training-free network pruning approaches guided by the Hessian have been a prominent solution to this problem, as pruning reduces the number of nonzero parameters read from memory during decoding. Nevertheless, typical methods in this line compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences, whereas the model is fed self-generated tokens during decoding, creating a distribution shift between the two sequences. The Hessian calculated on the natural sequence is different from that calculated on the generated sequence. We observe that this discrepancy causes the activation distribution during generation to deviate from that used for pruning, further hurting the pruned model performance. Moreover, most existing LLM pruning methods that bring actual speedup primarily target the sparse matrix-matrix (SpMM) multiplication, providing limited support for the sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) operations, which dominate decoding. To solve these problems, we introduce SparseDecoding, a principled decoding-aware pruning framework tailored for accurate and efficient LLM decoding. Specifically, at the algorithmic axis, SparseDecoding constructs calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during the dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill, thereby aligning the pruning objective with the decoding activations. At the system axis, we develop an optimized N:M sparse matrix-vector kernel with bitmask indexing and fixed-step traversal. Substantial empirical results on representative LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-14B / 32B) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms standard fixed-text calibration on the long-form generation benchmarks while achieving up to 1.48x end-to-end wall-clock decoding speedup on A100 GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SparseDecoding 把剪枝校准数据从预采集自然文本换成稠密模型自回归解码（排除 prefill）时逐层采集的激活，使 Hessian 与解码期激活分布对齐，并配一个带 bitmask 索引与定步遍历的 N:M SpMV kernel。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-14B/32B 的长文本生成基准上一致优于固定文本校准，A100 上端到端解码加速最高 1.48x。
Motivation: LLM 解码阶段受 memory-bound 制约，Hessian 引导的免训练逐层剪枝是主流缓解手段，但 Hessian 在自然序列上算、解码时模型吃的是自生成 token，分布偏移使剪枝所用激活偏离生成期激活；同时现有真正提速的剪枝多优化 SpMM，对主导解码的 SpMV 支持不足。
Method: 算法侧：从稠密模型自回归生成（不含 prefill）的逐层激活构造校准矩阵，把剪枝目标与解码激活对齐；系统侧：实现面向 N:M 稀疏的优化 SpMV kernel，采用 bitmask 索引与固定步长遍历。
Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-14B/32B 上，长文本生成基准中一致优于标准固定文本校准；在 A100 GPU 上端到端 wall-clock 解码加速最高 1.48x。
Conclusion: 剪枝校准数据的分布要与解码期自生成 token 对齐，加上针对 SpMV 的 kernel 优化，才能同时保住剪枝后模型质量并拿到真实解码提速。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM's first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM's decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Science: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists. Equal contribution
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在神经算子 (neural operator) 微调配置选择任务中，LLM 智能体同时依赖任务先验与实验反馈：未看验证分数前其首个配置已接近随机搜索池顶端，反馈可用后重分配验证分数会改变每一次后续提议，而保值改写没有同等效应。跨 PDE 族迁移的匹配比较中，LLM 的 held-out nRMSE 几乎全部低于随机搜索与贝叶斯优化。
Motivation: LLM 科学智能体在有限试验预算下选微调配置时，究竟只用初始任务上下文还是会依据实验反馈调整决策，端点性能无法区分这两种机制。
Method: 在 PDE 族内与族间的神经算子迁移上，让 LLM 在有限试验预算内选择微调配置，并与随机搜索、贝叶斯优化做匹配比较；用受控干预做归因：观察验证分数前的首个配置排名、随 PDE 描述改变冷启动的 base learning rate、在已评估配置间重分配验证分数、以及保值改写 (value-preserving rewrite)。
Result: 跨 PDE 族迁移的匹配比较中，LLM 的 held-out test nRMSE 几乎每一对都低于随机搜索与贝叶斯优化；未观察任何验证分数时其第一个配置已接近对应随机搜索池顶端；冷启动干预下所选 base learning rate 随 PDE 描述变化；反馈可用后重分配验证分数在每个测试案例中都改变了下一个提议，保值改写则无同等总体效应。
Conclusion: LLM 的决策级动作同时响应给定任务与已观测结果，即把任务相关先验与对实验反馈的敏感性结合起来；端点性能本身不足以区分这一机制，需受控干预验证归因。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Spatial Pattern Formation from Multi-Agent Learning in Public Goods Dilemmas
papers.abstract_en: Spatial public goods models show that prescribed movement toward richer locations can generate spatial patterns. We ask how such patterns emerge when agents learn where to move and how learning rates shape their consequences for collective welfare. Fixed populations of cooperators and defectors independently learn movement policies using tabular Q-learning and local observations. Cooperator learning generates clusters around resource peaks, while co-adaptation changes their strength and motion. At a fixed training budget, the largest welfare losses occur when cooperators learn at high rates and defectors at low rates. In part of this regime, learned policies also generate traveling bands supported by a shared directional preference. The conditions supporting travel change with further training, so these patterns reflect training history rather than an established asymptotic outcome. Across the tested learning-rate conditions with cooperator learning, mean collective welfare falls below random movement because increased crowding outweighs gains in resource benefit. Charging agents for the crowding they impose on others during learning recovers much of the welfare loss in the tested conditions. These results connect learning rates to the emergence and welfare costs of spatial organization driven by individual rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在空间公共品博弈中，合作方与背叛方各自用表格型 Q-learning 独立学习移动策略，学习率差异直接决定空间格局与集体福利。固定训练预算下，合作方高学习率、背叛方低学习率时福利损失最大，且该区间内出现由共享方向偏好支撑的行进条带；这些格局随继续训练而改变，属于训练历史的产物而非渐近稳态。对施加给他人拥挤收费可挽回大部分福利损失。
Motivation: 已有空间公共品模型靠预设向富集区域移动来产生空间格局，但真实个体是自己学会往哪走的；学习率如何塑造这种自发空间组织及其对集体福利的后果尚不清楚。
Method: 固定数量的合作方与背叛方用表格型 Q-learning 基于局部观测独立学习移动策略，扫描合作方与背叛方的学习率组合，在固定训练预算下比较不同学习率条件下的空间格局与集体福利，并测试对拥挤外部性收费的干预。
Result: 固定训练预算下，合作方高学习率、背叛方低学习率时福利损失最大；该区间部分区域出现由共享方向偏好支撑的行进条带，且随继续训练条件改变。在所有含合作方学习的测试学习率条件下，平均集体福利低于随机移动，因为拥挤加剧超过资源收益增益；对拥挤收费在测试条件下挽回了大部分福利损失。
Conclusion: 学习率差异会通过个体奖励驱动的空间组织造成福利损失，拥挤收费是有效的纠正手段；但这些格局反映训练历史，不构成已确立的渐近结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Controllable Exaggeration for Generative Motion Models via Training-Time Adaptation and Inference-Time Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Recent motion generative models have demonstrated strong capabilities in synthesizing physically plausible character motion, but often overlook established animation principles used by professional animators to ground and design their animation work. Understanding and incorporating these principles into motion generative pipelines is essential for producing motions that serve not only physically grounded applications but also the needs of the character animation community. This enables the creation of characters that not only move in physically plausible ways but also feel alive, expressive, and engaging. To close this gap, we focus on the Exaggeration principle of animation and investigate how it can be incorporated into modern motion generative pipelines to produce more expressive character motions. To this end, we introduce a framework that operates at two stages of existing motion generative pipelines. The first stage introduces exaggeration during training, where we perform supervised fine-tuning of pre-trained text-to-motion models on our curated exaggeration dataset. The second stage operates at inference time, where we: (i) introduce a mathematical formulation of exaggeration based on dynamic movement primitives (DMPs); and (ii) leverage this formulation as an exaggeration guidance signal to guide existing diffusion and flow-matching text-to-motion generation models toward exaggerated motion without additional training. Through qualitative and quantitative evaluations against three strong motion generation models, we show that our methods generate more exaggerated and expressive motions while preserving neutral reference motion intent and physical plausibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把动画十二原则中的 Exaggeration（夸张）接入文本到动作生成管线：训练期用自建夸张数据集对预训练 text-to-motion 模型做监督微调，推理期用基于动态运动基元 (DMPs) 的夸张数学形式作为 guidance 信号，无需额外训练即可引导 diffusion 与 flow-matching 模型生成更夸张、更有表现力的动作，同时保留中性参考动作意图与物理合理性。
Motivation: 现有动作生成模型能合成物理上合理的角色动作，却忽略了专业动画师长期使用的动画原则，导致生成动作缺少表现力与感染力，难以满足角色动画社区的需求。
Method: 两阶段框架：训练阶段在自建的夸张数据集上对预训练 text-to-motion 模型做监督微调 (SFT)；推理阶段提出基于动态运动基元 (Dynamic Movement Primitives, DMPs) 的夸张数学形式，并将其作为 guidance 信号引导已有的 diffusion 与 flow-matching 文本到动作生成模型，无需再训练。
Result: 在与三个强动作生成模型的定性与定量对比中，该方法生成的动作更夸张、更有表现力，同时保持中性参考动作的意图与物理合理性。
Conclusion: 夸张既可在训练期通过微调注入，也可在推理期作为无训练的 guidance 信号施加，两者都能在不牺牲物理合理性的前提下提升动作表现力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Verdict Without the Rule: Diagnosing and Auditing Regulatory Rule Sensitivity in LLM Compliance Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model compliance systems are deployed on the assumption that a verdict depends on the regulatory rule it is given. We test this directly across five models and 20 regulatory and platform-policy domains: delete, swap, or negate the governing rule while holding the case fixed, and check whether the verdict changes (OCS) or the model's internal representation of compliance shifts at all (ICS-delta). Neither moves much: models' verdicts are often invariant to substantial perturbations of the supplied rule, and the guard model, evaluated here under a custom-rule adaptation of its native taxonomy, is the least rule-sensitive and least accurate of the five, barely above chance (51%, versus 90-92% for general-purpose models). This reflects easy cases more than blanket neglect: on cases where deleting the rule changes a previously correct model prediction, models do track it closely. Neither better prompting nor direct intervention on the model's internal representations closes this gap. Accuracy alone does not establish that a compliance verdict is grounded in the supplied rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM 合规系统做规则敏感性审计：固定案件、删除/替换/否定所给监管规则，看判决是否改变 (OCS) 或内部合规表征是否移动 (ICS-delta)。五个模型、20 个监管与平台政策域上判决基本不变；guard 模型在自定义规则适配下最不敏感也最不准，仅 51%（通用模型 90–92%），且更好的提示与直接干预内部表征都无法弥合该差距。
Motivation: 合规系统默认判决依赖所给监管规则，但这一假设未经检验；若判决对规则扰动不敏感，仅凭准确率无法证明判决确实以外部规则为依据。
Method: 在五个模型、20 个监管与平台政策域上做受控干预：固定案件，删除 (delete)、替换 (swap) 或否定 (negate) 所给规则，测量判决变化 (OCS) 与模型内部合规表征偏移 (ICS-delta)；guard 模型按其原生分类体系做自定义规则适配后评测，并测试改进提示与对内部表征的直接干预两种补救手段。
Result: 五个模型、20 个域上判决对规则大幅扰动基本不变；guard 模型准确率仅 51%（接近随机），通用模型为 90–92%，是五个模型中最不规则敏感也最不准的。在删除规则会改变原本正确预测的案件上，模型能紧密跟踪规则，说明失灵来自易案例而非全面忽视；更好的提示与对内部表征的直接干预都无法弥合这一差距。
Conclusion: 准确率本身不能证明合规判决以外部所给规则为依据；规则敏感性需要与准确率分开审计，且提示工程和表征干预都不足以修复该缺口。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 五个模型、20 个域上判决对规则大幅扰动基本不变；guard 模型准确率仅 51%（接近随机），通用模型为 90–92%，是五个模型中最不规则敏感也最不准的。在删除规则会改变原本正确预测的案件上，模型能紧密跟踪规则，说明失灵来自易案例而非全面忽视；更好的提示与对内部表征的直接干预都无法弥合这一差距。
summary_sections.conclusion: 准确率本身不能证明合规判决以外部所给规则为依据；规则敏感性需要与准确率分开审计，且提示工程和表征干预都不足以修复该缺口。

papers.title: Is In-Domain Training Enough for Fine-Grained Industrial Anomaly Understanding?
papers.abstract_en: A single multimodal large language model (MLLM) struggles to excel simultaneously at detection, localization, description, and reasoning in multimodal industrial anomaly understanding (MM-IAU). We show that in-domain training does not close this gap. On MMAD, a widely adopted MM-IAU benchmark, trained specialists reach at most 75.5% accuracy in defect localization, against 92.3% for human experts, and even detect anomalies less accurately than their untrained base model. Meanwhile, different MLLMs offer complementary strengths but share this weakness in fine-grained perception, so combining them alone cannot remove it. We therefore propose SiGMA, a spatially grounded multi-agent framework that divides labor between heterogeneous MLLM agents and a dedicated visual defect expert. A multimodal searcher supplies industrial knowledge and normal references, the defect expert turns query-reference comparison into calibrated anomaly evidence, and a label-free reliability controller weighs each source by task-wise competence and query-level evidence quality. SiGMA reaches 85.2% average accuracy on MMAD, 4.0% above the strongest trained specialist and Gemini-2.5-Pro and within 1.5% of human experts. Even with three agents of at most 9B parameters, it reaches 84.4%, and new MLLMs join without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在工业异常理解基准 MMAD 上，仅靠领域内训练无法让单一 MLLM 同时做好缺陷检测、定位、描述与推理：训练后的专家模型定位准确率最高 75.5%，甚至比未训练的基座模型更差。作者提出 SiGMA，用空间接地的多智能体分工加无标签可靠性控制器，把平均准确率推到 85.2%，距人类专家 1.5 个百分点以内。
Motivation: 单一 MLLM 在多模态工业异常理解 (MM-IAU) 的四项任务上难以兼顾，且领域内训练补不上细粒度感知这块短板；不同 MLLM 的互补优势也消不掉这一共同弱点。
Method: SiGMA 是空间接地的多智能体框架：异构 MLLM 智能体与专职视觉缺陷专家分工协作，multimodal searcher 提供工业知识与正常样本参照，缺陷专家把查询-参照比对转成经过校准的异常证据，无标签可靠性控制器按任务能力与查询级证据质量对各来源加权。

papers.title: BudgetPix: Compute-Adaptive Tokenization for Pixel-Space Image Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. This static paradigm cannot adapt to different resource constraints at inference time, and yields suboptimal quality-cost tradeoff by devoting the same effort to both plain backgrounds and intricate details. We propose BudgetPix, an adaptive tokenization framework that dynamically allocates compute based on visual complexity and spatial layout, enabling flexible computational budgeting at inference time. BudgetPix comprises three key components: (1) an adaptive encoder that maps a fixed-size image to a variable-length token sequence using an entropy-guided quadtree alongside a multi-scale patch embedder; (2) a scale-aware decoder reconstructs fixed-resolution images from multi-scale token sets; and (3) a flexible training and sampling schedule that enables pixel-space denoisers to operate across variable token counts. BudgetPix seamlessly integrates with existing pixel-space diffusion architectures, enabling a single checkpoint to be operated at a wide range of compute budgets. Evaluated on text-to-image generation, BudgetPix matches the fidelity of MiniT2I-L at $512^2$ and PixelDiT at $1024^2$ using just 25% of the original compute budget. In class-conditional generation using a MeanFlow backbone, BudgetPix requires merely 60% of the full compute budget to produce images with near-zero quality degradation, observing a marginal 0.8-point increase in FID. Comprehensive assessments by human and VLM judges confirm that BudgetPix establishes a significantly improved quality-efficiency tradeoff over prior budget-adaptive baselines. More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix
papers.comment: More details are available at our project page: https://karaozgur.com/BudgetPix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BudgetPix 在像素空间图像扩散中按视觉复杂度与空间布局动态分配 token 预算：熵引导四叉树 (entropy-guided quadtree) 自适应编码器把定长图像映射为变长 token 序列，尺度感知解码器重建定分辨率图像，配合可变 token 数的训练与采样调度，使单个 checkpoint 在推理时覆盖大范围算力预算。在 512² 文生图上以 25% 算力预算匹配 MiniT2I-L 的保真度，1024² 上以 25% 预算匹配 PixelDiT；类条件生成（MeanFlow backbone）只需 60% 预算，FID 仅上升 0.8 点。
Motivation: 图像生成普遍用均匀 tokenization，对平坦背景和复杂细节一视同仁，且推理时算力预算固定，无法按资源约束调整质量-成本折中。
Method: 三组件框架：熵引导四叉树加多尺度 patch embedder 的自适应编码器输出变长 token 序列；尺度感知解码器从多尺度 token 集重建定分辨率图像；灵活的训练与采样调度让像素空间 denoiser 在可变 token 数上运行，可直接接入现有像素空间扩散架构。
Result: 文生图上以 25% 原始算力预算匹配 MiniT2I-L 在 512² 的保真度、PixelDiT 在 1024² 的保真度；类条件生成用 MeanFlow backbone 仅需 60% 全算力预算，FID 仅边际上升 0.8 点；人工与 VLM 评审确认其质量-效率折中显著优于既有 budget-adaptive 基线。
Conclusion: 按内容复杂度做自适应 tokenization，可让单个像素空间扩散 checkpoint 在很宽的算力预算区间内几乎无质量损失地运行，取代固定预算的均匀 tokenization。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Structural Theory of Cognitive Representation and Problem Solving,Contexts, Invariance, and the Knowledge Space
papers.abstract_en: Learning and problem solving depend critically on the structure of internal representations. While many modern data-driven artificial systems achieve strong predictive performance, their learned representations often lack explicit structure for expressing abstraction, invariance, and task-relevant regularities. We propose a minimal structural framework in which representational operations relevant to problem solving, such as context formation, invariance recognition, representative selection, abstraction, and procedural reuse, are made explicit. The central notion is that of a \emph{context}, formalized as a partition of a subset of an underlying state space, which fixes the distinctions, granularity, and form in which a problem can be posed. Within this setting, invariance recognition and representative selection are treated as fundamental representational operations. The framework is realized as a Knowledge Space composed of two coupled graph structures: a Concept Graph that hosts constructed and refined concepts, and a Procedure Graph that encodes typed operations over representations. Together, these structures provide a minimal cognitive-representational algebra for operating on representations without assuming sophisticated inference, learning, control, perception, or motor mechanisms. Using simple illustrative examples and a finite weak-solver demonstration, we show that appropriate representational organization can simplify the form and scope of admissible regularities, even when problem solving is carried out by a fixed and limited solver. The contribution of the paper is structural rather than algorithmic: it identifies representational prerequisites for abstraction, invariance, and procedural reuse in problem solving, and states explicit success and failure conditions for the weak-solver setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个认知表征的结构框架：把 context 形式化为状态空间子集上的划分，用 Concept Graph 与 Procedure Graph 耦合的 Knowledge Space 显式表达上下文形成、不变性识别、代表选择、抽象与过程复用。在固定且能力有限的 weak-solver 上，恰当的表征组织能缩小可容许正则的形式与适用范围，并给出该设定下成功与失败的显式条件。
Motivation: 许多数据驱动系统预测性能强，但学到的表征缺少表达抽象、不变性与任务相关规律的显式结构，使得在受限求解器上做问题求解时可容许的规律形式与范围难以界定。
Method: 以 context（状态空间子集上的划分，固定问题可提出的区分、粒度与形式）为核心概念，把不变性识别与代表选择作为基本表征操作；框架实现为 Knowledge Space，由承载概念的 Concept Graph 与编码带类型表征操作的 Procedure Graph 两个耦合图结构组成，构成不依赖复杂推理、学习、控制、感知或运动机制的表征代数。
Result: 用简单示例与一个有限 weak-solver 演示说明：合适的表征组织可以简化可容许规律的形式与范围，即使问题求解由固定且受限的求解器完成；并为 weak-solver 设定给出显式的成功与失败条件。
Conclusion: 论文的贡献是结构性而非算法性的：给出抽象、不变性与过程复用所需的表征前提，并在 weak-solver 设定下明确何时该组织有效、何时失效。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: From What to Which: Decoding Modifier Grounding in Frozen MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can describe increasingly complex visual scenes, token-level grounding becomes crucial. Yet, when an MLLM generates "the yellow banana on the left", established grounding approaches focus on what is in the image ("banana"), overlooking tokens that help describe which instance is meant ("yellow", "left"). In this work, we ask whether frozen MLLM representations contain decodable grounding information about the referred instance across generated tokens, extending to modifiers such as attributes, spatial expressions, and relational/action terms. To address this question, we introduce OTTER, a lightweight supervised probe over frozen MLLM representations that uses Optimal Transport (OT) to align generated tokens with visual regions and produce compact grounding maps. Our results show that (i) instance-discriminative visual information can be decoded from modifier tokens, with the clearest evidence for spatial terms, but (ii) is not confined to them, as contextualized object nouns also carry referential information; (iii) the recovered grounding remains informative under context perturbations, while selected regions remain relevant to generation; and (iv) the learned OT-based grounding extends beyond the controlled setting to free generation and cross-dataset transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 OTTER：在冻结 MLLM 表示上用 Optimal Transport 对齐生成 token 与视觉区域，解码修饰语（属性、空间词、关系/动作词）的指代 grounding。结果表明修饰语 token 携带可解码的实例判别信息，空间词证据最清晰，上下文扰动下 grounding 仍有效，并可迁移到自由生成与跨数据集。
Motivation: 现有 token 级 grounding 只关注图像中「有什么」（如 banana），忽略决定「哪一个」的修饰语 token（如 yellow、left），无法回答 MLLM 是否在这些 token 中编码了指代实例信息。
Method: OTTER：在冻结 MLLM 表示上加一个轻量监督探针，用 Optimal Transport (OT) 将生成的 token 与视觉区域对齐，输出紧凑的 grounding map；考察属性、空间表达、关系/动作词等修饰语，并在受控设定、自由生成与跨数据集迁移上检验。
Result: 四点发现：(i) 修饰语 token 可解码出实例判别视觉信息，空间词证据最清晰；(ii) 该信息不限于修饰语，语境化的物体名词也携带指代信息；(iii) 在上下文扰动下恢复的 grounding 仍具信息量，且所选区域与生成相关；(iv) 基于 OT 的 grounding 可从受控设定扩展到自由生成与跨数据集迁移。
Conclusion: 冻结 MLLM 的表示中确实包含跨生成 token 分布的可解码指代 grounding 信息，且不限于修饰语 token；OT 对齐可将其提取为紧凑 grounding map 并迁移到自由生成场景。

papers.title: Looking Inside LLMs: Small-World Connectivity as a Signature of Reasoning Performance
papers.abstract_en: Understanding large language model (LLM) reasoning requires looking beyond behavioral performance to examine how reasoning ability is reflected in internal organization. Inspired by neuroscience findings linking higher intelligence to stronger small-world organization in functional brain networks, we investigate small-world connectivity as a structural signature of LLM reasoning. We construct functional graphs from attention-head activation similarities and find that a higher small-world index (SWI), capturing local clustering and short global paths, consistently correlates with better fluid reasoning performance across models and training checkpoints. Since local clustering is central to small-world organization, we further examine how heads important for model performance connect within and across communities. We find that these heads tend to have a larger share of connection weight within their own communities (high core scores) and a more concentrated weight distribution across communities (low bridge scores). These observations motivate the hypothesis that high core and low bridge scores serve as structural indicators of head importance for reasoning capability. We validate this hypothesis through pruning, introducing Small-World Allocation (SWA), a hierarchical sparsity allocation method guided by these scores. Across six LLMs, SWA better preserves small-world organization and model performance than competing allocation strategies, reducing WikiText perplexity by up to 20%. Together, these findings identify small-world functional connectivity as a measurable signature of LLM reasoning performance, offering a structural perspective that complements behavioral evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用注意力头激活相似度构建 LLM 功能网络，发现小世界指数 (SWI) 越高、流体推理 (fluid reasoning) 表现越好；重要头呈高 core score、低 bridge score。据此提出 Small-World Allocation (SWA) 层级稀疏分配，在 6 个 LLM 上比其他分配策略更好地保持小世界结构与性能，WikiText 困惑度最多降低 20%。
Motivation: LLM 推理能力评估多停留在行为表现层面，缺少能从内部组织刻画推理能力的结构性指标。
Method: 由注意力头激活相似度构建功能图，计算含局部聚类与短全局路径的 SWI；考察对模型性能重要的头在社区内/社区间的连接权重，得到 core score 与 bridge score，并据此设计层级稀疏分配方法 SWA，通过剪枝验证。
Result: SWI 更高与更好的流体推理表现跨模型、跨训练 checkpoint 一致相关；重要头在自身社区内连接权重占比更大（高 core score）、跨社区权重分布更集中（低 bridge score）；在 6 个 LLM 上，SWA 比竞争分配策略更好地保持小世界组织与模型性能，WikiText 困惑度最多降低 20%。
Conclusion: 小世界功能连接是 LLM 推理表现的可测结构签名，core/bridge score 可作为头重要性的结构指标来指导剪枝与稀疏分配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Probabilistic Logic Programs with Functional Gradient Guided Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Declarative logic programs offer a powerful and interpretable abstraction for encoding relational structure and neurosymbolic reasoning, by expressing dependencies as weighted compositional rules. However, inducing them from data remains fundamentally hard, bottlenecked by the combinatorial explosion of symbolic search spaces. LLMs have recently emerged as powerful hypothesis generators, but when used in isolation, they lack the capacity to do systematic inductive reasoning needed to reliably synthesize valid programs that fit complex relational distributions. We introduce grasp (Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs), a neurosymbolic framework that casts relational structure learning as functional gradient boosting in which the weak learner is a first-order rule and the intractable inner search is delegated to an LLM proposal oracle. We evaluate grasp on four relational benchmarks spanning molecular toxicity prediction (Tox21), mutagenesis, and citation matching (Cora), and show that it improves over purely symbolic, neural, and LLM-based baselines, while producing interpretable weighted rule ensembles. By replacing combinatorial search with gradient-guided LLM hypothesis generation, grasp retains boosting guarantees without sacrificing the transparency of symbolic outputs.
papers.journal_ref: 6th International Joint Conference on Learning & Reasoning (IJCLR 2026) 6th International Joint Conference on Learning & Reasoning 6th International Joint Conference on Learning & Reasoning (IJCLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 grasp（Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs），把关系结构学习形式化为函数梯度 boosting，弱学习器是一阶规则，内层组合搜索交给 LLM 提议 oracle。在 Tox21 分子毒性、mutagenesis、Cora 引文匹配四个关系基准上，它优于纯符号、纯神经与纯 LLM 基线，同时输出可解释的加权规则集成。
Motivation: 从数据归纳声明式概率逻辑程序受符号搜索空间组合爆炸制约；单独用 LLM 做假设生成又缺乏系统归纳推理能力，难以可靠合成拟合复杂关系分布的合法程序。
Method: 将关系结构学习建模为函数梯度 boosting（functional gradient boosting），弱学习器为一阶规则，不可解的内层搜索委托给 LLM proposal oracle；用梯度引导的 LLM 假设生成替代组合搜索，保留 boosting 保证。
Result: 在四个关系基准（含 Tox21、mutagenesis、Cora）上，grasp 改进（improves over）纯符号、神经与基于 LLM 的基线，并产出可解释的加权规则集成。
Conclusion: 用梯度引导的 LLM 假设生成替换组合搜索，可以在不牺牲符号输出透明度的前提下保留 boosting 保证，从而绕开逻辑程序归纳的搜索瓶颈。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ME-World 把多智能体第一人称世界模型形式化为共享世界中的同步 ego 流生成：在同一条 token 序列里联合去噪多个智能体的视角流，用全体智能体的目标视角位姿做条件，并以共享环境记忆约束生成。在真实与合成多智能体数据上，该模型在共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持与视频质量上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多智能体世界模型只用移动、相机控制、离散指令等粗粒度动作，细粒度具身交互下的跨视角一致性、共享环境一致性与交互引发的状态更新传播没有被处理。
Method: 提出 Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World)：在共享 token 序列中联合去噪多个智能体的 ego 流，每个流以所有智能体的 target-view pose 为条件，并用共享环境记忆 (shared environment memory) 落地生成；训练与评测同时使用真实和合成多智能体数据，并新定义面向环境、更新、身份三方面的共享世界一致性指标。
Result: 在真实与合成多智能体数据上，ME-World 在共享世界一致性、动作控制、身份保持和视频质量四个维度上均超过现有方法；评测使用作者新提出的 environment consistency、update consistency、identity consistency 指标。
Conclusion: 把多智能体第一人称生成当作共享 token 序列上的联合去噪并显式注入共享环境记忆，可以在细粒度动作下同时保住跨视角一致性和身份，优于依赖粗粒度动作的既有世界模型。

papers.title: Machine Learning Meets High-Energy Nuclear Physics: From Pattern Recognition to Physics-Integrated Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) in high-energy nuclear physics (HENP) is entering a new stage in which physical knowledge is incorporated more directly into data analysis, simulation, and physics inference. This mini-review focuses on developments that have matured in the past several years. Whereas earlier applications emphasized event classification, pattern recognition, and surrogate models for selected observables, recent work has moved toward physics-integrated workflows: calibrated Bayesian extraction of QCD matter properties, dense-matter equation-of-state inference from heavy-ion and neutron-star data, generative event modeling, neural unfolding of weak physical signals, differentiable inverse solvers, gauge-equivariant and diffusion-based lattice-field samplers, and neural reconstruction of model functions in holographic QCD. We survey recent applications of ML in heavy-ion collisions, neutron-star physics, lattice QFT, and holographic or continuum QCD. The emphasis is not on ML architectures alone, but on how they enter concrete physics workflows, how physical constraints such as symmetries, conservation laws, causality, thermodynamic stability, and topology are imposed, and how uncertainty quantification and validation determine whether an AI-assisted result can support a reliable physics conclusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇高能核物理 (HENP) 中机器学习的 mini-review，主张该领域已从事件分类与代理模型转向物理集成工作流：把对称性、守恒律、因果性、热力学稳定性与拓扑等物理约束直接嵌入模型，并用校准的贝叶斯不确定性量化决定 AI 辅助结果能否支撑可靠物理结论。综述覆盖重离子碰撞、中子星物理、格点 QFT 与全息/连续 QCD 四个方向的具体工作流。
Motivation: 早期 ML 应用停留在事件分类、模式识别与观测量代理模型，物理知识与工作流脱节，结果的可靠性与不确定性无法判定，难以支撑真正的物理推断。
Method: 按物理集成工作流组织综述：校准贝叶斯提取 QCD 物质性质、从重离子与中子星数据推断致密物质状态方程、生成式事件建模、弱信号的神经 unfolding (neural unfolding)、可微分逆求解器、规范等变与扩散式格点场采样器 (gauge-equivariant and diffusion-based lattice-field samplers)，以及全息 QCD 中模型函数的神经重建；重点考察对称性、守恒律、因果性、热力学稳定性、拓扑等约束如何施加，以及 UQ 与验证如何决定结论可信度。
Result: 综述性结论：ML 在 HENP 的成熟方向是从模式识别转向物理集成推断，涵盖重离子碰撞、中子星、格点 QFT、全息/连续 QCD 四类场景；摘要未给出任何数据集、基线或定量指标。
Conclusion: 作者主张 AI 辅助结果能否成为可靠物理结论，取决于物理约束的施加方式与不确定性量化、验证是否到位，而非 ML 架构本身。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: One Word Opens the Gate: The Option-Channel Attack on Typed Decision Models as Agent Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: A typed decision model reads a piece of text and returns a probability over caller-defined options, each with a short written definition, generating no text. Recent work places these models in agent systems as guardrails: the component that reads a proposed tool call or incoming message and decides whether to allow it. We evaluate seven open-weight models in that role and report the two error directions separately: a fail-open error allows a prohibited action and is a vulnerability; a fail-closed error blocks a permitted one and is only a cost. On prompt-injection, jailbreak and toxic-content screening, accuracy at the allow-or-block decision ranges from 36% to 72% against a chance level of 50%. A low error rate in one direction only reflects which answer a model defaults to: one allows nearly everything, another blocks nearly everything. On a synthetic suite of agent tool calls, six lines of server log text that say nothing about the policy raise a gate's fail-open rate from 0% to 63% on a policy it otherwise decides correctly. Giving the permissive option a misleading name, with its definition and the judged text untouched, raises that rate to between 93% and 100% on the four models that place the label in their input. Every defense we tested is defeated, either by an attacker who targets its mechanism or by attacker-controlled text. Escalating the least confident decisions does not help either: a decision an attack has reversed is no less confident than the one it replaced. Parsing each policy field into a typed value does eliminate one attack, but it also makes the model unnecessary: a deterministic rule over those values reaches 100% accuracy on all six policies. These models can reduce how many cases reach a reviewer, but on this evidence they should not be the component that decides. Code is available at https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/option-channel-attack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 typed decision model 当作 agent guardrail 会被 option-channel attack 击穿：七个开源模型在允许/拦截决策上准确率仅 36%–72%（随机基线 50%），六行与策略无关的服务端日志就能把某策略的 fail-open 率从 0% 抬到 63%，仅给宽松选项改个误导性名字则升到 93%–100%。作者结论是这类模型可减少送审量，但不应做最终决策者。
Motivation: agent 系统用 typed decision model 读工具调用或消息并判定放行，但其两个错误方向性质不同：fail-open 是漏洞，fail-closed 只是成本；此前缺少对这两个方向的分别评估与对抗性检验。
Method: 在 prompt-injection、jailbreak、toxic-content 三类筛查上评估七个开源模型，分开报告 fail-open 与 fail-closed；构造合成的 agent 工具调用套件，注入六行与策略无关的服务器日志文本，并单独改动宽松选项的名称（定义与被判定文本不动）；测试多种防御与按置信度升级决策的策略，并将策略字段解析为 typed value 后与确定性规则对比。
Result: 允许/拦截准确率 36%–72%，随机水平 50%；单一方向的低错误率只反映模型默认倾向（一个几乎全放行，另一个几乎全拦截）；六行无关日志使 fail-open 率 0% → 63%；误导性选项名使四个把该标签纳入输入的模型 fail-open 率升至 93%–100%；所有被测防御均被绕过；按最低置信度升级无效，因为被攻击翻转的决策与被替换者置信度一样高；解析为 typed value 后确定性规则在全部六个策略上达 100% 准确率。
Conclusion: typed decision model 可以减少需要人工复核的案例，但按这些证据不应承担最终放行决策；把策略字段解析成 typed value 后，确定性规则已足够，模型反而变得多余。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Testing Algebraic Complete Intersections
papers.abstract_en: Given independent and identically distributed samples samples from a probability distribution in a potentially high-dimensional real space, we study the problem of testing whether the distribution is concentrated near a real algebraic complete intersection of prescribed dimension, bounded degree, and bounded condition number. We design an explicit and effective learning procedure which either certifies the nonexistence of such a manifold, up to a controlled relaxation of the approximation threshold, or returns a candidate regression manifold with controlled geometric complexity. Equivalently, the procedure tests the manifold hypothesis within this hypothesis class. The proposed procedure relies on quantitative geometric estimates for regular polynomial systems, which lead to a tractable auxiliary optimization problem. We then develop a data-driven algorithm to solve this auxiliary optimization problem, establishing explicit bounds on its sample and arithmetic complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高维实空间中给定 i.i.d. 样本，检验分布是否集中在给定维数、次数与条件数上界的实代数完全交 (algebraic complete intersection) 附近。所给过程要么在受控的逼近阈值松弛下证明该流形不存在，要么返回几何复杂度受控的候选回归流形，等价于在该假设类内检验 manifold hypothesis；其样本与算术复杂度有显式界。
Motivation: manifold hypothesis 的检验需要在维数、次数、条件数受限的代数流形假设类上给出可判定、带证书的算法，而非仅给出拟合。
Method: 依赖正则多项式系统的定量几何估计，把检验化为一个可解的辅助优化问题；再设计数据驱动算法求解该问题，并给出样本复杂度与算术复杂度的显式界。
Result: 过程或在受控逼近阈值松弛下证书化非存在性，或返回几何复杂度受控的候选回归流形；对辅助优化问题建立显式的样本复杂度与算术复杂度界。
Conclusion: 在次数与条件数受限的代数完全交假设类内，manifold hypothesis 检验可做成带证书且复杂度可控的学习过程。

papers.title: Slot3R: Set-Associative Spatial Memory for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve evidence from each frame while processing an expanding scene online. Spatial memory is a natural fit because it organizes history by reconstructed 3D location. Yet Point3R uses spatial proximity both to associate a new observation with an existing memory entry and to decide whether to fuse it, conflating co-location with state identity. Because pointers summarize image patches, nearby pointers may encode distinct surfaces, viewpoints, or visibility conditions; averaging them can destroy complementary evidence before later frames disambiguate it. We argue that location should determine address, not whether observations must merge. Slot3R realizes this principle as a training-free, set-associative retrofit that lets multiple states coexist at a shared address while keeping the pretrained Point3R backbone frozen. A bounded sparse readout further decouples persistent storage from per-frame decoder access. At 300-500 sampled frames, Slot3R reduces Point3R's point-cloud accuracy error (Acc) by 57.1%-63.1% on 7Scenes and 64.0%-72.0% on NeuralRGBD, lowers Sim(3)-aligned absolute trajectory error (ATE) on all three pose benchmarks, and remains competitive on video-depth estimation. It completes all evaluated settings from 600 to 1000 sampled frames at about 19 FPS under the same protocol, whereas Point3R and InfiniteVGGT run out of memory at 800 frames and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Slot3R 把 Point3R 的空间记忆改成集合联想 (set-associative) 结构：位置只决定地址，同一地址可共存多个状态，从而避免把不同表面/视角的指针平均掉。在 300–500 采样帧上把 7Scenes 点云 Acc 误差降低 57.1%–63.1%、NeuralRGBD 降低 64.0%–72.0%，并在 600–1000 帧以约 19 FPS 跑完全部设置，而 Point3R 与 InfiniteVGGT 在 800 帧及以上爆显存。
Motivation: 流式 3D 重建需在线处理不断扩张的场景，Point3R 用空间邻近同时决定关联与融合，把共址误当同一状态，指针平均会在后续帧消歧前毁掉互补证据。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 的集合联想改造，冻结预训练 Point3R backbone，让多个状态共存于同一地址；用有界稀疏读出 (bounded sparse readout) 把持久存储与逐帧解码访问解耦。
Result: 300–500 采样帧下，7Scenes 点云 Acc 误差较 Point3R 降低 57.1%–63.1%，NeuralRGBD 降低 64.0%–72.0%；三个位姿基准上 Sim(3) 对齐的 ATE 全部下降，视频深度估计保持竞争力。600–1000 帧全部设置以约 19 FPS 完成，同协议下 Point3R 与 InfiniteVGGT 在 800 帧及以上显存耗尽。
Conclusion: 位置应当只决定地址而非是否合并观测；把地址与状态身份解耦后，流式 3D 重建的精度与可扩展帧数可以同时提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unlocking the Regulatory Genome by ARGUS: An Evidence-Constrained Agentic Framework for Interpreting Single Nucleotide Variants
papers.abstract_en: Over 90% of disease-associated variants from genome-wide association studies fall in noncoding regulatory regions, yet their functional interpretation remains a central open problem in genomic medicine. Large language models prompted to interpret such variants routinely hallucinate transcription factor (TF) binding changes, fabricate experimental support, and assign biological significance to statistically negligible signals. We present ARGUS (Agentic Regulatory Genomics for an Uncertainty-aware Scientist), which strictly separates deterministic biological computation from LLM-mediated reasoning. ARGUS wraps 458 DNABERT-based TF binding models in a hypothesis-directed investigation loop where a planner selects evidence sources based on current uncertainty, a verifier deterministically interprets each observation, and intermediate results change the investigation path. On variant rs6983267 at the 8q24 cancer risk locus, the same planner produces four divergent trajectories for four TFs. FOXA1 is rescued in 3 steps when real ADASTRA allele-specific binding data (15 experiments, FDR = 0.030) reveals a model false negative masked by saturation. KLF6 traverses 8 steps across ADASTRA, JASPAR motif analysis, and ENCODE cCRE regulatory annotation before abstaining due to mixed indirect evidence. RAD21 abstains in 8 steps after ADASTRA returns a coverage-qualified but nonsignificant allelic test (5 experiments, FDR = 0.65), and SP1, which shares FOXA1's saturated retained prediction, abstains because no direct experimental evidence exists at this locus. All observations come from real ADASTRA, JASPAR, and ENCODE cCRE queries; none are simulated. A comparison of fixed-priority and LLM-mediated planning shows that the LLM planner reaches identical verdicts with fewer tool calls by declining evidence that cannot resolve the claim under test.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS). Code: https://github.com/duttaprat/ARGUS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARGUS 把变异解读拆成确定性生物计算与 LLM 推理两层：用 458 个 DNABERT 转录因子结合模型包一个假设导向的调查循环，planner 按当前不确定性选证据源，verifier 确定性解释每次观测。在 8q24 位点 rs6983267 上，同一 planner 对四个 TF 走出四条不同轨迹，FOXA1 被 ADASTRA 真实数据 3 步内纠正为假阴性，KLF6 与 RAD21 各 8 步后弃权，SP1 因无直接实验证据弃权。
Motivation: 超过 90% 的 GWAS 疾病变异落在非编码调控区，功能解读仍是基因组医学的开放问题；直接让 LLM 解读会幻觉 TF 结合变化、编造实验证据。
Method: ARGUS 包裹 458 个基于 DNABERT 的 TF 结合模型，planner 依据当前不确定性选择证据源，verifier 确定性解释观测结果，中间结果改变后续调查路径；证据全部来自真实的 ADASTRA、JASPAR 与 ENCODE cCRE 查询，并对比固定优先级与 LLM-mediated 两种规划。
Result: FOXA1 在 ADASTRA 等位基因特异结合数据（15 个实验，FDR = 0.030）揭示被饱和掩盖的模型假阴性后 3 步内被纠正；KLF6 跨 ADASTRA、JASPAR motif 与 ENCODE cCRE 走 8 步后因混合间接证据弃权；RAD21 在 ADASTRA 返回覆盖合格但不显著的等位检验（5 个实验，FDR = 0.65）后 8 步弃权；SP1 因该位点无直接实验证据弃权。LLM planner 以更少工具调用得到相同判定。
Conclusion: 把确定性证据解释与 LLM 规划分离，可以让变异解读在证据不足时弃权而非编造结论，且 LLM 规划通过拒绝无法解决当前命题的证据来减少工具调用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DVD 把 2D 框、2D mask、3D 框统一转成 1D 向量序列并映射为高维空间中的紧凑离散 token，再用轻量 de-tokenizer 解码回原表示，从而绕开文本坐标表示的 token 开销与固定量化的量程/精度限制。在 RefCOCO 系列、SUN-RGBD、KITTI、Hypersim、nuScenes 上同时取得更优的 2D/3D 感知性能并显著降低 token 开销与推理延迟。
Motivation: MLLM 感知方法要么用文本坐标表示导致 token 开销过大，要么用固定范围量化而受量程与精度约束，尤其在无界空间、高定位精度要求的 3D 域上失效。
Method: DVD 先把 2D bounding boxes、2D masks、3D bounding boxes 等异构感知表示统一变换为 1D 向量序列，再映射为高维空间中的紧凑离散 token；输出端用轻量 de-tokenizer 将 token 解码回原始 2D/3D 表示，与 MLLM 直接对接。
Result: 在 2D 与 3D 感知基准 RefCOCO 系列、SUN-RGBD、KITTI、Hypersim、nuScenes 上，DVD 取得更优的 2D 与 3D 任务性能，并显著减少 token 开销与推理延迟。
Conclusion: 向量化解码加轻量 de-tokenizer 可以作为把 2D/3D 感知能力接入 MLLM 的通用高效框架，克服文本坐标与固定量化两类表示的固有限制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
papers.abstract_en: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvement at 20\% cost ($2.7\times$ efficiency, $p=0.002$ over 10 seeds). On the more volatile Container Trace, it achieves 96\% at 20\% cost ($4.8\times$ efficiency, $+75\%$ MAE reduction over Static). Unlike classical drift detectors (ADWIN, DDM, Page-Hinkley) which fail to trigger on regression-scale error streams, AdaptLSTM fires 42 times over 301 steps and outperforms matched-budget baselines. Wall-clock profiling shows $1.33\times$ throughput gain and 45\% update-time reduction. The framework is model-agnostic: identical Pareto patterns hold for LSTM, GRU, and Transformer backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaptLSTM 用验证集校准的阈值检测分布漂移并只做选择性更新，在云工作负载回归任务上以 20% 的更新成本恢复 Naive Online 的大部分精度提升：Alibaba Machine Trace 上恢复 54%（2.7 倍效率，p=0.002，10 seeds），Container Trace 上恢复 96%（4.8 倍效率，MAE 相对 Static 降低 75%）。
Motivation: Web 级云服务中热点内容、产品上线与用户行为造成分布漂移，离线训练模型精度快速退化；朴素在线学习能恢复精度但每步计算成本过高，而 ADWIN、DDM、Page-Hinkley 等经典漂移检测器在回归量级的误差流上不触发。
Method: AdaptLSTM 是模型无关的自适应在线学习框架：用验证集校准的阈值检测漂移，触发后只做选择性、定向的模型更新；在 LSTM、GRU、Transformer 三种骨干上验证同一 Pareto 模式，并与匹配预算基线及 ADWIN/DDM/Page-Hinkley 对比，含 wall-clock profiling。
Result: Alibaba Machine Trace：以 20% 成本恢复 Naive Online 改进的 54%，效率 2.7 倍，p=0.002（10 seeds）。Container Trace：20% 成本恢复 96%，效率 4.8 倍，MAE 相对 Static 降低 75%。漂移检测在 301 步中触发 42 次，优于匹配预算基线；wall-clock 吞吐提升 1.33 倍、更新时间减少 45%；LSTM、GRU、Transformer 骨干上 Pareto 模式一致。
Conclusion: 在分布漂移下，用校准阈值做选择性在线更新可以用约两成更新成本换回大部分在线学习收益，且该 Pareto 收益与骨干模型无关。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Syn-Omni: Structured Specialization and Progressive Collaboration for Omnimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Omnimodal embeddings naturally involve both shared representations and modality-specific features across heterogeneous inputs. However, existing omnimodal embedding methods often rely on a single shared parameter space over mixed-modality data, limiting structural separation between universal and modality-specific representations. To address this, we propose Syn-Omni, a unified framework for structured omnimodal adaptation with modality specialization and controlled cross-modal collaboration. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which decomposes adaptation into a shared LoRA path for universal semantics and modality-expert LoRA paths for modality-aware specialization. Furthermore, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) enables experts to first establish modality-specific priors, then gradually interact with other modality-experts for cross-modal synergy. Evaluated across 81 diverse tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, Syn-Omni consistently outperforms omnimodal baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured specialization and cross-modal progressive collaboration.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Long, Findings). Code: https://github.com/sony/syn-omni
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Syn-Omni 把全模态嵌入的适配拆成共享 LoRA 与模态专家 LoRA 两条正交路径，再用渐进式协同路由让专家先建立模态内先验、后逐步跨模态交互。在覆盖图像、视频、音频、音视频的 81 项任务上一致优于全模态基线。
Motivation: 现有全模态嵌入方法把混合模态数据压进单一共享参数空间，通用表征与模态特异表征之间缺少结构性分离。
Method: 提出 Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA)，将适配分解为承载通用语义的共享 LoRA 路径与承载模态感知特化的模态专家 LoRA 路径；再用 Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) 让各专家先建立模态特异先验，随后逐步与其他模态专家交互以获得跨模态协同。
Result: 在覆盖图像、视频、音频、音视频共 81 项多样任务的评测中，Syn-Omni 一致优于全模态基线。
Conclusion: 结构化的模态特化加受控的渐进式跨模态协作，比单一共享参数空间更适合全模态嵌入适配。

papers.title: How Much Audio Is Left In An Embedding? An Inversion Audit Of Audio Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained audio encoders are reused for downstream tasks that are often unknown when the encoder is trained, so their usefulness depends partly on which signal properties survive the pretext objective. We study this retained information through paired source reconstruction. Using a shared Stable Audio Open latent diffusion decoder, we reconstruct five-second, 44.1-kHz stereo music from frozen representations produced by supervised classifiers (VGGish, ConvNeXt), an audio-text contrastive model (CLAP), and a waveform-reconstruction model (EnCodec). These objectives impose different pressures to preserve source detail, while their exposed interfaces vary substantially in temporal and spectral resolution. Evaluating on the Million Song Dataset (MSD), we find clear differences in reconstructability across encoder families, while within encoder comparisons show improved recovery when finer temporal or spectral structure is exposed. Even compressed task oriented embeddings support reconstructions that preserve measurable source specificity and high level musical content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用共享的 Stable Audio Open latent diffusion 解码器对冻结音频编码器做配对源重建审计，量化预训练目标下保留了多少源信号信息。在 Million Song Dataset 上，不同编码器族（VGGish、ConvNeXt、CLAP、EnCodec）的可重建性差异明显，暴露更细时间或频谱结构的接口重建恢复更好，连压缩的任务导向 embedding 也能重建出可测的源特异性和高层音乐内容。
Motivation: 预训练音频编码器会被用于训练时未知的下游任务，其可用性取决于预训练目标保留了哪些信号属性，但这一保留程度此前缺少直接的度量手段。
Method: 以配对源重建 (paired source reconstruction) 为探针：用同一个 Stable Audio Open latent diffusion 解码器，从冻结的监督分类器 (VGGish、ConvNeXt)、音频-文本对比模型 (CLAP) 与波形重建模型 (EnCodec) 的表示中重建 5 秒、44.1 kHz 立体声音乐，并比较不同接口暴露的时间与频谱分辨率。
Result: 在 Million Song Dataset (MSD) 上，编码器族之间可重建性差异清晰；族内比较显示暴露更细时间或频谱结构时恢复改善；即便压缩的任务导向 embedding 也能支持保留可测源特异性与高层音乐内容的重建。
Conclusion: 预训练目标与接口分辨率共同决定冻结音频编码器保留多少源细节，因此下游可用性可由重建审计来判定。

papers.title: Real-Time Motion Planning with Dynamic Hazards: Classical vs. Learning-Based Methods
papers.abstract_en: We study real-time motion planning in dynamic hazard fields through a controlled comparison between classical planning and learning-based methods. Rather than introducing a new planner, we construct a unified benchmark in which representative classical and learning-based methods face the same environments, motion constraints, information assumptions, and evaluation metrics. The test environment consists of planar domains populated with rotating sprinkler-like hazards that generate time-varying forbidden regions via sweeping angular sectors. Our results show a clear regime shift. In deterministic environments, classical planners achieve near-perfect success and higher-quality paths, though sometimes at the cost of substantial planning or replanning time. Under stochastic obstacle dynamics, however, online search becomes strongly budget-sensitive: low budgets lead to frequent failure, while high budgets improve success at the cost of latency and longer trajectories. PPO-based policies, trained under the same scenario distribution, consistently outperform in latency, success rate, and path quality in these stochastic regimes. Overall, the results indicate that uncertainty in obstacle evolution, more than partial observability, is the dominant factor determining which planning paradigm is practically effective for the problem at hand.
papers.comment: This paper is scheduled to be presented at the 2027 International Symposium on Artificial Life and Robotics (AROB 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在含旋转喷灌式动态危险区的平面环境中统一评测经典规划与学习型方法，发现确定性场景下经典规划器成功率接近满分、路径质量更高但规划/重规划耗时大；随机障碍动力学下在线搜索对时间预算高度敏感，而同分布训练的 PPO 策略在延迟、成功率与路径质量上全面占优。决定范式选择的主导因素是障碍演化的不确定性，而非部分可观测性。
Motivation: 动态危险场中的实时运动规划缺少在相同环境、运动约束、信息假设与指标下的公平对比，经典与学习型方法各自报告的结果无法直接比较。
Method: 构建统一 benchmark：平面域中布置旋转喷灌式危险源，其扫掠角扇区生成时变禁飞区；在同一场景分布下对比代表性经典规划器与 PPO 策略，统一运动约束、信息假设与评估指标，并区分确定性与随机障碍动力学两种体制。
Result: 确定性环境中经典规划器成功率接近完美、路径质量更高，但常付出大量规划或重规划时间；随机障碍动力学下在线搜索强依赖预算——低预算频繁失败，高预算提高成功率但增加延迟与路径长度；PPO 策略在随机体制下于延迟、成功率、路径质量三项上持续占优。
Conclusion: 障碍演化的不确定性（而非部分可观测性）是决定经典规划与学习型范式何者实用的主导因素：确定性场景选经典规划，随机场景选同分布训练的 PPO 策略。

papers.title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
papers.abstract_en: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://egocentricvoice.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoVoice 把 HoloAssist 真人指导视频改造成逐时刻二选一（保持沉默或给出语音指导）的训练与评测框架，用源分离与语音重合成清洗音频流，微调 omni-modal LLM 并叠加直接偏好优化 (DPO)。实验显示现有系统很少产生时机恰当、内容有意义的主动介入，EgoVoice 在介入时机、内容相关性和人类偏好上相对 zero-shot 骨干均有明显提升。
Motivation: 主动视频助手、语音对话系统与第一人称任务理解各自发展，但没有系统同时解决从连续第一人称流中决定何时开口、说什么这一联合问题。
Method: 从 HoloAssist 真人指导视频出发，用源分离 (source separation) 与语音重合成 (speech resynthesis) 构造干净音频流，把每个视频会话转成模型逐时刻在沉默与语音指导之间决策的格式；在此数据上微调 omni-modal LLM，再用直接偏好优化 (DPO) 强化主动介入行为。
Result: 在闭源与开源模型上的实验表明，现有系统很少产生时机恰当、内容有意义的主动介入；EgoVoice 相对 zero-shot 骨干在介入时机、内容相关性和人类偏好三方面均有清晰提升。
Conclusion: 把「何时开口」显式建模成逐时刻决策并配合偏好优化，能让可穿戴 AR 助手从被动应答转向时机恰当的主动语音指导。

papers.title: Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cluster-TNN 在预处理阶段先对输入图做划分，运行时按簇采样、重建诱导子图并在 mini-batch 内做 graph lifting，从而避免全图一次性物化高阶域。在 21 组与全图执行的配对对比中，峰值 GPU 显存在每种配置下都下降，平均降 83.2%，预测性能保持竞争力，并首次在 Reddit 与 OGBN Products 上训练多种高阶拓扑神经网络。
Motivation: 拓扑深度学习需先把图提升为超图、胞腔或单纯复形，全域训练在 Reddit（233k 节点、57.3M 边）这类大规模稠密图上要先构造并存储完整提升表示，成为严重计算瓶颈，常使训练不可行。
Method: Cluster-TNN 是域无关框架：预处理时对输入图做聚类划分，运行时动态采样节点簇组、重建其诱导子图组成 mini-batch，并在每个 mini-batch 内执行所选 lifting；保留采样节点间全部边以维持跨簇构造高阶结构所需的连通性，产出可被现有 Topological Neural Networks 直接处理的拓扑 mini-batch。
Result: 在与全图执行的 21 组配对对比中，Cluster-TNN 在每种配置下都降低峰值 GPU 显存，平均降幅 83.2%，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能；该显存下降使其据作者所知首次在 Reddit 与 OGBN Products 等大规模数据集上训练多种不同的高阶拓扑神经网络。
Conclusion: 把高阶域的构造从全图全局物化改为按 mini-batch 局部提升，是让拓扑深度学习扩展到大规模图的通用策略，且不牺牲预测性能。

papers.title: RIFT: Relative Isolation From Trees For Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Isolation Forest (IF) is a widely used baseline for unsupervised anomaly detection. Recent studies provide a closed-form expression for the infinite-forest limit for one-dimensional data. Inspired by the geometric interpretation of this formula, we introduce RIFT (Relative Isolation From Trees), a deterministic anomaly detection method that generates the minimum spanning tree and scores each point by the sum of the apparent sizes of tree edges as viewed from that point. For one-dimensional data, the RIFT score recovers the closed-form IF limit exactly. In higher dimensions, it provides a parameter-free generalization that is deterministic, robust to varying density and clustered anomalies and avoids the axis-parallel artifacts of IF. We further propose an ensemble variant for large datasets. Experiments on synthetic data and the ADBench benchmark demonstrate that the accuracy is comparable to IF, while the ensemble variant exhibits significantly lower variance across random seeds.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: AdaCast: Conditional Parameter Generation for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved strong forecasting performance across domains. However, most adaptation methods remain static. Existing all-in-one methods learn a single set of dataset-level parameter updates and apply the same adapted model to every input. As a result, they cannot adapt the model parameters to the temporal patterns, seasonality and dynamics of each input time series. This limits their ability to produce forecasts that are tailored to heterogeneous inputs. To address this limitation, we propose AdaCast, a conditional parameter generation framework for time-series forecasting. AdaCast uses a generator to produce input-specific low-rank parameter updates for a frozen pretrained TSFM. These updates adapt the model to each input during both training and inference. Across six public benchmarks, AdaCast consistently outperforms static adaptation baseline in in-domain forecasting and improves zero-shot generalization to held-out datasets across domains. These results demonstrate that conditional parameter generation provides an effective approach for adaptive forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaCast 用生成器为每条输入时间序列即时生成低秩参数更新，注入冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型 (TSFM)，取代对所有输入套用同一套数据集级参数的静态适配。在六个公开基准上，该条件式参数生成在 in-domain 预测中稳定超过静态适配基线，并提升了跨领域留出数据集上的 zero-shot 泛化。
Motivation: 现有 all-in-one 适配方法只学一套数据集级参数更新，对每条输入都用同一个已适配模型，无法跟随各输入的时间模式、季节性与动态变化，因而难以针对异构输入给出定制化预测。
Method: AdaCast 是条件参数生成框架：一个 generator 依据每条输入时间序列产出 input-specific 的低秩 (low-rank) 参数更新，加到冻结的预训练 TSFM 上，训练与推理阶段都按输入做适配；对照基线是学习单一数据集级更新的静态适配方法。
Result: 在六个公开基准上，AdaCast 在 in-domain 预测中持续优于静态适配基线，并在跨领域留出数据集上改善了 zero-shot 泛化；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 条件式参数生成是实现自适应时间序列预测的有效路径：把适配从数据集级常量改为按输入生成的低秩更新，可同时改善域内精度与跨域零样本泛化。

papers.title: La-Ribo: RNA Co-Design via Geometry-Latent Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: RNA function arises from the coupling of nucleotide sequence and three-dimensional structure, motivating their joint design. Coordinating global folding with nucleotide-level detail remains challenging under limited structural supervision. We introduce La-Ribo, a generative framework for RNA sequence-structure co-design via geometry-latent flow matching. La-Ribo retains a sparse phosphate-sugar--base scaffold and encodes nucleotide identity and local conformation in residue-wise latents. A shared flow network generates both jointly, and an RNA-specific decoder then reconstructs all heavy atoms. To expand supervision, we construct a quality-controlled corpus of 168,561 RNA structures, integrating experimental data with predictions from three folding models, including 10,631 MSA-supported structures generated in this work. La-Ribo improves designability and codesignability over the evaluated baselines across sampling budgets and two refolding models, and the same prior supports scaffold-conditioned inverse folding without additional training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: La-Ribo 用几何-隐空间流匹配 (geometry-latent flow matching) 做 RNA 序列-结构协同设计：保留稀疏磷酸-糖-碱基骨架，残基级 latent 同时编码核苷酸身份与局部构象，共享流网络联合生成两者，再由 RNA 专用解码器重建全部重原子。在自建的 168,561 条质控 RNA 结构语料上，其 designability 与 codesignability 在所评测基线、多个采样预算和两个 refolding 模型下均更优，同一先验还无需再训练即可做 scaffold 条件的逆折叠。
Motivation: RNA 功能由序列与三维结构耦合决定，需要联合设计；但全局折叠与核苷酸级细节难以协调，且结构监督信号有限。
Method: 保留稀疏 phosphate-sugar--base 骨架，用 residue-wise latents 编码核苷酸身份与局部构象，共享流网络 (flow matching) 联合生成序列与结构，RNA 专用解码器重建全部重原子。为扩充监督，构建 168,561 条质控 RNA 结构语料，整合实验数据与三个 folding model 的预测，其中 10,631 条为本文生成的 MSA-supported 结构。
Result: 在所评测基线、跨采样预算与两个 refolding 模型的比较中，La-Ribo 的 designability 与 codesignability 均有提升；语料规模 168,561 条，含本文生成的 10,631 条 MSA-supported 结构。同一先验在不额外训练的条件下支持 scaffold 条件的 inverse folding。
Conclusion: 把序列与结构放进同一个几何-隐空间流先验，可在结构监督有限时同时改善协同设计并复用到逆折叠任务。

papers.title: ReSI: Recursive Safety Improvement toward Resistant and Resilient AI
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement, the participation of AI systems in improving their own capabilities, is beginning to move from theoretical prospect to practice, posing both challenges and opportunities for safety alignment. Models evolve through frequent updates, and their safety alignment requires continual adaptation to each new checkpoint. Meanwhile, with evolving red-teaming methods exposing new vulnerabilities, safety improvement for each checkpoint needs to mitigate exposed vulnerabilities and generalize to risks not yet revealed. Following R$^2$AI, we term these goals resistance to known threats and resilience to unforeseen risks. Recursive self-improvement, in turn, inspires an approach to both goals: safety alignment could likewise advance through successive rounds of evaluation and update. We therefore introduce ReSI, a recursive safety improvement framework that implements this approach through automated research. In each round, ReSI applies diverse red-teaming methods to identify vulnerabilities in the current target model, develops training recipes, and promotes the update with the largest safety gain among those passing a Pareto gate on capability retention as the next target model. Across four dense and mixture-of-experts models, ReSI matches or exceeds evaluated frontier models on in-distribution and out-of-distribution safety benchmarks, and outperforms alignment baselines on nearly all safety evaluations while largely preserving general capabilities. In particular, ReSI reduces the mean X-Teaming attack success rate across the four models from 86.01% to 31.45%, well below GPT-5.6-Luna's leading frontier result of 56.69%, indicating stronger resilience to attacks unseen during training. These findings support recursive safety improvement as a practical path toward resistant and resilient AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReSI 把递归自改进思路搬到安全对齐上：每轮用多种 red-teaming 找出当前模型漏洞，自动生成训练配方，只保留通过能力保持 Pareto 门控且安全增益最大的更新作为下一轮目标模型。在四个 dense 与 MoE 模型上，X-Teaming 平均攻击成功率从 86.01% 降到 31.45%，低于 GPT-5.6-Luna 的 56.69%。
Motivation: 模型频繁更新使安全对齐必须逐 checkpoint 重做，而红队方法不断暴露新漏洞：既要缓解已知威胁（resistance），又要泛化到尚未揭示的风险（resilience），逐次人工对齐难以跟上。
Method: ReSI 是通过自动化研究实现的递归安全改进框架：每轮对目标模型施加多种 red-teaming 方法定位漏洞，据此开发训练配方，对候选更新做安全评测并施加能力保持的 Pareto 门控，选出安全增益最大者作为下一轮目标模型，循环迭代。
Result: 在四个 dense 与 mixture-of-experts 模型上，ReSI 在分布内与分布外安全基准上匹配或超过所评测的前沿模型，并在几乎所有安全评测上优于对齐基线，同时大体保持通用能力；X-Teaming 平均攻击成功率从 86.01% 降至 31.45%，低于 GPT-5.6-Luna 的前沿最佳结果 56.69%。
Conclusion: 递归安全改进是通向 resistant 与 resilient AI 的可行路径：以评测—更新的循环迭代，可以在保留通用能力的同时对训练中未见的攻击表现出更强韧性。

papers.title: Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) methods for time-series forecasting update a deployed model, or a small adapter around it, from incoming ground truth. But the label of an $H$-step forecast exists only $H$ steps later, and real data pipelines add further delay. We build a leakage-free harness in which the label of forecast origin $s$ is released for updates only at step $s+d$ with $d \ge H$, and enforce this rule inside the released code of four recent TTA methods (TAFAS, COSA, PETSA and DynaTTA), run on their own backbones and checkpoints across five benchmarks (ETTm1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity and Traffic). As references we add two closed-form correctors: a bank of recursive least squares (RLS) filters combined by a per-coordinate median, with no tunable hyperparameters and 56 microseconds per step on the 7-channel streams, and an ELF-style linear corrector. Under causal delayed labels the picture is asymmetric. On ETTm1 every audited method genuinely adapts, yet the RLS bank still beats three of the four at a fraction of their cost; only DynaTTA beats the bank, only at the minimum causal delay, and at roughly 2,500 times the per-update cost; the ELF-style corrector beats all four. On the other four datasets, the largest statistically significant improvement any published method achieves over its own frozen checkpoint is half a percent, on all four at least one published method is significantly worse than the frozen model at the minimum causal delay, and on drift-heavy ETTh2 longer label delays make every adapter that separates from the frozen model, ours included, significantly harmful. Leaky next-step updates inflate the apparent gains of simple adapters by up to 110%, and the backbone training recipe moves frozen online error by up to a factor of 25, more than any adaptation effect we measure. We release the harness, integration patches and all cached runs.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 9 figures. Code and cached results: https://github.com/Xodios/TRAINING-ON-THE-FUTURE-A-DELAY-AWARE-AUDIT-OF-TEST-TIME-ADAPTATION-FOR-TIME-SERIES-FORECASTING
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对时序预测测试时适应 (TTA) 的标签延迟泄漏，构建延迟感知审计框架：预测原点 s 的标签只在 s+d（d≥H）释放，据此重跑 TAFAS、COSA、PETSA、DynaTTA 四种方法。结果显示泄漏式下一步更新会把简单适配器的表面增益夸大至多 110%，而因果延迟下已发表方法相对冻结检查点的最大显著提升仅 0.5%，骨干训练配方对冻结在线误差的影响可达 25 倍。
Motivation: TTA 方法从到达的真值更新模型，但 H 步预测的标签要 H 步后才存在，真实管线还有额外延迟；若按下一步标签更新即构成泄漏，会虚增收益并误导方法比较。
Method: 构建无泄漏 harness，在四个近期 TTA 方法（TAFAS、COSA、PETSA、DynaTTA）的官方代码、骨干与检查点上强制执行 d≥H 的标签释放规则，跨五个基准（ETTm1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic）；对照为无可调超参的递归最小二乘 (RLS) 滤波器组（按坐标取中位数融合，7 通道流上每步 56 微秒）与 ELF 风格线性校正器。
Result: ETTm1 上所有被审方法都真实适应，但 RLS 组以极低成本胜过其中三种，仅 DynaTTA 在最小因果延迟下胜过它且单次更新成本约 2500 倍，ELF 风格校正器胜过全部四种。其余四个数据集上，已发表方法相对自身冻结检查点的最大统计显著提升仅 0.5%，且每个数据集至少有一种方法在最小因果延迟下显著劣于冻结模型；漂移重的 ETTh2 上更长标签延迟使所有偏离冻结模型的适配器（含作者自己的）显著有害。泄漏式下一步更新把简单适配器的表面增益夸大至多 110%，骨干训练配方使冻结在线误差变化至多 25 倍，超过所测任何适应效应。
Conclusion: 在因果延迟标签下，多数已发表 TTA 方法的收益不成立甚至有害，泄漏评估与训练配方才是表面提升的主因；审计 harness、集成补丁与全部缓存结果已开源。
Relevance: 38

summary_sections.result: ETTm1 上所有被审方法都真实适应，但 RLS 组以极低成本胜过其中三种，仅 DynaTTA 在最小因果延迟下胜过它且单次更新成本约 2500 倍，ELF 风格校正器胜过全部四种。其余四个数据集上，已发表方法相对自身冻结检查点的最大统计显著提升仅 0.5%，且每个数据集至少有一种方法在最小因果延迟下显著劣于冻结模型；漂移重的 ETTh2 上更长标签延迟使所有偏离冻结模型的适配器（含作者自己的）显著有害。泄漏式下一步更新把简单适配器的表面增益夸大至多 110%，骨干训练配方使冻结在线误差变化至多 25 倍，超过所测任何适应效应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在因果延迟标签下，多数已发表 TTA 方法的收益不成立甚至有害，泄漏评估与训练配方才是表面提升的主因；审计 harness、集成补丁与全部缓存结果已开源。

papers.title: From Prompting to Composing: A Spatial Canvas Interface for Poster Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text prompting is an indirect interface for poster generation, requiring users to encode inherently two-dimensional composition intent into a one-dimensional sequence of words. We introduce a Spatial Canvas Interface that enables users to directly compose generation intent in space through four complementary binding types: semantic, identity, text, and pixel, together with Text Specifications for individual elements and global appearance. Based on this interface, we develop Compo, a poster generation model adapted from a pretrained image editing model to understand Spatial Canvas inputs and Text Specifications. Compo supports both direct inference, where users explicitly construct the canvas, and agentic mode, where a high-level request is automatically translated into a planned Spatial Canvas. To train Compo, we develop a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs supervision data for different binding types and their combinations, enabling efficient adaptation without training a specialized poster generator from scratch. We further introduce a benchmark that evaluates adherence to individual binding types and their joint composition. Experiments show that Compo achieves stronger compositional controllability than both general-purpose image generation models and dedicated poster generation systems while maintaining high visual quality. By decoupling intent specification from visual generation, our work shifts poster generation from prompting toward composing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Compo 用 Spatial Canvas Interface 把海报排版意图直接写在二维画布上，通过 semantic、identity、text、pixel 四类绑定加 Text Specifications 约束元素与整体外观，再由预训练图像编辑模型适配生成。它支持用户手工搭画布的直接推理与把高层请求自动译成画布的 agentic 模式，在自建绑定基准上比通用图像生成与专用海报系统有更强的组合可控性，同时保持高视觉质量。
Motivation: 文本提示把本质上二维的排版意图压成一维词序列，用户难以精确控制元素的位置、身份与文字，海报生成的可控性受限。
Method: 提出 Spatial Canvas Interface，含 semantic、identity、text、pixel 四类绑定与逐元素 Text Specifications 及全局外观规格；Compo 由预训练图像编辑模型适配而来，支持直接推理与 agentic 模式（高层请求自动规划画布）。训练用可扩展流水线自动构造覆盖各绑定类型及其组合的监督数据，避免从零训练专用海报生成器；并配套评测各绑定类型及其联合组合依从性的基准。
Result: 实验显示 Compo 在组合可控性上强于通用图像生成模型与专用海报生成系统，同时保持高视觉质量；评测由自建基准按单类绑定与联合组合的依从性打分。
Conclusion: 把意图指定与视觉生成解耦，海报生成可从 prompting 转向 composing，且靠自动监督数据适配即可获得比专用系统更强的可控性。

papers.title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
papers.abstract_en: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit, follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source-target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine-tuning, followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning to improve edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions. We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects. VibeEdit achieves a VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed, the highest-scoring text-instructed baseline in our evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VibeEdit 把空间标记加短注释组成 canvas instruction，直接指定图像编辑的位置与内容，无需单独文本提示即可完成物体增删替换、属性修改与移动。在 419 例人工构建、强调相似物体间目标选择的基准上，VLM rubric 分 79.9、编辑区域外 PSNR 32.8 dB，均高于最强文本指令基线 FireRed 的 67.4 与 24.0 dB。
Motivation: 文本引导图像编辑里描述改动容易，但在多个相似物体中指认目标对象或区域很繁琐，纯文本提示难以表达编辑位置。
Method: 构建 155 万组带物体 mask 与结构化编辑描述的源-目标编辑对，训练时渲染成 canvas instruction；在 Qwen-Image-Edit 上做 layer-decoupled conditioning，分别编码源图与 canvas instruction；先做 region-weighted 监督微调，再用 rubric-guided 强化学习优化编辑完成度、局部编辑质量与未编辑区域保持。
Result: 在独立构建、人工整理的 419 例基准（强调相似物体间目标选择）上，VibeEdit VLM rubric 分 79.9、区域外 PSNR 32.8 dB；文本指令基线中得分最高的 FireRed 分别为 67.4 与 24.0 dB。
Conclusion: 把编辑位置与内容合并成 canvas instruction 并分层条件化，能在相似物体场景下同时提高编辑完成度与未编辑区域的保持质量。

papers.title: Stride Independent Patching for Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents semi-automatic stride-independent patching (SSP) as an alternative to automatic stride-dependent patching techniques. SSP uses user or expert input to position predefined patches over one or more objects of interest. To evaluate its effectiveness, three patch-based datasets were created using SSP, overlapping patching (Overlap), and non-overlapping patching (Noverlap). DeepLabV3+ models with ResNet50, ResNet18, and MobileNetV2 backbones were trained sepa-rately on each dataset. Quantitative evaluations were performed on the respective test splits and a common external test set. SSP generally achieved higher segmentation scores on the test splits and required the shortest model training time across all three backbones. On the external test set, SSP achieved the highest average precision and F1-score across backbones, whereas Noverlap achieved the highest average recall. These preliminary results demonstrate that the potentially greater spatial coverage of Noverlap and Overlap does not generally translate into better segmentation perfor-mance and that SSP offers a favorable balance between segmentation performance and model training time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出半自动步长无关切块 (SSP)，由用户或专家把预定义 patch 摆到一个或多个感兴趣目标上，作为步长相关自动切块的替代。用 SSP、重叠切块 (Overlap)、非重叠切块 (Noverlap) 各建一个 patch 数据集，分别训练 DeepLabV3+（ResNet50/ResNet18/MobileNetV2）：SSP 在测试划分上分割分数普遍更高且训练时间最短，在公共外部测试集上跨 backbone 平均 precision 与 F1 最高，而 Noverlap 平均 recall 最高——更大的空间覆盖并不换来更好的分割。
Motivation: 自动步长相关切块让 patch 覆盖与目标位置脱钩，覆盖更大却不保证分割更好，还带来训练时间开销；需要一种把 patch 直接对准目标的切块方式。
Method: SSP 用用户或专家输入定位预定义 patch 覆盖感兴趣目标；据此与 Overlap、Noverlap 各构建一个 patch 数据集，分别在其测试划分与一个公共外部测试集上训练 DeepLabV3+，backbone 取 ResNet50、ResNet18、MobileNetV2。
Result: SSP 在三个 backbone 上普遍取得更高分割分数且模型训练时间最短；在外部测试集上 SSP 跨 backbone 平均 precision 与 F1 最高，Noverlap 平均 recall 最高。
Conclusion: Noverlap 与 Overlap 潜在的更大空间覆盖通常不转化为更好的分割性能，SSP 在分割性能与训练时间之间给出更有利的平衡；作者称结果为初步结果。

papers.title: ISBO: Scalable Spatio-Temporal Bayesian Optimization with Log Gaussian Cox Process Models via the INLA-SPDE Approach
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is a popular method for efficiently optimizing expensive black-box objectives. However, BO utilizing standard Gaussian Processes is ill-suited for doubly stochastic Cox Processes that are often used in spatio-temporal problem spaces. We introduce INLA-SPDE Spatio-Temporal Bayesian Optimization (ISBO): the first scalable BO framework for spatio-temporal data, that models the log-intensity with a Log-Gaussian Cox Process(LGCP) and performs inference via Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation and Stochastic Partial Differential Equations (INLA-SPDE) approach. Using a Matern field on meshes yields a sparse Gaussian Markov Random Field, where INLA provides fast and accurate posterior inference throughout sequential optimization. ISBO stably locates high-intensity regions and the peak of the latent intensity with minimal evaluations. A time-varying Upper Confidence Bound acquisition with masking avoids revisits, while penalized-complexity priors regularize early rounds. Experiments on synthetic and real-world spatio-temporal datasets show accurate peak discovery, intensity recovery, and substantial speedups over an RKHS-based baseline, positioning ISBO as a practical choice for BO with point-process data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ISBO 把时空贝叶斯优化的代理模型换成 Log-Gaussian Cox Process，用 INLA-SPDE 在网格上做 Matern 场推断，得到稀疏高斯马尔可夫随机场，从而在序贯优化中快速给出后验。配合带掩码的时变 UCB 采集函数与 penalized-complexity 先验，它以极少评估稳定定位高强度区域与潜在强度峰值，并在合成与真实时空数据上相对基于 RKHS 的基线取得大幅加速。
Motivation: 标准高斯过程代理不适合时空场景中常见的 doubly stochastic Cox 过程，且传统 BO 推断在时空维度上难以扩展，导致峰值定位需要大量昂贵评估。
Method: ISBO 用 LGCP 建模 log-intensity，通过 INLA-SPDE 在网格上放置 Matern 场，形成稀疏 GMRF 并由 INLA 提供快速后验；采集函数为带掩码的时变 Upper Confidence Bound，避免重复访问，早期轮次用 penalized-complexity 先验做正则化。
Result: 在合成与真实时空数据集上，ISBO 实现准确的峰值发现与强度恢复，并相对基于 RKHS 的基线取得显著加速；以极少评估稳定定位高强度区域与潜在强度峰值。
Conclusion: 对点过程数据的贝叶斯优化，LGCP 加 INLA-SPDE 的稀疏推断配合掩码时变 UCB 是一个实用且可扩展的选择。

papers.title: When Has a Bayesian Neural Network Sampled Enough? Adaptive Inference Time with Statistical Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian neural network predictions are commonly approximated using a fixed number of Monte Carlo samples per input, without controlling the resulting error that comes from this finite sample. We propose the use of confidence sequences to dynamically determine how many samples are needed while maintaining statistical guarantees. We consider several ways in which predictive probabilities are used, including identifying the most likely class, approximating the full predictive distribution, and resolving probability-threshold decisions. Sampling stops once the corresponding decision can be made with the desired guarantee. Experiments show that the method allocates the computational budget efficiently, assigning more samples to ambiguous inputs than to easy inputs while preserving reliable decisions and reducing overall latency relative to a fixed Monte Carlo budget.
papers.comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: E-Values: From Statistics to ML
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 贝叶斯神经网络 (BNN) 推断通常对每个输入固定采样相同数量的 MC 样本，误差不受控。本文用置信序列 (confidence sequences) 动态决定每个输入需要多少样本，在保持统计保证的前提下，一旦对应决策（取最可能类别、逼近完整预测分布、或概率阈值判定）能以目标保证做出就停止采样。实验显示该方法把算力预算高效分配给模糊输入而非简单输入，在保持决策可靠的同时相对固定 MC 预算降低了整体延迟。
Motivation: BNN 预测靠有限 Monte Carlo 样本近似，固定采样数既不对误差做控制，也在简单输入上浪费算力、在模糊输入上可能不足。
Method: 引入置信序列 (confidence sequences) 按输入动态确定所需样本数，覆盖三类预测概率用法：识别最可能类别、逼近完整预测分布、以及概率阈值决策；当决策能以目标统计保证做出时即停止采样。
Result: 实验表明该方法算力预算分配高效：给模糊输入分配的样本多于简单输入，同时保持决策可靠，并相对固定 MC 预算降低了整体延迟。
Conclusion: 用带统计保证的置信序列替代固定 MC 样本数，可以在不牺牲决策可靠性的前提下减少 BNN 推断的整体计算与延迟。

summary_sections.result: 实验表明该方法算力预算分配高效：给模糊输入分配的样本多于简单输入，同时保持决策可靠，并相对固定 MC 预算降低了整体延迟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 用带统计保证的置信序列替代固定 MC 样本数，可以在不牺牲决策可靠性的前提下减少 BNN 推断的整体计算与延迟。

papers.title: Verification with Transfer: Exact Information Frontiers and Their Price in Calls
papers.abstract_en: A verifier that accepts or rejects whole answers reveals little: under a flat prior over $k$-bit answers, zero error needs $2^k-1$ verifications. The usual remedy is to solve related source tasks, either all first, as a curriculum does, or interleaved with verification. We price this remedy in information and in calls. With an exact verifier, the least causal information that any interleaving of source calls and $n$ verifications needs to succeed with probability $s$ is a list rate-distortion function, attained by one observation before any verification. It lower-bounds the expected number of binary source calls, which designed sources meet within $1+\log_25$ calls for unique answers and within a logarithmic term in general, where no additive constant suffices. With an exact verifier and fixed sources, moving every call before the first verification preserves all hard caps on calls, although interleaving can save unboundedly many expected calls; under a noisy verifier, source-first protocols can lose unbounded factors in information and in error. For linear banks over $\mathbb{F}_2$, optimal accuracy has a closed form, and after a polynomial-time reduction the budget profile is computable in time $2^{O(h^2)}\operatorname{poly}(J,k+h)$ for $J$ sources and nuisance dimension $h$. In these banks, for zero error under a hard cap, the calls beyond the rounded-up information price are exactly those spent on nuisance. Every numbered result apart from two clauses about the planner is machine-checked in Lean 4, assuming two published results. Used as a ruler, the frontier shows a small transformer using all delivered bits at latent dimension $5$ and none at $11$ within fixed training budgets; in a test with predictions recorded before training, low XOR degree of the target bits did not suffice for their use.
papers.comment: 46 pages, of which 8 pages main text. The Lean 4 formalization is in the ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在整答案验证器下，把验证与相关源任务调用交错的信息代价可精确刻画：成功概率 s 所需的最小因果信息是一个 list rate-distortion 函数，且由首次验证前的单次观测达到。精确验证器下把所有源调用移到首次验证之前不破坏任何调用硬上限，但噪声验证器下 source-first 协议可能在信息与误差上损失无界因子；用作标尺时，一个小 transformer 在隐维 5 用尽全部交付比特、在 11 则完全不用。
Motivation: 只接受或拒绝整答案的验证器在平坦先验下零误差需要 2^k−1 次验证，代价过高；常见补救是先解或交错解相关源任务，但这一补救在信息与调用两种代价上从未被定价。
Method: 以 list rate-distortion 函数刻画任意交错协议的最小因果信息并给出下界；对 F_2 上的线性源库 (linear banks) 推导最优精度闭式，经多项式时间归约后预算剖面可在 2^{O(h^2)}·poly(J,k+h) 时间内计算；除两条关于 planner 的子句外全部编号结果在 Lean 4 中机器验证（假设两条已发表结果）。
Result: 设计出的源在唯一答案下于 1+log_2 5 次调用内达到下界，一般情形差一个对数项且无可加常数；精确验证器加固定源时 source-first 保留全部调用硬上限，而交错可节省无界多的期望调用，噪声验证器下 source-first 可能损失无界因子；线性库中零误差硬上限下超出向上取整信息价的调用恰为花在 nuisance 上的部分。作为标尺，小 transformer 在隐维 5 用尽全部交付比特、在 11 为零，训练前记录预测的测试中目标比特的低 XOR degree 并不足以被利用。
Conclusion: 验证与源任务交错的代价有精确信息前沿，且可用 Lean 4 机器检验；该前沿能定量判定模型在给定训练预算下是否真的用上了交付的比特。
Relevance: 18
