papers.title: SciTBERT: A family of chronologically consistent language models for scientific and technological language processing
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained transformer models are increasingly being used to study scientific and technological progress. Encoders tuned to paper or patent text outperform general-purpose models on downstream classification, regression, and proximity tasks within science and technology. However, the applicability of these models for studying time-dependent or archival properties of science, technology, and their interface is limited due to lookahead and domain biases inherent to these pre-trained models. These limitations arise from training on corpora with unconstrained chronological and text source distributions. We introduce SciTBERT: a family of chronologically consistent BERT-derived language models trained on text from scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text with training data cutoff dates spanning each year between 2013 and 2025. We also post-train these models in a chronologically-consistent manner using paper and patent citations, creating SciTBERT-CI model family. We find that these models generally outperform predecessor domain-specific encoder models even when training data is limited by early year restrictions in the corpus. To further investigate the extent to which this class of models can learn representations that bridge science and technology, we introduce the PatRepEval benchmark, a suite of patent-related text embedding tasks at the science-technology interface. Performance in a variety of classification, regression, and retrieval tasks spanning papers and patents highlights the importance of aligning encoder model representations with the domain distributions of their downstream tasks, and chronologically consistent encoders can match or exceed models trained without temporal constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciTBERT 是一族按年份截断语料训练的 BERT 编码器（2013–2025 每年一个截止点），消除预训练中的 lookahead 与领域偏倚；再用论文与专利引用做时间一致的后训练得到 SciTBERT-CI。即便训练数据被早年截止限制，这类模型通常仍优于既有的领域专用编码器，并在新提出的 PatRepEval 专利文本嵌入基准上匹配或超过无时间约束训练的模型。
Motivation: 用预训练编码器研究科技进展时，语料的时间与来源分布不受约束会引入 lookahead 和领域偏倚，使模型难以用于时间依赖或档案性质的科技研究。
Method: SciTBERT 在科学论文、专利与高质量教育网页文本上训练，训练数据截止日期覆盖 2013 至 2025 每一年；SciTBERT-CI 在此基础上用论文与专利引用做时间一致的后训练。另提出 PatRepEval 基准，包含跨论文与专利的分类、回归与检索任务。
Result: 即便语料受早年截止限制，SciTBERT 系列通常优于前身的领域专用编码器；在 PatRepEval 的分类、回归与检索任务上，时间一致编码器可匹配或超过无时间约束训练的模型。
Conclusion: 编码器表征与下游任务的领域分布对齐很重要，而时间一致的预训练在受限数据下也不牺牲性能，可用于无 lookahead 的科技动态研究。

papers.title: Quickest Change Detection with Diffusion-Integrated Scores
papers.abstract_en: Classical CUSUM relies on the log-likelihood ratio of the underlying distributions, which cannot generally be computed from finite pre- and post-change samples alone. We propose diffusion-integrated score CUSUM (DI-SCUSUM), a training-free detector. We add Gaussian noise to the samples to form two smooth density estimates and calculate their Hyvärinen scores exactly, without training a score network. For each incoming observation, we sample a diffusion time, perturb the observation, and use the importance-weighted score difference as an increment in the DI-SCUSUM recursion. Under the assumption that observations follow the fixed empirical distributions, the post-change mean increment is proportional to the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence from the smoothed post-change to the smoothed pre-change empirical distribution. We establish exponential false-alarm scaling and a first-order delay bound that, for a fixed threshold and increment scaling, is inversely proportional to the KL divergence. In the calibrated anisotropic Gaussian simulation, DI-SCUSUM nearly matches likelihood-ratio CUSUM and reduces the measured detection delay by about 91% relative to score-based CUSUM. On MNIST and Oxford-IIIT Pet, DI-SCUSUM also has lower empirical conditional detection delay than SCUSUM at comparable false-alarm levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的变点检测器 DI-SCUSUM：对样本加高斯噪声得到两个平滑密度估计，精确计算其 Hyvärinen score，按采样的 diffusion time 对观测加扰并用重要性加权的分数差作递推增量。在固定经验分布假设下，后变点平均增量正比于平滑后分布到平滑前分布的 KL 散度，由此得到指数误报标度与一阶检测延迟上界（固定阈值与增量标度下与 KL 散度成反比）；在各向异性高斯仿真中检测延迟比 score-based CUSUM 降低约 91%，几乎追平似然比 CUSUM。
Motivation: 经典 CUSUM 依赖对数似然比，而似然比一般无法仅从有限的变点前后样本估计出来，需要一个不依赖似然与训练的替代增量。
Method: DI-SCUSUM：对样本加高斯噪声构造两个平滑密度估计并直接解析计算 Hyvärinen score，不训练 score network；每来一个观测就采样一个 diffusion time、扰动该观测，用重要性加权的分数差作为递推增量。理论分析在观测服从固定经验分布的假设下进行。
Result: 后变点平均增量正比于平滑后经验分布到平滑前经验分布的 KL 散度；建立指数误报标度与一阶延迟上界，固定阈值和增量标度下延迟与 KL 散度成反比。在标定的各向异性高斯仿真中，DI-SCUSUM 几乎匹配似然比 CUSUM，检测延迟相对 score-based CUSUM 降低约 91%；在 MNIST 与 Oxford-IIIT Pet 上，同等误报水平下经验条件检测延迟低于 SCUSUM。
Conclusion: 免训练的 diffusion 积分分数增量可以替代似然比做 CUSUM，在仿真中逼近似然比 CUSUM 的延迟，并在图像数据上以可比误报率胜过 SCUSUM。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: DataSense-Bench: The First Step Toward an AI Scientist
papers.abstract_en: As claims about recursive self-improvement (RSI) and artificial general intelligence (AGI) proliferate, we ask a simple question: do frontier AI models have a sense of data, i.e., can they reliably select the right data for training? We introduce DataSense-Bench to study this capability through the fundamental problem of data selection and performance forecasting in machine learning. We ask AI agents to select and rank candidate training subsets that can be used to fine-tune a small LLM model. Agents are allowed to inspect the data, write and execute analysis code, and run model forward passes, but can not train the model or access the actual evaluation tasks. We then fine-tune the base model on each selected subset and evaluate its post-training performance under a standardized protocol. We instantiate the benchmark in terminal problem solving and tool use, selecting trajectories from OpenThoughts-Agent and EnvScaler and evaluating on TBLite and BFCL, respectively. We then evaluate the agents along two complementary dimensions: the post-training performance of the top-ranked subset, reflecting the ability to identify high-value training data, and ranking accuracy, reflecting the ability to predict the relative performance of the selected subsets. In our experiments, selection gains over random selection are limited; agents do not reliably rank their selected groups, and ranking ability does not hold consistently across tasks: Astra identifies the best group in all three tool-use runs but in only one of three terminal runs. Analysis of execution traces on both tasks shows that agents often use similar data signals while interpreting their training value differently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DataSense-Bench 让 AI agent 在不训练模型、不接触评测任务的前提下，通过查数据、写分析代码、跑前向来挑选并排序候选训练子集，再用微调小 LLM 的真实后训练表现检验其“数据感”。结果显示 agent 相对随机选择的增益有限，且无法可靠排序自己选出的数据组：Astra 在三次 tool-use 运行中都选中最优组，但三次 terminal 运行中只有一次选中。
Motivation: 关于 RSI 与 AGI 的讨论隐含前沿模型能可靠挑选训练数据，但这一能力从未被直接检验；数据选择与性能预测正是 AI scientist 需要的核心数据判断力。
Method: 构建 DataSense-Bench：让 agent 检查数据、写并执行分析代码、跑模型前向，选出并排序候选训练子集用于微调小 LLM，但禁止训练模型或访问真实评测任务；随后按标准化协议在每个选中子集上微调并评测。实例化在 terminal problem solving（从 OpenThoughts-Agent 选轨迹，评 TBLite）与 tool use（从 EnvScaler 选轨迹，评 BFCL）两个任务上，从两维度评估：top-ranked 子集的后训练表现与排序准确率。
Result: agent 相对随机选择的增益有限；agent 无法可靠排序自己选出的组，排序能力跨任务不一致——Astra 在全部三次 tool-use 运行中都识别出最佳组，但在三次 terminal 运行中仅一次成功。对两个任务执行轨迹的分析显示，agent 常使用相似的数据信号却对其训练价值给出不同解读。
Conclusion: 前沿模型目前尚不具备可靠的数据选择与性能预测能力，其“数据感”在不同任务间不稳定，且对同一数据信号的价值判断存在分歧——这是通往 AI scientist 的第一步障碍。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.

papers.title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出跨域 agentic BBO 基准 AgenticBBO-Bench，在统一有限预算评测协议下覆盖合成函数、超参数优化、数据库调优、芯片设计与分子设计五类任务。实验显示 agentic BBO 的族平均分在五个域全部高于直接 LLM 方法，并在其中四个域超过最佳数值优化器；消融表明额外数值工具并不稳定增益、任务语义普遍有用而具体先验更不可靠，数值优化器能吸收 agent 搜索轨迹的收益。
Motivation: 现有 agentic BBO 研究任务域与系统配置各异，结果难以横向比较，单个设计选择的作用也无法隔离。
Method: 构建 AgenticBBO-Bench：五个域（合成函数、超参数优化、数据库调优、芯片设计、分子设计）统一有限预算评测协议；考察三类因素——优化工具、任务信息与先验知识、LLM 在搜索中的角色；另设五任务 frontier challenge，在 Codex agent harness 下评测七个 LLM。
Result: agentic BBO 在全部五个域的 family-averaged score 高于直接 LLM 方法，在其中四个域超过最佳数值优化器；额外数值工具不一致提升性能，任务语义 broadly useful 而更具体先验 less reliable，数值优化器可吸收 agent 建立的搜索轨迹收益；GPT-6 Astra 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在性能-成本上位于 Pareto frontier。
Conclusion: 在统一预算下，LLM agent 驱动的黑盒优化整体强于直接 LLM 调用且多数情况强于数值优化器，但工具堆叠并非稳定收益来源，语义先验比具体先验更可靠。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AI-Based On-Board Maritime Object Detection for Earth Observation Payload Data Reduction on Versal Embedded Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellites acquire more data than they can store and downlink, while in maritime surveillance the vessels cover a tiny fraction of each scene. We study onboard vessel detection as a way to select what is downlinked, which reduces the data according to its content rather than coding every pixel; it is complementary to conventional onboard compression. The work follows three axes. (i) Data and algorithm: a controlled dataset is generated from 68 annotated Maxar scenes with 43 vessel classes, and a YOLOX-S detector is trained on it. (ii) Embedded deployment: the detector is quantized and deployed on the DPU of a Versal VC1902, with a limited loss of detection quality and a processing time of a few seconds per scene. (iii) Data reduction: we propose several downlink modes, from metadata only (box, class and score of each detection) to image crops around vessels, tiles holding detections, or the whole scene with a degraded background, and estimate from the measured detection errors the trade-off each offers between the vessels kept and the volume downlinked. On our dense harbor and coastal scenes, tiles keep 98% of the vessels with 29% of the scene volume, and crops 83% with 3%.
papers.comment: 8 pages. Accepted at the 10th On-Board Payload Data Compression Workshop (OBPDC 2026), Barcelona, Spain, 12-14 October 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Versal VC1902 的 DPU 上部署量化 YOLOX-S 船舶检测器，用检测结果决定下传哪些内容而非压缩全部像素：密集港口与沿岸场景中，tile 模式以 29% 的场景体积保留 98% 船舶，crop 模式以 3% 体积保留 83%。
Motivation: 极高分辨率对地观测卫星的存储与下行带宽装不下全部数据，而海上监视中船只只占场景极小比例，按内容选择下传可与常规星上压缩互补。
Method: 从 68 幅 Maxar 标注场景生成受控数据集（43 类船舶），训练 YOLOX-S；量化后部署到 Versal VC1902 的 DPU；提出多种下传模式（仅元数据 box/class/score、船舶 crop、含检测的 tile、背景降质整景），并用实测检测误差估计保留船舶数与下传体积的权衡。
Result: 密集港口与沿岸场景中，tile 模式保留 98% 船舶、占场景体积 29%；crop 模式保留 83%、占 3%。量化部署检测质量损失有限，单景处理时间为数秒。
Conclusion: 星上按检测内容选择下传可在大幅削减下行量的同时保住绝大部分船舶目标，tile 与 crop 分别对应高保留率与极低体积两端。

papers.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS)：让单一基座模型在进化式工作流搜索与自生成轨迹的监督微调之间交替，迭代提出、执行并自评多智能体工作流，以突破不可验证任务上的递归自我改进 (RSI) 监督瓶颈。用 Qwen3.6-27B 跑两个 MASS 周期后，四个开放式公开基准上每输出 token 的性能提升 1.2–1.6 倍；在多智能体轨迹上训练的学生模型胜过用 1.4 倍训练 token 的单智能体学生。
Motivation: 开放式研究等不可验证任务上，模型输出超出人类专家可靠评估能力，监督成为瓶颈；单实例模型又难以在同质循环中批判并改进自身的复杂推理。
Method: MASS 在进化式工作流优化与自生成轨迹的监督微调之间交替：由单一基座模型迭代提出、执行并自评多智能体工作流，进化搜索受结构性护栏 (structural guardrails) 约束，优化计算图式的编排，为给定任务发现不同角色与信息路由。
Result: 两个 MASS 周期、Qwen3.6-27B，在四个开放式公开基准上每输出 token 性能提升 1.2–1.6 倍；多智能体轨迹训练效率更高，其学生模型超过用 1.4 倍训练 token 的单智能体学生模型。
Conclusion: 从多智能体轨迹联合学习编排与有界的子智能体执行，可为 RSI 提供有效信号：改进后的模型同时成为更好的优化器与评估器，使交替框架持续递归自举。

papers.title: Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation. We introduce Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens. A task-specific grammar organizes these elements into spatial sequences, allowing one autoregressive Transformer to learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a common next-token objective. We train the model from scratch using random-play transition pretraining followed by joint action and state training on expert demonstrations. During pretraining, recorded action coordinates condition subsequent state predictions and are excluded from the prediction loss. During control, the model decodes only executable action targets and updates its history with newly observed states. We evaluate the approach on Push-T in simulation and on a real robot. The model achieves competitive simulation performance and higher task success and target coverage than the evaluated real-robot policy baselines. Training ablations show improved control with joint action and state sequences, with further gains from random-play pretraining. Given supplied action trajectories, the same model also predicts successive scene states, capturing the geometric effects of pushing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把机器人操作中的场景轮廓、目标、动作目标和未来状态统一编码为离散坐标与语义 token 的共享词表，用任务特定文法组织成空间序列，让单个自回归 Transformer 通过同一个 next-token 目标同时学动作生成与动作条件下的状态预测。在 Push-T 仿真和真机上取得有竞争力的仿真表现，真机任务成功率与目标覆盖高于所评估的策略基线；消融显示联合动作-状态序列提升控制，随机游玩 (random-play) 预训练带来进一步增益。
Motivation: 让动作如何改变场景几何成为目标导向操作的补充监督信号，同时避免为动作生成和状态预测分别建模两套系统。
Method: Spatial Language Modeling：以离散坐标与语义 token 的共享词表表示场景轮廓、目标、动作目标与未来状态，任务特定文法将其组织为空间序列；单个自回归 Transformer 用统一 next-token 目标学习动作生成与动作条件状态预测。训练分两阶段：随机游玩转移预训练（动作坐标作为后续状态预测的条件，且不计入预测损失），再在专家演示上做动作与状态联合训练；控制时只解码可执行动作目标，并用新观测状态更新历史。
Result: 在 Push-T 仿真与真机上评估：仿真表现有竞争力，真机任务成功率与目标覆盖高于所评估的真机策略基线；消融显示联合动作-状态序列相比不含状态序列的设置控制更好，随机游玩预训练在此基础上进一步提升；给定动作轨迹时，同一模型能预测相继场景状态，捕捉推动的几何效果。
Conclusion: 动作生成与动作条件状态预测可以由同一个自回归 Transformer 通过共享空间词表和统一 next-token 目标联合承担，联合训练与随机游玩预训练都对控制性能有正贡献。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在 Push-T 仿真与真机上评估：仿真表现有竞争力，真机任务成功率与目标覆盖高于所评估的真机策略基线；消融显示联合动作-状态序列相比不含状态序列的设置控制更好，随机游玩预训练在此基础上进一步提升；给定动作轨迹时，同一模型能预测相继场景状态，捕捉推动的几何效果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 动作生成与动作条件状态预测可以由同一个自回归 Transformer 通过共享空间词表和统一 next-token 目标联合承担，联合训练与随机游玩预训练都对控制性能有正贡献。

papers.title: Learning to Plan by Looking Back: Hindsight Hierarchies for Training Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a self-improvement loop for reasoning models based on the following observation: Even when the difficulty of a problem exceeds the model's current solving abilities, an additionally supplied solution might enable the model to extract useful solution ideas in hindsight. We operationalize this by jointly training the same model to exhibit the following three capabilities: predicting solution ideas from problems alone, reverse-engineering ideas from problems and known solutions, and solving problems using provided ideas. The loop alternates between reverse engineering such ideas from problems with supplied solutions and using these ideas as additional supervision for joint training of all three capabilities. We give a formal specification of our method and a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving in the Lean theorem prover; empirical evaluation remains future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种推理模型自我改进循环：即使题目超出模型当前能力，附带的参考解也能让模型事后 (hindsight) 提炼出可用的解题思路。同一模型被联合训练三种能力——仅由题目预测思路、由题目与已知解反向工程思路、借助给定思路解题——循环在反向工程与联合训练之间交替。方法给出形式化规格并在 Lean 定理证明器上给出具体实例，实证评估留作后续工作。
Motivation: 当问题难度超过模型当前解题能力时，常规自我改进缺少可学的监督信号；本文要利用附带解法把这种难题转化为思路级监督。
Method: 联合训练同一模型的三项能力：从题目预测解题思路、从题目与已知解反向工程 (reverse-engineering) 思路、利用提供的思路解题；循环交替执行“从有解题目反向工程思路”与“以这些思路作为额外监督联合训练三项能力”。给出方法的形式化规格，并在交互式定理证明 Lean 中给出具体实例化。
Result: 给出方法的形式化规格与 Lean 定理证明器上的具体实例；摘要明确实证评估 (empirical evaluation) 为后续工作，因此无实验数字或基线对比。
Conclusion: 作者主张：参考解即使在模型解不出题时也能提供可提取的思路级监督，通过三能力联合训练的交替循环驱动自我改进。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Is Real-World Training Data Necessary for Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection?
papers.abstract_en: Generalist graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to build a foundation model that detects anomalies on arbitrary unseen graphs without retraining or fine-tuning. Sufficient data are essential for foundation model training, yet generalist GAD still faces a data shortage, as real-world anomalous graphs are scarce and costly to collect and annotate. To fill this gap, we propose AG-FORGE, an Anomalous Graph generation Forge for automatic synthesis of anomalous graphs, exploring the feasibility of synthetic data-driven training for generalist GAD. Empirically, we find that synthetic data can achieve performance comparable to real-world training, but fail to push the performance boundary further due to the limited capacity of existing methods. To further unlock model capacity as training data scale up, we develop TS-GGAD, a Topology-Semantic coordinated Generalist GAD that captures complementary topological and semantic anomaly evidence, together with a curriculum learning strategy tailored to large-scale synthetic training. Extensive experiments on 14 real-world datasets demonstrate that TS-GGAD, trained on data generated by AG-FORGE, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对通用图异常检测 (generalist GAD) 缺少真实异常图数据的问题，提出 AG-FORGE 自动合成异常图，并配 TS-GGAD（拓扑-语义协同的通用 GAD + 面向大规模合成训练的 curriculum learning）。在 14 个真实数据集上，用 AG-FORGE 生成数据训练的 TS-GGAD 显著优于 SOTA；作者发现合成数据可达到与真实训练相当的性能，但受限于现有方法容量，无法进一步突破性能边界。
Motivation: 通用图异常检测需要在任意未见图上免重训、免微调地检测异常，但真实异常图稀缺且采集标注成本高，基础模型训练面临数据短缺。
Method: 提出 AG-FORGE（Anomalous Graph generation Forge）自动合成异常图，探索合成数据驱动的通用 GAD 训练；再提出 TS-GGAD，协同捕获拓扑与语义两类互补的异常证据，并配一个专为大规模合成训练设计的 curriculum learning 策略以释放随数据规模增长的模型容量。
Result: 在 14 个真实数据集上，以 AG-FORGE 生成数据训练的 TS-GGAD 显著优于 state-of-the-art 方法；经验上合成数据可达到与真实世界训练相当的性能，但因现有方法容量有限而无法进一步推高性能边界。
Conclusion: 真实异常图并非通用图异常检测训练的必要条件——合成数据足以匹配真实训练水平，但要随数据规模继续提升，必须同时扩大模型容量（如 TS-GGAD 的拓扑-语义协同与合成数据 curriculum）。

papers.title: Scalable Hierarchical Graph Generation via Soft Community Structure
papers.abstract_en: Generating large attributed graphs requires reproducing the topology, generating attributes jointly with the structure, and remaining scalable. Many real-world graphs exist as a single large graph, so a generative model has to generalize from the one graph it is fit on, without independent samples. We present Schema, which recursively decomposes a reference graph into a hierarchy of soft communities, assigning each node a membership distribution. Generation is then split into three stages, each trained independently: (1) synthesizing node attributes conditioned on soft memberships, (2) generating intra-community edges from local structural context, and (3) modeling inter-community connections over bridge nodes whose membership mass is distributed across several communities. No stage forms the full adjacency matrix, and each stage operates on a subgraph bounded by the community size. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that covers structural fidelity, memorization, downstream utility, and scalability. On four real-world attributed graphs, Schema recovers the balance between local and long-range structure more closely than any other model that generates attributes, while reproducing only a small fraction of the reference edges. It retains the downstream accuracy of the reference graph without raising it artificially above that level. Baselines that match its structural fidelity memorize the reference, while those with higher downstream accuracy either exceed the reference accuracy or fail to complete on the larger graphs. We measure scalability on six additional graphs with up to 10 million nodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Schema 用软社区 (soft community) 层级分解把大规模属性图生成拆成三个独立训练的阶段——按软隶属分布生成节点属性、按局部结构生成社区内边、按桥节点建模社区间连接——任何阶段都不构造完整邻接矩阵。在四个真实属性图上，它在只复现参考图一小部分边的情况下，比其他能生成属性的模型更贴近局部与长程结构的平衡，并把下游精度保持在参考图水平而不人为抬高。
Motivation: 真实世界图往往只以单个大图形式存在，生成模型必须从这一个图泛化而没有独立样本；同时要联合生成属性与结构并保持可扩展，现有方法难以兼顾。
Method: Schema 递归地把参考图分解为软社区层级，为每个节点给出隶属分布；随后三个阶段各自独立训练：以软隶属为条件合成节点属性、从局部结构上下文生成社区内边、在隶属质量跨越多个社区的桥节点上建模社区间连接。每个阶段只作用于受社区大小约束的子图。另提出覆盖结构保真、记忆化、下游效用与可扩展性的评估协议。
Result: 在四个真实属性图上，Schema 比任何其他能生成属性的模型更贴近局部与长程结构的平衡，且只复现参考图的一小部分边；其下游精度保持在参考图水平而不人为超过。结构保真相当的基线会记忆参考图，下游精度更高的基线则要么超过参考精度、要么在较大数据图上无法完成。可扩展性在另外六个图上测量，最大达 1000 万节点。
Conclusion: 把属性图生成按软社区拆成三个不构造完整邻接矩阵的独立阶段，可以在不记忆参考图的前提下同时保住结构保真、下游效用与千万节点级可扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When KL Regularization Misfires in Group Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Why does removing reference-policy KL regularization sometimes improve group policy optimization? This motivates studying how reference-policy information should enter group-relative updates. We analyze seven potential failure modes in the interactions between KL and rewards: residual KL updates after reward clipping, after gradient cancellation, and in groups with identical rewards; KL growth with response length and an imbalance in its relative contribution; KL concentration on a small number of tokens; and sampling noise when k1 is incorporated into rewards. We propose Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO), which uses relative drift measured by conditional KL to calibrate within-group reward coefficients and integrates them into the base surrogate. Mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design's effectiveness in our settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在组策略优化中，参考策略 KL 正则有时反而有害，作者系统列出 KL 与奖励交互的七种失效模式，并提出 Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO)：用条件 KL 度量的相对漂移校准组内奖励系数，再并入基础 surrogate。数学推理实验与消融支持该设计在其实验设置下有效。
Motivation: 组策略优化中移除参考策略 KL 正则有时反而提升效果，说明 KL 信息进入组相对更新的方式本身有问题，需要厘清 KL 与奖励交互在哪些情形下产生反效果。
Method: 分析七种 KL-奖励失效模式：奖励裁剪后的残余 KL 更新、梯度抵消后的残余更新、组内奖励相同情形、KL 随回答长度增长且相对贡献失衡、KL 集中于少量 token、以及把 k1 纳入奖励时的采样噪声；据此提出 ZCPO，用条件 KL 度量的相对漂移校准组内奖励系数并整合进基础 surrogate。
Result: 在数学推理实验中，ZCPO 的设计有效性得到实验与消融 (ablation) 支持；摘要给出的失效模式分析覆盖七种 KL 与奖励交互情形。
Conclusion: 参考策略 KL 不应以固定权重直接进入组相对更新，而应按组内相对漂移动态校准奖励系数；该结论在作者的数学推理实验设置下成立。

papers.title: Connected Self Forcing: Beyond Local Learning in Video Autoregression
papers.abstract_en: To stream long videos while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency, Self Forcing mitigates exposure bias through self-rollout training on self-generated histories with key-value (KV) caching. To keep memory manageable, it detaches historical caches, preserving forward dependencies between chunks but severing the backward gradient paths. We introduce Connected Self Forcing, a training framework that reconnects gradient paths across autoregressive chunks, allowing feedback from later predictions to guide how earlier context is generated. These connections go beyond historical KV-writing: gradients pass through generated latents into the computations that produced them, linking the generation of earlier context to its use in later predictions. To make this connected training memory-efficient, we develop shortcut gradient replay, which recovers cross-chunk gradients without retaining the full rollout computation graph. Integrated with distribution matching distillation, Connected Self Forcing trains historical chunks according to both their direct supervision and their contribution to subsequent generation. Experiments on autoregressive video generation show improvements in long-horizon visual quality and temporal consistency, without changing the inference procedure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Connected Self Forcing：在自回归视频生成的 Self Forcing 训练中重新接回被 detach 掉的跨 chunk 梯度，让后续预测的反馈回传到早期上下文的生成过程，并用 shortcut gradient replay 免于保存整段 rollout 计算图。与 distribution matching distillation 结合后，长时程视觉质量与时序一致性提升，推理流程不变。
Motivation: Self Forcing 用自生成历史加 KV caching 做自回滚训练以缓解 exposure bias，但为控制显存而 detach 历史 cache，切断了反向梯度路径，早期上下文的生成无法根据其在后续预测中的作用被优化。
Method: 跨自回归 chunk 重连梯度路径，梯度穿过生成的 latent 回传到产生它们的计算，而不止于历史 KV 写入；用 shortcut gradient replay 在不保留完整 rollout 计算图的前提下恢复跨 chunk 梯度；再与 distribution matching distillation 集成，使历史 chunk 同时受直接监督和对后续生成贡献的约束。
Result: 在自回归视频生成实验中，长时程视觉质量与时序一致性得到提升，且不改变推理流程；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把后续预测的梯度反馈回早期上下文的生成，可以在保持推理不变的前提下改善长视频自回归生成的质量与一致性，关键在于跨 chunk 梯度而非只做历史 KV 写入。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 跨自回归 chunk 重连梯度路径，梯度穿过生成的 latent 回传到产生它们的计算，而不止于历史 KV 写入；用 shortcut gradient replay 在不保留完整 rollout 计算图的前提下恢复跨 chunk 梯度；再与 distribution matching distillation 集成，使历史 chunk 同时受直接监督和对后续生成贡献的约束。
summary_sections.result: 在自回归视频生成实验中，长时程视觉质量与时序一致性得到提升，且不改变推理流程；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把后续预测的梯度反馈回早期上下文的生成，可以在保持推理不变的前提下改善长视频自回归生成的质量与一致性，关键在于跨 chunk 梯度而非只做历史 KV 写入。

papers.title: Toward Optimal Regret in Adversarial MDPs with Stochastic Hard Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study episodic constrained Markov decision processes with adversarial losses under stochastic hard constraints. Specifically, starting from a known strictly feasible policy with margin $d$, we seek to obtain optimal regret while satisfying the expected cost constraints in every episode. In this setting, Stradi et al. (2025) show that a carefully designed mixing rule attains regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\min\{d,d^2\})$. Interestingly, they also provide a lower bound of order $Ω(\sqrt{T}/ρ)$ for the same setting, where $ρ$ is the Slater margin of the offline problem and can be much larger than $d$. In this work, we build on their approach to obtain optimal regret dependence on these margins. Specifically, we propose MA-OPS, an algorithm that combines an optimistic search for the Slater margin with a pessimistic evaluation of the selected policies to safely learn a policy with a large feasibility margin. This policy is then used to minimize regret while satisfying the constraints at every episode. In particular, we show that MA-OPS attains regret $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/ρ+ 1/(dρ))$. Finally, we provide a matching lower bound, showing that the dependence on $T$, $d$, $ρ$ in the regret bound is optimal up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带随机硬约束的对抗性 MDP 中，提出 MA-OPS：对 Slater margin 做乐观搜索、对所选策略做悲观评估，从而学到可行裕度大的策略再用于最小化 regret。regret 达到 Õ(√T/ρ + 1/(dρ))，并给出匹配下界，说明对 T、d、ρ 的依赖在对数因子内最优。
Motivation: Stradi et al. (2025) 的混合规则得到 regret Õ(√T/min{d,d²})，而同设定下界为 Ω(√T/ρ)；离线问题的 Slater margin ρ 可远大于初始可行裕度 d，两者之间存在缺口。
Method: MA-OPS 结合对 Slater margin 的乐观搜索 (optimistic search) 与对所选策略的悲观评估 (pessimistic evaluation)，先安全地学到可行裕度大的策略，再用它在每个 episode 都满足期望成本约束的前提下最小化 regret。
Result: MA-OPS 的 regret 为 Õ(√T/ρ + 1/(dρ))；并给出匹配下界，表明对 T、d、ρ 的依赖在对数因子意义下最优。
Conclusion: 对抗性约束 MDP 的 regret 对 margin 的正确依赖由离线 Slater margin ρ 主导，而非初始裕度 d；该依赖在对数因子内不可改进。

papers.title: Bayesian Optimisation under State-Preservation Constraints
papers.abstract_en: In many engineering design problems, the objective and constraints depend on the state: the solution of a PDE determined by the design parameters. We consider improving a design while holding selected state observables near trusted values, which we call state preservation constraints. Constrained Bayesian optimisation handles these with a learnt feasibility model, but struggles with this problem's highly anisotropic feasible set. Our central idea is to pre-compute the set of controls whose linearised constraint response stays within tolerance, thereby pulling back the state-space constraint into design space. This linearisation defines an ellipsoid from which we can efficiently draw a large number of well-spread candidates. The underlying linear response map is refined online, and the ellipsoid is rebuilt accordingly. We demonstrate the method end-to-end on our key application - Tokamak divertor optimisation under plasma-boundary preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对设计参数经 PDE 决定状态、且需把状态观测量保持在可信值附近的工程优化，提出把状态空间约束经线性化拉回设计空间：预计算使线性化约束响应留在容差内的控制集，得到一个可高效大量采样候选点的椭球，并在线精修线性响应映射后重建椭球。端到端演示于 Tokamak divertor 在等离子体边界保持约束下的优化。
Motivation: 工程设计中目标与约束依赖 PDE 解出的状态，需在改进设计的同时把选定状态观测量保持在可信值附近；约束贝叶斯优化用学习的可行性模型处理时，难以应对该问题高度各向异性的可行集。
Method: 核心是把状态空间约束经线性化拉回设计空间 (pull back)：预计算线性化约束响应保持在容差内的控制集合，该线性化定义一个椭球，可从中高效抽取大量分布良好的候选；底层线性响应映射在线精修并据此重建椭球。
Result: 在关键应用 Tokamak divertor 在 plasma-boundary preservation 约束下的优化上端到端演示了该方法；摘要给出的是方法演示而非与基线的定量对比数字。
Conclusion: 把状态保持约束线性化拉回设计空间并在线更新椭球，是处理高度各向异性可行集的约束贝叶斯优化的一条可行路径，适用对象为状态由 PDE 决定的工程设计问题。

papers.title: Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning, and quantum neural networks (QNNs) in particular, are advancing fields with growing potential. Although systematic comparisons of QNN configurations have been explored primarily for classification tasks, comparatively little attention has been given to regression problems, particularly financial time series forecasting. This study presents a large-scale systematic comparative evaluation of QNN component configurations for financial time series forecasting, using the GBP/USD spot exchange rate as a case study. A grid search across encoding methods, ansatz designs, qubit counts, layer depths, and cost functions yields 1,368 distinct model configurations, each evaluated in terms of prediction accuracy, computational cost, and convergence behaviour. The results reveal unique insights into how the choice of methods influences performance, such as that gate selection and arrangement are more critical to model success than raw parameter count, and that entanglement is a system-level property of the full circuit rather than solely at the ansatz level. The best-performing QNN configuration achieves an $R^2$ score of 0.985, outperforming a classical BiLSTM baseline. Additionally, the impact of real quantum hardware noise is assessed through execution on the IQM Emerald device, revealing that gate errors and decoherence represent a significant barrier to practical deployment, with gate selection and circuit depth identified as key determinants of hardware noise resilience. Overall, the findings provide practical architectural guidance for QNN design and establish a baseline characterisation of QNN noise sensitivity on near-term quantum devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对量子神经网络 (QNN) 做金融时间序列回归的大规模配置网格搜索：以 GBP/USD 即期汇率为案例，遍历编码方式、ansatz 设计、量子比特数、线路深度与代价函数共 1,368 种配置。最佳配置 R² 达 0.985，超过经典 BiLSTM 基线；门的选择与排列比参数总量更关键，纠缠是整条线路的系统级属性。
Motivation: QNN 的系统性配置比较集中在分类任务，回归问题尤其是金融时间序列预测很少被覆盖，缺少可比的配置基准与噪声敏感性刻画。
Method: 在 GBP/USD 即期汇率上做网格搜索，遍历编码方法、ansatz 设计、量子比特数、层深与代价函数，得到 1,368 个模型配置，按预测精度、计算开销与收敛行为三项评估；另在 IQM Emerald 真机上执行以评估真实量子硬件噪声。
Result: 共评估 1,368 种 QNN 配置；最佳配置 R² = 0.985，优于经典 BiLSTM 基线。IQM Emerald 上的执行显示门误差与退相干是实际部署的显著障碍，门选择与线路深度是硬件噪声鲁棒性的关键决定因素。
Conclusion: QNN 设计应优先挑选门的类型与排列而非堆参数量，并把纠缠当作整条线路的性质来调；在近期量子设备上门误差与退相干仍限制实用部署。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Healthy Counterfactual Generation via Diffusion Inpainting for Mammography Classification
papers.abstract_en: False negatives remain a critical limitation of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems for breast cancer screening due to delayed detection and treatment. To address this issue, we propose a counterfactual data augmentation strategy that generates healthy mammograms by "erasing" lesions from anomalous images, thereby enriching the training distribution. We train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model on BI-RADS 1 (healthy) mammograms and use a RePaint-based sampling strategy to inpaint realistic normal tissue within annotated lesion bounding boxes. The resulting healthy counterfactuals replace annotated lesion regions with realistic healthy tissue while preserving patient-specific anatomical structure, as supported by similarity metrics between real and generated images. Image realism was further assessed by radiologists and found to be consistent with the original dataset quality. We evaluate counterfactual augmentation across four representative classifier architectures: a convolutional neural network (ConvNeXt), a vision transformer (ViT), a vision-language model pre-trained on mammogram-report pairs (Mammo-CLIP) and a multi-scale attention-based multiple-instance learning framework (FPN-MIL). Experiments conducted on the VinDr-Mammo dataset show improvements in sensitivity across all architectures, particularly at 80\% fixed specificity, contributing towards more reliable CAD systems for breast cancer. Code is available at: https://github.com/ines03garcia/diffusion-based-counterfactual-generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用扩散模型把乳腺 X 线中的病灶“擦除”生成健康反事实图像，作为数据增强扩充训练分布，在 VinDr-Mammo 上对四种分类架构均提升敏感度，尤其在 80% 固定特异度下。
Motivation: CAD 系统的假阴性导致乳腺癌延迟检出与治疗，训练分布中健康样本与病灶样本的不平衡是可改进点。
Method: 在 BI-RADS 1 健康乳腺 X 线图像上训练 Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model，用基于 RePaint 的采样策略在标注病灶边界框内补全真实正常组织，生成保留个体解剖结构的健康反事实图像并替换病灶区域做数据增强；在 ConvNeXt、ViT、Mammo-CLIP、FPN-MIL 四种分类器上评估。
Result: 在 VinDr-Mammo 数据集上，四种架构（ConvNeXt、ViT、Mammo-CLIP、FPN-MIL）的敏感度均有提升，在 80% 固定特异度下尤为明显；真实与生成图像的相似度指标支持解剖结构保留，放射科医师评估图像真实感与原数据集质量一致。
Conclusion: 扩散补全生成的健康反事实图像可作为有效数据增强，提升乳腺癌 CAD 在固定特异度下的敏感度，减少假阴性。

papers.title: Instruction-Conditioned Electromagnetic Spectrum Understanding via Budget-Adaptive Signal Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Electromagnetic spectrum monitoring increasingly requires flexible analysis beyond task-specific recognition and detection. Multimodal large language models offer a unified interface, but extending vision-language models (VLMs) to raw I/Q signals requires tokenization that balances fidelity against a strict budget. For signals, dense encoding causes token costs to grow with observation length, whereas fixed-resolution compression may discard short-duration or localized signal evidence. Thus, we propose \textbf{BATok}, a budget-adaptive signal tokenizer that adjusts token capacity to the input length while allocating that capacity according to the signal content. BATok constructs candidate representations from signal-derived features using lightweight multi-resolution branches, then combines a local energy prior with learnable queries to resample these representations into compact signal tokens. The number of tokens adapts to the input length while remaining strictly bounded. The resulting tokens are projected into the language embedding space of VLMs. We further introduce \textbf{EMSpec-Instruct}, a multimodal instruction dataset aligning raw I/Q signals, waterfall images, and language supervision for modulation recognition, structured detection, and language-conditioned signal grounding. Experiments show that BATok learns effective signal representations and achieves competitive performance across all tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BATok 把原始 I/Q 信号按输入长度自适应地压成有严格上限的信号 token，再投进 VLM 的语言嵌入空间，配合 EMSpec-Instruct 多模态指令数据集做调制识别、结构化检测与语言条件下的信号定位。摘要称其在全部任务上取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 把视觉语言模型扩展到原始 I/Q 信号时，稠密编码的 token 成本随观测长度增长，固定分辨率压缩又会丢掉短时或局部信号证据，需要在保真与预算之间折中的 tokenization。
Method: BATok 用轻量多分辨率分支从信号特征构造候选表示，以局部能量先验加可学习 query 对其重采样为紧凑信号 token，token 数随输入长度自适应且严格受限，再投影到 VLM 语言嵌入空间；配套构建 EMSpec-Instruct 指令数据集，对齐原始 I/Q、waterfall 图像与语言监督。
Result: 实验显示 BATok 学到有效的信号表示，并在调制识别、结构化检测、语言条件信号定位全部任务上取得有竞争力的表现。
Conclusion: 按输入长度自适应、按信号内容分配容量的 token 化，可以在严格 token 预算下支撑面向电磁频谱的多模态指令理解。

papers.title: Poster: A Preliminary Study of LLM Distillation Inference
papers.abstract_en: Unauthorized model distillation, in which a model is trained on the outputs of a proprietary large language model (LLM), is a growing threat to model providers. We study distillation inference: determining whether a suspect model was distilled from another model or trained independently. We formulate this problem as a hypothesis test and estimate the behavior expected under each hypothesis by training shadow models: distilled shadow models learn from the teacher's reasoning traces, whereas independent shadow models learn only from reference answers. The auditor measures how closely each model predicts the teacher's reasoning outputs and then uses the shadow models to convert the suspect's score into a calibrated p-value. In a preliminary study using Qwen2.5-7B as the teacher and Llama-3.2-3B for the suspects, our test achieves a true positive rate of 1.0 at a significance level of 0.02. These results demonstrate the feasibility of using distillation inference to detect distillation attacks.

papers.title: Q-Shaped Options for Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning to tackle long-horizon, goal-conditioned tasks requires an agent to reason over extended timescales and act across a broad range of states. In principle, Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) addresses both challenges through the interaction between action (temporal) and state (spatial) abstraction. First, using an action abstraction to represent temporally extended behaviour as options reduces the effective decision horizon. Second, enabling different state abstractions at each level of the decision process permits greater data aggregation for learning. However, realising these two benefits of a hierarchical policy depends on learning an appropriate action abstraction. Current HRL algorithms fail in one of two ways. Some discard distinctions between options needed for optimal control, undermining hierarchy altogether. Others retain unnecessary distinctions, preserving horizon reduction, but forfeiting coarser state abstraction. In this work, we characterise three desiderata for an action abstraction. We introduce Q-Shaped Options (QSO) to address all three. QSO builds on an architecture with distinct state-value functions, Q functions and policies at each level of the hierarchy. It learns the action abstraction between consecutive levels as a shared encoder shaped by their respective Q functions. The low-level Q function uses the option as a goal, encouraging the abstraction to retain distinctions necessary for optimal control. The high-level Q function uses it as an action, encouraging unnecessary distinctions to be discarded. Across offline goal-conditioned locomotion and manipulation environments, QSO learns semantically meaningful option spaces and outperforms baselines, achieving non-zero performance in tasks where all other evaluated algorithms fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Q-Shaped Options (QSO)，用层级间共享的 option 编码器同时满足动作抽象的三条要求：低层把 option 当目标以保留最优控制所需区分，高层把它当动作以丢弃多余区分。在离线目标条件的运动与操作任务上，QSO 学到语义上有意义的 option 空间，并在所有对比算法都失败的任务上取得非零性能。
Motivation: 现有 HRL 算法要么丢掉最优控制所需的 option 区分、层级形同虚设，要么保留过多区分、牺牲更粗粒度的状态抽象，无法同时兑现时间抽象与空间抽象两项收益。
Method: QSO 在层级每一层配备独立的 state-value 函数、Q 函数与策略；相邻层之间的动作抽象由一个共享编码器表示，并由两层各自的 Q 函数共同塑造：低层 Q 以 option 为目标，高层 Q 以 option 为动作。
Result: 在离线目标条件的 locomotion 与 manipulation 环境上，QSO 学到语义上有意义的 option 空间，整体优于基线，并在所有其他被评估算法均失败的任务上取得非零性能。
Conclusion: 把 option 同时当作低层目标与高层动作、用共享编码器承载抽象，可以兼顾最优控制所需的区分与更粗的状态抽象，从而在离线长时程目标任务上突破现有 HRL 的失败模式。

papers.title: OA-MAP: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Multimodal Framework for Interpretable Knee Osteoarthritis Progression
papers.abstract_en: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) progression prediction can support patient monitoring, requiring the integration of multimodal data and multidomain expertise. Moreover, isolated risk estimates provide limited insight underlying a prediction. To automate the progression assessment workflow and reduce manual effort while providing interpretable findings and supporting evidence, we present OA-MAP, an autonomous multi-agent framework for evidence-grounded assessment of structural and pain progression in KOA. The system incorporates modality-specific agents including MRI, X-ray, and clinical agents, together with a coordinator agent. This framework can autonomously recruit specialist agents, select tools for prediction and analysis, and retrieve literature as external evidence based on user request and available patient information. An uncertainty-informed human-in-the-loop mechanism enables clinicians to review and correct intermediate findings, triggering recomputation of affected results. We evaluate the prediction models using 600 participants from the FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium cohort. On the test set of 100 participants, the fusion models achieve AUROCs of 0.80 for structural progression and 0.68 for pain progression. A case study illustrates how OA-MAP combines risk estimates with intermediate findings, cross-modal conflicts, literature support, and uncertainty indicators to support interactive review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OA-MAP 是面向膝骨关节炎 (KOA) 进展的多智能体多模态框架，用 MRI、X-ray、临床三个模态专属智能体加一个协调器自主招募专家、选工具并检索文献作为外部证据，再由不确定性驱动的 human-in-the-loop 让临床医生纠正中间结果并触发重算。在 FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium 600 名参与者上训练、100 人测试集上，融合模型结构进展 AUROC 0.80、疼痛进展 0.68。
Motivation: KOA 进展评估需要整合多模态数据与多领域专长，而孤立的风险估计无法说明预测背后的依据，人工评估流程耗时且缺少可解释证据。
Method: 框架包含 MRI agent、X-ray agent、clinical agent 与 coordinator agent：协调器按用户请求和患者信息自主招募专科智能体、选择预测与分析工具、检索文献作为外部证据；不确定性信息驱动的 human-in-the-loop 供临床医生审查并纠正中间发现，触发受影响结果的重算；融合模型负责结构与疼痛两类进展预测。
Result: 在 FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium 队列 600 名参与者上评估预测模型，测试集 100 人上融合模型 AUROC：结构进展 0.80，疼痛进展 0.68；案例研究展示 OA-MAP 如何把风险估计与中间发现、跨模态冲突、文献支持和不确定性指示结合以支持交互式审查。
Conclusion: 把模态专属智能体、文献证据与不确定性 human-in-the-loop 组合起来，可在给出结构与疼痛进展风险的同时提供可审查的依据；疼痛进展的判别力明显低于结构进展。

papers.title: Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read
papers.abstract_en: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and it compresses faster than rereading the whole context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KV cache 压缩中「把上下文全部重读一遍再保留被注意的条目」在紧预算下反而失效：3% keep ratio 时 RULER 只剩 31.5/96.5 分，LongBench 自然文本任务上甚至输给完全不重读的方法。作者提出训练无关的 Attic-KV，让模型用引用上下文的问答对自测、并按内容自适应数量加入 anchor tokens，只改 rehearsal 就在 RULER 与 LongBench 的 8 个设置上成为最佳 training-free 方法，接入 KVgrad 与 RestoreKV+ 分别最多提升 17.1 与 28.1 分，3% keep ratio 下比全量重读高 41.9 分。
Motivation: KV cache 压缩普遍假设「cache 重读得越完整、记住得越好」，但在紧预算下重读把有限条目摊到整个上下文，答案自身的条目存活率仅略高于随机。
Method: Attic-KV 是 training-free 的 rehearsal 方案：模型用引用上下文的 question-answer 对自测（quiz itself），并按内容自适应数量加入 anchor tokens；两条原则是 rehearse what will be read 与 rehearse as much as there is。该机制可单独使用，也可插入基于梯度的 KVgrad 与训练式 RestoreKV+。
Result: 3% keep ratio 下全量重读在 RULER 上只保留 96.5 分中的 31.5 分，LongBench 自然文本任务上低于完全不重读的方法；Attic 单独使用在 RULER 与 LongBench 自然文本的全部 8 个设置上都是最佳 training-free 方法；接入 KVgrad 与 RestoreKV+ 分别最多提升 17.1 与 28.1 分；预算越紧优势越大，3% keep ratio 下比全量重读高 41.9 分，且压缩速度快于全量重读。
Conclusion: cache 记住的是它所重读的内容，因此应只重读将被读取的部分、并按实际内容量决定重读多少；在紧预算下按需 rehearsal 优于全量重读。

papers.title: A structure-preserving neural density functional for the ions of a polymer electrolyte
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the structure and response of inhomogeneous polymer electrolytes requires a description of ion correlations that retains molecular-scale accuracy while remaining transferable across spatial scales and geometries. We develop a neural density functional for electrolytes that preserves spatial symmetries, thermodynamic integrability and the Noether identities, with perfect screening recovered in stable, noncritical bulk states. Its nonlinear density dependence captures the concentration-dependent correlations missed by a pair closure, including a crossover from enhanced to suppressed long-wavelength number fluctuations at strong coupling. The functional describes density profiles at an untrained salt concentration and predicts bulk structure factors and the long-wavelength number response. Trained solely on planar density and internal-force profiles from molecular dynamics, the functional predicts ionic structure in larger domains and in two-dimensional external fields. On the same ion data, it is more accurate than three other neural density-functional architectures and keeps its accuracy with a quarter of the training runs, where the errors of the best alternative grow by about two thirds. The spatial transferability provides a necessary foundation for connecting molecular correlations to continuum predictions at larger scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出保持空间对称性、热力学可积性与 Noether 恒等式的聚合物电解质神经密度泛函，其非线性密度依赖刻画了对偶闭合 (pair closure) 遗漏的浓度相关关联，并在强耦合下给出长波数涨落从增强到抑制的交叉。仅用平面密度与内力剖面训练，它在未训练盐浓度、更大区域和二维外场中仍能预测离子结构；同等数据下精度优于另外三种神经密度泛函架构，且只需四分之一训练轮次，而最佳替代方案误差增大约三分之二。
Motivation: 非均匀聚合物电解质的离子关联描述需要兼顾分子尺度精度与跨尺度、跨几何的可迁移性，而对偶闭合遗漏浓度依赖关联，现有神经泛函也缺少对称性与热力学一致性约束。
Method: 构建结构保持的神经密度泛函：强制空间对称性、热力学可积性与 Noether 恒等式，并在稳定非临界体相中恢复完美屏蔽 (perfect screening)；训练数据仅来自分子动力学的平面密度剖面与内力剖面，非线性密度依赖用于刻画浓度依赖关联。
Result: 泛函描述了未训练盐浓度下的密度体面，并预测体相结构因子与长波数响应；在相同离子数据上精度优于另外三种神经密度泛函架构，且用四分之一训练轮次即可保持该精度，而最佳替代方案的误差增大约三分之二；同时给出强耦合下长波数涨落由增强转为抑制的交叉。
Conclusion: 把对称性、可积性与 Noether 恒等式作为硬约束写进神经密度泛函，可在只用平面剖面训练的前提下获得跨浓度、跨几何的离子结构预测，为把分子关联接到更大尺度的连续介质预测提供必要基础。

summary_sections.method: 构建结构保持的神经密度泛函：强制空间对称性、热力学可积性与 Noether 恒等式，并在稳定非临界体相中恢复完美屏蔽 (perfect screening)；训练数据仅来自分子动力学的平面密度剖面与内力剖面，非线性密度依赖用于刻画浓度依赖关联。
summary_sections.result: 泛函描述了未训练盐浓度下的密度体面，并预测体相结构因子与长波数响应；在相同离子数据上精度优于另外三种神经密度泛函架构，且用四分之一训练轮次即可保持该精度，而最佳替代方案的误差增大约三分之二；同时给出强耦合下长波数涨落由增强转为抑制的交叉。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把对称性、可积性与 Noether 恒等式作为硬约束写进神经密度泛函，可在只用平面剖面训练的前提下获得跨浓度、跨几何的离子结构预测，为把分子关联接到更大尺度的连续介质预测提供必要基础。

papers.title: An Investigation of Model Coherence: Narrow Finetunes Contradict Themselves Under Resampling
papers.abstract_en: A large body of research measures model coherence based on output variance without adequately considering competing causes. We identify two such causes, ambiguity and indifference, and we introduce a set of 175 questions where contradicting answers cannot easily be explained by either. We then measure incoherence in terms of contradictions when resampling answers to the same question. In contrast to other methods our metric has high specificity, and only ranks models as incoherent when the issues are glaring. Even so, we find narrow finetunes score poorly. Inspecting inconsistencies flagged by our method, we find that model organisms from the literature display severe issues such as identity conflation, introspection failures and rationalizations. These findings suggest that the pathologies induced by narrow finetuning may limit what these models can tell us about coherent misaligned behaviour.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/themachinefan/twominds
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文指出仅凭输出方差衡量模型一致性会混淆歧义与无所谓两种竞争成因，构造了 175 道两者都无法解释的矛盾问题集，以对同一问题重采样答案时的自相矛盾度量不一致。即便指标特异性很高、只在问题明显时才判为不一致，窄微调 (narrow finetune) 模型仍得分很差，文献中的 model organisms 出现身份混淆、内省失败与合理化等严重问题。
Motivation: 既有一致性研究多用输出方差度量，却未区分歧义 (ambiguity) 与无所谓 (indifference) 等竞争成因，导致不一致信号难以归因。
Method: 构造 175 道矛盾答案无法由歧义或无所谓解释的问题集；对同一问题重采样回答，以重采样间的矛盾数作为不一致度量，并强调该指标高特异性、仅在问题明显时才将模型判为不一致；随后人工检查被标记的不一致案例。
Result: 在该 175 题重采样矛盾度量下，窄微调模型得分很差；被标记的文献 model organisms 显示身份混淆 (identity conflation)、内省失败 (introspection failures) 与合理化 (rationalizations) 等严重问题。
Conclusion: 窄微调诱发的病理可能限制这些模型在告诉我们连贯的失准 (coherent misaligned) 行为方面的能力，即其输出难以代表真正连贯的失准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
papers.abstract_en: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LVS 对邻近视角不再重复渲染整个 3D Gaussian Splatting 场景，而是用相对位姿引导的 RGB-D 图像复用：几何 warping 搬运已有内容，轻量多尺度网络预测 RGB 残差补出新暴露区域并纠正深度误差，缓存的源特征进一步省算力。在 GS-render 上残差精修比纯 warping 把 PSNR 提高 0.72 dB，实拍与渲染场景评测显示查询延迟低。
Motivation: 交互式场景浏览需要频繁更新视角，而小幅相机运动保留了大部分可见内容，3DGS 仍逐视角全量渲染，图像重叠被浪费；纯几何 warping 又无法恢复新暴露内容且对深度误差敏感。
Method: 提出 per-scene 框架，用相对位姿引导的 RGB-D 图像复用替代邻近视角的重复场景渲染：几何 warping 依深度与相对位姿搬运源内容，轻量多尺度网络预测 RGB 残差以纠正伪影并补全缺失外观，同时缓存源特征以减少重复计算。
Result: 在 GS-render 上，残差精修相比纯 warping 将 PSNR 提升 0.72 dB；在实拍与渲染场景上的评测显示低查询延迟。
Conclusion: 把场景渲染与局部视角更新分离，可在保持响应式场景浏览的同时支撑 AR/VR 应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SuperNav 为服务机器人导航提出免微调的 agent harness：保留预训练 MLLM 的通用能力，只让它解读请求、理解场景并决策，把运动执行交给 Navigation Skills 与 Tools，通过统一的视觉-点接口在图像中直接指定目的地并依据执行反馈修正决策。在 instance-level、multi-object、demand-driven 任务上超过 4 个评测基线，并在 HM3D 类别级评测与真实四足机器人部署中验证跨环境适用性。
Motivation: 现有方法靠微调 MLLM 预测导航动作，行为受导航训练数据覆盖限制，难以泛化到新请求与陌生环境。
Method: 为预训练 MLLM 配套 agent harness，不做导航专用微调；包含 Navigation Skills、面向 agent 的物理交互 Tools、任务进度与上下文管理；统一 visual-point 接口让模型在图像中直接指定目的地，并从执行反馈中修正决策。
Result: 在 instance-level、multi-object、demand-driven 三类任务上优于 4 个被评测基线；在 HM3D 上做类别级 (category-level) 评测，并部署到真实四足机器人验证跨环境适用性。
Conclusion: 让 MLLM 专注请求理解与决策、把运动执行外包给导航工具，可以在不微调的前提下同时获得任务通用性与场景通用性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Use and Disuse: Intent-Structured Experience Consolidation for Memory and Learning in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The evolution of Large Language Model agents from single-task execution to long-term autonomous operation highlights the critical challenge of transforming continuous experiences into reusable knowledge. To address this, we propose Hippocam, a hierarchical memory and continual learning architecture. Hippocam draws inspiration from two characteristics of human memory: cognitive processes selectively maintain information relevant to current goals, while long-term memories form gradually through repeated consolidation. Accordingly, Hippocam structures an agent's ongoing work as nested intents. The active context remains centered on the current intent, while completed intents are consolidated into the task-relevant outcomes and state needed for subsequent work, rather than carrying forward their full working details. Concurrently, a recursive prefix consolidation mechanism repeatedly consolidates earlier history, causing long-unused experiences to become increasingly abstract. Original interactions are preserved, allowing the agent to progressively recover finer-grained details through the hierarchy and stop once sufficient information is available. Crucially, when past experiences are recalled and reintegrated into active work, they undergo subsequent consolidation alongside new experiences, thereby being reinforced, supplemented, and updated. Through this memory dynamic of use and disuse, Hippocam connects working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning within a single continuously evolving experiential process. This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLM agent 的分层记忆与持续学习架构 Hippocam：把正在进行的工作组织成嵌套 intent，活跃上下文只围绕当前 intent，已完成 intent 被固化为后续所需的任务相关结果与状态；再用递归前缀固化 (recursive prefix consolidation) 让久未使用的经验逐层抽象，原始交互仍保留、可按需逐级恢复细节。被召回的经验会与新经验一起再次固化而被强化和更新，agent 因此在不更新参数的情况下靠自身经验积累知识与技能。
Motivation: LLM agent 从单任务执行转向长期自主运行时，持续产生的交互难以转化为可复用知识：完整工作细节被不断带入上下文，既冗余又让旧经验无法沉淀成能力。
Method: Hippocam 借鉴人类记忆的两个特征——认知过程按当前目标选择性保留信息、长期记忆靠反复固化逐渐形成——设计三层机制：以嵌套 intent 结构化 agent 的持续工作并让活跃上下文围绕当前 intent；对已完成 intent 固化出任务相关结果与状态；递归前缀固化反复压缩早期历史使其日益抽象，同时保留原始交互供层级式细节恢复，召回的经验与新经验一同再固化。
Result: 摘要给出的是机制层面的定性结论：通过 use 与 disuse 的记忆动态，Hippocam 把工作上下文、长期记忆、知识积累与技能学习连进同一个持续演化的经验过程，使 agent 不做参数更新即可从自身经验中学习并演化能力。
Conclusion: 作者主张记忆的使用与废弃本身就是一条不依赖参数更新的能力积累路径：被反复调用的经验被强化更新，闲置经验则抽象化，细节按需逐级恢复。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Using Weisfeiler-Leman Features for Algorithm Selection in Constraint Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Algorithm Selection is essential for efficient Constraint Programming. Over the years, many algorithm selectors based on machine learning methods have been successfully applied, yet traditional feature extraction methods often rely on manually decided instance-level statistics that fail to capture the underlying problem structure. In this paper we aim to bridge this gap by introducing a novel, automated feature extraction methodology that integrates graph conversion and Weisfeiler-Lehman graph kernels to generate robust structural representations of problem instances. The 1-WL test bounds the graph-distinguishing power of standard message-passing Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and suitable GNN architectures match this bound \citep{Xuetal2018}. WL-based features offer an alternative that does not require training a GNN. Our primary contribution is a cut-based representation (\texttt{WLc}) designed to model structural partitions and provide a more nuanced predictive signal. We evaluate our approach on instances from the 2023--2025 MiniZinc Challenges across two tasks: maximizing Borda count scores and maximizing predictive accuracy. Experimental results across Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and Multi-Layer Perceptrons demonstrate that cut-based features outperform \texttt{fzn2feat} with SVMs, while results with RFs and MLPs are closer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在约束优化的算法选择中，用图转换加 Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) 图核自动生成实例结构特征，主贡献是基于割的表示 WLc 来刻画结构划分。在 2023–2025 MiniZinc Challenges 实例上，WLc 特征配 SVM 在 Borda count 与预测准确率两项任务上超过 fzn2feat，配 RF 和 MLP 时差距较小。
Motivation: 传统算法选择的特征依赖人工设定的实例级统计量，抓不住问题的底层结构；而训练 GNN 又需要额外成本，WL 特征提供免训练的替代。
Method: 把约束问题实例转成图，用 Weisfeiler-Leman 图核生成结构表示，核心是割基表示 WLc 以建模结构划分；再把特征喂给 SVM、Random Forest、MLP 做算法选择，与 fzn2feat 对比。
Result: 在 2023–2025 MiniZinc Challenges 实例上评估两个任务：最大化 Borda count 分数与最大化预测准确率。WLc 特征配 SVM 时优于 fzn2feat；配 RF 与 MLP 时结果与 fzn2feat 更接近。
Conclusion: 免训练的 WL 割基特征可作为约束优化算法选择中人工统计特征的替代，其优势在 SVM 上最明显，换到 RF/MLP 则收窄。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Credal Machine Learning for Risk-Averse Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: In many machine learning applications, it is necessary to guard against worst-case scenarios and predictions that could result in substantial losses. In principle, this can be achieved by training risk-averse predictive models that minimize loss functions such as conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), rather than relying on models that perform well on average. In practice, however, the effectiveness of this approach to risk aversion is undermined by the learner's uncertainty regarding the true loss distribution and, consequently, the true CVaR. To achieve reliable risk-aversion, we propose a method in which this (epistemic) uncertainty is represented in terms of credal sets, i.e., sets of probability distributions. More specifically, we develop an efficient yet reliable learner that produces predictions in the form of credal sets and combine it with a novel decision rule that maps each credal set to a single predictive distribution for CVaR minimization. Across classification, under distribution shift, and in reinforcement learning, our approach reliably avoids catastrophic decisions, while sacrificing little in expected performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 credal set（概率分布集合）刻画学习器对真实损失分布的认知不确定性，训练输出 credal set 预测的模型，再用新决策规则把每个 credal set 映射为单一预测分布以最小化 CVaR。在分类、分布偏移与强化学习三类设定下，该方法可靠地避开灾难性决策，同时期望性能损失很小。
Motivation: 用 CVaR 等风险规避损失训练预测模型时，学习器对真实损失分布、进而对真实 CVaR 存在认知不确定性，导致名义上的风险规避在实践中失效。
Method: 以 credal set 表示认知不确定性，开发一个高效可靠的 learner 输出 credal set 形式的预测，并结合新决策规则将每个 credal set 映射为用于 CVaR 最小化的单一预测分布。
Result: 在分类、分布偏移 (distribution shift) 与强化学习三类场景中，方法可靠地避免灾难性决策，同时在期望性能上只牺牲很少。
Conclusion: 把认知不确定性显式建成 credal set 并在决策层做 CVaR 最小化，可以在不明显牺牲平均性能的前提下获得可靠的风险规避。

papers.title: Universal Textual Teaching for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from stronger Teacher models to weaker Student models, but most methods require training the Student parameters, thereby binding the distilled knowledge to a specific architecture and checkpoint. This implicit representation is difficult to interpret or reuse across models and limits KD for API-only or costly-to-train models. This paper studies knowledge transfer for large language models (LLMs). We introduce Universal Textual Teaching (UTT), a parameter-update-free framework that distills observed Teacher-Student knowledge gaps into a textual, interpretable, and reusable natural-language artifact called Primer. Specifically, UTT first identifies representative gap cases through paired evaluations, and iteratively updates the Primer via multi-role interactions: the Student attempts each task, the Prompter turns evaluation feedback into a teaching instruction, the Teacher provides a targeted demonstration, and the Synthesizer consolidates validated lessons. Empirically, on the challenging math (Omni-MATH-2) and code generation (KernelBench) tasks, extensive results confirm the effectiveness of the method: UTT remarkably raises the Student's accuracy from 9.4% to 48.6% and Fast1 accuracy from 9% to 35% on KernelBench, while increasing mathematical reasoning accuracy from 27.6% to 51.7%. UTT also performs better than representative prompt engineering and parameter-based KD methods. Of note, UTT is shown to be generalizable across different Teachers and Students: a Primer synthesized for one Teacher-Student pair can generalize to other Students that do not participate in the synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UTT 把强弱模型之间的知识差距蒸馏成可复用的自然语言制品 Primer，全程不更新 Student 参数。在 KernelBench 上 Student 准确率从 9.4% 提到 48.6%、Fast1 从 9% 提到 35%，Omni-MATH-2 数学推理从 27.6% 提到 51.7%，且优于代表性 prompt engineering 与参数式 KD 方法。
Motivation: 主流知识蒸馏 (KD) 必须训练 Student 参数，知识被绑死在特定架构与 checkpoint 上，隐式表示难以解释或跨模型复用，对只能调 API 或训练成本高的模型尤其受限。
Method: UTT 通过成对评估 (paired evaluations) 找出代表性差距样本，再用多角色交互迭代更新 Primer：Student 作答，Prompter 把评估反馈转成教学指令，Teacher 给出针对性示范，Synthesizer 汇总已验证的经验。
Result: KernelBench 上 Student 准确率 9.4% → 48.6%，Fast1 准确率 9% → 35%；Omni-MATH-2 数学推理准确率 27.6% → 51.7%；整体优于代表性 prompt engineering 与基于参数的 KD 方法。
Conclusion: 知识蒸馏可以脱离参数更新，以可解释、可复用的文本制品承载；为某对 Teacher-Student 合成的 Primer 能迁移到未参与合成的其他 Student。

papers.title: A Geometric Approach to Soft Actor-Critic with Zonotopes for Locomotion Learning
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy actor--critic methods control overestimation bias by taking the minimum of two critics. This uses the same aggregation rule everywhere, regardless of how the critics disagree. We propose \textbf{GeZo-SAC}, which uses auxiliary geometric representations to adapt critic pessimism to the state and action. Alongside its scalar value, each critic predicts a set of generators defining a zonotope. Probing this zonotope along sampled directions provides a geometric width, "subtracted from each critic value as a pessimistic offset, and a measure of disagreement between the two critics, aggregated with log-sum-exp. This disagreement controls how the critics are combined, moving from a width-weighted average toward the usual minimum as disagreement increases. At inference, the deployed policy is an unmodified SAC actor, since the generators are used only on the critic side during training.Across four MuJoCo-v5 locomotion benchmarks and six off-policy baselines, GeZo-SAC achieves the highest mean return on Ant-v5 and Hopper-v5 and remains competitive with other methods on the remaining tasks. Our analysis further shows that GeZo-SAC achieves the lowest average actuator work and action effort per metre among the evaluated methods, while maintaining near-zero measured overestimation frequency across all four environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeZo-SAC 在 SAC 双 critic 之外各加一组 zonotope 生成元，用沿采样方向探测得到的几何宽度作为悲观偏移，并以 log-sum-exp 聚合两 critic 的分歧度来控制融合方式：分歧越大越接近常规取最小值。在四个 MuJoCo-v5 运动基准上，它在 Ant-v5 与 Hopper-v5 取得最高平均回报，且四个环境的实测过估计频率接近零。
Motivation: off-policy actor-critic 用双 critic 取最小值抑制过估计偏差，但该聚合规则在所有状态-动作上一视同仁，不利用两个 critic 的分歧结构。
Method: 每个 critic 除标量价值外还预测一组定义 zonotope 的生成元；沿采样方向探测 zonotope 得到几何宽度，从各自 critic 值中减去作为悲观偏移，并给出两 critic 间的分歧度，用 log-sum-exp 聚合。分歧度控制融合权重，从按宽度加权的平均过渡到取最小值；推理时部署未改动的 SAC actor，生成元仅在训练期的 critic 侧使用。
Result: 在四个 MuJoCo-v5 locomotion 基准、六个 off-policy 基线上，GeZo-SAC 在 Ant-v5 与 Hopper-v5 取得最高平均回报，其余任务保持竞争力；其每米平均执行器功与动作努力在所评估方法中最低，且四个环境的实测过估计频率接近零。
Conclusion: 把 critic 悲观度做成随状态-动作变化的几何量，可以在不改推理策略的前提下同时压低过估计并降低运动控制的动作能耗。

papers.title: ContourVLA: A Closed-Loop Perception-Action Contour Policy for Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Generalized referring expression segmentation (GRES) requires dynamically balancing high-level semantics for identifying a variable number of language-specified referents with fine-grained visual evidence for precise boundary delineation. This requirement challenges existing cascaded vision-language architectures, which typically rely on static feature interfaces and single-pass mask prediction, limiting adaptive perception and geometric correction. We introduce ContourVLA, a vision-language-action policy that recasts GRES as a closed-loop visuomotor process, in which editable contours serve as explicit policy states that condition multimodal perception and are updated by geometric action chunks. Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) couples contour-guided bidirectional boundary sampling with state-conditioned routing of multilevel multimodal features, adapting perception to each contour state. Following supervised initialization, Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) jointly optimizes discrete grounding and continuous contour actions with instance-level credits. Its rollout rewards and credits are derived from soft prediction-target correspondences that account for false positives and missed targets. ContourVLA improves gIoU over the strongest evaluated baselines by 8.7, 2.8, and 2.7 points on gRefCOCO val, testA, and testB, respectively, and achieves the highest mIoU across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContourVLA 把广义指代表达分割 (GRES) 改写成闭环视觉-语言-动作策略：可编辑轮廓作为策略状态驱动感知，几何动作块更新轮廓，再用 DECT-GRPO 联合优化离散定位与连续轮廓动作。在 gRefCOCO val/testA/testB 上 gIoU 比最强基线分别高 8.7、2.8、2.7 点，并在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg 全部八个 split 上取得最高 mIoU。
Motivation: 级联视觉-语言架构依赖静态特征接口与单次 mask 预测，无法在识别变数量指代对象与精细边界勾勒之间自适应感知和几何纠错。
Method: 以可编辑轮廓为显式策略状态，几何动作块 (action chunks) 更新轮廓形成闭环；Evolution-Aware Semantic Scheduling (EASS) 把轮廓引导的双向边界采样与多层级多模态特征的状态条件路由耦合；监督初始化后用 Dustbin-Augmented Entropic Credit Transport GRPO (DECT-GRPO) 联合优化离散 grounding 与连续轮廓动作，rollout 奖励与 credit 由计入假阳与漏检的软预测-目标对应关系导出。
Result: gIoU 相对最强评估基线在 gRefCOCO val、testA、testB 上分别提升 8.7、2.8、2.7 点；在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCoG 共八个 split 上取得最高 mIoU。
Conclusion: 把 GRES 当作轮廓状态驱动的闭环感知-动作过程，并用实例级 credit 的强化学习联合优化定位与边界，可在保持多目标指代精度的同时改善边界质量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Could LLM Watermark Detection be Public?
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking large language models is popular for tracing chatbot and agentic outputs, yet detectors remain unreleased since exposing them could let attackers do targeted edits with the detector's feedback. However, watermarks are already vulnerable to uninformed tampering attacks. We thus first quantify whether a public detector would be an additional liability in a deployment setting at varying levels of access, from token-level scores to a binary verdict. Second, we introduce a split-key public-private watermarking method that exposes one key through a public detector while keeping the other for full verification and forensics. An informed attacker can only move the public signal, creating an imbalance between public and private scores. We introduce a statistical test for this imbalance, and combine it with the full key verdict in a two-stage mechanism. Third, we evaluate the split-key method on a wide range of removal and forgery attacks, comparing the uninformed to detector-informed settings. Public detection improves removal only at small edit budgets, since plain rephrasing already strips the watermark at a lower quality cost, but it does enable forgery, which the private pipeline can identify. Overall, releasing half of the watermark enables transparency and interoperability, and tampering with the released half stays detectable. This bounds the provider's liability and questions the need to keep detectors fully private.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文量化了公开 LLM 水印检测器在不同访问级别（token 级分数到二元判定）下是否构成额外安全负债，并提出 split-key 公私钥水印：公开一个 key 供检测器使用，保留另一个 key 做完整验证与取证。发现知情攻击者只能移动公开信号、造成公私分数失衡，可用统计检验配合两阶段机制识别；公开检测只在小编辑预算下改善移除攻击，但确实使伪造成为可能且能被私有管线检出。
Motivation: 水印检测器因担心给攻击者反馈、便于定向编辑而普遍不公开，但水印本身已能被不知情篡改攻击破坏，因此需要量化公开检测器到底新增多少风险。
Method: 先在部署场景中按访问级别（token 级分数到二元判定）量化公开检测器的额外负债；再提出 split-key 公私钥水印，公开一个 key、保留另一个 key 做完整验证，并针对公私分数失衡设计统计检验，与完整 key 判定组成两阶段机制。
Result: 在广泛的移除与伪造攻击上对比不知情与 detector-informed 设定：公开检测仅在小编辑预算下改善移除（因单纯改写已能以更低质量代价去掉水印），但确实使伪造可行，而私有管线能识别该伪造。
Conclusion: 公开一半水印 key 即可实现透明与互操作，且对已公开部分的篡改仍可被检测，从而限定提供方责任，并质疑检测器必须完全私有的必要性。

summary_sections.method: 先在部署场景中按访问级别（token 级分数到二元判定）量化公开检测器的额外负债；再提出 split-key 公私钥水印，公开一个 key、保留另一个 key 做完整验证，并针对公私分数失衡设计统计检验，与完整 key 判定组成两阶段机制。
summary_sections.result: 在广泛的移除与伪造攻击上对比不知情与 detector-informed 设定：公开检测仅在小编辑预算下改善移除（因单纯改写已能以更低质量代价去掉水印），但确实使伪造可行，而私有管线能识别该伪造。
summary_sections.conclusion: 公开一半水印 key 即可实现透明与互操作，且对已公开部分的篡改仍可被检测，从而限定提供方责任，并质疑检测器必须完全私有的必要性。

papers.title: VINCIE-NExT: Unlocking Video Editing from Images via In-Context Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Building a capable video editor remains significantly harder than a video generator: editing requires (source, instruction, edited) triplets that are prohibitively expensive to annotate and difficult to synthesize at scale, whereas image editing has already reached maturity with millions of such pairs readily available. In this work, we introduce VINCIE-NExT, a unified framework that transfers editing capability from images to videos through in-context visual demonstrations, alleviating the need for large-scale paired video editing data. VINCIE-NExT decomposes video editing into a structured chain of composable sub-tasks (Video -> Image -> Image -> Video), routing editing intent through the image domain and enabling scalable joint training from heterogeneous image and video corpora under a unified diffusion objective. An image editing pair, synthesized by the model or supplied by the user, is prepended as an in-context visual demonstration that serves as a spatial appearance blueprint for every output frame. To ground appearance edits across the interleaved context, we introduce a novel position encoding that links image demonstrations and video frames in a shared spatial coordinate system, enabling pixel-faithful propagation of appearance changes to every output frame. Chain-of-Editing further provides principled test-time scaling: by executing the sub-task chain as progressive diffusion stages, editing quality can be improved by investing additional compute without retraining. Comprehensive experiments on OpenVE-Bench demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across diverse editing categories, with ablations confirming the effectiveness of each component.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS'26. Project page: https://vincie-next.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VINCIE-NExT 把视频编辑拆成 Video→Image→Image→Video 的可组合子任务链，把编辑意图路由到图像域，并把一对图像编辑样例作为 in-context 视觉示范前置，用共享空间坐标的新型位置编码把外观改动逐像素传播到每一输出帧。在 OpenVE-Bench 上跨多类编辑任务达到 state-of-the-art，Chain-of-Editing 允许不重训、靠追加推理算力逐级扩散提升编辑质量。
Motivation: 视频编辑需要 (source, instruction, edited) 三元组，标注成本极高且难以大规模合成；而图像编辑已有数百万对成熟数据，能力无法直接迁移到视频。
Method: 将视频编辑分解为 Video→Image→Image→Video 的结构化子任务链，在统一 diffusion 目标下对异构图像与视频语料做联合训练；把模型合成或用户提供的图像编辑对前置为 in-context 视觉示范，作为每帧的空间外观蓝图；提出把图像示范与视频帧关联到同一空间坐标系的新位置编码；Chain-of-Editing 把子任务链执行为渐进 diffusion 阶段，实现测试时算力扩展。
Result: 在 OpenVE-Bench 上跨多种编辑类别取得 state-of-the-art 表现，消融实验确认各组件均有效；测试时通过追加算力可在不重训的情况下提升编辑质量。
Conclusion: 把编辑能力从图像经 in-context 示范路由到视频，可绕开大规模成对视频编辑数据的需求；外观编辑的跨帧一致性依赖把示范与帧放进共享空间坐标系。

papers.title: Few-Step Generation via Data-Space Iteration
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 data-space iteration：把少步生成的迭代从概率流上搬到数据空间，共享生成器直接在数据空间逐步精修预测，每次迭代都训练成在该步数容量下能产出的最好样本，从而完全去掉 flow 的时间步离散化。在 class-conditional ImageNet 256x256 上，该方法优于标准离散化基线，并匹配或超过经 schedule search 挑出的变体，且不需要 schedule 专属训练。
Motivation: Flow matching 采样需要大量网络评估，蒸馏到一到几步时一步生成常牺牲质量；现有少步方法沿概率流迭代，依赖手工启发式选择且调参昂贵的时间步离散化，当不同样本或空间位置精修难度不同时该离散化还具有限制性。
Method: 从噪声出发，用一个共享生成器在数据空间直接迭代精修预测，每次迭代以产出该容量下最优样本为目标来训练；框架与 distribution matching distillation (DMD) 以最小改动整合，从而在匹配的训练设置下受控比较不同迭代方式。
Result: 在 class-conditional ImageNet 256x256 上，data-space iteration 超过标准离散化基线，并匹配或改进经 schedule search 选出的变体，且无需 schedule-specific training。
Conclusion: 数据空间迭代是离散化 flow 空间迭代的简单有效替代，去掉时间步离散化即可实现快速生成。

papers.title: SCORE: Spectral Correlation Estimation for Multivariate Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: Neural network-based predictive modeling with high-dimensional structured Gaussian targets requires an efficient and numerically stable, yet expressive approximation of the covariance matrix. We propose SCORE: a scalable framework, combining scoring rule training with an expressive covariance approximation learned in spectral space. For $d$-dimensional data, the learning task is decomposed into learning the marginal distributions and learning a structured correlation matrix, which enables dense dependencies with linear storage and $\mathcal{O}(d\log d)$ cost. We utilize the closed form Gaussian kernel score for training, which remains defined even for degenerate covariances and admits bounded gradients during optimization. We characterize kernel scores under invertible transforms and prove exact invariance under unitary transforms. At population level, our two-level objective recovers the true marginals and projects the target correlation onto the representable class; finite-sample PAC bounds show that the errors of the two stages enter additively. We evaluate our model on a variety of tasks with a commonly assumed Gaussian domain: Time-series forecasting, monocular depth estimation, and spatial weather prediction, showing improved performance at lower computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCORE 用评分规则 (scoring rule) 训练加谱空间中的结构化相关矩阵近似，把 d 维高斯目标的学习拆成边缘分布与相关矩阵两部分，实现线性存储与 O(d log d) 代价的稠密依赖建模。在时间序列预报、单目深度估计与空间天气预报三类任务上以更低计算代价取得更好表现。
Motivation: 高维结构化高斯目标的神经预测需要既高效数值稳定、又能表达稠密依赖的协方差近似，直接建协方差矩阵在存储与计算上不可行。
Method: SCORE 将学习分解为边缘分布与结构化相关矩阵两部分，相关矩阵在谱空间学习；训练用闭式 Gaussian kernel score，该分数在协方差退化时仍有定义且梯度有界。理论上刻画 kernel score 在可逆变换下的性质并证明酉变换下精确不变；总体层面两层目标恢复真实边缘并把目标相关投影到可表示类，有限样本 PAC 界给出两阶段误差的加性分解。
Result: 在假定高斯域的三类任务上评估：时间序列预报、单目深度估计、空间天气预测，均以更低计算代价取得改进表现；存储为线性、代价为 O(d log d)，并有有限样本 PAC 加性误差界。
Conclusion: 把高维协方差建模拆成边缘与谱空间相关矩阵两阶段，配合闭式 kernel score，可在保持表达力的同时把代价降到线性存储与 O(d log d)，并在高斯型任务上以更低成本提升精度。
