papers.title: FearCaut-Qwen: Affective Steering in a Vision-Language Model Shifts the Decision Criterion for Hazard Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential for damage assessment after a disaster, but a recurring deficiency is that they are reluctant to declare a hazard; that is, recall is low even when overall accuracy appears adequate. This study examines that deficiency by using signal detection theory to decompose the decision behavior into perceptual capability and decision-criterion placement. We then propose a novel method for correcting the over-conservative decision policy, inspired by the finding that fear makes humans risk-averse, and ask whether an affective representation associated with fear can be causally manipulated to similarly alter a VLM's decision tendency. Using mechanistic interpretability, we localize a causally implicated affective circuit in the model and use activation steering to manipulate it while observing the effect on downstream prediction. The method is tested on a two-stage SeisMLLM pipeline built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which flags only 27.0% of genuinely unsafe buildings on the SeisMLLM-1K test split and never issues a false Red, an SDT criterion of c = +1.354, despite adequate evidence quality (d' = 1.521). An affective direction is localized on emotion-rich natural scenes, causally validated by sparse-neuron knockout and distributed steering on held-out emotion data, and then injected into the building task. Fear-direction injection raises Red recall to 75.7% (p<0.001), and subtracting the same direction suppresses Red predictions entirely, whereas norm-matched random and matched happiness directions show no significant effect. The mechanism is a shift in criterion (c=-1.515) while discrimination is not improved (d'=-0.493). These results show that VLM decisions can be adjusted at inference time without retraining and demonstrate how mechanistic interpretability can be used to diagnose and control VLM decision behaviors in engineering applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 VLM 在灾后建筑危险评估中过度保守、宁可漏报也不报 Red 的问题，用信号检测理论 (SDT) 把行为拆成辨别力 d' 与判据 c，再用 activation steering 注入在情绪场景上定位的 fear 方向。在 SeisMLLM-1K 测试集上，Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 基线只报出 27.0% 真正不安全建筑且从不误报 Red（c=+1.354，d'=1.521）；注入 fear 方向后 Red recall 升到 75.7%（p<0.001），减去同一方向则完全压制 Red，而等范数随机方向与 happiness 方向无显著效应。
Motivation: VLM 做灾后损伤评估时总体准确率看似够高，但危险召回率低、从不给出 Red 判定；这种过度保守的决策倾向需要被区分于感知能力不足，才能对症纠正。
Method: 先用 SDT 把预测分解为 d' 与判据 c；再用 mechanistic interpretability 在情绪丰富自然场景上定位与 fear 关联的因果情感回路，经 sparse-neuron knockout 与 distributed steering 在留出情绪数据上做因果验证，最后把该 affective direction 注入基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 的两阶段 SeisMLLM 管线，在建筑任务上做推理期 steering，对照等范数随机方向与匹配的 happiness 方向。
Result: 基线在 SeisMLLM-1K 测试集上 Red recall 27.0%、零误报 Red，c=+1.354、d'=1.521；fear 方向注入后 Red recall 升至 75.7%（p<0.001），判据移到 c=-1.515 而辨别力未改善（d'=-0.493）；减去同一方向使 Red 预测完全消失，随机方向与 happiness 方向无显著影响。
Conclusion: VLM 的危险判定倾向可在推理期通过情感方向 steering 直接改写，且改变的是判据 c 而非辨别力 d'，说明 mechanistic interpretability 能诊断并控制工程应用中的 VLM 决策行为，无需重训练。

summary_sections.result: 基线在 SeisMLLM-1K 测试集上 Red recall 27.0%、零误报 Red，c=+1.354、d'=1.521；fear 方向注入后 Red recall 升至 75.7%（p<0.001），判据移到 c=-1.515 而辨别力未改善（d'=-0.493）；减去同一方向使 Red 预测完全消失，随机方向与 happiness 方向无显著影响。
summary_sections.conclusion: VLM 的危险判定倾向可在推理期通过情感方向 steering 直接改写，且改变的是判据 c 而非辨别力 d'，说明 mechanistic interpretability 能诊断并控制工程应用中的 VLM 决策行为，无需重训练。

papers.title: Example-driven Parametrisations for Bayesian Shape Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimisation is the natural tool for shape design when objectives are expensive and non-differentiable, but it needs a compact yet expressive parameterisation of the search space. Hand-crafting one is a complex endeavour requiring domain expertise, and often yields implicit infeasible regions, artificial bounds, and coupled, unordered coordinates. We instead learn the parameterisation from a collection of existing designs, applying principal component analysis to the deformations between shapes. The result is a linear, interpretable search space in which the number of components explicitly trades expressivity against dimensionality. Across aerofoils, wings, and radio-frequency cavities, spanning 2D geometry to 3D aerodynamics and electromagnetics, we show improved sample efficiency and the ability to explore beyond the confines of hand-crafted baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把贝叶斯形状优化的搜索空间参数化改为从已有设计集合中学习：对形状之间的形变做 PCA，得到线性、可解释、维数可调的低维空间，再交给 Bayesian optimisation。在 aerofoil、机翼与射频腔三类对象上（2D 几何到 3D 空气动力学与电磁学），该学习参数化相比手工参数化提高了样本效率，并能探索到手工基线之外的区域。
Motivation: 手工设计搜索空间参数化需要领域经验，还常带来隐式不可行区域、人为边界以及耦合无序的坐标，限制了昂贵且不可微目标下的贝叶斯优化。
Method: 收集已有形状设计，计算形状之间的形变并对其做主成分分析 (PCA)，得到线性、可解释的搜索空间，其中主成分个数显式权衡表达力与维度；随后在该空间上做 Bayesian optimisation。
Result: 在 aerofoil、wing、radio-frequency cavity 三类对象上（覆盖 2D 几何、3D 空气动力学与电磁学），相较手工参数化基线表现出更高的样本效率，并能探索手工基线之外的区域。
Conclusion: 形状优化的搜索空间参数化可以从已有设计中学习得到，用主成分个数直接控制表达力与维度的取舍，从而替代需要领域经验的手工参数化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient quadratic entropy with distance sketches
papers.abstract_en: We detail scalable methods for approximating the quadratic entropy $p^T d p$ for arbitrary distributions $p$ and common distances $d$ of negative type. We focus on the Euclidean and spherical geodesic cases, which both use random feature embeddings and projections to dramatically improve computational complexity within a simple framework. Amortization of a single large matrix multiplication and control variates further enable computation at large scale with low memory and runtime in situations where $d$ is held constant while $p$ varies. We demonstrate this with a comparison against direct pair sampling and bibliometric/scientometric examples on Open Graph Benchmark datasets, revealing papers, fields, and institutions with both particularly narrow and broad interdisciplinary reach from their citations and text features alone.
papers.comment: Code for reproducing results in LaTeX comments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用随机特征嵌入与投影近似负型距离下的二次熵 p^T d p，配合单次大矩阵乘法摊销与控制变量 (control variates)，在 d 固定、p 变化时以低内存低运行时完成大规模计算。与直接配对采样对比，并在 Open Graph Benchmark 数据集上做文献计量/科学计量示例。
Motivation: 二次熵的直接计算需要对分布两两配对求距离，复杂度随样本量平方增长，难以扩展到大规模分布与高维特征。
Method: 针对负型距离 (negative type) 的二次熵 p^T d p，重点处理欧氏与球面测地距离两种情形，用随机特征嵌入与随机投影近似距离矩阵；当 d 固定而 p 变化时，用单次大矩阵乘法的摊销与控制变量进一步降低内存和运行时。
Result: 与直接配对采样 (direct pair sampling) 对比展示可扩展性；在 Open Graph Benchmark 数据集上从引用与文本特征出发，识别出互连面特别窄和特别宽的论文、领域与机构。
Conclusion: 随机特征加摊销矩阵乘法可把负型距离二次熵算到大规模，且能从引用与文本特征直接刻画跨领域辐射面的宽窄。

papers.title: CAPABLE: Capability-Aware Policy Adaptation via Behavioral Latent Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies assume the embodiment on which they were trained and can fail when a joint fault changes how commanded actions are physically executed. Existing fault-recovery methods often require task-specific retraining, fault labels, explicit diagnosis, or privileged embodiment information. We introduce CAPABLE, a unified capability-aware adaptation framework for frozen VLAs that integrates self-supervised capability inference with residual reinforcement learning. CAPABLE infers capability, how much of the commanded motion each joint actually realizes and how that motion contributes to end-effector behavior, online from command-response history and kinematics using a temporal encoder shared across joints, Jacobian grounding, cross-joint attention, and self-supervised physical prediction. The resulting representation conditions a residual policy that adds bounded corrections to the VLA arm action without fault labels or faulty-joint identifiers. Across 28 LIBERO tasks, CAPABLE raises success on an actuator excluded from fault training from 24.8% to 59.3%, outperforming a parameter-matched global-history baseline by 17.4 points while preserving healthy performance. Leave-one-actuator-out experiments across six joints show that this transfer is not specific to one actuator, and additional evaluations characterize transfer to unseen fault families and demonstrate recovery on a physical Franka Panda. https://capable-vla.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAPABLE 面向冻结的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略，在关节故障改变指令动作的实际执行时，用自监督能力推断加残差强化学习在线补偿，无需故障标签或故障关节标识。在 LIBERO 28 项任务上，对未参与故障训练的执行器成功率从 24.8% 提到 59.3%，比参数量对齐的全局历史基线高 17.4 个百分点，同时保持健康状态性能。
Motivation: VLA 策略绑定训练时的机体形态，关节故障会改变指令动作的物理执行；现有故障恢复方法往往需要任务级重训练、故障标签、显式诊断或特权机体信息。
Method: 在线从指令-响应历史与运动学推断能力表征：跨关节共享的时序编码器、Jacobian grounding、跨关节注意力与自监督物理预测；该表征条件化一个残差策略，在 VLA 机械臂动作上叠加有界修正，不使用故障标签或故障关节标识。
Result: LIBERO 28 项任务中，对未参与故障训练的执行器成功率 24.8% → 59.3%，比参数量对齐的全局历史基线高 17.4 个百分点，且保持健康性能；对六个关节的 leave-one-actuator-out 实验显示迁移不依赖特定执行器，另有对未见故障族的迁移评测与 Franka Panda 实机恢复演示。
Conclusion: 把机体能力作为在线推断的隐变量并用残差策略补偿，可让冻结 VLA 在无故障标注条件下跨执行器、跨故障族恢复。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning Which Correspondences to Trust: Confidence-Weighted Event-Camera Localization in LiDAR Maps
papers.abstract_en: Localizing an event camera against a pre-built LiDAR map can be cast as dense optical-flow estimation between a rendered depth view and an event image, followed by a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver over the induced 3D-2D correspondences. Existing pipelines rely on geometric consensus during pose estimation, but do not explicitly model the reliability or pose informativeness, i.e., how strongly a correspondence constrains the camera pose, of individual correspondences. We show that the natural way to learn it -- using the per-correspondence error to constrain the learning of confidence -- suffers from a depth-dependent bias: small pixel errors reside predominantly at large depths and do not lead to high pose informativeness. Instead, in our method (CELL), we learn a per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through the pose, using a differentiable probabilistic PnP whose log-partition term encourages weight configurations that yield a better-constrained pose distribution. The learned confidence is used in three ways: (i) it reweights the flow supervision in a decoupled training scheme that keeps pose gradients out of the flow/edge backbone; (ii) it drives a probabilistic correspondence selection at test time; and (iii) together with the network's edge-probability it weights a final edge-matching refinement. We further design a partial-completion depth representation that adds signal without hallucinating across large gaps. On M3ED and DSEC our full system improves over the LEAR baseline on the majority of the evaluated sequences: it reduces the median translation error by up to 26.9% and the median rotation error by up to 15.8%.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 8 figures/tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027 (under review). Code: https://github.com/panagiotisq/CELL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CELL 把事件相机在 LiDAR 地图中的定位写成渲染深度视图与事件图之间的稠密光流加 PnP，并端到端学习每个对应点的置信度：用可微概率 PnP 的 log-partition 项直接从位姿梯度学习置信度，避开按逐点像素误差学习带来的深度相关偏差（小像素误差集中在大深度、并不带来高位姿信息量）。在 M3ED 与 DSEC 上相对 LEAR 基线在多数序列降低中位平移误差至多 26.9%、中位旋转误差至多 15.8%。
Motivation: 现有流程只靠位姿估计阶段的几何一致性，不显式建模单个对应点的可靠性与位姿信息量；而按逐点误差学习置信度存在深度相关偏差，小像素误差多出现在大深度处却不能有效约束位姿。
Method: CELL 将定位表述为渲染深度视图与事件图像间的稠密光流估计，再对 3D-2D 对应做 Perspective-n-Point 求解；用可微概率 PnP 的 log-partition 项端到端从位姿学习逐点置信度。学到的置信度三用：在解耦训练中重加权光流监督（位姿梯度不回传到光流/边缘 backbone）、测试时驱动概率化对应点选择、与网络边缘概率共同加权最终的边缘匹配精化；另设计 partial-completion 深度表示，在大空洞处不臆造也能补信号。
Result: 在 M3ED 与 DSEC 上，完整系统在多数被评估序列上优于 LEAR 基线：中位平移误差最多降低 26.9%，中位旋转误差最多降低 15.8%。
Conclusion: 对应点的置信度应通过位姿（而非逐点像素误差）来学，因为位姿层面的目标能反映对应点对位姿的实际约束力；解耦训练加概率化选择与边缘精化是该置信度的三种用法。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
papers.abstract_en: Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MindFlow 把科研构思建模为图结构的 Flow in Mind，由模块化思考算子组成并用概率 mind supernet 建模，controller 动态采样思考流生成候选研究想法，再用基于锦标赛的相对排序优化使 controller 逐步偏向高质量思考流。配套提出同时评估 problem finding 与 problem solving 的评测协议，超越只看标题或摘要的判断。
Motivation: 科研想法的生成与评估难以规模化、可控地进行：想法需在 novelty、plausibility、feasibility 之间平衡，而现有 LLM 方法受限于预定义的静态构思流程。
Method: 将构思显式表述为图结构 Flow in Mind，由模块化思考算子构成并以概率 mind supernet 建模；给定研究主题后 controller 动态采样思考流生成候选想法，用锦标赛式相对排序作为优化目标；另引入联合评估 problem finding 与 problem solving 的评测协议。
Result: 在多样研究主题上，MindFlow 被报告为显式、可控且可优化的研究想法创新器，优于既有 LLM 构思方法；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把构思流程参数化为可采样、可排序优化的思考流，能突破静态 agent 流水线的限制，实现可控且可优化的研究想法生成。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 将构思显式表述为图结构 Flow in Mind，由模块化思考算子构成并以概率 mind supernet 建模；给定研究主题后 controller 动态采样思考流生成候选想法，用锦标赛式相对排序作为优化目标；另引入联合评估 problem finding 与 problem solving 的评测协议。
summary_sections.result: 在多样研究主题上，MindFlow 被报告为显式、可控且可优化的研究想法创新器，优于既有 LLM 构思方法；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把构思流程参数化为可采样、可排序优化的思考流，能突破静态 agent 流水线的限制，实现可控且可优化的研究想法生成。

papers.title: Can LLMs Fix It Without Code? Toward Automated Verification of No-Code Bug Fixes
papers.abstract_en: A no-code fix resolves an invalid bug report by directing the user to change a setting, update to a version where the problem is already fixed, or adjust their workflow. Manually verifying whether a proposed no-code fix resolves the reported bug takes considerable developer time. This study proposes an automated, execution-based pipeline for evaluating the capability of large language models (LLMs) to generate no-code fixes in a real browser environment. We evaluate 322 no-code fixes generated by the 12 configurations released with the benchmark of a previous study, covering bug reports categorized as Faulty Configuration, Wrong Version, or External System & Dependency. An executor agent applies each fix by following its natural-language instructions, and an issue-specific checker determines whether the reported bug persists. We repeat the pipeline with three executors: two Computer-Use Agents, OpenCUA-72B and Claude Sonnet 5, and one multimodal agentic LLM, Meta's Muse Glimmer. Only 17.6% of the candidate issues could be set up and passed both sanity gates. Across the 322 fixes, 14.6% to 49.7% resolved the bug depending on the executor, and the strongest configuration, Claude Opus 4.6 in the Vanilla pipeline, resolved up to 74.1% of its fixes under Claude Sonnet 5. Changing only the executor shifted a configuration's resolution rate by 38.8% on average, and the three executors reached the same verdict on only 46.9% of the fixes. Compared with human execution, the executors matched the human consensus for 66.1% to 88.1% of the sampled fixes. Even under the best executor, fewer than half of the LLM-generated no-code fixes resolve the reported bug, so such fixes need verification before they reach users. Execution-based verification can provide this, but the measured capability depends strongly on the executor, which evaluations must report and control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在真实浏览器环境中执行并核验 LLM 生成的 no-code 修复的自动化流水线：执行 agent 按自然语言指令操作，issue-specific checker 判断 bug 是否仍在。322 个修复中仅 14.6%–49.7% 真正解决 bug（随执行器而变），最强配置 Claude Opus 4.6 在 Claude Sonnet 5 执行下达 74.1%；换执行器平均使解决率移动 38.8%，三执行器结论一致率仅 46.9%。
Motivation: no-code 修复靠改设置、升级版本或调整工作流来化解 bug 报告，人工核验是否真的解决非常耗时；而 LLM 能否生成有效 no-code 修复此前缺少可执行的自动评估手段。
Method: 构建 execution-based 流水线：执行 agent 按修复的自然语言说明在真实浏览器中操作，issue-specific checker 判定报告的 bug 是否仍存在；用三种执行器重复——两个 Computer-Use Agent（OpenCUA-72B、Claude Sonnet 5）与一个多模态 agentic LLM（Meta 的 Muse Glimmer），评估对象是前一项研究 benchmark 发布的 12 个配置所生成的 322 个修复，覆盖 Faulty Configuration、Wrong Version、External System & Dependency 三类 bug 报告。
Result: 仅 17.6% 的候选 issue 能完成搭建并通过两道 sanity gate；322 个修复中按执行器计有 14.6% 至 49.7% 解决 bug，最强配置 Claude Opus 4.6（Vanilla 流水线）在 Claude Sonnet 5 执行下解决率最高达 74.1%。只换执行器就使某配置的解决率平均移动 38.8%，三个执行器对同一修复给出相同结论的仅 46.9%；与人工执行相比，执行器在抽样修复上与人工共识一致率为 66.1% 至 88.1%。
Conclusion: 即便用最好的执行器，少于一半的 LLM 生成 no-code 修复能真正解决 bug，因此这类修复在触达用户前必须核验；execution-based verification 可以提供核验，但测得的能力强烈依赖执行器，评估必须报告并控制执行器。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction for Effective Subgroup Reliability
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction offers a distribution-free coverage guarantee, making it especially attractive for clinical applications. Standard conformal prediction, however, provides such guarantees only at the population level, and its prediction sets can exhibit coverage disparities across clinically important subgroups. A natural remedy is to calibrate within predefined groups. However, this can require access to sensitive subgroup attributes and is prone to a worst-group bottleneck: protecting the most difficult subgroup can inflate prediction sets for all, increasing cognitive burden on decision makers. To this end, we propose Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction (SGCP), a conformal framework for subgroup-reliable uncertainty quantification. It learns a stochastic grouping map that allows each sample to draw calibration information from others with similar calibration behavior, yielding a local score law that boosts reliability across subpopulations. We prove that SGCP retains the standard coverage guarantee. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that it consistently reduces subgroup coverage gaps while achieving smaller or comparable prediction set sizes relative to existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出随机分组保形预测 (Stochastic Grouping Conformal Prediction, SGCP)：学一个随机分组映射，让每个样本从校准行为相似的样本处借校准信息，形成局部分数律，在保留标准覆盖保证的同时缩小子群覆盖差距。合成与真实基准上，它在预测集尺寸更小或相当的前提下持续降低子群覆盖差异。
Motivation: 标准保形预测只在总体层面给覆盖保证，临床重要子群之间会出现覆盖差异；按预定义分组校准又需要敏感子群属性，且受最差子群瓶颈拖累——保护最难子群会把所有样本的预测集撑大，加重决策者认知负担。
Method: SGCP 学习一个随机分组映射 (stochastic grouping map)，使每个样本从校准行为相似的其他样本抽取校准信息，由此得到提升子群可靠性的局部分数律；作者证明该框架保留标准覆盖保证，并在合成与真实基准上与现有基线比较。
Result: 在合成与真实基准实验中，SGCP 持续缩小子群覆盖差距 (subgroup coverage gaps)，同时预测集尺寸相对现有基线更小或相当；并给出保留标准覆盖保证的理论证明。
Conclusion: 不必访问敏感子群属性、也不必按最差子群统一放大预测集，就能换取更均衡的子群覆盖——随机借用相似校准行为的样本是可行的分组校准替代路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning for Temporally Robust Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: A generated video of a task the robot is about to perform is useful guidance only if it depicts the phase the robot is actually in. We show that temporal misalignment can turn a task-consistent generated future into actively harmful guidance. On CALVIN, a five-frame early shift nearly erases the benefit of generated futures, reducing success from 81.3% to 54.8% against 54.0% without futures; imposed timing shifts reduce it even further to 34.2%, 19.8 points below the future-free policy. We introduce Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning (RAFC), which treats this as a control problem rather than a generation problem. At every step, RAFC estimates how far to trust the received clip and which nearby temporal hypothesis to prefer, falling back toward a static branch when neither fits, and it learns both from task reward alone without shift labels or alignment supervision. RAFC sits on top of Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), which builds the clip once from task grounding, a robot-free digital-twin rollout, and mask-free video diffusion. Under deliberately off-grid phase shifts and rate mismatch, RAFC substantially improves success under temporal mismatch. Candidate ensembling accounts for most of the recovery near alignment, while learned reliability adds a further 7.0 percentage points over uniform averaging of the identical candidate bank under off-grid shifts. The gain holds on the evaluated task sets and survives on a Franka under natural timing mismatch nobody imposed, where aggregate success rises from 26.7% to 56.7%. All resources will be made publicly available. https://future-condition.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机器人操作中，生成视频若与当前任务阶段错位会从有益提示变成有害提示：CALVIN 上五帧提前几乎抹掉生成未来的收益，成功率从 81.3% 降到 54.8%（无未来提示为 54.0%），强加时序偏移进一步降到 34.2%。RAFC 把这当作控制问题，每步估计该多信任片段、偏好哪个邻近时序假设，仅从任务奖励学习、无需偏移标签。对齐附近候选集成贡献大部分恢复，离网格偏移下学习到的可靠性比均匀平均同一候选库再高 7.0 个百分点；Franka 实机自然时序错配上总成功率从 26.7% 升到 56.7%。
Motivation: 用生成未来指导机器人操作的前提是片段对应真实任务阶段；时序错位会让任务一致的生成未来变成主动有害的引导，而现有条件化机制无法判断该多信任收到的片段。
Method: RAFC 叠在 Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC) 之上：FEC 由任务 grounding、无机器人的 digital-twin rollout 与 mask-free video diffusion 一次性生成片段；RAFC 每步估计对片段的信任度并选择邻近时序假设，不匹配时回退到 static 分支，两者都只从任务奖励学习，不用偏移标签或对齐监督。
Result: CALVIN 上无偏移时生成未来把成功率提到 81.3%，五帧提前降到 54.8%（无未来 54.0%），强加时序偏移降到 34.2%，比无未来策略低 19.8 个百分点；离网格相位偏移与速率失配下，候选集成贡献对齐附近的大部分恢复，学习到的可靠性相对同一候选库的均匀平均再加 7.0 个百分点；Franka 实机自然时序错配上总成功率 26.7% → 56.7%。
Conclusion: 生成未来的价值取决于时序可靠性判断，把对齐当作控制问题并只用任务奖励学习，可在错位条件下恢复大部分性能并在实机自然错配上成立；资源将在 future-condition.github.io 公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Look Where You Can: Active View Selection for CAD Reconstruction under Occlusion
papers.abstract_en: CAD reconstruction methods assume a luxury reality rarely grants: unrestricted visual access to the object, photographed from any desired angle. Real objects, however, are scene-embedded, bolted against walls, wedged into corners, resting on floors, where the scene renders much of the view sphere unreachable and the remaining views unequally informative. We introduce \textbf{SightCAD}, a framework for parametric CAD reconstruction that treats view feasibility as a first-class constraint. In this work we consider objects from standard CAD benchmarks embedded in realistic indoor scenes with physically derived visibility constraints over a discrete view sphere. A learned view selector must choose $K$ feasible views for a vision--language model (VLM) that generates executable CadQuery code, scored by geometric fidelity of the executed solid. Because reward arrives only after discrete view selection, autoregressive generation, and CAD-kernel execution, we propose a joint training paradigm in which the view selector and the CAD-generation VLM are trained together against this reward. The learned selection policy departs sharply from random, uniform, and coverage-greedy alternatives, outperforming surface-area maximization (SA-max) by up to $6.4$ Intersection-over-Union (IoU) points across budgets $K\in\{1,\dots,5\}$. The full system surpasses strong external baselines on scene-embedded, occluded multi-view renders of DeepCAD and Fusion360 objects ($+21$ and $+17$ effective-mIoU points over the best baseline, respectively), as well as on test-time domain-canonicalized real images from the industrial T-LESS benchmark and on both synthetic and real images from the MP6D industrial metal-parts benchmark, while producing the highest rate of executable programs of any method compared (invalid-code rate ${\leq}1.5\%$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SightCAD 把视角可行性作为一等约束做参数化 CAD 重建：学习式视角选择器为 VLM 挑选 K 个可行视角，VLM 生成可执行 CadQuery 代码，二者针对执行实体的几何保真度奖励联合训练。在场景嵌入、遮挡的 DeepCAD 与 Fusion360 多视角渲染上，相对最强基线分别高出 +21 与 +17 effective-mIoU 点，视角选择比 SA-max 最多高 6.4 IoU 点，无效代码率 ≤1.5%。
Motivation: CAD 重建默认可以从任意角度拍摄，但真实物体嵌在场景里、贴墙或卡在角落，视球大部分不可达且剩余视角信息量不均，视角可行性此前未被当作显式约束。
Method: 在标准 CAD benchmark 物体嵌入的室内场景上，用物理推导的离散视球可见性约束定义可行视角；学习式视角选择器挑 K 个可行视角交给生成 CadQuery 代码的 VLM，按执行实体的几何保真度打分；因奖励在离散视角选择、自回归生成与 CAD kernel 执行之后才出现，选择器与 VLM 以该奖励联合训练。
Result: 学到的策略明显偏离随机、均匀与 coverage-greedy，在 K∈{1,…,5} 预算下比 surface-area maximization (SA-max) 最多高 6.4 IoU 点；在场景嵌入遮挡的 DeepCAD 与 Fusion360 多视角渲染上分别比最强外部基线高 +21 与 +17 effective-mIoU 点；在工业 T-LESS（测试时域规范化真实图像）与 MP6D（合成与真实工业金属零件图像）上同样超过强基线，且可执行程序生成率最高，无效代码率 ≤1.5%。
Conclusion: 把视角可行性作为一等约束并让选择器与生成模型共享几何保真度奖励，能在遮挡场景下同时提高 CAD 重建质量与代码可执行率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 在标准 CAD benchmark 物体嵌入的室内场景上，用物理推导的离散视球可见性约束定义可行视角；学习式视角选择器挑 K 个可行视角交给生成 CadQuery 代码的 VLM，按执行实体的几何保真度打分；因奖励在离散视角选择、自回归生成与 CAD kernel 执行之后才出现，选择器与 VLM 以该奖励联合训练。
summary_sections.result: 学到的策略明显偏离随机、均匀与 coverage-greedy，在 K∈{1,…,5} 预算下比 surface-area maximization (SA-max) 最多高 6.4 IoU 点；在场景嵌入遮挡的 DeepCAD 与 Fusion360 多视角渲染上分别比最强外部基线高 +21 与 +17 effective-mIoU 点；在工业 T-LESS（测试时域规范化真实图像）与 MP6D（合成与真实工业金属零件图像）上同样超过强基线，且可执行程序生成率最高，无效代码率 ≤1.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把视角可行性作为一等约束并让选择器与生成模型共享几何保真度奖励，能在遮挡场景下同时提高 CAD 重建质量与代码可执行率。

papers.title: Interval-valued SHAP in Tree-Based Models
papers.abstract_en: Shapley values are among the most popular feature-attribution explanations. Efficient approaches for computing/estimating Shapley values for tree-based models, which are state-of-the-art for tabular data sets, have been developed. However, it is known that Shapley values can be (highly) unrobust due to small and realistic changes. In this paper, we propose an imprecise Dirichlet model (IDM) based method to analyze the robustness of Shapley values in decision trees and random forests. Technically, it is done by quantifying and analyzing the interval-valued Shapley values when a few unannotated instances are randomly introduced to the leaves of the trees. The interval-valued Shapley values can be defined following common principles in handling incomplete data: the pessimistic and averaging principles. We derive various theoretical results that lead to efficient computation of the interval-valued Shapley values. We also show that the proposed method can be straightforwardly generalized to the case of Banzhaf values. We then present various case studies and experiments to illustrate the behaviour of the proposed interval-valued Shapley values and their applications in debiasing uninformative features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对树模型 Shapley 值对微小扰动不稳健的问题，提出基于不精确 Dirichlet 模型 (IDM) 的区间值 SHAP 方法：向决策树与随机森林叶子随机注入少量未标注实例，按悲观原则与平均原则给出区间值 Shapley 值，并推导出高效计算的理论结果。区间可用于识别并去偏无信息特征，方法可直接推广到 Banzhaf 值。
Motivation: Shapley 值是表格数据树模型最常用的特征归因解释，但已知其对微小且现实的输入变化高度不稳健，解释可信度受损。
Method: 用不精确 Dirichlet 模型 (IDM) 刻画树叶子中引入少量未标注实例后的不确定性，按处理不完整数据的悲观原则与平均原则定义区间值 Shapley 值；推导支撑高效计算的理论结果，并说明可直接推广到 Banzhaf 值，随后用案例研究与实验展示行为及在去偏无信息特征上的应用。
Result: 给出区间值 Shapley 值的多项理论结果以实现高效计算，并通过多个案例研究与实验展示其行为，以及在去偏 (debiasing) 无信息特征上的应用；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把 Shapley 值的不稳健性显式表示为区间而非单点，可在树模型解释中量化归因的不确定范围，并用于剔除无信息特征的虚假归因。

papers.title: Score-Based Learning of Cluster DAGs from Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Graphical approaches to causal abstraction transform a low-level causal directed acyclic graph (DAG) over many measured variables into a smaller, high-level DAG whose nodes cluster the original variables and whose edges summarize the causal relations between clusters. Such cluster DAGs are easier to interpret, but learning them requires finding the clusters and recovering the edges between them. Madaleno et al. (2026) learn the interventional coarsening (the cluster DAG that merges variables the interventions cannot distinguish) in two constraint-based phases: first the clusters, then the edges. We introduce COARSE, the first score-based method for this task: it keeps the two-phase structure but, under linear Gaussian assumptions, swaps the constraint-based edge phase for a score-based one. We show that the interventions themselves identify a causal order over the clusters, and learning the edges reduces to a single local search per cluster under a cluster-level BIC score. We prove that the procedure runs in polynomial time and, provided the variables affected by each intervention are correctly identified, that it is consistent. On synthetic and real-world interventional data, COARSE matches state-of-the-art edge recovery given enough samples, with an edge phase up to two orders of magnitude faster, including on dense graphs with hundreds of nodes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 COARSE：首个基于评分 (score-based) 学习 cluster DAG 的方法，在线性高斯假设下保留两阶段结构，把第二阶段的约束式边恢复换成 cluster 级 BIC 评分的局部搜索。干预本身给出 cluster 上的因果顺序，算法被证明多项式时间可解且在干预受影响变量识别正确时相合；在合成与真实干预数据上，样本充足时边恢复达到 SOTA 水平，边阶段最多快两个数量级。
Motivation: 因果抽象需要把含大量变量的低层因果 DAG 聚合成更易解释的 cluster DAG，但同时要找出聚类并恢复 cluster 之间的边；已有 Madaleno et al. (2026) 的两阶段约束式方法在边恢复阶段代价高。
Method: COARSE 沿用两阶段结构：先学 interventional coarsening 得到聚类，再在边阶段用 cluster 级 BIC 评分做每 cluster 一次的局部搜索，取代约束式边恢复；依赖线性高斯假设，并利用干预诱导出的 cluster 级因果顺序。
Result: 在合成与真实干预数据上，样本充足时 COARSE 的边恢复达到 state-of-the-art 水平，边阶段最多快两个数量级，包括数百节点的稠密图；理论上被证明多项式时间运行，且在每个干预受影响变量识别正确时相合。
Conclusion: 在干预可识别 cluster 因果顺序的前提下，把约束式边恢复换成评分式局部搜索即可在保持一致性的同时大幅提速，稠密大规模 cluster DAG 也可行。

papers.title: TACROSS: An Efficient and Low-Cost Scalable Human Touch System Across Heterogeneous Tactile Sensors for Dexterous Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Collecting tactile demonstrations on robots is costly and slow, motivating the use of lower-cost human tactile gloves for scalable data collection. However, human capacitive/piezoresistive gloves and robotic tactile sensors differ fundamentally in transduction principle, sensor layout, spatial resolution, and dynamic response, making alignment of raw sensor channels ill-posed. To address this problem, we present TACROSS, a scalable system for learning from human touch and transferring it to robots that bridges this heterogeneity by aligning tactile streams at the level of contact events rather than raw sensor values. The hardware component of TACROSS integrates a piezoresistive glove with five layers and a cost of USD 10.86 with 285 sensing points. To align contact semantics, we design canonicalizers and residual adapters that map heterogeneous signals into a shared tactile latent with 256 dimensions via a temporal Transformer with attention across fingers. We further introduce a robot-grounded policy learning scheme in which robot demonstrations provide the sole source of ground-truth action supervision, while human demonstrations support tactile representation learning and provide confidence-weighted auxiliary supervision through valid retargeted hand targets. We evaluate our system on four contact-rich manipulation tasks. Compared to conventional teleoperation, our proposed system achieves a 3.5-fold efficiency improvement while reducing demonstration acquisition equipment cost by 95.7%. We will open-source the TACROSS hardware and software system and publicly release a tactile dataset comprising over 150 hours of recordings. Project page: https://tacross-touch-project.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TACROSS 用接触事件（contact event）而非原始通道对齐人手触觉手套与机器人触觉传感器，硬件为五层压阻手套、285 个感知点、成本 10.86 美元，经 canonicalizer 与 residual adapter 映射到 256 维共享触觉隐空间。在四个接触密集操作任务上，相比传统遥操作效率提升 3.5 倍、演示采集设备成本降低 95.7%，并将开源硬件软件与超过 150 小时触觉数据集。
Motivation: 机器人触觉演示采集昂贵且慢，人手电容/压阻手套与机器人触觉传感器在换能原理、布局、空间分辨率和动态响应上根本不同，直接对齐原始通道是不适定问题。
Method: TACROSS 硬件为五层压阻手套、285 个感知点、成本 10.86 美元；用 canonicalizer 与 residual adapter 把异构信号映射到共享触觉隐空间（256 维），骨干是跨手指注意力的 temporal Transformer。策略学习中机器人演示是唯一动作监督真值，人手演示只做触觉表示学习并经有效重定向手目标提供置信度加权的辅助监督。
Result: 在四个接触密集操作任务上，相比传统遥操作效率提升 3.5 倍，演示采集设备成本降低 95.7%；将开源硬件与软件，并发布超过 150 小时录制的触觉数据集。
Conclusion: 把异构触觉对齐放在接触事件层面而非原始数值层面，配合机器人动作真值加人手触觉辅助监督，可让低成本人手手套成为可扩展的机器人灵巧操作数据来源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. For GUI agents, safety is therefore a property of the transition rather than of the screen, and a monitor that inspects only screens can be defeated by reusing a legitimate one. Judging a transition requires an expectation of what should have followed the action. Existing GUI world models provide one, but they output it as text, code, or images, so checking it against the observed screen requires a second model to judge the two. We argue that a world model meant for verification should instead predict in the space in which observations are encoded, and present LGWM, a decoder-free, action-conditioned world model that predicts the representation of the next screen directly, trained without semantic annotation on 1.85M real GUI transitions. Verification reduces to a vector comparison, and the same signal reveals whether a mismatch is harmful. We evaluate on RSWT-BENCH, a diagnostic where each credential screen appears under both a legitimate and a hijacked transition, so detectors that see only the screen are at chance by construction. The training-free score reaches 0.987 AUC at 17 ms per decision, on par with the strongest closed-source VLMs and about ten AUC points above generative GUI world models at over three orders of magnitude lower latency. The residual direction reaches 0.953 AUC at separating harmful from benign violations, where prompted VLMs are near chance. Further analyses show that the prediction is a usable future state rather than an anomaly score. World models have mostly served as simulators or planners; our results point to a third role, verification, for which predicting in representation space is the natural design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LGWM：一个无解码器、以动作为条件的 GUI 世界模型，直接在观测编码空间预测下一屏的表征，把 GUI agent 的安全校验化简为一次向量比较。在 RSWT-BENCH（每个凭证界面都同时出现在合法与被劫持转移中，只看屏幕的检测器按构造只能到随机水平）上，训练无关的校验分数达到 0.987 AUC、每次决策 17 ms，与最强闭源 VLM 相当，比生成式 GUI 世界模型高约 10 个 AUC 点且延迟低三个数量级以上；残差方向分离有害与良性违规达 0.953 AUC，而提示式 VLM 接近随机。
Motivation: GUI agent 的安全性取决于转移而非单屏：合法界面被复用到别的动作后就是攻击，只看屏幕的监控器会被这种重放击穿。现有 GUI 世界模型能给出“下一步应该是什么”，但输出是文本、代码或图像，还得再接一个模型去比对观测。
Method: LGWM 是无解码器、动作条件的世界模型，直接预测下一屏在观测编码空间中的表征，训练不使用语义标注，语料为 1.85M 条真实 GUI 转移；校验即预测表征与实测表征的向量比较，残差方向同时指示失配是否有害。评测用 RSWT-BENCH，其中每个凭证界面都同时出现在合法与被劫持转移下。
Result: 训练无关分数在 RSWT-BENCH 上达 0.987 AUC、每次决策 17 ms，与最强闭源 VLM 相当，比生成式 GUI 世界模型高约 10 个 AUC 点且延迟低三个数量级以上；残差方向分离有害与良性违规达 0.953 AUC，提示式 VLM 在此接近随机。进一步分析显示预测是可用的未来状态而非异常分数。
Conclusion: 世界模型除了模拟器和规划器之外还有第三种角色——验证，而“在表征空间预测”是验证用途下的自然设计；只看屏幕的监控器在构造上无法区分合法与劫持转移。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Does Target Alignment Mean Target Recovery? An Evidence-Ladder Study of Adversarial Claims on Contrastive Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks on vision-language models optimize an image toward a text target, then cite the attacked model's similarity score as evidence of success. We ask whether that score - victim-space target alignment (VTS) - predicts recovery of the target by an independent model. We first build a measurement instrument: supervised judges outside the attacked geometry, real-target blend controls, shuffled-target negatives, and a reference level derived from a 50% target-image blend. Two preregistered studies then compare six contrastive encoders under a matched attack at three perturbation budgets. Robustly trained encoders (FARE, TeCoA, PMG, TRADES) transfer substantially more independent evidence than vanilla CLIP or SigLIP; all eight contrasts reject at the bootstrap floor. However, no cell reaches the blend-derived reference level. The three best cells fall within its replication band, leaving practical recovery undecided. Within robust encoders, per-sample alignment gain correlates with evidence gain ($ρ= 0.24-0.51$); within vanilla CLIP the correlation is consistent with zero. Across encoders we find no monotone alignment-evidence relation. VTS is therefore informative only within a fixed robust encoder, and we provide a reporting protocol in its place.

TL;DR: 对抗攻击把图像优化到文本目标后用受害模型相似度 (VTS) 当成功证据，但该分数并不预测独立模型能否恢复目标：六个对比编码器在三档扰动预算下，稳健训练的 FARE、TeCoA、PMG、TRADES 转移的独立证据显著多于 vanilla CLIP 与 SigLIP（八个对比全部在 bootstrap 下界拒绝），却没有任何单元达到由 50% 目标图像混合导出的参考水平。作者据此用一套报告协议替代单看 VTS。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型对抗攻击普遍以受害模型自身的相似度分数作为成功证据，但该分数处于被攻击的几何内部，是否对应独立模型真正恢复目标此前没有测量手段。
Method: 先构建测量仪器：被攻击几何之外的监督判别器、真实目标混合对照、打乱目标负例，以及由 50% 目标图像混合导出的参考水平；随后两项预注册研究在匹配攻击与三档扰动预算下比较六个对比编码器，用 bootstrap 检验对比并计算逐样本相关。
Result: 稳健训练编码器 FARE、TeCoA、PMG、TRADES 转移的独立证据远多于 vanilla CLIP 与 SigLIP，八个对比全部在 bootstrap 下界拒绝；但没有任何单元达到混合导出的参考水平，最好的三个单元仅落在其复现带内。稳健编码器内部逐样本对齐增益与证据增益相关 ρ=0.24–0.51，vanilla CLIP 内部相关与零一致；跨编码器不存在单调的对齐-证据关系。
Conclusion: VTS 只在固定稳健编码器内部有信息量，跨模型或跨编码器不能作为目标恢复的证据，应改用其提出的报告协议。

papers.title: Revisiting Identity and Spectra Dispersion in Media-Bridged Time Series Forecasting: Linking Multivariate Signals and Narrative Flows
papers.abstract_en: Media-bridged time series forecasting is expanding to encompass traditional "multivariate" and emerging "multimodal" (e.g., through textual assistance). Existing Time Series Forecasting (TSF) models still rely on paradigm-specific relation, fusion, and temporal modules, hindering a common forecasting backbone across numerical and pre-aligned narrative-flow settings. To explore this, we propose the Multimedia Identity-Aware Prism Network (MIDAPN), a unified spatiotemporal forecasting backbone based on media-general graph adaptation and automatic temporal learning: (1) Following media pre-alignment, our Multimedia Identity-Aware Graph (MIDAG) revisits identity through static essence, dynamic behavior, and latent commonality, inducing affinities that extend variable-specific dependencies across media. Contextual Identity Modulation (CIM) further refines discriminative aggregation. (2) We develop Spectral Prism Convolution (SPConv) to automatically perform hierarchical temporal analysis, balancing coarse trends and fine-grained details. Meanwhile, its Adaptive Search Guidance configures a scale-efficient architecture for temporal-dimension reconstruction. These decoupled yet synergistic components jointly address media identity disentanglement and temporal-scale mismatch. Comprehensive evaluations involving 16 SOTA TSF models across 13 "multivariate" and 12 "multimodal" datasets, alongside targeted long-context comparisons against 14 time series foundation models and fused pretrained language models, demonstrate MIDAPN's consistent superiority and broad shared backbone compatibility. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/leijieruilq/MIDAPN/tree/main}{https://github.com/MIDAPN}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MIDAPN：一个统一的时空预测骨干，用媒体通用图适配把多变量数值序列与文本叙事流放进同一套关系与融合框架，并用谱棱柱卷积 (SPConv) 自动做层次化时序分解。在 13 个多变量与 12 个多模态数据集上对比 16 个 SOTA TSF 模型，并在长上下文上对比 14 个时序基础模型与融合预训练语言模型，MIDAPN 一致更优。
Motivation: 现有 TSF 模型依赖范式专属的关系、融合与时序模块，数值多变量与文本辅助的多模态设置之间缺少通用预测骨干。
Method: 媒体预对齐后，MIDAG 从静态本质、动态行为与潜在共性三个角度重定义身份 (identity)，诱导跨媒体的变量级亲和度；上下文身份调制 (CIM) 细化判别式聚合；SPConv 配合 Adaptive Search Guidance 自动完成时序维度的层次化重建，平衡粗趋势与细粒度细节。
Result: 在 13 个「多变量」与 12 个「多模态」数据集上评测 16 个 SOTA TSF 模型，并与 14 个时序基础模型及融合预训练语言模型做长上下文对比，MIDAPN 表现出一致优势与广泛的共享骨干兼容性。
Conclusion: 媒体身份解耦与时序尺度匹配可以解耦但协同地处理，从而让一个骨干同时覆盖数值多变量与文本增强的多模态预测。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Neural Decoding as Cognitive Inference
papers.abstract_en: The brain maintains stable cognition despite continuously changing neural activity. How to extract stable cognitive states from variable neural observations remains a central problem in neural decoding. Existing neural decoding methods map neural observations to predefined external labels based on the stimulus-response principle, often capturing recording-specific spurious correlations. Inspired by how the brain infers the world, and specifically by Bayesian brain theory, we recast neural decoding as cognitive inference constrained by brain-intrinsic priors, yielding high-level meta-neural semantic representations. In decoding experiments spanning five neural recording modalities and three cognitive domains (motor, perception and internal mentation), our cognitive inference method reorganized the geometry of neural observation representations, yielding meta-neural semantic representations that exhibited consistent geometric relationships across cognitive tasks and enabled the recovery of stable cognitive states from variable neural observations. Our work provides an account of how the brain maintains relatively stable cognition despite continual changes in the external environment. Cognitive stability is sustained through cognitive inference from changing neural activity, without requiring fixed neural activity patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把神经解码重构为受脑内先验约束的认知推断 (cognitive inference)，在五种神经记录模态、运动/感知/内隐心智三类认知任务上重组神经观测表征的几何结构，得到跨任务几何关系一致的 meta-neural semantic 表征，从而从可变神经活动中恢复稳定认知状态。
Motivation: 现有神经解码按刺激-响应范式把神经观测映射到预定义外部标签，容易学到记录特异的伪相关；而大脑如何在神经活动持续变化时维持稳定认知本身是核心问题。
Method: 借鉴 Bayesian brain theory，把解码从标签映射改写为受脑内先验约束的认知推断，输出高层 meta-neural semantic 表征；在五种神经记录模态与三类认知域上做解码实验，检验表征几何是否跨任务一致。
Result: 在覆盖五种神经记录模态、三个认知域（motor、perception、internal mentation）的解码实验中，该方法重组了神经观测表征的几何结构，所得 meta-neural semantic 表征在不同认知任务间呈现一致的几何关系，并支持从可变神经观测中恢复稳定认知状态。
Conclusion: 认知稳定性来自对变化中神经活动的认知推断，而不要求固定的神经活动模式；这为大脑在外部环境持续变化下维持相对稳定认知提供了一种解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Surface to Depth: Towards Cognitive Appraisal Reasoning in Multimodal Emotion Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly incorporate explainable reasoning for emotion understanding. However, reasoning based mainly on observable affective cues can reduce emotion understanding to superficial cue-label associations, giving rise to the Clever Hans effect. Such shortcuts become unreliable when affective cues are implicit, conflicting across modalities, linguistically misleading, or obscured by redundant details. In contrast, human emotions are shaped by how individuals interpret and evaluate surrounding events beyond observable cues. Inspired by appraisal theories of emotion, we formulate multimodal emotion understanding as a progression from perception to cognitive appraisal, and introduce a dataset, a model, and a benchmark to support this novel paradigm. CogEmo-40K is a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset constructed through a perception-to-appraisal pipeline to elicit evidence-grounded reasoning across six cognitive appraisal dimensions underlying emotion. CogEmo-MoE is a compact sparse MLLM that introduces interleaved MoE blocks for appraisal-specific adaptation, enabling effective appraisal reasoning at a substantially smaller scale than typical emotion MLLMs. CogEmo-Bench introduces an Appraisal Evidence Quality Score (AEQS) to assess cognitive-affective understanding across six complementary appraisal dimensions, addressing the limitation of conventional emotion metrics that evaluate what emotion is predicted but not why it arises. Extensive experiments show that our paradigm not only leads CogEmo-Bench, but also exhibits strong cross-domain generalization. Our findings suggest that perception-to-appraisal reasoning can move beyond surface-level cue-label associations toward more reliable multimodal emotion understanding and closer cognitive alignment between MLLMs and humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多模态情绪理解重构为从感知到认知评价 (cognitive appraisal) 的递进推理，提出 CogEmo-40K 指令微调数据集、交错 MoE 块的稀疏模型 CogEmo-MoE，以及带评价证据质量分数 (AEQS) 的 CogEmo-Bench。实验显示该范式在 CogEmo-Bench 上领先并具跨域泛化，说明感知到评价的推理能绕开表层线索-标签关联（Clever Hans 效应）。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 的可解释情绪推理主要依赖可观察情感线索，遇到隐含、跨模态冲突或语言误导的线索时退化为线索-标签捷径，且常规情绪指标只评预测了什么情绪、不评为什么产生。
Method: 构建 CogEmo-40K：经 perception-to-appraisal 流水线在六个认知评价维度上激发有证据支撑的推理；模型 CogEmo-MoE 用交错 MoE 块做评价专属适配，规模远小于典型情绪 MLLM；评测用 CogEmo-Bench 的 AEQS 从六个互补评价维度打分。
Result: 实验显示该范式在 CogEmo-Bench 上领先，并展现强跨域泛化 (cross-domain generalization)；CogEmo-MoE 以明显更小的规模实现有效评价推理。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 感知到评价的推理可超越表层线索-标签关联，带来更可靠的多模态情绪理解与 MLLM 和人类之间更近的认知对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Puffin: Probabilistic Learning of Spatial Detail From Coarse Observations
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution socioeconomic variables are important for applications such as urban planning, public health, disaster response, and resource allocation. In practice, however, these variables are often observed only at a coarse spatial resolution. We introduce Puffin, a probabilistic framework for statistical disaggregation that raises the resolution of coarse totals using high-resolution satellite embeddings as covariates. Instead of predicting a single value for each fine-resolution subregion, Puffin learns a probability distribution and is trained through an aggregation-aware likelihood. At inference, Puffin conditions these predictions on the observed regional total and splits it among the subregions. The resulting fine-scale estimates are consistent with the observed aggregate and come with calibrated uncertainty, without requiring fine-resolution labels for training. We evaluate Puffin on German and US census, employment, and election data across population, jobs, and other count variables, and study when statistical disaggregation succeeds or fails across regions, countries, and targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Puffin 是面向社会经济变量的统计降尺度 (statistical disaggregation) 框架：以高分辨率卫星 embedding 为协变量，用 aggregation-aware likelihood 学习每个细分区的分布而非单值，推理时再以观测到的区域总量为条件把总量拆分到子区域。细尺度估计与观测总量严格一致且带校准不确定性，训练无需细分辨率标签；在德国与美国的人口普查、就业和选举数据上检验该方法在哪些区域、国家和目标上成功或失败。
Motivation: 城市规划、公共卫生、灾害响应和资源分配需要高分辨率社会经济变量，但这些变量实际只在粗空间分辨率上被观测到，且细分辨率标签稀缺、难以作为训练目标。
Method: 以高分辨率卫星 embedding 作为协变量输入概率框架，输出每个细分辨率子区域上的概率分布而非单点值，用 aggregation-aware likelihood 训练；推理阶段以观测到的区域总量为条件，把总量分配到各子区域，从而在无细分辨率标签的情况下得到与总量一致的估计。
Result: 在德国与美国的人口普查、就业和选举数据上评估，覆盖人口、就业 (jobs) 及其他计数变量，并系统考察统计降尺度在不同区域、国家和目标变量上何时成功、何时失败；细尺度估计与观测总量保持一致并附带校准不确定性。
Conclusion: 总量一致性约束加卫星协变量可以在没有细分辨率标签的条件下做带校准不确定性的社会经济降尺度，但其成败取决于区域、国家与目标变量，需逐场景检验。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.conclusion: 总量一致性约束加卫星协变量可以在没有细分辨率标签的条件下做带校准不确定性的社会经济降尺度，但其成败取决于区域、国家与目标变量，需逐场景检验。

papers.title: Cost-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Coordination for Model Markets
papers.abstract_en: Existing model marketplaces typically trade and select individual models as indivisible units, limiting their ability to exploit complementarities among heterogeneous experts. This paper proposes an MoE-based model market framework that lifts Mixture-of-Experts from a model-level learning architecture to a market-level coordination mechanism. In this framework, brokers use gating networks to coordinate multiple heterogeneous experts and deliver a composite model service. We formalize the market participants, service workflow, expert cost structure, and a welfare objective that combines predictive utility with heterogeneous execution costs. We then derive a cost-aware gating mechanism and market-aware training objective, and introduce a cost-adjusted revenue allocation rule that distributes residual revenue according to realized expert participation and execution cost. We also establish basic theoretical properties of the allocation rule, including budget balance, participation monotonicity, and cost sensitivity. Experiments over five random seeds on fifteen tabular and image benchmarks use independently trained and frozen neural and tree-based experts together with latency-derived execution costs. MoE Market achieves the highest mean welfare on all fifteen datasets and a lower mean expected cost than Standard MoE in every case, while maintaining competitive predictive performance. The allocation experiments further demonstrate systematic sensitivity to expert participation and cost, together with substantially lower computational overhead than exact Shapley allocation. These results suggest that MoE can serve as a market-level coordination principle for collaborative, cost-aware, and economically grounded model marketplaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Mixture-of-Experts 从模型级架构提升为模型市场 (model market) 的协调机制：broker 用 gating 网络组合多个异构专家交付复合模型服务，并配合成本感知 gating、市场感知训练目标与按实际参与和执行成本分配剩余收益的规则。在 15 个表格与图像基准、5 个随机种子上，MoE Market 在全部数据集上取得最高平均 welfare，且平均期望成本在每种情形下都低于 Standard MoE，同时预测性能保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有模型交易平台把单个模型当作不可分割单元交易与选择，无法利用异构专家之间的互补性，也难以在预测效用与异构执行成本之间做权衡。
Method: 形式化市场参与者、服务流程、专家成本结构，以及结合预测效用与异构执行成本的 welfare 目标；据此推导成本感知 gating 机制与市场感知训练目标，并提出按实际专家参与和执行成本分配剩余收益的 cost-adjusted revenue allocation rule，证明其预算平衡、参与单调性与成本敏感性。实验用独立训练并冻结的神经网络与树模型专家，成本由延迟推导。
Result: 在 15 个表格与图像基准、5 个随机种子上，MoE Market 在全部 15 个数据集上取得最高平均 welfare，且在每种情形下平均期望成本都低于 Standard MoE，预测性能保持竞争力。分配实验显示收益对专家参与和成本系统性敏感，计算开销显著低于 exact Shapley allocation。
Conclusion: MoE 可以作为模型市场层面的协调原则，用于协作式、成本感知且有经济学依据的模型市场；成本感知 gating 与按参与和成本分配的规则能在保持预测性能的同时压低期望成本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Visual Enhancement: Adaptive Multi-Context Steering to Mitigate LVLM Hallucinations
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIMS（Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering）在解码时为视觉、预填文本、已生成文本三类上下文各建紧凑 prototype，用与当前 query 的亲和度算逐注意力头的 steering 权重，把多源方向直接加到 query 表示上。它不加训练、不做额外前向，也能压低 LVLM 的物体幻觉并保持通用多模态能力。
Motivation: 现有免训练方法靠对比解码或一味放大视觉证据的相对影响来抑制幻觉，但 LVLM 本就会动态调节不同上下文的贡献，这一内在行为尚未被量化和利用。
Method: AIMS 为视觉、预填文本、生成文本三个上下文域构造紧凑 prototype，估计其与当前 query 的亲和度以确定 head-wise steering 权重，将多源 steering 方向作用于 query 表示；无需额外训练或辅助前向。
Result: 在多个 LVLM 与多种解码策略上的实验显示，AIMS 有效缓解物体幻觉 (object hallucination)，同时保持有竞争力的通用多模态能力；并发现 LVLM 存在内在的 vision-attending 倾向可引导自适应视觉 steering，文本上下文同样有助于抑制幻觉。
Conclusion: 抑制 LVLM 幻觉不必一味加强视觉，按亲和度自适应协调视觉与文本上下文的解码期 steering 即可，且代价是轻量、免训练的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RobustLDS: Learning linear dynamical systems under adversarial corruptions
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning linear dynamical systems under adversarial contamination from a single trajectory of length $T$. While identification of linear dynamical systems itself is well-studied, the problem of robust system identification under adversarial contamination is relatively less explored. In this work, we study the setting where a fraction of the $T$ observations are contaminated by adversarial outliers. We propose different estimators based on relaxations of least-trimmed squares along with an alternating minimization algorithm. Furthermore, we also propose two estimators which exploit the group-sparsity (through penalization/hard-constraints) of the outliers. For the estimator with group-sparse penalty, we derive non-asymptotic error bounds which establish its robustness to outliers. We also show empirically that the proposed estimators work well in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RobustLDS 在单条长度 T 的轨迹上、且部分观测被对抗性污染时学习线性动力系统 (LDS)：提出基于 least-trimmed squares 松弛加交替最小化的估计器，以及两个利用离群点 group-sparsity（惩罚或硬约束）的估计器。对带 group-sparse 惩罚的估计器推导了非渐近误差界以确立其对离群点的鲁棒性，并给出实证结果。
Motivation: 线性动力系统辨识本身研究充分，但在对抗性污染下的鲁棒系统辨识 (robust system identification) 相对少有人做；这里只有单条轨迹、且 T 个观测中有一部分被对抗性离群点破坏，经典最小二乘会失效。
Method: 两条路线：一是 least-trimmed squares 的松弛形式配交替最小化算法；二是利用离群点 group-sparsity 结构的两个估计器，分别通过惩罚项和硬约束实现。对 group-sparse 惩罚版估计器推导非渐近误差界。
Result: 对带 group-sparse 惩罚的估计器给出非渐近误差界，建立其对离群点的鲁棒性；作者同时报告所提估计器在实践中表现良好（摘要未列具体数值）。
Conclusion: 利用离群点的 group-sparsity（惩罚或硬约束）配合 LTS 松弛与交替最小化，可以在单轨迹、部分观测被对抗污染的条件下鲁棒地辨识线性动力系统。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Forms of LLM-Integrated Applications from LLM-Chats to Autonomous AI Agent System
authors: Irene Weber (University of Applied Sciences Kempten
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent. Whether these labels denote genuine architectural forms or serve as branding has not been assessed systematically. In the sources surveyed, labels do carry architectural content, most clearly in vendor usage: copilot denotes a router-worker architecture operating a host application under step-by-step user confirmation, while the more recent shift to the label agent coincides with AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The coding agents of four major providers share one architecture, a reason-and-act loop delegating to subagents. This survey describes seven recurring forms---LLM chats, custom agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-enhanced workflows, copilots, coding agents, and, in part, agentic RAG---in a common vocabulary of agents and tools. Each is characterized along four structural dimensions (agentic RAG only partially): the architectural pattern, the control of execution and the point of user intervention, the number of agent calls per task, and tool use. An illustrative corpus of 22 systems from research publications and vendor documentation grounds the descriptions and shows where they reach their limit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统梳理 LLM 集成应用的七种形态（LLM chat、custom agent、RAG、AI-enhanced workflow、copilot、coding agent、agentic RAG），用统一的 agent/tool 词汇刻画其架构。结论是这些标签确实承载架构含义而非纯营销：copilot 对应 router-worker 架构且需用户逐步确认，agent 标签对应 AI 规划的多步执行、用户只看结果；四家主要厂商的 coding agent 共享同一 reason-and-act 循环加子 agent 委派架构。
Motivation: chatbot、copilot、RAG、workflow、coding agent、AI agent 等标签被厂商混用，尚无系统评估区分它们是真实架构形式还是营销话术。
Method: 以 22 个来自研究论文与厂商文档的系统作为示例语料，用 agent 与 tool 的统一词汇描述七种形态，并沿四个结构维度刻画：架构模式、执行控制权与用户介入点、每任务的 agent 调用次数、工具使用（agentic RAG 仅部分覆盖）。
Result: 在所考察的来源中标签确有架构内容，vendor 用法最清晰：copilot 为 router-worker 架构、在宿主应用上按用户逐步确认执行；agent 标签对应 AI 规划的多步执行、用户仅见结果。四家主要厂商的 coding agent 共享同一架构，即 reason-and-act 循环委派给 subagent。示例语料含 22 个系统。
Conclusion: 这些标签不是纯品牌包装，而是对应可区分的架构形态；用四个结构维度加统一 agent/tool 词汇即可刻画它们，同时该语料也显示了这些描述的适用边界。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Automated Assembly Instruction Generation from CAD Models Using Grounded Large Language Models: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework
papers.abstract_en: Assembly documentation is a downstream manufacturing artifact that is still usually authored by interpreting CAD models by hand. Structured product data and large language models are both available, yet studies of CAD interpretation, assembly sequence planning, instruction writing, and human oversight have largely proceeded separately. This paper formulates CAD-grounded assembly instruction generation: the production of natural-language assembly procedures constrained by structured engineering information extracted from CAD models. The proposed framework maps a STEP assembly to a typed ProductGraph intermediate representation, derives a precedence order by deterministic topological sorting, realizes each step as language conditioned only on selected graph context, attaches per-step visual documentation, and applies rule-based and model-assisted checks. PDF export remains disabled until a human reviewer resolves every quality flag. The case study establishes endto-end feasibility on a built-in six-part reference assembly: the pipeline preserves a reported assembly order and carries quantity, material, and torque into an exported manual page. Generalization and geometric validation remain open empirical questions. The contribution is an architecture that separates engineering state, deterministic reasoning, grounded language realization, verification, and human release.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CAD 落地的装配说明书生成框架：把 STEP 装配体映射为类型化 ProductGraph，用确定性拓扑排序得到装配顺序，再由 LLM 仅依据选定图上下文生成每步文字并附视觉文档，规则与模型辅助检查全部通过、人工审核清完质量标记后才允许导出 PDF。在内置六件参考装配的案例研究中，流水线保留了报告的装配顺序，并把数量、材料、扭矩带入导出的手册页面。
Motivation: 装配文档仍靠人工解读 CAD 模型撰写，而 CAD 解读、装配序列规划、说明书撰写与人工监督的研究各自独立推进，缺少把结构化工程信息约束到语言生成的端到端方案。
Method: 框架将 STEP 装配体转为类型化 ProductGraph 中间表示，用确定性拓扑排序推导先后顺序，每一步的语言只由选定的图上下文条件化生成，并附带逐步视觉文档；再叠加规则检查与模型辅助检查，PDF 导出在人工审核解决全部质量标记前保持禁用。
Result: 在内置六件参考装配的案例研究中确立端到端可行性：流水线保留了报告的装配顺序，并把数量、材料与扭矩信息带入导出的手册页面。
Conclusion: 作者主张把工程状态、确定性推理、落地语言生成、验证与人工放行分离成清晰架构即可实现可行的 CAD 落地装配说明书生成；泛化能力与几何验证仍是待做的实证问题。

papers.title: Evaluating Exact Output and Checkpoint-State Prediction in Real Programs
papers.abstract_en: We present a benchmark for predicting final output and checkpoint state from source and input alone. It extends CRUXEval-style output prediction with paired shorter- and longer-trace inputs and checkpoints inside and after a loop. The benchmark contains 400 cases from 371 Python and C++ programs, evaluated under seven settings from four model families without tools or code execution. Of 11,200 planned predictions, 11,151 produced gradable responses. Reasoning-enabled settings outperform their off counterparts by 33.1 to 55.2 percentage points on completed responses. The strongest setting scores 93.0% on shorter-trace final output, 77.0% on longer-trace final output, and 65.5% and 63.5% on the two state tasks; these scores also hold when missing responses count as wrong. Across 2,397 matched Python comparisons with identical source, changing to the longer-trace input yields 528 correct-to-wrong changes and 147 reversals. Source-clustered analyses preserve this accuracy gap, while adjusted Python models give no evidence of a positive incremental association between cumulative state load and error. Changed inputs and checkpoint tasks alter several factors together, so the gaps do not isolate trace length or an internal state-tracking mechanism. The benchmark exposes errors hidden by short-output scores alone.
papers.comment: 15 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding. Includes appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个从源码与输入直接预测最终输出和检查点状态的基准，扩展 CRUXEval 式输出预测，配对短/长轨迹输入以及循环内与循环后的检查点，共 400 例、371 个 Python 与 C++ 程序，在无工具无执行条件下测 4 个模型家族 7 种设置。最强设置在短轨迹最终输出上得 93.0%、长轨迹 77.0%、两个状态任务 65.5% 与 63.5%；把缺失响应计为错误分数仍成立。
Motivation: 只看短输出分数会掩盖模型在长轨迹与状态检查点上的错误，且现有输出预测评测缺少循环内/后的检查点配对设置。
Method: 基准含 400 例、371 个 Python/C++ 程序，配对短与长轨迹输入及循环内、循环后检查点；在无工具、无代码执行条件下评测 4 个模型家族的 7 种设置，共 11,200 次预测，其中 11,151 次产生可评分响应；另做源码聚类分析与调整后的 Python 回归模型。
Result: 推理开启设置比关闭设置在完成的响应上高 33.1 到 55.2 个百分点；最强设置短轨迹最终输出 93.0%、长轨迹 77.0%、两个状态任务 65.5% 与 63.5%，缺失计错时仍保持。2,397 组同源 Python 对比中，改用长轨迹输入造成 528 例由对变错和 147 例反向翻转；源码聚类分析保留该差距，调整后的 Python 模型未显示累计状态负载与错误的正向增量关联。
Conclusion: 短输出分数会隐藏长轨迹与状态预测上的错误，但输入与检查点任务同时改变了多个因素，这些差距不能单独归因于轨迹长度或某个内部状态跟踪机制。

papers.title: legoESM: a modular, differentiable, multiscale, AI-ready Earth system model built with AI agents
papers.abstract_en: Earth system models (ESMs) have grown tremendously in realism, yet key uncertainties persist in the climate response to greenhouse-gas forcing, particularly due to cloud radiative feedbacks. In addition, their software architecture was not designed for accelerator hardware or modern artificial intelligence (AI). Here we present legoESM, a composable, differentiable, multiscale ESM written in JAX. It builds on decades of community-developed parameterizations and numerical methods, recast in a unified framework by AI coding agents under a human-specified scientific contract and verified through benchmarking. Dynamical cores, physics schemes, grids, complexity levels and components are swappable like building blocks, and can use conventional physics or machine-learned emulators. A single code base spans metre-scale large-eddy simulation to global simulations and weather to climate. End-to-end differentiability enables gradient-based calibration, variational data assimilation and online training. legoESM modular architecture enables systematic evaluation of diverse model variants to explore structural uncertainty and test hypotheses. legoESM produces realistic simulations across scales, reduces land-surface temperature bias through gradient-based calibration, and scales efficiently on GPUs to kilometer-scale simulations. It offers an open, community infrastructure for hypothesis testing, research and teaching in Earth sciences and a template for multiscale physical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: legoESM 是用 JAX 写成的可组合、可微、多尺度地球系统模型，动力核、物理方案、网格与复杂度层级像积木一样可换，同一代码库覆盖从米级大涡模拟 (LES) 到全球模拟、从天气到气候。端到端可微性直接支撑基于梯度的校准、变分数据 assimilation 与在线训练；梯度校准降低了陆面温度偏差，且在 GPU 上高效扩展到公里级模拟。
Motivation: ESM 对温室气体强迫的气候响应仍存在关键不确定性，尤其来自云辐射反馈；同时其软件架构并非为加速器硬件和现代 AI 设计，难以系统评估模型结构不确定性。
Method: 用 JAX 重写 ESM，由 AI coding agents 在人类指定的科学契约 (scientific contract) 下把社区长期积累的参数化与数值方法重构进统一框架，并通过 benchmarking 验证；动力核、物理方案、网格、复杂度层级与组件可互换，可挂传统物理或机器学习 emulator；端到端可微性用于基于梯度的校准、变分数据 assimilation 与在线训练。
Result: legoESM 在跨尺度上产生真实模拟，基于梯度的校准降低了陆面温度偏差，并在 GPU 上高效扩展到公里级模拟；单一代码库覆盖米级 LES 到全球模拟、天气到气候。
Conclusion: 把 ESM 重构成可微、可组合的统一框架后，梯度校准与变分数据 assimilation 可以直接嵌入建模流程，同一代码库即可支撑从天气到气候的多尺度假设检验，并作为多尺度物理系统的开源模板。

papers.title: How Is Automated Research Evaluated? A Survey of Benchmarks and Evaluation Practices
papers.abstract_en: Automated research systems support literature synthesis, ideation, experiments, writing, and peer review, but their evaluation is dispersed across tasks, benchmarks, and studies that are difficult to compare directly. We review this literature from the perspective of evaluation design and evidence, covering six targets: literature synthesis, research ideation, executable workflows, scholarly writing and communication, automatic peer review, and end-to-end research. We compare task construction, evidence sources, evaluators, and scoring procedures to explain the capabilities assessed by different designs. Our synthesis highlights three recurring lessons: output checks, process checks, and human studies provide complementary information; evaluator calibration is specific to the property being assessed; and resource budgets and attempt selection are integral to interpreting performance comparisons. We identify diagnostic evaluation designs and documented gaps in supporting evidence, and translate these comparisons into reporting and audit recommendations for specific evaluation settings. The survey helps readers navigate existing evaluations, select appropriate benchmarks, and design subsequent studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于自动化科研系统 (automated research systems) 评测的综述，按文献综述、研究构思、可执行工作流、学术写作、自动同行评审、端到端科研六类目标梳理任务构造、证据来源、评测者与打分流程。核心结论是输出检查、过程检查与人工研究三类证据互补，评测者校准只对被测属性有效，资源预算与尝试选择 (attempt selection) 是解读性能对比的必要条件。
Motivation: 自动化科研系统的评测分散在互不可比的任务、基准与研究中，读者难以判断各设计究竟测了什么能力，也难以比较性能数字。
Method: 从评测设计与证据视角综述文献，对六类目标比较任务构造、证据来源、评测者 (evaluators) 与打分程序，并识别诊断性评测设计与证据缺口，转化为针对具体评测场景的报告与审计建议。
Result: 综述给出三条反复出现的结论：输出检查、过程检查与人工研究提供互补信息；评测者校准与被评估的具体属性绑定；资源预算和尝试选择是解读性能对比的组成部分。
Conclusion: 自动化科研评测应按被测属性选择评测者并显式报告资源预算与尝试选择，否则跨基准的性能对比不可解读。

papers.title: Relative Patch Response Learning for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Generative models can now synthesize highly realistic images, simultaneously increasing the risks of misinformation and visual forgery. Therefore, detecting AI-generated images becomes more essential, and a reliable detector must generalize to unseen generators and stay robust to unseen perturbations in the wild. Existing detectors are typically trained on either independently collected real and generated images or aligned real-generated pairs designed to mitigate content bias. Building on aligned pairs, recent methods form a mixed view by replacing some patches of the real image with their generated counterparts. However, we find that self-attention lets real and generated patches interact, so the feature of each patch no longer reflects its own source alone. This contextual shift makes a per-patch source label an imprecise target. To this end, we propose Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL). Instead of labeling each patch, PRL compares the same patch across two mixed views of an aligned pair and learns from its patch response, the change of its score between the views. (i) To give precise supervision under the contextual shift, a relative response objective measures the responses of source-changed patches against those of source-unchanged patches, which respond to the shift alone. (ii) To provide a reliable reference for the shift, a reference coherence objective keeps each group of source-unchanged patches moving as a whole. (iii) Since the two views contain different amounts of generated content, an area ranking objective asks the view with the larger generated area to have a higher mean patch score. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of PRL, which surpasses the best prior methods by 4.3% and 5.9% in average balanced accuracy across eight standard and three in-the-wild benchmarks, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Relative Patch Response Learning (PRL)：混合视图中 self-attention 让真假 patch 互相污染，逐 patch 源标签不再精确，改为比较对齐图像对两个混合视图中同一 patch 的分数变化（patch response）来学习。在八个标准与三个 in-the-wild 基准上，平均 balanced accuracy 分别超过此前最佳方法 4.3% 和 5.9%。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器依赖独立收集的真假图或对齐图像对，混合视图下 self-attention 使每个 patch 的特征不再只反映自身来源，逐 patch 源标签成为不精确的监督目标，检测器难以泛化到未见生成器与扰动。
Method: PRL 含三个目标：relative response objective 用源未变 patch 的响应作参照来度量源已变 patch 的响应；reference coherence objective 让每组源未变 patch 作为整体一起移动；area ranking objective 要求生成内容面积更大的视图具有更高的平均 patch 分数。
Result: 在八个标准基准和三个 in-the-wild 基准上，PRL 的平均 balanced accuracy 分别超过此前最佳方法 4.3% 和 5.9%。
Conclusion: 在上下文偏移下，用同一 patch 跨视图的相对响应替代逐 patch 绝对源标签，可给出更精确的监督，从而提升检测器对未见生成器与扰动的泛化。

papers.title: Learning structured linear dynamical systems from missing observations
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning structured linear dynamical systems over convex sets $\mathcal{K}$, where only a small subset of the observations are available at each time point. An estimator which minimizes a bias-corrected, potentially non-convex objective function is proposed. Non-asymptotic bounds are obtained for the statistical error, which depend on the local complexity of $\mathcal{K}$, the trajectory length $T$, and the sub-sampling probability $p$. Convergence of the projected gradient descent algorithm is also established. The general theory is applied to settings where (i) $\mathcal{K}$ is a subspace, (ii) $\mathcal{K}$ is the set of bi-isotonic matrices, and (iii) $\mathcal{K}$ is the set of matrices whose rows are formed by sampling Lipschitz functions. We show meaningful recovery of the transition matrix is possible for values of $T$ much smaller than what is required in the unconstrained case, and for $p = o(1)$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在每个时刻只有小部分观测可用时，用偏差校正的目标函数学习凸约束集 K 上的结构化线性动力系统，并证明投影梯度下降收敛。非渐近误差界依赖 K 的局部复杂度、轨迹长度 T 与子采样概率 p；恢复转移矩阵所需的 T 可远小于无约束情形，且在 p=o(1) 时仍可行。
Motivation: 线性动力系统辨识在观测逐时刻缺失（子采样）时，无约束估计需要很长轨迹才能恢复转移矩阵，且标准目标函数在缺失下有偏。
Method: 提出最小化偏差校正、可能非凸的目标函数的估计量，用投影梯度下降求解并证明其收敛；给出依赖 K 局部复杂度、T、p 的非渐近统计误差界。理论应用于 K 为子空间、bi-isotonic 矩阵集、行由 Lipschitz 函数采样构成的矩阵集三类结构。

papers.title: Understanding Latent-Dimension Scaling in Dynamical-System Learning through Spectral Reliability
papers.abstract_en: In deep learning, approximation theory motivates increasing representation size. We ask whether this benefit extends to dynamics learning through autoregressive prediction. We analyze the learned time evolution through the eigenstructure of Koopman operators, using relative residuals to detect spurious eigenpairs arising even as one-step error falls. For bounded Koopman operators, we show that minimal residuals over learned dictionary spaces converge pointwise to their full-space counterparts as these spaces approximate the observable space in $L^2$. Our hypothesis is that Koopman spectral reliability helps explain how consistently rollout error decreases with increasing dimension. We compare two models of a shared Koopman autoencoder trained alternately for reconstruction and latent evolution, using latent-prediction loss (one-step prediction errors in latent coordinates) or spectral-residual loss (relative residuals of candidate eigenpairs). Across six chaotic systems, both models reduced median windowed rollout error from smallest to largest dimension. The spectral-residual model achieved lower medians than the latent-prediction model for all systems and dimensions, and its median fell by a larger factor in every system. Its median decreased monotonically with dimension in four systems, against one for latent prediction. Against four baseline families, its mean valid prediction times were nearly always longer. At the largest dimension under two-stage training, we compared eigenvalue positions with each learned dictionary's residual contours. Spectral-residual eigenvalues concentrated in low-residual regions, whereas latent-prediction eigenvalues also appeared in high-residual regions, consistent with the hypothesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自回归动力系统学习中，用 Koopman 算子特征结构的相对残差判定谱可靠性：以谱残差损失替代潜在预测损失训练共享 Koopman autoencoder，可让特征值集中在低残差区、并使 rollout 误差随隐空间维度增大而更稳定地下降。在六个混沌系统上，谱残差模型在所有系统与维度上的窗口 rollout 误差中位数都更低，且中位数在四个系统中随维度单调下降（潜在预测仅一个系统）。
Motivation: 近似理论鼓励加大表示维度，但自回归动力学习中一步误差下降时仍会出现伪特征对 (spurious eigenpairs)，rollout 误差是否随维度稳定改善缺乏可解释的判据。
Method: 分析 Koopman autoencoder 学到的时间演化特征结构，用候选特征对的相对残差检测伪特征对；同一架构交替做重建与潜在演化训练，对比 latent-prediction loss（潜在坐标一步误差）与 spectral-residual loss（候选特征对相对残差）两种损失；并证明当字典空间在 L2 中逼近可观测空间时，有界 Koopman 算子的最小残差逐点收敛到全空间对应值。
Result: 在六个混沌系统上，两种模型都使窗口 rollout 误差中位数从最小维度到最大维度下降；谱残差模型在所有系统与所有维度上的中位数都低于潜在预测模型，且每个系统的中位数降幅因子都更大；其误差中位数在四个系统中随维度单调下降，潜在预测仅一个系统；对照四类基线，其平均有效预测时间 (mean valid prediction times) 几乎总是更长；在最大维度两阶段训练下，谱残差模型的特征值集中在低残差区域，潜在预测模型的特征值也出现在高残差区域。
Conclusion: Koopman 谱可靠性可以解释 rollout 误差为何随隐维度增大而更一致地下降：把谱残差直接写进损失，比只监督潜在坐标一步误差更能抑制伪特征对、延长有效预测时间。

papers.title: Conditional Kernel Stein Discrepancy
papers.abstract_en: Kernel Stein discrepancies (KSDs) provide a versatile tool for comparing distributions. One of their main applications is in quantifying the goodness-of-fit (GoF) between a data-generating distribution and a prescribed target distribution. In this work, we study the related problem of conditional GoF quantification: given only a (possibly non-normalized) conditional target model, without information on the distribution of its covariates, and samples from a joint distribution, the goal is to assess how well the conditional distribution of the samples matches the target. To tackle this setting, we present a framework that allows lifting unconditional KSDs to the conditional setting through an operator-valued kernel on the covariate space, going beyond the known Euclidean case. We establish that our suggested statistic vanishes if and only if the conditional model and the true conditional distribution agree for almost all covariates and deploy it to test conditional GoF on smooth manifolds and on discrete spaces. Our experiments on level, power, and runtime demonstrate the viability of testing on these domains using the proposed statistic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Conditional Kernel Stein Discrepancy (CKSD)：用协变量空间上的算子值核 (operator-valued kernel) 把无条件 KSD 提升到条件分布，仅凭未归一化条件目标模型与联合分布样本即可检验条件拟合优度。统计量在条件模型与真实条件分布几乎处处相等时才为零，并在光滑流形与离散空间上通过水平、功效与运行时间实验验证可用性。
Motivation: 条件拟合优度检验通常需要知道协变量分布，而实际中往往只有未归一化的条件目标模型和联合样本；已有的 KSD 提升方法局限于欧氏协变量空间。
Method: 通过协变量空间上的算子值核将无条件 KSD 提升到条件设定，推广到已知的欧氏情形之外；构造的统计量在条件模型与真实条件分布几乎处处一致时为零，并用于光滑流形与离散空间上的条件 GoF 检验。
Result: 在水平 (level)、功效 (power) 与运行时间三方面做实验，表明该统计量在流形与离散域上检验可行；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 算子值核提升给出一个可证当且仅当性质的条件 GoF 统计量，适用于流形与离散协变量空间。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: LEVER: Adaptive Cost-Aware Proof Search Over AND/OR Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Mathematicians value proofs for more than correctness: among correct proofs, simplicity, purity and the computational cost of finding them vary widely. Yet LLM-powered theorem provers largely search for any correct proof, and improve its quality only after it is found. We propose LEVER, a proof search algorithm that makes the objective over correct proofs programmable and optimizes it during search. LEVER scores partial proofs over an AND/OR proof graph, combining realized objective values with predictions for open subgoals, so the objective guides search before a proof is complete. The same mechanism optimizes computational cost, proof length, topical impurity, and even their weighted combinations, while the Lean kernel enforces correctness. On PutnamBench in Lean 4, under matched budgets, LEVER costs 34% less than a strong single-conversation agent while raising the solve rate from 80% to 96%. On reducing topical impurity, i.e., how far a proof strays from its theorem's subject, it improves over post-hoc refactoring (42% reduction against 33%) at two-thirds of the cost and more reliably; on proof length, the metric refactoring is built for, it approaches refactoring. Varying the objective's weights traces a quality-cost trade-off curve, so the user can choose how much a better proof is worth. Overall, LEVER is a performant, cost-efficient and tunable proof search algorithm for navigating the space of correct proofs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEVER 把「正确证明的质量」做成可编程目标，在 AND/OR 证明图上搜索过程中就优化计算成本、证明长度与主题纯度，而不是先找对再改。在 PutnamBench (Lean 4) 同等预算下，成本比强单对话体 agent 低 34%，求解率从 80% 升到 96%；主题纯度上比事后重构多降 42%（重构 33%）而成本只有三分之二。
Motivation: LLM 定理证明器只以「找到任意正确证明」为目标，简洁性、纯度与搜索成本这些数学家真正在意的性质要等证明找到后才被事后改进。
Method: 在 AND/OR 证明图上对部分证明打分：已实现的目标值加上对未闭合子目标的预测，使目标在证明完成前就引导搜索；Lean kernel 负责正确性，目标可加权组合成本、长度与主题纯度。
Result: PutnamBench (Lean 4) 同等预算下成本比强单对话 agent 低 34%，求解率 80% → 96%；主题纯度改善 42%（post-hoc refactoring 为 33%），成本为后者的三分之二且更稳定；证明长度上接近 refactoring。
Conclusion: 把证明质量做成搜索期可优化的可编程目标，能同时提高求解率并降低成本，权重调节可画出质量-成本权衡曲线供用户选择。

papers.title: Trajectory-Guided Fault Localization for Agent Skill Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills provide reusable guidance for code agents, but incomplete or unsuitable guidance can impair task execution. To reduce the manual effort of skill refinement, recent approaches use LLMs to generate revisions from execution feedback. However, grounding these revisions in explicit behavioral evidence remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose SkillMorph, a skill-evolution approach based on trajectory-guided fault localization in agent skills. Its core idea is to link execution evidence to specific skill contents before generating revisions. Specifically, SkillMorph compares failure and success evidence in abstracted trajectories across repeated runs and tasks, incorporating changes between evolution loops to identify suspicious actions. It then uses these suspicious actions to localize edit sites in the skills and generate corresponding revisions. Experiments on SWE-Skills-Bench and CannBot show that the skills evolved by SkillMorph consistently achieve higher trial-level accuracy and execution consistency than the original skills and those from four existing skill-evolution methods. We have also applied SkillMorph to automated kernel generation with an AI operator-development team, which has accepted 6 skill-revision pull requests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillMorph 用轨迹引导的故障定位 (trajectory-guided fault localization) 演化 agent skill：对比重复运行与跨任务中成功/失败的抽象轨迹并纳入演化循环间的差异，定位可疑动作，再据此确定 skill 的编辑点并生成修订。在 SWE-Skills-Bench 与 CannBot 上，其演化出的 skill 在 trial 级准确率与执行一致性上稳定高于原始 skill 及四种已有 skill-evolution 方法；在 AI 算子开发团队的自动内核生成中被接受 6 个 skill 修订 PR。
Motivation: 用 LLM 从执行反馈生成 skill 修订的现有做法缺少显式行为证据支撑，修订难以落到 skill 的具体位置，导致人工精修成本高。
Method: SkillMorph 先在抽象轨迹上比较重复运行与不同任务的失败证据和成功证据，并纳入演化循环间的变化以识别可疑动作；再用这些可疑动作把故障定位到 skill 的具体编辑点，最后生成对应修订。
Result: 在 SWE-Skills-Bench 和 CannBot 上，SkillMorph 演化的 skill 在 trial 级准确率与执行一致性上一致高于原始 skill 和四种已有 skill-evolution 方法；在 AI 算子开发团队的自动内核生成场景中，其产出被接受 6 个 skill 修订 pull request。
Conclusion: 把执行证据先锚定到 skill 的具体条目再生成修订，能让 skill 演化同时提高任务准确率与执行一致性，并可直接产出被团队接受的修订 PR。

papers.title: Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Inpainting via Learnable Mask Attention and Support Token Refinement
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene inpainting aims to recover missing or occluded regions in edited 3D scenes, while ensuring geometric and textural consistency. Existing approaches, however, typically require accurately calibrated camera poses, which restricts their applicability in casual, in-the-wild scenarios and introduces additional preprocessing overhead. To overcome this limitation, we present FreeInpaint, a novel feed-forward framework that generates complete and 3D-consistent scenes directly from unposed multi-view images with masked regions. At its core, FreeInpaint extends a 3D foundation model to propagate masked regions from a reference view to other unposed views, bridging 3D reconstruction and scene inpainting while preserving the model's native ability to recover camera poses and scene geometry. Our method addresses two key challenges in adapting feed-forward 3D foundation models to masked inputs. First, masked regions can corrupt cross-view correspondence reasoning, degrading pose estimation and geometry recovery. To address this, we introduce a Learnable Mask Attention mechanism that preserves the spatial anchoring of reliable observations while allowing masked regions to progressively absorb useful context in deeper layers. Second, under severe occlusions, a single forward pass often lacks sufficient appearance evidence for high-fidelity completion. Therefore, we propose a Support Token Refinement strategy, which injects diffusion-generated support evidence as confidence-weighted auxiliary tokens to refine under-observed regions while preserving the original spatial anchor. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that FreeInpaint achieves superior inpainting quality, eliminating the reliance on pre-computed camera poses while keeping a fast inference speed. The project page is https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Project page: https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreeInpaint 是一个前馈 3D 场景补全框架，直接从带掩码的无位姿多视角图像生成几何与纹理一致的完整场景，无需预先标定相机位姿。可学习掩码注意力 (Learnable Mask Attention) 保住可靠观测的空间锚定并让掩码区在深层逐步吸收上下文，Support Token Refinement 再注入扩散生成的置信度加权辅助 token 精修欠观测区域。实验显示其补全质量更优，同时省去预计算位姿并保持较快推理速度。
Motivation: 现有 3D 补全方法依赖精确标定的相机位姿，限制了在随手拍摄的 in-the-wild 场景中的使用，并带来额外预处理开销。
Method: 扩展一个 3D foundation model，把掩码区域从参考视角传播到其他无位姿视角，保留其原生的相机位姿与场景几何恢复能力；针对掩码输入引入 Learnable Mask Attention 处理被破坏的跨视角对应推理，再用 Support Token Refinement 将扩散生成的支持证据作为置信度加权辅助 token 注入欠观测区域。
Result: 在多个多样数据集上的实验中，FreeInpaint 取得更优的补全质量，同时消除对预计算相机位姿的依赖并保持较快推理速度。
Conclusion: 无位姿的前馈 3D 补全是可行路径：把掩码处理与位姿/几何恢复耦合进同一个 foundation model，即可在不预标定位姿的前提下得到 3D 一致的补全结果。
Relevance: 0
