papers.title: GRPODropout: Less is More for Online Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as GRPO substantially improve large language model reasoning but often suffer from policy entropy collapse: the loss of sampling diversity weakens exploration and limits further improvement. Existing methods address this issue either through algorithm-level interventions, such as reward modification and entropy/KL regularization, or through token-level reweighting. We investigate a complementary perspective: entropy collapse can also be mitigated by changing which generated rollouts contribute to policy updates. Under the same sampling budget, not all rollouts contribute positively to an update, and selectively excluding some can improve learning. To address this, we propose GRPODropout: before the standard update, we use a simple strategy that selectively removes a small number of high-probability positive-advantage rollouts and recenters the retained advantages. To motivate this design, we develop a rollout-level theoretical analysis that guides method design and threshold selection. The method changes only rollout usage, and adds negligible computational overhead. Experiments show higher accuracy than original GRPO and higher actor entropy while using fewer rollout samples for updates, illustrating "less is more." This work provides insight into RL rollout usage: removing some rollouts can improve performance. Code is available at https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRPODropout 在 LLM 推理的在线 RL 训练中，于标准更新前选择性剔除少量高概率、正优势 (positive-advantage) 的 rollout，并对保留样本的优势重新中心化 (recenter)，以缓解策略熵坍缩。实验显示它比原始 GRPO 准确率更高、actor 熵更高，且用于更新的 rollout 样本更少，计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: GRPO 等 LLM 推理 RL 方法常出现策略熵坍缩，采样多样性丧失削弱探索、限制进一步提升；已有手段集中在奖励改造、熵/KL 正则或 token 级重加权，rollout 层面的取舍尚未被利用。
Method: 提出 GRPODropout：在标准更新前用简单策略剔除少量高概率正优势 rollout，并对保留 rollout 的优势重新中心化；配套 rollout 级理论分析指导方法设计与阈值选择，只改变 rollout 的使用方式。
Result: 实验中相比原始 GRPO 取得更高准确率与更高 actor 熵，同时用于更新的 rollout 样本更少，额外计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 在同等采样预算下并非所有 rollout 都对更新有正贡献，选择性丢弃一部分反而能改善学习，即「少即是多」。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DADP: Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning, A Reverse Hebbian-Inspired Structural Pruning Method
papers.abstract_en: Modern neural networks are heavily over-parameterized. This redundancy incurs substantial compute and memory overhead during training and inference. Existing pruning methods rely on post-hoc magnitude thresholds or static initialization heuristics. Consequently, they often require manual per-layer sparsity targets or expensive retraining cycles. We propose Dynamic Activity-Dependent Pruning (DADP), a biologically inspired structural plasticity mechanism. During training, DADP measures connection importance via the accumulated product of pre-synaptic activations and post-synaptic error gradients. Using a single global threshold instead of fixed layer budgets, DADP dynamically allocates sparsity across network depth while naturally inducing neuron- and channel-level pruning. Across MLP, VGG-16, ResNet-18, BiLSTM-CRF, and MiniBERT architectures, DADP matches or outperforms Magnitude, SNIP and RigL, retaining 73.67% accuracy (dense baseline: 76.06%) at 99% sparsity on ResNet-18. Finally, matrix-based Shannon entropy and effective rank measurements confirm that DADP preserves latent feature diversity at extreme sparsities without representation collapse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DADP 用突触前激活与突触后误差梯度的累积乘积衡量连接重要性，以单一全局阈值在训练中动态分配各层稀疏度，无需逐层稀疏目标或重训练。在 ResNet-18 上 99% 稀疏度仍保留 73.67% 准确率（dense 基线 76.06%），匹配或超过 Magnitude、SNIP、RigL。
Motivation: 现有剪枝依赖事后幅值阈值或静态初始化启发式，常需手工设定逐层稀疏度或昂贵的重训练循环，冗余参数带来训练与推理的算力和内存开销。
Method: DADP 是受生物结构可塑性启发的反 Hebbian 结构剪枝：训练中以突触前激活与突触后误差梯度的累积乘积作为连接重要性，用单一全局阈值替代固定逐层预算，动态跨深度分配稀疏度并自然诱导神经元与通道级剪枝；用矩阵 Shannon 熵与 effective rank 度量表示多样性。
Result: 在 MLP、VGG-16、ResNet-18、BiLSTM-CRF、MiniBERT 上匹配或超过 Magnitude、SNIP 与 RigL；ResNet-18 在 99% 稀疏度下保留 73.67% 准确率（dense 基线 76.06%）；矩阵 Shannon 熵与 effective rank 测量确认极端稀疏下潜特征多样性得以保持、无表示坍缩。
Conclusion: 用全局阈值加活动依赖的重要性度量即可在极端稀疏度下替代逐层预算与重训练，同时保住表示多样性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VEDJE: Video-Efficient Discriminative Joint Encoder for Scalable Video-Text Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Finding the right video often requires distinguishing similar scenes in which different events occur. Joint matching improves retrieval, but processing rich video representations for each query is costly. VEDJE compresses features within sampled frames while keeping their representations separate in a reusable cache. Feature-change prediction supplies an auxiliary training signal that improves retrieval from the compressed cache without adding work at query time. On MSR-VTT, MSVD, DiDeMo, and ActivityNet, VEDJE improves R@1 over matched first-stage retrievers in both retrieval directions. On MSR-VTT, it reaches 59.8 text-to-video R@1 with a fine-tuned VideoCLIP-XL first stage. In the VideoPrism configuration, shrinking the per-video cache fourfold to 12 KiB preserves text-to-video recall within 0.2 points. These results show that accurate video search can operate on compact evidence, encoded once and reused as new queries arrive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VEDJE 在采样帧内压缩视频特征并把各帧表示分开存入可复用缓存，用特征变化预测 (feature-change prediction) 作为辅助训练信号，使压缩缓存上的检索在查询时不增加额外计算。在 MSR-VTT、MSVD、DiDeMo、ActivityNet 上双向检索 R@1 均优于匹配的首阶段检索器，MSR-VTT 上配合微调的 VideoCLIP-XL 首阶段达到 59.8 的 text-to-video R@1；VideoPrism 配置下把每视频缓存压缩四倍至 12 KiB，text-to-video recall 仅下降 0.2 点以内。
Motivation: 区分相似场景中不同事件需要联合匹配 (joint matching)，但对每个查询都重新处理富视频表示代价高，视频检索的存储与查询开销成为瓶颈。
Method: 在采样帧内压缩特征，同时保持各帧表示在可复用缓存中彼此独立；以特征变化预测作为辅助训练信号，让模型从压缩缓存中恢复检索能力，查询阶段无需额外计算。首阶段检索器可选微调的 VideoCLIP-XL 或 VideoPrism。
Result: 在 MSR-VTT、MSVD、DiDeMo、ActivityNet 四个数据集上，VEDJE 在 text-to-video 与 video-to-text 两个方向的 R@1 均高于匹配的首阶段检索器；MSR-VTT 上配合微调 VideoCLIP-XL 首阶段取得 59.8 text-to-video R@1；VideoPrism 配置下每视频缓存缩小四倍至 12 KiB，text-to-video recall 保持在 0.2 点以内。
Conclusion: 准确的视频检索可以在紧凑证据上完成：视频编码一次即可被后续新查询反复复用，压缩缓存不必然牺牲检索精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization via Complex-Valued Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization (OV-AVEL) labels each video segment with an event class, including classes that were never seen during training. The dominant pipeline uses a frozen multimodal foundation model (e.g. ImageBind) to embed the visual frame, the audio mel-spectrogram, and each candidate class name into a shared space, then computes two cosine similarities for each segment against each class: visual-text and audio-text. Existing methods then collapse this pair into a single scalar score with a fixed rule (geometric mean, weighted average) before taking the argmax. Instead, we compute complex-valued similarities and learn their fusion using a complex-valued neural network (CVNN). Each modality's standard representation becomes the real part of our pipeline, and a paired companion stream supplies the imaginary part. We use imaginary part of iHSV for visual modality and CycleGAN-translated phase spectrogram for audio modality as these companion streams. This results in two complex similarities, which are then fused. While the vision and audio encoders remain frozen, only the temporal-attention blocks and the fusion CVNN are trained. The four-stream complex architecture sets a new state of the art on both OV-AVEL benchmarks. On the open (unseen-class) split of OV-AVEBench we reach 66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1 (+1.6/+4.1/+6.6 over the previously reported fine-tuned baseline), with consistent gains for seen classes as well. We also modify AVE dataset for this task and observe that our architecture reaches 60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1, achieving state-of-the-art OV-AVEL results on it as well. We also propose a two-stream alternative, which also sees great improvements over the baseline.
papers.comment: Accepted to British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对开放词汇音视事件定位 (OV-AVEL) 中固定规则融合视觉-文本与音频-文本相似度的做法，提出用复值神经网络 (CVNN) 学习复相似度融合：各模态标准表示作实部，iHSV 虚部（视觉）与 CycleGAN 翻译相位谱（音频）作虚部。在 OV-AVEBench 未见类划分上达到 66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，较此前微调基线分别 +1.6/+4.1/+6.6。
Motivation: 现有 OV-AVEL 流水线用几何平均或加权平均把视觉-文本与音频-文本余弦相似度压成单一标量再取 argmax，融合规则固定，无法学习两种模态证据的组合方式。
Method: 冻结 ImageBind 类多模态基础模型的视觉与音频编码器，只训练时间注意力块与融合 CVNN；每模态标准表示作实部，配对伴随流（视觉用 iHSV 虚部，音频用 CycleGAN 翻译的相位谱）作虚部，构成两个复相似度后由 CVNN 融合；另提出两流替代方案。
Result: OV-AVEBench 开放（未见类）划分：66.5/59.1/54.1% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，较此前报告的微调基线 +1.6/+4.1/+6.6，且已见类上也有稳定增益。改造后的 AVE 数据集上：60.7/51.9/50.4% Acc/Seg-F1/Event-F1，同样达到 SOTA。
Conclusion: 四流复值架构在两个 OV-AVEL 基准上均创 SOTA，说明用可学习的复值融合替代固定相似度合并规则能同时提升未见类与已见类性能。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Recovery Guarantees for Posterior Sampling of One-Bit Compressed Sensing
papers.abstract_en: We study the sample complexity of noisy one-bit compressed sensing for signals drawn from a prior distribution. By characterizing the effective distributional complexity of the prior via its approximate covering number, we prove that posterior sampling achieves accurate recovery with high probability when the number of measurements scales with the logarithm of the approximate covering number, up to a one-bit separation gap factor. This upper bound is robust to learned prior mismatch. Specifically, we show that posterior sampling with an approximate prior remains reliable, provided that the learned prior distribution is sufficiently close to the true signal distribution in Wasserstein distance. In addition, we establish a sample complexity lower bound for any reliable method of noisy one-bit compressed sensing, showing that our upper bound is nearly matched in its main prior dependent term. To approximate the ideal posterior sampling process for real world scenarios, we instantiate posterior sampling through a plug-and-play algorithm with diffusion priors. Experiments on the FFHQ and ImageNet datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

Method: 用近似覆盖数量化先验的有效分布复杂度，证明后验采样的样本复杂度上界（随覆盖数对数增长，含单比特分离间隙因子），并给出对 Wasserstein 距离下先验失配的稳健性；再对任意可靠方法建立下界。为逼近理想后验采样，用扩散先验 (diffusion priors) 实现 plug-and-play 算法。

papers.title: Probability-Signature Dynamics: Unpacking Modular Addition Learning Within Two-Layer Networks
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks trained on modular addition tasks often develop Fourier-structured representations that support exact generalization. While prior work has identified these Fourier circuits, the mechanism by which gradient-based training selects them from the data distribution remains unclear. We address this question using probability signatures, which express leading gradient interactions through conditional statistics of the training distribution. For modular addition, these signatures are cyclic shift operators and are diagonalized by the discrete Fourier transform, yielding approximately decoupled Fourier-mode dynamics. This explains the emergence of Fourier sparsity, frequency matching, and phase alignment. The same framework resolves a puzzle under label noise: corrupted examples can show faster early loss decrease than clean examples, despite lacking a coherent generalization rule. We show that noise increases conditional label collisions, strengthening early shared-coordinate reinforcement. Finally, this method can be applied to other operators. Taking XOR as an example, we observed the predicted frequency in experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 probability signature（训练分布条件统计刻画的领先梯度交互）解释两层网络学模加法时为何选出 Fourier 电路：模加法的 signature 是循环移位算子，被 DFT 对角化，使各 Fourier 模近似解耦，从而产生 Fourier 稀疏、频率匹配与相位对齐。标签噪声下受损样本早期损失下降反而更快，因为噪声增加条件标签碰撞、强化早期共享坐标；XOR 实验观测到预测的频率。
Motivation: 已有工作识别出模加法任务中的 Fourier 电路，但梯度训练如何从数据分布中选中这些表示的机制尚不清楚。
Method: 以 probability signature 表达训练分布条件统计下的领先梯度交互；对模加法证明其为循环移位算子并由 DFT 对角化，得到近似解耦的 Fourier 模动力学；再用条件标签碰撞解释标签噪声下的早期动力学，并以 XOR 为例检验可推广性。
Result: 框架解释了 Fourier 稀疏、频率匹配与相位对齐的出现；标签噪声下受损样本比干净样本早期损失下降更快，原因是噪声提高条件标签碰撞、加强早期共享坐标强化；XOR 实验中观测到所预测的频率。
Conclusion: 模加法中 Fourier 表示的涌现可由 signature 的谱结构决定，且该框架可迁移到其他算子（如 XOR）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Suppression to Repair: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Localized Distribution Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Object hallucination remains a major obstacle for large vision-language models (LVLMs) to generate reliable content. An intuitive mitigation strategy is to suppress hallucination-related components in hidden representations. However, these components may also contain useful information, and suppressing them can weaken the model's multimodal capabilities. In this paper, we propose ResOT, a training-free method that repairs representations at inference time through localized distribution alignment. Specifically, ResOT projects dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace, forming a low-dimensional residual subspace for intervention. Within this subspace, ResOT uses Gaussian optimal transport (OT) to align the hallucinated distribution with the faithful one. The resulting map defines repair targets with minimal changes to the original representations. At inference, ResOT adaptively controls how far each token state moves toward its OT target. Experiments on three representative LVLMs show that ResOT substantially reduces object hallucination while improving image caption quality and multimodal performance across multiple benchmarks. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResOT 不再压制幻觉方向，而是在推理时做局部分布对齐修复：先把主导幻觉方向投影出忠实子空间，得到低维残差子空间，再用 Gaussian optimal transport 把幻觉分布对齐到忠实分布，自适应控制每个 token 状态向 OT 目标移动的距离。在三个代表性 LVLM 上，该 training-free 方法显著降低物体幻觉，同时提升图像描述质量与多模态性能。
Motivation: 抑制幻觉相关隐表示会连带损失其中的有用信息，削弱模型的多模态能力，需要一种不牺牲能力的幻觉缓解路径。
Method: ResOT 是推理时的 training-free 方法：将主导幻觉方向投影出忠实子空间以构造低维残差子空间，在该子空间内用 Gaussian optimal transport (OT) 对齐幻觉分布与忠实分布，由所得映射给出对原表示改动最小的修复目标，并在推理时自适应控制每个 token 状态向目标移动的步长。
Result: 在三个代表性 LVLM 上，ResOT 在多个 benchmark 上显著降低物体幻觉 (object hallucination)，并同时改善图像描述质量与多模态性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 物体幻觉可以通过对隐表示做局部 OT 分布修复而非压制来缓解，且与多模态能力提升可以兼得；代码将发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Supervised Speech Representations for Cross-Speaker Dysarthria Detection During Awake Craniotomy
papers.abstract_en: Detecting intra-operative speech impairment during awake craniotomy is essential for preserving language function. However, automated detection remains challenging because operating-room recordings contain substantial acoustic interference, clinically relevant speech events are rare, and available cohorts are small and heterogeneous across speakers. This study presents a systematic component-wise evaluation of a pipeline for distinguishing dysarthric from no-trouble speech in the DATABRASE corpus of awake-craniotomy recordings. The pipeline incorporates speaker diarization to isolate patient speech, a multi-view representation combining handcrafted acoustic descriptors with multilayer wav2vec 2.0 embeddings, speaker-conditional normalization and transferability-based feature selection to improve cross-speaker robustness, and a cascaded classifier comprising a gradient-boosted first stage and a neural second stage. Evaluation was conducted under strict speaker-independent conditions using leave-one-speaker-out cross-validation. The results show that cross-speaker performance is influenced more strongly by the speech representation than by classifier choice. The AUCs of three classifiers differed by no more than 4.7%, whereas replacing conventional acoustic descriptors with the multilayer self-supervised representation produced AUC improvements of 18.2%-26.1%. Diarization-conditioned feature extraction and the proposed classifier cascade provided additional consistent gains. These findings indicate that reliable patient-specific speech isolation and strong pretrained representations are more important than increased classifier complexity in low-resource intra-operative settings. They also quantify the potential performance gains that may be achieved through patient-specific preoperative calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DATABRASE 开颅术中语音库上，用说话人日志 (diarization) 隔离患者语音，再以多层 wav2vec 2.0 自监督表征替代传统声学描述子，跨说话人构音障碍 (dysarthria) 检测 AUC 提升 18.2%–26.1%，而三个分类器之间 AUC 差距不超过 4.7%。结论是低资源术中场景下表征与患者语音隔离比分类器复杂度更关键。
Motivation: 开颅术中录音噪声大、临床相关语音事件稀有、队列小且说话人异质，导致跨说话人的自动构音障碍检测困难。
Method: 流水线含说话人日志隔离患者语音、手工声学描述子与多层 wav2vec 2.0 嵌入的多视图表征、说话人条件归一化与基于可迁移性的特征选择，以及梯度提升首阶段加神经网络次阶段的级联分类器；用 leave-one-speaker-out 交叉验证做严格说话人无关评估。
Result: 三个分类器 AUC 相差不超过 4.7%；用多层自监督表征替换传统声学描述子带来 18.2%–26.1% 的 AUC 提升；日志条件化特征提取与所提分类器级联还提供额外的一致增益。
Conclusion: 在低资源术中设置里，可靠的患者语音隔离与强预训练表征比加大分类器复杂度更重要，并量化了患者个体化术前校准可能带来的性能收益。

papers.title: From Pixels to Structure: Lightweight Vision-Language Models for Document OCR and Structured JSON Extraction
papers.abstract_en: While massive, closed-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) set strong benchmarks for document understanding, their dependence on commercial APIs limits adoption in institutional archives due to data autonomy concerns, recurring costs, and the environmental footprint of hyperscale computing. This is especially acute in heritage digitization, where documents include historical handwriting, domain-specific terminology (e.g., jewelry, prehistory, architecture), and non-standard layouts requiring high-dimensional structured extraction. We present a comparative study of eight open-source lightweight VLMs (up to 7B parameters) for Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-to-structure across three university heritage collections. Given a document image, models must extract text and generate schema-compliant JSON, enabling automatic validation and downstream use. We evaluate models under a constraint-aware protocol across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning settings, measuring extraction fidelity and structured-output quality using Character Error Rate (CER), Approximate Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS*), and mean Average Precision F1 (mAP-F1). Against a fine-tuning baseline, we further test the independent impact of (i) hyperparameter optimization, (ii) classical image preprocessing (illumination flattening, denoising, and CLAHE), and (iii) multi-stage training. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between dataset-specific fine-tuning and a single multi-dataset checkpoint, where joint training enables one model to operate across collections but can shift performance between datasets. Overall, we show that carefully adapted VLMs with up to 7B parameters can provide a sustainable, private, high-performing alternative to manual transcription or commercial black-box systems, and we offer actionable guidance for heritage institutions seeking institution-controlled OCR-to-JSON extraction.
papers.comment: 17 pages. Published in Document Analysis and Recognition - ICDAR 2026, LNCS vol. 16974, Springer. Code: https://github.com/uddipan77/Analysis-of-Lightweight-Vision-Language-Models-for-Document-OCR-and-Structured-Output-Generation
papers.journal_ref: Document Analysis and Recognition - ICDAR 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16974, pp. 502-519, Springer, 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 8 个开源轻量 VLM（最大 7B）在三个大学遗产馆藏上做 OCR 到 schema 合规 JSON 的对比研究，评测 zero-shot、few-shot、微调三种设定，并在微调基线上分别检验超参优化、经典图像预处理（光照拉平、去噪、CLAHE）与多阶段训练的独立影响。结论是经过适当适配的 7B 级 VLM 可作为人工转录或商业黑盒系统的可持续、私有替代方案。
Motivation: 机构档案（尤其遗产数字化）依赖商业 API 做文档理解，带来数据自主权、持续成本与算力碳足迹问题；同时历史手写、领域术语与非标准版式需要高维结构化抽取，通用闭源模型难以在机构自控前提下满足。
Method: 对 8 个开源轻量 VLM（≤7B 参数）在三个大学遗产馆藏上做约束感知协议的对比评测，任务为给定文档图像同时抽取文本并生成 schema 合规 JSON；覆盖 zero-shot、few-shot、微调三种设定，以微调为基线，分别测试超参优化、图像预处理（illumination flattening、denoising、CLAHE）与多阶段训练的独立影响，并比较数据集专属微调与单一多数据集 checkpoint 的取舍。
Result: 评测指标为 Character Error Rate (CER)、Approximate Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS*) 与 mean Average Precision F1 (mAP-F1)，在三个遗产馆藏、三种训练设定与三项干预（超参优化、图像预处理、多阶段训练）下衡量抽取保真度与结构化输出质量；联合训练使单一模型可跨馆藏运行，但会在数据集之间转移性能。
Conclusion: 适当适配后的 ≤7B VLM 足以在机构自控前提下替代人工转录或商业黑盒系统做 OCR-to-JSON 抽取；跨馆藏部署应权衡单一多数据集 checkpoint 的通用性与数据集专属微调的性能，作者据此给出面向遗产机构的可操作选型与适配指引。

summary_sections.result: 评测指标为 Character Error Rate (CER)、Approximate Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS*) 与 mean Average Precision F1 (mAP-F1)，在三个遗产馆藏、三种训练设定与三项干预（超参优化、图像预处理、多阶段训练）下衡量抽取保真度与结构化输出质量；联合训练使单一模型可跨馆藏运行，但会在数据集之间转移性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 适当适配后的 ≤7B VLM 足以在机构自控前提下替代人工转录或商业黑盒系统做 OCR-to-JSON 抽取；跨馆藏部署应权衡单一多数据集 checkpoint 的通用性与数据集专属微调的性能，作者据此给出面向遗产机构的可操作选型与适配指引。

papers.title: Fast Pose Tracking of Rigid Objects with Compact Pose Graph Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Tracking a novel object's 6D pose over long horizons currently requires either expensive onboarding or a reconstruction maintained throughout the sequence. This makes current trackers impractical for robotic manipulation and augmented reality, which need trackers that are ready to use and run in real time. We show that a lightweight tracking module can be applied on top of a wide range of correspondence estimation methods to keep drifts bounded while maintaining fast runtime. Our key idea is to avoid point-based optimization in the pose graph and operate only on relative pose constraints, which we weight by a derived uncertainty from the geometric alignment. This makes optimization independent of the number of correspondences while avoiding the direct inclusion of noisy point measurements, leading to fast and robust long-term tracking. Across four real-world benchmarks, our approach achieves tracking accuracy comparable to reconstruction-based trackers with a fraction of the optimization cost. Overall, these results suggest that a compact and reliable pose graph optimization can provide long-horizon consistency at substantially lower computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个轻量级 6D 位姿跟踪模块，叠加在任意对应关系估计方法之上，只在位姿图中使用相对位姿约束（按几何对齐导出的不确定性加权），完全避开点基优化，使优化开销与对应点数量无关。在四个真实世界基准上，跟踪精度与基于重建的跟踪器相当，而优化成本只占其一小部分。
Motivation: 新物体的长时程 6D 位姿跟踪目前要么需要昂贵的物体建模导入，要么需要在整段序列中持续维护重建，导致现有跟踪器难以用于要求开箱即用、实时运行的机器人操作与增强现实。
Method: 在对应关系估计之上叠加轻量跟踪模块；位姿图中不使用点测量，只保留相对位姿约束，并用几何对齐导出的不确定性为其加权，使优化复杂度与对应点数量解耦。
Result: 在四个真实世界基准上，跟踪精度与基于重建的跟踪器相当，优化成本仅为后者的一小部分（a fraction of the optimization cost），并保持快速运行时。
Conclusion: 紧凑可靠的位姿图优化可以在大幅降低计算成本的同时提供长时程一致性，因此叠加式跟踪模块足以替代昂贵的在线重建。

papers.title: Seek-and-View Reasoning for Multi-View Spatial Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches to multi-view spatial reasoning operate largely on sparse input views. Vision-language models (VLMs) are thus restricted to understand a scene and infer spatial relations within these fixed views, leading to fragile cross-view alignment and geometry-to-language bottleneck. To address these issues, we formulate a novel Seek-and-View reasoning approach to find implicit cross-view spatial evidence by locating a question-relevant view to support the spatial reasoning. To realize this approach, we propose Vantage, a training-free model-agnostic reasoning framework that pairs a VLM with a 3D foundation model: a viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage for question analysis and view planning, followed by a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage to effectively synthesize and incorporate visual evidence into the final reasoning. Comprehensive experiments on six VLMs demonstrate consistent improvements on five benchmarks without fine-tuning. Overall, by revealing spatial evidence through view-grounded reasoning, Vantage can largely reduce reliance on language-based cross-view alignment and improve multi-view spatial understanding. Our code is available at https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vantage 是一个 training-free、模型无关的多视空间推理框架，把 VLM 与 3D foundation model 配对：先做 viewpoint-grounded 的问题分析与视点规划，找到与问题相关的视图，再做 geometry-grounded 的证据增强，把合成的视觉证据并入最终推理。在六个 VLM、五个基准上无需微调即取得一致提升，减少对语言式跨视对齐的依赖。
Motivation: 现有方法只在稀疏固定视图上做多视空间推理，导致跨视对齐脆弱，并出现 geometry-to-language 的瓶颈。
Method: Seek-and-View 两阶段：viewpoint-grounded reasoning 阶段做问题分析与视点规划，geometry-grounded evidence augmentation 阶段合成并注入视觉证据；框架 training-free、模型无关，VLM 与 3D foundation model 配对，无需微调。
Result: 在六个 VLM 上、五个基准上均取得一致改进，且全程不微调。
Conclusion: 通过视点落地的推理显式暴露空间证据，可以大幅降低对语言式跨视对齐的依赖，从而改善多视空间理解。

papers.title: PRAXIS: Learning Dynamics of Self-Improving Models with Symbolic Archives
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving learning systems adapt data selection, optimization, and auxiliary symbolic components, inducing nonstationary objectives outside standard learning assumptions. We introduce \textsc{PRAXIS}, a co-evolutionary framework that models generators, learners, and symbolic archives as interacting dynamical processes. We prove that KL-constrained generator updates and controlled archive-weight movement bound one-step objective drift, that archive updates suppress a program relative to any fixed comparator with a persistent cumulative utility advantage under sub-Gaussian noise, and that stochastic gradient descent achieves an average-stationarity guarantee whose degradation is governed by cumulative objective drift. Experiments across visual robustness, relational graph reasoning, and algorithmic graph reasoning exhibit generator stabilization, decreasing learner loss, and archive concentration consistent with these theoretical mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRAXIS 把自我改进学习系统中的生成器、学习器和符号档案 (symbolic archive) 建模为相互作用的动力学过程，证明 KL 约束的生成器更新与受控档案权重移动能界定单步目标漂移，且 SGD 的平均平稳性保证的退化由累积目标漂移决定。在视觉鲁棒性、关系图推理与算法图推理三类实验中观察到生成器稳定、学习器损失下降和档案集中，与理论机制一致。
Motivation: 自我改进系统会动态调整数据选择、优化过程和辅助符号组件，导致目标非平稳，超出标准学习理论的平稳假设，现有分析框架无法界定其目标漂移与收敛退化。
Method: 将生成器、学习器、符号档案表述为共演化动力系统；证明三条界：KL 约束生成器更新加受控档案权重移动界定单步目标漂移，亚高斯噪声下档案更新相对任意固定比较器保持累积效用优势，SGD 平均平稳性保证的退化由累积目标漂移控制；再在视觉鲁棒性、关系图推理、算法图推理上做实验对照这些机制。
Result: 实验覆盖视觉鲁棒性、关系图推理、算法图推理三个领域，呈现生成器稳定、学习器损失下降、档案集中三个定性现象，与理论预测一致；理论侧给出单步目标漂移上界、相对固定比较器的累积效用优势（亚高斯噪声条件）以及由累积目标漂移决定的 SGD 平均平稳性退化界。
Conclusion: 把自我改进系统当作共演化动力系统来分析，可以用目标漂移这一统一量同时解释生成器稳定、学习器收敛和档案集中的行为。

papers.title: Softmax Attention on Gaussian Mixtures: Linear When It Can, Selective When It Must
papers.abstract_en: Softmax attention, at the heart of Transformers, has demonstrated remarkable capabilities. Yet its underlying mechanisms remain only partially understood. Recent theoretical work studies Gaussian prompts, where the infinite-prompt limit reduces softmax attention to a linear map, but also removes the query-dependent selection that distinguishes it from linear attention. This work studies the infinite-prompt limit of softmax attention on Gaussian mixtures, which retain the tractability of Gaussian data while introducing latent structure, multimodality, and nonlinear dependencies. We show that softmax attention can represent and learn, via gradient-based methods, optimal solutions to a range of statistical tasks, including supervised classification and denoising. Our results highlight two complementary capabilities of softmax attention: it can recover linear tasks as effectively as its simpler linear counterpart, while also exploiting query-dependent context selection to solve nonlinear tasks beyond the reach of linear attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高斯混合 (Gaussian mixture) prompt 的无穷 prompt 极限下分析 softmax attention，证明它既能像 linear attention 一样恢复线性任务的最优解，又能靠 query-dependent 的上下文选择解出线性 attention 做不到的非线性任务，且这些最优解可通过梯度方法学到。
Motivation: 已有理论工作只在单一高斯 prompt 的无穷极限下把 softmax attention 退化成线性映射，这恰好抹掉了 softmax 区别于 linear attention 的 query-dependent 选择能力，机制理解因此不完整。
Method: 把分析对象从单一高斯换成保留潜结构、多模态与非线性依赖的高斯混合，求无穷 prompt 极限下 softmax attention 的表达与可学性；任务设定为监督分类与去噪等统计任务，解由基于梯度的优化方法获得。
Result: 证明 softmax attention 在该极限下能表示并通过梯度方法学到一类统计任务（含监督分类与去噪）的最优解；既能与 linear counterpart 同样有效地恢复线性任务，也能用 query-dependent 上下文选择解决线性 attention 范围之外的非线性任务。
Conclusion: softmax attention 的价值不只在近似线性：高斯混合 prompt 下它同时具备线性可恢复性与选择性，非线性任务正是靠 query-dependent 选择才可解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
papers.abstract_en: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Memento 3 让冻结参数的 LLM 智能体通过外部自然语言规则手册 (rulebook) 持续学习显式世界模型：规则编译成可执行代码，用预测误差驱动反思与修订，只有 LLM 判定代码忠实于规则手册且 cell-exact replay 复现观测转移才接受更新。在 ARC-AGI-3 上单模型智能体通关全部 25 个公开游戏的所有关卡，RHAE 均值 100.0，动作数为人类的 44%；Atari Pong 案例中学到的反馈控制器在三种不同开局的三局中均以 21:0 获胜且不再调用 LLM。
Motivation: 有限观测往往同时支持多个能解释历史交互、但在未见状态下预测不同的世界模型，导致智能体无法确定环境真实动态；同时冻结 LLM 缺少持续更新自身世界模型的机制。
Method: 维护自然语言规则手册作为持久语义记忆，记录可修订的环境动态假设并把未知部分留空；将其编译为用于预测与规划的可执行代码，形成观测、反思、修订规则、编译、验证的持续循环，以预测误差同时改进规则手册与代码。更新的代码须通过 LLM 忠实性判定与 cell-exact replay 复现观测转移才被接受；另有一个 population 扩展并行维护多个世界模型、共享交互证据并用其预测引导探索。
Result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，单模型智能体通关全部 25 个公开游戏的每一关，Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) 均值 100.0，动作数仅为人类的 44%。在 Atari Pong 案例研究中，学到的反馈控制器在三种不同开局的三个评估对局中均以 21:0 获胜，且推理阶段不再调用 LLM。
Conclusion: 以可验证的规则手册-代码更新为中介，冻结 LLM 也能走出一条基于模型的递归自我改进 (RSI) 路径：世界模型的可信度由忠实性判定与转移重放共同把关，而非由模型参数更新保证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: Memento 3 让冻结参数的 LLM 智能体通过外部自然语言规则手册 (rulebook) 持续学习显式世界模型：规则编译成可执行代码，用预测误差驱动反思与修订，只有 LLM 判定代码忠实于规则手册且 cell-exact replay 复现观测转移才接受更新。在 ARC-AGI-3 上单模型智能体通关全部 25 个公开游戏的所有关卡，RHAE 均值 100.0，动作数为人类的 44%；Atari Pong 案例中学到的反馈控制器在三种不同开局的三局中均以 21:0 获胜且不再调用 LLM。

summary_sections.method: 维护自然语言规则手册作为持久语义记忆，记录可修订的环境动态假设并把未知部分留空；将其编译为用于预测与规划的可执行代码，形成观测、反思、修订规则、编译、验证的持续循环，以预测误差同时改进规则手册与代码。更新的代码须通过 LLM 忠实性判定与 cell-exact replay 复现观测转移才被接受；另有一个 population 扩展并行维护多个世界模型、共享交互证据并用其预测引导探索。
summary_sections.result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，单模型智能体通关全部 25 个公开游戏的每一关，Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) 均值 100.0，动作数仅为人类的 44%。在 Atari Pong 案例研究中，学到的反馈控制器在三种不同开局的三个评估对局中均以 21:0 获胜，且推理阶段不再调用 LLM。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以可验证的规则手册-代码更新为中介，冻结 LLM 也能走出一条基于模型的递归自我改进 (RSI) 路径：世界模型的可信度由忠实性判定与转移重放共同把关，而非由模型参数更新保证。

papers.title: AuraLuxMuse: Adaptive Fusion Modeling for Aesthetic Stage Lighting Design with Music and Expert Guidance
papers.abstract_en: We present AuraLuxMuse, a novel system for automated aesthetic stage lighting design that integrates expert knowledge, representation learning, and preference-adaptive modeling. Lighting design in live performance settings requires the seamless translation of musical features into dynamic lighting behaviors. However, traditional workflows remain time-consuming, labor-intensive, and difficult to transfer. AuraLuxMuse encodes music and professional cue sequences into a shared retrieval space, estimates cue-event density, and retargets selected fixture commands to the destination stage. It assists pre-production authoring by returning editable cues rather than replacing the designer with an unconstrained generator. At the heart of AuraLuxMuse are two key modules: Lighting-Aligned Music Pretraining (LAMP), which performs contrastive learning between audio and lighting cues for alignment, and Preference-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (PAMoE), which conditions preference-aware cue retrieval and adaptation on designers' intent through a gated ensemble of style-specific expert networks. To support training and evaluation, we introduce Musilux, the first dataset of paired musical audio and professional lighting cue sequences under diverse performance scenarios. We evaluate AuraLuxMuse across both virtual simulation environments and professional-grade laboratories. Experimental results, including objective and subjective evaluation, demonstrate that AuraLuxMuse retrieves and adapts stage-lighting cues that are visually cohesive, semantically meaningful, and artistically expressive, showing its potential for AI-assisted aesthetic stage design.
papers.comment: Accepted to appear in SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AuraLuxMuse 把音乐特征与专业灯光 cue 序列编码进共享检索空间，用 LAMP 对比学习对齐音画、用 PAMoE 门控专家集成按设计师意图做偏好自适应 cue 检索与改写，输出可编辑 cue 而非无约束生成。在虚拟仿真与专业实验室的主客观评测中，检索改写的灯光 cue 在视觉连贯、语义贴合与艺术表现上成立，并配套发布首个音乐-专业灯光配对数据集 Musilux。
Motivation: 现场演出灯光设计要把音乐特征实时翻译成动态灯光行为，传统流程耗时、劳动密集且难以迁移，现有生成器又直接取代设计师、不可编辑。
Method: 两个核心模块：Lighting-Aligned Music Pretraining (LAMP) 在音频与灯光 cue 之间做对比学习以对齐表征；Preference-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (PAMoE) 用风格特化专家网络的门控集成，把设计师意图作为条件做偏好感知的 cue 检索与适配。系统估计 cue-event 密度并把选定 fixture 命令重定向到目标舞台，同时引入配对数据集 Musilux 支撑训练与评测。
Result: 在虚拟仿真环境与专业级实验室两类设置上做客观与主观评测，结果显示系统检索与适配出的舞台灯光 cue 视觉连贯、语义有意义且具艺术表现力；并提出 Musilux，即首个覆盖多种演出场景的音乐音频与专业灯光 cue 配对数据集。
Conclusion: 灯光设计应走检索加可编辑改写的辅助路线，让设计师保留控制权，而不是用无约束生成器替代人；音乐-灯光对比对齐加偏好自适应专家集成是实现该路线的可行架构。

papers.title: Phase-aware video generation for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions
papers.abstract_en: Generating physically plausible videos for solid-gas dynamics is challenging as different phases exhibit distinct dynamics yet remain coupled through physical interactions. We present PAVG, a Phase-Aware Video Generator for solid-gas dynamics and interactions. It employs a dual-branch architecture to explicitly model the distinct dynamics of solids and gases, while spatiotemporal cross-attention captures their physical interactions. This design enables PAVG to preserve phasespecific motion characteristics while producing physically consistent responses across phases. To facilitate this task, we further construct a simulation corpus comprising over 700K physical trajectories across diverse solid, gas, and solid-gas interaction scenarios. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our PAVG produces videos with improved motion adherence, physical plausibility, and visual quality compared with existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAVG 用双分支架构分别建模固体与气体各自的动力学，再用时空 cross-attention 显式耦合两相交互，从而在生成视频中保持各相特有的运动特征并产生跨相一致的物理响应。配套构建了含 70 万条以上物理轨迹的仿真语料，覆盖纯固体、纯气体与固气交互场景；评测显示其在运动贴合度、物理合理性与视觉质量上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 固气多相动力学中各相规律不同却通过物理交互耦合，现有视频生成难以同时保住各相运动特征与跨相一致的物理响应。
Method: PAVG（Phase-Aware Video Generator）采用双分支架构分别显式建模固体与气体动力学，以时空 cross-attention 捕捉两相物理交互；同时构建超过 700K 条物理轨迹的仿真语料作为训练/评测基础，覆盖固体、气体及固气交互场景。
Result: 在该仿真语料上的广泛评测中，PAVG 生成视频在 motion adherence、physical plausibility 与 visual quality 三个维度上均较现有方法有提升；语料规模为 700K 以上物理轨迹。
Conclusion: 把相态分开建模、再用跨注意力耦合交互，是让生成视频同时保住各相运动特性与跨相物理一致性的有效设计。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Compile the Table: Query-Calibrated Operator Compression for Tabular In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tabular in-context learning (ICL) has emerged as a training-free and accurate paradigm for tabular prediction, but current approaches to compressing its in-context examples face an accuracy-throughput tradeoff: fixed subsets can sacrifice accuracy, while query-specific retrieval limits cache reuse and batching across queries, reducing throughput. We propose QCOC (Query-Calibrated Operator Compression), which exploits the exchangeability and repeated use of in-context examples by compiling their full KV cache once into compact memory shared across subsequent queries. Instead of retaining raw examples, QCOC clusters their states into joint-KV prototypes, preserves per-cluster multiplicities and the original example count, and calibrates prototype values against attention query vectors produced by the in-context examples through an anchored closed-form solution. Prototype compression drives the speedup, while value fitting helps preserve accuracy. On 64 held-out OpenML-CC18 datasets, QCOC achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared compression and retrieval methods at both retained counts. Across 12 configurations on seven long tables, it ranks first among compressed methods in ten and averages 0.23 percentage points below full context. Compressing 8,192 in-context examples to 512 memory slots yields a 10.5x cache compression ratio; excluding one-time compilation, in a single-core CPU online-serving comparison over 1,000 queries, QCOC is up to 508x faster than dynamic retrieval baselines and 1.98x faster than full-context inference. These results show that QCOC enables compact-memory reuse and efficient inference across queries while retaining accuracy close to full context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QCOC 把表格 in-context learning 的全部 in-context examples 的 KV cache 一次性编译成跨查询共享的紧凑原型记忆：对 example 状态做 joint-KV 聚类、保留每簇 multiplicity 与原始 example 数，并用锚定闭式解按 in-context examples 产生的 attention query 向量校准 prototype 值。在 64 个 held-out OpenML-CC18 数据集上取得所比较压缩与检索方法中的最高平均准确率；把 8,192 个 in-context examples 压到 512 个 memory slots 得到 10.5x cache 压缩比，单核 CPU 上 1,000 查询的在线服务中比动态检索基线快至 508x、比 full-context 推理快 1.98x。
Motivation: 表格 ICL 的上下文压缩存在准确率-吞吐权衡：固定子集会损失准确率，按查询检索又无法跨查询复用 cache、难以 batch，吞吐受限。
Method: QCOC 将 in-context examples 的完整 KV cache 一次性编译为共享记忆：对 example 状态做 joint-KV 聚类得到 prototypes，保留每簇 multiplicity 与原始 example 数，并通过锚定闭式解 (anchored closed-form solution) 用 in-context examples 产生的 attention query 向量校准 prototype 值；prototype 压缩带来加速，value fitting 保住准确率。
Result: 在 64 个 held-out OpenML-CC18 数据集上，QCOC 在两个 retained count 下均取得所比较压缩与检索方法的最高平均准确率；在七张长表的 12 个配置中，有 10 个在压缩方法里排名第一，平均比 full context 低 0.23 个百分点。8,192 个 in-context examples 压到 512 个 memory slots 得 10.5x cache 压缩比；排除一次性编译，单核 CPU 上 1,000 查询的在线服务对比中，比动态检索基线快至 508x，比 full-context 推理快 1.98x。
Conclusion: 把 in-context examples 的 KV cache 编译成跨查询共享的校准原型，可以在表格 ICL 上同时拿到接近 full context 的准确率和远高于动态检索的在线吞吐。

papers.title: In-Ride Alcohol-Impairment Detection in E-Scooterists with False-Alarm Control
papers.abstract_en: Shared e-scooter services have become a widely adopted urban transport mode. While most users ride responsibly, alcohol intoxication stands out among the factors contributing to severe crashes. Nonetheless, countermeasures remain limited to single-point reaction tests and night bans that suspend the service altogether. This paper proposes a new approach in which onboard sensors evaluate the rider as the trip unfolds, raising an alarm as soon as enough evidence of impairment has accumulated. Specifically, we introduce a detector that operates on inertial and throttle measurements, with a provable bound on the rate of false alarms. Experiments on sensor data from 141 rides, in which 25 participants rode while sober and at two target blood alcohol concentration levels, confirm that the bound holds, whereas baselines and ablations either exceed it or lose detection performance, and in some cases delay the alarm. At a bound of 0.023, the detector identifies 91% of the rides performed at the higher concentration and 50% of those at the lower one, with median detection times of 25 and 27 seconds, respectively. We further show that an embedded implementation meets the real-time requirement, making mitigation actions feasible onboard, without requiring data to leave the vehicle. Overall, this work lays the ground for interventions that reach impaired riders as soon as possible, sparing the sober ones the burden of a pre-ride test or the suspension of the service at night, while letting operators budget false alarms against user experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对共享电动滑板车骑行中酒精受损检测，提出基于惯性与油门传感器的在线检测器，随行程累积证据触发报警，并给出可证明的误报率上界。在 141 次骑行（25 名受试者，清醒与两个目标血酒精浓度）上，0.023 的误报上界成立，高浓度骑行检出 91%、低浓度 50%，中位检测时间分别为 25 和 27 秒。
Motivation: 共享电动滑板车的酒精相关严重事故缺乏有效对策，现有手段只有单点反应测试和直接停运的夜间禁令，无法在行程中实时识别受损骑行者。
Method: 检测器消费车载惯性与油门测量，随行程累积受损证据并触发报警，具备可证明的误报率上界；与基线和消融版本对比，并给出满足实时性、数据不出车的嵌入式实现。
Result: 在 141 次骑行、25 名受试者（清醒与两个目标 BAC 水平）上，0.023 的误报上界成立，而基线与消融或超界、或损失检测性能、或延迟报警；该上界下高浓度骑行检出 91%、低浓度 50%，中位检测时间 25 秒与 27 秒；嵌入式实现满足实时要求。
Conclusion: 带误报预算的行程内检测可在不打扰清醒用户、不整体停运的前提下尽早干预受损骑行者，并让运营方按用户体验预算误报。

papers.title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
papers.abstract_en: Interactive agents can turn experience into reusable skills, yet existing self-evolving skill libraries primarily improve by accumulating new knowledge. Failures may lead to new skills, while previously stored skills are less often revisited as new evidence arrives. However, growth alone does not ensure reliability, as a retrieved skill may be inapplicable under the current task conditions, and an existing skill may encode a mis-specified operational boundary. Reliable skill evolution therefore requires not only adding knowledge, but also testing and revising what is already stored. We introduce Skill-V, a verifiable self-evolving skill library. To make stored knowledge testable, we propose representing skills as versioned, falsifiable contracts that link semantic intent to observable behavioral criteria. We use environment outcomes to drive library evolution. Specifically, task failures motivate skill addition, while disagreements between contract evaluations and task outcomes guide revisions to existing skill boundaries. To validate these revisions, we require them to preserve protected semantic constraints and satisfy non-regression criteria for rubric-outcome metrics on historical replay evidence. Finally, we employ an applicability-aware filter to exclude candidates judged confidently inapplicable to the current task. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, Skill-V achieves success rates of 95.3% and 85.9%, respectively, while maintaining a more compact skill library than growth-oriented baselines. Applicability-aware filtering reduces incorrect skill invocations, and outcome-grounded revisions correct mis-specified skill boundaries without degrading performance on previously observed evidence. These results show that reliable skill evolution requires more than accumulating experience: the library must learn which knowledge to retain, when to revise it, and when it should be applied.

papers.title: RouterInterp: Understanding Superposed Specialisation in Mixture of Experts Routing
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens. A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that each expert specialises in a single, coherent domain. However, interpretability efforts that assume this hypothesis have generally been unsuccessful. We propose and present evidence for an alternative account that we call the Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis (SSH): experts specialise in a disjoint union of fine-grained features rather than one broad domain. Leveraging the SSH, we introduce RouterInterp, a method for interpreting expert routing that identifies Sparse Autoencoder features most predictive of routing decisions and produces unified natural language explanations. On gpt-oss-20b, RouterInterp explains expert routing with ${\sim}65\%$ higher detection accuracy than prior token statistics based methods. This work provides a scalable method for generating more accurate explanations of expert routing and increases our understanding of a previously uninterpretable component of foundation models.
papers.comment: 33 pages (12 non-appendix pages), 7 figures, published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RouterInterp 提出叠加特化假说 (Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis, SSH)：MoE 专家并非各自对应单一宽领域，而是特化于一组互不相交的细粒度特征的并集。据此用 Sparse Autoencoder 特征找出最能预测路由决策的因子并生成统一自然语言解释，在 gpt-oss-20b 上比既有基于 token 统计的方法检测准确率高约 65%。
Motivation: MoE 性能的主流假说是每个专家负责一个连贯领域，但建立在该假说上的可解释性工作普遍不成功，专家路由这一组件此前基本不可解释。
Method: 先提出 SSH 作为替代解释框架，再引入 RouterInterp：利用 Sparse Autoencoder 特征定位对路由决策预测力最强的因子，并把它们合成统一的自然语言解释，用于解读专家路由。
Result: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，RouterInterp 解释专家路由的检测准确率比既有基于 token 统计的方法高约 65%。
Conclusion: 专家特化应按细粒度特征的叠加来理解而非单一领域，SSH 框架下的 RouterInterp 提供了可扩展且更准确的路由解释方法。

papers.title: Safe Actions Alone Do Not Ensure Safe Agents: Identifying Unfulfilled Obligations with Guard Models
papers.abstract_en: Guard models are increasingly used to safeguard LLM-based agents, primarily by identifying actions that agents are forbidden to perform. However, identifying forbidden actions alone is insufficient to ensure agent safety. In this paper, we argue that agent safety also depends on identifying required yet unperformed safety-critical actions, which we call obligations. Our preliminary study on a popular benchmark for evaluating safety shows that 56.92% of GLM-5.3 trajectories contain unfulfilled obligations, compared with only 30.00% containing forbidden actions. This finding reveals unfulfilled obligations as a major and previously overlooked source of safety risk. However, to our knowledge, no existing benchmark evaluates whether guard models can identify these obligations. To close this gap, we introduce ObligationBench, the first benchmark for evaluating the capability of obligation identification, comprising 240 expert-validated trajectories covering issue resolution, feature development, and terminal operations. Our evaluation of 14 representative models reveals substantial limitations: the highest recall and exact-match rate are only 48.97% and 10.00%, respectively. To address these limitations, we develop ObligationGuard using 40,000 synthetic training examples. ObligationGuard achieves 57.52% recall and an exact-match rate of 21.67%, surpassing all evaluated models on both metrics. We call on the community to incorporate obligation identification into the design and evaluation of future guard models to improve agent safety.
papers.comment: 21 pages. Code, data, and supplementary materials: https://github.com/THU-Agent/ObligationGuard
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 的 guard model 只查禁行行为不够，还必须识别“该做而未做”的义务 (obligations)。初步研究显示 GLM-5.3 轨迹中 56.92% 含未履行义务，远高于含禁行行为的 30.00%；新基准 ObligationBench 上 14 个模型最高 recall 仅 48.97%、exact-match 仅 10.00%，用 40,000 条合成样本训练的 ObligationGuard 把两项提到 57.52% 与 21.67%，仍全面领先被评模型。
Motivation: 现有 guard model 只标注 agent 被禁止的动作，遗漏了“必须执行却未执行”的安全关键动作；而初步统计表明未履行义务是比禁行行为更大的风险来源，且此前没有任何基准衡量模型识别义务的能力。
Method: 提出义务识别任务并构建 ObligationBench：240 条专家校验轨迹，覆盖 issue resolution、feature development、terminal operations 三类场景；用 40,000 条合成训练样本训练 ObligationGuard，并在 14 个代表性模型上评测 recall 与 exact-match。
Result: GLM-5.3 轨迹中 56.92% 含未履行义务，仅 30.00% 含禁行行为。ObligationBench 含 240 条专家校验轨迹；14 个被评模型最高 recall 48.97%、最高 exact-match 10.00%。ObligationGuard（40,000 合成样本）达 recall 57.52%、exact-match 21.67%，两项均超过全部被评模型。
Conclusion: 仅靠识别禁行行为不足以保证 agent 安全，义务识别应纳入未来 guard model 的设计与评测；即便专用模型，exact-match 也仅 21.67%，识别能力仍有限。

papers.title: Optimal random quantisers for spherically symmetric distributions
papers.abstract_en: Zador's celebrated theorem is a cornerstone of optimal quantisation: it establishes both the weak limit of the empirical distribution of an optimal $n$-point quantiser in $R^d$ and the decay rate of the associated $L_s$-mean quantisation error. In large dimension, however, observing this asymptotic behaviour requires an astronomically large sample size. We prove that, for spherically symmetric target distributions, optimisation over all spherically symmetric distributions is a convex problem and derive an equivalence theorem that both characterises global optimality and yields a constructive algorithm. We show that, for moderate $n$, random quantisers uniformly distributed on a sphere of suitably chosen radius $R$ perform exceptionally well and, over a broad range of values of $n$, are numerically certified to be optimal among all random quantisers. Their expected distortion has an explicit integral representation that can be evaluated to arbitrary precision, and we prove concentration across random quantisers: the distortion variance tends to zero as $n\to\infty$ for fixed $d$. For $s=2$, both the optimal radius and the associated minimum expected distortion admit exact expressions. For general $s$, the optimal radius can be determined efficiently, and extreme-value theory provides useful approximations when $n$ grows with $d$. Depending on this growth rate, $R$ either converges to zero or approaches a positive limit that is independent of $s$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明：对球对称目标分布，在所有球对称分布上做随机量化器优化是凸问题，并给出既刻画全局最优又可构造求解的等价定理。中等 n 下均匀分布在半径 R 的球面上的随机量化器在很宽的 n 范围内被数值认证为所有随机量化器中最优，其失真方差在固定 d、n→∞ 时趋于零；s=2 时最优半径与最小期望失真有精确表达式。
Motivation: Zador 定理给出最优量化的渐近分布与 L_s 平均误差衰减率，但在高维下要观察到该渐近行为所需样本量天文级，中等样本量下的最优量化行为缺乏刻画。
Method: 把球对称目标分布上的随机量化器优化化为凸问题，推导同时刻画全局最优性并给出构造性算法的等价定理；用极值理论处理 n 随 d 增长的情形，并给出期望失真的显式积分表示以便任意精度求值。
Result: 中等 n 时半径 R 球面上均匀分布的随机量化器在很宽的 n 范围内被数值认证为所有随机量化器中最优；固定 d、n→∞ 时失真方差趋于零；s=2 时最优半径与最小期望失真有精确表达式；一般 s 时最优半径可高效求解，n 随 d 增长时 R 要么收敛到 0，要么趋于与 s 无关的正常数。
Conclusion: 高维下不必依赖 Zador 渐近：球对称随机量化器在中等 n 即可达最优，且最优半径随 n 与 d 的增长速率呈现两种定性体制。

papers.title: From Video Clips to Creation Trajectory: Sora100K for AI-Native Video Creation
papers.abstract_en: AI-Native video creation is shifting from isolated video clips toward iterative video creation workflows. However, existing datasets remain largely video clips, representing video generation and editing as separate tasks rather than connected stages of a video creation workflow. In this paper, we introduce Sora100K, a dataset that represents the AI-Native video creation workflow as a structured video creation trajectory. Specifically, we first identify video creation trajectories and decompose them into three subsets according to their structural roles: text-to-video generation records as roots, single-turn video editing records as editing edges, and multi-turn video editing records as complete trajectories. Then, we use a VLM to assign semantic annotations for generation roots and editing-operation annotations for editing edges. A strict construction pipeline further reconstructs source-to-edit lineage, editing order, and intermediate video states while ensuring data quality. Finally, we perform lightweight adaptation on LTX-2 models to assess the supervision value of Sora100K. The results show improvements in visual quality, multi-shot generation, and cross-shot consistency, while successive-turn evaluation reveals that following multi-turn editing instructions remains challenging. Sora100K establishes a new data foundation for AI-Native video creation beyond isolated video clips and toward structured video creation trajectory. The dataset and supplementary materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ysicong/Sora100K.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sora100K 把 AI 原生视频创作从孤立片段重构为结构化创作轨迹：以文生视频记录为根、单轮编辑为编辑边、多轮编辑为完整轨迹，并用 VLM 标注语义与编辑操作、严格管线重建源到编辑的血缘与中间状态。在 LTX-2 上做轻量适配后，视觉质量、多镜头生成与跨镜头一致性均有提升，但连续多轮编辑指令的跟随仍然困难。
Motivation: 现有数据集仍是孤立视频片段，把视频生成与编辑当作彼此分离的任务，无法表示一条连贯的多轮视频创作工作流。
Method: 先识别视频创作轨迹并按结构角色拆成三个子集（文生视频根、单轮编辑边、多轮编辑完整轨迹），再用 VLM 为根分配语义标注、为编辑边分配编辑操作标注；严格构建管线重建 source-to-edit 血缘、编辑顺序与中间视频状态并保证数据质量，最后在 LTX-2 模型上做轻量适配以检验监督价值。
Result: LTX-2 轻量适配后在视觉质量、多镜头生成与跨镜头一致性上均有提升；successive-turn 评测显示跟随多轮编辑指令仍具挑战。数据集与补充材料在 HuggingFace 公开（ysicong/Sora100K）。
Conclusion: 结构化视频创作轨迹可作为 AI 原生视频创作的数据基础，取代孤立片段；多轮编辑指令跟随是当前仍待解决的短板。

papers.title: Narrow and Deep: An Ontology Tower as the Knowledge of an LLM Agent for an Industrial Equipment System
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to operate industrial energy equipment, and what they get right depends on what they are told about the plant. Established building ontologies name many kinds of points across many sites, whereas an industrial equipment system needs few entities with much knowledge about each. This study proposes the ontology tower, a narrow-and-deep ontology of a single equipment system whose knowledge deepens in two ways: through quantities derived from the measured points by physical relations, and through lessons from the operating journal incorporated as knowledge nodes. On a real low-humidity air-handling test plant operated daily through a programmable logic controller, agents received a text projected from its tower in a preregistered evaluation of nine tasks replayed from the plant's records, using four open-weight models from 9 to about 750 billion parameters. This knowledge raised the rate at which the agents avoided the most plausible misjudgment of each task by about 20 percentage points, and the overall task score of the 9-billion-parameter model as much as that of the largest. Operating lessons were used when incorporated into the tower or placed in the prompt as records, but seldom when left in the journal behind a search tool. In live runs through an invariant safety layer, the agents brought the controlled variable into its target band in 12 of 14 runs. An ontology narrow in entities but deep in what is known about them can thus supply the knowledge that an agent for an industrial equipment system needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ontology tower：针对单一工业设备系统构建实体少而知识深的窄深本体，知识由测点经物理关系导出的量与运行日志提炼的操作经验两层加深。在真实低湿空气处理试验台的 9 项任务预注册评测中，该知识使 agent 规避最可能误判的比例提高约 20 个百分点，9B 模型总分追平最大模型；实时运行 14 次中 12 次把被控变量带入目标区间。
Motivation: LLM agent 操作工业能源设备时的正确性取决于对厂房的先验知识，而既有建筑本体覆盖多站点多类型测点、对单一设备系统而言广而不深，agent 缺少可直接使用的领域知识。
Method: 为单一低湿空气处理试验台构建 ontology tower：以物理关系从测点导出派生量，并把运行日志 (operating journal) 中的经验固化为知识节点；预注册评测从厂房记录回放 9 项任务，向 agent 提供由该塔投影出的文本，比较四种开放权重模型（9B 至约 750B 参数），并设置不变安全层 (invariant safety layer) 支撑实时运行。
Result: 该知识使 agent 规避每项任务最可能误判的比例提高约 20 个百分点；9B 模型的总体任务分数最高可与最大模型相当。操作经验在并入塔或作为记录放进 prompt 时被使用，放在日志里靠搜索工具时很少被用到。实时运行中 14 次有 12 次把被控变量带入目标区间。
Conclusion: 实体窄而知识深的本体足以充当工业设备系统 LLM agent 的知识来源；操作经验直接并入知识结构比留在日志中靠检索更可能被真正用上。

papers.title: Same Outcome, Different Evidence: Intent Recovery in LLM Safety Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Safety evaluations of large language models commonly summarize harmful-output behavior with attack success rate (ASR). Yet the same non-harmful outcome can arise for very different reasons. A model may recover a harmful task and refuse it, fail to recover the task, or respond to something else entirely. Distinguishing these cases becomes especially important under intent-obscuring prompts, where a low ASR does not reveal whether the evaluated task was actually engaged. To make this distinction explicit, we pair ASR with operative understanding rate (UR), which measures whether a response both identifies the evaluated task and treats it as the task to be answered. Across interfaces, this paired view reveals substantial variation hidden by ASR: similar ASR values can correspond to sharply different recovery rates. Controlled English reconstructions show that recovery consistently improves as compressed prompts become more explicit, whereas ASR does not follow the same pattern. A complementary contrast comes from FormalLogic, where high recovery can still coincide with frequent harmful assistance. Together, these results show that non-harmful outcomes are not equally informative about model safety, motivating the joint reporting of intent recovery and ASR in LLM safety evaluation. Code and experiment inputs are available at https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. Code and experiment inputs: https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 安全评估中单一的攻击成功率 (ASR) 会把「非有害输出」混为一谈：模型可能恢复了有害任务再拒绝、根本没恢复任务、或答非所问。作者提出与 ASR 配对的操作性理解率 (UR)，衡量响应是否识别出被评估任务并把它当作要回答的任务；配对视角显示相近 ASR 背后恢复率差异巨大，且压缩提示越显式恢复率越高而 ASR 不随之变化，FormalLogic 上高恢复仍伴随频繁有害辅助。结论是应联合报告 intent recovery 与 ASR。
Motivation: intent-obscuring 提示下低 ASR 无法说明被评估任务是否真的被模型接住，单一 ASR 把恢复后拒绝、未恢复、答非所问这几种成因完全不同的非有害结果混在一起，掩盖了安全信号的真实差异。
Method: 在 ASR 之外定义操作性理解率 (operative understanding rate, UR)，判定响应是否既识别被评估任务又将其作为回答对象；跨多种接口做配对统计，并用受控英文重构 (controlled English reconstructions) 调节压缩提示的显式程度，另以 FormalLogic 作为对照案例。
Result: 配对视角揭示被 ASR 掩盖的大幅差异：相近 ASR 对应的恢复率 (recovery rate) 明显不同；受控英文重构中压缩提示越显式恢复率持续提高，而 ASR 不呈同样趋势；FormalLogic 上高恢复率仍与频繁有害辅助 (harmful assistance) 并存。
Conclusion: 非有害输出对模型安全的 informative 程度并不相等，LLM 安全评估应把 intent recovery 与 ASR 联合报告，而不是只看 ASR。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RAGenome: Scaling Retrieval-Based Genomic Language Models to Long Contexts
papers.abstract_en: The genome holds the blueprint that governs the biological properties of the cell. Consequently, advancing our knowledge of genomic function is crucial both for a broader understanding of biology and for continued biomedical advances. The success of large language models on natural language and protein sequences has motivated similar efforts on genomic data. However, standard genomic language models (gLMs) often require extremely large computational resources and still fall behind traditional methods on some downstream tasks. Recently, MSA-based pretraining has been proposed as an efficient alternative, but existing models are limited to short input contexts, restricting their use to short-range tasks, such as variant effect prediction. In this work, we present RAGenome, the first retrieval-based gLM that scales pretraining to longer contexts (100$\times$ longer than existing MSA-based gLMs), allowing it to capture both across-species evolutionary relationships and within-species longer-range interactions. Trained on whole-genome alignments from 100 vertebrates, RAGenome substantially improves the long-range capabilities of MSA-based gLMs, raising gene finding performance from 0.45 to 0.60, while remaining competitive on purely evolutionary-based tasks like prioritizing pathogenic variants. RAGenome provides competitive gLM performance at a fraction of the training cost, unifying evolutionary modeling and long-range capabilities within a single, flexible, scalable framework. Code is available at https://github.com/PanosAntoniadis/RAGenome.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures and 4 tables, Accepted at ML4Molecules workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAGenome 是首个基于检索的基因组语言模型 (retrieval-based gLM)，把 MSA 类预训练的上下文长度扩展到现有模型的 100 倍，用 100 种脊椎动物的全基因组比对同时建模跨物种进化关系与种内长程互作。基因发现 (gene finding) 性能从 0.45 提升到 0.60，同时在致病变异优先级等纯进化任务上保持竞争力，训练成本只是常规 gLM 的一小部分。
Motivation: 标准基因组语言模型算力开销极大且部分下游任务仍落后于传统方法；新近的 MSA 类预训练更高效，但输入上下文很短，只能做变异效应预测这类短程任务。
Method: 以检索机制替代固定窗口，把 MSA 类预训练扩展到长上下文（比现有 MSA-based gLM 长 100 倍）；在 100 种脊椎动物的全基因组比对 (whole-genome alignments) 上预训练，使模型同时捕获跨物种进化关系与种内长程互作。
Result: 基因发现性能从 0.45 提升到 0.60；在致病变异优先级等纯进化任务上保持竞争力；训练成本仅为常规 gLM 的一小部分；上下文长度为现有 MSA-based gLM 的 100 倍，训练数据覆盖 100 种脊椎动物。
Conclusion: 检索式预训练可以在单一框架内统一进化建模与长程能力，以低成本让 MSA-based gLM 覆盖此前做不了的长程任务。

papers.title: Beyond QAOA: A Review of AI and Quantum Computing for Adaptive Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Near-term quantum approaches to combinatorial optimization are limited by qubit counts, circuit fidelity, sampling cost, and the difficulty of encoding constraints, while machine learning is increasingly used to configure and control quantum optimization workflows. We call such workflows adaptive: decisions conventionally fixed in advance, from formulation and penalties to shot budgets, backends, and whether to invoke a quantum processor at all, are made by learned policies that respond to the instance, the progress of the solve, or the hardware. This review examines three paradigms, AI for quantum optimization, quantum for AI-driven optimization, and AI-quantum co-optimization, and organizes the literature by the decision being learned rather than by application. A structured review of 119 papers, 67 coded in detail, shows that the evidence is considerably stronger for AI-assisted quantum optimization than for the reverse direction: learning already reduces quantum evaluations, improves initialization, supports decomposition and penalty control, and mitigates noise, whereas evidence that quantum computation improves learned optimizers remains largely confined to small-scale simulation. Experimental controls are thin: 25 of 57 studies include no classical baseline, the quantum contribution is fully isolated in 10 of 24 studies where an ablation applies, and the median experiment uses 17 qubits. We introduce an M0-M5 evidence hierarchy, from simulation to matched-resource practical advantage, and find no broadly convincing result at the highest level. We argue that scaling is increasingly a systems problem: the question is not only whether a problem fits on a quantum processor, but how classical and quantum resources should be allocated across the optimization process. The review is aimed at researchers in quantum computing, machine learning, and operations research.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Review article. Supplementary evidence matrix (coded data for all 119 papers) included as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 AI 与量子计算用于自适应组合优化的综述，按“被学习的决策”而非应用领域组织三大范式（AI for quantum optimization、quantum for AI-driven optimization、AI-quantum co-optimization）。对 119 篇论文（67 篇详细编码）的结构化审查发现证据严重不对称：AI 辅助量子优化的证据明显强于反方向，后者多局限于小规模模拟；作者提出 M0–M5 证据层级，最高层（匹配资源的实用优势）尚无令人信服的结果。
Motivation: 近期量子组合优化受量子比特数、电路保真度、采样成本与约束编码难度制约，而现有文献缺乏按“学习什么决策”组织的证据评估，无法判断 AI 与量子谁真正贡献了性能。
Method: 综述性工作：结构化审查 119 篇论文、其中 67 篇详细编码，按被学习的决策（公式化与惩罚、shot 预算、后端选择、是否调用 QPU 等）组织三大范式；引入 M0–M5 证据层级（从模拟到匹配资源的实用优势）；附带含全部 119 篇编码数据的证据矩阵作为 ancillary 文件。
Result: AI 辅助量子优化方向的证据明显更强：学习已能减少量子评估次数、改进初始化、支持分解与惩罚控制、抑制噪声；而量子计算提升学习型优化器的证据主要限于小规模模拟。实验对照薄弱：57 项研究中 25 项无经典基线；24 项适用消融的研究中仅 10 项完全隔离量子贡献；实验中位数为 17 个量子比特。M0–M5 层级最高层无广泛令人信服的结果。
Conclusion: 作者主张扩展规模日益成为系统问题：关键不只是问题能否放进量子处理器，而是经典与量子资源如何在优化流程中分配；当前 AI-for-quantum 方向的证据基础远强于 quantum-for-AI。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memory Forcing: Attendable Mid-Horizon History for Streaming Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion enables causal video streaming without a bidirectional pass over the full clip, but existing few-step systems usually retain only the opening and most recent frames in a fixed-size KV cache. Once an event leaves this window, later frames can no longer attend to it, a failure we term mid-horizon forgetting. We present Memory Forcing, a few-step streaming method that preserves this missing history without increasing the cache size. Its Archive \& Working Banks partition the cache into sink, archive, and working regions, retaining diverse intermediate events alongside recent motion under fixed memory. Because absolute temporal indices drift outside the training range, Bank-aware RoPE reassigns indices at attention time so each bank remains distinguishable. At 1.3B, Memory Forcing leads on longer clips, shows the smallest drop from 5s to 60s among methods reporting all four lengths, and preserves subjects and scenes through leave-and-return. The same design scales to Wan2.2 5B, producing more physically plausible, realistic, and dynamic videos and, to our knowledge, the first public 5B model on this forcing line.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Memory Forcing 是面向流式视频生成的少步 (few-step) 方法，把固定大小 KV cache 划成 sink、archive、working 三个 bank，在不增大缓存的前提下保住中途离开窗口的事件，并用 Bank-aware RoPE 在注意力时重新分配时间索引使各 bank 可区分。1.3B 模型在长片段上领先，在同时报告 5s/10s/30s/60s 四个长度的方法中 5s→60s 降幅最小，并在 leave-and-return 场景保持主体与场景一致；同一设计扩展到 Wan2.2 5B。
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散可做因果流式生成，但现有少步系统只在固定 KV cache 里保留开头帧和最近帧，事件一旦离开该窗口后续帧就无法再注意它，即 mid-horizon forgetting。
Method: Archive & Working Banks 把 cache 切成 sink、archive、working 三区，在固定内存下同时保留多样的中途事件与近期运动；针对绝对时间索引超出训练范围的问题，Bank-aware RoPE 在注意力计算时重新分配索引，使各 bank 仍可区分。设计可从 1.3B 扩展到 Wan2.2 5B。
Result: 1.3B 模型在更长片段上领先，在同时报告 5s、10s、30s、60s 四个长度的方法中 5s→60s 的性能降幅最小，并在 leave-and-return（离开再返回）场景中保持主体与场景；扩展到 Wan2.2 5B 后生成视频更物理合理、更真实、更动态，作者称是该 forcing 线上首个公开的 5B 模型。
Conclusion: 在固定缓存预算下按 sink/archive/working 分区并重分配时间索引，可以在不增加内存的情况下缓解流式视频生成的 mid-horizon forgetting，且该设计可放大到 5B 规模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SR-TTA: Spatial-Redundancy Test-Time Adaptation for Interference-Robust Respiration Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Future 6G networks aim to expose sensing as a native service by reusing communication infrastructure. We study respiration sensing on a cell-free massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) base station, where a 64-antenna channel must be fused into a breathing waveform. The state-of-the-art hand-crafted fusion is near-optimal in benign conditions. It collapses, however, under strong in-band motion interference, whose frequency falls inside the respiration band. We show that a learned complex-weight beamformer recovers respiration by spatial nulling, and that the remaining gap to a per-recording oracle can be closed at deployment by label-free test-time adaptation. Crucially, we identify which label-free signal makes this work. Frequency- and variance-based criteria cannot separate an in-band interferer from breathing. Our spatial-redundancy test-time adaptation (SR-TTA), which maximizes consistency across random antenna subsets under an out-of-band spectral veto, preserves benign performance in our tests. The respiration-rate error drops from 5.8 to 0.8 breaths per minute (bpm) under simulated in-band interference, and the pipeline maps onto the Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) architecture as O-RAN distributed-unit (O-DU) range-gating, an adaptation xApp, and a calibration rApp. On real testbed recordings, a one-time cross-subject calibration plus SR-TTA reduces failures from 47% to 7%, drawing level with the hand-crafted combiner using label-free test-time adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 cell-free massive MIMO 基站上做呼吸感知时，手工融合在带内运动干扰下失效；学习型复权重波束成形器靠空间零陷恢复呼吸波形，再用无标签测试时适应 SR-TTA（随机天线子集一致性 + 带外频谱否决）逼近逐录音 oracle。仿真带内干扰下呼吸频率误差从 5.8 降到 0.8 bpm，真实测试床录音经一次性跨被试校准加 SR-TTA 后失败率从 47% 降到 7%，与手工融合器持平。
Motivation: 6G 想把感知做成复用通信基础设施的原生服务，但呼吸频带内的强运动干扰会让接近最优的手工天线融合直接崩溃，且部署时没有标签可用于修正。
Method: 把 64 天线信道用学习型复权重波束成形器融合成呼吸波形，靠空间零陷压制带内干扰；部署时用 SR-TTA 做无标签适应，目标是最大化随机天线子集间的一致性，并加带外频谱否决约束；对照频域与方差类判据。管线映射为 O-RAN 的 O-DU range-gating、适应 xApp 与校准 rApp。
Result: 仿真带内干扰下呼吸频率误差 5.8 → 0.8 bpm；真实测试床录音上一次性跨被试校准加 SR-TTA 使失败率 47% → 7%，达到手工融合器水平；SR-TTA 在测试中保持良性条件性能，而频域与方差判据无法区分带内干扰者与呼吸。
Conclusion: 能区分带内干扰与呼吸的无标签信号是空间冗余一致性而非频域或方差特征，因此 SR-TTA 可在部署时无标签地把学习型波束成形器拉回 oracle 水平并映射到 O-RAN 架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Output-Only Review Cannot Verify: Study Contracts for Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Some defects in an AI-generated study can be identified from its artifacts; others require knowledge of what was approved before execution. We propose study contracts that bind declared experimental choices, run obligations and claim scope to recorded execution evidence, and distinguish this contract-relative verification from scientific truth. A diagnostic using eight self-authored clean/mutated pairs illustrates the information boundary. A deterministic checker applying a registered, fault-specific rule to approved and executed objects detected all eight registered mutations. Across eighteen recorded judge aliases given individual metadata-filtered packages without pair context or the registry-selected fault label, 104 of 144 mutated evaluation cases received defect flags; the remaining cases comprised 32 abstentions and eight terminal failures, with no explicit clean decisions on mutated cases. Some packages retained approval and execution fields, including digests. The prompt instructed judges to abstain when evidence was insufficient. These results characterize a deliberately information-asymmetric development setting; they do not isolate the effect of authoritative information from differences in task specification and rule selection, and they are not comparative verifier quality or agent reward hacking. We identify full-information comparisons, legitimate-adaptation controls and closed-loop agent evaluations as necessary tests of whether contract checks improve useful compliant completion under optimization.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 tables. Preprint. Not peer reviewed. Companion manuscripts prepared in parallel
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 study contracts，把 AI 生成研究中已声明的实验选择、运行义务与论断范围绑定到记录的执行证据，并明确区分这种 contract-relative verification 与科学真值。确定性 checker 用注册的 fault-specific 规则检出全部 8 个注入变异；而 18 个 judge alias 在只拿到元数据过滤包、无配对上下文与注册 fault 标签时，144 个变异案例中 104 个被标记缺陷，另有 32 次弃权与 8 次终端失败。
Motivation: AI 生成研究的缺陷有些能从产物本身看出，有些必须知道执行前获批的方案才能判定；仅审输出无法覆盖后者，需要一种与科学真值区分开的、基于获批记录的验证口径。
Method: 定义 study contracts：将声明的实验选择、run obligations 与 claim scope 绑定到记录的执行证据；用 8 组自撰 clean/mutated 对做诊断，并实现一个对获批对象与执行对象套用注册 fault-specific 规则的确定性 checker；另设 18 个 judge alias，各自收到按元数据过滤的独立包（无配对上下文、无注册 fault 标签），提示词要求证据不足时弃权。
Result: 确定性 checker 检出全部 8 个注册变异；18 个 judge alias 在 144 个变异评估案例中给出 104 个缺陷标记，其余为 32 次弃权与 8 次终端失败，变异案例上没有出现显式 clean 判定；部分包仍保留 approval 与 execution 字段（含 digest）。
Conclusion: 输出侧评审存在信息边界，绑定获批记录的 contract 检查能覆盖仅看产物无法判定的缺陷；作者指出该结果只刻画信息刻意不对称的开发环境，尚需全信息对比、合法改编对照与闭环 agent 评测来检验 contract 检查能否在优化压力下提升有用且合规的完成度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Dino Forcing Flow Models: Do not denoise what you can predict
papers.abstract_en: Co-denoising pretrained representations such as DINO can substantially improve the training speed and quality of flow matching models, but it introduces a second denoising trajectory and requires carefully designed schedules. We propose a simpler alternative: predict the pretrained representation directly, then condition the model on its own prediction. This removes the need for a second ODE and any representation-specific denoising schedules, while retaining the benefits of representation guidance. Our approach converges substantially faster and achieves better generation quality as measured by FID score. On ImageNet, it outperforms the state of the art in latent space at 2x fewer epochs than prior methods; in pixel space, it improves FID over comparable prior methods by more than 20%. These results support a simple principle: do not denoise what you can predict. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dino Forcing：flow matching 训练中不额外去噪 DINO 表示，而是直接预测该预训练表示并用自身预测作条件，从而去掉第二条 ODE 与表示专用去噪调度。ImageNet 上潜空间以 2 倍更少 epoch 超过先前方法的 SOTA，像素空间 FID 较可比先前方法改善 20% 以上。
Motivation: 用 DINO 等预训练表示做 co-denoising 能加速并提升 flow matching，但会引入第二条去噪轨迹和需要精细设计的调度，训练复杂度高。
Method: Dino Forcing Flow Models：不联合去噪预训练 DINO 表示，而是让模型直接预测该表示，再以自身预测作为条件，移除第二条 ODE 与表示专用去噪调度，保留表示引导收益；代码开源在 github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing。
Result: ImageNet 上潜空间以 2 倍更少的 epoch 超过先前方法的 state of the art；像素空间 FID 较可比先前方法改善 20% 以上；收敛显著更快，生成质量以 FID 衡量更优。
Conclusion: 核心原则是能预测的表示就不要去噪：直接预测并自条件化即可在去掉第二条 ODE 的同时获得更快收敛与更好 FID。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 树式投机解码在固定草稿树上存在草稿-目标模型不匹配，本文证明所有最优精确路径验证器共享同一 exit 与 bonus-token 律，据此提出 TEV（一次 exit 节点决策加一次 bonus-token 决策的层级并行验证）与 ExitTrain（用缺失目标概率做节点级反馈训练草稿树）。在对话、代码与数学推理上，ExitTrain 使平均输出块长度提升 13%，TEV 使验证阶段延迟降低 15%，端到端相对 DDTree 加速 14%。
Motivation: 有限草稿树由草稿分数构建，与目标模型存在根本性不匹配；更好的精确验证能否在固定树上提高接受率、目标反馈又如何改进树本身，此前缺少理论刻画。
Method: 通过 target-flow 视图给出 canonical exit law，证明 1 加 target coverage 严格界定任何精确路径验证器的期望输出块长度（含 bonus token）；据此设计 Tree Exit Verification (TEV) 的层级并行精确验证，以及 ExitTrain，用 exit law 识别出的 missing target probability 对推理期草稿树做节点级反馈训练。
Result: 理论结果：所有最优验证器共享同一 exit 与 bonus-token 律，predraw-and-follow 与 sequential residual 等代表性验证器已达到该律。实验覆盖对话、代码、数学推理：ExitTrain 平均输出块长度 +13%，TEV 验证阶段延迟 -15%，端到端相对 DDTree 加速 14%。
Conclusion: 固定树上的接受率与验证延迟是两个可分离的优化机会：更好的草稿树提高接受，更直接的验证降低延迟，二者可同时兑现。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 理论结果：所有最优验证器共享同一 exit 与 bonus-token 律，predraw-and-follow 与 sequential residual 等代表性验证器已达到该律。实验覆盖对话、代码、数学推理：ExitTrain 平均输出块长度 +13%，TEV 验证阶段延迟 -15%，端到端相对 DDTree 加速 14%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 固定树上的接受率与验证延迟是两个可分离的优化机会：更好的草稿树提高接受，更直接的验证降低延迟，二者可同时兑现。

papers.title: DEX: Digit-Level Early Exit for Energy-Efficient MSDF Neural Network Inference
papers.abstract_en: U-Net inference for brain-tumor segmentation requires billions of multiply-accumulate operations, motivating hardware that can reduce computation dynamically rather than relying only on fixed precision or static model compression. Most-significant-digit-first (MSDF) arithmetic exposes the leading digits of a result during computation, enabling output-dependent decisions before the full value is generated. This paper presents an MSDF accelerator for quantized U-Net segmentation with a two-stage grouped processing element supporting signed INT8 operands and in-stream bias accumulation. Four runtime mechanisms operate directly on the output digit stream: exact early negative detection (END) in ReLU layers, exact sign-only decision making in the segmentation head, calibrated low-order-digit skipping, and calibrated pruning. The two approximate mechanisms are selected offline under an accuracy constraint, while execution requires only lightweight control and does not modify the stored weights. On a residual U-Net trained with nnU-Net for BraTS, the proposed mechanisms reduce digit cycles by 38.38\% while achieving a mean Dice score of 80.58\% on 73 held-out cases, compared with 81.20\% for the floating-point model; the exact mechanisms alone reduce cycles by 18.79\% without altering the quantized output. Synthesized in 45~nm, the processing element operates at 500~MHz, occupies 0.858~mm$^2$, and consumes 0.726~mJ per $192\times192$ patch under switching-activity-annotated power analysis. A projected eight-output accelerator with shared activation delivery achieves 16.6~ms latency and 1.67~mJ per patch.

TL;DR: 提出面向量化 U-Net 分割的 MSDF 加速器，用两级分组 PE 支持 INT8 有符号操作数与流内偏置累加，并在输出位流上做四种运行时机制：ReLU 层的精确负值早停 (END)、分割头的精确符号判定、低位跳过与剪枝。在 nnU-Net 训练的 residual U-Net、BraTS 73 例留出集上，数字周期减少 38.38%，mean Dice 80.58%（浮点模型 81.20%）；仅用精确机制时周期减少 18.79% 且量化输出不变。
Motivation: 脑肿瘤分割的 U-Net 推理需要数十亿次乘加，固定精度量化和静态压缩无法按输出内容动态削减计算，硬件层面缺少在数值算完之前就提前终止的手段。
Method: 利用 MSDF 算术在计算过程中先暴露结果高位的特性，构建支持 signed INT8 与 in-stream bias accumulation 的两级分组 PE；四个运行时机制直接作用于输出位流——ReLU 的 exact END、分割头的 exact sign-only 判定、calibrated 低位跳过与 calibrated 剪枝，两个近似机制在离线阶段按精度约束选取，运行时只需轻量控制且不改动存储权重。
Result: 在 BraTS 上用 nnU-Net 训练的 residual U-Net、73 例留出集：四种机制合计减少 digit cycles 38.38%，mean Dice 80.58%（浮点模型 81.20%）；仅精确机制减少 18.79% 周期且不改变量化输出。45 nm 综合下 PE 工作于 500 MHz、面积 0.858 mm²、每 192×192 patch 功耗 0.726 mJ；投影的八输出共享激活加速器达 16.6 ms 延迟、每 patch 1.67 mJ。
Conclusion: MSDF 位流上的早停与近似跳位可以在几乎不损失 Dice 的前提下显著压缩量化 U-Net 的计算周期，精确机制保证输出不变、近似机制的精度代价由离线校准控制。

papers.title: Streaming-Aware Diffusion for Real-Time Video Super-Resolution via Cross-Step Attention
papers.abstract_en: Real-time video super-resolution requires high spatio-temporal fidelity under strict latency constraints, challenging diffusion models due to their iterative sampling cost and limited temporal coordination. We propose a streaming-aware framework that adapts pretrained single-image latent diffusion models for efficient video super-resolution (VSR) by exploiting the sequential structure of video streams. Our Cross-Step Attention mechanism reuses intermediate denoising features across adjacent frames and diffusion steps, enabling temporal information exchange without explicit temporal modeling. We further introduce Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling, which aligns adjacent diffusion states and provides cleaner intermediate representations for cross-step conditioning, improving temporal coherence. These components are integrated into a streaming inference pipeline that incrementally propagates latent states across frames, reducing the effective computational complexity from $O(N \cdot S)$ to $O(N + S)$ for $N$ frames and $S$ diffusion steps. Experiments on REDS4 and YouHQ40-Test demonstrate improved perceptual quality and temporal realism while maintaining frame-wise stability. Our method achieves over 40 FPS at $512 \times 512$ resolution after cold start, enabling real-time VSR without explicit temporal modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把预训练单图 latent diffusion 改造成流式视频超分辨率 (VSR)：Cross-Step Attention 在相邻帧与相邻扩散步之间复用去噪特征，Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling 对齐相邻扩散态以提供更干净的跨步条件，推理复杂度从 O(N·S) 降到 O(N+S)。在 REDS4 与 YouHQ40-Test 上感知质量与时间真实感提升，512×512 冷启动后超过 40 FPS，实现无需显式时间建模的实时 VSR。
Motivation: 实时视频超分辨率要求在严格延迟下保持时空保真，而扩散模型的迭代采样开销与有限的时间协调能力使其难以胜任。
Method: 复用预训练单图 latent diffusion：Cross-Step Attention 在相邻帧与相邻扩散步间交换去噪特征，Trajectory-Coupled Diffusion Scheduling 对齐相邻扩散态；流式推理管线逐帧增量传播 latent，把 N 帧 S 步的复杂度从 O(N·S) 降到 O(N+S)。
Result: 在 REDS4 与 YouHQ40-Test 上感知质量与时间真实感改善且逐帧稳定；512×512 分辨率冷启动后超过 40 FPS，全程无需显式时间建模。
Conclusion: 利用视频流的顺序结构在扩散步与帧之间复用中间特征，可以在不引入显式时间建模的前提下把扩散 VSR 推到实时速度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Ball and the Box: Two Geometries of Computation in Superposition
papers.abstract_en: Neural representations can encode more features than they have dimensions, a phenomenon known as superposition. We study the dimension needed to compute Boolean gates from such representations. For a single threshold layer with a Gaussian random dictionary and uniformly random sparse Boolean inputs, we derive sharp dimension thresholds under two error criteria. A vanishing expected error count can require more dimensions than correctness of every output with high probability. Shared reads explain the gap: rare realizations can produce many errors at once. The expected-count threshold has ball geometry, while joint reliability has box geometry when a gate is evaluated on every feature tuple. Optimizing shared readout weights and biases gives explicit thresholds for conjunction, disjunction, and majority. For pairwise conjunction, the analysis also describes the transition near the threshold, in agreement with exact simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究叠加表示 (superposition) 中用单层阈值网络计算布尔门所需的最小维度：在高斯随机字典与均匀随机稀疏布尔输入下，为两种误差准则导出尖锐的维度阈值。期望错误数趋零的阈值高于高概率下所有输出正确的阈值，因为共享读出使罕见输入实现一次性产生大量错误；前者呈球几何 (ball geometry)，后者在门对每个特征元组求值时呈盒几何 (box geometry)。
Motivation: 神经表示能编码远超维度数的特征，但叠加表示中计算布尔门所需的维度下界此前缺少针对具体误差准则的刻画，且两种常用误差准则之间的差距来源不明确。
Method: 对单层阈值层、高斯随机字典与均匀随机稀疏布尔输入，推导期望错误数与高概率逐输出正确两种准则下的维度阈值；通过优化共享读出权重与偏置，给出 conjunction、disjunction、majority 的显式阈值，并分析 pairwise conjunction 在阈值附近的过渡行为。
Result: 期望错误数趋零所需维度可多于高概率逐输出正确所需维度；期望错误数阈值具球几何，联合可靠性阈值在逐元组求值时具盒几何；给出 conjunction、disjunction、majority 的显式阈值，pairwise conjunction 的阈值附近过渡分析与精确模拟结果一致。
Conclusion: 叠加中布尔计算的维度需求取决于误差准则：共享读出使期望错误数准则更严格、几何为球，而逐输出联合可靠性准则几何为盒；对 conjunction 等门可给出可用的显式阈值。
