papers.title: TraceRelay: Attention-Aligned Recurrence over Rolling Traces
papers.abstract_en: We present TraceRelay, an attention-aligned recurrent architecture that distributes persistent representations over a rolling sequence of low-dimensional traces. Local right looking attention forms increments from lower-layer representations; delivery is delayed until all attended inputs are in the causal past. A fixed additive phase recurrence accumulates the delayed increments, and left-looking attention reads the resulting residual augmented stream. A stride-wise prefix sum supports parallel prefill and bounded-buffer continuation. We study 36 small-model runs on Equal Repeats, bounded Dyck closing-type prediction, and causal Most-Freq generation, using three seeds per setting. At trained length 256, Equal Repeats models with recurrent phase inheritance reach 98.81-99.69% accuracy versus 50.73-51.63% for separately trained variants without inheritance, despite the latter receiving more updates. Accuracy drops sharply at lengths beyond the training range. At the longest evaluated lengths, models with more dimensions in the middle layer's recurrent traces perform better on Dyck (76.34% versus 55.49% close accuracy at length 4096), whereas models with fewer trace dimensions perform better on five-symbol Most-Freq (70.74% versus 55.60% exact generation at length 1024). These contrasting cases motivate further study of how the size of recurrent representations should be chosen for different tasks, without establishing a general rule across tasks or model configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraceRelay 提出注意力对齐的循环架构，把持久表示分布到滚动的低维 trace 序列上：右看注意力生成增量并延迟到全部输入进入因果过去后，由固定加法相位递归累积，左看注意力读取残差增广流，stride-wise 前缀和支持并行 prefill。在 Equal Repeats 上带相位继承的模型准确率 98.81–99.69%，而无继承的独立训练变体仅 50.73–51.63%；但超出训练长度后准确率骤降，且 Dyck 与 Most-Freq 对 trace 维度的偏好相反。
Motivation: 循环模型要在长序列上维持持久表示，但增量何时累积、表示容量多大才合适缺少设计依据；作者用三组受控任务检验相位继承与 trace 维度的作用。
Method: 架构由局部右看注意力生成增量（延迟交付）、固定加法相位递归 (additive phase recurrence) 累积、左看注意力读取残差增广流，以及支撑并行 prefill 与有界缓冲续写的 stride-wise 前缀和组成；实验为 36 次小模型运行，覆盖 Equal Repeats、有界 Dyck 闭合类型预测、因果 Most-Freq 生成三个任务，每设置 3 个随机种子。
Result: 训练长度 256 处，Equal Repeats 上带循环相位继承的模型准确率 98.81–99.69%，无继承的独立训练变体 50.73–51.63%（后者训练更新更多）；超出训练范围后准确率急剧下降。最长评测长度上，中间层 trace 维度更多者在 Dyck 上更好（长度 4096 闭合准确率 76.34% 对 55.49%），维度更少者在五符号 Most-Freq 上更好（长度 1024 精确生成 70.74% 对 55.60%）。
Conclusion: 循环表示的容量应按任务选择：Dyck 偏多维 trace、Most-Freq 偏少维 trace，作者明确不主张存在跨任务与跨模型配置的通用规则。

papers.title: Correlational Training of Morphological Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are typically trained using first-order methods and back-propagation. It is unclear whether this approach is optimal for morphological layers whose weight Jacobians are sparse and whose resulting parameter gradients can be poor. In this work, we propose a novel weight update method for morphological neural networks inspired from the Multiplicative Weights Update (MWU) scheme. We view each morphological perceptron as an instance of the learning from experts' advice problem in logarithmic space, and use a correlation-based reward that favors inputs aligned with the desired output change, regardless of whether a strong gradient signal has reached their weight. We empirically evaluate our approach by training fully connected layers both as stand-alone models and as parts of larger transformer networks. Across nine benchmarks, correlational training yields improvements on eight, by up to 32.84 percentage points, while substantially reducing run-to-run variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对形态神经网络 (morphological neural networks) 权重 Jacobian 稀疏、反向传播梯度信号差的问题，提出受乘性权重更新 (MWU) 启发的相关性训练：把每个形态感知机视为对数空间中的 experts' advice 学习实例，用与期望输出变化对齐的相关性奖励更新权重，即使梯度没传到该权重也照常奖励。在九个基准上八个取得提升，最高达 32.84 个百分点，同时显著降低运行间方差。
Motivation: 一阶方法加反向传播是否适合形态层并不清楚：这类层的权重 Jacobian 稀疏，得到的参数梯度质量差，训练信号弱。
Method: 把每个形态感知机建模为对数空间中 learning from experts' advice 问题，采用 MWU 式权重更新；奖励基于相关性，偏向与期望输出变化方向一致的输入，而不依赖梯度是否强地传到该权重。训练对象包括独立的全连接层以及作为更大 transformer 网络组成部分的层。
Result: 在九个基准上，相关性训练在其中八个带来提升，最高改善达 32.84 个百分点，并显著降低 run-to-run variability；评测覆盖独立全连接层与嵌入 transformer 的两种设置。
Conclusion: 对形态层而言，基于相关性的 MWU 式更新可以替代反向传播，绕开稀疏 Jacobian 导致的弱梯度问题，并让训练更稳定。

papers.title: Scalable AI Uncertainty Quantification via Generalized Laplace Active Subspaces
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying neural networks in scientific and high-stakes applications, but full Bayesian inference over the network parameters is computationally infeasible. We propose a low-rank generalized Laplace approximation for neural-network UQ based on a small number of data-informed curvature directions. Starting from a generalized Bayesian posterior defined through an empirical loss, we construct a local Gaussian approximation around a pretrained set of weights in this active curvature subspace. The posterior variances in the retained subspace are available in closed form, and the prior variance is calibrated by an empirical Bayes procedure. The generalized Bayesian formulation allows us to compare two posterior scalings: the standard Bayesian scaling associated with the summed negative log likelihood, and a mean-loss scaling in which the empirical loss is normalized by the number of data. A central finding is that the standard scaling induces a data-size dependent contraction of the posterior variance in the leading active directions. In regression problems, this can force the low-rank framework to retain additional weak-curvature directions in order to achieve nominal coverage of calibration data. When posterior samples are propagated through the non-linear network, these additional directions can degrade the coherence of the predictive intervals and shift the posterior predictive mean away from the pretrained model. In contrast, the generalized mean-loss scaling yields a more stable, lower dimensional active subspace and produces calibrated, coherent predictive confidence intervals. These results indicate that generalized Laplace active subspaces provide a practical and scalable route to calibrated uncertainty quantification in neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出低秩广义 Laplace 活跃子空间 (generalized Laplace active subspace) 做神经网络不确定性量化：在预训练权重附近沿少数数据信息曲率方向构造局部高斯近似，后验方差闭式给出，先验方差用 empirical Bayes 标定。核心发现是标准贝叶斯缩放（按负对数似然求和）会让主活跃方向的后验方差随数据量收缩，迫使回归问题保留更多弱曲率方向，进而破坏预测区间一致性并使后验预测均值偏离预训练模型；改用按数据量归一化的 mean-loss 缩放则得到更稳定、更低维的活跃子空间和校准且一致的置信区间。
Motivation: 神经网络在科学与高风险场景需要可靠 UQ，但对网络参数做完整贝叶斯推断计算上不可行；而直接套用标准贝叶斯缩放会在数据量增大时把后验方差压塌，逼出更多弱曲率方向。
Method: 从基于经验损失的广义贝叶斯后验出发，在预训练权重处沿少量数据信息曲率方向取活跃子空间，构造该子空间内的局部高斯近似；保留子空间上的后验方差有闭式解，先验方差由 empirical Bayes 过程标定。框架内对比两种后验缩放：标准贝叶斯缩放（summed negative log likelihood）与 mean-loss 缩放（经验损失按数据量归一化）。
Result: 标准缩放导致主活跃方向后验方差随数据量收缩；在回归问题中这会迫使低秩框架保留额外弱曲率方向以达到对校准数据的 nominal coverage，而这些方向经非线性网络传播后会降低预测区间一致性并使后验预测均值偏离预训练模型。mean-loss 缩放给出更稳定、更低维的活跃子空间，并产生校准且一致的预测置信区间。
Conclusion: 广义 Laplace 活跃子空间是神经网络可校准 UQ 的一条实用且可扩展的路径，但后验缩放方式必须选 mean-loss 归一化，否则数据量增大会以牺牲区间一致性为代价换取覆盖率。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Uncovering and Fixing Collider Bias in Bayesian PINNs
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian physics-informed neural networks (B-PINNs) are a popular framework for parameter and state inference from sparse or noisy observations. They are commonly formulated via a collider structure, in which physical and trajectory parameters are assumed to be a priori independent and become coupled through virtual likelihoods on differential-equation residuals that enforce physical consistency. We show that this modeling choice can induce severe systematic bias in the posterior over physical parameters: even when the prior is favorably centered on the ground-truth parameters, the resulting posterior can drift away and concentrate far from them. As a remedy, we advocate a hierarchical chain model in which physics generates trajectories, which in turn generate observations. The chain model does not suffer from this posterior bias, but it poses a harder, so-called doubly intractable, inference problem due to a physics-dependent normalization constant. This challenge can be resolved by discretizing the underlying stochastic dynamics, after which the chain posterior can be sampled exactly with particle MCMC. We identify two distinct mechanisms characterizing the collider bias, derive analytical approximations of their magnitudes, and establish diagnostic criteria for predicting when standard B-PINNs remain reliable. Experiments confirm the predicted bias and show that the chain formulation successfully avoids it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: B-PINN 常用的 collider 结构把物理参数与轨迹参数先验独立、再靠微分方程残差的虚拟似然耦合，这会让物理参数后验系统性偏离真值，即使先验已对准真值也如此。改用层级链式模型（物理生成轨迹、轨迹生成观测），离散化随机动力学后可用 particle MCMC 精确采样，实验确认链式表述避开了该偏差。
Motivation: 从稀疏含噪观测做参数推断时，B-PINN 的 collider 建模选择会给物理参数后验引入严重系统性偏差，先验设置正确也挡不住。
Method: 提出层级链式模型（物理→轨迹→观测），通过离散化随机动力学消去依赖物理的归一化常数，从而可用 particle MCMC 精确采样链式后验；同时识别 collider 偏差的两种机制、推导其量级的解析近似，并给出判定标准 B-PINN 何时仍可靠的诊断准则。
Result: 实验确认了预测的偏差，并显示链式表述成功避免了该偏差；偏差量级有解析近似，并建立了诊断准则。
Conclusion: collider 结构会给 B-PINN 物理参数后验带来可预测的系统偏差，链式生成表述加 particle MCMC 是其可靠替代，且可用诊断准则预判标准 B-PINN 是否仍可信。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Towards Unified Evaluation of Prompt Enhancers for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern video generators can realize increasingly complex visual narratives, positioning the prompt enhancer (PE) as a critical bridge from concise user instructions and multimodal references to structured cinematic plans. However, existing PE evaluation relies on rendered videos, imposing substantial computational and human costs, slowing PE training and iteration, and conflating PE quality with downstream generator behavior. To address this gap, we introduce PEBench, the first unified benchmark for direct PE evaluation across text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video prompt enhancement. It comprises 1,100 expert-verified cases and 1,005 visual assets, spanning 35 fine-grained tasks with diverse temporal, cinematic, audiovisual, and multi-reference requirements. In addition, we develop PEBench evaluation, an evidence-grounded framework that combines modality-aware fact extraction with rubric-based assessment across 24 criteria. Our systematic evaluation of representative open- and closed-source PE methods reveals an emerging shift from fine-grained descriptive expansion toward intent-preserving cinematic planning, while the caption-reconstruction and forward-refinement methods show complementary strengths in cinematic coverage and semantic fidelity or internal coherence, respectively. Human validation shows that PEBench scores align closely with expert judgments of enhanced prompts and downstream videos from Wan3.0 and MiniMax-H3, indicating that prompt-level evaluation reliably reflects downstream utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PEBench，把视频生成的 prompt enhancer (PE) 从渲染视频评测中解耦，直接在 prompt 层做统一评测：1,100 条专家核验案例、1,005 个视觉资产、35 项细粒度任务，覆盖文生视频、图生视频与参考生视频。评测显示 PE 正从细粒度描述扩写转向保意图的电影化规划，caption-reconstruction 与 forward-refinement 分别在电影覆盖度、语义保真度与内部一致性上互补；PEBench 分数与专家对增强 prompt 及下游 Wan3.0、MiniMax-H3 视频的判断高度一致。
Motivation: 现有 PE 评测依赖渲染视频，算力与人力成本高、拖慢 PE 训练迭代，且把 PE 质量与下游生成器行为混在一起，无法直接衡量 enhancer 本身。
Method: PEBench 含 1,100 条专家核验案例与 1,005 个视觉资产，覆盖 35 项细粒度任务（时序、电影语言、视听、多参考等）；配套 PEBench evaluation 框架，用 modality-aware fact extraction 加 rubric-based assessment，跨 24 条评分准则打分，并以人工验证对齐专家判断。
Result: 系统评测开源与闭源 PE 方法发现评测重心正从细粒度描述扩写转向保意图的电影化规划；caption-reconstruction 与 forward-refinement 分别在 cinematic coverage 与 semantic fidelity、internal coherence 上互补。人工验证显示 PEBench 分数与专家对增强 prompt 及下游 Wan3.0、MiniMax-H3 视频的判断高度一致。
Conclusion: prompt 层的直接评测能可靠反映下游效用，从而免去渲染视频的算力与人力开销，让 PE 训练与迭代更快。

papers.title: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $Φ$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration
papers.abstract_en: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $Φ$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and optional characterization of selected anomaly types. Before launch, the pipeline was trained and validated on simulated $Φ$sat-2 imagery to assess algorithmic performance and compatibility with resource-constrained onboard hardware. After integration and functional validation in the mission environment, early experiments on real $Φ$sat-2 acquisitions revealed a significant mismatch between simulated and in-orbit data. The pipeline was therefore retrained on real Level-1 imagery using an improved annotation strategy to better handle ambiguous marine regions, substantially enhancing performance. Beyond demonstrating the onboard feasibility of the application, the $Φ$sat-2 experience highlights the importance of robust annotation strategies and sensor-aware design, and shows that simulation-based development is valuable for pre-flight risk reduction, while reliable scientific validation requires representative in-orbit data and should be clearly distinguished from functional validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Φsat-2 在轨海洋异常检测流水线先用仿真影像训练，入轨后发现仿真与真实 L1 数据存在显著失配，改用真实 Level-1 影像与改进的歧义海域标注策略重训后性能大幅提升。结论是仿真开发适合发射前降风险，但科学验证必须用有代表性的在轨数据，并与功能验证分开。
Motivation: 星上 AI 处理可提升对地观测的响应速度与带宽效率，但受限于星上算力，且仿真训练的模型直接上轨常因数据分布失配而失效。
Method: 轻量流水线依次为：海面分割、海区自监督特征编码、基于偏离正常海况的通用异常检测，以及可选的特定异常类型刻画；发射前在仿真 Φsat-2 影像上训练与验证以评估算法性能和星上硬件资源兼容性，入轨后在真实 L1 影像上用改进的歧义海域标注策略重训。
Result: 早期在轨真实 Φsat-2 数据实验显示仿真与在轨数据存在显著失配；用真实 Level-1 影像重训后性能显著提升。摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 仿真驱动开发对发射前降风险有价值，但可靠的科学验证需要有代表性的在轨数据，且应与功能验证明确区分；鲁棒的标注策略与传感器感知设计是关键。

summary_sections.method: 轻量流水线依次为：海面分割、海区自监督特征编码、基于偏离正常海况的通用异常检测，以及可选的特定异常类型刻画；发射前在仿真 Φsat-2 影像上训练与验证以评估算法性能和星上硬件资源兼容性，入轨后在真实 L1 影像上用改进的歧义海域标注策略重训。

papers.title: Timer-M1: A Multivariate Time Series Foundation Model via Learning Primitives
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Timer-M1, a pretrained multivariate time series foundation model that learns with primitives for zero-shot forecasting. Across domains, time series share elementary temporal and relational patterns, termed primitives, yet differ in how these primitives manifest and evolve across different contexts. Despite progress in zero-shot and task-general forecasting, existing foundation models may still struggle to generalize to complex real-world scenarios. To this end, we develop a primitive-based data synthesis and pretraining pipeline. The synthesis pipeline generates series with temporal primitives shared across domains and then assembles real and generated series into multivariate samples using relational primitives. Afterwards, samples are organized into episodes by assigning distinct channel roles as target variates, past-only covariates, and known-future covariates, ensuring that the model is optimized on predictable variates using available exogenous information. Technically, Timer-M1 further adapts gated two-dimensional Transformer blocks that dynamically allocate cross-variate attention across layers. Across three large-scale forecasting benchmarks, Timer-M1 ranks first on both FEV and TIME and second on GIFT-Eval among most recent time series foundation models. These results support effective primitive-based pretraining as a route to robust general forecasting technique across domains and task settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Timer-M1 用「基元 (primitives)」做数据合成与预训练：先生成跨领域共享的时间基元序列，再按关系基元把真实与合成序列拼成多变量样本，并按目标变量、仅历史协变量、已知未来协变量分配通道角色组成 episode，模型用门控二维 Transformer 跨变量注意力。在三个大规模预报基准上，Timer-M1 在最新时间序列基础模型中 FEV 与 TIME 排名第一、GIFT-Eval 排名第二。
Motivation: 跨领域时间序列共享基本时间与关系模式，但这些基元在不同上下文中的表现与演化方式不同，现有零样本、任务通用的基础模型在复杂真实场景下泛化仍然吃力。
Method: 构建基元式数据合成与预训练流水线：合成管线生成跨领域共享时间基元的序列，再用关系基元把真实与生成序列组装成多变量样本；样本按通道角色（目标变量、仅历史协变量、已知未来协变量）组织成 episode，使模型只在可利用外生信息预测的变量上优化。网络采用门控二维 Transformer 块 (gated two-dimensional Transformer blocks)，逐层动态分配跨变量注意力。
Result: 在三个大规模预报基准上，Timer-M1 在多数近期时间序列基础模型中 FEV 与 TIME 均排名第一，GIFT-Eval 排名第二。
Conclusion: 基元式预训练是一条通向跨领域、跨任务稳健通用预报技术的有效路径。

papers.title: MemTrial: Learning When to Trust Memory in LLM Portfolio Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents for portfolio management learn from experience: they credit each experience in their memory with the outcome of the decisions that used it. In financial markets, however, this outcome mostly reflects the market move shared by all decisions on that date, so the credit tracks the market rather than the experience, and these agents often do worse than simply holding the equal-weight (1/$N$) portfolio. We ask how an agent can credit an experience with what it changes, and answer it by putting memory on trial: drafts of the same decision with and without an experience face the same market, so the outcome they share cancels in their difference. Our agent, MemTrial, drafts each decision with eight combinations of its retrieved experiences, chosen by a fractional factorial design, and credits each experience with its Banzhaf value, the average of these differences. As each date occurs once and each draft is a noisy LLM sample, these credits are noisy and may not hold on new dates. MemTrial therefore pools them across dates and similar experiences with a hierarchical Bayesian model, acts on them only after they have predicted unseen dates, and otherwise stays anchored at a conservative reference such as 1/$N$. On four benchmarks, MemTrial not only benefits from experiences that matter (the best of 15 methods on a semi-synthetic benchmark with known experience quality) but also limits its losses when its values do not hold (at most 2.2\% below 1/$N$ on PortBench and InvestorBench, against 15--38\% for the best experience-learning agent). Averaged over five settings, it improves the utility of the best experience-learning agent by 21.2\%, and with eight LLMs it beats every LLM-based baseline on InvestorBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemTrial 用同一决策在有/无某条经验下的两次草稿做差，把市场共同项消掉，再用 Banzhaf value 给经验记账，并用分层贝叶斯模型跨日期汇总、只在能预测未见日期时才据此行动，否则退回 1/N 参考组合。在四个基准上它既吃到有用经验（半合成基准上 15 种方法中最优），又把失效时的损失压到 PortBench 与 InvestorBench 上最多低于 1/N 的 2.2%，而最好的经验学习代理会低 15–38%。
Motivation: LLM 组合管理代理按决策结果给记忆里的经验记账，但该结果主要由当天全市场共同涨跌决定，记账学到的是市场而非经验本身，导致这类代理常常跑不赢等权 1/N 组合。
Method: 用 fractional factorial design 取检索经验的八种组合作草稿，同一决策在有/无某经验下对同一市场，差分消去共同结果，取各差分均值即 Banzhaf value 作为该经验的贡献；再用分层贝叶斯模型跨日期与相似经验汇总这些含噪记账，仅在其预测过未见日期后才据此行动，否则锚定 1/N 等保守参考。
Result: 在四个基准上：半合成基准（经验质量已知）中为 15 种方法里最好；在 PortBench 与 InvestorBench 上最坏仅比 1/N 低 2.2%，而最好的经验学习代理低 15–38%；跨五个设置平均，把最佳经验学习代理的 utility 提升 21.2%；在 InvestorBench 上用八个 LLM 跑赢所有基于 LLM 的基线。
Conclusion: 把记忆放上审判台、用同市场差分记账并只在可外推时采信，能让 LLM 组合代理既利用有价值的经验，又在经验失效时把下行锁在接近 1/N 的水平。

papers.title: Spectral Weight Decay: Inducing Low-Rank Structure in Neural Network Weights
papers.abstract_en: Standard weight decay treats each weight matrix as a vector and ignores its spectral structure. We introduce spectral weight decay, a post-step decoupled nuclear-norm update that applies additive rather than multiplicative spectral shrinkage. We connect the update to approximate proximal descent and show that its sensitivity to update order can exceed that of conventional $\ell_2$ weight decay near rank deficiency. Across LLaMA models with $124$M to $500$M parameters, spectral weight decay lowers effective rank and improves SVD-LLM compression at matched validation loss. At $500$M and a $4\%$ distortion budget, it reaches $1.89\times$ compression and $1.18\times$ GPU inference speedup, compared with $1.14\times$ and $1.01\times$ after standard weight decay. Under fixed-horizon training with $60\%$ label noise, it also improves final mean clean-test accuracy over matched $\ell_2$ regularization by up to $17.8$ points on MNIST and $4.6$ points across four BERT-base tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/brain-lab-research/SpectralWD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出谱权重衰减 (spectral weight decay)：在每步优化后对权重矩阵做解耦的核范数 (nuclear norm) 加性收缩，而非把矩阵当向量的乘性 ℓ2 收缩，从而直接压低权重矩阵的有效秩。在 124M–500M 的 LLaMA 模型上，它在同等验证损失下提升 SVD-LLM 压缩率：500M 模型、4% 失真预算下达到 1.89× 压缩与 1.18× GPU 推理加速，而标准 weight decay 只有 1.14× 与 1.01×；在 60% 标签噪声的固定步数训练下，相对匹配的 ℓ2 正则，MNIST 干净测试准确率最多高 17.8 个百分点，四个 BERT-base 任务平均高 4.6 个百分点。
Motivation: 标准 weight decay 把每个权重矩阵当作向量处理，完全忽略其谱结构，因此无法直接控制矩阵的秩与低秩可压缩性；而下游压缩方法（如 SVD-LLM）恰恰依赖低秩结构。
Method: 在优化器解耦 weight decay 的位置替换为核范数更新：每步之后对权重矩阵做加性 (additive) 谱收缩而非乘性 (multiplicative) 收缩。作者把该更新与近似近端下降 (approximate proximal descent) 联系起来，并分析其对更新顺序的敏感性，在接近秩亏 (rank deficiency) 时可超过常规 ℓ2 weight decay。
Result: 在 124M 到 500M 参数的 LLaMA 模型上，谱权重衰减降低有效秩并在同等验证损失下改善 SVD-LLM 压缩：500M 模型、4% 失真预算下达到 1.89× 压缩与 1.18× GPU 推理加速，对比标准 weight decay 后的 1.14× 与 1.01×。在 60% 标签噪声的固定步数 (fixed-horizon) 训练下，相对匹配的 ℓ2 正则，MNIST 最终干净测试准确率最多提升 17.8 个百分点，四个 BERT-base 任务提升 4.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把权重衰减从向量式 ℓ2 改成作用于谱的加性核范数收缩，可以在不牺牲验证损失的前提下诱导低秩结构，直接换来更高的压缩率与推理加速，并在标签噪声下更稳健。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MAP4CS: A Multi-dimensional Data Pruning Framework for Efficient Code Retriever Fine-tuning
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a cornerstone in software engineering for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) with domain-specific knowledge. However, adapting retrievers to evolving code repositories remains challenging due to the noise and redundancy inherent in massive code corpora. Standard fine-tuning on the full corpus is computationally expensive and often leads to sub-optimal performance due to negative transfer from low-quality samples. Conversely, simple random sampling fails to guarantee data representativeness. To address these challenges, we propose MAP4CS (Multi-dimensional Awareness Pruning for Code Search), an adaptive data pruning framework. MAP4CS identifies a small, high-quality core subset by integrating syntactic structure, semantic diversity, and distributional representation, followed by a rigorous rule-based filtering pipeline. Extensive experiments on two large-scale datasets demonstrate that MAP4CS consistently outperforms random sampling baselines using only 5% of the training data. Remarkably, it achieves performance comparable to, or even superior to, fine-tuning on the full dataset, validating the ''less is more'' hypothesis in data-centric AI. Furthermore, linguistic analysis reveals an adaptive optimization mechanism: MAP4CS automatically functions as a de-duplicator for redundant corpora and a denoiser for chaotic ones, constructing a training corpus that is both lexically diverse and information-dense.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAP4CS 针对代码检索器 (code retriever) 微调提出多维数据剪枝框架，把句法结构、语义多样性与分布代表性结合选出高质量核心子集，再经规则过滤管线筛除低质样本。在两个大规模数据集上仅用 5% 训练数据即稳定超过随机采样基线，并达到与全量微调相当甚至更优的表现。
Motivation: 代码语料规模大且含噪声与冗余，全量微调计算开销高、低质样本带来负迁移，而随机采样又无法保证数据代表性。
Method: MAP4CS (Multi-dimensional Awareness Pruning for Code Search)：整合句法结构、语义多样性与分布表示识别小规模高质量核心子集，随后接一条基于规则的严格过滤管线；语言学分析用于刻画其去重与去噪行为。
Result: 在两个大规模数据集上，仅用 5% 训练数据 consistently 优于随机采样基线，且达到与全量数据微调相当甚至更优的性能；语言学分析显示它对冗余语料充当去重器、对混乱语料充当去噪器，产出词汇多样且信息密集的训练语料。
Conclusion: 数据剪枝可以验证 data-centric AI 的 less is more：少量精选样本即可匹配全量微调，同时按语料状态自适应去重或去噪。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Addressing Overcommitment in the Reasoning of Gendered Economic Memes under Multimodal Ambiguity
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal meme understanding is increasingly used to analyze socially sensitive content, yet existing models often exhibit biased behavior when interpreting economic dependence and social roles under ambiguity. Many memes express economic relationships through sparse text or symbolic visual cues, providing insufficient evidence for gendered attribution. In such underspecified settings, models tend to rely on pretraining correlations, leading to hallucinated and stereotypical economic role assignments. In this work, we study gendered economic dependence in image-text memes through the lens of contextual sufficiency and identify epistemic overcommitment-inferring roles without adequate evidence-as a primary source of bias. We propose CGER-Net, a context-grounded multimodal framework that estimates whether the input provides sufficient evidence for gendered economic reasoning and applies evidence-gated inference to enable confident attribution when cues are explicit while favoring principled abstention otherwise. We evaluate CGER-Net on EconMeme-GE, a curated dataset of image-text memes annotated as Men, Women, Neutral, or Ambiguous. Across strong contemporary multimodal baselines, CGER-Net reduces Gender Overcommitment Rate by up to 44% on ambiguous instances while maintaining comparable accuracy on unambiguous cases. Human evaluation further shows that 79% of generated rationales are judged as epistemically aligned with the available evidence. These results highlight the importance of modeling when not to infer for reliable and responsible multimodal analysis.

TL;DR: 提出 CGER-Net，用上下文充分性判断图像-文本 meme 是否提供足够证据再做性别经济角色归因：证据充分时才自信归因，否则选择弃权 (abstention)。在 EconMeme-GE 上，相比多个多模态基线，歧义样本的 Gender Overcommitment Rate 最多降低 44%，无歧义样本准确率保持相当，人工评估中 79% 的生成理由被评为与证据认识论一致。
Motivation: 多模态模型在文本稀疏或符号化视觉线索的经济 meme 上缺乏足够证据，却依赖预训练相关性给出幻觉化、刻板化的性别经济角色归因，形成认识论上的过度承诺 (epistemic overcommitment)。
Method: 提出 context-grounded 多模态框架 CGER-Net：先估计输入是否足以支撑性别经济推理，再用证据门控推理 (evidence-gated inference) 决定自信归因还是弃权；在标注为 Men、Women、Neutral、Ambiguous 的 EconMeme-GE 数据集上评测，并与多个强多模态基线对比。
Result: 在歧义 (Ambiguous) 样本上 Gender Overcommitment Rate 最多降低 44%，同时无歧义样本准确率与基线相当；人工评估显示 79% 的生成理由被评为与可用证据认识论一致。
Conclusion: 对多模态敏感内容分析，建模「何时不该推断」并主动弃权，是降低性别角色过度承诺偏差的关键。

papers.title: MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?
papers.abstract_en: Multiplayer world models must ensure that independently controlled views remain consistent with one shared and persistent world. We introduce MultiWorldBench, a diagnostic Minecraft benchmark containing 495 case configurations across seven task suites and ten capabilities, including independent control, cross-view motion, shared-state synchronization, persistence, structural reasoning, concurrent interaction, and delayed revisit. We evaluate Solaris, Gamma-World, and MineWorld, using Engine GT as a reference. Gamma-World achieves the highest ten-capability average among the generated systems at 21.39, followed by Solaris at 20.88 and MineWorld at 1.89, while Engine GT reaches 91.69. Gamma-World performs better on several control, shared-state, and revisit capabilities, whereas Solaris leads in cross-view motion and race-condition consistency. Nevertheless, all generated systems score at most 8.00 on state persistence and 1.33 on structural consistency, and none succeeds in spatial reasoning or building-identity preservation. Human preferences produce the same overall ranking and show strong alignment with the automatic evaluation, with a mean dimension-level Spearman correlation of 0.96. These results show that plausible individual views do not yet constitute a coherent multiplayer world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultiWorldBench 是一个诊断性 Minecraft 多人世界模型基准，含 495 个案例配置、七个任务套件、十项能力，用以检验独立控制的多个视角是否指向同一持久世界。评测 Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld 并以 Engine GT 为参照：十项能力均分 Gamma-World 21.39、Solaris 20.88、MineWorld 1.89，Engine GT 91.69；状态持久性最高仅 8.00、结构一致性 1.33，空间推理与建筑身份保持全部失败，说明单个视角看起来合理并不等于连贯的多人世界。
Motivation: 多人世界模型需要让各自独立控制的视角保持对同一持久世界的一致性，但现有系统在跨视角同步、持久性与结构推理上缺少可诊断的评测手段。
Method: 构建 Minecraft 诊断基准 MultiWorldBench：495 个案例配置、七个任务套件、十项能力（独立控制、跨视角运动、共享状态同步、持久性、结构推理、并发交互、延迟重访等）；对 Solaris、Gamma-World、MineWorld 三个生成系统评测，以 Engine GT 作参照，并加入人类偏好与自动评测的对照。
Result: 十项能力平均分：Gamma-World 21.39（生成系统中最高）、Solaris 20.88、MineWorld 1.89，Engine GT 91.69。Gamma-World 在控制、共享状态与重访类能力上更好，Solaris 在跨视角运动与竞态一致性上领先；所有生成系统状态持久性至多 8.00、结构一致性 1.33，空间推理与建筑身份保持无一成功。人类偏好给出相同总体排序，维度级 Spearman 相关均值 0.96。
Conclusion: 生成式多人世界模型目前只能产出各自合理的单视角，尚不能构成一个连贯、共享且持久的世界，短板集中在持久性、结构一致性与空间推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality
papers.abstract_en: We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 4-tensor attention：把场景状态写成带位置 (x, t) 与语义纤维、时间上下文纤维的窗口，用一次 softmax 在整个窗口上联合归一化，预测下一语义状态，供视频生成与机器人规划用。在 ROCStories 的下一句任务上，验证集最后一句交叉熵比自由运行的一维 Transformer 低 5.3%（H=2, L=2）、2.6%（H=4, L=2）、2.4%（H=4, L=3），且 H=4, L=2 时参数量几乎相同（172.5M 对 175.9M），同两块 GPU 上训练 2.4 小时对 45.2 小时。
Motivation: 自由运行的一维 Transformer 逐 token 顺序前向，训练慢且在窗口化下一状态预测上交叉熵偏高；需要一个把语义与时间上下文统一放进一次归一化的更新算子。
Method: 4-tensor attention：窗口内状态含位置 (x, t)、语义纤维与时间上下文纤维，单次 softmax 在整个窗口上联合归一化；编码器、渲染器与规划器置于更新之外，只单独检验更新本身。训练在 ROCStories 上，每个窗口在语义层提出同一下一句任务，验证集按单 seed 比较。
Result: 验证集最后一句交叉熵相对自由运行一维 Transformer 降低 5.3%（H=2, L=2）、2.6%（H=4, L=2）、2.4%（H=4, L=3）；H=4, L=2 参数量 172.5M 对 175.9M；同两块 GPU 上 4-tensor 训练 2.4 小时，基线 45.2 小时（基线按自由运行解码，每个目标 token 一次顺序前向）。
Conclusion: 把语义纤维与时间上下文纤维放进一次联合 softmax 的更新，在下一语义状态预测上以近乎相同的参数量同时降低交叉熵并大幅缩短训练时间。

papers.title: Internalizer: Portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping for Very Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Hypernetworks that map a context directly to a LoRA adapter let a large language model carry that context in its weights, but prior work has demonstrated them only on base models of up to 14 billion parameters. We present the Internalizer, a state-of-the-art, portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping hypernetwork that generates document-specific LoRA adapters for the frozen 284B-parameter DeepSeek v4 Flash, a target two orders of magnitude larger than in any previous work. Most of its parameters live in a model-agnostic trunk with only thin entry and exit layers per base model, so it trains cheaply against small models before being ported to the large one. On unseen documents of up to 4096 tokens, the generated adapters reach 84.9% top-1 and 97.8% top-5 teacher-forced accuracy against 63.4% and 83.5% for the base model, with nothing in the context window but a three-word instruction. Once the hypernetwork is trained, a single forward pass turns any document into an adapter for such a model, which could be served alone for speed or alongside the document in the window to raise accuracy further.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Internalizer 是一个把文档直接映射为 LoRA 适配器的 hypernetwork，可为冻结的 284B DeepSeek v4 Flash 生成文档专属适配器，目标模型规模比既有工作（最大 14B）大两个数量级。在未见文档（≤4096 tokens）上，生成适配器的 teacher-forced top-1/top-5 准确率达 84.9%/97.8%，基座模型仅 63.4%/83.5%，且上下文窗口里只有三词指令。
Motivation: hypernetwork 用权重承载上下文的做法此前只在最大 14B 的基座模型上验证过，无法说明能否扩展到生产级超大 LLM；且每次换基座模型都要重训，成本高。
Method: Context-to-Parameter Mapping hypernetwork 为冻结的 284B DeepSeek v4 Flash 生成 document-specific LoRA adapter；主体参数放在 model-agnostic trunk，仅按基座模型配薄的 entry/exit 层，因此可先在小模型上廉价训练再移植到大模型。训练完成后单次前向即可把任意文档转成适配器。
Result: 在未见文档（up to 4096 tokens）上，生成适配器的 teacher-forced 准确率为 top-1 84.9%、top-5 97.8%，基座模型为 63.4% 与 83.5%；上下文窗口中只有三词指令。目标模型 284B 参数，比此前最大 14B 的演示大两个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者主张 Context-to-Parameter Mapping 可移植到远超以往规模的超大 LLM，且适配器既能单独服务以提速，也能与文档同放上下文窗口进一步提准确率。

papers.title: DeltaReplay: Task-Relative Memory Reuse for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented mobile GUI agents store successful execution trajectories and reuse them in later tasks, but a stored trajectory rarely matches a new task exactly. The new task may use different parameters, share only some of its steps with a stored trajectory, or have no relevant record in memory. Forcing the agent to use irrelevant memory can mislead it, whereas discarding memory that may still be useful deprives it of guidance from past experience. To address this dilemma, we propose DeltaReplay, a step-level memory reuse framework that decides how to use existing memory without modifying it. We observe that the reusable part of a stored record is determined not by the record itself but by its relation to the new task, mainly through two factors: page-level consistency and action-level generality. We therefore store execution trajectories as paths in a transition graph, whose nodes (pages) and edges (actions between pages) capture these two factors. At reuse time, the action on each edge is split into a task-independent operation and task-specific parameters. DeltaReplay then compares each recorded step with the new task and the current screen, and decides whether to follow it, execute it after replacing its parameters, or leave it to the base agent. On AndroidWorld and SPA-Bench, DeltaReplay improves the task success rate over a base agent with the same backbone by up to 10.3 and 25.0 percentage points, respectively. These results indicate that deciding at each step how to use retrieved memory lets agents benefit even from partially matching trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeltaReplay 是面向移动 GUI agent 的步级记忆复用框架：把执行轨迹存成以页面为节点、动作为边的转移图，复用时按页面一致性与动作通用性逐条比对记录步骤与新任务及当前屏幕，决定照抄、替换参数后执行或交回基线 agent，且不修改记忆本身。在 AndroidWorld 与 SPA-Bench 上，同 backbone 基线的任务成功率分别最多提升 10.3 与 25.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 记忆增强的移动 GUI agent 存下的成功轨迹很少与新任务完全一致：参数不同、只共享部分步骤或根本没有相关记录，强行复用会误导 agent，全丢弃又失去经验指导。
Method: 把执行轨迹存为转移图路径，节点是页面、边是页面间动作，分别承载页面级一致性与动作级通用性；复用时把边上动作拆成任务无关操作与任务特定参数，逐条比对记录步骤、新任务与当前屏幕，三选一：跟随、替换参数后执行、留给基线 agent，全程不修改已有记忆。
Result: 在 AndroidWorld 上任务成功率较同 backbone 基线最多提升 10.3 个百分点，在 SPA-Bench 上最多提升 25.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 逐决策定如何使用检索到的记忆，能让 agent 从仅部分匹配的轨迹中获益，而不必改写记忆库。

papers.title: Does an Illumination Prior Help Face-Swap Detection? A Controlled Study of Temporal Self-Blended Images
papers.abstract_en: Self-blended images are widely used to train face-swap detectors, but primarily capture blending artifacts. We investigate whether adding illumination inconsistencies improves detection. Temporal Self-Blended Images (T-SBI) transfer lighting statistics between frames of the same video, with the mismatch controlled by luminance difference (ΔL). Using five training regimes and a three-seed comparison of high- and low-ΔL training, we find no evidence of illumination-specific improvements. AUC differences remain within seed variability across four datasets, and an analysis of 506,328 attribute-binned samples shows no preferential reduction in errors under harsh lighting. Instead, T-SBI shifts prediction scores, changing optimal thresholds by approximately 0.34 on FaceForensics++ and 0.30 on Celeb-DF, making comparisons at a fixed threshold misleading. However, T-SBI improves robustness to heavy JPEG compression on DFDC (AUC 0.780 versus 0.696), potentially reflecting greater reliance on low-frequency cues. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating training methods against their intended targets and accounting for threshold effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T-SBI 用同一视频帧间转移光照统计并以亮度差 ΔL 控制失配来训练人脸替换检测器，结果在四个数据集上没有光照方面的检测提升：AUC 差异落在三个种子的波动内，506,328 个按属性分箱的样本显示恶劣光照下错误未被优先降低。相反 T-SBI 主要平移预测分数，使 FaceForensics++ 与 Celeb-DF 的最优阈值分别移动约 0.34 与 0.30，固定阈值比较会失真；它只在 DFDC 重 JPEG 压缩下把 AUC 从 0.696 提到 0.780。
Motivation: Self-blended images 训练的人脸替换检测器主要学到混合伪影，光照不一致这一线索是否真能改善检测缺少受控证据，而固定阈值的评测方式可能掩盖训练方法的真实效果。
Method: 提出 Temporal Self-Blended Images (T-SBI)，在同一视频的帧之间转移光照统计，用亮度差 ΔL 控制失配强度；设计五种训练 regime，并做高 ΔL 与低 ΔL 的三种子对比，在四个数据集上评测，另对 506,328 个按属性分箱的样本分析错误分布与阈值效应。
Result: 四个数据集上 AUC 差异保持在种子波动范围内，无光照特异性提升；506,328 个属性分箱样本显示恶劣光照下错误未被优先降低。T-SBI 使最优阈值在 FaceForensics++ 上移动约 0.34、Celeb-DF 上约 0.30。在 DFDC 重 JPEG 压缩下 AUC 0.780 对基线 0.696，作者认为这可能反映对低频线索的更强依赖。
Conclusion: 加入光照不一致并未带来针对光照目标的检测改善，T-SBI 的主要作用是平移分数分布而非提升判别力；评测训练方法须对准其声称的目标，并报告阈值效应而非只看固定阈值。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Intervention anchors and scientific verification in synthetic vascular predictive representations
papers.abstract_en: Complete orthogonal predictive coordinates do not by themselves bind a latent direction to a named intervention. We present a mathematical and synthetic audit motivated by vascular device-vessel suitcordance. Capacity-matched least-squares predictors were exactly equivalent under complete fixed output transforms, whereas an anchor-only observer recovered interpretations only within the span of known perturbation signatures. Six three-dimensional configurations across 64 seeds gave a maximum paired prediction discrepancy of 6.7e-15 but a median untransported edit error of 1.513. Coordinate transport removed that error. Noisy and weak anchors constrained calibration stability, and changing the representation basis required recalibration or verified transport. Across 256 additional fits in dimensions 3-24, prediction equivalence persisted within 4.0e-15. We then evaluated nine deliberate runnable fault classes across 64 seeds. All 576 faulty executions completed, but each violated at least one reconstruction, prediction, delivered-edit or scope contract; all 320 valid control records passed. Repeating a faulty implementation gave exact self-agreement despite error against the separately computed simulator expectation. For one omitted-direction defect, probe coverage followed its analytic law, and rank-aware abstention protected unsupported interpretations. Scalar-noise experiments exposed both missed weak faults and excessive rejection under narrow relative tolerances. These controls provide an executable separation of prediction, semantic support and scientific acceptance. They are synthetic numerical audits, not clinical validation, neural JEPA-Anything replication, agent learning or patient treatment-effect estimation.
papers.comment: Technical Note; 18 pages, 8 figures; reproducibility source and data archive included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 血管器械-血管适配场景下，完整正交预测坐标本身无法把潜在方向绑定到具名干预：容量匹配的最小二乘预测在完全固定输出变换下严格等价（64 个种子、6 种三维配置的最大配对预测差 6.7e-15），但未做坐标传输的编辑误差中位数达 1.513，坐标传输 (coordinate transport) 将其消除。结论是预测等价、语义支撑与科学验收必须用可执行契约分开检验，弱锚与噪声锚下需重新校验或验证传输。
Motivation: 完整的预测坐标并不保证潜在方向对应某个具名干预，导致预测正确与解释可用之间存在断裂；血管器械-血管适配需要把这两者在可执行层面分开审计。
Method: 数学与合成审计：容量匹配的最小二乘预测器在完全固定输出变换下比较，anchor-only 观测器只在已知扰动签名张成的 span 内恢复解释；用坐标传输消除未传输编辑误差，并设计九类可运行故障注入，配合 rank-aware abstention 与标量噪声实验检验校准稳定性。
Result: 6 种三维配置 × 64 个种子的最大配对预测差 6.7e-15，未传输编辑误差中位数 1.513，坐标传输后该误差被消除；另 256 次拟合（维度 3–24）预测等价保持在 4.0e-15 以内。九类故障 × 64 种子共 576 次故障执行全部完成，且每类至少违反重建、预测、交付编辑或作用域契约之一；320 条有效对照记录全部通过。重复同一故障实现出现完全自洽但偏离独立计算的模拟器期望；标量噪声实验同时暴露漏检弱故障与窄相对容差下的过度拒绝。
Conclusion: 预测等价不等于语义支撑：解释必须由锚与坐标传输约束，验收必须对照独立模拟器期望的可执行契约，弱锚与噪声锚下需重新校验或验证传输。作者明确这是合成数值审计，不是临床验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What is the goal of unsupervised machine learning?
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised learning is one of the main branches of machine learning. Here I argue that unlike the other branches of machine learning (supervised and reinforcement learning), unsupervised learning is a rather heterogenous field that can serve several different goals. It seems futile to try to define one single goal for unsupervised learning. I identify four different goals for unsupervised learning: 1) Estimating the distribution, 2) Generating new data points, 3) Extracting features for downstream tasks, and 4) Understanding the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论证无监督学习不存在单一目标，给出四类可区分的目标：估计分布、生成新数据点、为下游任务提取特征、理解数据；并主张用一个统一定义去框定无监督学习是徒劳的。
Motivation: 监督学习与强化学习各有明确目标，而无监督学习内部目标混杂，导致该分支难以被单一定义刻画，讨论长期停留在含混层面。
Method: 概念性论证：以监督学习和强化学习为对照，逐一辨识并区分无监督学习可服务的四类目标（分布估计、数据生成、下游特征提取、数据理解），据此论证单一目标定义不可行。
Result: 给出四类目标的分类：1) 估计分布，2) 生成新数据点，3) 为下游任务提取特征，4) 理解数据；核心论断是试图为无监督学习定义单一目标是徒劳的。
Conclusion: 无监督学习应被理解为服务多个不同目标的异质领域，而非由单一目标定义的分支。

papers.title: A 3D Characterization Framework for Intelligent Sequential Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Puzzles are widely used to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) systems for sequential decision making, yet approaches originating from different paradigms are rarely compared under unified conditions. To address this gap, we introduce a three-dimensional characterization framework that enables the analysts of AI methods by 1) projecting them to the Markov decision process (MDP) sequential decision making formalism, 2) degree of autonomy through human prior ranking of their designs and, 3) skill and computational cost. Using this framework, we analyze how representative graph-based, reinforcement learning, and large language model (LLM)-based approaches differ in their design choices and performance characteristics, instantiated respectively by Neurosolver, forward-backward reinforcement learning (FBRL), and automated thought-of-search (AutoToS), including a double-agent extension of thought-of-search (DA-ToS). The analysis relies on the Tower of Hanoi puzzle that provides a controlled benchmark with well-defined rules and scalable complexity, enabling consistent comparison across increasing problem sizes. The 3D characterization reveals that LLM-based methods, due to their weakly constrained action-space design, shift complexity from architecture to inference-time verification, leading to substantially higher memory and runtime costs than Neurosolver and FBRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出三维刻画框架，把图搜索、强化学习与 LLM 三类序列决策方法统一投影到 MDP 形式、按人类先验排序的自主度、以及技能与计算成本三个维度上比较。在 Tower of Hanoi 基准上，LLM 方法因动作空间约束弱，把复杂度从架构转移到推理时验证，内存与运行时开销显著高于 Neurosolver 与 FBRL。
Motivation: 不同范源的序列决策方法缺少统一比较条件，设计选择与性能特征难以在同等基准下对照。
Method: 框架含三个维度：投影到 MDP 形式、按人类先验对设计自主度排序、刻画技能与计算成本；以 Neurosolver（图基）、FBRL（强化学习）、AutoToS 及其双智能体扩展 DA-ToS（LLM）为实例，在规则明确、复杂度可扩展的 Tower of Hanoi 上做一致比较。
Result: 在 Tower of Hanoi 上随问题规模增大，LLM 类方法（AutoToS、DA-ToS）的内存与运行时成本显著高于 Neurosolver 与 FBRL，原因是动作空间设计约束弱、复杂度转移到推理时验证。
Conclusion: 序列决策方法的取舍可由架构约束与推理时验证成本的转移来解释：动作空间约束越弱，运行时代价越高。

papers.title: Elucidating the Space of Enzymatic Reaction: A Unified Benchmark and Pretrained Model
papers.abstract_en: Existing reaction models primarily learn molecular transformations, whereas enzy- matic reactions depend jointly on molecular structure and catalytic function. We formulate this problem as learning an enzymatic reaction space linking reactants, products, and Enzyme Commission (EC) annotations. To characterize this space, we introduce VenusRX-Bench, a unified benchmark for forward reaction prediction, single-step retrosynthesis, and EC-number prediction. VenusRX-Bench integrates reactions from multiple biochemical databases with standardized curation, leakage- controlled splits, and consistent evaluation. Benchmarking representative chemical and enzymatic models reveals a clear chemical-to-enzymatic domain gap, driven by limited domain data, catalytic-context dependency, and the difficulty of modeling large biomolecular structures. To bridge this gap, we develop VenusRX, a unified T5-style sequence-to-sequence model for enzymatic reactions. VenusRX jointly learns forward prediction, ret- rosynthesis, and reaction reconstruction, with two-stage training on millions of template-expanded reactions followed by real biochemical reactions. In addition, optional EC conditioning incorporates catalytic context, while Molecule Library- Constrained Decoding improves the generation of complex biomolecules. Across benchmark tasks and challenging generalization splits, VenusRX achieves the best or competitive performance on most evaluated settings over representative chem- ical and enzymatic baselines. Moreover, EC information consistently improves reaction prediction, while learned reaction representations support accurate EC prediction, revealing a bidirectional relationship between reaction structure and catalytic function. Together, VenusRX-Bench and VenusRX provide a unified framework for elucidating and modeling enzymatic reaction space
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出酶反应空间学习框架：VenusRX-Bench 统一前向反应预测、单步逆合成与 EC 号预测三项任务，配套 T5 式序列到序列模型 VenusRX，用两阶段训练（先模板扩展的百万级反应，再真实生化反应）加可选 EC 条件与 Molecule Library-Constrained Decoding 生成复杂生物分子。基准测试显示化学模型与酶反应之间存在清晰的 domain gap；VenusRX 在多数评估设置上取得最好或有竞争力的表现，且 EC 信息一致提升反应预测、学到的反应表示又能准确预测 EC 号。
Motivation: 现有反应模型只学分子转化，而酶反应同时依赖分子结构与催化功能；化学模型迁移到酶反应时存在明显 domain gap，源于领域数据有限、催化上下文依赖以及大生物分子结构难建模。
Method: VenusRX-Bench 整合多个生化数据库的反应，做标准化整理、防泄漏划分 (leakage-controlled splits) 与一致评测，覆盖前向反应预测、单步逆合成、EC 号预测；VenusRX 为 T5 式 seq2seq，联合学习前向预测、逆合成与反应重建，两阶段训练（数百万模板扩展反应 → 真实生化反应），可选 EC 条件注入催化上下文，并用 Molecule Library-Constrained Decoding 约束复杂生物分子生成。
Result: 基准对比代表性的化学与酶模型，揭示清晰的 chemical-to-enzymatic domain gap；VenusRX 在多数评估设置与具有挑战性的泛化划分上相对代表性化学与酶基线取得最好或有竞争力的表现；EC 信息一致提升反应预测，学到的反应表示支持准确的 EC 预测。
Conclusion: 酶反应空间中反应结构与催化功能是双向关系：EC 条件帮助生成反应，反应表示也能反推 EC 号；VenusRX-Bench 与 VenusRX 合起来构成刻画并建模酶反应空间的统一框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning?
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models supply reinforcement learning (RL) with priors that mitigate its longstanding weaknesses in sample efficiency and transfer, but their token-by-token generation makes queries sequential and costly. Jev, a recently released decision model, generates nothing and returns calibrated, typed answers in a single forward pass. Existing work studies foundation models in RL either as models to be trained or as generators to be prompted, and Jev belongs to neither category, having so far served only as a black box in single domains. How well such a model decides on its own in RL environments, and how it can improve RL as a component of training, therefore remain unaddressed. To this end, in this paper we first examine the requirements that the objects of an RL system place on the answers they consume, and establish that Jev can fulfill all of them except the cardinal use of a value function. The remaining objects form positions that admit several roles each. We then construct algorithms that employ Jev at three of these positions, as a reference policy, an exploration judge, and a replay rater, to improve sample efficiency, exploration, and learning performance. Across nine MiniGrid tasks and three Atari games, training with Jev outperforms a standard RL learner, including where the learner makes no progress alone, while the model itself remains untrained. To our knowledge, we present the first use of Jev within the RL learning process and establish a frozen decision model as a usable component of RL training, inviting further exploration of how Jev and other advanced decision models can improve RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 决策模型 Jev 不生成 token、单次前向返回校准好的分类型答案，可作为冻结组件嵌入 RL 训练循环，充当参考策略、探索裁判与回放评分器三种角色。在九个 MiniGrid 任务与三款 Atari 游戏中，带 Jev 的训练胜过标准 RL 学习器，包括学习器单独训练毫无进展的设置，而 Jev 本身始终不被训练。
Motivation: 基础模型作为 RL 先验能改善样本效率与迁移，但逐 token 生成使查询串行且昂贵；Jev 此前只在单一领域当黑箱用，它能否自主决策、以及能否作为训练组件改进 RL，此前没有研究。
Method: 先分析 RL 系统各对象对其所消费答案的需求，证明 Jev 除价值函数这一核心用途外均可满足，剩余对象构成可容纳多角色的位置；再在其中三个位置上构造算法，把 Jev 用作参考策略 (reference policy)、探索裁判 (exploration judge) 与回放评分器 (replay rater)，分别改善样本效率、探索与学习性能。
Result: 在九个 MiniGrid 任务和三款 Atari 游戏上，用 Jev 训练胜过标准 RL 学习器，包括学习器单独训练毫无进展的情形；Jev 全程保持冻结不训练。
Conclusion: 冻结的决策模型可以作为 RL 训练的可用组件，这是 Jev 首次进入 RL 学习过程；Jev 不能承担价值函数这一用途。

papers.title: Epistemic Disturbance in the Graph Model for Conflict Resolution: State-Preserving Actions, Four-Valued Assessments, and the Distinction between Capability and Intention
papers.abstract_en: In the graph model for conflict resolution (GMCR), a decision maker (DM) either moves the conflict to another state or does nothing. The basic definitions leave inaction implicit, so every action that leaves the state unchanged is treated as doing nothing. Yet announcements, exercises, leaks and selective disclosures are neither moves nor inaction: they leave the state unchanged but change what other DMs believe about which moves are available and which moves others would want to make. We introduce such state-preserving actions by augmenting states with the DMs' epistemic states: a physical move changes the physical state, a state-preserving action changes only the epistemic state, and inaction is the absence of a transition. Actions generate evidence through observer-specific interpretation maps. Building on a four-valued extension of GMCR from the author's earlier work, which separates evidence for and against, we show that evidence for a move can only enable perceived moves and evidence against can only disable them, that two of the four reduction operators ignore one kind of evidence, and that contradictory assessments are absorbing under monotone accumulation. With the monotonicity of stability in move sets, this fixes the direction in which any action moves a DM's stability judgements and characterizes when actions can enable provocation or deterrence. Capability assessments affect all sanction-based stability concepts, and on the DM's own side also Nash stability, whereas intention assessments affect only sequential stability. Hedging between two candidate types weakly expands or shrinks an observer's sequentially stable set according to how it reads contradiction. In the 1995 DVD format negotiation, general metarationality cannot distinguish its phases, since the computer industry group could always sanction; sequential stability, which asks whether it would, can.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冲突解决图模型 (GMCR) 中引入不改变物理状态、只改变信念的状态保持型行动（公告、演习、泄密），并把四值评估（支持/反对证据）接到稳定性分析上。结果给出方向性定理：支持某行动的证据只能使感知到的可行动集扩大、反对证据只能使其缩小，矛盾评估在单调累积下是吸收态；能力评估影响所有基于制裁的稳定性概念及己方的 Nash 稳定性，意图评估只影响序列稳定性，因此 1995 年 DVD 格式谈判中一般超理性 (GMR) 分不清阶段而序列稳定性 (SEQ) 可以。
Motivation: GMCR 的基本定义把「什么都不做」隐式化，任何不改变状态的行动都被当成不作为，因而无法表示那些不移动冲突却改变其他决策者对可用行动与意图的信念的信号行为。
Method: 把状态扩展为物理状态加决策者的认知状态：物理移动改变物理状态，状态保持型行动只改变认知状态，不作为则是没有转移；行动通过观察者特定的解释映射产生证据，并建立在作者此前的四值 GMCR 扩展（区分支持与反对证据）之上，结合移动集稳定性的单调性刻画行动如何移动稳定性判断。
Result: 证明支持某行动的证据只能使感知到的可行动集扩大、反对证据只能使其缩小；四个归约算子中有两个忽略其中一类证据；矛盾评估在单调累积下是吸收态。能力评估影响全部基于制裁的稳定性概念以及决策者己方的 Nash 稳定性，意图评估只影响序列稳定性；在两个候选类型间对冲会依观察者如何解读矛盾而弱扩张或弱收缩其序列稳定集。1995 年 DVD 格式谈判案例中，一般超理性无法区分谈判阶段（计算机产业集团始终可制裁），序列稳定性可以区分。
Conclusion: 状态保持型行动对稳定性判断的作用方向由证据类型与稳定性概念的单调性固定：能力证据走制裁类与 Nash 路径，意图证据只走序列稳定性路径，因此区分能力与意图是判定行动能否构成挑衅或威慑的关键。

papers.title: HI3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D): Object-specific 3D Asset Generation with High Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-3D generation has become increasingly capable of producing objects that closely resemble the input image, and an outstanding challenge is to reproduce the depicted object itself, including the specific geometry that defines it. Inscriptions, brand marks, and repeated structures are frequently distorted or lost, despite being critical to object identity. We present Hi3D 3.0, an image-to-3D generation system targeting object-specific fidelity, with Twinkle3D as its geometry model for generating watertight triangle meshes at $2048^{3}$ resolution. Twinkle3D advances high-fidelity geometry generation along four dimensions. First, while O-Voxel/FaithC offers high representational precision, it often suffers from poor surface quality and non-watertight geometry. We address both issues while retaining its $2048^{3}$-level precision. Second, we scale diffusion generation to sequences of up to 300K geometric tokens through a redesigned DiT architecture and large-scale distributed training optimizations, reducing training time per step from approximately ten minutes to ten seconds. Third, subsequent refinement cannot fully compensate for errors introduced during initial generation; we therefore strengthen both global shape and local detail in the initial generation stage, and the resulting single-stage model surpasses prior two-stage pipelines with $512^{3}$ refinement. Finally, we introduce a fine-grained image-3D cross-modal interaction mechanism that strengthens correspondence between visual evidence and geometric tokens, improving the recovery of object-specific structures. We evaluate geometric fidelity using alignment metrics derived from silhouettes and normal fields. Hi3D 3.0 outperforms four commercial systems across all reported metrics, recovering 82.1% of inscribed characters at 98.2% precision, compared with 21.7% recall for the strongest competitor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Hi3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D) 是面向物体专属保真度的 image-to-3D 生成系统，其几何模型在 2048^3 分辨率下生成封闭三角网格，铭文、品牌标识等物体身份特征可被恢复而非在生成中丢失。单阶段初始生成强化全局形状与局部细节后超过带 512^3 精化的两阶段流程，最终在全部报告指标上超过四个商业系统：铭文字符恢复率 82.1%、精度 98.2%，最强竞争者召回率仅 21.7%。
Motivation: image-to-3D 已能生成与输入图像相似的物体，但难以复现图像中所绘的特定物体本身；铭文、品牌标识、重复结构这类决定物体身份的几何经常被扭曲或丢失。
Method: Twinkle3D 以 O-Voxel/FaithC 的 2048^3 级表示精度为基础，改进表面质量与非封闭问题；用重新设计的 DiT 架构与大规模分布式训练把扩散生成扩展到最长 300K 几何 token 序列；在初始生成阶段同时强化全局形状与局部细节，取代先生成再精化的两阶段流程；并引入细粒度 image-3D 跨模态交互机制加强视觉证据与几何 token 的对应。
Result: 每步训练时间从约十分钟降到十秒；单阶段模型超过带 512^3 精化的既有两阶段流程；用基于轮廓 (silhouette) 与法向场 (normal fields) 的对齐指标评测，Hi3D 3.0 在全部报告指标上超过四个商业系统，铭文字符恢复 82.1%、精度 98.2%，最强竞争者召回率 21.7%。
Conclusion: 物体专属结构的恢复取决于初始生成阶段的质量与视觉-几何对应，后续精化无法弥补初代误差；把精度、规模、单阶段生成和跨模态交互一起做，image-to-3D 才能保住物体身份特征。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Camera-Noise Residuals for Face-Swap Detection: Redundant, Not Complementary, and Why
papers.abstract_en: Fusing a learned camera-noise fingerprint with an RGB appearance backbone is an appealing route to generator-independent deepfake detection, because the noise residual is grounded in image-formation physics rather than in the texture statistics of a particular generator. We test, on FaceForensics++, whether a Noiseprint++ residual channel carries information \emph{complementary} to an RGB Xception backbone for face-swap detection. A three-model ablation (RGB-only, residual-only, late-fusion) shows that fusion does not improve over RGB alone and that the residual branch alone is near chance. A seven-level bottleneck diagnostic localizes the cause: the noise maps do carry a discriminative signal, but it is statistical---carried by the per-sample first and second moments (mean, variance, energy) of the residual---and the per-sample \texttt{InstanceNorm} layer placed at the noise-branch input, following the TruFor template, standardizes exactly those moments away (five-fold cross-validated AUC drops from $0.747$ to $0.554$). A context-crop control rules out cropping geometry, and two fixed-fusion variants that remove the bottleneck recover the statistical signal yet still fail to beat RGB on every dataset. We conclude that, on this manipulation distribution, the noise residual is redundant with RGB rather than complementary, and we give concrete guidance for practitioners adopting noise-residual fusion for face-swap detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 FaceForensics++ 上检验 Noiseprint++ 噪声残差通道能否为 RGB Xception 骨干提供互补信息，结论是不能：三模型消融显示融合不优于纯 RGB，残差分支单独使用接近随机水平。七层瓶颈诊断定位原因——噪声图的判别信号来自逐样本一阶二阶矩（均值、方差、能量），而噪声分支输入处沿用 TruFor 模板的 InstanceNorm 恰好把这些矩标准化掉，五折交叉验证 AUC 从 0.747 跌到 0.554。
Motivation: 噪声残差基于成像物理、被认为对生成器无关，常被当作 RGB 外观骨干的互补线索引入 deepfake 检测；但其是否真的带来 RGB 之外的信息从未被单独检验。
Method: 在 FaceForensics++ 上做三模型消融（纯 RGB、纯残差、late-fusion），配七层瓶颈诊断逐层定位信息丢失位置；另设 context-crop 对照排除裁剪几何因素，并测试两个移除该瓶颈的固定融合变体。
Result: 融合不优于纯 RGB，残差分支单独接近随机；InstanceNorm 使五折交叉验证 AUC 从 0.747 降至 0.554；context-crop 对照排除裁剪几何；两个移除瓶颈的固定融合变体恢复了统计信号，但在每个数据集上仍未能超过 RGB。
Conclusion: 在该操纵分布上，噪声残差与 RGB 是冗余而非互补；采用噪声残差融合做 face-swap 检测前，应先确认归一化层没有把残差的判别性矩信息抹掉。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 在 FaceForensics++ 上检验 Noiseprint++ 噪声残差通道能否为 RGB Xception 骨干提供互补信息，结论是不能：三模型消融显示融合不优于纯 RGB，残差分支单独使用接近随机水平。七层瓶颈诊断定位原因——噪声图的判别信号来自逐样本一阶二阶矩（均值、方差、能量），而噪声分支输入处沿用 TruFor 模板的 InstanceNorm 恰好把这些矩标准化掉，五折交叉验证 AUC 从 0.747 跌到 0.554。

papers.title: VESSI - VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations
papers.abstract_en: Automated video surveillance analysis has become a critical component of intelligence infrastructures and Law Enforcement agencies. Traditional systems lack the semantic module for comprehensive situational awareness and forensic tasks, limiting their ability to interpret events meaningfully or support post-incident investigations. This slows operational insight and increases the burden on human analysts. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer promising pathways to bridge this gap. To address this, we propose VLM-Enhanced Support for Surveillance and Investigations (VESSI), a VLM-based framework designed to enhance automated video surveillance analysis through prompt-driven interrogation of video sequences where salient visual features are converted into textual descriptions. We test our framework with four state-of-the-art models. Since most datasets for this task are unlabeled, we also propose the Composite Model Utility Score (CMUS) to assess VLM performance. Experimental results show that our solution substantially improves the analysis capabilities of human operators and enhances the flexibility of automated surveillance systems. In our evaluation, the most reliable model flagged potentially relevant activity in more than 66% of the videos while reducing review time by more than 85%, offering a practical balance between selectivity and efficiency. The model ordering produced by the reference-free CMUS evaluation was reproduced by the normal-video CMUS evaluation and matched the false-positive-rate ordering obtained from 5,909 manually referenced frames. This agreement supports the operational use of the score within the evaluated setting.
papers.comment: 12-page main manuscript, 3 main figures; supplementary material included
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Early Signatures of Memorization in Diffusion Models via Basin Geometry and Cyclic Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generalize early in training and later reproduce individual training samples. Standard tests detect memorization only once one-shot generation produces near-copies, leaving a released model unaudited until its outputs fail. We show that memorization is encoded in the geometry of the learned energy landscape before it appears in generated samples, a state we call latent memorization. Using score divergence and basin volume, we find that localized basins form around training samples and separate them from held-out samples before the first memorized sample appears, with an onset that follows the same $O(n)$ scaling as the memorization time. We probe these basins with cyclic denoising, which repeatedly applies partial noising and denoising. Under the exact empirical score, we prove that cycling started near an isolated training sample recovers it and returns to it over any finite number of cycles with high probability. In trained models, cycling recovers training images from CelebA and CIFAR-10 checkpoints whose one-shot samples contain no copies, and at a CelebA checkpoint with 0.1% one-shot copies, 500 cycles raise the memorized fraction above 30%. Cycling also reveals degenerate attractors that match no single training image and fade as training proceeds, so residence in a basin does not by itself imply memorization. These findings hold on a Gaussian mixture, CelebA, and CIFAR-10 across optimizers, architectures, noise schedules, and training-set sizes, and extend to off-the-shelf Stable Diffusion v1.4, where the cycled conditional-unconditional divergence gap separates memorized from non-memorized prompts with an AUC of 0.944 and a TPR of 0.866 at 1% FPR. More broadly, what a diffusion model has memorized is a property of the geometry and stability of its learned distribution, and assessing it requires examining this structure rather than generated outputs alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 扩散模型的记忆在生成样本出现近似复制之前就已写入学到的能量景观几何（latent memorization）：score divergence 与 basin volume 显示训练样本周围先形成孤立局部 basin，其出现时刻遵循与记忆时间相同的 O(n) 标度。cyclic denoising（反复部分加噪-去噪）能在 one-shot 样本无复制的 CelebA/CIFAR-10 checkpoint 中恢复训练图像；在 one-shot 复制率 0.1% 的 CelebA checkpoint 上，500 次循环把记忆比例推到 30% 以上。
Motivation: 标准记忆检测要等 one-shot 生成出近似复制才报警，此时已发布模型无法审计；需要在输出暴露之前判定模型记住了什么。
Method: 用 score divergence 与 basin volume 刻画学到能量景观中围绕训练样本的局部 basin，并提出 cyclic denoising（反复部分加噪与去噪）作为探测手段；在精确经验 score 下证明从孤立训练样本附近启动的循环以高概率恢复并返回该样本。实验覆盖 Gaussian mixture、CelebA、CIFAR-10，跨优化器、架构、噪声调度与训练集规模，并扩展到现成 Stable Diffusion v1.4。
Result: basin 出现时刻服从与记忆时间相同的 O(n) 标度；在 one-shot 无复制的 CelebA/CIFAR-10 checkpoint 上循环可恢复训练图像；CelebA 某 checkpoint one-shot 复制率 0.1% 时，500 次循环使记忆比例升至 30% 以上。Stable Diffusion v1.4 上循环得到的 conditional-unconditional divergence gap 区分记忆与非记忆 prompt，AUC 0.944，1% FPR 下 TPR 0.866。循环还暴露与任何单张训练图像都不匹配、且随训练推进而消退的退化吸引子。
Conclusion: 扩散模型记住了什么由学到分布的几何与稳定性决定，记忆审计必须检查景观结构而非只看生成输出；但停留在 basin 内本身并不等同于记忆，因为退化吸引子同样会造成驻留。

papers.title: Perceptually Grounded and Semantics-Aware Evaluation for Holistic Co-Speech Gesture Generation
papers.abstract_en: Holistic and semantics-aware co-speech gesture generation has advanced rapidly, yet evaluation remains behind: objective metrics do not consistently reflect human perception, and semantic appropriateness remains difficult to quantify. We present a perceptually grounded and semantics-aware benchmark that combines standardized model comparison, human-centered metric validation, and fine-grained semantic evaluation. We first curate a list of 13 objective metrics covering different aspects, including distributional similarity, geometric fidelity, kinematic quality, cross-modal synchrony, and semantic appropriateness. For the semantic-appropriateness category, we propose a new metric, Semantic Gesture Preservation (SGP), which measures how far semantic gestures in the ground truth are preserved in the generated gestures. For this, we augment the BEAT2 dataset's annotations using a multi-modal LLM. We then conduct a perceptual study where 101 participants score generated gestures among five dimensions, including human-likeness, motion diversity, absence of animation errors, speech timing and content match. We systematically analyze objective metric--subjective score correlations. Unlike Semantic Score (SC), which shows no significant association with the evaluated perceptual dimensions, SGP is selectively aligned with speech-aware human judgments. We construct five target-specific composite metrics aligned with the subjective dimensions. These composites improve perceptual alignment across all five dimensions, with the largest gains for absence of animation errors and content match, indicating that complementary objective signals can better approximate human judgments than individual metrics alone. Overall, our results show that objective metrics require validation against subjective evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对协同语音手势 (co-speech gesture) 生成中客观指标与人类感知脱节、语义适切性难量化的问题，提出感知落地且语义感知的评测基准：整理 13 个客观指标，新增 Semantic Gesture Preservation (SGP) 并用多模态 LLM 增强 BEAT2 标注。101 人参与的感知研究显示，SGP 与语音感知判断选择性对齐，而 Semantic Score (SC) 与五个感知维度均无显著关联；五个面向具体维度的复合指标在全部五个维度上提升感知对齐，动画错误缺失与内容匹配提升最大。
Motivation: 协同语音手势生成进展快，但客观指标不能稳定反映人类感知，语义适切性也难以量化，导致模型比较与优化缺少可信评测信号。
Method: 整理覆盖分布相似性、几何保真度、运动学质量、跨模态同步与语义适切性的 13 个客观指标；为语义适切性提出 SGP，度量真值语义手势在生成结果中的保留程度，并用多模态 LLM 增强 BEAT2 数据集标注；开展 101 名参与者的感知研究，对 human-likeness、motion diversity、动画错误缺失、语音时序、内容匹配五个维度打分，系统分析客观指标与主观分数的相关性，并构建五个面向具体维度的复合指标。
Result: 13 个客观指标、5 个感知维度、101 名参与者；SC 与所评估感知维度无显著关联，SGP 与语音感知判断选择性对齐；五个复合指标在全部五个维度上提升感知对齐，其中动画错误缺失与内容匹配提升最大。
Conclusion: 客观指标必须先用主观评测校验才能用于手势生成模型比较；互补的客观信号组合比单一指标更能逼近人类判断。

papers.title: $σ$Transfer: Uncertainty Transfer from Small to Large Networks under $μ\mathrm{P}$
papers.abstract_en: Reliable predictive uncertainty in Laplace approximations depends critically on the prior precision, yet selecting it requires a posterior sweep that is prohibitively expensive for neural networks with billions of parameters. Under the Maximal Update Parametrization ($μ\mathrm{P}$), we derive a rescaling of the prior covariance that makes the selected precision stable as model width grows. This leads to $σ\mathrm{Transfer}$: we select the precision on a smaller model and zero-shot transfer it to the much larger model, i.e., without searching for the precision on the larger model at all. We show convergence of the prior kernel, posterior covariance, selected precision, and posterior-derived decisions under explicit conditions, and verify $σ\mathrm{Transfer}$ across regression, image classification, and Transformer readouts. For example, measured precision-sweep speedups reach $\sim 5000\times$ when transferring from width 128 to 4096 on MNIST, at a target-NLL degradation of $0.002$; transferring from a public 1B to 7B model gives a median search speedup of $\sim 2.3\times$ (up to $\sim 330\times$), with a mean measured target-NLL increase below $10^{-4}$ across ten tasks. The same posterior stability also enables transfer of acquisition, OOD-detection, and abstention decisions without constructing a target posterior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 μP 参数化下推导先验协方差的重标定，使 Laplace 近似所选的 prior precision 随模型宽度增长保持稳定，从而在小模型上选好精度后零样本迁移到大模型，完全跳过对大模型的精度扫描。MNIST 上从宽度 128 迁到 4096 的精度扫描加速约 5000×，目标 NLL 仅退化 0.002；1B 迁 7B 模型在十个任务上中位加速约 2.3×（最高约 33×），目标 NLL 平均增量低于 10⁻⁴。
Motivation: Laplace 近似的预测不确定性高度依赖 prior precision，但选它需要对模型做精度扫描，对数十亿参数的神经网络代价过高。
Method: 在 Maximal Update Parametrization (μP) 下推导先验协方差的重标定式，使所选精度对宽度稳定；在小模型上扫描选定精度后零样本转移到大模型，并给出先验核、后验协方差、所选精度与后验决策收敛的显式条件，在回归、图像分类与 Transformer readout 上验证。
Result: MNIST 上从宽度 128 转移到 4096 的精度扫描加速约 5000×，目标 NLL 退化 0.002；从公开 1B 模型转移到 7B 模型，十个任务上中位搜索加速约 2.3×、最高约 33×，目标 NLL 平均增量低于 10⁻⁴。
Conclusion: μP 下的后验稳定性使精度与 acquisition、OOD 检测、abstention 决策都能在不构造目标后验的情况下从小模型迁移到大模型。

papers.title: Autoregressive Retriever: Improving Query Understanding from Item Feedback for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Universal multimodal retrieval typically encodes a query once and ranks independently indexed items by embedding similarity. This design supports efficient search, but leaves the query representation unchanged even when retrieved items could help clarify the information need. We introduce the AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR), a multimodal retrieval model that learns both to select informative items and to use their content to refine subsequent retrieval. ARR alternates between retrieving an item and updating the query embedding, then uses the final embedding to rank the collection. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the encoder to use feedback through stepwise contrastive supervision. Reinforcement learning treats feedback items as actions and optimizes their selection using the final reciprocal rank of a relevant item. A query-side adapter enables this optimization against a fixed item index. ARR demonstrates strong retrieval performance on both in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, outperforming the compared baselines on average. Further analyses show that feedback improves retrieval at inference time and that training with feedback also improves the initial query embedding, before any item is observed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARR 打破一次编码、独立排序的通用多模态检索范式：检索一个 item 后用其内容更新 query embedding，再继续检索，最终用收敛后的 embedding 对整个集合排序。训练分两段——stepwise contrastive supervision 的监督微调，以及以相关 item 的最终 reciprocal rank 为奖励、把反馈 item 当作 action 的强化学习，配合 query-side adapter 在固定 item 索引上优化。在 in-domain 与 zero-shot 基准上平均超过所比较的基线，且反馈既提升推理时检索，也在未观察任何 item 前就改善初始 query embedding。
Motivation: 通用多模态检索通常只编码一次 query、按 embedding 相似度独立排序，query 表示在检索过程中不再变化，而已检索到的 item 本可以澄清真实信息需求。
Method: AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR) 交替执行「检索一个 item」与「更新 query embedding」，最后用最终 embedding 排序集合。监督微调通过 stepwise contrastive supervision 教编码器利用反馈；强化学习把反馈 item 当作 action，用相关 item 的最终 reciprocal rank 优化选择，并用 query-side adapter 在固定 item 索引上完成该优化。
Result: 在 in-domain 与 zero-shot 两类检索基准上平均优于所比较的基线；进一步分析显示推理时使用反馈能改善检索，而带反馈的训练也在任何 item 被观察之前就改善了初始 query embedding。
Conclusion: 让检索过程迭代改写 query 表示、并用最终排序信号训练 item 选择，是提升通用多模态检索的有效路径，且收益同时体现在初始 query 编码与后续反馈利用上。

papers.title: Evi-VN: Hard Region Guided Virtual Node Evidence Injection for GNN-Based Fraud Detection
papers.abstract_en: Online platforms contain growing numbers of bots, deceptive reviewers, and scam accounts that imitate legitimate users. Such camouflage blurs graph neighborhoods and behavioral attributes, making it difficult for graph neural networks (GNNs) to distinguish both well-disguised fraudsters and legitimate users. Across diverse GNNs, we observe overlapping errors on a shared hard region, suggesting the presence of latent fraud evidence that graph topologies and standard features fail to capture. Fraud-specific GNNs can mitigate particular graph pathologies, yet they still make limited use of heterogeneous evidence such as structured records, text, images, and audio; uniform multimodal fusion may also disturb nodes already handled reliably by the graph. We propose Evi-VN to learn and correct these shared blind spots rather than build another fraud detector. To our knowledge, Evi-VN is the first graph fraud detection framework to use feature isolated evidence chains to correct hard regions shared across GNNs. Its evidence chains connect behavior, content, and context across structured, textual, visual, and acoustic sources, helping expose camouflage that graph neighborhoods may miss. Crucially, Evi-VN selectively applies this evidence only to likely hard samples via virtual class nodes, preserving both the reliable predictions and the input design of existing GNNs. Shared hard regions also let Evi-VN enhance generic, fraud-specific, and unseen GNNs even with imperfect evidence models. Experiments across bot, fake-review, refund-evidence, and telecom-fraud tasks validate these advantages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Evi-VN 不另训欺诈检测器，而是学习多个 GNN 共享的错误盲区（hard region），用特征隔离的证据链（structured/textual/visual/acoustic 四源）经虚拟类节点选择性注入，只纠正疑似难样本，保留已有 GNN 的可靠预测与输入设计。在 bot、假评论、退款凭证、电信欺诈四类任务上验证其对通用、欺诈专用及未见 GNN 的增强效果。
Motivation: 伪装账号模糊图邻域与行为属性，导致 GNN 对高伪装欺诈者与正常用户都判错；不同 GNN 在同一 hard region 上重叠出错，说明图拓扑与常规特征抓不到潜在欺诈证据，而现有欺诈专用 GNN 对异构证据利用不足、均匀多模态融合还会扰动本已判对的节点。
Method: Evi-VN 先跨多种 GNN 定位共享 hard region，再构建特征隔离的证据链，把行为、内容、上下文跨结构化记录、文本、图像、音频四类来源连接起来；随后通过虚拟类节点 (virtual class nodes) 把证据选择性注入疑似难样本，不改动现有 GNN 的输入设计。
Result: 在 bot 检测、假评论、退款凭证 (refund-evidence) 与电信欺诈四类任务上的实验验证了这些优势：Evi-VN 能增强通用 GNN、欺诈专用 GNN 与未见 GNN，即使证据模型不完美也有效。
Conclusion: 与其再造一个欺诈检测器，不如把跨 GNN 的共享盲区当作纠正对象，用选择性证据注入同时保住可靠预测与原 GNN 架构。

papers.title: Constrained Command-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Bandit Strategy Selection in Real-Time Strategy Games
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning agents reach strong performance in real-time strategy games but can be brittle against opponents outside their training distribution. Separating strategic command selection from learned unit control allows different strategies to be selected for different opponents while reusing the same execution policy. This requires an executor that can follow different commands and measurable criteria for assessing whether it does so. We introduce a constrained command-conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy, the executor, for MicroRTS, a real-time strategy environment. Discrete commands specify strategic objectives and behavioral requirements for economy, army composition, military posture, and worker policy over multiple environment steps; the executor determines the unit-level actions used to fulfill them. A Thompson-sampling bandit acts as the strategist, selecting command tuples from an estimate of the opponent's strategy built from in-game observations rather than opponent identity. In a controlled comparison with a flat PPO baseline trained with the same architecture, budget, curriculum and self-play league, the strategist-executor system wins significantly more often against three of the four strongest opponents on a training map, including the two strongest held-out ones (0.55 to 0.97 and 0.01 to 0.34), with no significant difference against the others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 RTS 游戏中的战略指令选择与单位控制分离：约束式指令条件 PPO 执行器按离散指令（经济、兵种构成、军事姿态、工人策略）控制单位，Thompson 采样 bandit 根据局内观测估计的对手策略挑选指令元组。在 MicroRTS 同架构、同预算、同课程与自博弈联赛的对照中，对四个最强对手中的三个胜率显著提升，含两个最强的留出对手（0.55→0.97、0.01→0.34），其余对手无显著差异。
Motivation: 深度 RL 智能体在 RTS 游戏中表现强但对训练分布外的对手脆弱；需要把战略选择与执行解耦，使同一执行策略可针对不同对手切换战略，并要有可度量的标准判断执行器是否真的遵循了指令。
Method: 提出约束式指令条件 PPO 执行器（constrained command-conditioned PPO）用于 MicroRTS：离散指令规定跨多个环境步的经济、兵种构成、军事姿态与工人策略目标，执行器决定满足指令的单位级动作；战略层用 Thompson 采样 bandit，从局内观测而非对手身份估计对手策略并选择指令元组。对照组为同架构、同预算、同课程、同自博弈联赛训练的 flat PPO 基线。
Result: 在训练地图上，strategist-executor 系统对四个最强对手中的三个胜率显著更高，包括两个最强的留出对手：胜率从 0.55 提到 0.97、从 0.01 提到 0.34；对其余对手无显著差异。
Conclusion: 把战略指令选择交给基于对手观测的 bandit、把执行交给统一的指令条件策略，能在训练分布外对手上显著提高胜率，而对部分对手不产生显著差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lamarck's Driving School: Discovering Autonomous Driving Training Strategies through Evolutionary Competition
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving capabilities depend strongly on the distribution of scenarios encountered during training. Existing methods commonly construct or dynamically adapt training scenario distributions using surrogate criteria such as realism, difficulty, or risk. However, these predefined surrogates may misrepresent training value, leading to inefficient use of training resources. To address this limitation, we propose a Lamarckian evolutionary framework that replaces surrogate-based guidance with competition among candidate distributions. We formulate training strategy discovery as a multi-stage bilevel optimization problem and use Lamarckian evolution algorithm to approximate its solution. At the outer level, Darwinian crossover, mutation, and selection explore the scenario distribution space; at the inner level, policy learning acquires new capabilities, and Lamarckian inheritance transfers them to subsequent stages, allowing scenario distributions and policy capabilities to co-evolve. The resulting evolutionary trajectories reveal recurring stage-wise regularities among high-value distributions, characterized by capability accumulation through stage-wise challenge rotation. We further distill these regularities into a lightweight, reusable Lamarckian Training Strategy. Experiments show that, compared with the baseline, the complete framework reduces performance loss by up to 25.07%, while the lightweight strategy still achieves a 19.13% reduction. These results demonstrate that evolutionary competition can both discover effective training strategies and reveal reusable stage-wise patterns in how the value of training distributions changes with policy capability. Code is available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用拉马克进化替代基于真实性/难度/风险等代理指标的场景分布构造，把自动驾驶训练策略发现写成多阶段双层优化：外层对场景分布做交叉、变异、选择，内层策略学习后经拉马克遗传把能力传给后续阶段，使分布与能力共同演化。与基线相比完整框架最多降低 25.07% 的性能损失，蒸馏出的轻量 Lamarckian Training Strategy 仍降低 19.13%。
Motivation: 自动驾驶训练场景分布通常靠真实性、难度、风险等预定义代理准则构造或自适应调整，这些准则可能误判训练价值，导致训练资源被低效使用。
Method: 将训练策略发现形式化为多阶段双层优化，用 Lamarckian evolution algorithm 近似求解：外层 Darwinian 交叉、变异、选择探索场景分布空间，内层 policy learning 获取新能力并通过 Lamarckian inheritance 传递到后续阶段；再从高价值分布的演化轨迹中蒸馏出可复用的轻量 Lamarckian Training Strategy。
Result: 与基线相比，完整框架最多减少 25.07% 的性能损失，轻量策略仍带来 19.13% 的性能损失下降；演化轨迹显示高价值分布呈现逐阶段挑战轮换带来的能力累积规律。
Conclusion: 进化竞争既能自动发现有效的训练策略，也能揭示训练分布价值随策略能力变化的可复用逐阶段模式，从而绕开预定义代理准则。

papers.title: DIAL-OPD: Learning More from Fewer Tokens in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated trajectories with token-level teacher signals. Its sampled-token variant avoids the cost of full-vocabulary probabilities. Yet we find that training on fewer tokens can outperform full-token OPD, challenging the intuition that more supervision improves learning. This motivates selecting tokens by learning value. Existing disagreement-based criteria ignore probability scale: tokens assigned negligible probability by both models, termed low-low tokens, can receive large log-ratio rewards and hinder learning. We propose DIAL-OPD, a token-selection method that bridges log-probability and probability spaces by weighting reward magnitude with the logarithmic mean of teacher and student probabilities. A parameter beta controls this weighting, and the highest-scoring tokens are retained. Across 4 teacher-student pairs and 7 mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we compare DIAL-OPD with 9 baselines. Retaining only 40% of tokens, it outperforms Vanilla OPD and its full-token variants, with mean accuracy gains reaching 5.25 percentage points over Vanilla OPD, and doubles AIME25 Pass@16 from 13.33% to 26.67%. It also achieves up to an 18% relative improvement in mean accuracy over the strongest token-selection baseline at matched retention ratios. With a 4B teacher, DIAL-OPD surpasses the strongest full-token baseline using an 8B teacher at both student scales, showing that effective supervision allocation can outweigh teacher scaling. Further analysis shows that moderate beta balances suppressing low-low tokens against preserving useful disagreements. Token-level evidence reveals that DIAL-OPD filters high-reward tokens with limited reasoning value while preserving supervision critical to reasoning correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DIAL-OPD 在 on-policy distillation 中按学习价值筛选监督 token：用教师与学生概率的对数均值 (logarithmic mean) 加权 log-ratio 奖励，参数 β 控制权重，只保留得分最高的 token，从而压低 low-low token（两模型都给极低概率却拿到大奖励）的干扰。在 4 组师生对、7 个数学推理基准上仅保留 40% token 即超过 Vanilla OPD 及其全 token 变体，平均准确率最高高出 5.25 个百分点，AIME25 Pass@16 从 13.33% 翻倍到 26.67%。
Motivation: On-policy distillation 的 sampled-token 变体虽省去全词表概率计算，但「监督越多学得越好」的直觉并不成立；现有基于分歧的选 token 标准忽略概率尺度，两模型都赋予极低概率的 low-low token 反而拿到大 log-ratio 奖励，拖累学习。
Method: DIAL-OPD 在 log 概率空间与概率空间之间做桥接：用教师与学生概率的对数均值加权奖励幅度，超参数 β 控制该权重，对每个 token 打分后只保留得分最高的部分（如 40% 保留率）；与 9 个基线在 4 组师生对上比较。
Result: 保留 40% token 时超过 Vanilla OPD 及其全 token 变体，平均准确率相对 Vanilla OPD 最高提升 5.25 个百分点；AIME25 Pass@16 从 13.33% 提到 26.67%；在相同保留率下相对最强选 token 基线平均准确率最高提升 18%；用 4B 教师在两个学生规模上均超过用 8B 教师的最强全 token 基线。分析显示中等 β 在抑制 low-low token 与保留有用分歧之间取得平衡。
Conclusion: 有效分配监督比放大教师规模更关键：按学习价值筛选 token，用更小的教师和更少的 token 就能超过全 token 蒸馏与更大教师的组合。

papers.title: DisFace3DNet: Explainable Facial Attractiveness Prediction via 3D Component Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: Facial attractiveness prediction usually assigns one overall rating, leaving the roles of shape, appearance, and viewing conditions implicit. We propose DisFace3DNet, which uses 3D component disentanglement to learn seven component reference scores from overall ratings with auxiliary weak semantic supervision, without human-labeled component targets. Designated 3D representations and image cues feed jointly learned routes for identity, skin, hair, light, background, expression, and pose. A constrained fit then combines five static and two signed dynamic scores into the overall rating, exposing each component's numerical contribution and supporting component-specific comparisons across images. On SCUT-FBP5500, DisFace3DNet achieves a Pearson correlation of $0.8904\pm0.0063$ (mean $\pm$ standard deviation across five folds) with average human ratings; its component terms reconstruct every held-out prediction to numerical precision. Skin, hair, and facial shape account for the largest component-wise prediction variation. Human evaluation supports the score directions for facial shape, skin, and hair; expression agreement is weaker. DisFace3DNet thus connects overall prediction to quantitative analysis of the facial and contextual cues entering each estimate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DisFace3DNet 用 3D component disentanglement 从整体颜值评分中拆出七个成分参考分（identity、skin、hair、light、background、expression、pose），无需人工标注成分目标，再用受约束拟合把五个静态分与两个带符号动态分合成总分，从而给出每个成分的数值贡献。在 SCUT-FBP5500 五折上与人类平均评分的 Pearson 相关为 0.8904±0.0063，成分项可把每个留出预测重建到数值精度。
Motivation: 面部吸引力预测通常只输出一个总分，形状、外观与观看条件各自的作用是隐式的，无法做成分级比较或解释单张图的预测来源。
Method: 以指定的 3D 表征与图像线索分别驱动 identity、skin、hair、light、background、expression、pose 七条联合学习的通路，用辅助弱语义监督从整体评分学出七个成分参考分（无成分级人工标签）；再用受约束拟合把五个静态分与两个带符号动态分组合成整体评分，暴露各成分的数值贡献。
Result: 在 SCUT-FBP5500 上，与人类平均评分的 Pearson 相关为 0.8904±0.0063（五折均值±标准差）；成分项可把每个留出预测重建到数值精度。成分级变化中 skin、hair 与面部形状贡献最大；人类评估支持 facial shape、skin、hair 的分数方向，expression 的一致性较弱。
Conclusion: 整体颜值预测可以被分解为可审计的成分贡献，其中 skin、hair、形状主导变化，而 expression 的方向与人类判断一致性不足。
