papers.title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
papers.abstract_en: Improving a long-horizon LLM agent means evolving the harness around a frozen model or training its weights. We let a self-evolving harness make the system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. We show that the right lever can be read off the agent's failure composition: labelling failed trajectories by the first signal that fires separates process failures (blocked calls, loops, exhausted step budgets) from content failures (a delivered plan that is poor). Harness evolution repairs the former, the behaviour it instils can be trained into the weights, and content failures are what weight training is for. On DeepPlanning, a self-evolving harness loop lifts the held-out score of Qwen3.5-4B from 0.16 to 0.30 and of Qwen3.5-9B from 0.32 to 0.44; for 4B, held-out delivery rises from 55% to 90% while content failures are left for the weights. LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories internalise the gain: under the original harness they add +0.13 on held-out tasks for both sizes; on 4B they stack with the harness to more than double the held-out score, and on 9B the adapter alone matches the full evolution line, cutting content failures from a quarter of trajectories to one in twenty. A placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls below the base model. The loop transfers to WebArena-Lite (+0.09 on 117 unseen tasks), where the gain lives in what the model sees and adapters do not add to it. The result is a diagnose-then-intervene rule applied twice: read the failure composition to choose between harness and weights, then read what the accepted edits changed to decide which gains to train in. Scores are four-rollout means against fresh anchors, same-night except where marked, across eight models from six families and two benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长时程 LLM agent，先用自演化 harness 提升冻结模型，再把演化轨迹上的 LoRA 训进权重，得到「先诊断失败构成、再选干预杠杆」的规则：过程失败（阻塞调用、循环、步数预算耗尽）由 harness 修复且可被训练内化，内容失败（交付方案质量差）才交给权重训练。在 DeepPlanning 上自演化 harness 把 Qwen3.5-4B 留出分数从 0.16 提到 0.30、9B 从 0.32 提到 0.44；LoRA 在原 harness 下对两种规模均再加 +0.13。
Motivation: 改进长时程 LLM agent 有两条路：演化模型外的 harness，或训练模型权重，但何时该切换、哪些增益能被权重保留并不清楚，缺少可操作的判据。
Method: 先让自演化 harness 在冻结模型上提升系统，再把多个 seed 的演化 harness 与 base/训练权重交叉组合；按「最先触发的信号」给失败轨迹打标，区分过程失败与内容失败；在演化 harness 轨迹上训练 LoRA adapter，并用 answer-shuffled 轨迹训练的 placebo adapter 作对照，评分取四次 rollout 均值、对新 anchor、同夜进行，覆盖六个模型家族共八个模型与两个 benchmark。
Result: DeepPlanning 上自演化 harness 使 Qwen3.5-4B 留出分数 0.16→0.30、9B 0.32→0.44；4B 留出交付率 55%→90%。LoRA 在原 harness 下对 4B 与 9B 均 +0.13；4B 上 adapter 与 harness 叠加使留出分数翻倍以上，9B 上仅 adapter 即追平完整演化线，内容失败从四分之一轨迹降到二十分之一。placebo adapter 低于 base 模型。迁移到 WebArena-Lite 的 117 个未见任务上 +0.09，但增益来自模型所见、adapter 不再叠加。
Conclusion: 先读失败构成选杠杆（过程失败走 harness、内容失败走权重），再读被采纳的编辑改了什么决定哪些增益该训练内化；WebArena-Lite 上增益存在于 harness 侧，权重训练不再叠加。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tabula Rasa: Monte Carlo estimation of unit-variance noise with controlled spatio-temporal correlation
papers.abstract_en: We suggest a method to generate time-varying Gaussian noise with controlled variance and controlled temporal correlation. This noise is used in several downstream tasks for temporal control and temporal coherence. The core technical idea is to phrase this problem as joint Monte-Carlo estimation of both a classic pixel reconstruction and estimation of variance using the concept of "sketching" from the database literature. We demonstrate that our method allows temporal control for downstream tasks with simpler and faster code than previous methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Tabula Rasa：把时变高斯噪声的生成写成像素重建与方差的联合 Monte Carlo 估计，并借用数据库文献中的 sketching 概念控制时空相关结构。该噪声用于下游任务的时间控制与时间一致性，作者称其代码比以往方法更简单、更快。
Motivation: 需要方差可控、时间相关可控的时变高斯噪声来做下游任务的时间控制与时间一致性，而既有生成方式在控制粒度与实现复杂度上不理想。
Method: 核心是把问题表述为联合 Monte Carlo 估计：同时估计经典像素重建与方差，并引入数据库文献的 sketching 概念来控制时空相关；输出方差与时间相关均可控的时变高斯噪声。
Result: 在若干下游任务上展示时间控制与时间一致性，作者报告该方法比以往方法代码更简单、运行更快；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把噪声生成转成带 sketching 的联合 Monte Carlo 估计，可以在保持方差与时间相关可控的同时简化实现并提速。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture for Expertise-Adaptive Qualitative Interviews Using Local LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Automated interviewers and conversational agents are increasingly used in research, recruitment, customer service, and education. However, many existing systems rely on fixed question sequences and provide limited context-based personalization without considering participants' knowledge, which can lead to repetitive or irrelevant follow-up questions. Therefore, there is a need for an adaptive interviewing system that can adjust question depth while maintaining conversational continuity and semantic progression. To address this, an Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture is presented using a locally hosted Large Language Model (LLM), with the interview continuously adapted throughout the entire conversation based on the participant's responses and evolving context. The interviewer profiles participants' expertise in real time to generate knowledge-appropriate questions, well-articulated responses, and smooth transition messages that support conversational continuity. A five-module prompt-driven architecture and persistent interview-state record support these functions. The interviewer was evaluated with 246 participants. Expertise Profiling module (M3) showed 78.9% exact agreement with independently reported participant expertise, with a weighted Cohen's K of 0.80. Generate Iterative Questions module (M4) showed a strong expertise-complexity association (p=.79, p<.001), and participants reported high relevance (mean 4.41), engagement (mean 4.32), and satisfaction (mean 4.38), providing evidence that the architecture's adaptive components operated consistently with their intended functions while participants reported a positive interview experience.
papers.comment: Accepted to be part of the book titled: AI in Education : Pedagogy, Ethics, and Society which will be published by Springer Nature in the Book series: Transactions on Computational Science and Computational Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出证据可追溯的动态面试官架构 (Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture)，用本地部署 LLM 和五模块提示链加持久面试状态记录，全程按受访者回答实时画像其专业水平并生成难度匹配的问题与过渡语。246 名参与者评估中，专业画像模块 M3 与独立自报专业度完全一致率 78.9%、加权 Cohen's K=0.80，问题生成模块 M4 的专业度-复杂度关联 p=.79（p<.001），参与者相关性、参与度、满意度均值分别为 4.41、4.32、4.38。
Motivation: 现有自动面试与对话系统多用固定问题序列，只做有限的上下文个性化而不考虑参与者知识水平，导致追问重复或不相关，缺少既能调节问题深度又能保持对话连续性与语义递进的自适应机制。
Method: 采用五模块提示驱动架构加持久面试状态记录 (persistent interview-state record)，由本地托管 LLM 运行：M3 Expertise Profiling 实时画像参与者专业水平，M4 Generate Iterative Questions 依据画像生成知识匹配的问题、表述与过渡消息，全对话持续更新上下文；以 246 名参与者进行评估，对照独立自报的专业度与参与者问卷。
Result: 在 246 名参与者的评估中，M3 与独立自报专业度完全一致率 78.9%，加权 Cohen's K=0.80；M4 呈现显著的专业度-复杂度关联（p=.79，p<.001）；参与者自评相关性均值 4.41、参与度 4.32、满意度 4.38。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明架构的自适应组件按其预期功能一致运作，且参与者报告了积极的面试体验；本地 LLM 加状态记录足以支撑按专业度调节深度的连续追问。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 采用五模块提示驱动架构加持久面试状态记录 (persistent interview-state record)，由本地托管 LLM 运行：M3 Expertise Profiling 实时画像参与者专业水平，M4 Generate Iterative Questions 依据画像生成知识匹配的问题、表述与过渡消息，全对话持续更新上下文；以 246 名参与者进行评估，对照独立自报的专业度与参与者问卷。
summary_sections.result: 在 246 名参与者的评估中，M3 与独立自报专业度完全一致率 78.9%，加权 Cohen's K=0.80；M4 呈现显著的专业度-复杂度关联（p=.79，p<.001）；参与者自评相关性均值 4.41、参与度 4.32、满意度 4.38。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明架构的自适应组件按其预期功能一致运作，且参与者报告了积极的面试体验；本地 LLM 加状态记录足以支撑按专业度调节深度的连续追问。

papers.title: SkillContrast: Difference-Guided Text Selection for Agent Skill Reranking
papers.abstract_en: Similar agent skills can share instructions but differ in their conditions of use. Query-based text selection may retain shared instructions and omit these distinctions. We introduce SkillContrast, a training-free selector that compares retrieved skills and retains their differing text with local context for a pretrained reranker. On 1,235 requests from SameCapRisk-Bench, it yields 54-72 more clean hits (requests that retrieve a helpful skill without its marked risky sibling) than TF-IDF query selection at identical per-candidate input lengths, across 2 retrievers and 2 reranker sizes. Length-matched component replacements identify differing text as the main contributor in the primary setting, with smaller, mixed context effects. Relative to full skill bodies, SkillContrast uses 51.1-58.8% fewer model-input tokens, with 10-18 fewer clean hits at 0.6B and matching or higher observed clean-hit counts at 4B. Candidate-relative differences thus complement query relevance in selecting compact reranking inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillContrast 是一个免训练的 agent skill 重排输入选择器：不按 query 相关性挑文本，而是对比检索到的相似 skill、保留它们彼此不同的文本段及其局部上下文，喂给预训练 reranker。在 SameCapRisk-Bench 的 1,235 条请求上，同等候选输入长度下比 TF-IDF query selection 多出 54–72 个 clean hits，且相对完整 skill 正文少用 51.1–58.8% 的模型输入 token。
Motivation: 相似 agent skill 常共享指令但适用条件不同，按 query 相关性做文本选择会保留共享部分、丢掉区分这些 skill 的差异文本，导致重排输入无法分辨有帮助的 skill 与其有风险的近邻。
Method: 训练-free 的候选相对对比选择器：对检索到的 skills 逐对比较，抽取彼此不同的文本并附带局部上下文，作为预训练 reranker 的输入；用长度匹配的组件替换 (length-matched component replacements) 做消融，分离差异文本与上下文各自的贡献。
Result: 在 SameCapRisk-Bench 1,235 条请求、2 种 retriever × 2 种 reranker 规模 (0.6B 与 4B) 下，同等每候选输入长度时比 TF-IDF query selection 多 54–72 个 clean hits（检索到有帮助 skill 且不带其被标记的有风险同级 skill）。长度匹配替换显示差异文本是主设定下的主要贡献，上下文效应较小且方向不一。相对完整 skill 正文少用 51.1–58.8% 模型输入 token：0.6B 上 clean hits 少 10–18 个，4B 上持平或更高。
Conclusion: 候选相对差异 (candidate-relative differences) 是与 query relevance 互补的信号，可用于为重排挑选更紧凑的输入；token 压缩的代价取决于 reranker 规模，4B 上可不损失 clean hits。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Skill Too Many: How Co-Installed Skills Conflict in Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are extended with agent skills, directories whose SKILL.md tells the model when and how to perform a task. Because skills come from independent sources (teams, developers, plugins, copied collections), an installed skill can be co-installed with a similar skill doing the same job, and the model picks between them by name and description alone. In a conflict, the installed skill loses core functions (e.g., a ban on touching git) because the similar skill runs instead or changes what it does. The task still passes, so benchmarks that check only task completion miss such cases. We present the first empirical study of such conflicts. From snapshots of 20,947 repositories, we mine 822,109 candidate similar-skill pairs, have an LLM judge a stratified sample of 3,754, and run 312 confirmed pairs on three models (6,368 runs, 169,294 tool calls, 542 agent-hours). We report five findings. (1) Conflict-prone skills are common: nearly one in four installed skills is co-installed with one that does the same job, and 37% of judged skills sit inside copied collections. (2) Most such pairs involve normative skills, then capability skills. (3) Without lowering task completion, a similar skill takes one in five runs from the installed skill, and runs that open the similar skill first lose over a third of the exclusive core functions that only the installed skill fulfills. (4) Install location decides which skill runs, listing order barely matters, and the final reply names the skill used in only 0.9% of substituted runs. (5) Conflicts are decided at the first skill read, almost always before any file is changed, and a pre-tool hook at that read restores fidelity on exclusive core functions to the level of runs that open the installed skill first. Benchmarks should thus score exclusive core functions, and platforms should guard the first read and show which skill ran.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同名同职能的 agent skill 共装时，模型仅凭 name/description 选择，导致已安装 skill 的核心功能（如禁止碰 git）被替换执行而不降任务完成率。312 个确认冲突对在三个模型上跑 6,368 次：相似 skill 抢走约 1/5 的运行，先读相似 skill 的运行丢失超过 1/3 的独占核心功能；在首次读 skill 处加 pre-tool hook 可把保真度恢复到先读已安装 skill 的水平。
Motivation: skill 来自团队、插件、拷贝集合等独立来源，同职能 skill 常共装；现有 benchmark 只查任务是否完成，因此功能被替换仍判通过，冲突被系统性漏检。
Method: 从 20,947 个仓库快照挖掘 822,109 个候选相似 skill 对，用 LLM 判读分层抽样的 3,754 对，再在三个模型上运行 312 个确认对，共 6,368 次运行、169,294 次工具调用、542 agent-hours；干预为在首次读 skill 处加 pre-tool hook。
Result: 近 1/4 已安装 skill 与同职能 skill 共装，37% 被判读 skill 位于拷贝集合内；不降任务完成率的前提下相似 skill 抢走 1/5 运行，先开相似 skill 的运行丢失超过 1/3 独占核心功能；安装位置决定谁被执行、列出顺序几乎无关，替换运行的最终回复仅 0.9% 提及实际所用 skill；首次读处的 pre-tool hook 使独占核心功能保真度回到先读已安装 skill 的水平。
Conclusion: 冲突在首次读 skill 时即已决定、几乎总在改文件之前，因此 benchmark 应按独占核心功能打分，平台应守住首次读并显式显示实际运行的 skill。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Phonologically Informed Tokenization for German Speech Recognition: A Cross-Domain Study
papers.abstract_en: German is a morphologically rich language whose syllable structure is exceptionally well-predicted by the Knuth--Liang hyphenation algorithm. We ask whether phonologically informed tokenization can serve as a competitive target for end-to-end speech recognition. We compare three tokenizer families on the Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0 backbone fine-tuned with CTC: the pretrained multilingual character inventory, a data-driven Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) over orthography, and phonologically informed units from Pyphen syllabification and grapheme-to-phoneme conversion. Across 40 fine-tunes, we evaluate on three German test sets spanning orthogonal shifts: in-domain read speech, dialectal spontaneous speech, and standard-German spontaneous speech. In-domain, all phonologically informed tokenizers match BPE and the multilingual character baseline on both WER and CER. Under domain shift the picture splits along vocabulary size rather than the linguistic axis of variation: at small vocabularies, syllable-aware tokenization improves on dialectal speech, where phonetic surface forms vary but syllable structure is preserved, and stays ahead on spontaneous speech, where new word-forms violate vocabulary closure. A phoneme-level confusion analysis further shows that all tokenizers commit the same canonical function-word errors, indicating that the acoustic encoder, not the tokenizer, dominates the error topology. Our findings suggest that tokenizer choice may depend on the vocabulary budget as much as on the distribution shift expected at deployment rather than reducing to a single universal optimum.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0 + CTC 骨干上比较三类分词器（多语言字符表、正字法 BPE、由 Pyphen 音节切分与字素-音素转换得到的音系学单元），40 次微调、三个德语测试集显示：域内 WER/CER 全部打平，域移下结果按词表大小而非语言学维度分化——小词表时音节感知分词在方言自发言语上更优并保持领先，音素级混淆分析显示各分词器犯同样的虚词错误，误差拓扑由声学编码器主导。
Motivation: 端到端语音识别的分词目标多沿用 NLP 的正字法 BPE，但德语形态丰富、音节结构可被 Knuth–Liang 连字算法高度预测，音系学单元能否在域移（方言、自发言语）下成为有竞争力的目标尚不清楚。
Method: 以 Omnilingual ASR 的 wav2vec 2.0 骨干做 CTC 微调，比较三类分词器：预训练多语言字符表、正字法上的数据驱动 BPE、以及由 Pyphen 音节切分加 grapheme-to-phoneme 转换得到的音系学单元；共 40 次微调，在三个正交域移的德语测试集上评测（域内朗读、方言自发言语、标准德语自发言语），并做音素级混淆分析。
Result: 域内朗读语音上，所有音系学分词器在 WER 与 CER 上均与 BPE 和多语言字符基线持平；域移下结果按词表大小分化：小词表时音节感知分词在方言自发言语上改进（音系表层形式多变但音节结构保持），并在自发言语上保持领先（新词形破坏词表闭合）。混淆分析显示所有分词器犯相同的规范虚词错误。
Conclusion: 分词器选择应同时看词表预算与部署时预期的分布移，而非存在单一普适最优；误差拓扑主要由声学编码器而非分词器决定。

papers.title: Revisiting Handcrafted Minutiae Detection: A Simple and Effective Open Source Baseline for Modern Fingerprint Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Handcrafted minutiae detection algorithms remain fundamental to biometric science and forensic practice due to their full auditability, adherence to international standards, and operational independence from training datasets or GPU hardware. However, current open-source traditional baselines are severely outdated, relying almost exclusively on legacy C/C++ codebases that lack seamless integration with modern scientific software ecosystems. To bridge this gap, the present work introduces SBMEX (Skeleton-Based Minutiae EXtraction), a fast and deterministic minutiae detection method integrated into the open source \texttt{pyfing} package. SBMEX achieves high computational throughput by employing a dual Look-Up Table architecture that replaces runtime neighborhood scanning during Crossing Number computation and skeleton tracking. Additionally, it incorporates a continuous quality scoring framework driven by tracking path length, dual ridge-valley skeleton fusion, and spatial density decay. Rigorous evaluation on NIST SD302 datasets demonstrates that SBMEX delivers feature extraction accuracy comparable to or outperforming traditional open-source baselines without fine-tuning, while achieving a drastic reduction in minutiae detection latency relative to classical Crossing Number Python implementations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SBMEX（Skeleton-Based Minutiae EXtraction）是集成进开源 pyfing 包的手工指纹细节点检测方法，用双查找表 (dual Look-Up Table) 架构替代 Crossing Number 计算与骨架跟踪时的邻域扫描，并加入由跟踪路径长度、脊-谷骨架融合与空间密度衰减驱动的连续质量评分。在 NIST SD302 上无需微调即可达到与传统开源基线相当或更好的特征提取精度，同时相对经典 Crossing Number Python 实现大幅降低检测延迟。
Motivation: 现有开源传统细节点检测基线严重过时，几乎全依赖遗留 C/C++ 代码库，难以与现代科学生态（如 Python）无缝集成。
Method: SBMEX 采用骨架化细节点提取：双 Look-Up Table 架构在 Crossing Number 计算与骨架跟踪中取代运行时邻域扫描；质量评分由跟踪路径长度、双脊-谷骨架融合与空间密度衰减共同驱动；作为确定性、快速的方法集成进 pyfing 开源包。
Result: 在 NIST SD302 数据集上，SBMEX 无需微调即取得与传统开源基线相当或更优的特征提取精度，并相对经典 Crossing Number Python 实现大幅降低细节点检测延迟。
Conclusion: 手工细节点检测仍具可审计、符合国际标准、不依赖训练数据与 GPU 的价值，而现代化 Python 实现可以在保持精度的同时显著提速，可作为现代指纹工作流的开源基线。

papers.title: LTBD: Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters for Prompt Injection Defense
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) perform remarkably well on complex tasks, yet remain highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, where malicious instructions embedded in external data can override user intent. Existing defenses remain limited by model fine-tuning requirements, vulnerability to adaptive attacks, or reliance on brittle handcrafted prompts. We argue that a fundamental source of this vulnerability is the lack of an explicit representation of trust provenance. To address this, we introduce Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters (LTBD), a lightweight defense that explicitly encodes trust boundaries in the input while keeping the LLM parameters unchanged. LTBD uses a small number of learnable delimiters to distinguish trusted user instructions from untrusted external data, enabling the model to better respect the intended trust hierarchy. Experimental results show that LTBD substantially outperforms inference-time defenses and performs competitively with training-based approaches, while preserving benign-task utility and introducing negligible inference overhead. In particular, LTBD achieves 0.00% ASR on AlpacaFarm and only 0.11-0.19% ASR on TaskTracker. LTBD also remains effective under adaptive attacks, where adversaries have full knowledge of the defense and explicitly attempt to bypass it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LTBD：在输入中用少量可学习分隔符 (learnable delimiters) 显式编码信任边界，区分可信用户指令与不可信外部数据，且完全不改动 LLM 参数。AlpacaFarm 上攻击成功率 (ASR) 降至 0.00%，TaskTracker 上为 0.11–0.19%，在自适应攻击下仍有效，推理开销可忽略。
Motivation: LLM 面对嵌入外部数据的提示注入攻击时易被覆盖用户意图；现有防御要么需要微调模型、要么易被自适应攻击绕过、要么依赖脆弱的手写提示，根因是缺少显式的信任来源表示。
Method: LTBD 是轻量推理时防御：在输入中加入少量可学习的分隔符标记，把可信用户指令与不可信外部数据在表示层面分开，使模型遵循信任层级；LLM 参数保持不变。
Result: AlpacaFarm 上 ASR 为 0.00%，TaskTracker 上 ASR 为 0.11–0.19%；性能显著优于其他推理时防御，与基于训练的方法相当，同时保持良性任务效用、推理开销可忽略；在攻击者完全知晓防御并尝试绕过的自适应攻击下仍有效。
Conclusion: 把信任来源显式编码进输入即可在不微调模型的前提下大幅降低提示注入成功率，且不牺牲良性任务表现。

papers.title: Neural Networks for Temporal Pattern Recognition and Dynamic Arm Gesture Speed Estimation for Robot Control
papers.abstract_en: Deploying intelligent robotic systems that interact with humans through gestures requires neural networks capable of recognizing diverse temporal patterns. We present a systematic benchmark of ten abstract sequential tasks--five permutation-invariant (set) and five order-dependent (sequence) problems--evaluated across eighteen neural network architectures spanning recurrent, convolutional, attention-based, and set-function families. Beyond the core architecture-task grid, we explore numerous preprocessing and target-variable transformations, yielding more than 250 distinct experimental configurations. All variants are trained and tested under strictly identical conditions (fixed random seeds, shared hyperparameters, shared data splits) to ensure fair and reproducible comparison. Ranking across all ten tasks reveals four consistently top-performing architectures--BiGRU, TCN, Conv1D, and GRUReLU--all compact enough for real-time deployment (under 2,000 parameters in the benchmark setting). Based on this ranking, we apply three architecturally diverse top models (BiGRU, TCN, and GRUReLU) to a practical robotics problem: estimating the execution speed of dynamic arm gestures from skeletal keypoint sequences. Three speed interpretations (peak count, period time, and mean spike spacing) are evaluated on a custom dataset of eight traffic-related gesture classes comprising 256,710 frames recorded via OpenPose. The best configuration achieves a mean absolute error of 0.198 on the peak-count interpretation, corresponding to roughly 5% relative error, while the period-time interpretation reaches approximately 4% relative error, and the mean spike spacing interpretation approximately 8% relative error. These results demonstrate that neural networks can reliably estimate gesture speed from skeletal data, opening a path toward speed-aware gesture-controlled robotic systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对十个抽象时序任务（五个置换不变集合类、五个顺序依赖序列类）在十八种神经网络架构上做严格同条件基准，>250 种配置下 BiGRU、TCN、Conv1D、GRUReLU 稳居前列且参数量均低于 2,000。将其中三个模型用于从骨骼关键点序列估计动态手臂手势执行速度，在 8 类、256,710 帧的自采数据集上，peak-count 解释的 MAE 为 0.198（约 5% 相对误差），period-time 约 4%，mean spike spacing 约 8%。
Motivation: 让机器人通过手势与人交互，需要网络能识别多样时序模式并估计手势执行速度；但架构在集合类与序列类任务上的相对优劣缺少统一、可复现的对照基准。
Method: 系统基准覆盖十个抽象时序任务（五个 permutation-invariant set、五个 order-dependent sequence）× 十八种架构（recurrent、convolutional、attention、set-function 四族），并加入多种预处理与目标变量变换，共 >250 种配置；固定随机种子、共享超参与数据划分以保证公平比较。再取 BiGRU、TCN、GRUReLU 三个架构差异较大的头部模型，用 OpenPose 提取的骨骼关键点序列估计手势速度，比较 peak count、period time、mean spike spacing 三种速度解释。
Result: 全十任务排名中 BiGRU、TCN、Conv1D、GRUReLU 四个架构持续领先，基准设定下参数量均低于 2,000。速度估计在 8 类交通相关手势、256,710 帧的自采数据集上：最佳配置对 peak-count 解释 MAE 0.198（约 5% 相对误差），period-time 约 4%，mean spike spacing 约 8%。
Conclusion: 紧凑循环与卷积架构足以在集合类和序列类时序任务上同时占优，并能从骨骼数据可靠估计手势速度，为速度感知的手势控制机器人系统铺路。

papers.title: Minimax Gaussian Mechanisms for Continual Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning updates a trained model after records are deleted, aiming to match exact retraining without repeating the full training procedure. We develop Gaussian mechanisms for Newton updates under sequential deletion requests. Using Gaussian differential privacy (GDP) and its adaptive composition rule, we show that the full sequence of released models is statistically difficult to distinguish from matched exact retraining. To calibrate these mechanisms for empirical risk minimization, we derive upper bounds on the error of the Newton approximation relative to exact retraining and on how this error changes after each deletion batch. Independent Gaussian noise is calibrated using bounds on the full residual at each release, whereas Gaussian random walk noise uses smaller bounds on residual increments. These bounds yield allocations minimizing the worst-case maximum noise variance across releases under the resulting GDP certification constraints. With count-based bounds, the random walk asymptotically matches the worst-case variance of a single release at deletion cap $M$, while independent noise incurs an additional factor of order $M$. Set-based bounds can reduce the noise variances by using gradients and Hessians of the deleted records. For singleton deletion, we further show that count-based independent noise, count-based random walk noise, and set-based independent noise are minimax among fixed Gaussian covariances under their respective residual or increment bounds. With set-based bounds, allowing variances to adapt to deleted records can improve on every fixed covariance by a factor of order $(\log M)^2$ on some data sequences. The residual and noise bounds also yield parameter and predictive consistency relative to exact retraining, uniformly over deletion policies. Simulations and a credit default data analysis evaluate bounds, noise variances, and estimation errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对序列删除请求下的持续机器遗忘 (continual machine unlearning)，用高斯差分隐私 (GDP) 及其自适应组合规则为 Newton 更新校准高斯噪声，使发布模型序列在统计上难以与精确重训练区分。计数型界下随机游走噪声的最坏方差渐近等于删除上限 M 处单次发布的方差，而独立噪声额外多出 O(M) 因子；集合型界利用被删记录的梯度与 Hessian 进一步降噪。
Motivation: 记录删除后需让已训练模型等价于精确重训练，但反复重跑完整训练代价高；序列删除下还要保证整条发布模型序列的隐私与逼近误差可控。
Method: 为序列删除下的 Newton 更新构造高斯机制，用 GDP 自适应组合规则认证整条发布序列；推导 Newton 近似相对精确重训练的误差上界及其在每个删除批次后的变化，据此在 GDP 约束下最小化各次发布最坏最大噪声方差，比较独立高斯噪声（用全残差界）与高斯随机游走噪声（用残差增量界），并区分计数型界与集合型界。
Result: 计数型界下随机游走噪声渐近匹配删除上限 M 处单次发布的最坏方差，独立噪声额外多出 O(M) 因子；集合型界可用被删记录的梯度与 Hessian 降低噪声方差；单删除情形下计数型独立、计数型随机游走、集合型独立噪声在各自残差或增量界下于固定高斯协方差中 minimax；集合型界下让方差随被删记录自适应可在某些数据序列上比任意固定协方差改进 O((log M)^2)；残差与噪声界还给出相对精确重训练、对删除策略一致的参数与预测相合性；用模拟与信用卡违约数据评估界、噪声方差与估计误差。
Conclusion: 在 GDP 认证下，随机游走噪声加集合型界是序列删除遗忘中控制最坏噪声方差的有效组合，且自适应方差相对固定协方差有可证明的对数级优势。

papers.title: Beyond Action Entropy: Quotient-Space Exploration for Genome-Scale Metabolic Model Repair
papers.abstract_en: Repairing scientific models from functional observations differs fundamentally from supervised prediction: feedback may certify a solution without revealing which structural correction is responsible. We study this setting for genome-scale metabolic model (GEM) repair, where multiple reaction edits can explain the same phenotypes and many apparently distinct edits correspond to the same biological mechanism. This many-to-one structure creates a hidden failure mode for conventional exploration: diversity in the output space need not translate into diversity of scientific hypotheses. We introduce QuotientPO, which collapses equivalent repairs into canonical mechanisms and optimizes exploration directly over the resulting quotient space. To make quotient exploration informative under finite rollouts, we derive a kernelized Rényi estimator that resolves graded crowding among distinct repair cores beyond coarse exact-match counts. On 2,212 held-out GEMs, QuotientPO improves Success@32 from 17.93% to 20.10% (+12.1% relative) while consistently increasing distinct successful-core discovery under the same sampling budget. These results establish quotient-space exploration as a principled approach to mechanism-level discovery under verifier-induced equivalence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对基因组尺度代谢模型 (GEM) 修复中「多种反应编辑对应同一机制」的多对一结构，提出 QuotientPO：把等价修复折叠成规范机制，在商空间 (quotient space) 上直接优化探索，并用核化 Rényi 估计器刻画不同修复核心之间的渐进拥挤度。在 2,212 个留出 GEM 上，Success@32 从 17.93% 提到 20.10%（相对 +12.1%），同采样预算下发现的不同成功核心数持续增加。
Motivation: 修复类任务的反馈只能认证解、不指出是哪处结构修正起作用，输出空间的多样性未必等于科学假设的多样性，常规探索因此存在隐藏失效模式。
Method: QuotientPO 将等价修复折叠为规范机制并在所得商空间上优化探索；为在有限 rollout 下使商空间探索有信息量，推导核化 Rényi 估计器，用于分辨不同 repair core 之间的渐进拥挤度，而非粗粒度精确匹配计数。
Result: 在 2,212 个留出 GEM 上，Success@32 由 17.93% 提升至 20.10%（相对提升 +12.1%），并在相同采样预算下持续提高不同成功核心 (distinct successful-core) 的发现数。
Conclusion: 在验证器诱导的等价性下，商空间探索是机制级发现的原则性方法：把等价修复归一化后再探索，比在原始输出空间追求多样性更能命中不同的生物学机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Constructing Structured Decision Sources for Consensus-Based Pseudo-Label Learning
papers.abstract_en: Consensus can make pseudo-label learning more reliable, but only when its predictors contribute genuinely different evidence. Multiple models that repeat the same boundary provide additional votes without additional information. We address this problem by con structing decision sources through controlled changes to within-class structure. Starting from a shared graph representation, we vary center granularity and neighborhood mixing, reproduce each resulting source to test its stability, and select a complementary subset using node pair coassignment. Unanimous predictions from the selected sources are then ranked for student training. On the public fixed splits of Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed, evaluated with five random seeds, the constructed sources improve fixed-budget training pseudo-label precision by 1.19 to 4.39 percentage points over three conventionally initialized GCN sources. Under matched structural filters, three-source consensus is more precise than each constituent source in all 45 dataset slot eed comparisons. The gains are strongest in pseudo-label quality: downstream accuracy remains competitive but does not lead on every dataset. These results identify source construction rather than model count alone as an important design problem for consensus-based pseudo-label learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 共识式伪标签学习只有在各预测器提供真正不同的证据时才可靠；本文通过受控改变类内结构来构造决策源：从共享图表示出发，改变中心粒度与邻域混合，复制每个源检验稳定性，再用节点对共分配 (node pair coassignment) 选出互补子集，并按排名使用一致预测训练学生。在 Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed 的公开固定划分上（5 个随机种子），构造出的源使固定预算下的训练伪标签精度比三个常规初始化 GCN 源高 1.19 至 4.39 个百分点。
Motivation: 多个模型若重复同一条决策边界，只增加票数而不增加信息，共识因此失效；作者把源构造本身（而非模型数量）识别为共识式伪标签学习的关键设计问题。
Method: 从共享图表示出发，通过受控改变类内结构（中心粒度、邻域混合）构造多个决策源；对每个源做复制以检验其稳定性；用节点对共分配 (node pair coassignment) 选择互补子集；将所选源的一致预测 (unanimous predictions) 排序后用于学生训练。
Result: 在 Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed 公开固定划分、5 个随机种子下，构造源使固定预算训练伪标签精度比三个常规初始化 GCN 源提升 1.19 至 4.39 个百分点；在匹配结构滤波条件下，三源共识在全部 45 组数据集-槽位-种子比较中都比任一单独源更精确；增益集中在伪标签质量，下游准确率保持竞争力但并非在每个数据集上领先。
Conclusion: 共识伪标签的收益来自源的构造方式而非源的数量；提升主要体现在伪标签精度上，下游准确率只是保持竞争力。

papers.title: Where to Adapt Matters: Layer-Selective Fine-Tuning for Capability Retention
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to specialized tasks, but often at the cost of degrading general capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing approaches primarily mitigate this trade-off through data replay or regularization, relying on additional data or explicit optimization constraints. We instead focus on a different question: where should adaptation be applied? We find that fine-tuning different Transformer layers produces different target-task gains and degrees of capability degradation, suggesting that not all layers are equally suitable for adaptation. To characterize this difference, we use layer-wise empirical Fisher information to measure target-task sensitivity. However, computing Fisher scores requires backward computation and becomes increasingly expensive for large models. We therefore introduce input--output cosine similarity as a lightweight, forward-only proxy for ranking layer sensitivity. Across models and tasks, layers with lower input--output similarity consistently exhibit higher empirical Fisher scores. Building on this observation, we propose Layer-Selective LoRA (LS-LoRA), which places trainable LoRA adapters only in layers with low input--output similarity. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that LS-LoRA improves average target-task performance while retaining substantially more commonsense reasoning capability than standard all-layer LoRA, demonstrating that carefully choosing where to adapt can provide a simple and effective way to balance target-task adaptation and general capability retention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LS-LoRA 只在输入-输出余弦相似度低的 Transformer 层放置可训练 LoRA adapter，用前向计算的轻量代理替代昂贵的逐层 empirical Fisher 打分来选层。低相似度层与高 Fisher 分数一致，据此选层在数学推理与代码生成上提升目标任务平均性能，同时比全层 LoRA 保留更多常识推理能力。
Motivation: PEFT 微调 LLM 常以牺牲预训练获得的通用能力为代价，现有缓解手段依赖数据回放或正则约束；而逐层 Fisher 打分需要反向计算，对大模型越来越贵。
Method: 先用逐层 empirical Fisher information 度量目标任务敏感度，发现其可用前向的输入-输出余弦相似度代理排序；再提出 Layer-Selective LoRA (LS-LoRA)，只在低相似度层放置可训练 LoRA adapter，与全层 LoRA 对照。
Result: 跨模型与任务，输入-输出相似度低的层 consistently 对应更高的 empirical Fisher 分数；在数学推理与代码生成实验中，LS-LoRA 提升目标任务平均性能，并比标准全层 LoRA 保留 substantially 更多常识推理能力。
Conclusion: 选择在哪些层做适配本身就是平衡目标任务适配与通用能力保留的简单有效手段，无需额外数据或显式优化约束。

papers.title: Randomized Transport Maps for Model-Free Policy-Gradient Mean-Field Control
papers.abstract_en: We develop a model-free policy gradient method for discrete-time mean-field control (MFC). In MFC, the policy affects the objective both through the controlled dynamics and through the population distribution. Standard REINFORCE estimators capture the first effect but not the second. We introduce Transport REINFORCE, a transport map-based approach that perturbs a suitable transformation of the population distribution to estimate this missing mean-field contribution. The method applies to both finite and continuous state spaces. In finite state spaces, we perturb the population distribution directly on the probability simplex through a convex combination of the current population weights and random weights. In continuous state spaces, we project the population distribution onto the manifold of Gaussian mixtures, and then randomize it via a transport map that ensures the perturbed law remains within this manifold. We prove consistency of the perturbed objective and gradient as the perturbation vanishes, and derive bias and mean-square error bounds for the resulting sample-based gradient estimator. Numerical experiments on several MFC benchmarks show that Transport REINFORCE improves over standard REINFORCE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Transport REINFORCE：针对离散时间 mean-field control (MFC) 中策略同时经由受控动力学和总体分布影响目标、而标准 REINFORCE 只捕捉前者的缺口，用 transport map 扰动总体分布来估计缺失的 mean-field 梯度项。有限状态空间上在概率单纯形上做当前权重与随机权重的凸组合扰动，连续状态空间上把总体分布投影到 Gaussian mixture 流形并用保持流形的 transport map 随机化；证明扰动趋于零时目标与梯度一致，并给出样本梯度估计器的偏差与均方误差界，数值实验上优于标准 REINFORCE。
Motivation: MFC 中策略对目标有两条作用通道，标准 REINFORCE 估计量只捕捉受控动力学那条，遗漏经由总体分布的贡献，导致梯度有偏。
Method: Transport REINFORCE：有限状态空间在概率单纯形上以当前总体权重与随机权重的凸组合直接扰动总体分布；连续状态空间先投影到 Gaussian mixture 流形，再用保证扰动后分布留在流形内的 transport map 随机化。理论上证明扰动消失时扰动目标与梯度的一致性，并推导样本梯度估计器的偏差与 MSE 界。
Result: 在若干 MFC benchmark 上的数值实验显示 Transport REINFORCE 优于标准 REINFORCE；理论结果为扰动目标与梯度的一致性证明以及样本梯度估计器的偏差和均方误差界。
Conclusion: 把总体分布的 transport map 扰动接进 REINFORCE，可以补上 MFC 中被遗漏的 mean-field 梯度贡献，且方法同时覆盖有限与连续状态空间。

papers.title: TAM: Task-Aware Memory Distillation for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation enables efficient spatiotemporal prediction by transferring knowledge from an accurate teacher to a compact student. However, matching outputs or features independently for each sample leaves cross-sample predictive structure underused. Exploiting this structure requires representations and historical references that reflect the dynamics of each task. We propose TAM, a Task-Aware Memory Distillation framework that organizes a frozen teacher's knowledge into a bounded, retrievable history. Memory entries encode latent features, forecast changes, or flow residuals, while task-specific selection rules identify relevant historical references. The student either matches the teacher's similarity distribution over shared references or regresses observation-conditioned residual prototypes. These objectives complement supervised prediction and conventional distillation. The teacher, memory, and auxiliary adapters are used only during training, leaving student inference unchanged. We evaluate TAM on video prediction, weather forecasting, and traffic flow prediction across multiple teacher-student configurations. Averaged over four paired runs, adding TAM improves SSIM on all six video datasets and reduces MSE on five relative to the corresponding KD baselines. Mean paired MSE reductions reach 1.86% on KittiCaltech, 1.93% on WeatherBench with a gSTA teacher, and 1.01% on TaxiBJ. These results demonstrate the utility of historical teacher supervision across distinct forecasting tasks without additional student inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAM 把冻结教师的知识组织成有界可检索的记忆库，用任务相关的选择规则取出历史参考，让学生匹配教师在共享参考上的相似度分布或回归观测条件残差原型，从而补上逐样本蒸馏忽略的跨样本预测结构。在四次配对平均下，加入 TAM 使六个视频数据集 SSIM 全部提升，MSE 在五个上下降，其中 WeatherBench（gSTA 教师）MSE 平均降低 1.93%，且学生推理开销不变。
Motivation: 逐样本独立匹配输出或特征的蒸馏没有利用跨样本预测结构，而利用该结构需要反映各任务动态的表征与历史参考。
Method: TAM 框架把冻结教师的知识存成有界可检索的历史记忆，条目编码 latent feature、forecast change 或 flow residual；任务特定选择规则检索相关历史参考，学生据此匹配教师的相似度分布或回归 observation-conditioned residual 相关的残差原型，与监督预测和常规蒸馏互补。教师、记忆与辅助 adapter 仅在训练期使用，学生推理结构不变。
Result: 在视频预测、天气预报与交通流预测上跨多种教师-学生配置评估：四次配对平均后，TAM 使全部六个视频数据集 SSIM 提升、五个数据集 MSE 相对 KD 基线下降；平均配对 MSE 降幅为 KittiCaltech 1.86%、WeatherBench（gSTA 教师）1.93%、TaxiBJ 1.01%。
Conclusion: 跨任务的历史教师监督对视频、天气、交通三类预测都有用，且不增加学生推理成本；收益以小幅但一致的 MSE/SSIM 改善呈现。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: AgentEvolver: System-Wide Self-Evolution Through Task Execution
papers.abstract_en: An agent can complete a task without improving how it works. Turning task experience into reusable capability requires connecting the changed component to its evaluation and subsequent use. We present AgentEvolver, a system for developing capabilities during task execution while keeping the foundation model fixed. Eight entity families expose reusable operations, methods, agents, control flow, interfaces, and supporting state to revision through a common versioned lifecycle. A shared Runtime coordinates ongoing work, while persistent planning and recoverable context preserve task direction and supporting evidence. We evaluate task outcomes on SWE-bench Pro Public and examine capability changes in six application cases. The team reports an 82.08\% resolution rate with evolution, exceeding its reported baseline without evolution. The cases show retained capabilities entering later website, game, and research work, while also documenting incomplete objectives and an unsuccessful strategy. These findings distinguish improvement in a reusable component from success on the final task. AgentEvolver provides a concrete basis for studying capability accumulation through execution; independent-task transfer and total development cost remain open questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentEvolver 是一个在任务执行过程中沉淀可复用能力的 agent 自进化系统：基础模型固定不动，八个实体家族（operations、methods、agents、control flow、interfaces 及支撑状态）通过统一的版本化生命周期接受修订，由共享 Runtime 协调执行，并用持久规划与可恢复上下文保持任务方向。在 SWE-bench Pro Public 上带进化的团队报告 82.08% 解决率，高于其自报的无进化基线；六个应用案例显示已沉淀能力被后续网站、游戏与研究类任务复用。
Motivation: agent 完成任务不等于改进自身工作方式：把任务经验变成可复用能力，需要把被修改的组件与其评估结果以及后续使用连接起来，而现有做法缺少这种闭环。
Method: 八个实体家族暴露可复用的 operations、methods、agents、control flow、interfaces 与支撑状态，统一走版本化生命周期；共享 Runtime 协调进行中的工作，持久规划 (persistent planning) 与可恢复上下文 (recoverable context) 保存任务方向和证据；基础模型保持固定。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Pro Public 上，带进化的团队报告 82.08% 解决率，超过其自报的无进化基线；六个应用案例中，已沉淀能力进入后续 website、game 与 research 工作，同时记录了未完成的目标和一次不成功的策略。
Conclusion: 可复用组件的改进与最终任务成功是两件事，需要分开衡量；独立任务间的迁移与总开发成本仍是开放问题。

papers.title: PointVGGT: Zero-Shot Multiview RGB-D Point Cloud Registration with Visual Geometry Foundation Priors
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses multiview RGB-D point cloud registration, aiming to estimate global rigid poses for unordered RGB-D scans and align them in a metrically consistent coordinate frame. The conventional pairwise-then-global paradigm suffers from locally optimized pairwise registration, severe error propagation and high computational burden. In particular, existing methods typically treat RGB data as a mere auxiliary matching cue and overlook the holistic geometric priors (e.g., camera poses and 3D models) encoded across image sequences. This paper introduces PointVGGT, a zero-shot framework built upon a novel \emph{foundation-then-refinement} paradigm that systematically leverages visual geometry foundation models (e.g., VGGT) as the computational backbone for robust, training-free multiview RGB-D registration. In the foundation stage, we directly recover metrically consistent global poses (without any pairwise estimation) by grounding the scale-ambiguous pose predictions of the foundation model against metric depth observations. In the refinement stage, we introduce an efficient voxelized spatial hashing mechanism that exploits the globally coherent 3D reconstruction (induced by the foundation model) as a shared spatial anchor, enabling dense multiview correspondences in near-linear time. On top of this, an IRLS-based robust motion-only bundle adjustment is performed using a conjugate gradient solver to jointly minimize the correspondence and reprojection residuals for multiview pose refinement. Extensive experiments on indoor/object-centric/outdoor datasets verify the outstanding zero-shot registration accuracy and computational efficiency of our proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PointVGGT 用「先基础后精修」范式做零样本多视图 RGB-D 点云配准：以 VGGT 等视觉几何基础模型为骨干，先用度量深度锚定其尺度歧义的位姿预测直接恢复全局一致位姿，再用体素化空间哈希在近线性时间内建立稠密多视对应，最后做 IRLS 鲁棒仅运动 BA 精修。在室内、物体中心与室外数据集上验证了零样本配准精度与计算效率。
Motivation: 多视图 RGB-D 配准的「先成对再全局」范式依赖局部优化的成对配准，误差传播严重且计算量大；现有方法还把 RGB 仅当辅助匹配线索，忽略了图像序列中编码的整体几何先验（相机位姿、3D 模型）。
Method: foundation 阶段：用 VGGT 等视觉几何基础模型直接预测位姿，并用地度量深度观测锚定其尺度歧义，跳过任何成对估计得到全局一致位姿。refinement 阶段：体素化空间哈希 (voxelized spatial hashing) 以基础模型诱导的全局一致 3D 重建为共享空间锚，近线性时间建立稠密多视对应；再用共轭梯度求解器做 IRLS 鲁棒仅运动 bundle adjustment，联合最小化对应残差与重投影残差。
Result: 在室内、物体中心与室外数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法的零样本配准精度与计算效率；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 以视觉几何基础模型为骨干、免训练的 foundation-then-refinement 路线可以在不依赖成对配准的前提下同时拿到多视图 RGB-D 配准的精度与效率。

papers.title: Beyond Report Imitation: Clinically Aware Multi-Image Ultrasound Report Generation from Visible Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Generating ultrasound reports from multiple images requires aggregating clinical evidence across views, yet archived key frames capture only part of the dynamic examination. Raw-report imitation is therefore misaligned with visual supervision: content that is clinically valid for the full examination may be unverifiable from the images available to a model. This gap creates a clinical behavior alignment problem. A model must preserve visible findings, avoid diagnostic reversals and unsupported completion, and not collapse into conservative templates. We propose CAMEO, a Clinically Aware Multi-image Evidence-grounded Orchestration framework for ultrasound report generation. Stage I learns ultrasound visual-language primitives; Stage II performs Cross-View Evidence Grounding by distilling trusted visible report points into multi-image QA and report-style supervision; and Stage III performs Clinically Aware Preference Alignment using clinical-error-oriented preference pairs. From USReport, we construct USReport-Distilled with 17,670 evidence-grounded paired-image training instances and USReport-Pref with 21,869 preference pairs; we additionally use 25,631 PubMedVision-US ultrasound instruction samples for domain adaptation and multi-image instruction tuning. On the primary USReport-Distilled benchmark, CAMEO improves over EchoVLM from 0.25 to 0.40 BLEU-1, 0.28 to 0.45 ROUGE-1, and 0.27 to 0.43 METEOR, while raising ClinicalScore from 55.02 to 74.20. These results underscore the value of evidence-grounded supervision, clinically aware alignment, and clinically structured evaluation for reliable ultrasound report generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAMEO 用三阶段流程把超声报告生成从「模仿原始报告」改为只监督图像可核验的证据：先学视觉-语言原语，再做跨视图证据锚定，最后用临床错误导向的偏好对做对齐。在 USReport-Distilled 上相对 EchoVLM，BLEU-1 从 0.25 升到 0.40、ROUGE-1 从 0.28 升到 0.45、METEOR 从 0.27 升到 0.43，ClinicalScore 从 55.02 升到 74.20。
Motivation: 存档关键帧只覆盖动态检查的一部分，直接模仿原始报告会让模型输出图像无法核验的内容，造成诊断反转、无依据补全或退化成保守模板的临床行为失配。
Method: CAMEO 三阶段：Stage I 学习超声视觉-语言原语；Stage II 做 Cross-View Evidence Grounding，把可信的可见报告要点蒸馏成多图像 QA 与报告式监督；Stage III 做 Clinically Aware Preference Alignment，使用临床错误导向的偏好对。从 USReport 构建 USReport-Distilled（17,670 条证据锚定的配对图像训练样本）与 USReport-Pref（21,869 个偏好对），另用 25,631 条 PubMedVision-US 超声指令样本做领域自适应与多图像指令微调。
Result: 在主基准 USReport-Distilled 上，CAMEO 相对 EchoVLM：BLEU-1 0.25→0.40，ROUGE-1 0.28→0.45，METEOR 0.27→0.43，ClinicalScore 55.02→74.20。
Conclusion: 证据锚定的监督加临床感知对齐能同时提高文本重合指标与临床正确性评分，说明可靠超声报告生成应按可核验证据而非原始报告全文来训练与评测。

papers.title: S$^3$Geo: Structure-Semantic Synergistic Learning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) aims to estimate geographic locations by matching images captured from different viewpoints, such as drone and satellite views. Existing methods mainly rely on visual representations, but often fail to jointly model fine-grained structural correspondences and semantic priors, making them prone to confusion between visually similar but semantically different regions, and thus limiting robustness under large viewpoint variations. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{S$^3$Geo}, a structure-semantic synergistic learning framework for cross-view matching. Specifically, we first introduce a Decoupled Query Pooling (DQP) module to extract a compact set of region-aware features from dense tokens, enabling explicit modeling of local structural patterns. We then design a query-level contrastive learning scheme with an optimal transport (OT)-based formulation to establish soft correspondences under cross-view spatial misalignment. Furthermore, we incorporate a Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SKD) strategy from a frozen CLIP teacher to transfer semantic priors and relational structures, thereby improving discrimination on hard negatives. By operating synergistically, the semantic priors provide robust contextual filtering, which guides the structural module to establish precise spatial alignments. Experiments on the University-1652 and SUES-200 datasets demonstrate that \textbf{S$^3$Geo} consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches without increasing inference complexity, validating the effectiveness of jointly modeling structural and semantic information for CVGL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S³Geo 把结构对齐与语义先验协同用于跨视角地理定位 (CVGL)：DQP 从稠密 token 提取区域感知特征，OT 形式的查询级对比学习建立跨视角软对应，冻结 CLIP 教师的语义蒸馏 (SKD) 提升难负例区分。在 University-1652 与 SUES-200 上持续优于 SOTA 且不增加推理复杂度。
Motivation: 现有 CVGL 方法只依赖视觉表示，无法同时建模细粒度结构对应与语义先验，容易混淆视觉相似但语义不同的区域，在大视角变化下鲁棒性受限。
Method: 三模块协同：Decoupled Query Pooling (DQP) 从稠密 token 提取紧凑的区域感知特征以显式建模局部结构；查询级对比学习用 optimal transport (OT) 公式化，在跨视角空间错位下建立软对应；Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SKD) 从冻结 CLIP 教师迁移语义先验与关系结构，语义先验为结构模块提供上下文过滤以精化空间对齐。
Result: 在 University-1652 与 SUES-200 两个跨视角地理定位数据集上，S³Geo 一致优于现有 SOTA 方法，且推理复杂度不增加。
Conclusion: 结构对应与语义先验联合建模是提升跨视角匹配在大视角变化下判别力的有效路径，且无需付出额外推理开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
papers.abstract_en: We introduce NanoProof, to our knowledge the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making it end-to-end reproducible using open-source resources. To this end, we build and release a dataset of structured proof trees, as well as a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier. To support sustainable research, we focus on compute efficiency to facilitate accessible training and evaluation. NanoProof achieves 50.8% pass@16 on MiniF2F-Test, exceeding the two closest systems of its class, HyperTree Proof Search and ABEL, at roughly 90x and 7x less compute, and using more than four orders of magnitude less compute than AlphaProof. Stronger open-weight provers exist, but they are fine-tuned from large pretrained language models and release neither training data nor pipeline; NanoProof shows that the factorized execution-guided class of provers can be rebuilt from scratch with modest resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NanoProof 是首个完全开源可复现的 Lean 4 因子化执行引导定理证明器 (factorized execution-guided theorem prover)，训练数据、提取工具、训练流程与权重全部公开。它在 MiniF2F-Test 上达到 50.8% pass@16，用约 1/90 与 1/7 的算力超过 HyperTree Proof Search 与 ABEL，比 AlphaProof 少四个数量级以上的算力。
Motivation: 因子化执行引导类证明器缺少端到端可复现的开源实现：现有更强的开放权重证明器都从大型预训练语言模型微调而来，且不公开训练数据与流程，算力门槛也阻碍可持续研究。
Method: 构建并发布结构化证明树 (structured proof trees) 数据集，以及一个在 Lean 4 形式验证器内做程序化交互与数据提取的工具；在此之上以算力效率为设计目标训练因子化执行引导证明器，并公开权重。
Result: MiniF2F-Test 上 pass@16 为 50.8%，超过同类最接近的 HyperTree Proof Search 与 ABEL，算力分别约为后两者的 1/90 与 1/7；相比 AlphaProof 算力少四个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 因子化执行引导证明器这一类模型可以用适度资源从零重建，前提是把训练数据、提取工具与流程一并开源；更强的开放权重系统依赖大型预训练模型微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Error-Propagation Modeling for Failure Attribution in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) are increasingly used to solve complex tasks through coordinated reasoning, tool use, and interaction with external resources. However, attributing failures in such systems remains challenging because the observed outcome often does not directly reveal the error responsible for the failed execution. In this work, the attribution target is the decisive error, defined as the agent--step pair whose correction would recover the failed execution. Existing approaches largely identify suspicious steps without explicitly modeling how errors propagate across interactions or persist in unresolved loops, making decisive errors difficult to distinguish from downstream failure symptoms. We propose \textbf{E}rror-Propagation \textbf{M}odeling for \textbf{F}ailure \textbf{A}ttribution (\textbf{EMFA}). EMFA constructs a structured representation of the failed trajectory, models both cascading propagation and persistent interaction loops, and uses propagation-aware candidate screening followed by counterfactual verification to identify the decisive agent--step pair. On the Who\&When benchmark, EMFA achieves state-of-the-art step-level attribution accuracy and remains competitive at the agent level. It improves the previous best step-level results by 3.45 and 4.40 percentage points on the Hand-Crafted and Algorithm-Generated subsets, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMFA 为 LLM 多智能体系统的失败归因建模错误传播：把失败轨迹结构化，显式刻画级联传播与持续交互环，再用传播感知候选筛选加反事实验证定位决定性 agent–step 对。在 Who&When 基准上取得 step 级 SOTA 归因准确率，较此前最好结果在 Hand-Crafted 与 Algorithm-Generated 子集分别提升 3.45 和 4.40 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体系统失败时，观测结果往往不直接暴露致错步骤；现有方法只挑可疑步骤，不建模错误跨交互传播与未解决循环，导致决定性错误与下游症状难以区分。
Method: EMFA 对失败轨迹构建结构化表示，同时建模级联传播 (cascading propagation) 与持续交互环 (persistent loops)，先做传播感知候选筛选，再用反事实验证 (counterfactual verification) 判定纠正后可恢复执行的决定性 agent–step 对。
Result: 在 Who&When 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 的 step 级归因准确率，agent 级仍具竞争力；step 级较此前最好结果在 Hand-Crafted 子集提升 3.45 个百分点、在 Algorithm-Generated 子集提升 4.40 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把错误传播与循环显式建模并配合反事实验证，能把决定性错误从下游失败症状中区分出来，从而刷新 LLM MAS 的 step 级失败归因精度。

papers.title: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
papers.abstract_en: Journals and conferences have begun to screen submitted manuscripts for text written using large language models (LLMs). The reliability of this screening rests on benchmark evaluations against a fixed set of LLM versions, while the versions in actual use keep changing. Here we quantify how this LLM turnover affects the screening of scientific manuscripts. We paired 4,000 pre-ChatGPT abstracts from the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August 2026. We then trained detectors under maintenance scenarios ranging from a detector retrained on every new version to one trained once and never updated. Detectors trained only on a vendor's past versions can collapse at the boundaries between model generations: calibrated to falsely flag 1% of human-written abstracts, they catch above 99% of rewrites just before the sharpest boundary and 3.8% just after it. Detectors trained on later versions can also miss rewrites of earlier ones. Vocabulary differences between versions largely track where detection transfers and where it fails. In the two screening scenarios we simulated, screens covering all 23 versions either flagged one in eight human-written abstracts or missed one in three rewrites of the newest version. Indeed, a commercial detector missed most rewrites of the version just after the sharpest boundary while flagging almost no human-written abstracts. Research-integrity policy should therefore treat the benchmark accuracy of a detector as provisional, to be re-verified with every LLM release, including earlier versions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 检测器在模型换代边界上会崩溃：在把人工摘要误报率校准到 1% 的条件下，只用某厂商历史版本训练的检测器在最陡边界前能抓到 99% 以上的改写，边界后骤降到 3.8%。作者据此主张，检测器的 benchmark 准确率只是暂定值，每次新 LLM 发布（含旧版本）都必须重新验证。
Motivation: 期刊与会议已开始筛查 LLM 代写的投稿，但检测器的可靠性建立在固定 LLM 版本集合的 benchmark 之上，而实际流通的版本持续更替，筛查策略可能因此失效。
Method: 把 4,000 篇 ChatGPT 之前的 PNAS 摘要与来自三家厂商、2023 年 6 月至 2026 年 8 月发布的 23 个 LLM 版本的改写配对，训练覆盖从每次新版本重训到训练一次永不更新等多种维护情景的检测器，并模拟两种筛查场景；另对照一个商用检测器。

papers.title: Runnable Commit Untangling for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents produce large, tangled patches that mix multiple development purposes, making the code hard to review and maintain. Commit untangling offers the promise of organizing such large patches into untangled, manageable commits. This paper emphasizes two important limitations in existing commit untangling studies. First, they do not consider that untangled commits are ordered and should leave the code runnable. In practice, maintainers are unlikely to accept commits that prevent the code from running. Second, existing studies claim that commit untangling helps software maintenance. However, they conduct syntactic comparisons between the untangled commits and developers' original commits without directly showing the claimed maintenance benefits. To address these gaps, this paper makes two novel contributions: (1) RucTangle, the first agentic method that untangles commits while keeping the code runnable after each commit; and (2) TangleEval, the first evaluation framework that quantifies how untangled, manageable commit histories help coding agents repair bugs. We compare RucTangle against four untangling methods on 131 agent-generated patches. All histories produced by RucTangle are runnable, while baselines produce 20.6%-37.4% unrunnable commit histories. We further collect 453 agent-generated patches that introduce regressions (i.e., causing previously passing tests to fail) and ask two other coding agents to repair regressions. Augmenting agent context with RucTangle-produced histories yields 5.2% absolute improvement in pass@1. We also analyze agent trajectories to learn how they use untangled commits to navigate and fix bugs. Our findings demonstrate the value of adopting established software engineering practices in the era of coding agents, which broaden the future research agenda: how can agents actively use software history to make better development decisions?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RucTangle，首个在每个 commit 之后都保持代码可运行的 commit untangling agentic 方法，并配套 TangleEval 评估框架，用回归修复任务量化可管理 commit 历史的实际维护收益。在 131 个 agent 生成的 patch 上，RucTangle 产出的历史 100% 可运行，四个基线有 20.6%–37.4% 不可运行；把其历史加入上下文后，两个修复 agent 的 pass@1 绝对提升 5.2%。
Motivation: 现有 commit untangling 研究既不保证 commit 有序且每步可运行，又只做与开发者原始 commit 的语法对比，无法证明所声称的维护收益；而维护者不会接受跑不起来的 commit 序列。
Method: RucTangle 用 agentic 流程把混合多个开发目的的大 patch 拆成有序、每步可运行的 commit；TangleEval 通过让另外两个 coding agent 修复回归（原本通过的测试变失败）来量化可管理 commit 历史对 bug 修复的帮助，并分析 agent 轨迹看它们如何利用 untangled commit 导航定位。
Result: 在 131 个 agent 生成 patch 上与四个 untangling 方法对比，RucTangle 产出的全部历史均可运行，基线则有 20.6%–37.4% 不可运行；在 453 个引入回归的 patch 上，用 RucTangle 历史增强 agent 上下文使 pass@1 绝对提升 5.2%。
Conclusion: commit untangling 必须同时满足有序与每步可运行，且其价值应通过下游维护任务（如回归修复）而非语法对比来证明；软件工程既有实践在 coding agent 时代依然有效。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adapting English Quality Classifiers for Multilingual LLM Pretraining Data Selection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language model (LLM) pretraining highlight the role of high-quality training data in improving performance. While model-based filtering has proven effective in selecting high-quality subsets from web-scale corpora, especially for high-resource languages, low-resource languages face challenges due to limited availability of annotated data. This work explores extending quality filtering to over 100 languages by proposing a multilingual adaptation approach that converts an existing English quality classifier into a multilingual variant. Our approach proposes training a small multi-layer perceptron on top of Transformer encoder-only model embeddings, using multilingual text as input and scores obtained from English classifiers applied to machine-translated text as labels. Our 1B, 3B and 8B scale experiments show that our approach maintains the downstream LLM benchmark performance of existing multilingual model-based filtering baselines, without harming regional and cultural knowledge benchmarks. To further evaluate cross-lingual generalization, we compare classifier scores of high-quality synthetic data and web samples, and the correlation of classifier scores with LLM-based ones, revealing that the classifier can learn the scoring criteria of its original English variant, even for languages not included in its training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把现成英文数据质量分类器改造成覆盖 100 多种语言的多语版本：用 Transformer encoder-only 模型的 embedding 上接小型 MLP，以英文分类器在机翻文本上给出的分数作标签训练。1B、3B、8B 规模实验显示该方法保持既有基于模型的多语数据过滤基线的下游 LLM benchmark 表现，且不损害区域与文化知识 benchmark，分类器还能学到英文原版的打分标准，包括训练数据中未出现的语言。
Motivation: 基于模型的数据过滤在高资源语言上有效，但低资源语言缺少标注数据，质量过滤难以扩展到 100 多种语言。
Method: 在 Transformer encoder-only 模型的 embedding 之上训练一个小型多层感知机 (MLP)，输入为多语原文，标签来自英文质量分类器对机翻文本的打分；在 1B、3B、8B 规模上做实验，并比较高质量合成数据与网页样本的分类器分数及其与 LLM 打分的相关性。
Result: 1B、3B、8B 规模实验中，该方法保持既有基于模型的多语过滤基线的下游 LLM benchmark 性能，且不损害区域与文化知识 benchmark；分类器分数在高质量合成数据与网页样本之间可区分，并与 LLM 打分相关，即使对训练数据未包含的语言也能学到英文原版的打分标准。
Conclusion: 英文质量分类器的打分标准可经机翻标签蒸馏迁移到多语场景，无需低资源语言的标注数据，且对未见语言同样成立。

papers.title: Embedding-Bias in Conditional Independence Testing
papers.abstract_en: To test conditional independence of $X$ and $Y$ given a text or an image $Z$, one conditions on an embedding $ψ(Z)$ in place of $Z$. The embedded test is valid if $Z$ is independent of $X$ or of $Y$ given $ψ(Z)$, which cannot be confirmed from data, and when this fails, the rejection probability under the null hypothesis can tend to one. We study this failure, and show that focusing on a specific form of dependence relaxes what the embedding must retain. For a residual correlation test inspired by the Generalised Covariance Measure, validity only requires that the parts of $\mathbb{E}[X \mid Z]$ and $\mathbb{E}[Y \mid Z]$ missed by $\mathbb{E}[X \mid ψ(Z)]$ and $\mathbb{E}[Y \mid ψ(Z)]$ are uncorrelated. Otherwise, we treat the discarded information as an omitted variable. Under the null hypothesis, the bias equals the absolute correlation of the missed parts times the geometric mean of two partial $R^2$ values. This identity yields a robust test valid under a declared tolerance for the geometric mean, which, like a sensitivity parameter, is not identified from the data. On synthetic data and text embeddings, the robust test holds its level approximately. On text generated by a language model, under an exact null hypothesis, every embedding, even the generator's own states, biases the embedded test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 条件独立检验用 embedding ψ(Z) 代替原始 Z 时，若 Z 与 X 或 Y 在给定 ψ(Z) 下不独立，原假设下的拒绝概率可趋于 1。作者证明对残差相关检验（类 Generalised Covariance Measure）只需被 embedding 漏掉的 E[X|Z] 与 E[Y|Z] 残差不相关即可，并给出偏差恒等式：偏差等于漏掉部分的绝对相关乘两个偏 R² 的几何平均，据此构造带容忍度参数的稳健检验。在合成数据与文本 embedding 上该检验近似保持水平；在语言模型生成文本的精确原假设下，任何 embedding（包括生成器自身隐状态）都会使嵌入检验产生偏差。
Motivation: 以 embedding 代替原始变量做条件独立检验时，有效性条件 Z⊥X|ψ(Z) 无法从数据确认，一旦失效原假设下拒绝概率可趋于 1，检验结论不可信。
Method: 针对受 Generalised Covariance Measure 启发的残差相关检验，把 embedding 漏掉的信息当作遗漏变量处理，推导偏差恒等式（偏差 = 漏掉部分的绝对相关 × 两个偏 R² 的几何平均），并据此构造在给定几何平均容忍度下稳健的检验；容忍度与敏感性参数一样不可从数据识别。
Result: 在合成数据与文本 embedding 上，稳健检验近似保持检验水平；在语言模型生成文本的精确原假设下，任何 embedding（含生成器自身隐状态）都会使嵌入检验产生偏差。
Conclusion: 对特定形式的依赖（残差相关）可放宽对 embedding 必须保留信息的要求，但偏差由漏掉部分的相关性与偏 R² 几何平均决定，需用声明的容忍度做稳健化，且该容忍度不可从数据识别。

papers.title: SDPAD: A Fully Spike-Driven Pipeline for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving demands trajectory planners that are both highly accurate and cheap enough for edge deployment. State-of-the-art artificial neural network (ANN) planners meet the accuracy requirement at the cost of heavy dense computation, while spiking neural networks (SNNs)---though promising orders-of-magnitude energy savings through sparse, event-driven arithmetic---still lag far behind in planning accuracy. We present \textbf{SDPAD}, a fully spike-driven end-to-end planning pipeline that closes this gap. SDPAD converts a pre-trained ANN perception stack into integer-spike form via quantized ANN2SNN conversion, lifts multi-view images into the bird's-eye-view (BEV) space with a spike-driven-max (SDM) depth distribution (Spike-3D-Lift), and plans through the Spike-QFormer, a spiking query transformer in which ego, agent, and map queries distilled from the BEV scene are fused by learnable waypoint queries via cross-attention, followed by deformable spike-cross-attention refinement. Every operation is gated by integer spikes and inference is a single feed-forward pass without temporal simulation loops. On the nuScenes open-loop benchmark, SDPAD achieves an average $L_2$ error of 0.40\,m and a collision rate of 0.12\%, on par with strong ANN planners while consuming 69.9\,mJ---less than 2\% of recent ANN baselines. In closed-loop evaluation on the NAVSIM navtest split, SDPAD reaches 86.3 PDMS, surpassing the previous SNN planner SAD by 4.3 points and matching mainstream ANN planners at a fraction of their energy. To our knowledge, SDPAD is the first fully spike-driven planner evaluated in end-to-end autonomous driving, demonstrating that SNNs can rival dense ANNs in complex driving tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SDPAD 把端到端自动驾驶规划做成全脉冲驱动 (fully spike-driven) 流水线：量化 ANN2SNN 转换感知栈、Spike-3D-Lift 把多视角图像抬到 BEV、Spike-QFormer 用可学习 waypoint 查询经交叉注意力融合 ego/agent/map 查询并做 deformable spike-cross-attention 细化，推理为单次前向、无时间仿真循环。在 nuScenes 开环上平均 L2 误差 0.40 m、碰撞率 0.12%，能耗 69.9 mJ（不到近期 ANN 基线的 2%）；NAVSIM navtest 闭环 86.3 PDMS，比此前 SNN 规划器 SAD 高 4.3 点。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶的轨迹规划器需要高精度且能边缘部署；ANN 规划器精度够但稠密计算太重，SNN 虽然事件驱动省能，规划精度却长期明显落后。
Method: SDPAD 由三部分组成：用量化 ANN2SNN 转换把预训练 ANN 感知栈转成整数脉冲形式；Spike-3D-Lift 用 spike-driven-max (SDM) 深度分布把多视角图像提升到 BEV；Spike-QFormer 是脉冲 query transformer，ego、agent、map 查询由可学习 waypoint 查询经 cross-attention 融合，再用 deformable spike-cross-attention 细化。所有运算由整数脉冲门控，推理为单次前向。
Result: nuScenes 开环基准：平均 L2 误差 0.40 m，碰撞率 0.12%，与强 ANN 规划器相当，能耗 69.9 mJ，低于近期 ANN 基线的 2%。NAVSIM navtest 闭环：86.3 PDMS，比此前 SNN 规划器 SAD 高 4.3 点，达到主流 ANN 规划器水平而能耗只是其一小部分。
Conclusion: 作者称 SDPAD 是首个在端到端自动驾驶中被评测的全脉冲驱动规划器，说明 SNN 在复杂驾驶任务上可以匹敌稠密 ANN。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Optimization for Physics-Aware Highway Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate trajectory forecasting and well-defined predictive uncertainty are crucial for reliable, safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Most trajectory prediction approaches provide point estimates only, while uncertainty-aware approaches typically quantify uncertainty only in the trajectory space. In physics-aware approaches, uncertainty in the predicted motion variables should be explicitly modeled and propagated through the vehicle dynamics. Otherwise, the resulting trajectory-space uncertainty may not fully reflect the variability introduced by the underlying motion prediction. Therefore, in this work, uncertainty-aware extensions of X-TRACK (X-TRACK-DE and X-TRACK-MCD), a physics-aware trajectory prediction framework, are proposed. The proposed framework predicts future vehicle motion variables and models both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties by propagating motion space uncertainty to trajectory space. Additionally, conformal prediction is applied to the trajectory space predictive covariance to construct uncertainty regions targeting a desired marginal coverage level. Evaluation on the highD dataset shows that X-TRACK-DE improves trajectory prediction accuracy over the deterministic baseline, while both uncertainty-aware variants provide predictive uncertainty that can be conformally calibrated to the desired marginal coverage level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在物理感知的轨迹预测框架 X-TRACK 上加两种不确定性扩展：X-TRACK-DE 与 X-TRACK-MCD，把运动变量空间的 aleatoric 与 epistemic 不确定性经车辆动力学传播到轨迹空间，再对轨迹空间预测协方差做 conformal prediction 构造目标边缘覆盖率的不确定性区域。highD 数据集上 X-TRACK-DE 相对确定性基线提升轨迹预测精度，两个不确定性变体的预测不确定性都可被共形校准到目标边缘覆盖率。
Motivation: 自动驾驶等安全攸关场景需要可靠且定义明确的预测不确定性，但多数轨迹预测只给点估计，已有不确定性方法多只在轨迹空间量化，未把底层运动预测的变异性经车辆动力学传进去。
Method: 提出 X-TRACK-DE 与 X-TRACK-MCD 两个不确定性感知扩展，预测未来车辆运动变量并同时建模 aleatoric 与 epistemic 不确定性，将运动空间不确定性传播到轨迹空间；再对轨迹空间预测协方差施加 conformal prediction，构造面向指定边缘覆盖率的不确定性区域。
Result: 在 highD 数据集上，X-TRACK-DE 相对确定性基线提升轨迹预测精度；X-TRACK-DE 与 X-TRACK-MCD 两个变体给出的预测不确定性均可共形校准到目标边缘覆盖率。
Conclusion: 把不确定性建在运动变量空间并经车辆动力学传播到轨迹空间，再用共形预测校准，可在物理感知轨迹预测中同时获得更高精度与可控覆盖率的不确定性区域。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: SV-TAD: Native Sparse Convs for Efficient Temporal Action Detection
papers.abstract_en: To adapt billion-parameter Vision Transformers for long-video understanding, recent methods freeze the backbone and train lightweight convolutional modules. While effective for parameter-efficient training, existing adapters do not reduce inference-time computation, leaving scalability with respect to video length largely unaddressed. Token selection can reduce attention cost by pruning redundant tokens, but it breaks the spatial grid structure required by convolutional adapters. This forces an expensive dense reconstruction, nullifying much of the potential speedup. We address this by introducing native sparse 2D convolutions, a primitive that allows these adapters, for the first time, to operate directly and efficiently on dynamically pruned token sets. We integrate this primitive into SV-TAD, an adapter framework for temporal action detection, reducing VideoMAEv2-L computation by up to 64% and achieving 2.2x faster inference, while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy on THUMOS-14 and ActivityNet-1.3. When scaled to InternVideoNext-L, our approach surpasses the previous state of the art at roughly half its computational cost. Moreover, the sparse formulation naturally supports auxiliary task tokens, which improves fine-grained assembly detection on ATTACH.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV 2026. Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol 17044. Springer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SV-TAD 为长视频时序动作检测 (temporal action detection) 引入原生稀疏 2D 卷积，让卷积 adapter 直接在动态剪枝后的 token 集合上运算，免去把稀疏 token 重建回稠密网格的开销。在 THUMOS-14 与 ActivityNet-1.3 上保持 SOTA 精度的同时，VideoMAEv2-L 计算量最多降 64%、推理提速 2.2 倍；InternVideoNext-L 以约一半计算量超过先前 SOTA。
Motivation: 十亿参数级 ViT 做长视频理解时，冻结 backbone + 轻量卷积 adapter 只省训练参数、不省推理计算；token 剪枝能压注意力开销却破坏卷积所需的二维网格，稠密重建又把加速吃掉。
Method: 提出原生稀疏 2D 卷积原语，作为 SV-TAD adapter 框架的核心，直接在动态剪枝的 token 集合上做卷积运算；稀疏形式还天然支持辅助任务 token，用于细粒度 assembly 检测。
Result: VideoMAEv2-L 计算量最多减少 64%，推理加速 2.2 倍，同时在 THUMOS-14 与 ActivityNet-1.3 上保持 state-of-the-art 精度；扩展到 InternVideoNext-L 时以约一半计算量超过先前 SOTA；辅助任务 token 改善了 ATTACH 上的细粒度 assembly 检测。
Conclusion: 把稀疏卷积做成原语后，token 剪枝与卷积 adapter 可以共存，长视频时序动作检测的推理开销随视频长度的扩展性问题得以缓解，且不牺牲精度。

papers.title: CoCam4D: Geometry-Aware Cooperative 4D Perception for Camera-Only Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles often suffer from limited perception due to occlusions, blind spots, limited sensor range, and the complex nature of surrounding environments. Multi-agent collaborative perception (CP) addresses these challenges by allowing vehicles to share sensory information and reconstruct the scene cooperatively. However, camera-only perception remains fundamentally limited by the uncertainty of distance-dependent monocular depth estimation. We propose CoCam4D, a Bayesian framework for collaborative perception that explicitly models geometric uncertainty. It uses a VGGT-based feedforward network to generate 3D Gaussian scene representations with associated uncertainty estimates, enabling multiple vehicles or agents to efficiently combine their observations. By sharing compact Gaussian primitives, reliable observations from one agent can reduce the depth uncertainty of another without requiring LiDAR sensors. To support real-world deployment, we introduce Dynamic Object Primitives (DOPs), a compact 35-byte representation designed for efficient C-V2X communication. Extensive experiments show that our proposed method consistently outperforms recent vision-only methods, achieving improvements of 11.48% on OPV2V+ and 10.62% on DAIR-V2X-C, demonstrating the potential of geometrically grounded collaborative perception for LiDAR-free autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoCam4D 是面向纯相机协同感知的贝叶斯框架：用 VGGT 前馈网络生成带不确定性估计的 3D Gaussian 场景表示，多车间共享紧凑 Gaussian 原语，使一个 agent 的可靠观测能降低另一个 agent 的深度不确定性，无需 LiDAR。在 OPV2V+ 与 DAIR-V2X-C 上分别比近期纯视觉方法提升 11.48% 和 10.62%。
Motivation: 自动驾驶单车感知受遮挡、盲区与传感器距离限制，而纯相机方案还额外受单目深度估计随距离不确定性的影响，多车协同感知需要一种能显式建模几何不确定性并可经 C-V2X 传输的表示。
Method: 贝叶斯协同感知框架：VGGT 前馈网络输出带不确定性估计的 3D Gaussian 场景表示，多 agent 直接合并各自观测；提出 Dynamic Object Primitives (DOPs)，一种 35 字节的紧凑表示用于 C-V2X 通信，共享 Gaussian 原语以跨车降低深度不确定性。
Result: 在 OPV2V+ 上比近期纯视觉方法提升 11.48%，在 DAIR-V2X-C 上提升 10.62%；DOPs 表示大小为 35 字节。
Conclusion: 几何上落地的协同感知可以在不依赖 LiDAR 的前提下缓解纯相机的深度不确定性，紧凑 Gaussian 原语足以支撑 C-V2X 实车部署。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Smoothing the Top-k Exposure Boundary for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models scale parameter capacity efficiently while maintaining a fixed compute budget per token. However, traditional training paradigms enforce a static choice of top-$k$ experts, which converts a continuous routing distribution into a rigid step function. This constraint introduces a brittle boundary where highly competitive experts are arbitrarily separated into full-supervision and zero-feedback zones based on minor score fluctuations. To address this issue, we propose Elastic Expert Routing, which stochastically samples the active expert budget from a localized discrete distribution centered at $k$. Over multiple training iterations, this mechanism softens the sharp threshold into a gradual probability distribution. Because the sampling neighborhood remains symmetric, this approach matches the expected computational cost of deterministic training, while preserving the inference budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of our method on both supervised fine-tuning and from-scratch pretraining settings. During supervised fine-tuning, elastic routing improves downstream macro-averages on OLMoE-1B-7B and Qwen3-30B-A3B by $+0.84$ and $+2.02$ points, respectively. In addition, in from-scratch pretraining, it outperforms the static top-$k$ baseline by $1.6$ points on average across downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 稀疏 MoE 训练中固定 top-k 把连续路由分布压成阶跃函数，分数相近的专家被任意划入全监督或零反馈区。Elastic Expert Routing 以 k 为中心的局部离散分布随机采样激活专家数，把硬阈值摊成渐进概率，且采样邻域对称、期望计算开销与确定性训练持平。SFT 中 OLMoE-1B-7B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 下游 macro-average 分别 +0.84、+2.02 点，从零预训练平均超静态 top-k 基线 1.6 点。
Motivation: 静态 top-k 路由把连续打分变成刚性阶跃，分数仅微小波动就让高度竞争的专家在全监督与零反馈之间被任意切分，训练信号因此脆弱。
Method: 提出 Elastic Expert Routing：从以 k 为中心的局部离散分布中随机采样激活专家预算，多次迭代后硬阈值被摊平为渐进概率分布；采样邻域对称，期望计算成本与确定性训练一致，推理预算不变。在监督微调 (SFT) 与从零预训练两种设置上实验。
Result: SFT 下游 macro-average：OLMoE-1B-7B +0.84 点，Qwen3-30B-A3B +2.02 点；从零预训练在下游任务上平均比静态 top-k 基线高 1.6 点。
Conclusion: 把 top-k 的硬边界换成以 k 为中心的对称随机采样，可在不改变推理预算、不增加期望训练计算的前提下提升稀疏 MoE 的下游表现，SFT 与从零预训练均成立。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Memory Type Varies: Empowering LLM Agents for Long-Term Memory with Diverse Strategies
papers.abstract_en: The memory capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have garnered increasing attention recently. Despite great success achieved, existing retrieval-based memory approaches typically overlook the differences between memories and employ a unified strategy to process all memories, leading to suboptimal performance. Thus, an intuitive question arises: can we categorize memory into different types and select appropriate strategies? However, given the topic-rich, scenario-complex, and boundary-blurred nature of memory scenarios, achieving precise classification of memories is not easy. To address this challenge, we propose a memory multi-class dataset in this paper, termed TriMEM, which provides precise annotations for memory types across diverse scenarios. Building upon this foundation, we propose a novel memory framework, named MemoType, which can adaptively recognize each memory and query type with the learned router model. With the memory and query routing, MemoType can retrieve the memory with corresponding query types and design tailored retrieval strategies, thereby enhancing the retrieval performance. Moreover, we theoretically prove that any single retrieval strategy is subject to a fundamental upper bound on its expected retrieval precision in multi-class corpora, leading to systematic precision degradation. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that MemoType consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 16.18% improvement in Recall@1.

TL;DR: MemoType 用学到的 router 对每条记忆和查询做多分类路由，再按类型选定制检索策略，避免对所有记忆用同一套检索。理论证明单一检索策略在多类语料上的期望检索精度存在基本上界，会导致系统性精度退化；在三个数据集上 Recall@1 最高提升 16.18%。
Motivation: 现有基于检索的 LLM 长期记忆方法忽略记忆之间的差异，对所有记忆套用统一策略，导致检索性能次优；而记忆场景主题多、场景复杂、边界模糊，精确分类本身困难。
Method: 提出记忆多分类数据集 TriMEM，跨多样场景给出精确的记忆类型标注；在此基础上构建 MemoType 框架，用学习得到的 router 模型识别每条记忆与查询的类型，按路由结果匹配查询类型并采用定制检索策略；同时给出单一策略在多类语料上期望检索精度上界的理论证明。
Result: 在三个数据集上的实验中 MemoType 一致优于现有方法，Recall@1 最高提升 16.18%；理论结果表明任何单一检索策略在多类语料上的期望检索精度都受基本上界约束，造成系统性精度退化。
Conclusion: 按记忆类型分而治之的检索优于统一策略，且这一优势有理论上的精度上界支撑；TriMEM 的类型标注是实现该路由的前提。

papers.title: PAM-ToD: Plug-and-Play Appearance Modeling for Cross-Time-of-Day 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Adapting a pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) road scene to a new time of day requires learning appearance changes from a few anchor images while preserving consistent, real-time rendering. We propose PAM-ToD, a lightweight plug-in that learns color corrections while keeping the pre-trained 3DGS parameters fixed. PAM-ToD scales each Gaussian's existing color to model illumination changes and uses an additive term for additional brightness, such as when street lamps turn on at night. Under a simplified image formation model, unchanged surface albedo can be eliminated from the relation between source and target appearances, allowing us to learn these corrections without separately estimating albedo and illumination. The model corrects colors across the scene while allowing the corrections to vary by location and by Gaussian. To guide learning from a few anchor images, it discourages abrupt spatial changes in these corrections. We also introduce CARLA-ToD, a benchmark with matching geometry, camera poses, and moving-object trajectories across three times of day. A few target-time anchor images are used to train each plug-in, while separate views are used for evaluation. Across the static and dynamic settings, PAM-ToD achieves higher PSNR and lower LPIPS than the baselines, even when the anchor images come from a single synchronized capture across multiple cameras.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAM-ToD 是一个即插即用的外观修正模块：冻结预训练 3DGS 道路场景参数，只学每个 Gaussian 的颜色乘性缩放与加性亮度项，在简化成像模型下消去表面反照率，从而用少量目标时段 anchor 图像适配到新时段。在自建 CARLA-ToD 基准的静态与动态设定上，其 PSNR 高于、LPIPS 低于基线，即使 anchor 图像来自多相机单次同步拍摄。
Motivation: 把预训练 3DGS 道路场景适配到新时段时，既要从极少 anchor 图像学出光照变化，又要保持一致且实时的渲染；直接微调 3DGS 参数代价大且易破坏几何。
Method: 冻结预训练 3DGS 参数，仅学习颜色修正：对每个 Gaussian 的既有颜色做乘性缩放建模光照变化，另加一个加性项表示路灯等额外亮度；在简化图像成像模型下消去不变的表面反照率，避免分别估计反照率与光照。修正量随位置和 Gaussian 变化，并加入对空间突变的抑制以从少量 anchor 图像中引导学习。同时提出 CARLA-ToD 基准，跨三个时段共享几何、相机位姿与运动物体轨迹，用目标时段 anchor 图像训练、独立视角评测。
Result: 在 CARLA-ToD 的静态与动态设定上，PAM-ToD 相对基线取得更高 PSNR 与更低 LPIPS；即使 anchor 图像来自多相机的单次同步拍摄，优势仍保持。
Conclusion: 冻结 3DGS 几何、只学可定位的颜色乘加修正，足以用少量 anchor 图像完成跨时段外观适配，并保持一致实时渲染。

papers.title: Automated Detection of Match Phases in Football from Spatio-Temporal Tracking Data Using Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal tracking data has opened new possibilities for detecting complex tactical patterns in football, yet modeling the interactive movements of multiple players remains challenging. This paper proposes a framework combining graph neural networks (GNNs) with a sequential model to classify match phases on a second-by-second basis across a seven-class taxonomy. Match phase classification is tactically meaningful, and the availability of rule-based labels across 203 matches makes it a suitable testbed for a systematic comparison of adjacency constructions and message-passing layers, a question that has received limited attention in existing research. Our selected GNN-LSTM model outperforms all aggregated-feature baselines, including XGBoost and a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, as the strongest baseline scores 4.6% lower in macro F1. Graph representations using a domain-informed Delaunay triangulation that approximates passing lanes, paired with a custom Spatial Edge-Augmented Convolution (SEAConv) layer that injects edge attributes directly into messages, achieve the best performance by capturing spatial dependencies while limiting uninformative messages from redundant edges. Integrated Gradients attributions indicate the model uses spatial player configurations, particularly horizontal positioning, in combination with possession and ball-status indicators. This work offers an automated solution for fine-grained tactical analysis, reducing the need for manual tagging and providing deeper insight into dynamic team behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 GNN-LSTM 对足球时空追踪数据做逐秒比赛阶段分类（七类），在 203 场比赛的规则标签上，域知识驱动的 Delaunay 三角剖分图（近似传球路线）配自定义 Spatial Edge-Augmented Convolution (SEAConv) 表现最佳，最强聚合特征基线 macro F1 低 4.6%。
Motivation: 足球追踪数据中多名球员的交互运动难以建模，现有研究对图构建方式与消息传递层的系统比较关注有限，战术阶段仍依赖人工标注。
Method: 框架组合图神经网络与序列模型（GNN-LSTM）做逐秒七分类；比较多种邻接构造与消息传递层，最佳配置用近似传球路线的 Delaunay 三角剖分作图表示，SEAConv 层把边属性直接注入消息；用 Integrated Gradients 归因模型决策。
Result: 在 203 场比赛的规则生成标签上，所选 GNN-LSTM 超过全部聚合特征基线（含 XGBoost 与 LSTM），最强基线 macro F1 低 4.6%；Delaunay + SEAConv 组合取得最佳性能；归因显示模型主要使用空间球员配置（尤其水平位置）结合控球与球状态指示。
Conclusion: 域知识构造的图结构加边属性注入的消息传递能更细粒度地自动识别战术阶段，减少人工标注需求并揭示动态球队行为。

papers.title: Scaling to Tens of Thousands of Test-Time Iterations with Loop-Native Attention Residuals
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we argue that looped Transformers need their own residual connections to prevent performance degradation as the number of iterations grows. We observe that increasing loop iterations can reduce reasoning accuracy: noisy state updates overwrite correct intermediate deductions and even undo completed solutions. This leaves subsequent iterations to recover lost information from an already degraded representation: once an error arises in an earlier loop, often as a result of long-range propagation through the recurrence, later loops find it difficult to correct. In this paper, we introduce InfiLoop, a loop-native residual connection that learns which past computations to retain and how much to accept from each new update. InfiLoop combines content-based weighting with learned temporal decay to maintain a running summary of recurrent states. An exact streaming recurrence keeps its persistent aggregation memory constant as the loop count grows. The resulting adaptive update suppresses unreliable proposals and preserves useful intermediate states. Across extensive reasoning tasks, a 7M-parameter InfiLoop model outperforms existing recursive architectures, reaching 97.9% exact accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme, and 13.6% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-2. Notably, on Sudoku-Extreme, InfiLoop continues to improve with test-time looping beyond 20,000 effective steps, showing that added depth translates directly into stronger reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/pixeli99/InfiLoop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InfiLoop 为 looped Transformer 引入原生残差连接：用内容加权加学习式时间衰减维护循环状态的运行摘要，抑制不可靠的新更新、保留有用的中间结论。7M 参数模型在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 97.9% exact accuracy，且在超过 20,000 个有效测试时迭代后仍在提升。
Motivation: looped Transformer 增加循环迭代数反而会降低推理精度：噪声状态覆盖正确中间推导、甚至撤销已完成的解，早期错误经长程传播后后续循环难以纠正。
Method: InfiLoop 将内容加权 (content-based weighting) 与学习式时间衰减 (learned temporal decay) 结合，维护循环状态的运行摘要；用精确流式递归使持久聚合记忆不随循环数增长，自适应更新抑制不可靠提案并保留有用中间状态。
Result: 7M 参数的 InfiLoop 模型在推理任务上超过现有递归架构：Sudoku-Extreme exact accuracy 97.9%，ARC-AGI-2 pass@2 13.6%；在 Sudoku-Extreme 上测试时循环超过 20,000 个有效步后性能继续提升。
Conclusion: 循环式 Transformer 需要自己的残差连接；加上后增加的深度能直接转化为更强的推理能力，而非性能退化。
