papers.title: RISR: Residual-Informed Scientific Equation Discovery with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression combines structural search with numerical fitting, but aggregate fit scores do not describe how the remaining error varies across inputs. We introduce RISR, a residual-informed method that uses these error patterns to guide formula discovery and learn which corrections are worth fitting. A residual encoder compresses aligned inputs, targets, current predictions, and residuals into continuous tokens that condition a language model to propose formulas. For subsequent refinement, a dual-view relational encoder uses additive and regularized multiplicative residuals to predict the post-fit utility of candidate corrections. We evaluate RISR on scientific tasks from the LLM-SRBench. RISR achieves 63.57% and 38.50% ID accuracy at the 1% and 0.1% pointwise relative-error tolerances, respectively. The corresponding OOD accuracies are 56.07% and 38.24%. RISR outperforms the reported baselines using the same backbone. The results show that our residual-informed approach can improve numerical equation recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RISR 用残差模式而非整体拟合分数来引导符号回归公式发现：残差编码器把输入、目标、当前预测与残差压成连续 token 去条件化大语言模型提出公式，双视角关系编码器再预测候选修正的拟合后效用。在 LLM-SRBench 上，1% 与 0.1% 逐点相对误差容忍度下 ID 准确率分别为 63.57% 与 38.50%，OOD 为 56.07% 与 38.24%，同 backbone 下超过已报告基线。
Motivation: 符号回归的结构搜索与数值拟合通常只看整体拟合分数，无法刻画残差在输入上的分布，导致语言模型提公式与后续修正选择都缺少针对性信号。
Method: 残差编码器将对齐的输入、目标、当前预测与残差编码为连续 token，条件化 LLM 提出候选公式；精修阶段用双视角关系编码器，以加性残差与正则化乘性残差预测候选修正的 post-fit utility，判断哪些修正值得拟合。
Result: 在 LLM-SRBench 科学任务上，1% 逐点相对误差容忍度下 ID 准确率 63.57%、OOD 56.07%；0.1% 容忍度下 ID 38.50%、OOD 38.24%；在相同 backbone 下优于已报告基线。
Conclusion: 把残差的空间分布显式喂给公式提出与修正筛选，可以提升数值方程恢复的准确率，且在 OOD 条件下仍保持相对基线的优势。

papers.title: Environmental Feedback Modeling Matters: Rethinking Feedback Treatment in Agentic Hindsight Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is commonly used to train language agents in interactive environments, but cannot be directly applied when rewards are unavailable. Recent methods use environmental feedback as privileged context for hindsight self-distillation, but our analysis suggests that simply conditioning the teacher on feedback is insufficient, motivating us to rethink how environmental feedback is used in agentic self-distillation. Given that environmental feedback contains rich supervision for modeling how the environment responds to agent actions, we introduce \textit{agentic SElf-distilLation with environmental Feedback modeling} (SELF), a framework that jointly optimizes environmental feedback modeling and hindsight self-distillation. SELF learns to predict environmental responses while distilling guidance from a feedback-conditioned self-teacher into the policy. Our analysis reveals a mutually reinforcing mechanism: environmental feedback modeling strengthens hindsight supervision and policy learning, while self-distillation enhances the model's ability to model environmental feedback. With Qwen3-8B, SELF outperforms SDPO and GRPO by 6.4 and 4.1 percentage points in $τ$-bench success rate, and by 10.71 and 3.57 percentage points in AppWorld task goal completion, respectively. These results show that SELF uses environmental feedback more effectively within agentic self-distillation, improving agent capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SELF 把环境反馈建模与 hindsight 自蒸馏联合优化：用反馈条件化的自教师蒸馏策略，同时让模型预测环境对动作的响应，两者互相增强。在 Qwen3-8B 上，τ-bench 成功率比 SDPO、GRPO 分别高 6.4 和 4.1 个百分点，AppWorld 任务目标完成率分别高 10.71 和 3.57 个百分点。
Motivation: 无奖励的交互环境中无法直接做强化学习，现有方法把环境反馈当作特权上下文喂给教师做 hindsight 自蒸馏，但仅以反馈为条件并不够。
Method: SELF (agentic SElf-distilLation with environmental Feedback modeling) 联合优化环境反馈建模与 hindsight 自蒸馏：模型学习预测环境响应，同时从反馈条件化的自教师蒸馏出策略指导；实验用 Qwen3-8B。
Result: 在 τ-bench 上 SELF 成功率比 SDPO 高 6.4 个百分点、比 GRPO 高 4.1 个百分点；在 AppWorld 上任务目标完成率分别高 10.71 和 3.57 个百分点。
Conclusion: 环境反馈建模与自蒸馏存在互促机制：前者强化 hindsight 监督与策略学习，后者提升环境反馈建模能力，因此反馈应作为建模目标而非仅作条件。

papers.title: PlanWAM: Planning-Shaped Future Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: World models in end-to-end autonomous driving predict future scene evolution to provide foresight for trajectory planning. Existing methods mainly study how to predict the future and how to use it, but less often ask which future representation is actually most useful for planning. To this end, we propose PlanWAM, a Planning-Shaped World Action Model. The key idea is to let the planning task shape the future-state representation, so that it retains the information most useful for planning. A latent world model then predicts this planning-shaped future latent representation from historical observations and uses it for planning, enabling foresighted planning. Specifically, we first use a Temporal Register Pyramid to compress multi-frame historical information in a recency-aware manner, learning a compact history representation oriented toward future reasoning and planning. We then introduce a privileged future posterior branch that observes ground-truth future frames, and shape its future latent representation with trajectory-planning objectives to obtain a planning-shaped future latent representation. Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation trains a prior branch that depends only on history to predict this future latent representation. The predicted future latent representation serves as planning context and guides trajectory generation and selection. PlanWAM achieves 93.8 PDMS / 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest and reaches 38.7 HD-Score on closed-loop HUGSIM in a zero-shot setting, demonstrating leading planning performance across both open-loop and closed-loop evaluations. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that planning-shaped future representations provide an effective and deployable form of foresight for world-action models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlanWAM 让规划任务本身塑造世界模型的未来隐表示：用 Temporal Register Pyramid 压缩历史帧，特权未来后验分支在真实未来帧上以轨迹规划目标塑形隐表示，再经 Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation 训练只依赖历史的先验分支去预测它，作为规划上下文生成与筛选轨迹。在 NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest 上取得 93.8 PDMS / 90.9 EPDMS，闭环 HUGSIM 零样本 38.7 HD-Score。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶的世界模型大多在争论如何预测未来、如何使用预测结果，却很少追问哪种未来表示对规划最有用，导致预测到的信息未必转化为规划收益。
Method: 三段式：Temporal Register Pyramid 以近因感知方式压缩多帧历史，得到面向未来推理的紧凑历史表示；特权未来后验分支观测真实未来帧，用轨迹规划目标塑形其未来隐表示；Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation 训练仅依赖历史的先验分支预测该表示，预测结果作为规划上下文引导轨迹生成与选择。
Result: NAVSIM-v1 navtest 93.8 PDMS，NAVSIM-v2 navtest 90.9 EPDMS；闭环 HUGSIM 零样本设置下 38.7 HD-Score，作者称在开环与闭环评测上均达到领先规划性能。
Conclusion: 被规划目标塑形的未来隐表示是 world-action model 可部署的前瞻形式，先验分支只靠历史即可复现这种前瞻并支撑规划。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: EvoKnow: Continual Knowledge Evolution for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image detectors are commonly trained on fixed generator domains and become difficult to maintain as new generative models emerge. Continual adaptation is challenging because replaying historical generated images is costly, whereas updating shared parameters with limited current-domain data can overwrite prior forensic knowledge. We propose EvoKnow, a replay-free framework that formulates continual AI-generated image detection as forensic knowledge evolution. EvoKnow preserves a shared forensic basis learned from base domains, incrementally adds isolated residual experts for complementary generator-relevant evidence, and retrieves expertise through an Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) updated in closed form from current-stage generated images and accumulated sufficient statistics. Experiments demonstrate effective cross-generator generalization, few-shot expansion, and long-horizon continual adaptation. With ten generated images per arriving generator, EvoKnow achieves 96.70% average accuracy on non-base GenImage generators and 94.48% accuracy on Chameleon without target-benchmark adaptation. Under a strict replay-free continual learning protocol, EvoKnow achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance, attaining 96.32% mean stage-wise accuracy and 4.32% average forgetting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoKnow 把持续学习下的 AI 生成图像检测重构为法证知识演化：保留基础域学到的共享 forensic basis，为每个新生成器增量挂载隔离的 residual expert，并用闭式更新的 Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) 按当前阶段生成图像与累积充分统计量检索专家，全程不回放历史生成图像。在每个新生成器仅 10 张生成图像的设定下，非基础 GenImage 生成器平均准确率 96.70%，Chameleon 上 94.48%；严格无回放协议下阶段平均准确率 96.32%、平均遗忘 4.32%。
Motivation: 检测器通常在固定生成器域上训练，新模型不断涌现时难以维护：回放历史生成图像成本高，而用有限的当前域数据更新共享参数会覆盖先前的取证知识。
Method: 免回放 (replay-free) 框架 EvoKnow：保留基础域学到的共享 forensic basis，为互补的生成器相关证据增量添加隔离的 residual experts；由 Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) 负责专家检索，AIR 用当前阶段生成图像与累积充分统计量以闭式 (closed form) 方式更新，无需历史图像回放。
Result: 每个到达生成器仅 10 张生成图像时，非基础 GenImage 生成器平均准确率 96.70%，Chameleon 上 94.48%（均无目标基准适配）；严格无回放持续学习协议下阶段平均准确率 (mean stage-wise accuracy) 96.32%，平均遗忘 (average forgetting) 4.32%，作者称达到 state-of-the-art 持续学习性能。

papers.title: Equal Path Cost, Unequal Output Effects: Understanding Perturbation Propagation in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling, with their sampling procedures routinely modified to control generation and improve efficiency. These modifications introduce perturbations along the sampling trajectory, raising a central question: how do such perturbations affect generated output? To address this question, we develop a theoretical framework to investigate perturbation propagation, combining dynamical analysis of the sampling process with an information-theoretic characterization of output responses. Within this framework, we quantify perturbation strength using the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between perturbed and reference trajectory distributions, termed as path cost, which is shown to bound, but do not determine, changes in the output distribution. Building on this analysis, we derive a response identity that connects the propagation and accumulation of local perturbations with the information captured by a selected feature mean, explaining why changes in the output distribution can remain undetected by its first-order response. We test our theoretical analysis through controlled interventions at equal path cost in pretrained diffusion models, revealing distinct patterns of output sensitivity across sampling stages and spatial frequencies. To assess whether our framework can diagnose perturbations arising from practical approximations, we apply it to cache-based acceleration and show that our propagation analysis reliably identifies sampling intervals where caching causes larger image errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文为扩散模型采样轨迹上的扰动传播建立理论框架：用扰动与参考轨迹分布的 KL 散度（path cost）度量扰动强度，证明它只能界定而不能决定输出分布的变化，并导出把局部扰动传播与所选特征均值信息联系起来的 response identity，解释一阶响应为何会漏检输出变化。在预训练扩散模型上做等 path cost 的受控干预，输出敏感度在不同采样阶段与空间频率上呈不同模式；把框架用于 cache 加速时，能可靠定位缓存导致图像误差更大的采样区间。
Motivation: 扩散模型采样过程常被改造以控制生成或提速，这些改造在轨迹上引入扰动，但同等强度的扰动为何产生不同输出影响缺乏统一的量化与诊断手段。
Method: 结合采样过程的动力学分析与输出响应的信息论刻画：以扰动轨迹分布与参考轨迹分布的 KL 散度定义 path cost 并证明其对输出分布变化只作界定；再导出 response identity，把局部扰动的传播与累积同学术所选特征均值携带的信息挂钩；随后在预训练扩散模型上做等 path cost 的受控干预，并将框架应用于 cache-based acceleration。
Result: 等 path cost 的受控干预显示输出敏感度在不同采样阶段和空间频率上呈不同模式；path cost 被证明界定但不决定输出分布变化；一阶响应可能检测不到输出分布的改变。用于 cache 加速时，传播分析能可靠识别缓存造成更大图像误差的采样区间。
Conclusion: 同等 path cost 不等于同等输出影响，扰动诊断应看分阶段、分空间频率的传播响应，而非只看 KL 强度；该框架可用来定位实际近似（如缓存加速）引入大误差的采样区间。

papers.title: FastJEV: Understanding Redundancy for Compact JEV Inference
papers.abstract_en: JEV models make multimodal decisions by directly scoring candidates. Although the common context is encoded once, candidate evaluation can still repeat matching token histories, duplicate inference states, and execute the full backbone. In this paper, we study these sources of redundancy and present FastJEV for compact candidate evaluation. We jointly organize history reuse and state storage, since sharing computation requires preserving states for later branches. We first introduce shared context anchoring to reuse recurrent initial states and omit unused final recurrent caches. We extend this reuse through candidate prefix sharing, retaining the intermediate states needed by subsequent branches. To further reduce the depth of these paths, we apply decision guided pruning based on relative score changes measured on a small unlabeled set. Our method retains full context encoding and all candidates without additional training. We evaluate FastJEV across three OmniJev model sizes on five public benchmarks and reconstructed LIBERO-10 offline questions. At the selected pruning budgets, the complete method reduces candidate depth by 43.75% to 45.83%, while retaining 93.66% to 97.52% of the original task scores on average across the six evaluation sets. Through controlled experiments, we show how candidate overlap and branching structure affect the execution cost of history reuse. In our implementation, candidate prefix sharing can reduce repeated computation while increasing latency. These findings motivate designing sharing granularity and execution schedules together for efficient JEV inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FastJEV 针对 JEV（联合嵌入变分）候选评估中的重复计算，联合组织历史复用与状态存储：共享上下文锚定复用循环初始状态并丢弃无用的最终循环缓存，候选前缀共享保留后续分支所需的中间状态，再用小规模无标注集上的相对分数变化做决策引导剪枝。在三个 OmniJev 模型规模、五个公开基准加重建的 LIBERO-10 离线问题上，选定剪枝预算下候选深度降低 43.75%–45.83%，六个评测集平均保留原任务分数的 93.66%–97.52%。
Motivation: JEV 模型虽只编码一次公共上下文，但候选评估仍会重复匹配 token 历史、复制推理状态并跑完整 backbone，造成冗余开销。
Method: 共享上下文锚定 (shared context anchoring) 复用循环初始状态并省去未使用的最终循环缓存；候选前缀共享 (candidate prefix sharing) 保留后续分支需要的中间状态；再基于小规模无标注集上测得的相对分数变化做决策引导剪枝 (decision guided pruning)。保留完整上下文编码与全部候选，无需额外训练。
Result: 在三个 OmniJev 模型规模、五个公开基准与重建的 LIBERO-10 离线问题共六个评测集上，选定剪枝预算下完整方法使候选深度降低 43.75% 至 45.83%，平均保留原任务分数的 93.66% 至 97.52%。受控实验显示候选重叠度与分支结构影响历史复用的执行开销；实现中候选前缀共享减少重复计算但增加延迟。
Conclusion: 共享粒度与执行调度需要一起设计才能高效做 JEV 推理：前缀共享省计算却可能加延迟，剪枝深度与任务分数保留之间存在可调预算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CRISP: Fixing Flying Pixels in Latent LiDAR Generation via Diffusion Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Latent LiDAR pipelines suffer from flying pixels: convolutional VAEs blur sharp radial depth discontinuities, yielding edge depths that back-project to points floating between surfaces. We identify this as a major, directly correctable decoder bottleneck and introduce CRISP: a pixel-space diffusion decoder with a backbone-agnostic latent adapter, DiT-based denoiser, and support mask predictor. CRISP replaces video-VAE and LiDAR-native decoders alike while keeping the encoder and latent generator fixed. Across KITTI-360, SemanticKITTI, and nuScenes, replacing only the decoder reduces FSVD/FPVD by 50.5% on average across frozen backbones; for generic video VAEs, the reductions reach 71%/74%. On the LiDAR-native LiDM backbone, FRID drops by 71%, with the largest gains at depth discontinuities. In a pretrained LiDM world model, the same zero-shot replacement improves FSVD by 15.5%, narrowing the sim-to-real gap.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 41 pages, 10 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://andrea25512.github.io/CRISP/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRISP 用像素空间扩散解码器替换潜空间 LiDAR 生成管线的 VAE 解码器，在编码器与潜生成器全部冻结的前提下修复 flying pixels（径向深度突变处被卷积 VAE 抹糊、反投影后悬浮在表面之间的点）。在 KITTI-360、SemanticKITTI、nuScenes 上仅换解码器即平均降低 FSVD/FPVD 50.5%，通用 video VAE 上降幅达 71%/74%，LiDM 上 FRID 降 71%，预训练 LiDM world model 零样本替换再降 FSVD 15.5%。
Motivation: 潜空间 LiDAR 管线中卷积 VAE 会模糊锐利的径向深度断崖，边缘深度反投影成悬浮在表面之间的 flying pixels 点，污染下游几何质量。
Method: CRISP 由三部分组成：backbone-agnostic 的 latent adapter、基于 DiT 的去噪器 (denoiser)、support mask predictor；作为像素空间扩散解码器替换 video-VAE 与 LiDAR-native 解码器，同时保持编码器与潜生成器冻结不动。
Result: 在 KITTI-360、SemanticKITTI、nuScenes 上，仅替换解码器使 FSVD/FPVD 在冻结 backbone 上平均下降 50.5%；对通用 video VAE 降幅达 71%/74%；在 LiDAR-native LiDM backbone 上 FRID 下降 71%，且增益在深度断崖处最大；在预训练 LiDM world model 中零样本替换使 FSVD 改善 15.5%，缩小 sim-to-real 差距。
Conclusion: flying pixels 主要是可直接修复的解码器瓶颈：不动编码器与潜生成器、只把解码器换成带 latent adapter 与 support mask 的像素空间扩散解码器，就能跨 backbone 与跨数据集大幅降低深度边缘误差并改善 sim-to-real。

papers.title: Rethinking Contrastive Loss in CLIP Post-training: A Complementary Framework with Frozen Text Encoder
papers.abstract_en: CLIP serves as a foundational vision-language model and the de facto vision encoder for downstream VLMs such as LLaVA. Post-training offers a lightweight route to refine CLIP, but recent work argues that the standard contrastive loss is unsuitable for post-training due to catastrophic forgetting under small batches, motivating designs that abandon the contrastive objective in favor of distillation. We revisit this premise and find that, for the InfoNCE objective, the reported forgetting is driven primarily not by insufficient negatives but by an inappropriate magnitude of the contrastive temperature $τ$: with $τ$ set sufficiently small, contrastive post-training improves rather than degrades the pretrained CLIP, which we explain through the temperature dependence of the InfoNCE gradient. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{ComCLIP}, a lightweight single-epoch post-training recipe that freezes CLIP's text encoder---so the refined vision encoder is a drop-in replacement with unchanged architecture and inference cost---and trains the vision encoder with a properly-tempered contrastive loss, an MSE anchoring loss against the original CLIP, and a relational distillation loss from DINOv2. Over multiple seeds, ComCLIP matches the self-distillation baseline CLIP-Refine on zero-shot classification while significantly improving the transferability of visual features, measured by linear probing ($48.99$ vs.\ $42.28$ on ViT-B/16), and on ViT-L/14 it also improves MMVP over CLIP-Refine ($24.20$ vs.\ $19.01$); CLIP-Refine remains stronger on image-text retrieval. Used as a drop-in vision encoder for LLaVA-1.5-7B without re-aligning the projector or LLM, ComCLIP yields no net change across $8$ VLM benchmarks, i.e., the refinement does not break downstream compatibility. Code and models are available at https://github.com/showstarpro/ComCLIP.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ComCLIP 重新审视 CLIP 后训练中「对比损失导致灾难性遗忘」的论断，指出 InfoNCE 的遗忘主因是温度 τ 取值不当而非负样本不足：τ 足够小时对比后训练反而提升预训练 CLIP。据此提出冻结文本编码器的单轮轻量配方，视觉编码器线性探测从 42.28 提到 48.99（ViT-B/16），ViT-L/14 上 MMVP 从 19.01 提到 24.20。
Motivation: 近期工作认为小批量下标准对比损失会造成灾难性遗忘，主张后训练放弃对比目标改用蒸馏；作者认为这一前提的归因有误，需要重新检验遗忘的真正来源。
Method: ComCLIP 冻结 CLIP 文本编码器，使精炼后的视觉编码器成为架构与推理成本不变的 drop-in 替换；训练视觉编码器时组合三个损失：温度调好的对比损失、对原始 CLIP 的 MSE 锚定损失、以及来自 DINOv2 的关系蒸馏损失，单轮 (single-epoch) 完成，并用 InfoNCE 梯度的温度依赖解释为何小 τ 能避免遗忘。
Result: 多随机种子下，ComCLIP 在零样本分类上与自蒸馏基线 CLIP-Refine 持平，但特征可迁移性显著更好：ViT-B/16 线性探测 48.99 vs 42.28；ViT-L/14 上 MMVP 24.20 vs 19.01，而 CLIP-Refine 在图文检索上仍更强。作为 drop-in 视觉编码器接入 LLaVA-1.5-7B（不重新对齐 projector 与 LLM），在 8 个 VLM 基准上净变化为零。
Conclusion: 对比后训练的遗忘可由温度这一超参数解决，无需放弃 InfoNCE 改走蒸馏；冻结文本编码器的精炼视觉编码器能保持下游 VLM 兼容性，代价是图文检索上仍不及 CLIP-Refine。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: ComCLIP 重新审视 CLIP 后训练中「对比损失导致灾难性遗忘」的论断，指出 InfoNCE 的遗忘主因是温度 τ 取值不当而非负样本不足：τ 足够小时对比后训练反而提升预训练 CLIP。据此提出冻结文本编码器的单轮轻量配方，视觉编码器线性探测从 42.28 提到 48.99（ViT-B/16），ViT-L/14 上 MMVP 从 19.01 提到 24.20。

papers.title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt optimization, as an efficient adaptation approach, be directly applied to continual learning?} Our analysis shows that, under sequential task adaptation, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting, while optimized prompts accumulate rules that overfit to local task distributions. To address these limitations, we propose \emph{Evolving Functional REpertoires} (EFRE), which replaces a single prompt with a repertoire of functions that evolves as new tasks arrive: compatible updates refine existing functions, while conflicting updates trigger the emergence of new ones. On a three-task continual-learning stream, EFRE achieves a final average performance 7.50 percentage points higher than GRPO. Moreover, after adaptation to the Bio task, its performance on FinQA decreases by only 1.56 percentage points, compared with 25.10 percentage points for the base prompt optimization method. We further instantiate EFRE in a minimal agent system and observe consistent improvements across different backbone models. Overall, these results demonstrate EFRE's strong performance in continual learning for large language models and highlight its substantial potential for continual learning in advanced agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EFRE 把单一优化提示替换为随新任务演化的功能库 (repertoire)：兼容更新细化已有函数，冲突更新催生新函数，从而避免顺序任务适应中的灾难性遗忘。在三任务持续学习流上，最终平均性能比 GRPO 高 7.50 个百分点；适配 Bio 任务后 FinQA 仅下降 1.56 个百分点，而基础提示优化方法下降 25.10 个百分点。
Motivation: 提示优化虽避免参数更新且在单任务上可匹敌 GRPO，但顺序任务适应下会灾难性遗忘，且优化出的提示累积的规则过拟合局部任务分布，无法直接用于持续学习。
Method: 提出 Evolving Functional REpertoires (EFRE)：用一个随新任务到达而演化的功能库取代单一提示，兼容性更新细化既有函数，冲突更新触发新函数涌现；并在一个最小 agent 系统中实例化，跨不同 backbone 模型检验。
Result: 在三任务持续学习流上，EFRE 最终平均性能比 GRPO 高 7.50 个百分点；适配 Bio 任务后 FinQA 性能仅下降 1.56 个百分点，基础提示优化方法下降 25.10 个百分点；最小 agent 系统中在不同 backbone 模型上观察到一致改进。
Conclusion: 提示优化要用于 LLM 持续学习，必须从单一提示升级为可演化的功能库，以兼容/冲突分流抑制对局部任务分布的过拟合与遗忘；该机制在 agent 系统中同样成立。

papers.title: SignRAG: Unified Retrieval-Augmented Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary decoder-only large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of domains. However, existing pretraining paradigms for gloss-free sign language translation (SLT) are largely designed around conventional encoder-decoder pretrained language models, which limits their direct applicability to decoder-only LLMs. To address this limitation, we propose SignRAG, a unified framework combining hierarchical pretraining, target-domain retrieval augmentation, and retrieval-aware reinforcement fine-tuning. Hierarchical pretraining first learns linguistically grounded sign representations and then jointly aligns the sign encoder with an LLM, mitigating cross-modal optimization imbalance. For downstream adaptation, SignRAG complements parameter-based fine-tuning with a target-domain retrieval gallery that provides instance-specific translation cues. To ensure that retrieved contexts are used appropriately, we further introduce Retrieval Utility-Guided Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RUG-RFT), which combines translation-quality and retrieval-utility rewards to encourage beneficial retrieval use while suppressing harmful reliance. Experiments on multiple SLT benchmarks establish new state-of-the-art performance. In particular, to the best of our knowledge, SignRAG is the first gloss-free approach to outperform gloss-supervised methods across all reported metrics on CSL-Daily. Our code has been released at \href{https://github.com/shahelaojieraozhi/SignRAG}{GitHub}, together with models of different sizes to support future academic research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SignRAG 把分层预训练、目标域检索增强与检索效用引导的强化微调 (RUG-RFT) 统一到 decoder-only LLM 上做无 gloss 手语翻译 (gloss-free SLT)，并用翻译质量与检索效用双奖励约束检索的使用方式。在多个 SLT 基准上达到新 SOTA，据作者所知是首个在 CSL-Daily 全部报告指标上超过 gloss 监督方法的无 gloss 方案。
Motivation: 现有无 gloss 手语翻译预训练范式围绕 encoder-decoder 预训练模型设计，无法直接迁移到 decoder-only LLM，且跨模态优化不平衡。
Method: 分层预训练先学有语言学依据的手语表示，再把 sign encoder 与 LLM 联合对齐；下游在参数微调之外加目标域检索库提供实例级翻译线索；RUG-RFT 以翻译质量奖励与检索效用奖励组合，鼓励有益检索、抑制有害依赖。
Result: 在多个 SLT 基准上建立新的 SOTA；据作者所知，SignRAG 是首个在 CSL-Daily 全部报告指标上优于 gloss 监督方法的无 gloss 方案；代码与多尺寸模型已在 GitHub 发布。
Conclusion: 检索增强加检索效用引导的强化微调，可让 decoder-only LLM 上的无 gloss 手语翻译达到并超过 gloss 监督水平。

papers.title: RIT-RAG: Navigating Document Corpora with Retrieval-Induced Trees
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in external corpora. Agentic RAG enables iterative search, yet exposes the model to isolated chunks without document structure, making it difficult to distinguish relevant evidence from chunks that merely resemble the query. Structure-aware methods such as PageIndex navigate document structure but cannot scale to the structures of large corpora, which do not fit in the LLM context. Hence, they first commit to a single document using a document retriever and cannot recover from a wrong choice. We propose RIT-RAG (Retrieval-Induced Tree RAG), which combines content retrieval with structural navigation. Offline, RIT-RAG builds a tree for each document from its table of contents or sitemap. At query time, it retrieves a broad set of chunks and uses their positions to induce manageable sub-trees, potentially across multiple documents. An LLM agent navigates these sub-trees, selectively reads promising nodes, and reformulates queries when needed. Thus, retrieval proposes where to look, while the agent decides what to read. Across financial, scientific, and customer-support benchmarks, RIT-RAG achieves the highest answer accuracy among vanilla, graph-based, and agentic baselines. On EntQABench, our new benchmark of 2.84 million technical-documentation webpages, it improves accuracy by 6.8 to 11.4 points over the strongest baseline across three LLMs.
papers.comment: 24 pages (main text through Limitations ends on page 9, followed by references and appendix), 9 figures, 16 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIT-RAG 把每篇文档的目录或站点地图离线建成树，查询时用检索到的 chunk 位置归纳出可管理的子树（可跨多文档），再由 LLM agent 在子树上导航、选择性读节点并改写查询，使检索负责提议位置、agent 决定读什么。在金融、科学、客服三类基准上答案准确率高于 vanilla、graph-based 与 agentic 基线；在自建的 EntQABench（284 万技术文档网页）上，对三个 LLM 相对最强基线提升 6.8 至 11.4 个百分点。
Motivation: Agentic RAG 让模型面对孤立 chunk 而丢失文档结构，难以区分真正证据与仅表面相似的内容；PageIndex 等结构感知方法无法扩展到放不进 LLM 上下文的大语料结构，只能先用文档检索器锁定单一文档，选错后无法恢复。
Method: 离线阶段从每篇文档的 table of contents 或 sitemap 构建树；查询时先广泛检索 chunk，用其在树中的位置归纳出规模可控的子树（可跨多文档），再由 LLM agent 导航子树、选择性读取有希望的节点并在需要时改写查询，形成检索提议位置、agent 决定读什么的分工。
Result: 在 financial、scientific、customer-support 三类基准上，答案准确率高于 vanilla、graph-based 与 agentic 基线；在 EntQABench（自建、含 284 万技术文档网页）上，对三个 LLM 相对最强基线提升 6.8 至 11.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把内容检索与结构导航结合、并让 agent 在跨文档子树上决定读什么，可在超出上下文容量的大型文档语料上取得最高答案准确率，且不必先锁定单一文档。

papers.title: SpatialOPSD: Self-Distilling Spatial Intelligence from Verified Coding Agent Traces
papers.abstract_en: Spatial coding agents significantly improve spatial reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by using external tools to generate verified execution traces. However, this paradigm inherently suffers from prohibitive inference-time overhead and external dependencies. In this paper, we explore whether an MLLM can internalize this agentic capability to operate entirely tool-free. We begin with a simple observation: prompting an MLLM with summarized execution traces of a spatial coding agent naturally unlocks the model's internal spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Motivated by this, we introduce SpatialOPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that internalizes spatial reasoning into a standalone MLLM by formulating verified agent traces as privileged information. To mitigate privileged-information leakage during distillation, we introduce Repetition-Aware Distillation, which combines repetition masking with unlikelihood regularization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that self-distilling SpatialOPSD achieves higher average accuracy than SFT and GRPO on both spatial and OOD datasets, exhibiting superior performance and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpatialOPSD 用自蒸馏把空间编码 agent 的已验证执行轨迹内化进单个 MLLM，实现免工具空间推理：把 agent 轨迹当作特权信息，用 Repetition-Aware Distillation（重复掩码 + unlikelihood 正则）抑制蒸馏中的特权信息泄漏。在多个空间与 OOD 基准上，自蒸馏的平均准确率高于 SFT 与 GRPO。
Motivation: 空间编码 agent 靠外部工具生成已验证轨迹来提升 MLLM 空间推理，但推理开销高且依赖外部工具，难以独立运行。
Method: 以 on-policy 自蒸馏框架把已验证 agent 轨迹形式化为特权信息，蒸馏进独立 MLLM；用 Repetition-Aware Distillation，即 repetition masking 结合 unlikelihood regularization，缓解蒸馏过程中的特权信息泄漏。
Result: 在多个基准上，自蒸馏 SpatialOPSD 的平均准确率高于 SFT 和 GRPO，覆盖空间数据集与 OOD 数据集，表现出更好的性能与泛化。
Conclusion: 空间 agent 能力可以通过把已验证轨迹当特权信息做 on-policy 自蒸馏内化到免工具 MLLM 中，且比 SFT、GRPO 更能兼顾空间任务与分布外泛化。

papers.title: FlyMark: Training-Free Invisible Watermarking of 3D Gaussian Splatting via a Fruit Fly Connectome
papers.abstract_en: A trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene ships as a portable parameter array that can be copied, pruned, requantized, or repackaged outside its training pipeline, so ownership evidence is most useful when it lives in the released parameters and remains checkable long after the embedding tooling is gone. Existing 3DGS watermarks typically tie embedding or extraction to scene optimization, a learned decoder, or rendered views, so the evidence survives only as long as a second trained artifact does. FlyMark instead writes a keyed message into the parameters a 3DGS file already stores. Its carrier directions are derived from the photoreceptors of a published connectome, a citable versioned artifact that fixes the geometry exhaustively and leaves nothing to tune per scene. A virtual observer reads cone-wise apparent luminance along a scene-normalized orbit from stored centers, colors, and opacities; a keyed dithered quantization-index-modulation code replicates each message bit across these observations; and one sparse bounded least-squares solve realizes the targets through achromatic shifts of existing degree-zero colors under a hard per-channel linear-RGB bound. All geometry and higher-order appearance parameters are preserved bit-identically, and extraction needs only cone queries, rounding, and majority voting. Under a model-domain threat model on synthetic and real scenes, FlyMark attains high clean bit accuracy and visual fidelity while cleanly separating matched from wrong keys.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlyMark 把带密钥的消息直接写进 3DGS 已存储的参数里，载体方向取自已发表的果蝇 connectome 光感受器几何，提取只需锥细胞查询、取整和多数投票，无需任何训练或渲染视图。在合成与真实场景的模型域威胁模型下，它取得高干净位准确率与视觉保真度，并能干净区分匹配密钥与错误密钥。
Motivation: 3DGS 场景以可移植参数数组形式发布，可被复制、剪枝、重量化或重新打包；现有水印方案把嵌入或提取绑定在场景优化、学习解码器或渲染视图上，证据随第二个训练产物一起失效。
Method: 载体方向由已发表 connectome 的光感受器确定（可引用、版本固定、无需逐场景调参）；虚拟观察者沿场景归一化的轨道从存储的中心、颜色、不透明度读取逐锥视亮度；带密钥的抖动量化索引调制 (QIM) 码把每个消息位复制到多次观测上；一次稀疏有界最小二乘求解通过零阶颜色的无彩色偏移实现目标，每通道线性 RGB 有硬上界。所有几何与高阶外观参数按位保持不变。

papers.title: UniData: Universal Multimodal Instruction Generation Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly being applied in a wider range of real-world scenarios. However, due to the substantial labor cost, creating high-quality multimodal instruction datasets for MLLMs remains a significant challenge. Although some methods propose to generate instruction data, they often face limitations in modality support and struggle with generating multi-round instructions. To address these problems, we introduce UniData, a universal instruction generation pipeline, to transform simple user requirements into multi-round, multimodal instructions. Specifically, UniData first expands user requirements into multiple diverse events. Using these events, UniData then integrates an any-to-any large model for multimodal instruction generation. Finally, UniData enhances data quality by correcting irrelevant and redundant inference flow, leveraging correlations between instruction rounds. To train this pipeline, we also build UniDataset, a dataset comprising 20,000 entries across nine modalities for improved multimodal generation. Our experiments demonstrate that UniData achieves SOTA performance in data quality and can also enhance the understanding and generation capabilities of other multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniData 把简单用户需求扩写成多个多样事件，再用 any-to-any 大模型生成多轮、跨模态指令，并通过修正无关与冗余推理流、利用轮次间相关性来提升数据质量。配套构建含 20,000 条、覆盖九种模态的 UniDataset 训练该流水线，实验显示其数据质量达到 SOTA，并能提升其他多模态模型的理解与生成能力。
Motivation: 高质量多模态指令数据集的人工成本高，已有指令数据生成方法在模态覆盖上受限，且难以生成多轮指令。
Method: UniData 流水线分三步：把用户需求扩写为多个多样事件；接入 any-to-any 大模型基于这些事件做多轮多模态指令生成；再通过修正无关与冗余的推理流、利用指令轮次间的相关性来增强数据质量。训练该流水线所用的 UniDataset 含 20,000 条数据、覆盖九种模态。
Result: 实验表明 UniData 在数据质量上达到 SOTA，并能增强其他多模态模型的理解与生成能力；训练集 UniDataset 规模为 20,000 条、九种模态。
Conclusion: 把需求扩写、any-to-any 生成与推理流修正串成一条流水线，可以在降低人工成本的同时产出高质量、多轮、跨模态的指令数据，并迁移到其他多模态模型。

papers.title: Bernoulli Flow Models: Self-Consistent Generative Modeling for Binary Data
papers.abstract_en: Binary diffusion models typically require a large number of function evaluations (NFEs) to generate high-quality samples, making practical inference computationally expensive. Reducing NFEs while preserving sample quality without distillation or additional training remains a significant challenge. Existing binary diffusion models define a discrete one-step forward path and then derive the reverse posterior. In low-NFE settings requiring cross-step sampling, they approximate the true multi-step likelihood with a single-step likelihood transition, which severely degrades sample quality. To address this fundamental limitation and decouple the generative dynamics from fixed discrete time steps, we propose Bernoulli Flow Models (BFM). Rather than relying on sequential one-step Markov diffusion chains, BFM defines a unified continuous global Bernoulli probability flow path between data distributions and pure noise, from which we derive analytical closed-form posterior transitions over arbitrary time intervals. Consequently, reducing the inference NFE is no longer an approximation based on skipping discrete steps; it only requires re-evaluating the analytical posterior over a new time grid. This eliminates the structural training-inference mismatch inherent to discrete chains and yields self-consistent low-NFE sampling. Experiments show that BFM is highly robust to aggressive NFE reduction. On LSUN Churches 256x256, a BFM trained with 256 steps achieves an FID of 9.22 using only 16 sampling steps, whereas the state-of-the-art discrete baseline degrades to 204.10. BFM also remains competitive with continuous and discrete generative baselines under standard full-step inference. These results establish BFM as a theoretically rigorous, self-consistent, and practically effective framework for fast binary data generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 二值扩散 (binary diffusion) 在低 NFE 采样时用单步似然近似多步后验，导致样本质量崩坏。Bernoulli Flow Models (BFM) 在数据分布与纯噪声之间定义统一的连续全局 Bernoulli 概率流路径，给出任意时间区间上的解析闭式后验，降 NFE 只需在新时间网格上重算后验。在 LSUN Churches 256x256 上，256 步训练的 BFM 用 16 步采样 FID 9.22，而 SOTA 离散基线退化到 204.10。
Motivation: 二值扩散生成高质量样本需要大量函数评估 (NFEs)，推理代价高；低 NFE 下跨步采样被迫用单步似然转移近似真实多步似然，样本质量严重下降，且不靠蒸馏或额外训练很难缓解。
Method: BFM 弃用顺序一步 Markov 扩散链，改为在数据分布与纯噪声之间定义统一的连续全局 Bernoulli 概率流路径，从中推导任意时间区间上的解析闭式后验转移；降低 NFE 等价于在新的时间网格上重新求值该解析后验，从而消除离散链固有的训练-推理不匹配。
Result: 在 LSUN Churches 256x256 上，以 256 步训练的 BFM 仅用 16 步采样达到 FID 9.22，而同期 SOTA 离散基线退化到 FID 204.10；在标准全步推理下 BFM 与连续及离散生成基线相比仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 把二值生成动力学从固定离散时间步解耦成连续概率流，可以在不蒸馏、不额外训练的前提下实现自洽的低 NFE 采样，作者据此称 BFM 为理论上严格且实用的快速二值数据生成框架。

papers.title: SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model
papers.abstract_en: A 4D audio-visual scene comprises a video, the dynamic geometry it depicts, and the sound sources that populate it, each with its own position and trajectory. Rendering such a scene from a novel viewpoint requires that every source be available as an individual waveform, so that it can be localized in the scene and propagated to the observer before the signals are mixed. Joint audio-video generators can synthesize the video and its soundtrack, but the soundtrack is emitted as a single audio-mix in which the sources are not individually accessible. We present SepGen, which extends a pretrained audio-video generator to emit the video, the mixed soundtrack, and one waveform per captioned source in one joint sampling run. SepGen supports two complementary modes: generation and separation. In generation mode, each source caption specifies what its stem contains. A two-speaker dialogue, for example, comes out as one stem per speaker in the original turn order. In separation mode, the input audio-mix remains clean while the captions specify what to extract, so the model can decompose a recording from a free-text description. We evaluate generation on scenes synthesized from text, and separation on scenes rendered by other generators and on real recordings of speech, music, and sound effects. Given an audio-mix and captions that carry the spoken lines, SepGen outperforms language-conditioned separators, most clearly on speech, and it keeps the lead when the lines are removed from the captions. Code, checkpoints, and datasets are available at https://sepgen.github.io/
papers.comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://sepgen.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SepGen 把预训练音视频生成器扩展成单一模型，在一次联合采样中同时输出视频、混合音轨和每个 caption 声源的独立波形 (stem)。给定带台词的 caption 时它在语音分离上最明显地超过语言条件分离器，即使把台词从 caption 中去掉仍保持领先。
Motivation: 联合音视频生成器只能产出单一混合音轨，声源不可单独访问；而 4D 场景渲染要求每个声源以独立波形存在，才能先定位、再传播到观察者。
Method: 在预训练音视频生成器上扩展，一次联合采样同时生成视频、混合音轨与逐声源波形；支持生成模式（每个 caption 指定该 stem 内容，如两人对话按原话轮次各出一个 stem）与分离模式（输入保持干净混合音，caption 指定要提取的内容）。
Result: 在文本合成场景上评测生成，在其他生成器渲染的场景以及真实语音、音乐、音效录音上评测分离；给定携带台词的 caption 时优于语言条件分离器，语音最明显，去掉台词后仍保持领先。
Conclusion: 把逐声源 stem 输出放进单模型单次采样是可行的，且语言条件分离在语音上可被超越；caption 内容（是否含台词）是分离质量的关键变量。

papers.title: RaReCache: Bridging the Gap in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse via Rank disagreement-based Selective Recomputation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-model KV-cache reuse remains a key challenge in modern LLM serving. Coding agents and multi-model systems increasingly route a shared context across models: a user may switch models mid-session, or a cascade may escalate a difficult query. Because KV caches contain model-specific representations, each switch typically forces the receiving model to prefill the entire context from scratch. Recent work shows that closed-form linear maps can translate KV caches between models in the same family, but transfer accuracy degrades as the model-size gap widens. In this paper, we establish that these transfer failures are concentrated in a small subset of information-dense tokens. To bridge this gap, we introduce RaReCache, a framework that enables a large target model to decode accurately from a cache prefilled by a much smaller source via selective recomputation. RaReCache identifies these critical positions using a novel rank disagreement metric, scoring each token by the energy of its mapped KV in output directions weakly supported by the calibration data. Across two model families and five benchmarks, on a 23x parameter gap (Qwen3-0.6B to 14B) recomputing just 30% of positions retains 95-99% of the target accuracy, whereas on a 8.8x gap (Llama3-8B to 70B), recomputing 40% retains 96.5% of the target accuracy. RaReCache largely removes sensitivity to source-model size, and achieves up to a 3.04x prefill speedup. For online serving, it handles 1.8x the request throughput of target prefill on a single GPU, and at the target's saturation load, reduces median and 99th-percentile time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 5.0x and 6.4x respectively, with a 30% recompute budget. RaReCache establishes an efficient serving paradigm where small models prefill on behalf of massive targets, enabling large models to recompute only critical tokens, drastically reducing prefill latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RaReCache 让小模型替大模型预填充 KV cache，再用 rank disagreement 指标挑出信息密集 token 做选择性重算，从而跨模型复用缓存。在 23× 参数差 (Qwen3-0.6B→14B) 下只重算 30% 位置即保留目标模型 95–99% 精度，prefill 加速最高 3.04×。
Motivation: LLM 服务中用户中途换模型或级联升级时，KV cache 因模型特异表示无法直接复用，接收模型须从头 prefill 整个上下文；已有线性映射跨模型迁移在模型规模差距拉大时精度显著退化。
Method: RaReCache 用闭式线性映射把源模型 KV 迁到目标模型，并提出 rank disagreement 指标：按映射后 KV 在校准数据弱支持的输出方向上的能量给每个 token 打分，只对关键位置做重算，其余直接沿用。
Result: 在两个模型家族、五个 benchmark 上：23× 参数差 (Qwen3-0.6B→14B) 重算 30% 位置保留目标精度 95–99%；8.8× 差 (Llama3-8B→70B) 重算 40% 保留 96.5%。prefill 加速最高 3.04×；单 GPU 在线服务吞吐达目标 prefill 的 1.8×，在目标饱和负载下 median TTFT 降 5.0×、P99 TTFT 降 6.4×（30% 重算预算）。
Conclusion: 跨模型 KV 迁移的误差集中在少数信息密集 token，选择性重算即可基本消除对源模型规模的敏感性，形成小模型代为 prefill、大模型只重算关键 token 的服务范式。

papers.title: Adaptive Adversarial Augmentation for Controllable Face Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data provides a scalable alternative to real-world datasets for training face recognition models, particularly under challenging conditions such as low resolution, occlusion, and masks. Yet, most approaches lack diversity and fail to generalize effectively. We propose Ensemble Feedback Controllable Synthesis (EFCS), a guided framework that generates diverse and challenging samples while preserving visual realism. EFCS expands distributional variability, often reflected in higher FID and KID scores compared to single-feedback and random synthesis, while maintaining high precision. Recognition models trained on EFCS data consistently outperform baselines across multiple benchmarks, showing improved generalization to real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we introduce an analytically motivated formulation linking perturbation-induced difficulty, sample utility, and performance degradation, offering principled insights into balancing synthetic data complexity for optimal training. Together, these contributions establish EFCS as an effective and analytically grounded approach for bridging the gap between synthetic and real datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Ensemble Feedback Controllable Synthesis (EFCS)，用集成反馈引导的人脸合成框架生成多样且有难度的样本，同时保持视觉真实度。其 FID/KID 分数高于单反馈与随机合成但精度仍高，用 EFCS 数据训练的人脸识别模型在多个基准上稳定超过基线。

Method: EFCS 为带引导的集成反馈可控合成框架，扩展分布多样性并保持真实度；另给出一个解析形式，把扰动引入的难度、样本效用与性能下降联系起来，用于权衡合成数据复杂度。
Result: FID 与 KID 分数高于单反馈与随机合成，同时保持高精度；在 EFCS 数据上训练的人脸识别模型在多个基准上一致超过基线，对真实场景泛化改善。
Conclusion: EFCS 是有解析依据的方法，可弥合合成与真实数据差距，并为平衡合成数据复杂度提供原则性依据。

papers.title: Writing for the Reviewer: Defensive Writing in GPT Models
papers.abstract_en: Researchers increasingly use ChatGPT to revise their papers, and recent GPT versions often narrow or even retract the authors' claims. We call such changes defensive writing when the given material does not support them, and we test two explanations: the model corrects the authors' overclaiming, or it writes for an anticipated reviewer. We ask GPT versions and models from other developers to rewrite paragraphs from papers written before ChatGPT, or to write from an evidence sheet that lists a paper's method and results. Defensive writing grows with GPT version. GPT-6-astra retracts the authors' claims outright, and when it writes from the evidence sheet, it still adds the most ungrounded qualifications. The results favor the anticipated-review explanation, and correcting overclaiming explains only a small part. When the models are only asked to polish, defense stays near the level of the originals; mentioning review raises it, and one round of self-review raises it further. At the same time, fewer than one in ten of the claims GPT-6-astra retracts are overstated. AI reviewers score defensive rewrites higher, while human readers find them harder to read and the authors less certain. Combining AI writing with AI review may amplify this style.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 GPT 改稿中「材料不支撑却收窄或撤回论断」的现象定义为 defensive writing，并用两种实验区分其来源：模型在纠正作者过度声称，还是在写给假想审稿人。结果支持后者——只让润色时防御性接近原文水平，提到 review 就抬高，再做一轮 self-review 抬得更高；GPT-6-astra 撤回的论断中不到十分之一确实被夸大，而 AI 审稿人给防御性改写更高分、人类读者觉得更难读且作者显得更不确定。
Motivation: 研究者越来越多用 ChatGPT 修改论文，而新版 GPT 会收窄甚至撤回作者原有论断；需要判断这是在纠正 overclaiming，还是在迎合预期审稿人，因为后者会让 AI 写作与 AI 审稿互相放大这种文风。
Method: 让多个 GPT 版本与其他开发者模型改写 ChatGPT 出现之前写成的论文段落，或依据只列出方法与结果的 evidence sheet 写作；对比只润色、提及 review、以及一轮 self-review 三种指令下的防御性水平，并比较 AI 审稿人评分与人类读者的可读性和确定性感知。
Result: Defensive writing 随 GPT 版本递增；GPT-6-astra 直接撤回作者论断，在 evidence sheet 条件下仍加入最多无依据的限定语。仅润色时防御性接近原文，提及 review 抬高，一轮 self-review 再抬高；GPT-6-astra 撤回的论断中不到十分之一（fewer than one in ten）确属夸大。AI 审稿人给防御性改写更高分，人类读者认为更难读、作者更不确定。
Conclusion: 防御性改写主要来自对预期审稿人的迎合而非纠正过度声称，纠正只解释很小一部分；把 AI 写作与 AI 审稿组合使用可能放大这种文风。

papers.title: RL-ARC: Calibrating Large Reasoning Models via Reasoning-guided Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) are commonly trained with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to enhance their reasoning capabilities. However, since RLVR does not explicitly account for calibration during training, it can lead to severe calibration degradation, including overconfidence. Recent calibration-aware training methods for LMs, which incorporate objectives for uncertainty estimation into training, improve calibration but still exhibit overconfidence under distribution shift, while sacrificing reasoning performance. To this end, we propose RL-ARC, a calibration-aware training framework that jointly leverages reasoning confidence and answer confidence. Specifically, RL-ARC leverages reasoning confidence as an auxiliary signal for calibrating answer confidence, applying it as reasoning-guided regularization for correct cases and as an overconfidence penalty for incorrect cases. Comprehensive results across ID and OOD settings show that, beyond improving calibration, RL-ARC enables reasoning models to adaptively estimate confidence based on the given question without substantially sacrificing reasoning performance, thereby highlighting the importance of reasoning confidence for training reliable reasoning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RL-ARC 在 RLVR 训练中同时利用推理置信度与答案置信度：对答对样本用推理引导的正则化校准答案置信度，对答错样本施加过度自信惩罚。在 ID 与 OOD 设定下，该框架在改善校准的同时让推理模型按题目自适应估计置信度，且不大幅牺牲推理性能。
Motivation: RLVR 训练不显式建模校准，导致严重过度自信；已有校准感知训练方法在分布偏移 (OOD) 下仍过度自信，并牺牲推理性能。
Method: RL-ARC 是校准感知训练框架，联合使用推理置信度与答案置信度：以推理置信度作为辅助信号，对正确样本施加 reasoning-guided regularization，对错误样本施加 overconfidence penalty，在 RLVR 目标之上加入该校准项。
Result: 在 ID 与 OOD 设定的综合结果中，RL-ARC 改善校准，并使推理模型能依题目自适应估计置信度，同时不大幅牺牲推理性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 推理置信度是训练可靠推理模型的关键信号，可在不明显损失推理能力的前提下缓解 RLVR 的过度自信，尤其在分布偏移下。

papers.title: Sample-Efficient Generative Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Generative conformal prediction builds uncertainty sets from samples of a conditional generator, which are efficient only when the samples represent the response distribution well. This can require many samples, each of which can be costly, as in large diffusion models and scientific simulators, so the sampling budget must be used efficiently. Existing methods draw the same number of samples at every input, wasting samples where the response distribution is simple and undersampling where it is complex, which inflates sets and leaves those inputs under-covered. We propose CASA (Conformal Adaptive Sample Allocation), which characterizes the marginal value of an additional sample and allocates samples across inputs to minimize the expected set size subject to marginal coverage and an average sampling budget. Theoretical analysis shows that adaptive allocation yields smaller sets than a fixed count at the same budget: a missed mode forces a radius that spans the gap between modes, and even oracle radius cannot compensate for it. On synthetic and real tasks, CASA produces substantially smaller sets at the same budget, often improves conditional coverage, and complements existing radius-adaptive methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 生成式 conformal prediction 里每个输入固定采样数会浪费简单分布的样本、又让复杂分布欠采样，导致集合偏大且欠覆盖。CASA 用额外一个样本的边际价值来跨输入分配采样预算，在同等预算下得到更小的预测集合，并常改善条件覆盖。
Motivation: 条件生成器的样本要代表响应分布才有效，但大扩散模型与科学模拟器单次采样昂贵；固定采样数在简单输入上浪费、在复杂输入上欠采样，既膨胀集合又留下欠覆盖输入。
Method: 提出 CASA (Conformal Adaptive Sample Allocation)：刻画多采一个样本的边际价值，在各输入间分配样本，以在边际覆盖约束与平均采样预算下最小化期望集合大小；并给出理论分析说明同等预算下自适应分配优于固定采样数。
Result: 理论结果：同等预算下自适应分配产生更小的集合，漏掉一个模式会迫使半径跨越模式间隙，即便 oracle 半径也无法补偿。在合成与真实任务上，CASA 在同等预算下集合显著更小，常改善条件覆盖，并与现有 radius-adaptive 方法互补。
Conclusion: 采样预算应按输入的响应分布复杂度自适应分配，而不是每个输入固定采样数；CASA 与 radius-adaptive 方法是互补而非替代关系。

papers.title: EgoPhys: Estimating Peak Contact Force and Mechanical Work from Egocentric Manipulation Video
papers.abstract_en: Physically grounded manipulation of articulated objects requires understanding both the maximum forces encountered during contact and the work performed as their parts move. Peak contact force and mechanical work quantify these complementary aspects, but estimating them from egocentric video is challenging because physical interaction cues are local and indirect. Moreover, peak force is associated with brief contact events, whereas mechanical work depends on force-motion coupling throughout the contact duration. To address these challenges, we propose EgoPhys, an RGB-only framework comprising Contact-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CASA) and Target-Specific Multi-Expert Temporal Routing (TMTR). CASA integrates appearance and geometry features to emphasize interaction-relevant cues, while TMTR models semantic, event, and motion cues with specialized temporal experts and routes them separately for force and work prediction. On the test split from Hoi! dataset, EgoPhys substantially improves predictions of peak force and mechanical work, achieving MAEs of \(5.205 \pm 0.584\) $N$ and $0.894 \pm 0.081$ $J$, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoPhys 用纯 RGB 的第一人称视频估计铰接物体操作中的峰值接触力与机械功：CASA 融合外观与几何特征突出交互线索，TMTR 用语义、事件、运动三个时间专家分别路由给力与功两个目标。在 Hoi! 数据集测试集上峰值力 MAE 为 5.205±0.584 N，机械功 MAE 为 0.894±0.081 J。
Motivation: 峰值接触力集中在短暂接触事件，机械功依赖整个接触时长内的力-运动耦合，二者时空尺度不同；而第一人称视频中的物理交互线索局部且间接，难以直接回归这两个量。
Method: 提出 RGB-only 框架 EgoPhys：Contact-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CASA) 整合外观与几何特征以强调交互相关线索；Target-Specific Multi-Expert Temporal Routing (TMTR) 用专门化时间专家分别建模语义、事件、运动线索，并为力与功两个预测目标独立路由。
Result: 在 Hoi! 数据集测试集上，峰值接触力 MAE 为 5.205±0.584 N，机械功 MAE 为 0.894±0.081 J，摘要称对两个目标的预测均有显著提升。
Conclusion: 把空间交互感知与按目标分离的多专家时间建模结合，可以从纯第一人称 RGB 视频中估计出峰值接触力与机械功这两个互补的物理量。

papers.title: SynCo: Data Synthesis Co-Training for Self-Evolving LLMs via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving LLM agents promise to improve autonomously through continual interaction and learning, reducing their dependence on manually curated supervision. Realizing this promise requires not only updating the agent, but also evolving its training experience as its capabilities change. However, most existing pipelines rely on static datasets or separately updated synthesis models, causing previously useful tasks to become trivial while overly difficult tasks remain uninformative. This growing mismatch between agent capability and training experience limits sustained self-improvement. To address this problem, we propose SynCo, an agentic data synthesis co-training framework for self-evolving LLMs based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. SynCo jointly optimizes two independently parameterized agents: a Synthesizer that constructs training tasks from the Reasoner's evolving capability state, and a Reasoner that learns from the resulting experience. Each synthesized task induces multiple Reasoner rollouts whose outcomes provide complementary rewards to both agents. Correctness feedback improves the Reasoner, while task quality, answer reliability, and outcome-grounded teachability guide the Synthesizer. Their updates are fed back into subsequent synthesis rounds, allowing the task-solving policy and its training distribution to evolve together. Extensive experiments across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SynCo substantially outperforms a broad range of existing synthetic-data methods and controlled baselines, achieving the strongest overall performance while deriving most of its gains from previously unsolved problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SynCo 把任务合成器 (Synthesizer) 与解题的 Reasoner 作为两个独立参数化的智能体联合训练，让训练数据分布随 Reasoner 能力状态演化，避免静态数据集里任务变 trivial 或过难。在八个数学推理基准上，SynCo 显著超过多种合成数据方法与受控基线，取得最强整体表现，且大部分增益来自此前未解出的题目。
Motivation: 自进化 LLM 智能体依赖静态数据集或单独更新的合成模型，导致任务难度与智能体能力逐渐错配：已会的题变得平凡、过难的题仍无信息量，限制持续自我改进。
Method: 基于多智能体强化学习的协同训练框架，联合优化两个独立参数化智能体：Synthesizer 依据 Reasoner 的能力状态构造训练任务，Reasoner 从这些任务学习；每个合成任务产生多次 Reasoner rollout，其结果为双方提供互补奖励——正确性反馈改进 Reasoner，任务质量、答案可靠性与基于结果的可教性 (outcome-grounded teachability) 引导 Synthesizer，更新结果回灌到后续合成轮次。
Result: 在八个数学推理基准上的大量实验中，SynCo 显著优于广泛的现有合成数据方法与受控基线，取得最强整体性能，且大部分增益来自此前未解决的问题。
Conclusion: 让任务求解策略与其训练分布共同演化，是维持 LLM 智能体持续自我改进的关键，合成数据的收益主要来自不断生成智能体当前刚好够不到的任务。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: SynCo 把任务合成器 (Synthesizer) 与解题的 Reasoner 作为两个独立参数化的智能体联合训练，让训练数据分布随 Reasoner 能力状态演化，避免静态数据集里任务变 trivial 或过难。在八个数学推理基准上，SynCo 显著超过多种合成数据方法与受控基线，取得最强整体表现，且大部分增益来自此前未解出的题目。
summary_sections.motivation: 自进化 LLM 智能体依赖静态数据集或单独更新的合成模型，导致任务难度与智能体能力逐渐错配：已会的题变得平凡、过难的题仍无信息量，限制持续自我改进。
summary_sections.method: 基于多智能体强化学习的协同训练框架，联合优化两个独立参数化智能体：Synthesizer 依据 Reasoner 的能力状态构造训练任务，Reasoner 从这些任务学习；每个合成任务产生多次 Reasoner rollout，其结果为双方提供互补奖励——正确性反馈改进 Reasoner，任务质量、答案可靠性与基于结果的可教性 (outcome-grounded teachability) 引导 Synthesizer，更新结果回灌到后续合成轮次。
summary_sections.result: 在八个数学推理基准上的大量实验中，SynCo 显著优于广泛的现有合成数据方法与受控基线，取得最强整体性能，且大部分增益来自此前未解决的问题。
summary_sections.conclusion: 让任务求解策略与其训练分布共同演化，是维持 LLM 智能体持续自我改进的关键，合成数据的收益主要来自不断生成智能体当前刚好够不到的任务。

papers.title: EvoSim: Learning to Model, Modeling to Learn
papers.abstract_en: Physics-based models connect scientific explanation with quantitative prediction. Constructing them requires selecting physical processes, defining states and governing equations, specifying couplings, and identifying parameters from experiments. Existing AI systems remain limited in making these model structure decisions autonomously. We introduce EvoSim, a self-evolving AI scientist for physical modeling. It uses experimental discrepancies to drive mechanism and equation revisions and held-out experimental data to test physical plausibility. Exploration traces make updates to knowledge, skills, and multi-agent orchestration. This co-evolution improves physics-based models and EvoSim's ability to select mechanisms, diagnose failures, and coordinate research. We evaluate EvoSim on two industrial battery modeling tasks. It predicts lithium-metal-plating onset from 25 to 45 degrees Celsius and 2 C to 6 C with a mean absolute error of 1.79% in state of charge. Dynamic voltage prediction under vehicle driving conditions achieves a root mean square error of 7.62 mV, surpassing the reported accuracy of models developed by human experts. Self-evolution reduces model and physics errors by approximately 36% relative to baseline, demonstrating improved scientific modeling capability. EvoSim turns experimental observations into validated models and cumulative research expertise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoSim 是一个自演化 AI 科学家，用实验偏差驱动机理与方程修订、用留出实验数据检验物理合理性，并把探索轨迹沉淀为知识、技能与多智能体编排的共同演化。在两个工业电池建模任务上，它以 1.79% SOC 的平均绝对误差预测 25–45 °C、2C–6C 下的锂金属析出起始，动态电压 RMSE 7.62 mV 超过人类专家模型的已报告精度，自演化使模型与物理误差相对基线下降约 36%。
Motivation: 现有 AI 系统在自主决定物理模型结构（选过程、定状态与方程、定耦合、辨识参数）上仍然受限，物理建模的关键决策仍依赖人工。
Method: EvoSim 以实验偏差 (experimental discrepancies) 作为信号驱动机理与方程的修订，用留出实验数据检验物理合理性；探索轨迹被用来共同演化知识、技能与多智能体编排，从而同时改进物理模型本身和 EvoSim 选择机理、诊断失败、协调研究的能力。
Result: 在两个工业电池建模任务上：锂金属析出起始预测覆盖 25–45 °C 与 2C–6C，SOC 平均绝对误差 1.79%；车辆行驶工况下的动态电压预测 RMSE 7.62 mV，超过人类专家所开发模型的已报告精度；自演化使模型误差与物理误差相对基线下降约 36%。
Conclusion: 实验观测加自演化循环可以产出经过验证的物理模型并累积可复用的研究经验，物理建模的结构决策能够由 AI 系统自主推进。

papers.title: Point-Focused Attention Meets Context-Scan State Space: Robust Biological Visual Perception for Point Cloud Representation
papers.abstract_en: Synergistically capturing intricate local structures and global contextual dependencies has become a critical challenge in point cloud representation learning. To address this, we introduce PointLearner, a point cloud representation learning network that closely aligns with biological vision which employs an active, foveation-inspired processing strategy, thus enabling local geometric modeling and long-range dependency interactions simultaneously. Specifically, we first design a point-focused attention, which simulates foveal vision at the visual focus through a competitive normalized attention mechanism between local neighbors and spatially downsampled features. The spatially downsampled features are extracted by a pooling method based on learnable inducing points, which can flexibly adapt to the non-uniform distribution of point clouds as the number of inducing points is controlled and they interact directly with point clouds. Second, we propose a context-scan state space that mimics eye's saccade inference, which infers the overall semantic structure and spatial content in the scene through a scan path guided by the Hilbert curve for the bidirectional S6. With this focus-then-context biomimetic design, PointLearner demonstrates remarkable robustness and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple point cloud tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PointLearner 用仿生物视觉的两段设计做点云表征：点聚焦注意力 (point-focused attention) 在视觉焦点处用局部邻居与可学习诱导点池化特征的竞争归一化注意力建模局部几何，上下文扫描状态空间 (context-scan state space) 沿 Hilbert 曲线引导的扫描路径对双向 S6 推断场景整体语义。焦点先行、上下文随后的设计在多个点云任务上取得 state-of-the-art 表现并展现强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 点云表征学习需要同时捕捉复杂局部结构与全局上下文依赖，而现有方法难以在非均匀分布的点上兼顾局部几何建模与长程依赖交互。
Method: 点聚焦注意力用局部邻居与空间下采样特征之间的竞争归一化注意力模拟中央凹视觉，下采样特征由基于可学习诱导点的池化得到，诱导点数量可控且与点云直接交互以适应非均匀分布；上下文扫描状态空间用 Hilbert 曲线引导的扫描路径驱动双向 S6，模拟眼动扫视推断场景整体语义与空间内容。
Result: 在多个点云任务上达到 state-of-the-art 性能并展现显著鲁棒性；摘要未给出具体数据集名称与指标数值。
Conclusion: 焦点先行、上下文随后的仿生设计能同时处理局部几何与长程依赖，是点云表征学习取得 SOTA 与鲁棒性的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReCast: Attribution-Oriented Step Representation Learning for LLM-Based Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: In LLM-based agent systems, failures can originate from early steps whose effects propagate through subsequent interactions, making their origins difficult to identify. To trace such failures back to their origin, failure attribution has been formulated as the task of identifying the earliest step responsible for the failure. Recent methods leverage LLM internal signals for failure attribution, typically using hidden states as step representations. We therefore conduct an empirical study to evaluate how effectively these representations distinguish root-cause steps from other steps and find limited separation. Motivated by this observation, we propose ReCast, a step representation learning method that transforms hidden states from a frozen LLM into attribution-oriented step representations. ReCast first selects attribution-relevant layers, then constructs complementary pattern and deviation features, and finally learns contextualized step representations through an encoder trained with contrastive and ranking objectives. We also introduce ReCast-2K, a training dataset for failure attribution. ReCast achieves the best Hit@1 across four benchmarks, surpassing the strongest baseline by 5.65 and 9.19 pp on Who&When Algorithm and Handcrafted, respectively. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ReCast-5FB6 .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCast 把冻结 LLM 的 hidden states 转成面向归因的步骤表征：先选归因相关层，再构造互补的 pattern 与 deviation 特征，最后用对比与排序目标训练编码器。在四个失败归因基准上 Hit@1 全部最佳，相对最强基线在 Who&When Algorithm 与 Handcrafted 上分别高出 5.65 与 9.19 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM agent 的失败可能源于早期步骤并沿交互传播，难以定位根因；现有方法直接用 hidden states 作步骤表征，实证发现其区分根因步骤与其他步骤的能力有限。
Method: ReCast 分三步：从冻结 LLM 中筛选 attribution 相关层，构造互补的 pattern 与 deviation 特征，再用带 contrastive 与 ranking 目标的 encoder 学习上下文化的步骤表征；同时发布训练数据集 ReCast-2K。
Result: 在四个失败归因基准上取得最佳 Hit@1，相对最强基线在 Who&When Algorithm 上高 5.65 pp、在 Who&When Handcrafted 上高 9.19 pp。
Conclusion: hidden states 原始分离度不足，需经归因导向的表征学习才能有效区分根因步骤；ReCast-2K 与代码一并开源。

papers.title: TokenBank: Financial Infrastructure for AI Services
papers.abstract_en: AI services incur inference costs during execution, while revenue may arrive later. Changing API prices, limited upfront capital, and service failures can limit operators' ability to sustain or expand their services. Beyond reducing per-request costs, operators need to plan future spending, fund execution before revenue arrives, and obtain compensation for specified losses. This requires clear agreements across services with different pricing and execution conditions. These agreements must distinguish rights to consume services from rights to receive payments, define obligations under uncertain costs and income, and specify which failures qualify for compensation and how much can be paid. We present TokenBank, a financial infrastructure that represents these commitments through structured contracts. It supports service-consumption rights, agreements that settle API-price differences in cash (forwards), financing through limited rights to future service revenue, and protection claims for specified service failures. Contracts specify participants, covered services, validity, ownership, fulfillment conditions, and settlement rules. Evaluation combines replay of 899,441 API requests, real model-driven agent execution, and contract API tests. In a zero-discount rising-price resampling scenario, forwards reduce mean expenditure by USD 304.88 but increase its standard deviation from USD 1,152.45 to USD 1,190.82. A controlled replication with five portfolios per capital condition finds mean contribution differences between financing and self-funding of +1.0635, -0.1406, and -0.2962 experimental USD under low, baseline, and ample capital, respectively. The evaluation distinguishes contract correctness from economic effectiveness under declared economic and failure assumptions; supplier invoices and commercial revenue are unavailable.
papers.comment: The cloud infrastructure repository is available at https://github.com/Nexilume-AI/nexus-cloud. The hosted deployment can be accessed at https://cloud.nexilume.com/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TokenBank 把 AI 服务的推理成本承诺做成结构化金融合约，区分服务消费权与收款权，并支持 API 价格差现金结算的 forward、以未来服务收入有限权利融资、以及指定故障的赔付保护。在 899,441 条 API 请求重放中，零折价涨价重采样场景下 forward 使平均支出降低 304.88 美元，但标准差从 1,152.45 升到 1,190.82 美元。
Motivation: AI 服务先支出后收款，API 价格变动、前期资本受限与服务故障会削弱运营者维持或扩张服务的能力，需要跨服务、跨定价与执行条件的清晰合约安排。
Method: 以结构化合约表示承诺，合约规定参与者、覆盖服务、有效期、所有权、履约条件与结算规则；支持服务消费权、现金结算 API 价格差的 forward、以未来服务收入有限权利融资、以及指定故障赔付。评估结合 899,441 条 API 请求重放、真实模型驱动 agent 执行与合约 API 测试。
Result: 零折价涨价重采样场景下 forward 使平均支出减少 304.88 美元，同时标准差从 1,152.45 升至 1,190.82 美元。受控复现在每种资本条件下各取五个投资组合，融资相对自筹的平均贡献差在低、基准、充裕资本下分别为 +1.0635、-0.1406、-0.2962 实验美元。
Conclusion: 合约在声明的经济与故障假设下可区分合约正确性与经济有效性；融资相对自筹的优势随资本充裕度由正转负，且供应商发票与商业收入不可得。

papers.title: PathLang: A Language-Centered Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong visual perception ability, but their robustness in the language domain remains poorly characterized. Existing pathology VLM benchmarks largely rely on canonical closed-set prompts or perturb only generic templates, treating language as a fixed evaluation component rather than a variable axis of model behavior. In clinical practice, however, diagnostic language varies across reports, institutions, and candidate diagnoses. We introduce PathLang, a language-centered and clinically grounded zero-shot benchmark. PathLang holds the underlying slides, ground-truth labels, and image-text evaluation direction fixed while systematically varying only the diagnostic language, so that performance differences reflect how a diagnosis is phrased rather than what is imaged. The language variation follows how pathologists actually rephrase diagnoses (terminology, specificity, and reporting style), and all prompts and candidate pools are validated by six board-certified pathologists. PathLang covers four task families: (1) zero-shot classification with image-text alignment analysis, (2) cross-modal retrieval, (3) paraphrase robustness, including semantic-equivalence paraphrases, length and reporting-style variation, and prompt ensembling, and (4) open-vocabulary diagnosis retrieval over four candidate pools with distinct forms of semantic competition. Across nine VLMs and five public datasets spanning four organs, we find that performance is highly sensitive to clinically equivalent paraphrases, varies substantially across forms of semantic competition, and that image-text alignment quality does not necessarily translate into inter-class separability. We release the prompt corpus, candidate pools, pre-computed text embeddings, and evaluation code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PathLang.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PathLang 是一个以语言为唯一变量的病理 VLM 零样本基准：固定切片、标签与图文评测方向，只按病理医生真实的改写方式（术语、特异度、报告风格）变换诊断表述，提示词与候选池经六位 board-certified 病理医生验证。在九个 VLM、五个公开数据集、四个器官上，性能对临床等价改写高度敏感，随语义竞争形式显著变化，且图文对齐好并不等于类间可分性好。
Motivation: 现有病理 VLM 基准多用封闭式固定提示或只扰动通用模板，把语言当作固定评测成分；而临床诊断语言在报告、机构与候选诊断之间本就多变，模型语言域鲁棒性缺乏刻画。
Method: 提出语言中心、临床落地的零样本基准 PathLang，固定切片、真值标签与图文评测方向，仅系统改变诊断表述；变化维度依病理医生实际改写习惯（术语、特异度、报告风格），提示与候选池由六位 board-certified 病理医生验证。覆盖四类任务：零样本分类与图文对齐分析、跨模态检索、改写鲁棒性（语义等价改写、长度与报告风格变化、prompt ensembling）、以及四种语义竞争形式的开放词表诊断检索。
Result: 在九个 VLM、五个公开数据集、四个器官上：性能对临床等价改写高度敏感，随语义竞争形式差异显著，且图文对齐质量不必然转化为类间可分性。发布提示语料、候选池、预计算文本嵌入与评测代码。
Conclusion: 病理 VLM 的语言域鲁棒性是独立于视觉感知的能力轴，评测必须把表述方式当作变量；图文对齐分数不能当作类间可分性的代理。

papers.title: Mine Odyssey: Benchmarking Spatial Agentic Intelligence in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Advances in foundation models are driving efforts to introduce agents to assist people in the physical world. Such agents require agentic spatial intelligence: exploring unfamiliar environments, updating spatial understanding through interaction, and adapting actions based on feedback to sustain progress toward a sequence of goals. Existing benchmarks cover only a limited range of spatial layouts, scales, and traversal requirements. We introduce Mine Odyssey, a benchmark for evaluating agentic spatial intelligence using Minecraft reconstructions of real-world locations. It comprises 180 tasks covering 30 such locations across 20 countries and regions on five continents, including 20 outdoor and 10 indoor settings. These settings span diverse spatial scales, layouts, terrains, and connectivity patterns, from Midtown Manhattan and rural Entrup to Santa Lucía Hill and Buckingham Palace. We select meaningful waypoints, such as landmarks, buildings, and rooms, and manually verify their accessibility. Each task provides a natural-language instruction specifying which waypoints to visit and in what order. Completing these tasks requires agents to find accessible routes and entrances, open doors, and move between levels using stairs and ladders, while monitoring their progress and recovering from navigation errors. Across eight evaluated state-of-the-art models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 85.6%. However, the second-best model, Claude Opus 5.5, completes 73.9% of tasks, while the strongest evaluated open-weight model, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, reaches 23.9%, highlighting substantial room for improvement in the agentic spatial intelligence of current models. Comprehensive analyses and ablation studies on Mine Odyssey reveal current models' limitations and provide insights for advancing agentic spatial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mine Odyssey 用真实地点的 Minecraft 复原场景评测智能体的空间行动能力：180 个任务覆盖 20 个国家和地区的 30 个地点，含 20 个室外与 10 个室内场景，任务要求按自然语言指令依次访问路点、找路线与入口、开关门、用楼梯梯子换层并从导航错误中恢复。八个前沿模型中 GPT-6 Astra 成功率 85.6%，Claude Opus 5.5 为 73.9%，最强开源模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 仅 23.9%，说明开源模型与闭源模型在该能力上差距悬殊。
Motivation: 现有基准覆盖的空间布局、尺度与穿行要求有限，无法刻画智能体在陌生环境中探索、随交互更新空间理解、并据反馈调整动作以推进连续目标的能力。
Method: 以真实地点的 Minecraft 复原场景构建基准，人工核验地标、建筑、房间等路点的可达性；每个任务给出自然语言指令，规定访问哪些路点及顺序，要求智能体自行找可达路线与入口、开门、经楼梯梯子换层，并监控进度与从导航错误中恢复；对八个前沿模型评测并做综合分析与消融研究。
Result: 共 180 个任务、30 个真实地点、20 个国家和地区、五大洲，含 20 个室外与 10 个室内设置；八个前沿模型中 GPT-6 Astra 成功率最高为 85.6%，次优 Claude Opus 5.5 完成 73.9%，最强开源模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 达 23.9%。
Conclusion: 当前模型的 agentic spatial intelligence 仍有很大提升空间，开源与闭源模型之间差距尤为突出（23.9% 对 85.6%）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: It's Always 10:10: Reference Images Break a Bias That Prompts Only Dent
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image models appear to reproduce the habits of the photographs they learned from. Analog clocks are an extreme case: in advertising, watches almost always show 10:10, and generated clocks return to 10:10 even when another time is requested. We measure this bias and test three ways of overcoming it on 52 models available on the Magnific platform, with a replication on Higgsfield. Every image shows three identical clocks that must show 2:35, 6:50 and 11:20. The description of the object is fixed and only the request about the time changes: no time (A), the time in digits (B), the hand positions described by construction relative to the dial numerals (C), or the same description plus a drawn reference dial (D). Two AI readers read all 1,799 images blind from coded copies, with a third reader and the author settling disagreements (dial-level agreement 96.0% and 97.3%). With no time requested, 67% of the images have all three clocks at 10:10. On the 20 current models, all three clocks are correct in 34% of the images with digits, 30% with the hands described in words and 75% with the reference dial (D-B: +37 points, 95% CI +28 to +45); we found no evidence that describing the hands in words beats the digits (C-B: -4 points, CI -10 to +1). The replication on the 12 models shared by both platforms gives the same picture (B 54%, C 50%, D 81%). Writing the time reduces the bias but leaves two thirds of the images of the 20 current models with at least one wrong clock; adding a drawn reference raises full accuracy to three quarters and almost eliminates images entirely at 10:10. We release all images, prompts, raw readings and a script that recomputes every result.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Data and code: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23224681
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 测得文生图模型存在 10:10 模拟钟表偏置：不指定时间时 67% 的图像三个钟全显示 10:10。在 20 个当前模型上，写明数字时间仅 34% 三钟全对，改为文字描述指针位置 30%（无优势），附上手绘参考表盘升至 75%（D-B +37 点，95% CI +28 到 +45），并几乎消除全 10:10 图像。
Motivation: 文生图模型复现训练照片的拍摄习惯，广告中手表几乎总是 10:10，导致即使指定其他时间也常被拉回 10:10；需要量化该偏置并检验提示词层面的破解办法。
Method: 在 Magnific 平台 52 个模型上测试（Higgsfield 复现），每图三个相同钟表须显示 2:35、6:50、11:20，物体描述固定，仅改变时间请求：不写时间 (A)、数字 (B)、按表盘数字相对位置描述指针 (C)、加手绘参考表盘 (D)。两个 AI 读图器盲读 1,799 张编码副本图像，分歧由第三个读图器与作者裁定，表盘级一致率 96.0% 与 97.3%。
Result: 不指定时间时 67% 图像三钟全为 10:10。20 个当前模型上三钟全对比例：数字 34%、文字描述指针 30%、参考表盘 75%（D-B +37 点，95% CI +28 到 +45；C-B -4 点，CI -10 到 +1）。两平台共有的 12 个模型复现一致：B 54%、C 50%、D 81%。写时间后 20 个当前模型仍有三分之二图像至少一个钟错误。
Conclusion: 写明时间只能部分削弱 10:10 偏置，附手绘参考表盘才把三钟全对率提到约四分之三并几乎消除全 10:10 图像；文字描述指针位置并不优于直接写数字。

papers.title: Finsler Flow Matching: Dynamics-Aware Geodesic Interpolation for Single-Snapshot Trajectory Inference
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell snapshot data can resolve a continuum of cellular states but do not uniquely determine the dynamics governing transitions between them. However, additional dynamical information can often be encoded in a cell-cell Markov transition kernel. Existing generative approaches for single cell trajectory inference either infer transport only from population marginals, impose a symmetric geometry on the state space, or incorporate directionality through a single velocity vector at each observed state. We introduce Finsler Flow Matching (FFM), a framework for learning continuous stochastic dynamics from discrete Markov transition graphs. We use the first and second local moments to construct a Finsler structure motivated by the Freidlin--Wentzell action, where the second moment determines anisotropic accessibility and the first moment introduces a preferred direction of motion. We learn neural approximations of the resulting directed geodesics, use their Finsler cost to construct source-target couplings, and define geometry-aware stochastic conditional paths that can be distilled into a continuous generative process through simulation-free score and flow matching. Across synthetic and single-cell trajectory inference benchmarks, FFM improves recovery of withheld intermediate populations, particularly when the transition dynamics are strongly directional or anisotropic. Our results provide a principled route from discrete transition probabilities to continuous generative dynamics while retaining both directional and diffusive structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Finsler Flow Matching (FFM) 从单细胞离散 Markov 转移图学出连续随机动力学：用转移核的一阶与二阶局部矩构造 Freidlin–Wentzell 意义下的 Finsler 结构，二阶矩决定各向异性可达性、一阶矩给出运动偏好方向，再经无模拟的 score 与 flow matching 蒸馏成生成过程。在合成与单细胞轨迹推断基准上，FFM 改进了被留出的中间群体 (withheld intermediate populations) 的恢复，且在转移动力学强方向性或强各向异性时改善最明显。
Motivation: 单快照 (single-snapshot) 单细胞数据能给出连续状态谱，却不能唯一确定状态间转移动力学；已有方法要么只从群体边缘分布推断输运、要么在状态空间上强加对称几何、要么每个观测状态只用一个速度向量表达方向性。
Method: 以 cell-cell Markov 转移核为输入，取其一阶与二阶局部矩构造 Finsler 结构（二阶矩定各向异性可达性，一阶矩定偏好方向）；用神经网络逼近对应的有向测地线 (directed geodesics)，以其 Finsler 代价构造 source-target coupling，定义几何感知的随机条件路径，最后通过 simulation-free 的 score matching 与 flow matching 蒸馏为连续生成过程。
Result: 在合成基准与单细胞轨迹推断基准上，FFM 提升了对被留出的中间群体的恢复，且这一改进在转移动力学强方向性或强各向异性时尤为突出；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张：从离散转移概率到连续生成动力学存在一条有原则的路径，前提是同时保留方向性与扩散结构，而非只用对称几何或单点速度。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DivMoE: Fine-Grained MoE Upcycling via Cross-Domain Expert Composition
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become essential for scaling large language models, with recent work demonstrating the benefits of fine-grained expert designs. Training such models from scratch is expensive, and sparse upcycling from pre-trained dense models is an attractive alternative. However, we identify a structural pathology of fine-grained upcycling: when fine-grained experts are derived from a single source model, naive routing collapses and downstream accuracy drops to near-random (e.g., on Qwen3-1.7B, Drop-Upcycling-fine-grained reaches only 23.2% average accuracy across 15 benchmarks, essentially matching from-scratch training at 22.2%, while the same method's coarse-grained variant reaches 50.2%). We propose DivMoE, the first framework achieving fine-grained MoE Upcycling with structurally-balanced routing. DivMoE introduces domain-specialized fine-grained expert initialization, deriving experts from dense models that have undergone domain-adaptive continual pre-training, and diversity-constrained routing, a hard structural constraint guaranteeing that each token activates experts from distinct domain groups. Across two base models and 15 benchmarks, DivMoE consistently outperforms six upcycling baselines (55.6% vs. 51.6% for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B) and strictly improves over the dense base model on every benchmark after Stage 2 continual pre-training -- closing the regression gap that has plagued prior fine-grained upcycling. After supervised fine-tuning on a public reasoning mixture, our 12B-parameter DivMoE model matches Moonlight-MoE (16B) at 64.5% average accuracy while outperforming a controlled NVIDIA-Upcycling baseline by 6.1 percentage points.
papers.comment: 19 pages, published as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DivMoE 指出细粒度 MoE upcycling 的结构性病理：专家都从单一 dense 源模型派生会导致路由塌缩，Qwen3-1.7B 上 Drop-Upcycling-fine-grained 15 个 benchmark 平均仅 23.2%，几乎等同从头训练的 22.2%，而同法粗粒度变体达 50.2%。改用领域持续预训练后的 dense 模型分别初始化专家，再加 diversity-constrained routing 硬约束每个 token 激活来自不同领域组的专家，平均准确率提到 55.6%。
Motivation: 细粒度专家能提升 MoE 扩展性，但从单一 dense 模型切出的细粒度专家彼此同质，朴素路由会塌缩、下游准确率掉到接近随机，使细粒度 upcycling 相对从头训练失去优势。
Method: DivMoE 含两个组件：domain-specialized fine-grained expert initialization，即从经过领域自适应持续预训练 (domain-adaptive continual pre-training) 的 dense 模型派生专家；diversity-constrained routing，硬性保证每个 token 激活的专家来自不同领域组。在两个 base model、15 个 benchmark 上对比六个 upcycling 基线，之后在公开推理数据混合上做监督微调。
Result: Qwen3-1.7B 上 Drop-Upcycling-fine-grained 平均 23.2%（从头训练 22.2%，粗粒度变体 50.2%）；DivMoE 55.6%，对最强基线 51.6% 领先 4.0 个百分点，且 Stage 2 持续预训练后每个 benchmark 都严格优于 dense base。12B 参数 DivMoE 经 SFT 后平均 64.5%，追平 Moonlight-MoE (16B)，比受控 NVIDIA-Upcycling 基线高 6.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 细粒度 upcycling 的回归问题源于专家同质导致的路由塌缩，用领域分化初始化加结构平衡路由即可在更少参数下追平更大 MoE。

papers.title: MetaEncoder: Exploring the Limit of Bi-Encoders for Multimodal System One Decision Making with Natural Language Interface
papers.abstract_en: System One models output constrained decisions and probability distributions rather than free-form text generation. While prevailing paradigms rely on structured schema objects to encode state, intent, and candidate choices, we revisit a fully natural language-based System One interface. In this framework, both the user request and each candidate option are expressed in natural language, supported by multimodal (image and video) auxiliary inputs. We introduce MetaEncoder, which fine-tunes a pre-trained Muse-Glimmer 30B decoder into an instruction-following decision-making encoder. To scale effectively across both small closed-set (< 256) and massive open-set (millions) candidate spaces, MetaEncoder employs a bi-encoder architecture trained via unidirectional contrastive learning for request-candidate alignment. We conduct extensive evaluations across 11 benchmark suites and 190 tasks spanning multimodal decision-making, understanding (closed-set) and retrieval (open-set), highlighting where MetaEncoder beats SOTA multimodal encoders, as well as its current limits on reasoning-intensive tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaEncoder 把预训练 Muse-Glimmer 30B 解码器微调成遵循指令的决策编码器，用双向对比学习做请求-候选对齐的 bi-encoder，覆盖 <256 的闭集与百万级开集候选空间。在 11 个 benchmark suite、190 个任务上评测，闭集理解与开集检索中超过 SOTA 多模态编码器，但在推理密集型任务上仍有明确上限。
Motivation: System One 决策模型通常用结构化 schema 对象编码状态、意图与候选选项，作者想检验完全基于自然语言的接口能否同时支撑闭集决策与大规模开集检索。
Method: 将预训练 Muse-Glimmer 30B 解码器微调为指令跟随的决策编码器，采用 bi-架构并以单向对比学习 (unidirectional contrastive learning) 训练请求-候选对齐；输入为自然语言表达的用户请求与候选选项，辅以图像和视频多模态输入。
Result: 在 11 个 benchmark suite、共 190 个任务上评测，覆盖多模态决策、理解（闭集）与检索（开集）；MetaEncoder 在其中超过 SOTA 多模态编码器，同时在推理密集型任务上暴露当前上限。
Conclusion: 纯自然语言的 System One 接口配合 bi-encoder 对齐可以同时处理小闭集与百万级开集候选空间，但推理密集型任务仍是该路线的短板。

papers.title: Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: In diffusion transformers, low-rank branches can mitigate 4-bit weight--activation (W4A4) post-training quantization (PTQ) loss by decomposing each weight into a low-bit residual and a high-precision low-rank component. Existing low-rank PTQ approaches, however, either optimize low-rank compensation and residual quantization separately, often requiring higher ranks, or rely on second-order weight updates without explicitly modeling activation quantization error, which becomes particularly pronounced under 4-bit quantization. To address these limitations, we present \method{}, a unified framework modeling low-rank-assisted W4A4 PTQ as a coupled calibration problem and deriving optimization-based solvers from the joint objective. Eliminating the output-side low-rank factor yields a \emph{deflated Hessian} that discounts residual errors already captured by the low-rank component, while an activation-noise surrogate is incorporated to suppress activation quantization error. Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 \method{} consistently outperforms rank-4 SVDQuant in PSNR and LPIPS. It further surpasses rank-32 SVDQuant on SANA-1.6B, FLUX.1-schnell, and FLUX.1-dev with an $8\times$ smaller rank and up to $6.25\times$ faster quantization. Furthermore, on the Qwen3-8B LLM, rank-4 \method{} improves MMLU accuracy from 61.50\% to 68.17\% over rank-32 SVDQuant. Overall, \method{} achieves better W4A4 performance with substantially lower rank and quantization cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多模态扩散 Transformer 的 W4A4 PTQ 建模为低秩补偿与残差量化的耦合标定问题，消去输出侧低秩因子得到 deflated Hessian，并加入 activation-noise surrogate 抑制激活量化误差。rank-4 即在五个扩散骨干上稳定超过 rank-4 SVDQuant 的 PSNR 与 LPIPS，并在 SANA-1.6B、FLUX.1-schnell、FLUX.1-dev 上以 8 倍更小的 rank 超过 rank-32 SVDQuant，量化速度最高快 6.25 倍。
Motivation: 现有低秩 PTQ 要么把低秩补偿与残差量化分开优化因而需要更高 rank，要么只用二阶权重更新而显式忽略激活量化误差，而后者在 4-bit 下尤其严重。
Method: 将低秩辅助 W4A4 PTQ 写成耦合标定目标并从中导出基于优化的求解器：把权重拆为低比特残差加高精度低秩分量，消去输出侧低秩因子得到对残差误差打折的 deflated Hessian，同时引入 activation-noise surrogate 项压制激活量化误差。
Result: 在五个 diffusion backbone 上 rank-4 该方法的 PSNR 与 LPIPS 均稳定优于 rank-4 SVDQuant；在 SANA-1.6B、FLUX.1-schnell、FLUX.1-dev 上以 8 倍更小的 rank 超过 rank-32 SVDQuant，量化速度最高快 6.25 倍；在 Qwen3-8B LLM 上相对 rank-32 SVDQuant 将 MMLU 精度从 61.50% 提到 68.17%。
Conclusion: 把低秩分量与残差/激活量化放进同一个耦合目标，可以用低得多的 rank 和量化开销拿到更好的 W4A4 性能，且收益可迁移到 LLM 的 MMLU 精度。
