papers.title: MiniVer-V: Identifying Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Short Video Verification
papers.abstract_en: A core challenge in short-video fact-checking is identifying which evidence is sufficient to support a verification conclusion. Existing approaches either give the verifier all available evidence, introducing noise, or select evidence by topical relevance, which conflates relatedness with sufficiency. We identify evidential sufficiency as the selection criterion: whether a subset of evidence is adequate to support a confident verdict without redundancy. We introduce MiniVer-V, a benchmark of 195 short videos with three-way verdict annotations (supported, refuted, insufficient) and 5,510 multimodal evidence units spanning visual keyframes, speech transcripts, and web-retrieved external sources. We propose a two-layer verification framework that separates claim-video consistency, assessed from internal evidence, from factual verdict determination, which additionally requires external corroboration. On top of it, a sufficiency-driven greedy search assembles evidence until a sufficiency threshold is met and outputs insufficient when the candidate pool is exhausted, rather than forcing a verdict. With Claude Sonnet 4, the method reaches a Macro-F1 of 0.510 using 4.5 evidence units on average (16% of the full evidence set), statistically indistinguishable from the full-evidence baseline (0.518 with 27.7 units), while significantly improving recognition of insufficient cases over the same search without abstention. The efficiency result replicates with GPT-5.5 and holds only partially with an open-weight Qwen2.5-72B verifier. Ablations show that external evidence is indispensable for factual determination, while internal video evidence grounds the verdict in claim-video consistency. These findings suggest that evidence-efficient verification is achievable, and that explicit abstention is needed when evidence is genuinely inadequate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiniVer-V 提出以「证据充分性」而非主题相关性做短视频事实核查的证据选择：两层框架把 claim-video 一致性（内部证据）与事实判定（需外部佐证）分开，再用带充分性阈值的贪心搜索逐条加入证据，池子耗尽就输出 insufficient 而不强行给结论。Claude Sonnet 4 上 Macro-F1 0.510、平均只用 4.5 个证据单元（全量的 16%），与全证据基线 0.518（27.7 个单元）统计上不可区分。
Motivation: 短视频事实核查里，要么把全部证据塞给验证器引入噪声，要么按主题相关性选证据，把「相关」与「足以支撑结论」混为一谈。
Method: 构建 MiniVer-V 基准：195 条短视频、三分类判定标注（supported/refuted/insufficient）、5,510 个多模态证据单元（视觉关键帧、语音转写、网络检索的外部来源）。在其上提出两层验证框架，外加充分性驱动的贪心搜索，达到充分性阈值即停止，候选池耗尽则输出 insufficient。
Result: Claude Sonnet 4 上 Macro-F1 0.510，平均用 4.5 个证据单元（全量证据的 16%），与全证据基线 0.518（27.7 个单元）统计上不可区分；相对同一搜索的无弃权版本，insufficient 案例识别显著提升。效率结果在 GPT-5.5 上复现，但在开源 Qwen2.5-72B 验证器上只部分成立。消融显示外部证据对事实判定不可或缺，内部视频证据则把判定锚定在 claim-video 一致性上。
Conclusion: 证据高效的核查可行，且当证据确实不足时必须显式弃权（abstention），而不是强行给出判定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Harness Compilation: Which Decisions Should a Small Vision-Language Model Keep?
papers.abstract_en: Small vision-language models may be able to read external evidence yet struggle to obtain it. We introduce Harness Compilation (HC), an offline procedure that adapts the division of work between a frozen small VLM and its external harness. A large teacher uses student execution traces to revise reusable content and control, while a separate validation set selects the deployed harness. Deployment requires neither weight updates nor teacher calls. Across seven visual question-answering settings with students of at most 9B parameters, HC improves scores over bare students by 9.9-23.9 points, averaged over three independent builds per setting. Interventions on five runtime decision types (invocation, selection, argument generation, evidence integration and abstention) show why this allocation matters: requesting evidence and generating open queries can be costly, whereas bounded choices and reading supplied text can remain useful student work. Fact cards benefit all ten evaluated students, but decision policies transfer unevenly. Recompilation for a new student model helps when the transferred interface no longer fits the student. With 100 practice items, HC exceeds answer-only LoRA on three tasks. Larger training budgets can match or surpass a fixed harness, while combining the two improves SlideVQA beyond either alone. These findings support allocating work from measured student behavior rather than uniformly removing decisions.

papers.title: SteerCast: Retrieval-Based Latent Steering for Decoder-Only Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting aims to predict future values from historical observations and auxiliary features. We propose \textbf{SteerCast}, a retrieval-based latent steering method that improves decoder-only forecaster at inference time, without updating its parameters. SteerCast constructs a database from the training set by storing a representation of each history window together with a \emph{steering vector} computed in the forecaster's latent space, defined as the difference between representations induced by the ground-truth continuation and by the model's own prediction. At test time, SteerCast retrieves nearest neighbors for a query history, aggregates their steering vectors, and injects the resulting signal into the forecaster's hidden states at every step of autoregressive generation, guiding predictions toward trajectories consistent with similar training cases. Experiments across diverse multivariate benchmarks and multiple horizons show that SteerCast consistently improves forecasting accuracy over the fine-tuned backbone and retrieval-based baselines, while requiring no additional training beyond the original fine-tuning and using only the training set as a retrieval corpus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SteerCast 在推理期为 decoder-only 时序预报器注入检索到的隐空间转向信号：用训练集每个历史窗口的真实延续与模型自身预测在隐空间的表示差构造 steering vector，测试时检索近邻并聚合，逐步注入自回归生成的隐藏状态。在多个多元时序基准与多个预报长度上，其预报精度一致优于微调后的骨干与检索类基线，且不更新参数、无需额外训练。
Motivation: decoder-only 时序预报器在与训练分布相似的样本上仍会偏离真实轨迹，而推理期改进通常需要重训或微调；目标是在不改参数的前提下把模型拉回相似历史对应的轨迹。
Method: 从训练集构建检索库：为每个历史窗口存表示，并计算该窗口真实延续与模型预测在预报器隐空间中的表示差作为 steering vector；测试时对查询历史取最近邻、聚合其 steering vector，在自回归生成的每一步注入隐藏状态，引导预测走向与相似训练案例一致的轨迹。
Result: 在多个多元时序基准与多个预报长度上，SteerCast 的预报精度一致高于微调后的骨干模型和检索类基线；除原始微调外无需额外训练，检索语料仅用训练集。
Conclusion: 推理期的检索式隐空间转向可以在不更新参数的情况下稳定提升 decoder-only 时序预报精度，训练集本身即可充当转向信号来源。

papers.title: Multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Sequential Recommendation via Collaborative Filtering Paths
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for sequential recommendation through their ability to reason over complex multimodal data. However, existing approaches either rely solely on the target user's own interaction history, neglecting collaborative signals from neighboring users, or incur substantial computational overhead through repeated MLLM inference over long interaction histories. To address these challenges, we propose MGRASRec, a multimodal graph retrieval-augmented framework for sequential recommendation. MGRASRec injects collaborative filtering signals conditioned on the candidate item directly into the MLLM prompt by retrieving structured paths from a user-item interaction graph, extended via multimodal similarity to increase coverage beyond exact co-interaction overlap. This retrieval also surfaces the history items most relevant to the candidate at no additional cost, removing the need for recurrent summarization and keeping inference to a single forward pass per candidate. All components are unified into an augmented prompt for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an MLLM. Extensive evaluations across three publicly available datasets validate the effectiveness of MGRASRec, achieving the best performance on all metrics with particularly strong gains in ranking quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MGRASRec 把用户-物品交互图上的协同过滤路径按候选物品检索出来，再用多模态相似度扩展覆盖，直接注入 MLLM prompt，使序列推荐只需对每个候选做一次前向推理。在三个公开数据集上全部指标取得最佳，排序质量提升尤其明显。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 序列推荐要么只用目标用户自身交互历史、丢掉邻居用户的协同信号，要么对长交互历史反复调用 MLLM 推理，计算开销很大。
Method: MGRASRec 从用户-物品交互图中按候选物品检索结构化路径注入 MLLM prompt，并用多模态相似度扩展路径以超出精确共交互重叠的覆盖范围；检索同时挑出与候选最相关的历史物品，省去反复摘要，全部组件合成一个增强 prompt 做参数高效微调 (parameter-efficient fine-tuning)。
Result: 在三个公开可用数据集上的评测中，MGRASRec 在所有指标上取得最佳性能，排序质量 (ranking quality) 方面的提升尤其突出；推理保持每候选一次前向传播。
Conclusion: 把协同信号按候选物品以图路径形式注入 prompt，可以在降低 MLLM 推理开销的同时提升序列推荐效果，尤其改善排序质量。

papers.title: When Lower Reconstruction Loss Hurts: Distributionally Robust Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) relies heavily on reconstruction loss minimization to preserve model quality at low precision. We show that the weights favored by minimizing this loss need not yield better model performance on new tasks. In fact, we find that lower reconstruction loss can even degrade model performance on the same calibration data. Our analysis further shows that weights with lower reconstruction loss on calibration data can have higher loss than other weights when the distribution of input activations changes. Motivated by these observations and our analysis, we propose Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ), a post-hoc refinement process that minimizes worst-case reconstruction loss over a constrained set of input activation distributions. DRQ refines the integer codes representing quantized weights within the existing quantization grid, keeping quantization parameters and inference operators unchanged. Extensive experiments show that DRQ improves models quantized by six representative PTQ methods, including AWQ, GPTQ, and ParoQuant, and delivers gains across both dense and mixture-of-experts large language models. These results establish DRQ as a general post-hoc refinement framework for weight-only PTQ, achieving better downstream performance without adding inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低比特 weight-only PTQ 中，最小化重建损失选出的权重在输入激活分布变化时反而可能更差，甚至在同一批校准数据上就降低模型性能。提出 DRQ：在既有量化网格内对整数码做后处理精修，最小化受约束激活分布集合上的最坏情形重建损失，量化参数与推理算子不变。在 AWQ、GPTQ、ParoQuant 等六种 PTQ 方法及 dense 与 MoE 大模型上均带来下游性能提升，且不增加推理开销。
Motivation: weight-only PTQ 高度依赖重建损失最小化来保住低精度下的模型质量，但该损失偏好选出的权重在新任务上未必更好，输入激活分布一变，校准集上损失更低的权重可能比其他权重损失更高。
Method: 提出 Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ)，一个后处理精修过程：在受约束的输入激活分布集合上最小化最坏情形重建损失，只在既有量化网格内精修表示量化权重的整数码，量化参数与推理算子保持不变。
Result: 在六种代表性 PTQ 方法（含 AWQ、GPTQ、ParoQuant）量化后的模型上均带来改进，增益同时覆盖 dense 与 mixture-of-experts 大语言模型；不引入额外推理开销。
Conclusion: 重建损失更低不等于下游性能更好，按最坏情形分布鲁棒地精修整数码可作为通用的 weight-only PTQ 后处理框架，在不改推理开销的前提下提升下游表现。

papers.title: SafeInferCom: Safe Inference-Time Compute via Verifier-Guided Mid-Generation Intervention for Robotic Task Planning
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Language Models (LRLMs) enable multi-step reasoning for robotic task planning, but continued reasoning can overwrite valid intermediate plans or leave constraint violations unresolved, reducing planning reliability and wasting inference-time computation. We develop an inference-time monitor that exposes and verifies intermediate plans without disrupting the original decoding trajectory. Building on this monitor, we propose SafeInferCom, a formal verifier-guided framework that preserves valid intermediate plans and directs error correction during generation. Experiments across multiple LRLMs and planning domains reveal reasoning-response inconsistency and limited self-correction under one-shot inference. SafeInferCom improves planning success and accelerates error correction relative to one-shot inference. When combined with iterative refinement, it further improves success while reducing token usage compared with refinement alone. We additionally evaluate SafeInferCom in VirtualHome and provide a real-world robotic-arm demonstration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeInferCom 在大推理语言模型 (LRLM) 生成机器人任务计划时插入一个不打断原解码轨迹的推理期监视器，用形式化验证器保住已正确的中间计划并引导错误纠正。在多个 LRLM 与规划域上，它相对 one-shot 推理提升规划成功率并加快纠错；与迭代精修结合时进一步提高成功率且 token 用量低于单独精修。
Motivation: LRLM 的持续推理会覆写本已正确的中间计划或让约束违例悬置，导致规划不可靠并浪费推理期算力；one-shot 推理下存在推理与回答不一致、自我纠错能力有限的问题。
Method: 构建一个推理期监视器，在不扰动原解码轨迹的前提下暴露并验证中间计划；在其上提出 SafeInferCom，用形式化验证器 (formal verifier) 在生成过程中保留有效中间计划并定向错误纠正，可与迭代精修 (iterative refinement) 组合使用。
Result: 在多个 LRLM 与多个规划域的实验中观察到推理-回答不一致与 one-shot 推理下自我纠错受限；SafeInferCom 相对 one-shot 推理提高规划成功率并加快错误纠正，与迭代精修结合时在进一步提高成功率的同时比单独精修减少 token 用量；另在 VirtualHome 中评估并给出真实机械臂演示。
Conclusion: 推理期用形式化验证器做中途干预，可以在不重跑生成的前提下同时改善机器人任务规划的成功率与推理算力开销，且与迭代精修兼容。

papers.title: Cross-species representation learning aligns mouse and human neural dynamics and tracks clinical drug efficacy
papers.abstract_en: Preclinical models poorly predict human drug efficacy, particularly in neurological disorders. Neural activity offers a uniquely rich source of translational information because it captures high-dimensional variation in nervous-system function that can be measured in both animals and humans. However, its high dimensionality makes it difficult to distinguish conserved disease-related features from variation arising from species, recording modality and experimental context. Here, we test whether shared neural dynamics can be identified directly from electrophysiology data by learning representations organized by biological state rather than species. We develop a dual-rule contrastive learning framework that aligns corresponding mouse and human states while preserving separation between distinct phenotypes. This framework recovered conserved sensory-response structure across species and, in epilepsy, resolved distinct relationships between three mouse models and heterogeneous human patient populations. When treated animals were projected into a frozen cross-species representation, drug-induced movement towards the human-aligned healthy state retrospectively tracked known clinical efficacy across ten model-drug combinations including a disease-specific detrimental effect. The framework also identified shared disease-associated neural dynamics between Fmr1-knockout mice and human 16p11.2 copy-number variant carriers despite differences in genetic aetiology and recording modality. Together, these findings show the potential of cross-species neural representation learning to map heterogeneous human disease onto experimentally tractable preclinical states and assess whether interventions restore human-relevant circuit function.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出双规则对比学习框架 (dual-rule contrastive learning)，按生物状态而非物种组织电生理表征，把小鼠与人类神经活动对齐到同一冻结的跨物种空间。在 10 组模型-药物组合上，给药动物向人类对齐健康态的位移能回溯性追踪已知临床疗效（含一个疾病特异的有害效应），并识别出 Fmr1 敲除小鼠与人类 16p11.2 拷贝数变异携带者共享的疾病相关神经动力学。
Motivation: 临床前模型对人类药物疗效预测能力差，尤其在神经疾病领域；电生理虽可跨物种测量，但高维变异混杂了物种、记录模态与实验情境，难以分离保守的疾病特征。
Method: 在电生理数据上学习按生物状态组织的表征：双规则对比学习同时拉近对应的小鼠-人类状态、又保持不同表型之间的分离；训练后冻结跨物种表征空间，把给药动物投影进去，用其相对人类对齐健康态的位移衡量干预效果。
Result: 框架恢复了跨物种保守的感觉响应结构；在癫痫中解析出三个小鼠模型与异质人类患者群体之间的不同关系；在 10 组模型-药物组合上，给药动物向人类对齐健康态的移动回溯性追踪已知临床疗效，包括一个疾病特异的有害效应；还识别出 Fmr1 敲除小鼠与人类 16p11.2 CNV 携带者共享的疾病相关神经动力学，尽管遗传病因与记录模态不同。
Conclusion: 跨物种神经表征学习可以把异质的人类疾病映射到实验可控的临床前状态，并用于判断干预是否恢复人类相关的回路功能。

papers.title: How Firm Should a Grasp Be?
papers.abstract_en: An ideal robot grasp is firm enough to securely handle an object, yet gentle enough to avoid damaging it. Achieving this balance requires knowledge of the object's material properties, such as its mass, elasticity, and surface friction. These properties, however, are seldom precisely known a priori. In this work, we propose a visuotactile approach to estimating material properties in real time, during the process of grasping. Our method uses these estimated properties to determine the minimum grasp force required to handle the object. We contribute a new dataset of real-world objects (fruits and vegetables) with measured physical properties (shape, mass, elasticity, and friction), which we use to construct our force estimation model via simulations. We experimentally validate our approach to grasp force control using a robot with a parallel-jaw gripper. We demonstrate our system's ability to gently grasp a wide variety of objects, in each case adapting to their unique physical properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在抓取过程中用视觉-触觉 (visuotactile) 实时估计物体质量、弹性与表面摩擦，并据此计算保持物体不滑落所需的最小抓取力，使平行夹爪在不损伤果蔬的前提下稳固抓取。作者贡献一套实测物理属性（形状、质量、弹性、摩擦）的真实果蔬数据集，用仿真构建力估计模型，并在平行夹爪机器人上实验验证。
Motivation: 理想抓取要在牢固与不损伤之间取平衡，但这需要物体质量、弹性、摩擦等材料属性，而这些属性事先通常并不精确已知。
Method: 视觉-触觉在线估计材料属性，再由力估计模型算出最小抓取力；力估计模型用新采集的实测属性数据集（形状、质量、弹性、摩擦）通过仿真构建，并在平行夹爪机器人上做抓取力控制实验验证。
Result: 在平行夹爪机器人上实验验证抓取力控制，系统能轻柔抓取多种物体，并对每个物体各自独特的物理属性自适应调整抓取力。
Conclusion: 抓取过程中在线估计材料属性并据此求最小抓取力，可让夹爪同时做到稳固与轻柔，无需事先精确知道物体属性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BRACE: Differential Privacy for Dense Associative Memory with LSR Energy
papers.abstract_en: Dense associative memory (DAM) provides an energy-based framework for memory retrieval with close connections to attention mechanisms in modern artificial intelligence. Despite growing interest in differential privacy for AI, the privacy of DAM retrieval dynamics remains relatively unexplored. In this paper, we develop a differential privacy framework for log-sum-ReLU (LSR) dense associative memory, whose finite-support retrieval dynamics pose distinctive challenges for privacy-preserving computation. We propose the Boundary-Responsive Adaptive Correction Evolution (BRACE) algorithm, a differentially private retrieval mechanism for LSR-DAM that adaptively corrects boundary-sensitive perturbations to control their cumulative effect over the retrieval trajectory. In theory, we prove that our method is minimax optimal by deriving dimension-independent terminal and full-trajectory retrieval error rates, with optimal dependence on the inverse temperature and, in the growing-horizon regime, the retrieval horizon. We further establish central limit theorems that enable uncertainty quantification for private retrieval by characterizing its asymptotic distribution and the additional variability introduced by privacy. Numerical experiments compare our proposed method with baseline differential privacy approaches and evaluate its retrieval accuracy. Together, our results provide a theoretical foundation for optimal privacy-preserving retrieval and uncertainty quantification in energy-based associative memory systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BRACE 为 log-sum-ReLU 稠密联想记忆 (LSR-DAM) 的检索轨迹提供差分隐私机制，通过自适应校正边界敏感扰动来控制其沿轨迹的累积效应。理论上证明方法 minimax 最优，给出与维度无关的终端与全轨迹检索误差率，对逆温度呈最优依赖，并在检索时域增长体制下对时域长度也最优；中心极限定理刻画私有检索的渐近分布与隐私引入的额外变异性。
Motivation: 差分隐私在 AI 中受关注，但 DAM 检索动力学的隐私问题基本未被探索；LSR-DAM 的有限支撑检索动力学给保私计算带来特有困难。
Method: 提出 Boundary-Responsive Adaptive Correction Evolution (BRACE)：一种针对 LSR-DAM 的可差分隐私检索机制，对边界敏感扰动做自适应校正以控制其在检索轨迹上的累积效应；辅以理论误差率推导与中心极限定理，并用数值实验与基线差分隐私方法比较检索精度。
Result: 证明方法 minimax 最优，导出与维度无关的终端与全轨迹检索误差率，对逆温度依赖最优，且在 growing-horizon 体制下对检索时域依赖最优；建立中心极限定理以刻画私有检索的渐近分布及隐私带来的额外变异性；数值实验将 BRACE 与基线差分隐私方法比较并评估检索精度。
Conclusion: 自适应校正边界扰动可以在 LSR-DAM 上同时给出最优的隐私保护检索误差与可用于不确定性量化的渐近理论，为基于能量的联想记忆系统奠定隐私与不确定性量化的理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens. Recent work seeks to combine the advantages of the two models, and each hybrid fixes its decoding schedule by design. In this paper, we ask whether the performance of decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps. We describe diffusion, AR, and models in between as paths on one corruption lattice, and define the cost of a schedule as the dependence its parallel steps discard. The cost shows that the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule are set by the geometry of the data, in the same way for tokens and for continuous fields. In particular, for data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps equal the graph's treedepth, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence and linear in the side length of a grid. With fewer steps than the treedepth, every schedule pays a positive cost, whose ranking we predict before decoding with a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights. Across text generation, image generation, and video generation, we verify most of the predictions about the rankings of different schedules under different metrics and benchmarks. This work therefore provides a design principle for decoding for future AR models, diffusion models, and anything in between. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 diffusion 与 AR 统一描述为同一 corruption lattice 上的路径，用调度所丢弃的并行步依赖定义代价，证明零代价调度的最少步数由数据几何决定：图上 Markov 且沿路径相依的数据，最少步数等于图的 treedepth，序列上为对数、网格上为边长线性。步数低于 treedepth 时每个调度都付出正代价，且该代价排序可在解码前用预训练权重估计的成对依赖核预测；在文本、图像、视频生成上多数排序预测得到验证。
Motivation: diffusion 与 AR 长期被视为两类模型，现有混合模型的解码调度靠人工设计固定，缺少在解码前判断调度优劣的依据。
Method: 将 diffusion、AR 及中间模型统一为同一 corruption lattice 上的路径，以调度丢弃的并行步依赖定义代价；用从预训练权重估计的成对依赖核 (kernel of pairwise dependence) 在解码前预测不同调度的代价排序。
Result: 零代价调度的最少步数由数据几何决定：图上 Markov 且沿路径相依的数据，最少步数等于 treedepth，序列长度上为对数、网格边长上为线性；步数低于 treedepth 时每个调度代价为正。在文本、图像、视频生成上，对不同调度在不同指标与 benchmark 下的排序预测多数得到验证。
Conclusion: 解码调度的优劣可在解码前由依赖几何预测，为未来 AR、diffusion 及其间的模型提供统一的解码设计原则。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: GATOR: Generative and Agentic 3D Object Reconstruction From Casual Images
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing complete, scene-aligned 3D objects from casual images requires integrating sparse, uncertain observations and inferring surfaces hidden by occlusions. We present GATOR, a generative and agentic framework that recovers textured object assets and their scene-relative pose from one or more images. Our local modality mixer couples patch-aligned RGB, target-mask, and pointmap features before cross-view reasoning, preserving scene context while distinguishing the target from its surroundings. Text-guided semantic conditioning complements these spatial cues with category names and object captions through stage-specific adapters for structure, geometry, and appearance generation. The generated asset initializes a multimodal agent, providing instance-specific geometry and pose for targeted structural and texture refinement through an observation-guided edit-render-review loop. Across synthetic objects, cluttered tabletops, and indoor scenes, GATOR achieves strong geometric and appearance fidelity while recovering scene-relative pose from sparse observations. Time-budget comparisons and scene-level simulation further demonstrate the reconstruction efficiency and simulation readiness. Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/lpr/gator/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GATOR 用生成式加智能体 (agentic) 框架从一或多张随意拍摄的图像恢复带纹理的 3D 物体资产及其场景相对位姿：局部模态混合器先耦合 patch 对齐的 RGB、目标 mask 与 pointmap 特征，再做跨视角推理，文本语义条件经分阶段 adapter 注入结构、几何与外观生成，生成的资产再初始化多模态智能体，通过观察引导的 edit-render-review 循环做结构与纹理精修。
Motivation: 从随意图像重建完整且与场景对齐的 3D 物体，需要融合稀疏、不确定的观测并推断被遮挡的表面，而现有做法难以同时保住场景上下文、区分目标与周围环境。
Method: 局部模态混合器 (local modality mixer) 在跨视角推理前耦合 patch 对齐的 RGB、target-mask 与 pointmap 特征；文本语义条件用类别名与物体描述，通过面向结构、几何、外观生成的分阶段 adapter (stage-specific adapters) 注入；生成资产作为初始化交给多模态智能体，用 observation-guided 的 edit-render-review 循环做针对性结构与纹理精修。
Result: 在合成物体、杂乱桌面与室内场景三类设置上，GATOR 在几何与外观保真度上表现强，并能从稀疏观测恢复场景相对位姿；时间预算对比与场景级仿真进一步展示其重建效率与仿真就绪度 (simulation readiness)。
Conclusion: 把生成式重建与智能体式精修结合，可以在稀疏、含遮挡的随意图像条件下同时得到纹理资产、场景相对位姿和可直接用于仿真的输出。

papers.title: Bridging KV-Cache Quantization and Linear Attention: From Theory to Pretrained Weight Migration
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache quantization and linear attention are two representative approaches to tackling the storage and computational costs of Transformers. KV-cache quantization compresses individual KV entries into discrete codes but retains all entries, whereas linear attention recurrently aggregates multiple historical KV contributions into a fixed-size continuous state but can introduce interference. This contrast raises the question of whether per-KV compression and multi-KV aggregation can be bridged within a single mechanism for efficient attention. We identify RAM-Net as such a bridge through soft assignments over a discrete address space. These assignments determine recurrent updates to the continuous slot state associated with each address. Under a restricted RAM-Net construction, we prove that soft address assignments extend hard quantized matching to a separable read-write overlap that locally approximates full-attention similarity and supports recurrent aggregation. These connections further enable Transformer-to-RAM-Net weight migration through a new path based on a soft-quantized intermediate construction. Across nine pretrained Transformer models from 0.3B to 7B parameters, RAM-Net recovers an average of 87.1% of the teachers' accuracy gains over random guessing across six commonsense and knowledge tasks using only a 500M-token budget per model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RAM-Net，用离散地址空间上的软分配 (soft address assignments) 把 KV-cache 量化与 linear attention 统一到同一机制：软地址决定对每个地址连续 slot 状态的递归读写，在受限构造下可局部逼近 full-attention 相似度。借助软量化中间构造的权重迁移路径，0.3B–7B 的九个预训练 Transformer 在每模型仅 500M token 预算下恢复教师相对随机猜测平均 87.1% 的精度增益。
Motivation: KV-cache 量化逐条压缩但保留全部条目，linear attention 定长聚合历史 KV 却引入干扰，两者各自解决 Transformer 的存储与计算开销，缺少统一机制。
Method: 以 RAM-Net 为桥：离散地址上的软分配驱动对各地址连续 slot 状态的递归更新；在受限构造下证明软地址把硬量化匹配扩展为可分离的读写重叠 (separable read-write overlap)，局部逼近 full-attention 相似度并支持递归聚合；再经软量化中间构造给出 Transformer 到 RAM-Net 的权重迁移路径。
Result: 在 0.3B 至 7B 参数的九个预训练 Transformer 上，每模型仅用 500M token 预算，RAM-Net 在六个常识与知识任务上平均恢复教师相对随机猜测精度增益的 87.1%。

papers.title: AliO: Output Alignment Matters in Long-Term Time Series Forecasing
papers.abstract_en: Long-term Time Series Forecasting (LTSF) tasks, which leverage the current data sequence as input to predict the future sequence, have become increasingly crucial in real-world applications such as weather forecasting and planning of electricity consumption. However, state-of-the-art LTSF models often fail to achieve prediction output alignment for the same timestamps across lagged input sequences. Instead, these models exhibit low output alignment, resulting in fluctuation in prediction outputs for the same timestamps, undermining the model's reliability. To address this, we propose AliO (Align Outputs), a novel approach designed to improve the output alignment of LTSF models by reducing the discrepancies between prediction outputs for the same timestamps in both the time and frequency domains. To measure output alignment, we introduce a new metric, TAM (Time Alignment Metric), which quantifies the alignment between prediction outputs, whereas existing metrics such as MSE only capture the distance between prediction outputs and ground truths. Experimental results show that AliO effectively improves the output alignment, i.e., up to 58.2% in TAM, while maintaining or enhancing the forecasting performance (up to 27.5%). This improved output alignment increases the reliability of the LTSF models, making them more applicable in real-world scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 38 (2025), 119563-119608
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AliO 针对长期时间序列预报 (LTSF) 中同一时间戳在不同滞后输入下预测输出不一致的问题，通过在时域与频域同时缩小同时间戳输出差异来提升 output alignment，并提出新指标 TAM 度量该对齐度。实验中 TAM 最多改善 58.2%，预报性能最多提升 27.5%。
Motivation: SOTA LTSF 模型对同一时间戳在不同滞后输入序列下输出不对齐，导致预测波动、可靠性下降；现有 MSE 类指标只衡量预测与真值的距离，无法刻画这种输出不一致。
Method: 提出 AliO (Align Outputs)，在时域和频域两个层面减小同一时间戳预测输出之间的差异；并引入新指标 TAM (Time Alignment Metric) 专门量化输出对齐程度，与只测预测-真值距离的 MSE 互补。
Result: 实验显示 AliO 最多将 TAM 提升 58.2%，同时预报性能最多提升 27.5%（保持或增强）。
Conclusion: 输出对齐是 LTSF 可靠性的独立于精度的维度，可在不牺牲（甚至提升）预报性能的前提下被专门优化，从而提高模型在真实场景（如天气预报、用电规划）中的可用性。

papers.title: Do Flatter Minima Drive Better Generalization? An Algorithmic Separation in Grokking
papers.abstract_en: Flat loss landscapes have long been linked to better generalization in neural networks. However, its role as a causal mechanism for generalization is less established. Grokking provides an unique testbed to understand this distinction: models are prone to fit observed data using non-generalizing structure and remain in that regime for prolonged periods, transitioning to generalization only under particular training conditions. In this work, we study whether flat loss landscapes can act as a driving mechanism in this transition. While recent work has argued for flatness as a necessary geometric condition for this transition, we find that biasing training toward flatter solutions using sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) is insufficient to reliably induce this transition, despite producing flatter solutions. However, when SAM is paired with mechanisms that drive generalization such as weight decay, an interesting property emerges: SAM can accelerate the transition to generalizing solutions by up to 4x at the epoch-level. We theoretically untangle this relationship between SAM and weight decay using a minimal interpolating two-layer ReLU model with both memorizing and generalizing solutions. We show that even in this simple setup, flatness alone cannot distinguish a memorizing solution from a generalizing one, while weight decay favors generalizing solutions. However, under a local stability analysis, there exists a window where a memorizing interpolant is locally stable under gradient descent but unstable under SAM in the low-norm regime, which can explain SAM's ability to accelerate this transition. Overall, our results provide a more interpretable account of the role of flatness in driving generalization, especially in settings where models are vulnerable to minimizing loss through learning non-generalizing structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 grokking 测试床上，单纯用 sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) 把训练推向更平坦的解并不能可靠触发从记忆到泛化的转变；SAM 与 weight decay 结合时可把转变加速最多 4 倍（epoch 级）。作者用最小插值两层 ReLU 模型解释：平坦度本身无法区分记忆解与泛化解，weight decay 偏向泛化解，而低范数区间内记忆插值在梯度下降下局部稳定、在 SAM 下不稳定，这解释了加速来源。
Motivation: 平坦损失面长期被当作更好泛化的标志，但其作为泛化因果机制的地位并不确立；grokking 中模型会长期停留在用非泛化结构拟合训练数据的阶段，需要区分平坦度究竟是必要几何条件还是真正的驱动机制。
Method: 在 grokking 设定下比较两种训练偏置：单独使用 sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) 与 SAM 加 weight decay 的组合；再用一个同时含记忆解与泛化解的最小插值两层 ReLU 模型做理论分析，包括局部稳定性分析，比较梯度下降与 SAM 下记忆插值的稳定性。
Result: 单独用 SAM 能产生更平坦的解，但不足以可靠诱导向泛化的转变；SAM 与 weight decay 结合时在 epoch 级上把向泛化解的转变加速最多 4 倍。理论侧显示平坦度本身无法区分记忆解与泛化解，weight decay 偏向泛化解，且在低范数区间存在一个记忆插值对梯度下降局部稳定、对 SAM 不稳定的时间窗。
Conclusion: 平坦度不是泛化的充分判据，它只有与 weight decay 这类真正驱动泛化的机制配合时才加速 grokking 转变；SAM 的加速作用可由低范数区间内记忆解的局部稳定性差异解释。

papers.title: Dissecting Representation Structure in Vision Transformers: A Rigorous Architectural Study
papers.abstract_en: Representation structure is crucial for understanding Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures and their generalization behavior. However, prior studies neither isolate nor analyze module-level features nor investigate how their interactions contribute to performance estimation. In this work, we conduct the first rigorous analysis of feature information across diverse architectural scales, empirically uncover the relationship between ViT representation and generalization behavior, and leverage these insights to guide efficient ViT design. Our contributions are fivefold: Across diverse architectural scales, 1) We identify feature collapse at initialization, which leads to redundancy, and propose a reduction scheme to mitigate this issue. 2) We quantify feature information using entropy and the minimum eigenvalue, demonstrating that these metrics serve as reliable indicators for generalization prediction. 3) We show that feature in the token space provides a more faithful representation than those in embedding space. 4) We discover an unexpected finding: features produced by linear submodules within ViT layers are critical for the prediction of generalization performance. 5) Our proposed proxy improves the correlation ranking by 18-48% over prior baselines and can effectively identify ViT architectures that achieve higher accuracy at lower or comparable computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Vision Transformer 做模块级表征结构解剖：用熵与最小特征值量化特征信息，发现初始化时的特征坍缩导致冗余并给出缓解方案，且 token 空间特征比 embedding 空间更能忠实反映泛化。所提 proxy 使泛化预测的相关性排序比既有基线提升 18–48%，可识别出在更低或相当算力下精度更高的 ViT 架构。
Motivation: 既有 ViT 表征研究既不隔离模块级特征，也不分析这些特征的交互如何影响性能估计，导致无法从表征结构预测泛化、指导高效架构设计。
Method: 在多种架构尺度上隔离并分析 ViT 各模块特征，用熵与最小特征值 (minimum eigenvalue) 量化特征信息作为泛化预测指标；针对初始化特征坍缩提出 reduction scheme，并用这些洞察构造 proxy 来排序 ViT 架构。
Result: 所提 proxy 的 correlation ranking 相比 prior baselines 提升 18–48%；能有效识别在更低或相当计算成本下达到更高精度的 ViT 架构；定性发现包括初始化时的特征坍缩、token 空间特征比 embedding 空间更忠实、线性子模块特征对泛化性能预测关键。
Conclusion: 模块级特征信息（尤其线性子模块输出）可作为 ViT 泛化的可靠预测信号，据此设计的 proxy 能在控制算力的前提下筛选出更高精度的架构。

papers.title: PageWeaver: KV-Guided Query Unions for Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic sparse attention limits the KV pages selected by each query, but a small support does not necessarily yield efficient GPU work. Query unions share page loads and populate Tensor Core tiles; their cost depends on which queries are grouped together. We present PageWeaver, an execution design that uses selected-page affinity to assemble query groups while preserving each query's original support and complete output ownership. A bounded GPU search produces query IDs, and an ID-aware two-CTA kernel consumes them without materializing reordered Q tensors or cross-page partial outputs. A direct KV-page union implementation provides a complementary design study of nonlocal reuse and reduction cost. With FP8 KV throughout, the H200 Union8 implementation achieves a 1.70x geometric-mean complete-call speedup over the measured FlashInfer path on six captures. Online regrouping further lowers latency by 3.26-7.66% on five selected 64K-context captures. Whole-model prefill throughput is 7.88-14.36% above the tested native path; the incremental regrouping benefit is smaller, with observed median gains of 0.47-0.73% at 32K/64K and regressions at 8K. A B300 comparison identifies cases where preparation cost and a stronger native kernel remove the advantage. These results separate execution-group reuse from the complete cost of exploiting it online.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Zhiyuan Li and Zihan Li contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PageWeaver 是面向动态稀疏注意力的 GPU 执行设计：用被选 KV page 的亲和度 (selected-page affinity) 组装 query 分组，在保持每个 query 原始支持集与完整输出所有权的前提下共享 page 加载并填满 Tensor Core tile。配 FP8 KV 的 H200 Union8 实现在六段 capture 上相对实测 FlashInfer 路径取得 1.70x 几何平均整调用加速，整模型 prefill 吞吐高出受测原生路径 7.88–14.36%。
Motivation: 动态稀疏注意力按 query 限制 KV page，但小支持集不等于 GPU 上的高效执行：page 加载与 Tensor Core tile 填充的开销取决于哪些 query 被编到一起，而在线重组本身要付准备成本。
Method: 以 selected-page affinity 组装 query 分组，保留每个 query 的原始支持集与完整输出所有权；用有界 GPU 搜索产出 query ID，再由 ID-aware two-CTA kernel 消费，避免物化重排后的 Q 张量与跨 page 部分输出；另给出直接 KV-page union 实现作为非局部复用与归约开销的对照设计研究，全程 FP8 KV。
Result: H200 Union8 在六段 capture 上取得 1.70x 几何平均整调用加速（相对实测 FlashInfer 路径）；在线重组在五段选定 64K-context capture 上再降延迟 3.26–7.66%；整模型 prefill 吞吐比受测原生路径高 7.88–14.36%，其中重组的增量收益中位数仅 0.47–0.73%（32K/64K），8K 上出现回退；B300 对比中，准备成本与更强原生 kernel 会抹掉优势。
Conclusion: 执行分组带来的复用收益与在线利用它的完整代价是两回事：重组在 64K 长上下文有小幅净收益，但在 8K 与更强原生 kernel（B300）下可能不划算。

summary_sections.result: H200 Union8 在六段 capture 上取得 1.70x 几何平均整调用加速（相对实测 FlashInfer 路径）；在线重组在五段选定 64K-context capture 上再降延迟 3.26–7.66%；整模型 prefill 吞吐比受测原生路径高 7.88–14.36%，其中重组的增量收益中位数仅 0.47–0.73%（32K/64K），8K 上出现回退；B300 对比中，准备成本与更强原生 kernel 会抹掉优势。
summary_sections.conclusion: 执行分组带来的复用收益与在线利用它的完整代价是两回事：重组在 64K 长上下文有小幅净收益，但在 8K 与更强原生 kernel（B300）下可能不划算。

papers.title: 3DTexMOR: 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting
papers.abstract_en: 3D object removal aims to remove target objects from reconstructed scenes and complete the geometry and appearance of occluded regions. Existing NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods typically inpaint 2D images to guide 3D completion. However, complex multi-object layouts limit the surrounding context visible in each view, making 2D inpainting prone to artifacts. Inconsistent completions across views also introduce conflicting supervision and blurry reconstructions. We propose 3D Gaussian Multi-Object Removal via Texture-Space Inpainting (3DTexMOR). Our key idea is to perform inpainting in a unified texture space shared by all views. By combining complementary observations, this space provides richer context for recovering missing regions and promotes cross-view appearance consistency. We aggregate multi-view observations into texture maps, inpaint the missing regions, and reproject the completed maps into camera views to supervise Gaussian scene completion. To avoid the influence of view-dependent highlights and reflections, we decompose appearance and aggregate view-independent intrinsic attributes instead of RGB colors. We further introduce geometrically regularized Gaussian completion to constrain the geometry of the completed regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate visually plausible completions and state-of-the-art multi-object removal performance, improving PSNR by 5.8 dB and reducing LPIPS by at least 22% compared with existing methods.
papers.comment: 17 pages, including appendix. Kunxin Guang and Yonghao Zhao contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3DTexMOR 把多视角图像聚合到所有视角共享的统一纹理空间，在该空间做补全后再重投影回相机视角监督 3D Gaussian 场景补全，从而避开逐视角 2D inpainting 在复杂多物体布局下的伪影与跨视角冲突。相比现有方法 PSNR 提升 5.8 dB、LPIPS 至少降低 22%，达到 SOTA 多物体移除性能。
Motivation: NeRF/3DGS 类物体移除依赖逐视角 2D 图像补全来引导 3D 补全，但复杂多物体布局限制了每个视角可见的上下文，导致补全易出伪影、跨视角不一致的补全又引入冲突监督与模糊重建。
Method: 3DTexMOR 将多视角观测聚合为纹理图，在共享纹理空间补全缺失区域后重投影回相机视角监督 Gaussian 场景补全；外观分解后聚合与视角无关的 intrinsic attributes 而非 RGB，以规避视角相关高光与反射；另引入几何正则化的 Gaussian completion 约束补全区域几何。
Result: 在多物体移除任务上达到 state-of-the-art 性能：相比现有方法 PSNR 提升 5.8 dB，LPIPS 至少降低 22%，并给出视觉上合理的补全结果。
Conclusion: 把补全从逐视角 2D 空间移到所有视角共享的纹理空间，配合视角无关外观聚合与几何正则，可同时改善跨视角一致性与多物体移除质量。

papers.title: Selective Listening: Mechanism-Guided Control of Audio Influence in Large Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) exploit multimodal evidence, yet task-irrelevant audio can alter text-reasoning decisions when listening is unnecessary. Aggregate Accuracy can hide this paired drift because audio-induced repairs and damages may cancel. Paired drift analysis and targeted interventions identify architecture-specific, intervention-sensitive late audio pathways as actionable control points. We introduce ICAP-Gate, which applies mechanism-guided, task-conditioned control to each model's pathway. Across four LALMs, two reasoning benchmarks, and environmental-sound and natural-speech interference, ICAP-Gate has lower point estimates for Influence Rate and Answer Flip than ungated inference in all 16 full-split model--condition evaluations. Fixed suppression degrades automatic speech recognition (ASR) across all four models, whereas ICAP-Gate matches ungated ASR performance by preserving the pathway for explicit audio-demand instructions. ICAP-Gate has lower paired-drift point estimates than mitigation prompting in all four evaluated settings and provides competitive stabilization relative to eight-sample Self-Consistency while using one generation per query; in controlled ARC measurements, Self-Consistency incurs $7.0$--$9.2\times$ ungated latency. These results establish selective modality influence control as a design principle for robust multimodal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ICAP-Gate，对大音频语言模型 (LALM) 的晚期音频通路做机制引导、任务条件化的选择性抑制：在听音不必要的推理任务上压低音频引起的答案漂移，同时在明确需要音频的指令（如 ASR）上保留通路不降性能。在 4 个 LALM × 2 个推理基准 × 环境声/自然语音干扰共 16 组全划分评测中，Influence Rate 与 Answer Flip 的点估计均低于无门控推理；ASR 性能与无门控持平，而固定抑制在全部 4 个模型上都损害 ASR。
Motivation: 任务无关的音频会改变大音频语言模型在本不需要听音时的文本推理决策，而聚合准确率 (Aggregate Accuracy) 会因音频引起的修复与损害相互抵消而掩盖这种成对漂移 (paired drift)。
Method: 先用成对漂移分析与针对性干预定位各模型架构特异、可干预的晚期音频通路，再据此施加任务条件化的 ICAP-Gate 门控；对比对象包括无门控推理、固定抑制、mitigation prompting 与 8-sample Self-Consistency。
Result: 在 4 个 LALM、2 个推理基准、环境声与自然语音干扰下，ICAP-Gate 在全部 16 组全划分模型-条件评测中 Influence Rate 与 Answer Flip 点估计均低于无门控推理；固定抑制在全部 4 个模型上降低 ASR，而 ICAP-Gate 保持与无门控相当的 ASR；在 4 组评测中成对漂移点估计低于 mitigation prompting；相对 8-sample Self-Consistency 竞争力相当但每查询只需 1 次生成，后者在受控 ARC 测量中带来 7.0–9.2 倍于无门控的延迟。
Conclusion: 选择性模态影响控制 (selective modality influence control) 可作为鲁棒多模态推理的设计原则：按通路做任务条件化门控，比固定抑制或提示缓解更能兼顾抗干扰与音频任务保真。

papers.title: OmniDex: Scaling Dexterous Hand Grasping to Diverse Cluttered Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous grasping is the foundational primitive in embodied AI, demanding massive data to train robust models. As real-world data collection is expensive, simulation has become the mainstream paradigm. Yet, while cluttered scenes best reflect real-world applications, learning to grasp within them is bottlenecked by a critical scarcity of large-scale data. To resolve this, we curate high-quality 3D objects and supporting bases, proposing a scalable seed-and-filter strategy that bypasses sluggish scene-level optimization. This yields an unprecedented benchmark comprising over 2.6 million scenes and 0.4B scene-specific grasp ground truths, featuring diverse realistic layouts paired with rich semantic and geometric observations. Furthermore, we introduce the OmniDex model to overcome the grasp multimodality and last-millimeter precision errors plaguing current generative models. By coupling Soft Winner-Takes-All learning with human-inspired physical constraints during training, and utilizing physics-driven ranking, our approach achieves robust dexterous grasping without the latency of post-optimization. Experimental results show that OmniDex model achieves state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization across diverse scenes, views, and unseen objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniDex 用 seed-and-filter 策略绕开缓慢的场景级优化，构建含 260 万+ 场景与 0.4B 场景级抓取真值的杂乱场景基准，并以 Soft Winner-Takes-All 学习耦合人类启发的物理约束训练生成式抓取模型，配合物理驱动排序，实现无需后优化延迟的灵巧抓取，在多样场景、视角与未见物体上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 灵巧抓取需要海量训练数据，真实采集昂贵；杂乱场景最贴近实际应用，却因大规模数据稀缺而成为瓶颈，现有生成式模型还受抓取多模态与最后毫米级精度误差困扰。
Method: 整理高质量 3D 物体与支撑底座，提出可扩展的 seed-and-filter 策略替代场景级优化，产出大规模基准；OmniDex 模型在训练中耦合 Soft Winner-Takes-All 学习与人类启发的物理约束，推理用物理驱动排序取代后优化。
Result: 基准含 260 万+（over 2.6 million）场景与 0.4B 场景级抓取真值，配有多样真实布局及语义、几何观测；实验显示 OmniDex 在多样场景、视角与未见物体上取得 state-of-the-art 性能与强泛化。
Conclusion: 以 seed-and-filter 造数据加物理约束的生成式抓取，可在不依赖后优化的前提下同时解决多模态与毫米级精度问题，把灵巧抓取扩展到杂乱场景。

papers.title: What to Admit and How to Present: Governing Persistent Memory in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory can improve personalization in LLM agents but can also induce sycophancy and cross-domain leakage. We distinguish two governance decisions: admission, which determines what recalled information enters the working context, and presentation, which determines how admitted information is expressed. We implement two inference-time designs without retraining: factor-compiled admission (FC), which assesses whole memory entries, and permission-semantic admission (PS), which decomposes entries into typed units; both translate adjudicated attributes into eligibility decisions via deterministic policies. We evaluate on a four-backbone development suite and an external benchmark with four tasks of 300 samples each. Relative to verbatim injection, FC and PS reduce pooled judge-assessed failure rates on the external benchmark by 6.7 and 8.8 percentage points (p = 2.7e-7 and 4.1e-12), and development-set cross-domain leakage falls by up to 29.5 percentage points. A query-conditioned gating baseline shows no significant change in objective-fact failure or pooled failure. Under matched admission budgets, PS outperforms random and relevance-based selection on external objective-fact judgment after Holm correction. Holding presentation fixed, tightening admission cuts cross-domain failure by a further 17.5 percentage points (p = 1.6e-4); in contrast, no comparison between two renderings of identical adjudicated outputs survives multiple-comparison correction. Both designs increase personalization failures, and PS misses the preregistered improvement and personalization-preservation criteria. These results support evaluating admission and presentation separately: selection quality provides task-specific safety gains, while preserving beneficial memory use remains unresolved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 持久记忆治理拆成 admission（哪些记忆进入工作上下文）与 presentation（进入后如何表达）两个独立决策，提出免训练的 factor-compiled admission (FC) 与 permission-semantic admission (PS)，后者把记忆条目分解为带类型的单元再按确定性策略判定资格。在外部基准上 FC 与 PS 相对逐字注入分别把 judge 评估的合并失败率降低 6.7 与 8.8 个百分点（p=2.7e-7、4.1e-12），开发集跨域泄漏最多降 29.5 个百分点；收紧 admission 在固定 presentation 下再降 17.5 个百分点（p=1.6e-4），而两种渲染方式的对比无一通过多重比较校正。
Motivation: 持久记忆能提升 LLM agent 个性化，但同时引入谄媚 (sycophancy) 与跨域泄漏；现有做法把“选什么”和“怎么呈现”混在一起，无法判断安全收益究竟来自哪一步。
Method: 两种推理期设计、不重训：FC 整体评估记忆条目，PS 把条目分解为带类型单元，二者都把裁决属性经确定性策略转成资格判定；在四 backbone 开发套件与含 4 个任务、每任务 300 样本的外部基准上评测，对照逐字注入、query-conditioned gating、随机与相关性选择，并做 Holm 校正与预注册判据。
Result: 外部基准合并 judge 失败率：FC 降 6.7 个百分点（p=2.7e-7）、PS 降 8.8 个百分点（p=4.1e-12）；开发集跨域泄漏最多降 29.5 个百分点；gating 基线在客观事实失败与合并失败上无显著变化；匹配 admission 预算下 PS 在外部客观事实上优于随机与相关性选择（Holm 校正后）；固定 presentation 时收紧 admission 再降跨域失败 17.5 个百分点（p=1.6e-4），而同一裁决输出的两种渲染之间无对比通过多重比较校正。
Conclusion: admission 与 presentation 应分开评估：选择质量带来任务相关的安全收益，而保留有益记忆使用（两种设计都增加个性化失败，PS 未达预注册的改善与个性化保持判据）仍未解决。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RGBD-to-3D Object Mesh Refinement via Depth Matching and Symmetry Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Single-view 3D reconstructors often produce plausible meshes that disagree with the input view, especially near depth discontinuities and self-occlusions. We present a lightweight, plug-and-play RGBD-to-3D refinement that improves any RGB-to-3D reconstructor without retraining. Given a depth map, we correct the visible surface by bipartite matching to back-projected depth points, mirror these corrections onto the occluded side across a detected symmetry plane, and propagate them with a smoothness solver. Every stage is closed-form, making the method orders of magnitude faster than optimization-heavy test-time refinement. On GSO and OmniObject3D with five backbones, it yields consistent gains, also with monocular pseudo-depth, benefits more from symmetry on symmetric objects, and compares favorably with prior refinement in accuracy and runtime. It further improves an RGB-D-to-mesh reconstructor and transfers to real captures with noisy sensor depth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种即插即用的 RGBD-to-3D 网格精修方法：用二分图匹配 (bipartite matching) 把反投影深度点与可见表面对齐，再沿检测到的对称面把修正镜像到遮挡侧并用平滑求解器传播，各阶段均为闭式解。在 GSO 与 OmniObject3D 上配合五个 backbone 均带来一致提升，速度比优化式测试时精修快若干数量级。
Motivation: 单视角 3D 重建器常给出与输入视图不一致的网格，尤其在深度不连续与自遮挡处；已有测试时精修依赖昂贵优化，难以即插即用。
Method: 给定深度图，先对可见表面与反投影深度点做二分图匹配得到修正，再在检测出的对称面 (symmetry plane) 上把修正镜像到遮挡侧，最后用平滑求解器 (smoothness solver) 传播；全部阶段闭式求解，无需重训练，可挂到任意 RGB-to-3D 重建器上。
Result: 在 GSO 与 OmniObject3D、五个 backbone 上均取得一致提升；使用单目伪深度 (monocular pseudo-depth) 时同样有效，对称物体上对称传播收益更大；与已有精修方法相比在精度与运行时间上均有竞争力，且速度比优化式测试时精修快若干数量级；还能进一步改进一个 RGB-D-to-mesh 重建器并迁移到含噪传感器深度的真实采集。
Conclusion: 闭式深度匹配加对称传播足以在不重训练的前提下修正单视角重建的视图不一致，且比优化式精修快若干数量级，可作为通用即插即用后处理。

papers.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FateMultiplicity 是一个无谱系标签的单细胞轨迹推断 Rashomon 集框架，用交叉拟合的留出基因上的模型差异加非劣效检验（non-inferiority testing）构造统计上可接受的模型集合。它发现命运多重性主要取决于模型空间的多样性而非规模（12 个配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，24 个配置仅 3.8%），并证明逐细胞认证的命运边际 FM 并不比基线配置自身的决策边际更可靠（AUC 0.682 对 0.965，p = 0.003）。
Motivation: 单细胞轨迹推断把转录组测量映射到发育连续体，但同样拟合数据的多个模型可能给出冲突的细胞命运分配；现有方法缺少不依赖谱系标签的手段来量化并认证这种多重性。
Method: 在交叉拟合的留出基因上评估模型差异，用针对随机种子变异校准的非劣效检验构造无标签的 Rashomon 集；在模拟真值上比较逐细胞认证边际 FM 与基线配置自身决策边际、种子离散度基线的判别力，并测试 q-分位数放宽的变体。
Result: 多重性取决于模型空间多样性而非规模：12 个配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，24 个配置暴露 3.8%。在模拟真值上，FM 判别误分配的 AUC 为 0.682，基线配置自身决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散度基线为 0.854。信息量由可接受集的广度而非基数决定：基数为 4 时，种子重拟合集 AUC 0.933，超参扰动集 0.701。上确界可达 0.973（theta*'* 成员资格从下方约束），下确界无锚定。两个构造在模拟中存活：边际侵蚀比区分真实与伪分支点 AUC 0.890（真实数据未测）；对照克隆观测命运，未认证细胞与其克隆结果不一致的概率比认证细胞高 16.4 个百分点（p < 0.001）。
Conclusion: 轨迹推断中的多重性值得测量和报告，但对无标签 Rashomon 集做逐细胞认证并不是获得更可靠命运判定的途径；存活的构造是边际侵蚀比和基于克隆观测的认证状态分层。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WorldFact-Bench: Beyond Image-Internal Plausibility to Image-World Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Advances in image generation have made visual authenticity increasingly difficult to assess. Although image forensics now examines both generation artifacts and higher-level visual inconsistencies, a plausible image can still contradict real-world facts or rules. We introduce WorldFact-Bench to evaluate image-world consistency from a single image, without a predefined claim or verification target. The benchmark contains 1,274 source-aligned real-fake pairs across four verification regimes and ten semantic domains. Each pair introduces a specific, evidence-supported factual conflict while seeking to preserve non-target content and visual plausibility. Images are evaluated independently, and pair accuracy requires both members of a pair to be classified correctly. We further propose PERSIST-Agent, which organizes iterative verification around a persistent state linking candidate facts, visual observations, evidence, and verification statuses. This state guides subsequent inspection and retrieval while retaining unresolved candidates. With backbone weights fixed, harness self-optimization refines the agent's prompts and execution rules through validation feedback. Experiments reveal strong label biases in several detectors and uneven gains from retrieval. On the evaluated 8B backbones, PERSIST-Agent improves pair accuracy over both direct judgment and retrieval-augmented baselines, while ablations support the role of persistent verification state. These findings highlight the value of state-guided verification and the remaining gap between visual plausibility and factual correctness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 WorldFact-Bench：从单图、无预设声明出发评测图像与真实世界事实的一致性，含 1,274 组源对齐真伪对、四种验证机制与十个语义域，成对准确率要求一对两张都判对。配套的 PERSIST-Agent 用持久验证状态串联候选事实、视觉观察、证据与验证状态，在权重固定的 8B backbone 上经 harness 自优化后，成对准确率超过直接判断与检索增强基线。
Motivation: 图像取证已能识别生成痕迹与视觉不一致，但一张看起来合理的图仍可能违反真实世界的事实或规则；现有评测需要预设声明或验证目标，无法从单图开放地检验这种图文世界一致性。
Method: 构建 1,274 组源对齐真伪对，每对注入一处有证据支撑的事实冲突并尽量保留非目标内容与视觉合理性，按四种验证机制与十个语义域划分，逐图独立评测并以成对准确率计分。提出 PERSIST-Agent：以持久状态组织迭代验证，串联候选事实、视觉观察、证据与验证状态以引导后续检查与检索并保留未决候选；backbone 权重固定，由 harness self-optimization 依据验证反馈优化 prompt 与执行规则。
Result: 基准含 1,274 组真伪对、四种验证机制、十个语义域；在所评测的 8B backbone 上，PERSIST-Agent 的成对准确率高于直接判断与检索增强基线，消融实验支持持久验证状态的作用；实验还揭示若干检测器存在明显标签偏置，检索带来的收益不均衡。
Conclusion: 状态引导的迭代验证（state-guided verification）能提升单图事实一致性判定，而视觉合理性与事实正确性之间仍存在明显差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RAG-Stress: Probing the Limits of Evidence Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Following retrieved evidence does not guarantee factual correctness: misleading evidence can induce a model to replace an answer it previously gave correctly. Standard accuracy measures obscure this behavior by combining answer replacement with preexisting errors. We introduce RAG-Stress, a controlled diagnostic protocol for examining the limits of evidence reliance in retrieval-augmented generation. The protocol holds the question and reference answer fixed, edits one assertion to support a designated incorrect answer, and crosses two source priority policies with three positions of the answer span within the evidence text. We measure misleading rate (MR) on each model's subset of questions answered correctly without retrieval, alongside clean accuracy on the full evaluation set. We evaluate fifteen systems spanning API models, open models, and search agents trained with reinforcement learning on TriviaQA-RC, HotpotQA, and SearchQA, with additional English and Chinese MedQA evaluations. Instructions that prioritize documents consistently produce higher MR than those permitting reliance on prior knowledge. Averaged over models and positions, the gap ranges from 10.9 to 13.5 percentage points across the three QA datasets. Mean MR follows End $>$ Beginning $>$ Middle under both policies, although individual models do not uniformly follow this ordering. A separate paired audit of 500 questions and two checkpoints supports increased harmful override without establishing a corresponding improvement in beneficial correction. These findings distinguish evidence adherence from factual reliability and motivate evaluating whether retrieved evidence preserves, replaces, or corrects a model's answers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAG-Stress 是一个受控诊断协议：固定问题与参考答案，只改写证据中的一条断言使其支持指定错误答案，再交叉两种来源优先级策略与答案片段在证据中的三个位置，量化模型被误导而替换原本答对答案的比率 (misleading rate, MR)。在 15 个系统、TriviaQA-RC/HotpotQA/SearchQA 及 MedQA 上，强制优先文档的指令比允许依赖先验知识的指令平均高出 10.9–13.5 个百分点的 MR，且 MR 均值呈 End > Beginning > Middle。
Motivation: 遵循检索证据并不保证事实正确：误导性证据会让模型把原本答对的答案改错，而标准准确率把这种替换与既有错误混在一起，掩盖了证据依赖的真实边界。
Method: 受控协议固定问题与参考答案，编辑证据中的一条断言以支持指定错误答案，交叉两种来源优先级策略与答案片段的三个位置（Beginning/Middle/End）；在无检索时答对的子集上测 MR，同时在全量评测集上测 clean accuracy。评测覆盖 API 模型、开源模型与经强化学习训练的搜索 agent 共 15 个系统，数据集为 TriviaQA-RC、HotpotQA、SearchQA，另有英文与中文 MedQA。
Result: 强制文档优先的指令在三个 QA 数据集上跨模型与位置平均比允许依赖先验知识的指令高 10.9 至 13.5 个百分点的 MR；MR 均值在两种策略下都呈 End > Beginning > Middle，但个别模型并不一致遵循该排序；对 500 道题与两个 checkpoint 的配对审计支持有害替换增加，而未确立相应的有益纠正改善。
Conclusion: 证据遵循度应与事实可靠性分开衡量：优先文档的指令会系统性抬高误导率，检索证据的作用需按保留、替换或纠正模型答案三类分别评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MATE4D: Matrix-Guided Editable 4D Generation from a Single Image
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have rapidly pushed content creation be-yond 2D imagery toward dynamic 3D and 4D scene synthesis. Yet pro-ducing realistic and temporally stable 4D content from a single image is still difficult because one view provides limited structural cues and weak motion evidence. We introduce MATE4D, a framework that converts one input image into editable dynamic 4D content. Our method constructs a spatio-temporal multi-view image matrix with text-guided background manipulation, delivering coherent supervision over viewpoint, appear-ance, and motion. These synthesized observations are used to optimize 3D Gaussian primitives, which are then animated through a lightweight deformation module to form a 4D representation. The resulting scenes preserve geometry more faithfully, maintain smoother temporal behavior, and keep background edits more consistent, reducing context ambiguity and motion artifacts. Experiments on Objaverse-XL and Diffusion4D show that MATE4D outperforms strong baselines in visual quality, effi-ciency, and controllability, supporting practical AR/VR content creation.

papers.title: Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Registration: A Comprehensive Review, Challenges and Prospects
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal remote sensing image registration is a crucial prerequisite for the collaborative processing and downstream application of remote sensing data, such as image fusion, change detection, and target recognition. However, significant variations in radiometry, geometry, scale, viewpoint, and time often exist between multimodal images. These differences, driven by varying sensor geometries, physical radiation mechanisms, imaging platforms, and environmental disturbances, pose severe challenges to achieving high-precision, robust registration. This paper systematically reviews the progress of mainstream multimodal remote sensing image registration methods. Based on their registration pipelines, existing approaches are categorized into three main types: region-based, feature-based, and deep learning-based methods. We detail the core principles, representative algorithms, advantages, and limitations of each category. Additionally, we summarize publicly available multimodal image datasets in the remote sensing domain, analyzing their specific characteristics and applicable scenarios. Finally, we highlight current bottlenecks in high-precision registration research and outline future development trends. This review aims to provide a comprehensive reference and valuable insights for researchers in related fields.
papers.comment: 12 figures, 8 tables, 135 references. Review article accepted for publication in Photogrammetric Engineering and Remote Sensing (ASPS), manuscript number PERS-26-00034
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇多模态遥感图像配准综述，按配准流程把现有方法分为基于区域、基于特征、基于深度学习三类，逐类梳理核心原理、代表算法与优劣，并汇总遥感领域公开的多模态数据集及其适用场景。结论是高精度配准的瓶颈来自辐射、几何、尺度、视角与时间差异，这些差异源于传感器几何、物理辐射机制、成像平台与环境扰动。
Motivation: 多模态遥感图像在辐射、几何、尺度、视角和时间上差异显著，来源包括传感器几何、物理辐射机制、成像平台与环境扰动，这些差异严重阻碍高精度、鲁棒的配准，而配准是图像融合、变化检测、目标识别等下游协同处理的前提。
Method: 按配准流程把主流多模态遥感配准方法系统地分为基于区域、基于特征、基于深度学习三类，逐类详述核心原理、代表算法、优势与局限；同时汇总遥感领域公开的多模态图像数据集，分析各自特性与适用场景，并梳理高精度配准的现有瓶颈与未来趋势。
Result: 综述覆盖 135 篇参考文献、12 幅图、8 张表，按三类配准流程组织方法并汇总公开多模态遥感数据集；摘要未给出任何定量对比数字。
Conclusion: 多模态遥感配准的进展可按区域、特征、深度学习三条技术路线归纳，其精度瓶颈根植于成像条件差异，未来趋势指向更高精度与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Higher-Order Action Supervision Makes A Strong Policy Class
papers.abstract_en: Modern data-driven decision-making methods, such as imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL), have achieved great success in solving many complex tasks. However, these methods often suffer from serious control instability and robustness issues when applied in real-world applications such as robotics and autonomous driving, posing notable challenges for their practical deployment. We argue that this instability issue stems largely from their limitations in solely supervising and optimizing zeroth-order actions (i.e., the action labels), failing to account for higher-order action dynamics and temporal consistency. In this paper, we show that simultaneously supervising both zeroth- and first-order actions can dramatically enhance policies' performance and control robustness. To achieve this, we introduce a novel and elegant loss scheme supported by formal theoretical guarantees that can equip any off-the-shelf policy model (e.g., deterministic, stochastic, or flow policies) with the capability for higher-order action supervision, without requiring any structural modifications. Moreover, our proposed method can serve as a lightweight plug-and-play module that seamlessly integrates with a broad spectrum of existing offline RL frameworks. Extensive evaluations on OGBench and D4RL demonstrate that our approach yields substantial performance and robustness improvements across a wide range of continuous control environments. Notably, our method can also enhance policies' out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization capability in the challenging low-data regime, making it an ideal tool in tackling many real-world control problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文指出模仿学习与强化学习只监督零阶动作（动作标签）是控制不稳与鲁棒性差的主因，提出同时监督零阶与一阶动作的损失方案，可在不改结构的前提下给任意现成策略（确定性、随机或 flow policy）加上高阶动作监督。在 OGBench 与 D4RL 的连续控制评测中，性能与鲁棒性均有大幅提升，并在低数据 regime 下改善 OOD 泛化。
Motivation: IL/RL 部署到机器人与自动驾驶等真实系统时控制不稳定、鲁棒性不足，根源在于只优化零阶动作而忽略高阶动作动态与时间一致性。
Method: 提出一种带形式化理论保证的损失方案，同时监督零阶与一阶动作，无需结构修改即可套用到任意现成策略模型，并作为轻量即插即用模块接入多种 offline RL 框架。
Result: 在 OGBench 与 D4RL 上的广泛连续控制环境中，该方法带来显著的性能与鲁棒性提升；在低数据 regime 下还改善了策略的 OOD 泛化能力。
Conclusion: 同时监督零阶与一阶动作是提升策略控制鲁棒性与 OOD 泛化的有效途径，且可作为不改结构的通用即插即用模块。

papers.title: IntactWorld: Joint World Modeling with Intact Features
papers.abstract_en: While recent video generation models synthesize highly realistic visuals, they lack a genuine understanding of intrinsic real-world logic. Existing methods attempt to understand the world by internalizing diverse world knowledge, yet constrained by computational overhead or dimensionality alignment, their learning processes inevitably compress features, causing a severe loss of structural information. To address this, we propose \textbf{IntactWorld}, a \textbf{Joint World Modeling Architecture} utilizing uncompressed \textbf{Intact Features}. Since data naturally reside on a low-dimensional manifold within a high-dimensional space, predicting the flow velocity $v$ within this uncompressed high-dimensional space induces a severe manifold gap. To successfully eliminate this optimization bottleneck, our framework instead predicts the clean feature $x_0$ at intermediate layers. Furthermore, to mitigate the computational overhead of incorporating complete world knowledge, we introduce a \textit{Full-to-Compact Training Paradigm}. By replacing raw full features with highly refined CLS tokens, this paradigm enables efficient single-branch guidance, reducing spatial memory consumption by 11.4\% and cutting inference latency by 43.8\%. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of IntactWorld, outperforming established baselines by 2.46 points on the VBench 2.0 benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IntactWorld 用未压缩的 Intact Features 做联合世界建模：因数据位于高维空间的低维流形上，在未压缩空间直接预测流速度 v 会带来流形间隙，故改为在中间层预测干净特征 x0；并以 Full-to-Compact 训练范式用精炼 CLS token 替代原始全特征做单分支引导。空间内存降 11.4%、推理延迟降 43.8%，VBench 2.0 上超既有基线 2.46 分。
Motivation: 现有视频生成方法受计算开销与维度对齐限制，学习过程必然压缩特征，导致结构信息严重丢失，难以真正内化世界逻辑。
Method: 提出 Joint World Modeling Architecture，保留未压缩的 Intact Features；不在高维空间预测流速度 v，而是在中间层直接预测干净特征 x0 以消除优化瓶颈；Full-to-Compact 训练范式用高度精炼的 CLS token 替换原始全特征，实现高效单分支引导。
Result: 空间内存消耗减少 11.4%，推理延迟降低 43.8%；在 VBench 2.0 基准上比既有基线高出 2.46 分。
Conclusion: 在中间层预测 x0 而非在未压缩空间预测 v，配合 CLS token 的 Full-to-Compact 引导，可在保留结构信息的同时降低视频世界模型的内存与延迟开销。

papers.title: VAMR: Multi-Question Agentic Reasoning for Efficient Long-Form Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-form video understanding often involves multiple questions about different aspects of the same recording. Yet existing video agents typically process each question through an isolated tool-use trajectory. This repeatedly restarts video exploration and memory construction, missing opportunities to acquire evidence jointly and progressively build a shared understanding that supports the complete question set. We introduce \textbf{VAMR} (\textbf{V}ideo \textbf{A}gent for \textbf{M}ulti-Question \textbf{R}easoning), which coordinates all questions about a video through one shared tool-use trajectory. At each round, a persistent policy model can invoke tools for one or more unresolved questions and submit answers for questions with sufficient evidence. Question-conditioned visual perception retrieves fine-grained clues for several questions in one call, while layered multi-question memory integrates reusable context into a shared video story and preserves separate evidence for individual questions. After supervised fine-tuning initializes this interaction protocol, we propose question-horizon policy optimization (\qhpo) to optimize shared trajectories in which questions progress and finish at different rounds. Specifically, a question-level critic estimates the value of each active question, while round alignment maps each question advantage to the rounds that directly serve it before the aligned advantages are aggregated to optimize the shared actor. Across LVBench, Video-Holmes, and LongVideoBench, VAMR achieves the highest accuracy overall and the fewest reasoning rounds among iterative methods. On LVBench, it reaches 62.1\% accuracy, exceeding VideoARM by \textbf{4.3} points while reducing reasoning rounds and processed frames by \textbf{85.9\%} and \textbf{61.4\%}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VAMR 把同一长视频上的多个问题放进一条共享工具调用轨迹，由持久策略模型按轮次为未解问题调用工具并提交已有充分证据的答案，配合 question-conditioned 视觉感知与分层多问题记忆。经 SFT 初始化后用 question-horizon policy optimization (QHPO) 优化：question-level critic 估计各活跃问题价值，round alignment 把优势映射到直接服务的轮次再聚合。在 LVBench、Video-Holmes、LongVideoBench 上总体准确率最高且推理轮数最少，LVBench 达 62.1%，超 VideoARM 4.3 点，同时推理轮数与处理帧数分别减少 85.9% 和 61.4%。
Motivation: 现有长视频 agent 对每个问题走独立工具调用轨迹，反复重启视频探索与记忆构建，无法联合取证并累积共享理解，导致多问题场景下轮数与帧处理开销高。
Method: VAMR 用单一共享工具调用轨迹协调同一视频的全部问题：持久策略模型每轮可为多个未解问题调用工具并提交证据充分的答案；question-conditioned visual perception 在一次调用中检索多个问题的细粒度线索；layered multi-question memory 把可复用上下文整合为共享 video story 并保留各问题独立证据。SFT 初始化交互协议后，QHPO 用 question-level critic 估计每个活跃问题的价值，round alignment 将问题级优势映射到直接服务它的轮次，再聚合对齐优势优化共享 actor。
Result: 在 LVBench、Video-Holmes、LongVideoBench 上 VAMR 总体准确率最高，且在迭代式方法中推理轮数最少。LVBench 上准确率 62.1%，比 VideoARM 高 4.3 点，推理轮数减少 85.9%，处理帧数减少 61.4%。
Conclusion: 多问题共享一条工具调用轨迹并按问题-轮次对齐优势做策略优化，可在长视频多问题问答上同时提高准确率并大幅压缩推理轮数与帧处理量。

papers.title: SACQ: Structured Decoding with Memory-Conditioned Refinement for Long-Horizon Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) models predominantly employ patch-based encoders terminated by a flatten readout head that maps the entire encoded historical memory to all future steps through a single shared projection. This implicit coupling of future positions obscures position-specific historical-to-future alignment and amplifies sensitivity to corrupted inputs and extreme supervision noise. We present SACQ, a plug-in structured prediction head that replaces flatten readout while keeping the encoder unchanged. SACQ adopts a two-stage decoding pipeline: it first establishes a coarse patch-grid forecast scaffold, then refines each future position through cross-attention over historical memory and merges the attention-derived correction with the coarse scaffold via a learned per-patch gate. To stabilize optimization under long horizons and noisy labels, we further propose a batch-adaptive scaled log-cosh loss that automatically calibrates robustness to the current residual scale, suppressing outlier gradients while preserving MSE-like sensitivity for typical errors. SACQ attains top-tier test MSE/MAE across PatchTST, DLinear, and patch-Mamba backbones with only modest incremental overhead in parameters and latency. Under inference-time input corruption and training-set label-noise stress tests, SACQ substantially outperforms flatten readouts, with ablation studies validating each architectural component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SACQ 是一个即插即用的结构化解码头，替换 LTSF 中把全部历史记忆一次性投影到所有未来步的 flatten readout：先生成粗粒度 patch-grid 预测骨架，再用对未来位置的 cross-attention 从历史记忆中取修正量，经逐 patch 门控与骨架融合，并配合 batch-adaptive scaled log-cosh 损失抑制离群梯度。在 PatchTST、DLinear、patch-Mamba 三个骨干上取得顶级 test MSE/MAE，参数与延迟开销仅小幅增加，且在推理期输入损坏与训练标签噪声压力测试中显著优于 flatten readout。
Motivation: flatten readout 用单一共享投影耦合所有未来位置，掩盖了位置特定的历史-未来对齐，并放大对损坏输入与极端监督噪声的敏感性，长时程预报下尤其突出。
Method: 两阶段解码：先建立粗 patch-grid 预测骨架，再对每个未来位置做历史记忆上的 cross-attention，用学习得到的逐 patch 门控把注意力修正与骨架合并；编码器保持不变。训练用 batch-adaptive scaled log-cosh 损失，按当前残差尺度自动校准鲁棒性，压低离群梯度同时保留对典型误差的 MSE 式敏感度。
Result: 在 PatchTST、DLinear、patch-Mamba 三个骨干上取得顶级 test MSE/MAE，参数与延迟仅小幅增量；在推理期输入损坏与训练集标签噪声压力测试中显著优于 flatten readout，消融验证各架构组件均有效。

papers.title: PMTRM: Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module for Embodied Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation often contains repeated motions whose local observations look similar at different phases. When these phases require different actions, a policy that relies mainly on the current observation may repeat completed motions or switch phases at the wrong time. To address this phase ambiguity, we present the Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module (PMTRM), a lightweight plug-in module with only 7.61M parameters that encodes a bounded history of executed states and actions into a latent sequence for existing policies. To help distinguish phases, a temporal heterogeneity objective penalizes positive similarity between distant positions in this sequence, while anchor and reconstruction losses preserve information needed for action prediction. The reconstruction decoder is used only during training, leaving the temporal re-encoder to supply history to the policy at inference. We train the module progressively on synthetic sequences and robot data, then jointly with the policy, using temporal masking to accommodate partial histories. This integration retains the original action head and action space and adds auxiliary losses to the original policy loss. Experiments with multiple policy backbones in simulation and on a real robot show improved task success on tasks with phase ambiguity, with little additional computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PMTRM 是一个 7.61M 参数的即插即用伪记忆时序重编码模块，把已执行状态与动作的有界历史编码成隐序列喂给现有策略，用时序异质性目标惩罚远距离位置的正相似来区分阶段。在含阶段歧义的任务上，多策略骨干在仿真与真机实验中均提升任务成功率，且额外计算开销很小。
Motivation: 机器人操作中重复动作在不同阶段的局部观测高度相似，仅依赖当前观测的策略会重复已完成动作或在错误时刻切换阶段（phase ambiguity）。
Method: PMTRM 以有界历史状态与动作为输入，经时序重编码器输出隐序列供策略使用；损失为时序异质性目标（惩罚序列远距离位置的正相似）加 anchor loss 与 reconstruction loss，重建解码器仅训练期使用；先在合成序列与机器人数据上渐进训练，再与策略联合训练，并用 temporal masking 适配部分历史，保留原动作头与动作空间。
Result: 模块参数量 7.61M；在多个策略骨干上、仿真与真机实验中，含阶段歧义的任务成功率提升，额外计算开销很小。
Conclusion: 把有界执行历史重编码为隐序列并用时序异质性目标区分阶段，可在不改动原动作头的前提下缓解相位歧义导致的重复动作与错误切换。

papers.title: PIVOT: Perplexity-Informed KD-to-RL Transition Scheduling for Vertical-Domain Few-Shot Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Vertical-domain few-shot classification remains challenging for small language models, as limited supervision makes it difficult to acquire domain-specific decision knowledge. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) can improve teacher-guided adaptation by supervising student-generated rollouts, while GRPO-based reinforcement learning can further refine downstream predictions. However, existing KD-to-RL pipelines typically rely on globally fixed transition schedules, ignoring that different samples may require different amounts of teacher-guided acquisition before reward-driven refinement. We propose PIVOT (Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization), a dynamic transition framework that routes samples between OPD and GRPO according to teacher-evaluated sequence perplexity. PIVOT moves low-perplexity samples to GRPO for reward-driven refinement while keeping high-perplexity samples under OPD for continued domain knowledge acquisition. Experiments on Banking77 and HWU64 show that PIVOT consistently outperforms continued OPD and globally synchronized OPD$\rightarrow$GRPO baselines under the same number of post-warm-up student optimization steps, achieving stronger downstream performance and more stable training dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PIVOT 用教师评估的序列困惑度 (perplexity) 逐样本决定何时从 On-Policy Distillation 切到 GRPO：低困惑度样本转入奖励驱动的 GRPO 精修，高困惑度样本留在 OPD 继续学领域知识。在 Banking77 与 HWU64 的垂直领域少样本分类上，同等 warm-up 后优化步数下，它稳定优于持续 OPD 和全局同步的 OPD→GRPO 切换基线。
Motivation: 垂直领域少样本分类中监督稀缺，小语言模型难以学到领域决策知识；现有 KD-to-RL 流水线用全局固定切换时刻，忽略了不同样本所需的教师引导量不同。
Method: PIVOT（Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization）按教师评估的序列困惑度把样本在 OPD 与 GRPO 之间路由：低困惑度样本交给 GRPO 做奖励驱动精修，高困惑度样本继续留在 OPD；warm-up 后按相同优化步数与基线对比。
Result: 在 Banking77 和 HWU64 上，PIVOT 在相同 warm-up 后学生优化步数下，持续优于 continued OPD 与全局同步 OPD→GRPO 两类基线，取得更强的下游性能和更稳定的训练动态。
Conclusion: KD-to-RL 的切换应按样本困惑度逐条路由而非全局同步，这样能在少样本垂直领域同时提升下游表现与训练稳定性。

papers.title: CARE: A Lightweight Plug-in Gated Correction and Uncertainty-aware Module for Long-term Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate long-horizon forecasting is critical to electricity load scheduling and traffic flow management, and to financial risk control. Existing deterministic backbones output a single trajectory, masking heterogeneous prediction difficulty across horizons and channels and providing no localized reliability signal. We present CARE (Corrective branch with Aligned context and Relative-error Estimation), a lightweight plug-in that enhances any deterministic forecaster without architectural redesign. Operating in parallel with the base model, CARE resamples historical context to match the forecast horizon, learns residual correction patterns from this aligned history, and applies scale-aware bounded updates modulated by per-coordinate sigmoid risk gates. A multi-objective loss jointly optimizes forecast accuracy, residual tracking, risk alignment, and base-model anchoring. Across eight benchmarks with three representative backbones, CARE improves accuracy with marginal parameter and latency overhead. Its risk gates reliably identify high-error regions: on Weather, the highest-gate tertile exhibits nearly four times the error of the lowest-gate tertile, offering planners an interpretable per-step trust signal. Code is available at https://github.com/CG-BNYC/CARE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARE 是一个即插即用的轻量模块，与任意确定性长序列预测骨干并行运行：把历史上下文重采样到预测时长上学习残差修正，再用逐坐标 sigmoid 风险门控施加尺度感知的有界更新。在八个基准、三个骨干上以极小参数与延迟开销提升精度；在 Weather 数据上，风险门最高的三分位误差约为最低三分位的近四倍，可作为逐步可信度信号。
Motivation: 确定性预测骨干只输出单条轨迹，掩盖了不同时长与通道上预测难度的异质性，也无法给出局部可靠性信号；电力负荷、交通流与金融风控需要按步的可信度指示。
Method: CARE（Corrective branch with Aligned context and Relative-error Estimation）作为并行插件接入骨干而不改架构：将历史上下文重采样以匹配预测时长，在对齐历史上学习残差修正模式，用逐坐标 sigmoid 风险门调制尺度感知的有界更新；多目标损失联合优化预测精度、残差跟踪、风险对齐与对基模型的锚定。
Result: 在八个基准、三个代表性骨干上，CARE 以极小的参数与延迟开销提升预测精度；风险门能可靠定位高误差区域——在 Weather 数据上，门值最高的三分位误差接近最低三分位的四倍。
Conclusion: 在不重设计骨干的前提下，对齐历史的残差修正加风险门控既能提高长程多变量预测精度，又能给出可解释的逐步信任信号。

papers.title: RideBench: A Large-Scale Exogenous-Aware Benchmark for Ride-Hailing Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: We release Ride-Hailing, a large-scale ride-hailing time series dataset synthesized from DiDi's marketplace data across 200 spatial areas. Ride-Hailing spans four consecutive years at half-hourly granularity and covers three representative exogenous scenarios: Weather Disturbance, Holiday Effect, and Large-scale Event Impact. Built upon Ride-Hailing, we introduce RideBench, a comprehensive benchmark for exogenous-aware ride-hailing forecasting, covering both regular week-ahead forecasting and long-horizon 8-week-ahead forecasting with up to 2,688 prediction steps. RideBench evaluates over 30 representative forecasting methods, including endogenous-only models, exogenous-aware models, and time series foundation models. Our results show that future-known exogenous variables provide clear benefits in regular week-ahead forecasting, especially under weather, holiday, and large-scale event (e.g., major sporting events and concerts) scenarios. However, current exogenous-aware models still struggle to fully capture disturbance-induced pattern changes under complex external contexts. For long-horizon forecasting, existing models cannot simultaneously achieve low pointwise errors, accurate broad trends, and reliable near-term forecasts. These findings reveal a clear mismatch between existing forecasting models and real-world ride-hailing requirements, highlighting the need for models that can better exploit future-known exogenous information, scale across heterogeneous areas, and support long-horizon planning. By introducing Ride-Hailing and RideBench, we aim to encourage the community to study these practical challenges in real-world ride-hailing forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RideBench 发布基于滴滴出行市场数据、覆盖 200 个空间区域、四年半小时粒度的 Ride-Hailing 数据集，并在其上评测 30 余个外生变量感知的时序预测方法。结果显示未来已知的外生变量（天气、节假日、大型活动）在常规一周前瞻预测中带来明确收益，但现有模型仍难以刻画扰动引起的模式变化；长时程预测中没有模型能同时做到低逐点误差、准确大趋势与可靠近期预报。
Motivation: 打车需求预测需要跨异质区域做长时程规划，但现有模型与真实运营需求存在明显错配：既难以利用未来已知的外生信息，也无法在 8 周前瞻尺度上兼顾逐点误差、趋势与近期精度。
Method: 构建 Ride-Hailing 数据集：从 DiDi 市场数据合成，200 个空间区域、连续四年、半小时粒度，含 Weather Disturbance、Holiday Effect、Large-scale Event Impact 三类外生场景。在其上建立 RideBench，覆盖常规一周前瞻与最长 2,688 步的 8 周前瞻预测，评测 30 余个方法，分为仅内生模型、外生感知模型与时序基础模型三类。
Result: 评测 30 余个方法：未来已知外生变量在常规一周前瞻预测中带来清晰收益，在天气、节假日与大型活动（大型体育赛事、演唱会）场景下尤其明显；但现有外生感知模型仍难以完全捕捉复杂外部情境下扰动引发的模式变化。长时程预测上，现有模型无法同时实现低逐点误差、准确的宽趋势与可靠的近期预报。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有预测模型与真实打车需求存在明确错配，需要能更好利用未来已知外生信息、跨异质区域扩展并支持长时程规划的模型。

summary_sections.motivation: 打车需求预测需要跨异质区域做长时程规划，但现有模型与真实运营需求存在明显错配：既难以利用未来已知的外生信息，也无法在 8 周前瞻尺度上兼顾逐点误差、趋势与近期精度。
summary_sections.method: 构建 Ride-Hailing 数据集：从 DiDi 市场数据合成，200 个空间区域、连续四年、半小时粒度，含 Weather Disturbance、Holiday Effect、Large-scale Event Impact 三类外生场景。在其上建立 RideBench，覆盖常规一周前瞻与最长 2,688 步的 8 周前瞻预测，评测 30 余个方法，分为仅内生模型、外生感知模型与时序基础模型三类。
summary_sections.result: 评测 30 余个方法：未来已知外生变量在常规一周前瞻预测中带来清晰收益，在天气、节假日与大型活动（大型体育赛事、演唱会）场景下尤其明显；但现有外生感知模型仍难以完全捕捉复杂外部情境下扰动引发的模式变化。长时程预测上，现有模型无法同时实现低逐点误差、准确的宽趋势与可靠的近期预报。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为现有预测模型与真实打车需求存在明确错配，需要能更好利用未来已知外生信息、跨异质区域扩展并支持长时程规划的模型。

papers.title: Characterizing Statistical Separability in TP-CRIV for Probabilistic AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Third-party challenge-response identity verification (TP-CRIV) enables an independent verifier to assess whether a claimant possesses a model identical to a remotely deployed model without directly accessing the reference model. However, for probabilistic AI models, repeated executions of the same query may produce different outputs and therefore different verification observations. This raises the question of how such stochastic evidence should be accumulated and how much evidence is required for reliable verification. In this work, we characterize statistical separability in TP-CRIV of probabilistic AI models. Specifically, we relate challenge-wise behavior of matching and non-matching provers to verification-level separability. The characterization explicitly describes how the numbers of independent challenges and repeated responses affect detection performance and enables the verification budget required for a target AUC to be estimated. We instantiate the proposed characterization for LLMs using open-ended challenges. The experiments demonstrate matching-non-matching separation, close agreement between theoretical and empirical AUCs, and consistent estimates of the minimum verification budgets. These results provide a statistical basis for relating probabilistic model behavior to verification-level separability and the evidence required for third-party verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对概率型 AI 模型的第三方挑战-响应身份验证 (TP-CRIV)，把单次挑战层面的匹配/不匹配行为映射到验证层面的统计可分性，显式刻画独立挑战数与重复响应数如何决定检测性能，并据此估计达到目标 AUC 所需的最小验证预算。在以开放式挑战实例化的 LLM 实验中，匹配与不匹配被分离开，理论 AUC 与经验 AUC 接近一致，最小验证预算估计稳定。
Motivation: 概率模型对同一查询重复执行会给出不同输出，导致验证观测随机，如何累积这类随机证据、需要多少证据才能可靠验证缺乏统计刻画。
Method: 将挑战层面匹配与非匹配证明者的行为关联到验证层面可分性，显式建模独立挑战数与重复响应数对检测性能的影响，并给出目标 AUC 所需验证预算的估计方法；随后用开放式挑战 (open-ended challenges) 在 LLM 上实例化该刻画。
Result: LLM 实验展示了匹配与不匹配的分离、理论 AUC 与经验 AUC 的接近一致，以及最小验证预算估计的一致性；刻画本身显式给出挑战数与重复响应数对检测性能的影响。
Conclusion: 概率模型的行为可以通过该统计刻画与第三方验证层面的可分性及所需证据量联系起来，为验证预算提供统计依据。
