papers.title: Stability-Plasticity Balance via Singular-Vector Selection in LLM Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Domain-specific continual adaptation of LLMs risks catastrophic forgetting, creating a fundamental tension between acquiring new capabilities and preserving those learned during pretraining. PEFT mitigates this problem by restricting the number of trainable parameters, but existing methods lack a principled unit for deciding where plasticity should be allocated and stability should be preserved. We identify the singular-vector channel as a natural unit for managing this trade-off. Each channel represents an input-output transformation, which can be updated to acquire new knowledge or fixed to preserve pretrained capabilities. Based on this perspective, we introduce SVC, a parameter-efficient continual-learning method that selectively updates Singular-Vector Channels. Before fine-tuning, SVC uses domain-specific data to estimate each channel's adaptation benefit and a fixed public general-domain corpus only as a history activation proxy for estimating forgetting cost. It then adaptively selects trainable channels based on these scores via knee-based cost screening, Pareto-front filtering, and Otsu thresholding. Experimental results across four LLM families and eight downstream tasks show that SVC better preserves pretrained capabilities while achieving strong downstream performance relative to existing PEFT baselines. Further analysis of channel scoring and selection demonstrates that selective plasticity at the singular-vector-channel level enables effective continual LLM adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SVC：把奇异向量通道 (singular-vector channel) 作为分配可塑性与稳定性的基本单元，按适应收益与遗忘代价打分后自适应挑选可训练通道。在四个 LLM 家族、八个下游任务上，SVC 相对现有 PEFT 基线更好地保留预训练能力同时保持强下游表现。
Motivation: LLM 领域持续适配存在灾难性遗忘，PEFT 虽限制可训练参数量，但缺少决定「在哪里分配可塑性、在哪里保持稳定性」的原则性单元。
Method: SVC 在微调前用领域数据估计每个奇异向量通道的适应收益，用固定公共通用领域语料仅作为 history activation proxy 来估计遗忘代价；再经 knee-based cost screening、Pareto-front filtering 与 Otsu thresholding 自适应选出可训练通道。
Result: 在四个 LLM 家族和八个下游任务上，SVC 相对现有 PEFT 基线更好地保留预训练能力并取得强下游表现；对通道打分与选择的进一步分析支持在奇异向量通道层面做选择性可塑性。
Conclusion: 奇异向量通道是管理稳定性—可塑性权衡的合适单元，按通道选择性开放可塑性即可实现有效的 LLM 持续适配。

papers.title: Optimally Pacing Budget Spending and Learning
papers.abstract_en: We establish near-optimal regret bounds for budget-constrained online learning against arbitrary classes of budget-pacing experts in the adversarial setting. In particular, given any class of $F$ experts and a candidate budget pacing schedule, we provide a full-information algorithm which obtains regret $O(D \sqrt{\log F}+ \sqrt{T\log F})$ against all experts whose cumulative spending stays within distance $D$ of this schedule, matching lower bounds established by Braverman et al. (2025). We additionally show that our technique extends to various problems in online resource allocation, where the learner gets to see the rewards and costs of the current options available to them, and establish $O(D\sqrt{\log F})$ regret bounds when fractional allocation is allowed. This is the first algorithm we are aware of which can achieve $o(\sqrt{T})$ guarantees for such tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在对抗设定下给出预算约束在线学习的近最优遗憾界：对任意 F 个预算节奏 (budget pacing) 专家类，全信息算法对所有累计支出与候选节奏距离不超过 D 的专家取得 O(D√logF + √(T logF)) 遗憾，匹配 Braverman et al. (2025) 的下界；允许分数分配时在线资源分配问题可降到 O(D√logF)，是首个达到 o(√T) 保证的算法。
Motivation: 预算约束在线学习中，学习者要与一整类按节奏花钱的专家竞争，此前缺少同时依赖节奏偏差 D 与类规模 F 的近最优遗憾保证，资源分配任务上也无 o(√T) 的结果。
Method: 针对候选预算节奏调度设计全信息算法，对累计支出落在该调度 D-邻域内的专家类做竞争；技术可推广到在线资源分配（学习者可见当前选项的收益与成本），并在允许分数分配时给出 O(D√logF) 界。
Result: 遗憾界 O(D√logF + √(T logF))，匹配 Braverman et al. (2025) 的下界；资源分配推广在分数分配下为 O(D√logF)，为该类任务首个 o(√T) 保证。
Conclusion: 预算节奏偏差 D 与专家类规模 F 足以刻画这类对抗在线学习的难度，且分数分配能把遗憾压到次 √T 级。

papers.title: No Distillation Needed: Single-Pass Real-Time Talking Heads via Acausal Noise Shaping
papers.abstract_en: Audio-driven facial animation underpins real-time avatars, telepresence, and embodied virtual agents. And it must run online: each frame emitted from audio observed up to the current time, at interactive rates. Recent progress is dominated by diffusion models, which need many network evaluations per sample and are therefore a poor fit for streaming. We argue the cost is unnecessary in this domain. Audio-conditioned facial motion occupies a comparatively low-dimensional manifold, a regime where a single-pass GAN suffices. The obstacle is not capacity but stochastic structure. We show that a causal, time-invariant generator driven by i.i.d. noise cannot suppress its output spectrum over a band without collapsing its per-step innovation. We proposed FaceGAN, which dissolved the limitation by shaping the noise pathway acausally. Because the driving noise is synthetic, its future can be sampled now, so the audio-to-expression path stays causal, and the model supports fully causal operation. FaceGAN emits expression and head pose in a single forward pass per frame and matches or outperforms state-of-art approaches in generation quality. Being feed-forward with bounded attention windows, it generates indefinitely without drift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FaceGAN 用单次前向的 GAN 替代扩散式音频驱动人脸动画：因果时不变生成器无法在压低输出频带的同时保住每步创新，作者改为非因果地整形噪声通路（合成噪声的未来可提前采样），使音频到表情的路径保持因果。每帧一次前向即输出表情与头部姿态，生成质量匹配或超过现有方法，且因注意力窗口有界可无限生成不漂移。
Motivation: 实时 avatar、远程呈现与具身虚拟代理要求逐帧在线生成人脸动画，而当前主流扩散模型每样本需多次网络评估，不适合流式推理。
Method: FaceGAN：单次前向的 GAN 生成器，音频条件驱动表情与头部姿态；核心是 acausal noise shaping——合成驱动噪声的未来可提前采样，从而在保持音频到表达路径因果、支持完全因果运行的同时绕开因果时不变生成器的频带抑制与创新塌缩限制；注意力窗口有界。
Result: 每帧单次前向输出表情与头部姿态，生成质量匹配或优于 state-of-the-art 方法；可无限时长生成而不产生漂移；相对扩散模型每样本多次评估，推理为 feed-forward 单遍。
Conclusion: 音频条件人脸运动处于低维流形，单遍 GAN 足以胜任，扩散式的多步采样开销在该域是不必要的；非因果噪声整形是让因果流式模型既抑噪又不塌缩创新的关键。

papers.title: Diffusion Meta-Prompting and Steering for Generalizable Foundation Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Prompt learning is a popular method for adapting foundation models, but learned prompts are typically task-specific and fail to generalize to new classes, domains, or compositions of tasks. In this paper, we introduce a Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP) model , a framework that models the distribution of learned prompts using diffusion models. Given a repository of previously learned prompts, DMP is trained and sampled without access to the original task examples or task losses, and synthesizes new prompts conditioned on natural language task descriptions. To improve the sampling stability, we introduce a test-time steering strategy for DMP, which uses the best training-selected prompt in the repository as a latent anchor during diffusion sampling, without retraining the DMP or accessing test classes. DMP improves generalization across classification, retrieval and text-to-image generation tasks, supports concept composition and negative prompting without explicit training. It reduces storage and inference costs by over 90% compared to prompt retrieval methods. For composite classification, DMP achieves upto 2.0% average gain over prior meta-learning methods across 55 pairs of datasets with gains as high as 8.5% on specific pairs such as Eurosat and Flowers. DMP also enhances cross-task generalization with ~2-9% improvement for hierarchical classification task. We further provide a theoretical guarantee bounding the expected task loss of prompts sampled from a DMP. Code is available: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://deepaksridhar.github.io/dmp.github.io/. Code: https://github.com/DeepakSridhar/dmp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Diffusion Meta-Prompt (DMP)，用 diffusion 模型对已学到的 prompt 分布建模，仅凭自然语言任务描述即可合成新 prompt，无需原始任务样本或任务损失。测试时用仓库中最优 prompt 作 latent anchor 做 steering，不重训也不接触测试类。复合分类上较先前 meta-learning 方法在 55 对数据集上平均提升至多 2.0%（Eurosat、Flowers 等特定对高达 8.5%），存储与推理成本较 prompt 检索方法降低 90% 以上。
Motivation: prompt learning 学到的 prompt 通常是任务专用的，遇到新类、新域或任务组合时无法泛化；已有 prompt 检索方法又带来高昂的存储与推理开销。
Method: DMP 用 diffusion 模型对 prompt 仓库中已学 prompt 的分布建模，训练与采样都不访问原始任务样本和任务损失，采样时以自然语言任务描述为条件合成新 prompt；测试时引入 steering 策略，把仓库中训练阶段选出的最优 prompt 作为 diffusion 采样的 latent anchor，不重训模型也不访问测试类。
Result: 复合分类上较先前 meta-learning 方法在 55 对数据集上平均提升至多 2.0%，其中 Eurosat 与 Flowers 等特定数据集对提升高达 8.5%；层次分类任务上跨任务泛化提升约 2–9%；相比 prompt 检索方法存储与推理成本降低 90% 以上；并给出约束 DMP 采样 prompt 期望任务损失的理论保证。
Conclusion: 把 prompt 当作可由 diffusion 生成的分布而非固定参数，配合测试时 latent anchor steering，可在不接触原始任务与测试类的前提下同时改善跨任务泛化并大幅压缩 prompt 存储与推理开销。

papers.title: CityDeploy-Bench: Benchmarking Physics-Grounded Spatial Set Planning for Multi-Transmitter Network Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Automating city-scale wireless deployment remains challenging under complex urban propagation and network-wide interference. We introduce \textbf{CityDeploy-Bench}, a benchmark that reframes multi-transmitter deployment as \emph{physics-grounded spatial set planning} under a unified ray-tracing verifier. The benchmark separates utility representation from planning dynamics, enabling controlled comparison between direct scalar rewards, relational models, and higher-order interaction structures across diverse planners. Our experiments reveal a clear transition in planning behavior as physical coupling grows. Deployment quality becomes increasingly dependent on whether the learned utility captures collective transmitter interactions, whereas stronger search alone cannot compensate for missing relational structure. This establishes multi-transmitter deployment as a coordination problem over physically interacting sets rather than a collection of independent spatial decisions. We release CityDeploy-Data and the benchmark framework as a reproducible testbed for research linking decision learning with physically grounded wireless network design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CityDeploy-Bench 把城市多基站部署重构为统一 ray-tracing 验证器下的物理接地空间集合规划 (physics-grounded spatial set planning)，把效用表示与规划动态解耦，以对比直接标量奖励、关系模型与高阶交互结构。实验显示随物理耦合增强，部署质量越来越取决于学习到的效用是否刻画发射机间的集体交互，单纯加强搜索无法弥补缺失的关系结构。
Motivation: 城市尺度无线部署受复杂 urban 传播与全网干扰制约，把多发射机部署当作彼此独立的空间决策会丢掉物理耦合，导致规划方法之间无法受控比较。
Method: 在统一 ray-tracing 验证器下把多发射机部署定义为空间集合规划，分离效用表示与规划 dynamics，从而在多种 planner 之间受控比较直接标量奖励、关系模型与高阶交互结构；发布 CityDeploy-Data 与 benchmark 框架。
Result: 实验揭示规划行为随物理耦合增长出现清晰转变：部署质量日益依赖学习效用是否捕捉发射机的集体交互，而更强的搜索无法补偿缺失的关系结构。
Conclusion: 多发射机部署本质上是对物理交互集合的协调问题，而非独立空间决策的集合；CityDeploy-Data 与框架作为可复现 testbed 连接决策学习与物理接地的无线网络设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring and Mitigating Solution Mode Collapse in RLVR
papers.abstract_en: A language model (LM) can usually answer the same question in more than one way, but reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is indifferent to which correct answer a model produces. A solution will earn the same reward whether it is the thousandth copy of a familiar answer or one the model has never produced before. Yet, there is potential value in having the model retain multiple correct solutions as it is trained. For instance, multiple modes may give users a choice and provide problem-solving strategies that improve overall model performance. Here, we introduce ModeBench, a benchmark of multi-solution tasks in which the verifier returns both correctness and mode discovered. We then use ModeBench to measure how solution diversity changes under RLVR post-training. We find that RLVR post-training concentrates probability onto fewer correct modes even as accuracy holds or improves, and moreover, that frontier models are already highly concentrated. We then introduce our solution, Re:Max, which stores one verified example per discovered mode in a replay buffer and trains on those stored modes uniformly. A solution found once is, therefore, practiced as often as one found repeatedly. Across three model scales, two RL objectives, and harder task constructions, replay improves both how often a policy succeeds and how many different ways it can succeed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR 后训练会把概率质量压到更少的正确解法上，即使准确率持平或上升；为此提出 Re:Max，用 replay buffer 每个已发现 mode 存一条验证样本并均匀回放，使只解出一次的解法与反复解出的解法得到同等练习。在三个模型规模、两种 RL 目标与更难任务构造下，回放同时提高成功率与可解出的不同解法数。
Motivation: RLVR 的可验证奖励对模型产出哪一个正确答案完全无差别，同一解法被重复上千次与首次出现拿到相同奖励，导致训练中多解能力被压缩。
Method: 提出 ModeBench，一个多解任务基准，其 verifier 同时返回正确性与发现的 mode；用它测量 RLVR 后训练下解法多样性的变化；再提出 Re:Max，为每个已发现 mode 在 replay buffer 中存一条已验证样本，并对这些 mode 均匀训练。
Result: RLVR 后训练使概率集中到更少的正确 mode，而准确率持平或提升；前沿模型本身已高度集中。Re:Max 在三个模型规模、两种 RL 目标和更难任务构造下，同时提高策略成功率与能成功的不同解法数量。
Conclusion: 解法多样性是 RLVR 中可被主动保留的资源：把每个已发现 mode 等量回放，就能在不牺牲准确率的前提下让模型保住并扩展多条正确解法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emergent Inverse-Depth Scaling From Nonlinearity In Attention
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws describe power-law improvements in model performance with dataset size and parameter count, yet their underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. To explain the parameter count scaling, existing theory posits power-law scaling with model depth. In linear-attention models, this scaling is tied to a power-law data spectrum: unable to selectively attend to relevant tokens, these models learn according to global spectral strength, with stronger directions learned before weaker ones. Large language models, however, can be strongly nonlinear. Here, we show that nonlinear attention yields inverse-depth decay of loss across all tested data spectra. Nonlinearity enables attention to focus selectively on relevant tokens, allowing strong and weak spectral directions to be learned in parallel. Similar focusing across layers motivates a connection to the central limit theorem: shared error across layers sets the loss plateau, while aggregation turns layer-specific differences into continued gains with depth. Our findings suggest that depth scaling may arise from nonlinearity in attention, which allows large language models to focus locally and may make the global covariance structure less relevant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文主张 Transformer 的深度幂律缩放来自注意力的非线性而非数据谱：线性注意力只能按全局谱强度依次学习，非线性注意力可选择性聚焦相关 token，使强弱谱方向并行学习，在所有被测数据谱上都产生损失随深度的 1/L 衰减。跨层相似聚焦被类比为中心极限定理——共享误差决定损失平台，层间差异的聚合带来随深度的持续增益。
Motivation: 参数量缩放律的既有理论把幂律归因于深度与幂律数据谱，但线性注意力无法选择性关注 token，而真实大模型高度非线性，深度缩放的机制来源并不清楚。
Method: 对比线性注意力与非线性注意力在多种数据谱下的深度-损失关系；用注意力对相关 token 的选择性聚焦解释强弱谱方向并行学习，再以中心极限定理式的跨层共享误差与聚合给出损失平台与随深度增益的解释。
Result: 非线性注意力在所有被测数据谱上均给出损失随深度的逆幂（1/L）衰减；线性注意力的深度缩放则绑定于幂律数据谱。摘要给出的是机制性结论，无数据集或基线上的具体数值。
Conclusion: 深度缩放可能源于注意力的非线性，使大语言模型得以局部聚焦，并可能让全局协方差结构变得不那么重要。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AffordDrive3D: Affordance-Aware World-Action Modeling with Spatial Understanding
papers.abstract_en: World-action models have recently improved autonomous driving by jointly learning future scene prediction and trajectory generation. Most existing approaches model the future primarily through RGB appearance, and recent works have begun to incorporate geometric prediction to improve spatial understanding. However, dense geometry describes the spatial layout of the entire scene without indicating which parts are most relevant to the ego vehicle's action. For driving, the model must also identify and anticipate where it can safely move and which regions may pose collision risks. Jointly modeling action-relevant regions and future geometry can provide the policy with both driving-relevant cues and their corresponding spatial structure. We therefore propose AffordDrive3D, an affordance- and geometry-aware world-action model that jointly learns future action-relevant regions and spatial structure. In order to capture the scene semantics and driving context needed for driving affordance prediction, we build AffordDrive3D on a VLM backbone to forecast drivable areas and collision-critical regions that directly affect ego motion, while predicting future geometry from RGB world-model latents. On NAVSIM, AffordDrive3D achieves state-of-the-art performance with 91.3 PDMS and 89.9 EPDMS, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling future affordances and geometry for trajectory planning.

papers.title: Refine Connections, Close the Gap: A Reliable Enhancement Framework for Driving Scene Topology
papers.abstract_en: In autonomous driving, understanding scene topology - the connectivity between lanes and traffic elements - is critical for safe path planning and motion control. While current methods excel at detecting individual map elements, their connectivity reasoning often falls short of its theoretical potential, leaving a significant performance gap relative to the theoretical upper-bound achievable given the underlying detections. Furthermore, the decision-ready topology graphs passed to downstream tasks often remain unreliable. Current approaches typically derive connectivity by thresholding continuous topology scores; however, these scores often fail to reflect the true logical likelihood of connectivity, resulting in false positives or missing connections. Existing benchmarks further overlook this issue by primarily evaluating continuous metrics, rather than assessing the discrete connectivity required for decision-making. To bridge these gaps, we propose TopoEnhance, a novel topology enhancement framework designed to unlock the latent potential of existing methods and improve the reliability of decision-ready topology. We formulate topology enhancement as a denoising-based reconstruction process, where the model learns to recover structural consistency from stochastically corrupted ground-truth graphs. This formulation enables the model to resolve logical inconsistencies and rectify unreliable connections, producing robust discrete topology graphs that closely approach theoretical maximum performance. Extensive experiments across different baselines show that TopoEnhance consistently improves both continuous topology metrics (TOP score), and discrete connectivity measured by our adapted Topology Jaccard Similarity (TJS) metric. As a flexible, source-agnostic framework, TopoEnhance delivers substantial gains across diverse state-of-the-art baselines without requiring retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoEnhance 把驾驶场景拓扑增强建模为去噪重建：在被随机破坏的真实拓扑图上学习恢复结构一致性，从而修正逻辑不一致与不可靠连接，输出可直接用于下游决策的离散拓扑图。作为与源方法无关的框架，它在多个 SOTA 基线上同时提升连续 TOP score 与离散连通性指标 TJS，且无需重训练。
Motivation: 现有方法能检测单个地图元素，但连通性推理远低于给定检测下的理论上界；且用阈值得到的离散连接不可靠，现有基准只评连续指标、不评决策所需的离散连通性。
Method: 将拓扑增强表述为基于去噪的重建过程：模型在随机损坏的真实图上学习恢复结构一致性，从而解析逻辑冲突并修正连接，输出稳健的离散拓扑图；框架与源方法解耦，无需重训练。
Result: 在多个不同基线上，TopoEnhance 一致提升连续拓扑指标 TOP score 与作者提出的离散连通性指标 Topology Jaccard Similarity (TJS)，并使离散拓扑接近理论上界表现。
Conclusion: 对连续拓扑分数直接阈值化不可靠，用去噪重建在检测之上重建离散连通性，可在不重训基线的情况下释放其潜在性能并提升决策可用性。

papers.title: Learning What to Trust in Multimodal Learning under Noisy Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal classification processes and relates information from multiple modalities to achieve more accurate predictions. However, existing methods typically rely on high-quality ground-truth labels, which are difficult to obtain in real-world scenarios. While sample-selection methods for learning with noisy labels aim to identify correctly labeled examples from noisy data, traditional methods primarily focus on unimodal settings and fail to exploit multimodal information fully. This motivates us to build a more reliable noise detector in multimodal learning. To this end, we theoretically analyze the relationship between representation structure and noise detection capability. Based on this analysis, we propose REFINE, which is a multimodal label-noise detection framework that jointly uses fused and unimodal representations for label-noise detection. Specifically, REFINE constructs discriminative eigenvectors through discriminative analysis of the target and background classes and selects trusted representation spaces with better noise detection capability for each class. Within each trusted space, REFINE measures the alignment between each instance representation and the discriminative eigenvectors. It then combines the subsets selected from these spaces. The combined set provides cleaner supervision for updating the multimodal classifier, thereby reducing the influence of mislabeled examples during training and improving model generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate REFINE's superiority compared to baseline methods. The source code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REFINE 是一个多模态标签噪声检测框架：对目标类与背景类做判别分析构造判别特征向量，为每个类挑选噪声检测能力更好的可信表示空间，在其中度量实例表示与判别特征向量的对齐度，再合并各空间选出的可信子集，用更干净的监督更新多模态分类器。作者给出表示结构与噪声检测能力之间关系的理论分析，并称在多种任务上相对基线方法体现优势。
Motivation: 多模态分类依赖高质量真实标签，而真实场景中难以获得；现有样本选择式噪声学习方法主要停留在单模态设定，未能充分利用多模态信息来识别错标样本。
Method: 先理论分析表示结构与噪声检测能力的关系；REFINE 联合使用融合表示与单模态表示，对目标类与背景类做判别分析以构造判别特征向量，为每个类选择检测能力更好的可信表示空间，度量实例表示与判别特征向量的对齐度，再合并各空间选出的子集，用该更干净的监督集更新多模态分类器。
Result: 在多种不同任务上与基线方法比较，REFINE 展现出相对基线方法的优势；源代码将公开。
Conclusion: 按类挑选可信表示空间并联合融合与单模态表示做标签噪声检测，可以给多模态分类器提供更干净的监督，从而减少训练中错标样本的影响并改善泛化。

papers.title: AgentHorizon: Evaluating Agentic Judges for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents are capable of completing complex tasks, increasing the use of automatic judges to determine success, either for training or for evaluation without human involvement. Despite their flexibility, their reliability on long tasks spanning multiple applications remains unclear. A trajectory, composed of long sequences of screenshots and actions, may appear complete, but in reality violates constraints from the instruction or introduces an unwanted side effect. To identify these errors, a judge needs to examine the trajectory with respect to the user's instruction. To this end, we introduce AgentHorizon, a benchmark of 1,373 computer-use tasks (instruction-trajectory pairs) drawn from 166 hours of human-recorded trajectories spanning three operating systems. By recording trajectories for closely related instructions, we can construct negative tasks by swapping the instructions. This paired design evaluates judges on their ability to distinguish a successful trajectory from one that completed a similar (but incompatible) request. We release the benchmark under three splits: a frontier split, AgentHorizon (AH), a simplified split, AgentHorizon-Simple (AH-S), and a development split, AgentHorizon-Development (AH-D). We further evaluate eleven judges by (1) directly passing the full trajectory (with up to 300 screenshots and actions), and (2) using them as coding agents across five agent harnesses. We find that our best agentic judge, GPT-5.5, achieves 80.9% balanced accuracy on the AH subset. We find that tool-use improves certain models but results in worse performance for open-weight models, and that judges differ drastically in their ability to accept a valid trajectory and reject failed ones. Our findings highlight the need for judges that are capable of locating and verifying often hidden evidence that a task was properly completed inside long interaction histories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentHorizon 是一个计算机使用 agent 的评判器 (agentic judge) 基准：1,373 条指令-轨迹对、来自 166 小时人工录制轨迹、覆盖三个操作系统，通过交换相近指令构造负例，专门检验评判器能否在长达 300 张截图与动作的轨迹中找出隐藏证据。最佳评判器 GPT-5.5 在 AH 子集上平衡准确率 80.9%，且工具使用对闭源模型有帮助、对开源权重模型反而降低性能。
Motivation: 自动评判器被用于 agent 训练与免人工评估，但其在跨多个应用的长轨迹上是否可靠尚不清楚：轨迹看似完成，实则违反指令约束或引入副作用，而现有评估缺少能区分成功与相似但不兼容请求的对照。
Method: 构建 AgentHorizon 基准，含 1,373 个指令-轨迹对（166 小时人工录制、三个操作系统），用相近指令互换生成负例的配对设计；发布 frontier (AH)、简化 (AH-S)、开发 (AH-D) 三个 split；评估十一个评判器，方式为直接输入完整轨迹（最多 300 张截图与动作）以及作为 coding agent 跨五种 agent harness 运行。
Result: 最佳 agentic judge GPT-5.5 在 AH 子集上取得 80.9% 平衡准确率；工具使用提升部分模型但使开源权重模型性能变差；不同评判器在接受有效轨迹与拒绝失败轨迹的能力上差异极大。
Conclusion: 长交互历史中的评判器必须能定位并核验任务确实完成的隐藏证据，仅看轨迹整体外观不足以判断成功与否。

papers.title: SatFix: Absolute Visual Localization of UAVs in Satellite Maps from a Single Oblique Image
papers.abstract_en: We study absolute metric UAV localization within a provided geo-referenced satellite region, recovering continuous map position and viewing heading from a single oblique image or a short multi-view clip. Existing cross-view geo-localization methods retrieve the most similar satellite tile from a gallery and report Recall@K, but retrieval depends on gallery sampling, provides no heading estimate, and returns a tile index rather than a continuous coordinate. We propose SatFix, a feed-forward UAV--satellite localization framework built on VGGT-$Ω$. Satellite-grid features act as queries that aggregate UAV visual evidence, and two lightweight heads regress a 3-DoF pose in the satellite-map frame: continuous 2D position and heading. SatFix requires no explicit 3D map, rendered bird's-eye image, auxiliary sensor, or test-time pose alignment. A single model supports both single- and multi-view inputs, with trajectory constraints used during multi-view training. For metric evaluation, we introduce University-Metric, where satellite imagery is re-collected over a region up to 10.7$\times$ longer on a side (about 114$\times$ the ground area) than the original University-1652 tiles, with continuous position and heading labels for the original UAV tours. With one UAV view, SatFix localizes 52.08% of test frames within 50 m and 17.34% within 10 m, with median position and heading errors of 45.66 m and $20.81^\circ$, respectively. Inference takes under 0.1 s per single-view query on an NVIDIA RTX 4090. With nine UAV views, the median position error falls to 21.96 m and the median heading error to $8.73^\circ$. Compared with a fine-tuned VGGT-$Ω$ baseline, SatFix reduces median position error by 34.0% and nine-view median heading error from $25.43^\circ$ to $8.73^\circ$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SatFix 是前馈式 UAV 绝对定位框架：以卫星栅格特征为 query 聚合 UAV 视觉证据，两个轻量头直接回归卫星地图坐标系下的 3-DoF 位姿（连续 2D 位置与朝向），无需 3D 地图、BEV 渲染、辅助传感器或测试时位姿对齐。单视图 52.08% 测试帧定位在 50 m 内、中位位置误差 45.66 m，九视图降至 21.96 m、朝向 8.73°。
Motivation: 现有跨视图 geo-localization 只从图库检索最相似卫星瓦片并报 Recall@K，结果依赖图库采样、不给朝向、只返回瓦片索引而非连续坐标，无法满足 UAV 在给定卫星区域内的绝对度量定位。
Method: 在 VGGT-Ω 之上构建前馈 UAV–卫星定位框架：卫星栅格特征作 query 聚合 UAV 视觉证据，两个轻量头回归卫星地图系 3-DoF 位姿；单一模型同时支持单视图与短多视图片段，多视图训练时加入轨迹约束。评测上重采 University-1652 原瓦片覆盖区，侧长扩大 10.7 倍（约 114 倍地面面积），为原 UAV 航线标注连续位置与朝向，构成 University-Metric。
Result: 单 UAV 视图下 52.08% 测试帧定位在 50 m 内、17.34% 在 10 m 内，中位位置误差 45.66 m、中位朝向误差 20.81°；单视图查询在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上推理低于 0.1 s。九视图时中位位置误差降至 21.96 m、中位朝向误差 8.73°。相对微调的 VGGT-Ω 基线，SatFix 中位位置误差降低 34.0%，九视图中位朝向误差从 25.43° 降到 8.73°。
Conclusion: 把跨视图检索换成卫星栅格查询加位姿回归，可在单张斜视图或短多视图片段上直接给出连续绝对坐标与朝向，且多视图轨迹约束显著收紧位置与朝向误差。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Rendering-Free Lookahead for Question-Guided Active Vision
papers.abstract_en: Active robot vision requires controlling the camera to reveal task-relevant information that is hidden from the current viewpoint. For example, determining what is inside a box may require raising the camera and looking down into it. For viewpoint-dependent question answering, the challenge is to select camera motions that expose the visual evidence needed to answer the question. Although vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret observed images, selecting such motions requires anticipating the usefulness of unseen views. We quantify this usefulness as answerability, a VLM's estimate that a view suffices to answer the question, and present Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL), a viewpoint-selection policy that ranks candidate camera motions by predicted future answerability. RFL transfers visual lookahead from deployment to offline training. At training, a privileged teacher renders candidate future views in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and uses a frozen VLM to compute one- and two-step answerability targets. Through two-stage distillation, a student learns to predict these action values from the question, recent visual observations, and a candidate camera motion. At deployment, RFL uses these predicted values to select camera motions without rendering future views. On 377 E3VS-Bench test episodes in unseen environments, RFL improves the mean judge score by 43\% over a direct-action baseline using the same VLM. These results support learning camera-control policies from privileged visual lookahead for viewpoint-dependent question answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL)：把需要渲染未来视角的视觉前瞻从部署期搬到离线训练期，用特权教师在 3D Gaussian Splatting 场景中渲染候选视角并以冻结 VLM 打分，学生蒸馏后在部署时直接预测 answerability 选相机动作、无需渲染。在 377 个 E3VS-Bench 未见环境测试 episode 上，平均 judge score 比同 VLM 的直接动作基线高 43%。
Motivation: 视角相关问答要求相机运动去暴露当前视角看不到的证据，但 VLM 只能解读已观测图像，选择动作需要预判未见视角的有用性；部署期渲染前瞻代价高。
Method: 把 answerability 定义为 VLM 对某视角是否足以回答问题的估计；训练时特权教师在 3DGS 场景渲染候选未来视角，用冻结 VLM 计算一步与两步 answerability 目标，经两阶段蒸馏让学生从问题、近期观测与候选相机动作预测该动作价值；部署时仅用预测值排序候选动作。
Result: 在 377 个 E3VS-Bench 测试 episode、未见环境上，RFL 的平均 judge score 相对使用同一 VLM 的直接动作基线提升 43%。
Conclusion: 特权视觉前瞻蒸馏出的相机控制策略可用于视角相关问答，且部署时无需渲染未来视角。

papers.title: Decision-Sufficient Posterior Approximation
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the consequences of requiring a posterior approximation to preserve a specified downstream decision problem. A target posterior $P$ and loss determine a regret geometry on actions, a baseline approximation $Q_0$ determines the forward-Kullback-Leibler information required to induce action changes, and a restricted approximation family $\mathcal{Q}$ determines which such changes are available. Contracting KL divergence over Bayes-action fibers gives exact distances to decision adequacy and decision failure together with the least-informative posterior deformations that reach either side of the decision boundary. In regular finite-dimensional problems, the target and baseline constructions have quadratic local limits: a target regret Hessian $G$ and a baseline information metric $J_I$ . Their generalized eigenproblem $Gv = γJ_Iv$ orders local decision directions by regret consequence per unit information cost and induces a tolerance-dependent effective dimension. For restricted approximation families, the tangent image separates decision coverage from information efficiency: a family may miss consequential decision directions, or it may realize reachable directions only at excess Fisher cost. The resulting framework provides decision-relative criteria for comparing and designing posterior approximation families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把下游决策问题写进后验近似的目标：目标后验 P 与损失定义动作上的 regret 几何，基线近似 Q0 定义改变 Bayes 动作所需的 forward KL 信息，受限族 Q 决定哪些改变可达。对 Bayes-action 纤维收缩 KL 得到到“决策充分”与“决策失败”的精确距离及最小信息的后验变形；正则有限维下退化为 regret Hessian G 与信息度量 J_I 的广义特征问题 Gv=γJ_Iv，按单位信息代价的 regret 后果排序决策方向并给出容忍度依赖的有效维数。
Motivation: 后验近似通常只按 KL 或似然保真度衡量，但真正要紧的是近似是否保住指定的下游决策；缺少把 regret 后果与信息代价放在同一尺度上比较近似族的准则。
Method: 由目标后验 P 与损失构造动作上的 regret 几何，由基线 Q0 定义诱导动作改变所需的 forward KL 信息，再在受限近似族 Q 上对 Bayes-action 纤维收缩 KL，得到决策充分/决策失败的精确距离与最小信息后验变形；正则有限维问题取局部二次极限，得到目标 regret Hessian G 与基线信息度量 J_I，解广义特征问题 Gv=γJ_Iv，并用切像 (tangent image) 分离决策覆盖与信息效率。
Result: 给出决策充分与决策失败的精确距离及到达决策边界的最小信息后验变形；正则有限维下目标与基线构造各有二次局部极限 G 与 J_I，广义特征值 γ 按单位信息代价的 regret 后果排序局部决策方向并诱导容忍度依赖的有效维数；受限族的切像可区分两类失效——错过有后果的决策方向，或只能以超额 Fisher 代价实现可达方向。
Conclusion: 后验近似族应按决策相对准则比较与设计：既要看是否覆盖有 regret 后果的方向，也要看实现这些方向的信息代价。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Transforming Image Editors into Video Editors
papers.abstract_en: Recent image editing systems have achieved impressive semantic understanding, visual fidelity, and instruction-following ability, while video editing remains substantially more difficult and costly. In this paper, we present a simple alternative to end-to-end video editing: instead of training a monolithic video editor, we transform a strong image editor into a video editor through anchor-based generation. Our key insight is that video editing can be decomposed into two subproblems: editing a sparse set of keyframes and propagating those edits across time. Based on this observation, we propose Anchor-based Video Editing (AVE), a two-stage framework in which a powerful image editor first performs composed editing on selected keyframes, and a motion-guided image-to-video diffusion model then generates the final video by treating the edited keyframes as fixed anchors. This design directly inherits the strengths of modern image editors while avoiding expensive end-to-end video editing training. Experiments on IVEBench and VIE-Bench show that AVE achieves strong performance in instruction following, temporal consistency, and content fidelity. Further ablations reveal that final video editing quality is strongly correlated with the quality of the image editor, suggesting that future progress in video editing may come from stronger image editing foundations and lightweight transfer to video. Code is available at https://github.com/wangf3014/AVE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVE 把视频编辑拆成「编辑稀疏关键帧」与「把编辑沿时间传播」两步：先用强图像编辑器对选定关键帧做 composed editing，再用 motion-guided 图生视频扩散模型把编辑后的关键帧当作固定 anchor 生成整段视频，从而绕开端到端视频编辑训练。在 IVEBench 与 VIE-Bench 上，AVE 在指令遵循、时间一致性与内容保真度上取得强表现，且消融显示最终视频编辑质量与图像编辑器质量强相关。
Motivation: 图像编辑器在语义理解、视觉保真与指令遵循上已很强，而视频编辑仍明显更难、更贵，端到端训练单一视频编辑器成本高。
Method: 提出两阶段 Anchor-based Video Editing (AVE)：强图像编辑器先在选定关键帧上执行 composed editing，随后 motion-guided image-to-video diffusion model 把这些编辑后的关键帧作为固定 anchor 生成最终视频，直接继承图像编辑器能力而不做端到端视频编辑训练。
Result: 在 IVEBench 与 VIE-Bench 上，AVE 在指令遵循、时间一致性与内容保真度方面表现强；消融进一步显示最终视频编辑质量与图像编辑器质量强相关。
Conclusion: 视频编辑可分解为关键帧编辑加时间传播，未来进展可能来自更强的图像编辑基础与向视频的轻量迁移，而非端到端视频编辑训练。

papers.title: FedAlphaEdit: Null-Space-Aligned Merging for Collaborative Knowledge Editing
papers.abstract_en: Multiple institutions may each hold their own private knowledge edits and wish to integrate them into a single large language model without sharing raw edit requests. Null-space-constrained editing methods such as AlphaEdit mathematically guarantee that each update leaves unrelated knowledge intact, while collaborative frameworks such as CollabEdit aggregate edits from multiple clients without data sharing. Combining the two appears trivial. However, we show that this naive combination fails structurally, and we identify its cause. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedAlphaEdit. To our knowledge, this is the first collaborative knowledge editing framework that aligns both local editing and the server-side merging rule under a single null-space principle for preserving existing knowledge. FedAlphaEdit builds on null-space-aligned merging, in which clients share projected statistics and the server provably recovers the result of editing everything in one place under a one-shot idealization. Empirically, the proposed method repairs the collapse and brings edit success and preservation simultaneously close to the level of centralized editing across two architecture families. FedAlphaEdit thus lets institutions that cannot share raw edit data, such as hospitals and financial firms, jointly maintain a shared model that closely approximates editing all facts in one place.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Includes appendices (proofs, implementation reconciliation, experimental details). Code: https://github.com/soutasuga/FedAlphaEdit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedAlphaEdit 把 AlphaEdit 的零空间约束与 CollabEdit 式多客户端聚合统一到同一条零空间原则上：客户端共享投影统计量，服务器可证明地还原出在单点集中编辑全部事实的结果（one-shot 理想化）。朴素拼接两者会结构性失效，而该方法修复了这一崩溃，使编辑成功率与无关知识保持度在两类架构族上同时逼近集中式编辑水平。
Motivation: 多家机构各自持有私有知识编辑、又不能共享原始 edit request；把零空间约束编辑与协作聚合直接拼接会结构性失败，需要找出成因并修复。
Method: 提出 FedAlphaEdit：客户端在本地编辑时共享投影统计量，服务器端合并规则与本地编辑对齐到同一零空间原则，并在 one-shot 理想化下可证明地复现集中编辑结果；附录含证明与实现对齐细节。
Result: 实证上该方法修复了朴素组合的崩溃，在两个架构族 (architecture families) 上让编辑成功率与知识保持度同时接近集中式编辑的水平。
Conclusion: 只有把本地编辑与服务器合并规则置于同一零空间原则之下，无法共享原始编辑数据的机构（如医院、金融公司）才能联合维护一个逼近集中编辑的共享模型。

papers.title: Language Modeling is Monotone Compression
papers.abstract_en: A long-standing hypothesis in artificial intelligence and neuroscience posits that intelligence is closely related to compression: the ability to compress information efficiently intuitively reflects capacities associated with intelligence and learning. Indeed, recent experimental works verify this intuition by showing connections between the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and their ability as compressors: for instance, Deletang et al. (ICLR'24) demonstrate that LLMs can be used as powerful compressors, and Huang et al. (COLM'24) show that the compression ability of LLMs is highly correlated with their performance on benchmarks for knowledge and reasoning. In this work, we initiate a theoretical study of this connection. Our main result is that LLMs (formally modeled as next-token predictors) are equivalent to monotone (a.k.a. order-preserving) compression algorithms---namely, compression algorithms where the encoding process preserves the ordering of the inputs---in the sense that the one can be constructed from the other while preserving the same error up to an additive gap of 2. We next show that the monotonicity is required for this equivalence to hold if and only if cryptographic (infinitely-often) one-way functions exist. As a direct corollary, we get a cryptographic result of independent interest: the notion of next-bit pseudoentropy (a computational analogue of entropy) of a distribution is equivalent to monotone incompressibility of the distribution. (Previously, it was only known (Haitner et al., ITCS'23) that incompressibility implies next-bit pseudoentropy.)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 形式化为 next-token 预测器，证明其与单调（保序）压缩算法在误差至多相差 2 的意义下互相构造等价；并证明该等价成立当且仅当密码学中（ infinitely-often）单向函数存在，由此推出 next-bit pseudoentropy 与分布的单调不可压缩性等价。
Motivation: 压缩能力与智能/推理能力的关联此前只有 Deletang et al. (ICLR'24)、Huang et al. (COLM'24) 等实验性证据，缺少理论刻画：LLM 作为压缩器究竟对应哪一类压缩算法、其边界条件为何尚不清楚。
Method: 将 LLM 建模为 next-token 预测器，构造其与单调（order-preserving）压缩算法之间的双向转换并控制误差；再用密码学归约分析单调性是否必要，涉及 infinitely-often 单向函数与 next-bit pseudoentropy。
Result: LLM 与单调压缩算法可互相构造且保持相同误差至多加性差 2；单调性对这一等价是必需的当且仅当 infinitely-often 单向函数存在；推论为 next-bit pseudoentropy 等价于分布的单调不可压缩性，而此前 Haitner et al. (ITCS'23) 只知道不可压缩性推出 next-bit pseudoentropy。
Conclusion: LLM 的压缩能力在理论上被刻画为单调压缩，且这一刻画的必要性与密码学单向函数的存在性绑定，同时把 next-bit pseudoentropy 与单调不可压缩性双向打通。

papers.title: NOMOS: Compiling Written Policies into Statically Verified Tool-Call Gates for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents violate the policies they are deployed to enforce, often silently. Prior defenses hand-write rules, query an LLM verifier per action, or compile policies through heavyweight formal machinery. Naive compilation fails: extracted rules block the tool satisfying their own precondition, or read arguments their tool lacks. NOMOS, a four-pass compiler, turns a natural-language policy into a deterministic tool-call gate; static verification with tool-schema-level checks alone (no prover, solver, or LLM) repairs or rejects 37% (airline) and 13% (retail) of candidates, without which most shipped rules are inoperable. Replaying compiled rules over undefended transcripts flags bindings that refuse legitimate work (a development binding refused 95.9% of task-passing calls); no evaluation binding is flagged. On $τ^2$-bench the gate cuts violations of reference-encoded clauses among state-changing calls from 66.3% to 2.6% (airline) and 30.8% to 6.9% (retail), raising airline task success significantly for $2 \le k \le 4$; a 26B on-premise compilation is not significantly worse than hand-written or frontier-compiled rules. Unlike AgentDojo's shipped defenses, it reaches a zero attack success rate (ASR) on banking, where nine attack families collapse onto three structural rules. On the other three suites its ASR is at most 3.6%, from goals with no tool call to govern and one write admitted by a binding weaker than its clause; a second agent model, Llama-3.3-70B, reproduces the effect on both benchmarks. Decisions take microseconds without an LLM call, at a domain-dependent benign-utility cost; compilation runs on-premise on open-weight gemma-4-26B.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NOMOS 把自然语言策略编译成确定性工具调用闸门，四遍编译加仅靠工具 schema 的静态校验即可修复或拒绝候选规则，无需证明器、求解器或 LLM。在 τ²-bench 上把状态变更调用的参考编码条款违规从 66.3% 压到 2.6%（airline）、30.8% 到 6.9%（retail），banking 上达到 0% ASR。
Motivation: 工具型 LLM agent 会静默违反其被部署去执行的策略：现有防御要么手写规则、要么每个动作调用 LLM 校验器、要么依赖重型形式化工具，朴素编译还会产出阻断自身前置条件或读取不存在参数的规则。
Method: NOMOS 是四遍编译器，将自然语言策略编译为确定性 tool-call gate；静态校验只做工具 schema 级检查（不用 prover、solver、LLM）来修复或拒绝候选规则；再在无防御的 transcript 上重放编译规则以标记拒绝合法工作的 binding；编译在本地用开放权重 gemma-4-26B 运行。
Result: 静态校验修复或拒绝 37%（airline）与 13%（retail）候选；一个开发用 binding 拒绝了 95.9% 的 task-passing 调用且无评估 binding 被标记；τ²-bench 上状态变更调用违规 66.3%→2.6%（airline）、30.8%→6.9%（retail），airline 任务成功率在 2≤k≤4 显著提升；26B 本地编译与手写或前沿模型编译规则无显著差异；banking 达 0% ASR（九类攻击收敛为三条结构规则），其余三套 ASR ≤3.6%；决策为微秒级且不调用 LLM；Llama-3.3-70B 在两个基准上复现该效果。
Conclusion: 仅靠 schema 级静态校验就足以让编译出的策略闸门可操作且强安全，代价是领域相关的良性效用损失；banking 的零 ASR 来自攻击面可被少数结构规则覆盖。

papers.title: Intent Graph: Navigating the Analytical Reasoning Space for Exploratory Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Exploratory data analysis (EDA) is rarely open-ended in practice: analysts work from high-level domain questions toward the concrete analyses that can answer them, prioritizing directions with domain knowledge and prior hypotheses. Large language models (LLMs) can supply such knowledge, but their responses are unstructured, leaving analysts no way to see what has been explored, what is missing, or why one direction was chosen over another. We present DAG-EDA, a system that lets analysts and an LLM co-navigate the space of possible analyses through two linked structures. An intent graph, governed by a grammar of analytical intent, decomposes an ambiguous natural-language question into progressively concrete analysis tasks, keeping alternative framings open and letting analysts branch, backtrack, and compare paths. A multi-layered knowledge graph externalizes the LLM's domain knowledge, linking domain concepts to the dataset variables that can measure them, so analysts can inspect and contest how their question is grounded in the data. Both graphs are constructed from only the dataset and the analyst's question, and the analyses the analyst reaches are rendered as interactive dashboards. We illustrate the system through a usage scenario and describe a user study design for examining whether the system scaffold analysts' reasoning and navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DAG-EDA：用受分析意图语法约束的 intent graph 把模糊自然语言问题逐层拆成具体分析任务，配合把领域概念连到数据集变量的多层 knowledge graph，让分析师与 LLM 共同导航探索式数据分析空间，可分支、回溯、比较路径并渲染成交互式 dashboard。两图仅由数据集与分析师问题构建，论文给出使用场景演示与一项用户研究设计。
Motivation: LLM 能提供领域知识，但回答是无结构的，分析师看不到已探索什么、缺什么、为何选某条路径，难以把高层领域问题落到具体可执行的分析上。
Method: DAG-EDA 含两个联动结构：intent graph 以分析意图语法 (grammar of analytical intent) 将模糊问题分解为逐步具体的分析任务并保留备选框架；multi-layered knowledge graph 把领域概念链接到可测量它们的数据集变量。两图仅由数据集与问题生成，最终到达的分析渲染成交互式 dashboard。
Result: 论文通过一个使用场景 (usage scenario) 展示系统，并给出一项用户研究设计，用于检验系统是否支撑 (scaffold) 分析师的推理与导航过程。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 的领域知识外化为可检查、可质疑的双图结构，可让分析师在探索式数据分析中追踪已走路径与备选分支，而不是接受无结构的模型回答。

papers.title: Expression-Diverse References for Identity-Preserving Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Identity-preserving video generation aims to maintain a subject's identity while synthesizing realistic videos. Yet a single reference portrait captures the subject's appearance under only one facial configuration. As expressions change, facial appearance can vary in highly identity-specific ways, leaving the subject's appearance under unseen expressions underdetermined by the reference alone. This expression-dependent variation also complicates evaluation: similarity to a neutral reference may decrease under strong expressions even for real images of the same person. We investigate this limitation from both generation and evaluation perspectives. First, we quantify how face-recognition similarity varies with expression intensity using controlled photographs and MEAD videos. We then construct a compact yet expressive reference gallery that captures diverse expression-dependent facial configurations. Matching against this gallery provides a more robust measure of identity similarity under expressive motion. To further expose performance degradation with expression intensity, we report identity similarity separately for mild, intense, and extreme expressions. For generation, we extend Stand-In to condition on our expression-diverse reference sets and develop a data-curation pipeline that extracts consistent yet diverse face crops from training videos. In practical settings where only a single portrait is available, we construct the reference set by synthesizing additional expressions with a pretrained facial reenactment model. On our controlled benchmark, both real and synthesized reference sets outperform the evaluated baselines in identity similarity across all three expression-intensity regimes, with the largest improvements for extreme expressions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 身份保持视频生成中单张参考照只覆盖一种表情，未见过的表情下外观欠定。作者构建表情多样的参考画廊 (expression-diverse reference gallery) 并扩展 Stand-In 以条件化该集合，同时按 mild/intense/extreme 三档表情强度分别报告身份相似度；在受控基准上真实与合成参考集在三档中均超过所评估基线，极端表情档提升最大。
Motivation: 单张参考肖像只记录一种面部构型，表情变化带来的身份特异性外观差异使参考无法约束未见表情；同时以中性参考计算的相似度在强表情下会下降，即使对同一人的真实照片也是如此，评估本身失真。
Method: 先用受控照片与 MEAD 视频量化人脸识别相似度随表情强度的变化，构建覆盖多样表情构型的紧凑参考画廊作为更稳健的相似度度量；生成侧将 Stand-In 扩展为以表情多样参考集为条件，并加入从训练视频提取一致且多样的人脸裁剪的数据整理流程；仅有单张肖像时，用预训练 facial reenactment 模型合成额外表情来构造参考集。
Result: 在受控基准上，真实参考集与合成参考集在 mild、intense、extreme 三个表情强度档的身份相似度上均超过所评估基线，且 extreme 档提升最大；身份相似度按三档分别报告以暴露随表情强度的性能下降。
Conclusion: 单张参考不足以约束表情变化下的身份外观，用表情多样的参考集（真实或由 reenactment 合成）做条件与评估，能在各表情强度下提升身份相似度，极端表情处收益最大。

papers.title: A Graph Neural Network for Global Daily Fire Radiative Power Prediction at Medium-Range Lead Times
papers.abstract_en: Skillful prediction of biomass-burning activity several days in advance is important for air-quality forecasting and aerosol prediction. Two operational constraints motivate this work. First, the GBBEPx satellite fire radiative power (FRP) product used to initialize NOAA's GEFS-Aerosols is available with about a 1.5-day latency, so each forecast cycle relies on the most recently available, but already outdated, fire observations. Second, these fire inputs are then held fixed throughout the subsequent 5-day operational forecast, or 7 days in the GSL experimental system, effectively assuming no evolution in fire activity. We develop a data-driven model that predicts global FRP one to seven days ahead from the most recent available observations. The model adapts a spatiotemporal graph neural network using reanalysis meteorology, land-cover and vegetation information, recent fire history, and GBBEPx FRP as the training target. It is trained on 2020-2022 data and evaluated for 2023-2024. The model reproduces the global seasonal cycle and substantially outperforms persistence. At 0.1$^\circ$ resolution, mean squared error is reduced by 32% at one-day lead and 43% at seven days in 2023, and by 24% and 40% in 2024. At 1$^\circ$ resolution, the critical success index ranges from 0.32 to 0.60. Detection skill declines only modestly with lead time, whereas intensity skill degrades more rapidly. Large fires are detected reliably, but their radiative power is systematically underestimated. These results demonstrate useful predictability of fire activity several days ahead and identify intensity calibration and small-fire placement as the main remaining challenges before predicted FRP can support operational aerosol forecasts.
papers.comment: Submitted to Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用时空图神经网络 (spatiotemporal GNN) 从最近可得的 GBBEPx FRP、再分析气象、土地覆盖与植被信息预测未来 1–7 天全球火辐射功率 (FRP)，以缓解卫星 FRP 约 1.5 天延迟且在 5–7 天业务预报中被固定不变的问题。在 2023–2024 检验中，0.1° 分辨率下 1 天和 7 天提前期的 MSE 分别较 persistence 降低 32%/43%（2023）和 24%/40%（2024）；探测技能随提前期仅小幅下降，但强度技能退化更快，大火 FRP 被系统性低估。
Motivation: 初始化 GEFS-Aerosols 的 GBBEPx 卫星 FRP 产品有约 1.5 天延迟，业务预报又把火活动在 5 天（GSL 实验系统 7 天）内固定不变，等于假设火活动无演变，削弱空气质量与气溶胶预报。
Method: 改造时空图神经网络，输入为再分析气象、土地覆盖与植被信息、近期火活动历史，以 GBBEPx FRP 作为训练目标；用 2020–2022 年数据训练，2023–2024 年检验，输出 1–7 天全球 FRP 预报。
Result: 0.1° 分辨率下 MSE 相对 persistence 在 2023 年 1 天/7 天提前期降低 32%/43%，2024 年降低 24%/40%；1° 分辨率下 critical success index 为 0.32–0.60。探测技能随提前期仅小幅下降，强度技能退化更快；大火可可靠探测但其 FRP 被系统性低估。模型重现全球季节循环。
Conclusion: 火活动在数天提前期上具有可用可预报性，可为业务气溶胶预报提供随时间演变的 FRP 输入；投入业务前的主要障碍是强度校准与小火位置定位。

summary_sections.method: 改造时空图神经网络，输入为再分析气象、土地覆盖与植被信息、近期火活动历史，以 GBBEPx FRP 作为训练目标；用 2020–2022 年数据训练，2023–2024 年检验，输出 1–7 天全球 FRP 预报。
summary_sections.result: 0.1° 分辨率下 MSE 相对 persistence 在 2023 年 1 天/7 天提前期降低 32%/43%，2024 年降低 24%/40%；1° 分辨率下 critical success index 为 0.32–0.60。探测技能随提前期仅小幅下降，强度技能退化更快；大火可可靠探测但其 FRP 被系统性低估。模型重现全球季节循环。
summary_sections.conclusion: 火活动在数天提前期上具有可用可预报性，可为业务气溶胶预报提供随时间演变的 FRP 输入；投入业务前的主要障碍是强度校准与小火位置定位。

papers.title: Mid-Training Language Models on Raw Video
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models learn mostly from paired image-text data or annotated video, and raw web video is rarely used to further train an existing language model. We study whether raw video, with no captions and no text loss, can serve as mid-training data for a pretrained language model. Frames are encoded into continuous visual tokens, and the language model learns to predict the next visual token. We mid-train Qwen3-1.7B on raw clips from YT-Temporal-1B and then apply the same image-text instruction tuning to it and to the model without mid-training, so that the two differ only in mid-training. The mid-trained model scores 2.9 points higher on average across four video benchmarks and 5.1 points higher across ten image benchmarks, spanning perception, document, and chart tasks. Text performance is preserved even though mid-training includes no text, with an average of 48.9 across 14 text benchmarks compared with 48.0 for the model without mid-training. Analyses across training show that the image and video gains emerge within 30% of training and plateau thereafter, varying by less than 0.5 points. Predicting captions fails to outperform next-visual-token prediction, demonstrating that video mid-training can remain purely self-supervised without the computational overhead or labeling noise of automated captioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在纯原始网络视频（无字幕、无文本损失）上做中训练 (mid-training) 可以提升多模态大模型：把帧编码为连续视觉 token，让语言模型预测下一个视觉 token。用 Qwen3-1.7B 在 YT-Temporal-1B 原始片段上中训练后，四个视频基准平均高 2.9 分、十个图像基准平均高 5.1 分，且 14 个文本基准平均 48.9 对比未中训练的 48.0，文本能力不退化；预测字幕并不优于预测下一个视觉 token。
Motivation: 多模态大模型主要依赖图文配对或人工标注视频，原始网络视频几乎不被用来继续训练已有语言模型；自动打字幕又有计算开销与标注噪声。
Method: 把视频帧编码为连续视觉 token，以 next-visual-token prediction 为唯一目标（无文本损失）对预训练语言模型 Qwen3-1.7B 做 mid-training，数据用 YT-Temporal-1B 的原始片段；之后对中训练模型与未中训练模型施加完全相同的图文指令微调，使两者只在中训练这一步上不同。
Result: 中训练模型在四个视频基准上平均高 2.9 分，十个图像基准（覆盖感知、文档、图表任务）上平均高 5.1 分；14 个文本基准平均 48.9，未中训练模型为 48.0，文本能力保持。训练过程分析显示图像与视频增益在训练的前 30% 内出现，此后进入平台，波动小于 0.5 分。以预测字幕替代 next-visual-token prediction 未能更好。
Conclusion: 视频中训练可以保持纯自监督，无需自动打字幕的计算开销与标注噪声；增益在训练早期（前 30%）即饱和，且不以牺牲文本能力为代价。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ParanoiaEval: Benchmarking Unnecessary Defensive Work in Agentic Coding
papers.abstract_en: As coding agents increasingly undertake real-world work autonomously, judging whether their risk treatments are warranted has become important. Existing work evaluates related agent behaviors from separate perspectives, but lacks a systematic framework for unifying these behaviors. To bridge this gap, we introduce ParanoiaEval, the first benchmark for unified evaluation of risk-treatment capabilities in coding agents. Grounded in the well-established Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance framework in software engineering risk management, ParanoiaEval operationalizes its 4 fundamental treatments for coding-agent settings and contains 200 evidence-controlled repository-level task pairs, each differing only in treatment-defining evidence. We further introduce dedicated metrics for risk-treatment violations and evidence responsiveness, using a human-calibrated agentic judge for reliable evaluation. Large-scale experiments on 8 representative models and a post-hoc human study reveal that (I) unnecessary risk treatment occurs in 11.2%-58.7% of runs despite explicit evidence, with substantial variation across agent configurations; (II) stronger task capability does not ensure more appropriate risk treatment, while treatment violations substantially harm developers' experience, establishing risk treatment as an independent capability dimension; and (III) agents exhibit systematic patterns consistent with established risk-management findings, suggesting that knowledge from human practice can guide the diagnosis and improvement of this capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ParanoiaEval：首个统一评测 coding agent 风险处置能力的 benchmark，基于软件工程风险管理的 Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance 框架，含 200 组仅在决定处置方式的关键证据上不同的仓库级任务对。在 8 个代表性模型的大规模实验中，即使有明确证据，11.2%–58.7% 的运行仍做出不必要的风险处置，且任务能力强并不等于处置更恰当。
Motivation: coding agent 越来越多地自主承担真实工作，但现有研究只从分散视角评估相关行为，缺少统一框架判断其风险处置是否与证据相称。
Method: 把 SE 风险管理的 Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance 四种处置落到 coding-agent 场景，构造 200 组证据受控的仓库级任务对（每对仅在定义处置方式的证据上不同）；提出针对风险处置违规与证据响应性的专用指标，用人工校准的 agentic judge 评分，并做后置人工研究。
Result: 在 8 个代表性模型上，即使存在明确证据，11.2%–58.7% 的运行仍出现不必要的风险处置，且随 agent 配置差异显著；任务能力更强不保证处置更恰当，处置违规显著损害开发者体验；agent 表现出与既有风险管理研究一致的系统性模式。
Conclusion: 风险处置是独立于任务能力的能力维度，人类风险管理实践中的知识可用来诊断并改进 agent 的这一能力。

papers.title: Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 冻结的 VideoLLM 内部已线性可读出「回答所需证据是否到齐」的 readiness 信号，无需另训触发器。该信号在 7 个模型上 AUROC 0.733–0.905，问题条件化（66.1% 配对翻转），且在答错样本上仍有 AUROC 0.722。把它做成 Readiness Gating 答题时机策略，在相同视频时长下最高提升 +9.75 pp，增益随任务可用精度余量变化。
Motivation: 流式视频问答需要判断证据是否到齐，现有系统都额外训练一个触发模块；作者追问未修改的模型是否已在内部计算该信号。
Method: 用带时间戳的证据（而非模型输出）打标签，对冻结 VideoLLM 的激活训练线性探针读出 readiness；在共享 byte-identical 评测上跨 7 个模型解码，用问题盲控制、跨 benchmark family 探针迁移、与不确定性估计器在延迟匹配下比较，并将读出转为 Readiness Gating 答题策略。
Result: 7 个模型上 AUROC 0.733–0.905（最严 not-ready 采样，拟合时钟接近随机）；仅换问题时 66.1% 配对读出翻转，问题盲控制按构造处于随机水平；答错样本上 AUROC 0.722；readiness 在延迟匹配的答案选择上优于不确定性估计器及其监督组合，且比置信度更贴近独立人类判断；已发布流式触发器读自身基座激活时与 readiness 近似正交、解码精度远低于探针；Readiness Gating 在相同视频时长下最高 +9.75 pp，26 个配置中增益随精度余量变化，干预移动余量时增益随之移动。
Conclusion: 证据就绪度已隐含在冻结 VideoLLM 的表征中且可线性读出，直接用它做答题时机即可在不增加计算开销下提升准确率，增益大小取决于任务本身留出的精度余量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: One-Shot Private Confidence Regions via Resampling
papers.abstract_en: We propose a simple framework for constructing differentially private confidence regions \textit{in one shot}, i.e., by adding noise only to the final resampling quantile instead of privatizing the estimator computed on each resample. The cost of privacy of our procedure is only logarithmic in the number of resamples $B$ under with-replacement ($m$-out-of-$n$) sampling and independent of $B$ under without replacement sampling (subsampling), avoiding the $\sqrt{B}$ factor that arises in previous works. We provide nonasymptotic Gaussian Differential Privacy (GDP) and utility guarantees for both subsampling and $m$-out-of-$n$ resampling, covering mean-like estimators with small global sensitivity as well as estimators admitting efficiently computable smooth sensitivity bounds, including quantiles and degenerate U-statistics. This allows us to also obtain private confidence regions for degenerate U-statistics where the private error is much smaller than the non-private error. In all, we provide a toolbox for widely applicable DP uncertainty quantification procedures under popular resampling strategies while avoiding the computational and privacy costs of privatizing many intermediate resample statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一次性构造差分隐私置信域的框架：只对最终重采样分位数加噪，而不对每个重采样样本上的估计量分别加噪。隐私代价在有放回 (m-out-of-n) 采样下只随重采样次数 B 呈对数增长，在无放回 (subsampling) 采样下与 B 无关，从而避开已有工作中的 √B 因子。
Motivation: 对每个重采样统计量逐一加噪会累积隐私损失并带来 √B 的代价，同时重复计算中间统计量开销大；需要在保留重采样置信域构造的同时降低隐私与计算成本。
Method: 只对最终重采样分位数加噪，给出有放回 (m-out-of-n) 与无放回 (subsampling) 两种采样下的非渐近 Gaussian Differential Privacy (GDP) 与效用保证；覆盖全局敏感度小的均值类估计量，以及可高效计算 smooth sensitivity 界的估计量，包括分位数与退化 U-统计量。
Result: 隐私代价在 m-out-of-n 采样下只随 B 对数增长、在 subsampling 下与 B 无关，避免已有工作的 √B 因子；对退化 U-统计量可得到私有误差远小于非私有误差的私有置信域。
Conclusion: 只私有化最终重采样分位数即可在常用重采样策略下提供广泛适用的 DP 不确定性量化，同时避开私有化大量中间重采样统计量的计算与隐私成本。

papers.title: A Stevens's Power Law Check-up of GPT-5.5's Implicit Reading of Visual Encoding
papers.abstract_en: We adapt Stevens's power law to measure the implicit ability of AI models to read visualizations, which can reveal the built-in perceptual mechanisms of algorithmic models. In our pilot study, AIs see no legend. In the color conditions, no colormap name is provided either. GPT-5.5 first views a reference visual representation and estimates its magnitude, then estimates the magnitude of each subsequent image of the same representation relative to that reference. Our evaluation of twelve visual variables makes how algorithmic models read visual encodings measurable, comparable with human perception, and more transparent to humans.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Stevens 幂律 (Stevens's power law) 移植到 AI 上，用无图例、无 colormap 名的条件测 GPT-5.5 对视觉编码量级的隐式读取：先看参考图估一个量级，再把同表示的后续图相对参考估计。对 12 个视觉变量的评测使算法模型读取视觉编码的方式变得可测、可与人类感知比较。
Motivation: AI 读可视化的能力缺少可量化手段，无法与人类感知对照，其内置感知机制也不透明。
Method: 改编 Stevens 幂律作为度量；试点中模型不看图例，颜色条件也不给 colormap 名；GPT-5.5 先估参考视觉表示的量级，再相对参考估后续同表示图像的量级；覆盖 12 个视觉变量。
Result: 对 12 个视觉变量完成评测，使算法模型读取视觉编码可测、可与人类感知比较、对人更透明；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: AI 对视觉编码的隐式量级读取可以用 Stevens 幂律框架量化，并作为与人类感知对照的窗口。

papers.title: Transect: Retaining Observability for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI evaluations increasingly use open-ended, agentic, long-horizon tasks whose transcripts can span hundreds of pages of outputs and actions from complex multi-agent networks. The observability envelop-the range of what evaluators can reliably infer about an agent's behaviours-is therefore narrowing. Language model assistants can help classify and interpret agent behaviour but also afford human evaluators significant analytical degrees of freedom, threatening the reproducibility and auditability of language-model-based transcript analysis. Transect is an open source package built on Inspect Scout to help evaluators understand how a long agent run unfolded, identify behaviour worth investigating, and check interpretations against the transcript. Users specify task context and behavioural vocabulary in a reusable evaluation-family configuration, with judge models and analysis settings supplied separately. Transect's navigable reports align recorded events, token use, sub-agent activity, and model-generated behavioural labels on a common turn-based timeline. Reviewers can quickly grasp a run's narrative, trace any label or event to its source turns, and export the underlying data tables for cross-run analysis. We demonstrate the workflow on an AI R&D evaluation that generated almost 13 million tokens, dividing the agents' work into behavioural phases aligned with research-skill classifications, sub-agent delegations and interactions, and token use. The combined view shows a focus on operational work and manuscript production, with little evidence of a sustained hypothesis generation stage-arguably a necessary component for high-quality scientific outputs. Transect's flexible, customisable transcript-analysis pipeline will enable evaluators to keep pace with longer, more complex, more frequent AI evaluations while supporting scientific rigour, transparency, and reproducibility.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Transect 是基于 Inspect Scout 的开源长程 LLM agent 评测可观察性工具：用可复用的 evaluation-family 配置定义任务上下文与行为词汇表，把事件、token 用量、子 agent 活动和模型生成的行为标签对齐到统一的 turn 时间线上，任何标签都可回溯到源 turn 并导出数据表。在一次约 1300 万 token 的 AI R&D 评测中，该视图把工作切成与科研技能分类对齐的行为阶段，显示 agent 集中在操作性工作与论文撰写，几乎没有持续的假设生成阶段。
Motivation: 长程 agent 评测的 transcript 可达数百页，评测者能可靠推断的行为范围（observability envelope）在收窄；用语言模型助手做行为分类又给人工评测者留下过大的分析自由度，威胁可复现性与可审计性。
Method: 开源包 Transect，构建在 Inspect Scout 之上；用户在可复用的 evaluation-family 配置里写任务上下文与行为词汇表，judge 模型与分析设置单独提供；生成可导航报告，把记录事件、token 使用、子 agent 活动与模型生成的行为标签对齐到基于 turn 的公共时间线，并可导出底层数据表做跨 run 分析。
Result: 在一次生成近 1300 万 token 的 AI R&D 评测上演示该工作流：把 agent 工作划分为与科研技能分类对齐的行为阶段、子 agent 委派与交互以及 token 使用；合并视图显示重点在操作性工作与论文撰写，几乎没有持续假设生成阶段的证据。
Conclusion: 把 transcript 分析做成可回溯、可导出的流水线，能让评测者跟上更长更频繁的 AI 评测，同时保住科学严谨、透明与可复现；而缺少假设生成阶段被视为高质量科学产出的必要成分缺失。

papers.title: PolarScale: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Radiometrically Consistent RGB-to-Stokes Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Polarization imaging provides physical cues beyond intensity imaging but typically requires specialized hardware. Recent methods infer polarization from RGB-like inputs, yet predict only normalized Stokes components or relative descriptors, from which the radiometric scale needed for full Stokes reconstruction has been divided out. We introduce PolarScale, a benchmark that makes this scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target. Built on existing trichromatic full-Stokes measurements, PolarScale takes the per-scene normalized total-intensity image $s_0$ (a scene-referred linear image, not a consumer sRGB photograph) and asks models to predict normalized Stokes components, AoLP/DoLP/DoCP, and a per-scene scale. Because the scale is divided out of the input, it is not physically identifiable; PolarScale therefore evaluates dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation against a constant-scale control, together with angular, self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics. Across seven restoration-based and generative backbones and three prediction strategies, the strongest restoration models estimate the scale with 3.6-4.3% mean relative error versus 5.7% for the constant control and violate physical bounds on fewer than 0.25% of pixels, whereas two generative baselines collapse to a near-zero scale; explicit descriptor supervision improves descriptor accuracy (23.66 vs. 18.88 dB PSNR for MAE). Predicted full-Stokes representations improve diffuse/specular separation, material segmentation, and glare classification, although in diffuse/specular separation the learned scale performs only on par with the constant control.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 17 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolarScale 把 RGB 偏振估计中被除掉的辐射尺度 (radiometric scale) 单列为显式预测与评测目标：输入是场景参考线性图 s0，模型需同时输出归一化 Stokes 分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP 与逐场景尺度。七个恢复类与生成类骨干上，最强恢复模型尺度平均相对误差 3.6–4.3%（常数尺度对照 5.7%），物理越界像素低于 0.25%；显式描述子监督把 MAE 的 PSNR 从 18.88 提到 23.66 dB。
Motivation: 现有从 RGB 推偏振的方法只预测归一化 Stokes 分量或相对描述子，辐射尺度在输入中已被除掉，导致完整 Stokes 重建缺少物理可用的绝对量纲，也无法被评测。
Method: 基于既有三色全 Stokes 测量数据构建 benchmark，输入逐场景归一化总强度图 s0（场景参考线性图而非 sRGB 照片），要求模型预测归一化 Stokes 分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP 及逐场景尺度；评测含数据集条件化的语义尺度估计（对照常数尺度）、角度、自洽性与物理边界指标，并比较七种恢复式/生成式骨干与三种预测策略。
Result: 最强恢复模型尺度平均相对误差 3.6–4.3%，常数对照 5.7%；物理边界越界像素低于 0.25%；两个生成式基线尺度塌缩到近零。显式描述子监督使 MAE 的描述子 PSNR 由 18.88 提升到 23.66 dB。预测的全 Stokes 表示改善漫射/镜面分离、材质分割与眩光分类，但漫射/镜面分离中学习尺度仅与常数对照持平。
Conclusion: 辐射尺度可作为显式预测目标被数据集条件化地估计并优于常数对照，且不破坏物理边界；但在漫射/镜面分离这类下游任务上，学习到的尺度相对常数尺度没有额外收益。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
papers.abstract_en: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge. To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench, a benchmark of newly designed text-based games, whose rules are novel or counterintuitive, requiring agents to acquire knowledge through interaction rather than rely solely on pretrained knowledge. These games provide reproducible feedback and automatic scoring, enabling controlled evaluation of learning across repeated attempts. We also vary game instances to test whether agents can apply what they have learned to new situations. Therefore, we evaluate how backbone models, self-evolving methods, and agent harnesses affect agents' learning ability, revealing three findings: (1) Experience retention: Retaining complete records of actions and feedback can support more effective learning than summarizing these experiences into rules or strategies. (2) Human agent gap: Top-performing human players achieve higher peak scores than the evaluated agents. Human explore more varied strategies, and repeat actions less. (3) Harness matters: With the backbone fixed, changing the harness can improve performance while reducing estimated inference cost. Together, these findings provide insights into how LLM agents learn from experience and suggest directions for future work to improve their learning ability. Project website: https://liushiliushi.github.io/learn2play-bench-website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Learn2Play Bench 用规则新颖或反直觉的自研文本游戏评测 LLM agent 从交互中学习的能力，可重复尝试、自动打分并更换游戏实例。三条发现：保留完整动作与反馈记录比把经验总结成规则更有效；顶尖人类玩家峰值分数高于受测 agent，且策略更多样、重复动作更少；骨干模型固定时更换 agent harness 可在降低推理成本的同时提升性能。
Motivation: 现有基准评测的任务规则要么写在指令里、要么已被预训练模型掌握，无法区分真正的交互学习与既有推理能力。
Method: 构建一组新设计的文本游戏基准，规则新颖或反直觉，提供可复现反馈与自动评分以支持重复尝试的受控评测，并变换游戏实例检验迁移；在此评测骨干模型、self-evolving 方法与 agent harness 三类因素对学习能力的影响。
Result: 三条定性发现：完整保留动作与反馈记录比将经验归纳为规则或策略更能支持有效学习；顶尖人类玩家峰值分数高于受测 agent，人类探索策略更多样、重复动作更少；骨干固定时更换 harness 可提升性能同时降低估计的推理成本。
Conclusion: LLM agent 从经验学习的瓶颈部分在经验留存方式与 harness 设计，而非只在骨干模型；保留原始交互记录与优化 harness 是可行的改进方向。

papers.title: VLA-ACL: Action-Consistent Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong robotic manipulation performance but incur high computational costs from processing long token sequences at every control step, limiting real-time deployment. Visual token pruning offers a direct solution, as visual patches dominate the input sequence and contain considerable redundancy. Existing approaches, however, either rely on indirect training-free heuristics, such as attention scores and motion thresholds, or require costly fine-tuning of the base VLA model. We introduce VLA-ACL (Action Consistency Learning), which learns a lightweight visual token pruning policy through action-level supervision while keeping the base VLA model entirely frozen. The training objective encourages actions produced from pruned visual contexts to remain consistent with the full-context teacher, with ground-truth actions as auxiliary supervision. This directly ties token selection to its effect on the downstream control output. Experiments on LIBERO and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-ACL prunes up to 87.5% of visual tokens while retaining competitive performance, reduces computation by up to 75%, and achieves a 1.5x inference speedup. These results establish a stronger performance-efficiency trade-off than existing frozen-VLA pruning methods and demonstrate the value of action-level supervision for visual token selection. Code is available at https://github.com/du-owen/VLA-ACL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA-ACL 用动作级监督学习一个轻量视觉 token 剪枝策略，在完全冻结基座 VLA 模型的前提下让剪枝后动作与全上下文 teacher 一致。在 LIBERO 与真实操作任务上最多剪掉 87.5% 视觉 token、计算量降低最多 75%、推理加速 1.5 倍，性能保持有竞争力。
Motivation: VLA 模型每个控制步都要处理长 token 序列，计算开销大、难以实时部署；现有剪枝方案要么依赖注意力分数、运动阈值等间接的 training-free 启发式，要么需要对基座 VLA 昂贵微调。
Method: 训练一个轻量视觉 token 剪枝策略，基座 VLA 完全冻结；训练目标要求从剪枝后视觉上下文产生的动作与全上下文 teacher 动作一致，并以 ground-truth 动作作辅助监督，把 token 选择直接绑定到下游控制输出。
Result: 在 LIBERO 与真实世界操作任务上，最多剪枝 87.5% 视觉 token 同时保持有竞争力的性能，计算量最多减少 75%，推理加速 1.5 倍；相较已有 frozen-VLA 剪枝方法取得更强的性能-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 动作级监督可以直接指导视觉 token 选择，让冻结的 VLA 模型在大幅削减 token 与计算的同时保住控制性能，优于依赖间接启发式或需微调的剪枝路线。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 动作级监督可以直接指导视觉 token 选择，让冻结的 VLA 模型在大幅削减 token 与计算的同时保住控制性能，优于依赖间接启发式或需微调的剪枝路线。

papers.title: When Plans Change Answers: Formalizing Cost-Accuracy Optimization for Semantic Queries
papers.abstract_en: In semantic query engines, predicates are evaluated by machine-learned models, and the choice of a query plan affects not only the cost of a query but also its result. Existing systems either apply a fixed threshold to each semantic operator or tune accuracy per operator, without accounting for how errors propagate through joins. We give a formal problem definition for cost-accuracy optimization of such queries. Our starting point is the calibrated confidence that decision models such as Jev attach to each decision. It yields an expected error for every decision; weighting these errors by each decision's contribution to the output (in the simplest case, its fan-out) gives the expected output quality of a plan without any labeled data, and the same computation in reverse turns an output-level accuracy target into a price on each base or intermediate tuple. Building on this, we define an oracle semantics for relational algebra with semantic operators, physical plans as pairs of a logical plan and a decision policy, declarative output-level targets, and a hierarchy of plan equivalence. We show that accuracy is plan-invariant under pointwise-deterministic policies, and that selection pushdown is not quality-sound when escalation bands are calibrated on the plan's own candidates. Expected quality can be computed in polynomial time under bag semantics; under set semantics it follows the dichotomy of tuple-independent probabilistic databases when every relation carries a semantic predicate. Choosing which tuples to drop is NP-hard, while the optimization problem decomposes into per-tuple decisions through two Lagrange multipliers, and, with what we call confidence-centric skipping, tuples that can no longer affect the target are skipped without being scored. Simulations on a synthetic workload illustrate these effects; an evaluation on real engines is left for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为语义查询引擎给出代价-精度优化的形式化框架：用决策模型的校准置信度推出每次决策的期望误差，按其对输出的 fan-out 加权得到计划的期望输出质量，反向计算则把输出级精度目标换算成每条元组的价格。核心结论是点态确定性策略下精度与计划无关，而当 escalation band 在计划自身候选上标定时 selection pushdown 不是 quality-sound；bag 语义下期望质量可多项式时间计算，选哪些元组丢弃是 NP-hard，但问题经两个 Lagrange 乘子分解为逐元组决策。
Motivation: 语义查询中谓词由机器学习模型判定，现有系统要么对每个语义算子用固定阈值，要么逐算子调精度，都不考虑误差如何沿 join 传播，导致查询计划的代价与结果质量无法统一权衡。
Method: 以 Jev 这类决策模型给出的校准置信度为起点，推出每次决策的期望误差，按 fan-out 加权得到计划期望输出质量（无需标注数据），反向计算把输出级精度目标转成元组价格；定义带语义算子的关系代数 oracle 语义、由逻辑计划与决策策略组成的物理计划、声明式输出级目标与计划等价层级，并引入 confidence-centric skipping 跳过不再影响目标的元组。
Result: 证明点态确定性策略下精度 plan-invariant；证明当 escalation band 在计划自身候选上标定时 selection pushdown 不是 quality-sound；bag 语义下期望质量可在多项式时间计算，set 语义下服从 tuple-independent probabilistic databases 的 dichotomy；选择丢弃哪些元组是 NP-hard，但优化经两个 Lagrange 乘子分解为逐元组决策。在合成工作负载上用仿真说明这些效应。
Conclusion: 输出级精度目标可以被声明式地分解为逐元组的代价决策，代价-精度优化在 bag 语义下可解、在丢弃决策上 NP-hard；真实引擎上的评估留待后续工作。

papers.title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to 24.2 pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when 37--98% of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where 98% of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at 0.0% success, while adding SRD reaches 60.6% under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD)：把交互后才可见的完整轨迹（含失败教训）蒸馏成交互前的 foresight 预测目标，作为 RLVR 的补充训练信号。在 10 个工具集成推理与长程 agentic 任务上最高提升 24.2 pp；当 37–98% 的 rollout 组奖励全同、组相对目标梯度消失时 SRD 仍能从轨迹中榨出学习信号，2B 模型 98% 组全失败时 RLVR 收敛到 0.0% 成功率，加 SRD 在相同 rollout 预算下达 60.6%。
Motivation: RLVR 主要靠交互后的标量结果奖励，组相对目标在所有 rollout 同奖励时信号完全消失，但这些轨迹本身仍包含任务要求与失败方式的信息。
Method: 提出 prospective learning：用事后经验监督交互前视角的 foresight 预测，实例化为 Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD)，把特权 hindsight 蒸馏成同一策略的 trajectory-blind foresight；foresight 只作训练目标，推理时不必显式生成，与 RLVR 和 self-distillation 基线互补。
Result: 在 10 个工具集成推理与长程 agentic 任务上，SRD 相对 RLVR 与 self-distillation 基线最高提升 24.2 pp；奖励对比稀缺时优势最明显，跨模型规模有 37–98% 的 rollout 组奖励全同；2B 设置下 98% 的组全失败，RLVR 训练最终成功率 0.0%，加 SRD 在相同 rollout 预算下达到 60.6%。
Conclusion: 事后 agent 经验不只用于评估或改进行为，还能在交互发生前塑造预测性表征；奖励信号越稀薄，从采样轨迹中蒸馏 foresight 的边际价值越大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neuromotor Hierarchy Network: Physiological Inductive Biases for Robust Generalization in sEMG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Surface electromyography (sEMG) provides a wearable, noninvasive interface to neuromuscular activity for movement decoding and human-computer interaction. Population-scale decoding remains difficult because the relationship between sEMG and neuromuscular activity varies across users and sessions, while task-relevant dynamics span channels and multiple timescales. Learning waveform-to-output mappings from task labels leaves the distinction between recording variability and coordinated motor activity implicit. We introduce the Neuromotor Hierarchy Network (NHN), which learns a compact latent neuromotor state from task supervision to represent task-relevant neuromuscular coordination. NHN constructs this latent state through a hierarchy inspired by neuromotor organization. It adapts recording statistics while preserving relative intensity. Its spatiotemporal encoder uses parameter-efficient channel interactions and modulates features with multi-timescale history. The resulting features yield candidate activations of learned motor primitives, which are temporally integrated and continuously weighted to form the state. Theoretical analysis characterizes the efficiency, temporal behavior, and optimization of NHN's core mechanisms. We evaluate the architecture for both continuous hand-pose estimation on emg2pose and touch-typing recognition on emg2qwerty. On emg2pose, NHN reduces user-averaged angular error by 0.52% to 2.84% across all three generalization splits in both Regression and Tracking relative to Hadidi et al.'s best task-specific variants, using 48.42% to 48.51% fewer parameters. On emg2qwerty, NHN reduces beam-search character error rate by 19.40% zero-shot and 30.42% after fine-tuning relative to SplashNet-Upscale, using 65.86% fewer parameters. Physiology-guided inference of a latent neuromotor state supports parameter-efficient sEMG decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Neuromotor Hierarchy Network (NHN)，用受神经运动组织启发的层级结构从任务监督中学出紧凑的潜在神经运动状态，以区分记录可变性与协调性运动活动。在 emg2pose 上相对 Hadidi et al. 的最佳任务特定变体，三个泛化 split 的用户平均角度误差在 Regression 与 Tracking 两种设置下均降 0.52%–2.84%，参数少 48.42%–48.51%；在 emg2qwerty 上相对 SplashNet-Upscale，beam-search 字符错误率零样本降 19.40%、微调后降 30.42%，参数少 65.86%。
Motivation: sEMG 与神经肌肉活动的映射随用户和任务变化，跨用户、跨会话的群体级解码困难；直接从任务标签学波形到输出的映射，会把记录可变性与协调性运动活动混在一起。
Method: NHN 从任务监督学出紧凑潜在神经运动状态：层级结构适配记录统计同时保留相对强度；时空编码器用参数高效的通道交互并以多时间尺度历史调制特征；这些特征给出学习到的运动基元 (motor primitives) 的候选激活，经时间积分并连续加权合成状态。作者另给出关于核心机制效率、时间行为与优化的理论分析。
Result: 在 emg2pose 连续手姿估计上，相对 Hadidi et al. 的最佳任务特定变体，三个泛化 split 在 Regression 与 Tracking 下用户平均角度误差均降 0.52%–2.84%，参数少 48.42%–48.51%。在 emg2qwerty 触打字识别上，相对 SplashNet-Upscale，beam-search 字符错误率降 19.40%（零样本）与 30.42%（微调后），参数少 65.86%。
Conclusion: 生理先验引导的潜在神经运动状态可以在大幅减少参数的同时支撑稳健泛化的 sEMG 解码，覆盖连续回归与序列识别两类任务。
Relevance: 2
