papers.title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Neural simulation of high-fidelity deformable bodies is a foundational challenge in computer graphics and physical AI. Long-horizon prediction for high-resolution 3D volumetric meshes is difficult: autoregressive methods are susceptible to error accumulation, while direct multi-frame prediction at native resolution is computationally prohibitive. This motivates a compact spatiotemporal latent representation, which is largely unexplored for mesh-based volumetric physics. Meanwhile, it remains unclear whether deterministic regression or generative diffusion is the more appropriate predictive paradigm. To address these coupled challenges, we introduce PhysLDM, a unified latent-diffusion paradigm for one-shot volumetric deformable simulation. Its core is a holistic spatiotemporal VAE that avoids the "staircase" artifacts of standard temporal compression (as in common video VAEs), achieving ~2.48 mm reconstruction precision on meter-scale scenes at up to 78x token compression. Based on this reliable latent space, we systematically compare regression and diffusion methods. Our experiments uncover a key modeling insight: complex deformable dynamics are often chaotic, and in this regime deterministic regression tends to produce non-physical averages, whereas diffusion better models their distribution. Accordingly, we employ a latent diffusion model that effectively learns from the chaotic data to generate physically plausible trajectories. Trained purely kinematically on an Objaverse-scale dataset, a single PhysLDM generalizes zero-shot to unseen OOD datasets (GSO and Toys4K). Its differentiability further enables efficient solution of inverse problems and higher-order design optimization. To our knowledge, PhysLDM is the first high-fidelity spatiotemporal autoencoder and latent-diffusion paradigm for volumetric deformable dynamics, offering a scalable and robust approach to neural simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysLDM 用整体式时空 VAE 把米级 3D 体素网格压进潜空间（最高 78× token 压缩、约 2.48 mm 重建精度），再用潜空间扩散 (latent diffusion) 一次性生成可变形体的长时程轨迹。核心发现是混沌体制下确定性回归会输出非物理的平均解，而扩散建模其分布，从而生成物理合理的轨迹，并零样本泛化到 GSO 与 Toys4K。
Motivation: 高分辨率 3D 体素网格的长时程可变形仿真中，自回归方法误差累积，原生分辨率直接多帧预测又算不动；同时网格化体素物理上紧凑时空潜表示几乎未被探索，回归与生成式扩散哪种预测范式更合适也不清楚。
Method: 核心是整体式时空 VAE，规避标准视频 VAE 时间压缩的 staircase 伪影；在其潜空间上系统对比回归与扩散，并采用潜扩散模型学习混沌动力学的分布。纯运动学方式在 Objaverse 规模数据集上训练，可微性用于逆问题求解与高阶设计优化。
Result: 重建精度约 2.48 mm（米级场景），token 压缩最高 78×；实验揭示复杂可变形动力学常呈混沌，此时确定性回归倾向给出非物理平均解，扩散则更好地建模其分布；单一 PhysLDM 零样本泛化到未见 OOD 数据集 GSO 与 Toys4K。
Conclusion: 对混沌可变形体动力学，潜扩散比确定性回归更适合作为预测范式，且紧凑时空潜表示可支撑一次成形、可微、可零样本泛化的体素级神经仿真。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 对混沌可变形体动力学，潜扩散比确定性回归更适合作为预测范式，且紧凑时空潜表示可支撑一次成形、可微、可零样本泛化的体素级神经仿真。

papers.title: The Review Lottery: Benchmarking an Observational Estimator of Peer-Review Noise (ICLR 2017-2025)
papers.abstract_en: How much of a conference accept/reject decision would change if the same paper were reviewed by a different set of reviewers? Running a second independent program committee is the gold standard for answering this, but it is prohibitively expensive: done only twice (NeurIPS 2014 and 2021). We build an observational estimator of this quantity from public review data alone, calibrate it twice, and apply it to nine years of ICLR (2017-2025; 36,113 papers, 134,912 reviews). The estimator decomposes scores with a Bayesian ordered-probit model into paper quality and reviewer noise, maps scores to decisions with a logistic model, and simulates two independent committees (posterior draws B=1,000; committee sizes k=2,3,4). Estimated disagreement rates are 23-30% at k=2 and 18-24% at k=4; 30-50% of accepted papers would be rejected. External calibration: at the NeurIPS 2021 reviewer-count caliber (k=3), the simulated 2021 disagreement rate is 23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%] vs. reported 23.0% (bias +0.3pp); accept precision and committee correlation agree within 5pp and 0.04. Internal calibration: on 18,740 papers with 4+ reviews, random model-free 2+2 reviewer splits agree with the k=2 simulation within 1pp in 2018 and 2021-2025. Longitudinally, we find no robust time trend in reviewer noise over 2017-2025. The high accepted-paper flip rates of 2020 and 2021 have distinct mechanisms: the 2020 four-point scale compressed scores (23.7% of papers had zero within-paper variance), and a counterfactual shows coarsening the scale raises disagreement by about 7pp; 2021 instead combined the lowest signal-to-noise ratio in the sample with the most threshold-crowded acceptances. For the LLM era, a 2023 breakpoint test on within-paper score variance finds no break, but the design has almost no power, and no post-2022 review text or confidence data exist, so no LLM attribution is attempted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用公开评审数据构建同行评审噪声的观测估计器，估计同一论文换一批审稿人时接收/拒稿结论翻转的概率。在 ICLR 2017-2025（36,113 篇论文、134,912 条评审）上估计：k=2 时分歧率 23-30%，k=4 时 18-24%，30-50% 的接收论文会被另一委员会拒稿。
Motivation: 回答「换一批审稿人结论会变吗」的金标准是重跑一个独立 PC（仅 NeurIPS 2014 和 2021 做过两次），成本过高；本文只用公开评审数据估计该量。
Method: 用 Bayesian ordered-probit 模型把分数分解为论文质量与审稿人噪声，再用 logistic 模型把分数映射到决策，模拟两个独立委员会（后验抽样 B=1,000，委员会规模 k=2,3,4）；外部校准对齐 NeurIPS 2021，内部校准用 18,740 篇 4+ 评审论文做无模型的 2+2 随机审稿人切分。
Result: 分歧率 k=2 为 23-30%，k=4 为 18-24%；30-50% 的接收论文会被拒。外部校准：k=3 时 2021 模拟分歧率 23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%] vs 报告值 23.0%（偏差 +0.3pp），接收精度与委员会相关性分别在 5pp 和 0.04 内一致。内部校准：2018 与 2021-2025 上 2+2 切分与 k=2 模拟在 1pp 内一致。2017-2025 审稿人噪声无稳健时间趋势；2020 年四分制压缩分数（23.7% 论文组内方差为零），反事实显示粗化量表使分歧率上升约 7pp；2021 年是样本中最低信噪比叠加最拥挤的接收阈值。2023 断点检验未发现组内方差断点，但检验功效极低。
Conclusion: 同行评审噪声在 ICLR 上足以让近四分之一到三分之一的决策随审稿人组合改变，且 2020 与 2021 的高翻转率机制不同（量表粗化 vs 低信噪比加阈值拥挤）；LLM 时代无法归因，因 2022 年后无评审文本与置信度数据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SOL: Measuring Gaps between Text Distributions by Double Sliced Wasserstein Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating text generation requires measuring how well the generated distribution matches the data distribution. For autoregressive models, this is done by the perplexity. Diffusion and flow-based language models can only provide a likelihood bound, whose tightness differs between model families. Sample-based substitutes such as generative perplexity with entropy do not consider the distribution fit. We propose SOL, a distance between text distributions. Each sequence is represented by the empirical measure of its hidden states under a fixed transformer and the distributions of these measures are compared by the double sliced Wasserstein distance. We prove that SOL is a metric if the transformer is injective. Experiments show that SOL detects distributional failures, recovers expected model trends, and provides stable sample-based estimates. We put forward SOL to fill the gap in the current evaluation protocol used for non auto-regressive models. As a first step we use SOL to re-evaluate a variety of models trained on OpenWebText.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SOL：把每条文本序列在固定 transformer 隐状态上表示为经验测度，再用 double sliced Wasserstein 距离比较两个文本分布，并证明 transformer 单射时 SOL 构成 metric。实验显示 SOL 能检出分布层面的失效、复现预期的模型趋势，并给出稳定的样本估计；作者用它重新评估了一批在 OpenWebText 上训练的模型，以补上非自回归模型的评测空缺。
Motivation: 自回归模型可用 perplexity 评测，而 diffusion 与 flow-based 语言模型只能给出松紧不一的 likelihood bound，含熵的 generative perplexity 又不刻画分布拟合程度，非自回归模型缺少统一的分布级评测协议。
Method: SOL 把每条序列编码为固定 transformer 隐状态下的经验测度，再以 double sliced Wasserstein 距离比较这些测度的分布；理论上给出 transformer 单射时 SOL 为 metric 的证明，并以样本估计方式计算。
Result: 实验显示 SOL 能检出分布性失效、复现预期的模型趋势并给出稳定的样本估计；作为首个应用，在 OpenWebText 上训练的多种模型被 SOL 重新评测。
Conclusion: 作者主张 SOL 可作为非自回归语言模型评测协议中的分布距离，填补 likelihood bound 与含熵 generative perplexity 之外的空缺。

papers.title: BabelFake: A Multilingual Audio-Visual DeepFake Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Reliable and practical audio-visual DeepFake detection requires benchmarks that reflect diverse linguistic contexts and modern data synthesis pipelines for visual as well as audio manipulations. However, existing datasets predominantly contain footage of English-speakers, often include outdated manipulation types, or overlook the audio modality. Further, many datasets feature individuals who did not consent to be used in DeepFake creation. We introduce BabelFake, a multilingual audio-visual DeepFake benchmark recorded with consenting participants. BabelFake contains 399k clips (1,323 hours) from 496 individuals spanning five languages (English, German, Italian, French, Spanish). Our modular data generation pipeline pairs 11 modern video manipulation methods with 4 voice cloning engines, distinguishing visual-only (face swapping) and joint audio-visual manipulations (lip synchronization and portrait animation). By benchmarking state-of-the-art detectors, we show that detection difficulty depends on the audio-visual generation pairing, with substantial performance degradation when authentic audio is preserved. Cross-language/demographic evaluation reveals sensitivity varying across detector architectures and training data, while human evaluation reveals that perceived realism and machine-detection difficulty do not necessarily align.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BabelFake 是一个经被试同意采集的多语言音视频 DeepFake 基准，含 399k 段（1,323 小时）、496 人、5 种语言，用 11 种视频操纵方法与 4 个语音克隆引擎组合生成。对 SOTA 检测器的基准显示检测难度取决于音视频生成配对，保留真实音频时性能大幅下降；跨语言与人群评测显示敏感度随检测器架构和训练数据而变，且人眼感知的真实感与机器检测难度并不一致。
Motivation: 现有 DeepFake 数据集以英语为主、操纵类型过时、常忽略音频模态，且大量使用未同意的个体，无法支撑多语言、现代合成管线下的音视频检测评测。
Method: 经同意被试录制 5 种语言（英、德、意、法、西）语料，构建模块化生成管线：11 种视频操纵方法 × 4 个 voice cloning 引擎，区分纯视觉（face swapping）与联合音视频操纵（lip synchronization、portrait animation）；在此之上评测 SOTA 检测器，并做跨语言/人群评测与人评。
Result: 399k clips（1,323 小时）、496 人、5 种语言、11 种视频操纵方法、4 个语音克隆引擎；检测难度取决于音视频生成配对，保留真实音频时性能显著下降；跨语言/人群敏感度随检测器架构与训练数据变化；人评显示感知真实感与机器检测难度不必一致。
Conclusion: 音视频 DeepFake 检测的成败取决于生成配对而非单一模态，评测必须覆盖多语言、现代操纵类型与同意合规的被试；感知真实感不能作为机器可检测性的代理。

papers.title: How Should a Prompt Optimizer Spend a Tight Budget? BudgetAPO with Noise-Adaptive Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has been widely employed to adapt large language models without updating their weights, yielding promising results. However, existing methods such as GEPA and OPRO assume hundreds to thousands of subject-model calls, far more than is practical behind paid, rate-limited APIs. Under tight budgets they fail in two ways: multi-stage pipelines can exhaust the budget and return the seed prompt unchanged, while single-stage methods compare candidates on fixed-size minibatches, regardless of each task's noise. As a remedy, we introduce BudgetAPO, a single-stage optimizer for the tight-budget regime. BudgetAPO incorporates (1) a noise-adaptive rule that sizes the evaluation slice to each task's noise, measured by a short probe; (2) a fixed slice that turns every accept/reject decision into a paired comparison; and (3) a reflective operator that rewrites reasoning strategy and output format jointly. Extensive results across seven benchmarks and five subject models demonstrate that BudgetAPO ranks first on every subject and beats every baseline under Holm-corrected paired tests, while returning the seed in 13% of runs at 250 calls against 86% for GEPA. On GPT-OSS-20B, GEPA needs 5 times as many calls to match \method's 100-call score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BudgetAPO 是面向紧预算的单阶段 prompt 优化器：用短探针测每个任务的噪声来决定评估切片大小，用固定切片把每次接受/拒绝变成配对比较，再用反思算子联合改写推理策略与输出格式。在七个基准、五个 subject model 上它每次排名第一，250 次调用时只有 13% 的运行退回种子 prompt（GEPA 为 86%）。
Motivation: GEPA、OPRO 等方法假设数百到上千次 subject-model 调用，在付费限流 API 后面不现实：多阶段管线会烧光预算并原样返回种子 prompt，单阶段方法则用固定大小 minibatch 比较候选，无视各任务的评估噪声。
Method: 单阶段优化器 BudgetAPO，含三个部件：噪声自适应规则用一次短探针测量任务噪声并据此确定评估切片大小；固定切片使每次 accept/reject 决策成为配对比较；反思算子联合重写推理策略与输出格式。
Result: 在七个基准、五个 subject model 上，BudgetAPO 在每个 subject 上排名第一，并在 Holm 校正的配对检验中胜过所有基线；250 次调用时返回种子 prompt 的比例为 13%，GEPA 为 86%；在 GPT-OSS-20B 上 GEPA 需要 5 倍调用数才能追平 BudgetAPO 100 次调用的分数。
Conclusion: 在紧预算下，按任务噪声自适应地分配评估样本并把决策做成配对比较，比多阶段管线和固定 minibatch 更能花掉有限的 API 调用预算并稳定改进 prompt。

papers.title: Universality and Convergence of Generative Flows
papers.abstract_en: Generative flows sample from an unnormalized target by training a flow to be balanced, and the training loss is the signal a practitioner watches. We ask what that signal is worth: whether a small loss certifies an accurate sampler, whether the loss can be driven to zero, and how fast gradient descent does so. The loss decides the first. Losses that compare the two sides of the balance by their difference bound, in total variation, the error of the sampler the flow implies, with explicit constants that do not involve the policy; flow-matching losses that compare them through a ratio admit no such bound, already on a single cycle, whenever their generator is continuous at balance. On graphs, the backward policy decides the other two. Once it is frozen, balance becomes invariance under the backward chain, so that existence is free on finite graphs, and one constant --- the norm of that chain's Green operator, which plays the role of an inverse spectral gap --- fixes the order of the curvature of the loss around the balanced flow, from above and below, and sets a floor under the rate at which training converges near it. The mechanism is that gradient descent diffuses the flow along the backward policy. For the squared-logarithm generator of detailed and trajectory balance, training the balance loss on states converges globally on every finite path-connected graph, from every positive initialization. The constant can be infinite while backward trajectories are short on average, and exact flow matching can then fail. The bounds and rates are tested by exact computation on enumerable state spaces, and every theorem carries a certification status computed from a Lean~4 development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 生成流的平衡训练损失能否作为采样精度证书，取决于损失形式：差值型（detailed balance、trajectory balance 的平方对数生成元）在总变差意义下以不含 policy 的显式常数约束采样误差，而 ratio 型 flow-matching 损失即使在单个环上、生成元在平衡点连续时也不存在此类界。图上冻结 backward policy 后，平衡等价于对后向链的不变性，其 Green 算子范数（扮演逆谱隙角色）从上下两侧确定损失曲率阶数并设定收敛速率下界；差值型训练在任意有限路径连通图上从任意正初始化全局收敛。
Motivation: 实践者用训练损失判断生成流质量，但小损失是否意味着采样准确、损失能否降到零、梯度下降多快收敛，此前缺少统一的判定条件。
Method: 按损失比较平衡两侧的方式分类：差值型损失给出总变差误差界（常数不含 policy），ratio 型 flow-matching 损失证明无此界；图上把平衡改写为后向链不变性，用该链 Green 算子范数刻画损失曲率与收敛速率；对 detailed/trajectory balance 的平方对数生成元证明全局收敛，并在可枚举状态空间上做精确计算检验，每个定理附带由 Lean 4 开发计算的 certification status。
Result: 差值型损失以显式常数在总变差上界定采样误差；ratio 型 flow-matching 损失在单个环上、生成元于平衡点连续时不存在该界。有限图上存在性自动成立，Green 算子范数决定损失曲率阶数与收敛速率下界；该常数可在后向轨迹平均很短时仍为无穷，此时精确 flow matching 可能失败。平方对数生成元的平衡损失在每个有限路径连通图上从任意正初始化全局收敛；界与速率在可枚举状态空间上经精确计算检验，全部定理带 Lean 4 认证状态。
Conclusion: 训练损失能否当证书由损失形式决定（差值型可以，ratio 型不行），而可训练性与速率由 backward policy 决定；选损失时应先看它比较平衡两侧的方式。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Population Scaling or Data Dilution? Dynamics of Local Topology Evolution in Decentralized Learning
papers.abstract_en: Scaling decentralized learning changes not only the number of clients $N$, but also the dynamics of information propagation and consensus. We argue that the effect of increasing $N$ cannot be understood in isolation, because data allocation, topology-dependent mixing, and communication capacity may change simultaneously. We study these coupled effects on CIFAR-10 with $N\in\{10,50,100,200\}$, comparing a degree-two Ring, a Static Random graph, and Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a locally adaptive topology process based on friend-of-friend discovery. The Ring provides an analytically transparent failure mode: its Metropolis spectral gap decays as $Θ(N^{-2})$, implying progressively slower contraction of model disagreement as the population grows. Experiments show that holding the nominal local dataset size fixed substantially reduces the apparent population penalty observed when a fixed total dataset is divided among more clients. The remaining degradation depends strongly on communication structure: Ring enters a high-disagreement regime, whereas Static Random and LFHE remain close to consensus. Increasing LFHE's degree threshold further improves accuracy and consensus, but at a substantially higher model-transmission cost. These results show that decentralized scaling is governed by coupled learning and communication dynamics, rather than by the number of clients alone.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Accepted as a poster at DynaFront @ NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CIFAR-10 上把客户端数 N 从 10 扩到 200 时，固定每客户端本地数据量会大幅削弱「固定总数据被更多客户端瓜分」所呈现的表观人口惩罚；剩余退化由通信拓扑决定：Ring 的 Metropolis 谱隙按 Θ(N⁻²) 衰减，进入高分歧态，而 Static Random 与 LFHE 仍接近共识。提高 LFHE 的度阈值可进一步提升精度与共识，但模型传输代价显著上升。
Motivation: 扩大去中心化学习规模时，客户端数 N、数据分配、拓扑混合与通信容量同时变化，把 N 的影响单独归因会混淆真实机制。
Method: 在 CIFAR-10 上取 N∈{10,50,100,200}，对比度为二的 Ring、Static Random 图，以及基于 friend-of-friend 发现的局部自适应拓扑过程 LFHE；用 Ring 的 Metropolis 谱隙给出解析失效模式，并分别固定本地数据量与固定总数据量做对照。
Result: Ring 的 Metropolis 谱隙按 Θ(N⁻²) 衰减，模型分歧收缩随之变慢；固定名义本地数据量时，表观人口惩罚相比固定总数据被更多客户端分割的情形大幅下降。剩余退化强烈依赖通信结构：Ring 进入高分歧区，Static Random 与 LFHE 接近共识；增大 LFHE 度阈值进一步提高精度与共识，但模型传输成本显著更高。
Conclusion: 去中心化扩展由学习与通信动力学耦合决定，而非客户端数本身；要缓解规模惩罚，需同时控制数据分配与拓扑混合，并在 LFHE 上权衡度阈值带来的精度收益与传输开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring Learned Monotone Temporal Aggregation at Matched Admissibility
papers.abstract_en: Risk regulation imposes directional constraints on scores; we adopt their strict per-input form -- the score monotone non-decreasing in every exposure input -- as a normative commitment. Deployed pipelines -- monotone hand-crafted aggregates feeding sign-constrained gradient boosting -- already satisfy it by composition, so constrained-versus-unconstrained comparisons price a guarantee the incumbent has for free. We instead hold admissibility fixed on both sides and measure what learning the aggregation is worth. Our instrument is a recurrent network whose state is classical risk statistics (an exponentially weighted moving average and a high-water mark with learned transforms), monotone by construction in every input and per MC-dropout sample. The central finding, by functional regression, is a subsumption boundary: a learned monotone channel reproduces the geometrically weighted separable family of hand-crafted statistics, one channel per member, to Spearman $ρ\ge 0.996$, approximates window statistics with measurable ceilings, and fails at consecutivity ($ρ= 0.924$) and time localization (0.628), both structural, and at the exposure floor (0.829), a learnability boundary. One explicit admissible basis repairs each failure (rank correlation 1.000). In or near the separable family, learned and engineered aggregation are substitutes, and the learned channel is never statistically behind at full sample size and specified capacity. Its advantages are incumbent-specific: a committed grid pays up to 0.019 AUC in decay regions it leaves uncovered (the learned channel stays within 0.004 of the strongest engineered consumer at every swept point); the highest-dimensional comparator degrades fastest with scarce data; and beyond the training support, grid-fed tree-ensemble scores go flat while a strictly increasing head keeps ranking. No single incumbent is dominated on all three axes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在风险评分的单调性约束下，把可容许性 (admissibility) 固定在两侧，测量「学习聚合本身值多少」：一个状态为经典风险统计量（指数加权移动平均与高水位线加可学习变换）的循环网络，按构造对每个输入单调、且对每个 MC-dropout 样本单调。功能回归给出的替代边界是：在几何加权可分族内学习与手工聚合互为替代（Spearman ρ≥0.996），在 consecutivity（ρ=0.924）、时间定位（0.628）与 exposure floor（0.829）处失效，各补一个显式可容许基即可修复到 ρ=1.000。
Motivation: 风险监管要求分数对每个 exposure 输入单调非降，但现有对比把「有约束 vs 无约束」当成卖点，而部署中的手工聚合加符号约束梯度提升本就按组合满足该保证，等于在为在位者白送的保证定价。
Method: 以循环网络为测量工具：其隐状态是经典风险统计量（exponentially weighted moving average 与 high-water mark，配可学习变换），按构造对每个输入单调、且每个 MC-dropout 样本独立单调；两侧固定同一可容许性，用功能回归 (functional regression) 刻画学习通道与手工统计族的对应关系，并用显式可容许基 (admissible basis) 修补失效维度。
Result: 学习的单调通道以每成员一个通道复现手工统计量的几何加权可分族，Spearman ρ≥0.996；对窗口统计量的逼近有可测上限；在 consecutivity 上 ρ=0.924、时间定位 0.628（均为结构性失效），exposure floor 0.829（可学习性边界），各补一个显式可容许基后秩相关达 1.000。在位网格在未覆盖的衰减区最多损失 0.019 AUC，而学习通道在每个扫描点都与最强手工消费者相差不超过 0.004；最高维比较器在数据稀缺时退化最快；超出训练支撑后网格喂养的树集成分数变平，而严格递增头部仍保持排序。
Conclusion: 在可分族内部或附近，学习聚合与工程化聚合是替代品，学习通道在全样本量与给定容量下从不统计落后；其优势是针对在位者特定缺陷的，没有任何单一在位者在三个轴上被全面支配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FreeLoc: Online Floorplan Localization via Diffusion-Aided Pose Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Floorplans provide compact and widely available geometric maps for indoor localization, but existing high-performing floorplan-based methods still convert them into dense scene-specific offline databases, tying accuracy, storage, and runtime to the sampling resolution of the discretized pose space. We present FreeLoc, an online RGB-based floorplan localization framework that treats the floorplan as a directly queryable geometric map. FreeLoc introduces an efficient online geometric querying and diffusion-aided refinement scheme, which retrieves plausible pose anchors through on-the-fly floorplan ray querying and refines them into accurate continuous pose estimates. For sequential localization, FreeLoc develops an online likelihood construction strategy that bridges single-frame localization and probabilistic temporal fusion by constructing likelihoods from coarse-sampled candidates and refined pose hypotheses, enabling histogram-filter-based temporal fusion without offline databases. Experiments demonstrate real-time online inference and state-of-the-art performance in both single-frame and sequential localization, while real-world results validate practical deployability in indoor robotic localization scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/freeloc/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreeLoc 把楼层平面图当作可直接查询的几何地图做在线 RGB 室内定位：按需 ray querying 检索位姿锚点，再用 diffusion 辅助细化为连续位姿，并用粗采样候选与细化假设构建似然，供 histogram filter 做时序融合，全程不建离线稠密数据库。摘要称其在单帧与序列定位上达到 state-of-the-art 并支持实时在线推理。
Motivation: 现有高性能楼层平面图定位方法仍需把地图转成场景专属的离线稠密数据库，精度、存储与运行时都被离散位姿空间的采样分辨率绑死。
Method: 在线几何查询加 diffusion 辅助细化：通过 on-the-fly floorplan ray querying 检索合理位姿锚点并细化为连续位姿估计；序列定位用在线似然构建策略，从粗采样候选与细化位姿假设生成似然，驱动 histogram filter 时序融合，无需离线数据库。
Result: 实验展示实时在线推理，并在单帧定位与序列定位两方面取得 state-of-the-art 表现；真实场景结果验证其在室内机器人定位中的可部署性。
Conclusion: 把楼层平面图当可查询几何地图、以在线查询加扩散细化替代离线稠密数据库，可在不牺牲精度的前提下解除采样分辨率对存储与运行时的绑定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Long-horizon Work Agents
papers.abstract_en: Work agents operate over digital artifacts to execute professional knowledge-intensive work, requiring training environments that support long-horizon interaction and trustworthy verification. However, hand-crafted environments incur prohibitive engineering overhead that prevents environment scaling, whereas synthesis methods sacrifice workspace complexity, realism, or grounded verifiability. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkForge, a scalable synthesis framework for constructing verifiable work-agent environments from real-world resources. Starting from expert workflows, WorkForge first identifies the resources, decisions, and deliverables required by each workflow. It then retrieves relevant real-world files and organizes them into a workspace. WorkForge inspects the workspace to extract concrete, checkable facts about its content. These factual anchors fix which task types the workspace can support and how their outcomes can be verified. Therefore, WorkForge derives each task's instructions, solution plan, and complementary programmatic and semantic verifiers directly from these factual anchors, keeping verification traceable to observable workspace evidence. Furthermore, we construct 16.7K verifiable environments across 40 professional domains, with workspaces collectively covering 60 file types. Post-training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base improves GDPVal from 45.5 to 73.6 and APEX Score from 5.0 to 21.3, while enabling Qwen3.5-27B to achieve highly competitive performance and outperform strong competitors. Our analyses confirm the efficacy of the proposed method and reveal consistent scaling behaviors across both data volume and interaction horizons.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorkForge 从真实专家工作流出发合成可验证的工作智能体 (work agent) 训练环境：先抽取工作流所需资源、决策与交付物，检索真实文件组 workspace，再从 workspace 中提取可核验的事实锚点 (factual anchors)，据此派生任务指令、解题计划以及程序化+语义双重验证器。构建了覆盖 40 个职业领域、60 种文件类型的 16.7K 个可验证环境，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 后训练后 GDPVal 从 45.5 升到 73.6、APEX Score 从 5.0 升到 21.3。
Motivation: 手工构造的训练环境工程开销过高，无法规模化；已有环境合成方法又牺牲 workspace 复杂度、真实性或可落地的可验证性，长时程、需可信验证的工作智能体训练因此缺少可用环境来源。
Method: 以专家工作流为起点，识别每个工作流的资源、决策与交付物；检索相关真实文件组织成 workspace；检查 workspace 提取关于其内容的具体可核验事实作为 factual anchors，由锚点限定 workspace 支持的任务类型与验证方式；再直接从锚点派生任务指令、解题计划以及程序化与语义两类验证器，使验证可追溯到 workspace 中可观测的证据。
Result: 共构建 16.7K 个可验证环境，覆盖 40 个职业领域、workspace 合计 60 种文件类型；后训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 使 GDPVal 从 45.5 提升到 73.6，APEX Score 从 5.0 提升到 21.3，并使 Qwen3.5-27B 达到很有竞争力的表现、胜过强劲对手；分析显示方法有效，且在数据量与交互时程两个维度上呈现一致的 scaling 行为。
Conclusion: 以真实资源加事实锚点驱动的环境合成可以在保住 workspace 复杂度与可验证性的同时规模化构造工作智能体环境，并带来随数据量和交互时程一致扩展的收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemTrace: State-Consistent Memory for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: As coding agents take on long-horizon software evolution tasks spanning multiple files and stages, longer execution trajectories introduce two coupled challenges: (1) accumulated histories strain context budgets, and (2) repository changes can invalidate earlier execution evidence. Existing approaches address these challenges through techniques like larger context windows, compression, retrieval, or repository representations, but often fail to reconstruct a consistent task state after a context refresh or verify whether recalled evidence remains valid. Thus, we introduce MemTrace, a provenance-aware memory system that preserves execution history and aligns its reuse with the evolving task (e.g., iterative cross-file repair) and repository state. MemTrace stores history as immutable Memory Traces anchored to key information (e.g., files, symbols, tests), and organizes their execution order and dependencies in a Memory Trace Graph. When context is constrained, working memory retains only compact Memory Anchors, from which the agent can reconstruct the latest execution state and locate evidence relevant to its next action. Before restoring historical evidence, MemTrace checks its validity against the current repository state and retrieves only what the next action requires. Across three complementary long-horizon coding benchmarks, MemTrace consistently outperforms all fully evaluated baselines under the same backbone and harness, improving DeepSWE pass@1 by 21.2 points, SWE-EVO Resolved Rate by 4.4 points, and SWE-Milestone Score by 17.8 points under Codex CLI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemTrace 用不可变的 Memory Trace 与 Memory Trace Graph 记录编码 agent 的执行历史，上下文受限时只保留紧凑 Memory Anchors 以重建最新执行状态，并在恢复证据前先对照当前仓库状态校验其有效性。在 Codex CLI 同一 backbone 与 harness 下，三个长程编码基准全面超过全部被完整评测的基线：DeepSWE pass@1 提升 21.2 点，SWE-EVO Resolved Rate 提升 4.4 点，SWE-Milestone Score 提升 17.8 点。
Motivation: 长程软件演化任务的执行轨迹变长后，历史累积挤占上下文预算，且仓库改动会让早期执行证据失效；现有更大上下文、压缩、检索或仓库表示方法在上下文刷新后难以重建一致任务状态，也不校验召回证据是否仍然有效。
Method: 把执行历史存为锚定到文件、符号、测试等关键信息的不可变 Memory Trace，并用 Memory Trace Graph 组织执行顺序与依赖；上下文受限时工作记忆只保留 Memory Anchors，由 agent 据此重建最新执行状态并定位下一步所需证据；恢复历史证据前先对照当前仓库状态做有效性检查，只取下一步动作需要的部分。
Result: 在三个互补的长程编码基准上，同一 backbone 与 harness 下 MemTrace 一致超过全部被完整评测的基线：Codex CLI 下 DeepSWE pass@1 提升 21.2 点，SWE-EVO Resolved Rate 提升 4.4 点，SWE-Milestone Score 提升 17.8 点。
Conclusion: 把执行历史做成带溯源、可校验有效性的结构化记忆，比单纯扩上下文或压缩检索更能支撑长程编码 agent 在仓库持续演化下的连续决策。

papers.title: ROMA: LLM System for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception
papers.abstract_en: Humans inherently understand the physical world through an active process. When sensory evidence is insufficient to infer physical properties, we naturally interact with the environment by deciding what information is missing, how to acquire it, and when sufficient evidence has been obtained. In stark contrast, existing multi-sensory robot systems mainly integrate sensory inputs rather than actively acquiring missing evidence through interactions. In this work, we introduce ROMA, an LLM-based system for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception. ROMA integrates vision, audio, tactile, and force sensing into a reasoning-interaction-feedback loop. The model identifies missing evidence and determines the target objects, interactions, and modalities, while a physical interface executes the selected interactions and collects the multi-sensory feedback. To support this capability, we construct ROMI-2K, a large-scale real-world multi-sensory object interaction dataset covering nearly 2,000 objects and 6 atomic interactions with synchronized sensory feedback. Building on these data, we develop a two-stage training framework that aligns sensory modalities and equips the LLM to assess evidence sufficiency, select informative interactions, and reason over the multi-sensory feedback. We further characterize active perception as perception chains, where acquired evidence guides subsequent interactions and reasoning, and establish ROMA Bench to evaluate single-attribute, long-horizon multi-attribute, and intent-driven active perception. Experiments show that ROMA can actively acquire missing evidence and solve complex, long-chain multi-sensory perception tasks that existing methods struggle to handle, laying a strong perceptual foundation for active multi-sensory embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROMA 是基于 LLM 的多感官主动感知系统，把视觉、听觉、触觉与力觉接入推理-交互-反馈闭环：模型自己判断证据是否充分、缺什么、该对哪个物体做哪种交互来补齐，物理接口执行并回传多感官反馈。配套构建近 2,000 个物体、6 种原子交互的 ROMI-2K 数据集与两阶段训练，实验显示它能主动获取缺失证据并完成现有方法难以处理的长链多感官感知任务。
Motivation: 现有机器人多感官系统以融合输入为主，不会主动通过交互去补上推断物理属性所缺的证据，导致复杂、长程的感知任务无法解决。
Method: ROMA 用 LLM 驱动推理-交互-反馈循环，识别缺失证据并选定目标物体、交互方式与模态，由物理接口执行交互并采集同步的多感官反馈；训练用两阶段框架，先对齐各感官模态，再让 LLM 学会评估证据充分性、选择有信息量的交互并推理反馈。数据基础是新构建的 ROMI-2K（近 2,000 个真实物体、6 种原子交互、同步感官反馈），评测用 ROMA Bench。
Result: ROMA Bench 覆盖单属性、长程多属性与意图驱动三类主动感知评测；实验显示 ROMA 能主动获取缺失证据，解决现有方法难以应对的复杂长链多感官感知任务。
Conclusion: 把证据充分性判断与交互选择交给 LLM 的闭环主动感知，是让具身智能体补齐缺失感官证据、完成长链感知的可行路径，并为多感官具身智能提供感知基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning to Decide, Not to Reason: Parameter-Efficient Decision Operators via Low-Rank Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Injecting skills into a frozen language model currently costs a million parameters and a reinforcement-learning pipeline. We introduce DecSteer, a System-1 decision operator trained by behavior cloning that lowers this cost by roughly two orders of magnitude. The default operator uses 330K parameters to match a 1.33M-parameter operator trained with reinforcement learning, exceeds or achieve comparable performance, while collapsing 3,685-token deliberation into a 6-token decision with no loss in accuracy. A rank-4 variant with 23K parameters, 1/58 of the strongest published skill operator, suffices for SearchQA and near-suffices for LiveMath, where higher rank still helps; the same recipe transfers across five tasks and three backbones, with out-of-distribution gains persisting on LiveMath problems released months after training. The gap to prior work is trainability, and it is set jointly by initialization and architecture. The initialization of prior operators zeroes the gradient of both large factor matrices at the first optimization step, whereas our zero-initialized output projection inside a shared low-rank backbone receives a gradient immediately, which a gradient-flow probe confirms directly. The gain isn't chain-of-thought compression. 23 of 57 LiveMath points beat the base model's best-of-8 sampling, and a logit-lens probe shows the operator amplifies the answer along the model's existing late-layer pathway, not writing it earlier. Gains track the base model's headroom across 13 base-task pairs, and skills compose as approximately linear operators that can be added, interpolated, and hot-swapped at inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DecSteer 用行为克隆训练一个 System-1 决策算子，把注入技能的成本从百万级参数加强化学习降到 330K 参数，并把 3,685 token 的推演压成 6 token 决策而精度不降。rank-4 变体只需 23K 参数（最强已发表技能算子的 1/58）即可胜任 SearchQA、接近胜任 LiveMath；技能可近似线性算子在推理时相加、插值与热插拔。
Motivation: 向冻结语言模型注入技能目前要百万级参数和一条强化学习流水线，且先初始化会让两个大因子矩阵在第一步梯度为零，导致算子难以训练。
Method: DecSteer 通过行为克隆训练 System-1 决策算子：在共享低秩骨干中放置零初始化输出投影，使梯度在第一步即可流动（gradient-flow probe 直接验证）；用低秩激活转向 (low-rank activation steering) 得到 rank-4、23K 参数变体，并在五个任务、三个 backbone 上复用同一配方。
Result: 330K 参数算子匹配 1.33M 参数强化学习算子的表现，3,685 token 推演压缩为 6 token 决策且精度无损；rank-4 23K 参数为最强已发表技能算子的 1/58，在 SearchQA 足够、LiveMath 接近足够且更高 rank 仍有帮助；LiveMath 上 23/57 个点超过基座模型 best-of-8 采样，OOD 增益在训练数月后发布的 LiveMath 题目上持续，增益随 13 组基座-任务配对的 headroom 变化。
Conclusion: 算子与先前工作的差距在可训练性，由初始化与架构共同决定；logit-lens 探针显示增益来自沿模型既有后期层通路放大答案而非更早写出，技能可作为近似线性算子在推理时组合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Super-Resolution in The Right Latent Space: A Frozen Vision-Foundation Substrate
papers.abstract_en: In an image latent space, the embeddings of high-resolution, natural, and sharp images form a manifold. Degradation of high-resolution images pushes their embeddings off this manifold. Real-world super-resolution (SR) then becomes the task of mapping the degraded embedding back onto this manifold --- not anywhere on the manifold, but to the point that preserves what the input still carries, both its semantics and pixel details. Every published method implements this mapping in a reconstruction-oriented latent space or pixel space. We claim these spaces are the wrong substrates for SR. Low-resolution and degraded images are embedded far from the manifold, making the mapping difficult and expensive. The lack of semantic information in these substrates also makes it difficult to navigate to the faithful point on the manifold, causing severe hallucination when degradation is heavy. Thus, restoring in a suitable latent space is crucial to the SR task. We show that the latent space of 23 fused layers of a frozen DINOv3-L is one such space that makes the SR task easier. Degraded images are embedded near the manifold. Moreover, this substrate contains a hierarchy of information, from pixel record to degradation robust semantics, guiding the model to find the faithful point on the manifold. On this substrate, a 415M decoder is trained under reconstruction and adversarial objectives to map the degraded embeddings back and decode to pixel space in one pass. The resulting model, RAESR, attains the best fidelity--perception trade-off among state-of-the-art adversarial and diffusion-based restorers on RealSR, DRealSR, LSDIR and DIV2K-Val, at 37 ms per 512 by 512 image on a single H20 GPU. Swapping the substrate for a VAE latent under an identical recipe loses on every metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAESR 把真实图像超分辨率 (real-world SR) 的映射放到冻结 DINOv3-L 中 23 层融合特征构成的潜空间里：退化图像在该空间贴近高质量图像流形，且空间自带从像素记录到退化鲁棒语义的层级信息，引导模型找回保真点。415M 解码器在重建与对抗目标下一次前向解码回像素空间，在 RealSR、DRealSR、LSDIR、DIV2K-Val 上取得对抗式与扩散式恢复器中最好的保真—感知权衡，512×512 单图 37 ms（单张 H20 GPU）；同配方换成 VAE 潜空间则每项指标都输。
Motivation: 现有 SR 方法都在面向重建的潜空间或像素空间里做退化到清晰的映射，退化图像离流形远、映射难且贵，且这些底座缺少语义信息，重退化时导航到保真点困难，导致严重幻觉。
Method: 以冻结 DINOv3-L 的 23 层融合作为潜空间底座，把退化图像嵌入到贴近流形的位置；其上训练一个 415M 参数解码器，用重建目标加对抗目标，把退化嵌入映射回流形并单次前向解码到像素空间。

papers.title: Beyond Entropy: Self-Diagnostic Multi-Role Token Optimization for Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially advanced multimodal reasoning, yet it remains fundamentally limited by ambiguous token-level credit assignment. While high-entropy token heuristics encourage possibility exploration, naively extending them to video reasoning tends to induce lengthy reasoning, as the model becomes overly reliant on high-entropy visual activations. Alternative approaches that rely on counterfactual-based visual token localization for credit assignment also tend to over-prioritize visual exploration at the expense of decisive reasoning cues for answer derivation, thereby exacerbating the interference from spurious visual nuances. Moreover, these methods employ static counterfactual strategies that fail to co-evolve with the policy during training. In this paper, we introduce DyCPO, a co-evolutionary framework that jointly optimizes reliable token selection and adaptive counterfactual intervention. It constructs a multi-role dependence metric to balance visual exploration and answer-relevance mining in token-wise contrastive learning, while suppressing exploration-only filler tokens and spurious visual noise. Rather than relying on static counterfactual priors, DyCPO dynamically derives counterfactual signals from the model's own successful and failed rollouts, enabling self-diagnostic analysis and co-evolution of the optimization objective with the policy. Extensive experiments on complex video reasoning and general video understanding benchmarks demonstrate consistent performance improvements, establishing DyCPO as a robust token-level credit assignment paradigm for multimodal reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyCPO 把视频推理 RLVR 中的 token 级 credit assignment 改成协同演化框架：用多角色依赖度量在 token 对比学习里平衡视觉探索与答案相关性挖掘，同时压制纯填充 token 与伪视觉噪声，并从模型自身成功/失败 rollout 动态导出反事实信号，使优化目标与策略共同演化。在复杂视频推理与通用视频理解基准上取得一致性能提升。
Motivation: RLVR 的 token 级 credit assignment 模糊：高熵 token 启发式在视频推理中导致冗长推理，反事实视觉 token 定位又过度偏向视觉探索、放大伪视觉干扰，且静态反事实先验无法随策略演化。
Method: DyCPO 联合优化可靠的 token 选择与自适应反事实干预：构造多角色依赖度量 (multi-role dependence metric) 引导 token-wise 对比学习，平衡视觉探索与答案相关性挖掘并抑制填充 token；反事实信号不再用静态先验，而是从模型自身成功与失败 rollout 中动态提取，实现自诊断与目标-策略协同演化。
Result: 在复杂视频推理与通用视频理解基准上取得一致的性能提升；摘要以定性方式陈述改进，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: token 级 credit assignment 应当让反事实干预与策略协同演化，而非依赖静态先验或单一高熵启发式，这样才能同时避免冗长推理与伪视觉噪声。

papers.title: Multi-Task Evolution for Zero-Shot Cross-Problem Generalization using LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Designing effective heuristics for diverse combinatorial optimization problems requires substantial expertise and repeated search. Large language models (LLMs) automate heuristic generation and refinement, but heuristic search typically depends on evaluation feedback from the problem being optimized. Generalizing to new problem definitions using only source-task feedback therefore remains a central challenge. We introduce MECo, an LLM-driven multi-task evolutionary framework for zero-shot cross-problem generalization. MECo maintains task-conditioned heuristic populations and uses a transfer gap based on cross-task population performance to guide their interactions. These interactions enable the transfer and recombination of heuristics. A complementary selection criterion then constructs a compact heuristic set by rewarding each member's additional coverage of source combinations. The selected set is applied to target problems without further search or adaptation. Experiments on 32 problem variants across vehicle routing (VRP) and flexible job-shop scheduling (FJSP) show that MECo achieves the lowest mean costs compared with eight automated heuristic design (AHD) baselines under the same budgets. On out-of-domain problems, it outperforms the strongest baseline in each family. Moreover, integrating the framework of MECo with different AHD methods improves their ID and OOD performance in both families, supporting its effectiveness across different methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MECo 用 LLM 驱动的多任务进化做启发式跨问题零样本泛化：维护按任务条件化的启发式种群，用跨任务种群表现的 transfer gap 引导迁移与重组，再按对源问题组合的增量覆盖挑选紧凑启发式集，直接套到目标问题上不再搜索。在 VRP 与 FJSP 共 32 个问题变体上，同预算下平均成本低于八个自动启发式设计 (AHD) 基线，OOD 上也胜过各家族最强基线。
Motivation: 启发式搜索通常依赖被优化问题本身的评估反馈，换到新问题定义时没有反馈可用，跨问题零样本泛化因此是核心难题。
Method: MECo 维护任务条件化的启发式种群，用基于跨任务种群表现的 transfer gap 引导种群间交互以实现启发式迁移与重组；再用补充选择准则按每个成员对源问题组合的额外覆盖构造紧凑启发式集，无需进一步搜索或适配即可用于目标问题。
Result: 在 VRP 与 FJSP 两个家族共 32 个问题变体上，同预算下 MECo 的平均成本低于八个 AHD 基线；在 out-of-domain 问题上优于每个家族中最强的基线；把 MECo 框架接入不同 AHD 方法，可同时提升它们在两个家族上的 ID 与 OOD 表现。
Conclusion: 跨任务 transfer gap 与覆盖导向选择足以让启发式在无目标反馈时迁移到新问题，并且作为通用框架能改善既有 AHD 方法的 ID 与 OOD 表现。

papers.title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IG-VLA 让 VLA 在视觉表征空间里显式想象未来场景演化来指导动作，再把推理得到的场景-行为关联压缩成 Scene Gist Token，推理时跳过未来想象。在 LIBERO-Plus Language 上，推理策略与 gist 策略的成功率都比最强基线高近 6%，gist 策略在单张 NVIDIA A6000 上把每个 action chunk 的延迟从 1081ms 降到 169.5ms，最高 6.38 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 中间推理只针对已观测状态，不显式预判未来场景演化；而每步都做显式未来 rollout 又带来很大的计算开销。
Method: IG-VLA 含两个组件：Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning 在视觉表征空间想象任务相关的未来场景演化（不做像素级视频生成）来引导动作预测；Scene Gist Memory 把推理得到的场景-行为关联内化为紧凑的 Scene Gist Token，推理阶段绕过显式未来想象。
Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、VLABench 上实验；LIBERO-Plus Language 套件中推理策略与 gist 策略的成功率均比最强基线高近 6%；gist 策略最高 6.38 倍加速，单张 NVIDIA A6000 上每 action chunk 推理延迟从 1081ms 降至 169.5ms。
Conclusion: 未来时空推理可以被内化成一个紧凑 token，在保住未来推理收益的同时实现高效的 VLA 部署。

papers.title: Evaluating and Improving the Robustness of Large Language Models to Input Sequence Variations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) in production systems face prompt injections, trojans (backdoors), and manipulation of automatic quality metrics. This thesis develops models, methods, and algorithms for evaluating and improving LLM robustness to adversarial input sequence variations. We propose R_stab(f), a generative robustness metric based on the Jensen-Shannon divergence between per-step output distributions under small input perturbations. For localized attacks we prove V(h) <= 1 - R_class(h), where R_class(h) is the probability that a decision operator h keeps its decision under small perturbations. For non-localized attacks we propose a calibrated empirical model. For LLM-as-a-Judge systems we develop ASA, an adaptive evolutionary black-box attack that reaches an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 73.8%, with transfer between open models up to 62.6%. On Trojan Detection Challenge 2023 data (Pythia-1.4B), surrogate triggers reach REASR ~0.99 while recall of the true triggers is ~0.17 against a baseline of ~0.14. On SaTML CTF 2024 we systematize four classes of bypasses of multi-layer defenses, which reduce the ASR from 90% to 15-25%. Committees of 5-7 heterogeneous models reduce the ASR for Gemma-3-4B by 47-55 percentage points, to 19.3% with 7 models. For agentic systems based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), we propose AttestMCP, which attests tool calls with HMAC-protected packets at under 0.1 ms per call, and the Commit Boundary isolation pattern. On the MCPBench benchmark of 847 scenarios they reduce the average ASR from 53.7% to 12.4%. The methods are implemented in the JudgeGuard and TrojanArmor software suites and the MCPSec module.
papers.comment: PhD thesis, 2026. 118 pages. v2: corrected a name spelling in the acknowledgements
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 LLM 对抗鲁棒性的博士论文：提出基于 Jensen-Shannon 散度的生成式鲁棒性指标 R_stab(f)，并给出局部攻击下 V(h) ≤ 1 − R_class(h) 的界。实测上，ASA 对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的攻击成功率 (ASR) 达 73.8%，5–7 个异构模型委员会把 Gemma-3-4B 的 ASR 降 47–55 个百分点至 19.3%，AttestMCP 与 Commit Boundary 在 MCPBench 的 847 个场景上把平均 ASR 从 53.7% 压到 12.4%。
Motivation: 生产环境中的 LLM 面向 prompt injection、木马 (trojan/backdoor) 与自动质量指标操纵，缺少可度量的鲁棒性刻画与可落地的防御手段。
Method: 提出 R_stab(f)：以小扰动下逐步输出分布的 Jensen-Shannon 散度度量生成鲁棒性；对局部攻击证明 V(h) ≤ 1 − R_class(h)，对非局部攻击给出校准的经验模型。防御侧包括 ASA（针对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的自适应进化黑盒攻击）、多层防御旁路的四类系统化、5–7 个异构模型委员会，以及面向 MCP 智能体的 AttestMCP（HMAC 保护的工具调用证明，每次调用低于 0.1 ms）与 Commit Boundary 隔离模式，落地为 JudgeGuard、TrojanArmor 与 MCPSec。
Result: ASA 对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的 ASR 最高 73.8%，跨开放模型迁移最高 62.6%。Trojan Detection Challenge 2023（Pythia-1.4B）上替代触发器 REASR 约 0.99，真实触发器召回约 0.17，基线约 0.14。SaTML CTF 2024 上四类多层防御旁路把 ASR 从 90% 降到 15–25%。5–7 模型委员会使 Gemma-3-4B 的 ASR 下降 47–55 个百分点，7 模型时为 19.3%。MCPBench 的 847 个场景上，AttestMCP 与 Commit Boundary 把平均 ASR 从 53.7% 降到 12.4%，单次工具调用开销低于 0.1 ms。
Conclusion: 鲁棒性可以被度量并分层治理：R_stab 与其界给出形式化刻画，模型委员会与 MCP 侧的证明/隔离能把对抗成功率压到 12.4%–19.3% 的量级，配套以 JudgeGuard、TrojanArmor、MCPSec 实现。

summary_sections.method: 提出 R_stab(f)：以小扰动下逐步输出分布的 Jensen-Shannon 散度度量生成鲁棒性；对局部攻击证明 V(h) ≤ 1 − R_class(h)，对非局部攻击给出校准的经验模型。防御侧包括 ASA（针对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的自适应进化黑盒攻击）、多层防御旁路的四类系统化、5–7 个异构模型委员会，以及面向 MCP 智能体的 AttestMCP（HMAC 保护的工具调用证明，每次调用低于 0.1 ms）与 Commit Boundary 隔离模式，落地为 JudgeGuard、TrojanArmor 与 MCPSec。
summary_sections.result: ASA 对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的 ASR 最高 73.8%，跨开放模型迁移最高 62.6%。Trojan Detection Challenge 2023（Pythia-1.4B）上替代触发器 REASR 约 0.99，真实触发器召回约 0.17，基线约 0.14。SaTML CTF 2024 上四类多层防御旁路把 ASR 从 90% 降到 15–25%。5–7 模型委员会使 Gemma-3-4B 的 ASR 下降 47–55 个百分点，7 模型时为 19.3%。MCPBench 的 847 个场景上，AttestMCP 与 Commit Boundary 把平均 ASR 从 53.7% 降到 12.4%，单次工具调用开销低于 0.1 ms。
summary_sections.conclusion: 鲁棒性可以被度量并分层治理：R_stab 与其界给出形式化刻画，模型委员会与 MCP 侧的证明/隔离能把对抗成功率压到 12.4%–19.3% 的量级，配套以 JudgeGuard、TrojanArmor、MCPSec 实现。

papers.title: Causal Memory Policy: Making Memory Utility Identifiable by Intervening on Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Memory-augmented large language models must decide which memories to retain, and recent systems do so by estimating each memory's effect on task performance. However, these estimates rely entirely on retrieved memories. When a memory is never retrieved, store-level interventions produce identical outcomes, leaving its utility unidentified. This is a retrieval-level positivity violation, invisible to diagnostics that examine only memory operations. We introduce Causal Memory Policy (CMP), a causal framework that restores identification by intervening on retrieval itself, reserving a fixed number of context slots for memories sampled with known propensities. CMP estimates memory utility by self-normalized inverse propensity weighting under a balanced assignment design. We prove the causal factorization of memory utility through retrieval, the unbiasedness and exact variance of the estimator, and the optimal decision rule under irreversible operations. Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 记忆增强 LLM 的记忆效用估计只依赖被检索到的记忆，从未被检索的记忆其 store 级干预结果完全相同，导致效用不可识别（retrieval-level positivity violation）。Causal Memory Policy (CMP) 直接干预检索本身，为按已知倾向采样的记忆保留固定 context slot，用 balanced assignment 下的自归一化逆倾向加权 (self-normalized IPW) 估计效用。LongMemEval 上 54%、LoCoMo 上 67% 的必需记忆识别失败，CMP 把必需/非必需记忆判别 AUC 从 0.54 提到 0.66。
Motivation: 现有系统靠估计每条记忆对任务表现的效应来决定保留谁，但估计完全建立在被检索的记忆上；未被检索的记忆在 store 级干预下结果相同，效用无法识别，而只检查 memory 操作的诊断发现不了这一 positivity violation。
Method: CMP 在检索层做干预：为按已知 propensities 采样的记忆保留固定数量的 context slot，在 balanced assignment 设计下用自归一化逆倾向加权 (self-normalized inverse propensity weighting) 估计记忆效用；并证明记忆效用经由检索的因果分解、估计量的无偏性与精确方差，以及不可逆操作下的最优决策规则。
Result: 识别失败覆盖 LongMemEval 上 54% 的必需记忆与 LoCoMo 上 67%，且在已部署的记忆系统中同样存在；CMP 将必需与非必需记忆的判别 AUC 从 0.54 提升到 0.66。单条记忆的 per-query 效用在其被估计的那个 query 上达到 0.78 AUC，但任何可供保留策略使用的聚合方式都无法预测该记忆在未见 query 上的价值。
Conclusion: 检索层干预能恢复记忆效用的可识别性并提高判别力，但被识别出的效用本身不足以支撑保留决策——在估计所用 query 上 0.78 AUC 的效用无法外推到未见 query，保留策略需要跨 query 的价值而非单 query 效用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2
authors: Pablo de Oliveira Castro (2) ((1) Krembil Centre for Neuroinformatics
papers.abstract_en: Should low-precision transformer inference use stochastic rounding (SR) or round-to-nearest (RN)? The answer depends on where in the network you look. We isolate this effect by holding the numerical format fixed and varying only the rounding rule at individual operation sites. To enable experiments at freely chosen precisions, we extend the PRISM vectorized rounding library to arbitrary virtual precision via a variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) algorithm, proving that the rounding decision is evaluated exactly in hardware floating point. We develop two analyses providing complementary insight into this site-level trade-off. First, a probabilistic forward-error bound for linear projections shows that SR's error envelope grows as $O(\sqrt{n} u)$ in reduction length $n$, versus $O(n u)$ for RN, a gap that widens rapidly at low precision and is most pronounced in the long multilayer perceptron (MLP) down-projection. Second, a second-order decomposition of expected cross-entropy loss change at the output softmax into signed drift, drift curvature, and a Fisher-weighted variance penalty reveals why the two sites behave oppositely: MLP noise is predominantly a uniform logit shift to which softmax is invariant, so SR's variance is largely discounted; head noise is non-uniform across the vocabulary and is not. On DistilGPT-2 at $t=6$ significand bits, observations match theory: SR in the MLP raises perplexity to 1.15x the full-precision reference, versus 2.21x for RN. At the language-model head, the ordering reverses because SR introduces non-uniform variance, whereas deterministic RN carries none. In a mixed-precision configuration (MLP output at $t=6$), assigning SR to the MLP and RN to the head brings perplexity within 1.10x of the full-precision reference, a 28% reduction over matched-bit RN.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Code and evaluation pipeline available at https://github.com/big-data-lab-team/fuzzy-llm and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23066028
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DistilGPT-2 低精度推理中，随机舍入 (SR) 与就近舍入 (RN) 的优劣取决于算子位置：MLP 降维投影用 SR、语言模型头用 RN 的混合配置，在 t=6 有效位下把困惑度拉回到全精度参考的 1.10 倍，比全 RN 降低 28%。
Motivation: 低精度推理中舍入规则的选择缺少按算子位置区分的理论依据，无法解释为何同一规则在网络不同部位表现相反。
Method: 扩展 PRISM 舍入库为任意虚拟精度的变精度随机舍入 (VPSR) 并证明舍入判定在硬件浮点中精确执行；给出线性投影的随机舍入前向误差界，以及输出 softmax 处交叉熵损失变化的二阶分解（signed drift、drift curvature、Fisher 加权方差惩罚）。
Result: 误差界显示 SR 随归约长度 n 为 O(√n·u)、RN 为 O(n·u)，差距在低精度下迅速扩大且在 MLP 降维投影最显著。DistilGPT-2 在 t=6 有效位下，MLP 处 SR 困惑度为全精度的 1.15 倍、RN 为 2.21 倍；语言模型头处顺序反转。MLP 输出 t=6 时 SR+RN 混合配置困惑度为全精度的 1.10 倍，比同位宽全 RN 降低 28%。
Conclusion: MLP 噪声主要是 softmax 不变的均匀 logit 平移，SR 方差被大幅折扣；头部噪声跨词表非均匀故 RN 更优，舍入规则应按算子位置分配。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
papers.abstract_en: An AI companion that talks with someone for months should come to understand them. It should know who they are, remember what they said, and recognize when something from the past matters now. Testing this needs real conversations, but real conversations are private, so existing benchmarks use invented people and invented questions. We release RealCompanion, ten real relationships between people and an AI companion, with 27,218 messages over up to 120 days. For each person, we release the full conversation, a profile, a persona, chat test items, and question test items. Every label points to the messages that support it, and every chat label comes with the reasoning that produced it. The real data shows three things. First, people rarely refer back. Only 3.4% of their messages depend on something said earlier, and when one does, the earlier message is usually far away (a median of 2,157 messages back). Averages hide this. Looking at the most recent messages finds the needed one 95.9% of the time overall, but only 2.2% of the time when it is far back. Second, AI systems cannot tell when the past matters. The detectors we tested barely beat chance on real messages, and when the same earlier messages are labeled "memories" instead of "earlier messages", models bring up the past 10 to 14 percentage points more often, even when nothing from the past is needed. Third, AI systems read more into a person than the person revealed. Three agent systems rebuild each persona equally well (F1 0.71). They see the person, and then imagine more. Understanding a person depends on knowing when their past matters and where what they shared ends, and only real conversations can test it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RealCompanion 发布 10 段真实人机陪伴关系、27,218 条消息、最长 120 天的纵向对话基准，每条标签都附支撑消息与推理链。真实数据中仅 3.4% 消息依赖更早内容，且被依赖消息中位距离为 2,157 条之前；按最近消息检索整体命中 95.9%，但远距离依赖仅 2.2%。被测检测器在真实消息上勉强胜过随机，且把同一批早期消息改标为 memories 会让模型多提过去 10–14 个百分点，三个 persona 重建 agent 的 F1 同为 0.71。
Motivation: 现有长期陪伴基准因真实对话隐私而使用虚构人物与虚构问题，无法检验 AI 何时该调用过去、以及人物信息在哪里结束。
Method: 发布 RealCompanion：10 段真实人机关系的完整对话、profile、persona、chat test items 与 question test items，每条标签指向支撑消息，每个 chat 标签附产生它的推理；用真实消息评测过去依赖检测器、记忆调用行为与 persona 重建 agent。
Result: 3.4% 的消息依赖更早内容，被依赖消息中位距离 2,157 条；最近消息检索整体命中 95.9%、远距离仅 2.2%；被测检测器在真实消息上勉强胜过随机，把早期消息改标为 memories 后模型多提过去 10–14 个百分点；三个 agent 的 persona 重建 F1 均为 0.71。
Conclusion: 理解一个人取决于知道其过去何时起作用、以及其所分享内容到哪里为止，而只有真实对话能检验这两点。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What They Cannot Deliver
papers.abstract_en: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness is decided by the agent's configuration at the moment of speaking, so it can be detected from a single turn, before deployment or at run time. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and an outcome taxonomy that separates these failures from honest deferrals and from over-refusal. We build a checker (a setup-blind detector, deterministic feasibility rules, and a response judge) validated against 400 human labels. On a controlled benchmark of 293 follow-up requests across five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, four open-weight models of 8-14B parameters fail on 45.9% of responses when no tool exists and nothing is stated. A frontier model fails on 4.4%, but it gets there by deferring and asking, not by using the tools it has: promises made without the enabling call remain in every model. Telling the model its runtime, the cheapest fix, cuts open-weight failures nearly in half where nothing is doable and changes nothing where a scheduler exists; a directive capability card removes most failures at the largest cost in over-refusal; running the checker in the loop and rewriting flagged replies removes more at a smaller cost. Code, prompts, model outputs, and human labels are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 定义并检测 LLM agent 的「空承诺」：当前轮承诺未来行动，但工具与运行时都无法兑现，其空虚性由说话时的配置决定，可单轮判定。构建含 setup-blind 检测器、确定性可行性规则与回复评判器的 checker（400 条人工标注验证），在 293 条追问、五种设置的受控基准上，四个 8–14B 开源模型在无工具且未说明时失败 45.9%，前沿模型 4.4%；告知运行时可将开源模型失败近乎减半。
Motivation: 聊天机器人承诺「明天提醒你」却不会再次运行，这类空承诺在部署前或运行时即可从单轮识别，区别于事后才知的 broken promise，但缺少形式定义与可检测手段。
Method: 在 commitment semantics 之上定义空承诺，含三类失败、针对工具可兑现承诺的 anchoring 条件，以及区分诚实推迟与 over-referral 的结果分类；checker 由 setup-blind 检测器、确定性可行性规则和 response judge 组成，用 400 条人工标注验证；基准为五种逐个加入持久化 affordance 的设置下的 293 条追问，测试四个 8–14B 开源模型与一个前沿模型。
Result: 无工具且未说明时开源模型失败 45.9%，前沿模型 4.4%（靠推迟与询问而非用工具达成）；无使能调用的承诺在每个模型中都存在。告知运行时使无事可做场景的开源失败近乎减半、有 scheduler 时无变化；capability card 消除大部分失败但 over-refusal 代价最大；checker in-the-loop 加改写以更小代价消除更多失败。
Conclusion: 空承诺可由说话时配置单轮判定，最便宜的修复是告知运行时，但仅在无事可做时有效；带使能调用的承诺缺失是所有模型的共性问题，checker 加改写是代价更小的补充手段。

summary_sections.motivation: 聊天机器人承诺「明天提醒你」却不会再次运行，这类空承诺在部署前或运行时即可从单轮识别，区别于事后才知的 broken promise，但缺少形式定义与可检测手段。
summary_sections.method: 在 commitment semantics 之上定义空承诺，含三类失败、针对工具可兑现承诺的 anchoring 条件，以及区分诚实推迟与 over-referral 的结果分类；checker 由 setup-blind 检测器、确定性可行性规则和 response judge 组成，用 400 条人工标注验证；基准为五种逐个加入持久化 affordance 的设置下的 293 条追问，测试四个 8–14B 开源模型与一个前沿模型。
summary_sections.result: 无工具且未说明时开源模型失败 45.9%，前沿模型 4.4%（靠推迟与询问而非用工具达成）；无使能调用的承诺在每个模型中都存在。告知运行时使无事可做场景的开源失败近乎减半、有 scheduler 时无变化；capability card 消除大部分失败但 over-refusal 代价最大；checker in-the-loop 加改写以更小代价消除更多失败。
summary_sections.conclusion: 空承诺可由说话时配置单轮判定，最便宜的修复是告知运行时，但仅在无事可做时有效；带使能调用的承诺缺失是所有模型的共性问题，checker 加改写是代价更小的补充手段。

papers.title: Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Despite rapid advances, large multimodal models are reaching a bottleneck: existing approaches focus primarily on accommodating additional modalities while overlooking the distinct characteristics of each modality and the relations among them. Motivated by the multistage property of human multisensory perception, we propose a multimodal interplay pyramid that organizes multimodal modeling as a progression from modality-specific processing, through cross-modal alignment, to deeper multimodal integration. Guided by this pyramid, Gestalt adopts a unified discrete diffusion framework and an interplay-partitioned architecture, with learnable interplay tokens mediating cross-modal exchange and integration. The pyramid also structures its data organization and training strategy. Strong performance across image generation, multimodal understanding, and text-only evaluation shows that Gestalt significantly improves cross-modal integration while preserving modality-specific information, effectively harnessing the strengths of diffusion-based multimodal models and offering a promising path toward unified multimodal intelligence. Project page: https://GeWu-Lab.github.io/Gestalt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gestalt 提出以多模态交互为核心的统一离散扩散大模型，用交互金字塔把建模分成模态内处理、跨模态对齐、多模态融合三级，并以可学习的 interplay token 承担跨模态交换。摘要称其在图像生成、多模态理解与纯文本评测上均表现强劲，在增强跨模态整合的同时保留各模态自身信息。
Motivation: 现有大模态模型主要在不断接入更多模态，忽略各模态自身特性及其相互关系，导致跨模态整合遇到瓶颈。
Method: 以多阶段人类多感知为动机构建 multimodal interplay pyramid，指导统一离散扩散框架与 interplay-partitioned 架构设计；可学习 interplay token 负责跨模态交换与融合，同一金字塔同时组织数据与训练策略。
Result: 在图像生成、多模态理解与纯文本评测三类任务上均取得强劲表现，显著改善跨模态整合并保留模态特异信息；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 按模态内处理到跨模态对齐再到深度融合的分层交互范式，是通向统一多模态智能的一条有前景路径。

papers.title: Grounding with Confidence: Controllable Generative Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video temporal grounding supports applications such as video search, content review, and automated editing by localizing events described in natural language. Yet existing generative models typically output timestamps without explicit interval-level confidence scores to guide candidate selection. We separate candidate generation from acceptance by scoring individual intervals within the original decoding pass. A lightweight confidence head reads pooled decoder states, providing an explicit score trained for interval selection. Offline verifier scores supervise the head on fixed candidate sequences, and temporal-overlap labels adapt it to current rollouts during reinforcement learning. GT-anchored candidate-pool supervision and set-level optimization train the generator. The resulting scores support ranking, threshold-based selection, and rejection without invoking an external verifier at inference. On a fixed OMTG-Bench candidate pool, confidence raises query-macro Recall@0.5 from 9.95% to 14.42% over generation order at a 10% global return budget, and from 26.48% to 31.12% at a 25% budget. The continuous scores let downstream applications adjust return budgets or acceptance thresholds to match their precision-recall preferences, without regenerating candidate intervals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 生成式视频时序定位 (generative video temporal grounding) 模型通常直接输出时间戳而没有区间级置信度，无法在候选间做选择或拒答。作者在原解码 pass 内用轻量 confidence head 读取池化 decoder 状态打分，推理时无需外部 verifier；在 OMTG-Bench 固定候选池上，10% 全局返回预算下 query-macro Recall@0.5 从生成顺序的 9.95% 提到 14.42%，25% 预算下从 26.48% 提到 31.12%。连续分数允许下游按精度-召回偏好调节返回预算或接受阈值，无需重新生成候选区间。
Motivation: 生成式时序定位模型只输出时间戳，缺少显式区间级置信度分数，下游无法据此挑选候选或拒答，只能依赖生成顺序。
Method: 把候选生成与接受分离：轻量 confidence head 读取池化 decoder 状态给出显式分数，用离线 verifier 分数在固定候选序列上监督该 head，并用时间重叠标签在强化学习 rollout 上自适应；生成器本身用 GT-anchored 候选池监督与 set-level 优化训练。
Result: 在 OMTG-Bench 固定候选池上，10% 全局返回预算时 query-macro Recall@0.5 由生成顺序的 9.95% 升至 14.42%，25% 预算时由 26.48% 升至 31.12%。
Conclusion: 区间级置信度分数可在推理时替代外部 verifier，支持排序、阈值选择与拒答，并让下游在不重新生成候选的前提下调节精度-召回权衡。

papers.title: LLM Persona Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Pre-training equips large language models (LLMs) with a broad repertoire of behavioral patterns associated with roles, styles, values, and goals. Post-training teaches conditional enactment and makes a helpful Assistant the default, but it does not erase alternative modes from the weights; explicit prompts can therefore elicit personas that repeatedly shape judgment, language, and action. In open-weight settings, runtime controls can be removed, motivating persona unlearning: a weight-level edit that makes a designated persona difficult to elicit and enact on unseen contexts. We introduce PersonaUnlearnBench, a model-specific paired benchmark spanning six LLMs from three families and five personas, with aligned forget/retain sets, held-out instruction paraphrases, and four-axis evaluation. The benchmark shows that standard unlearning methods cannot reliably erase the target persona without sacrificing meaningful generation or general utility. We therefore propose PaCE, which compares target and desirable responses to the same questions to locate an internal behavior direction, then trains target-prompt states away from the target mode and toward the matched desirable response. Experiments show that PaCE consistently suppresses target personas with high response quality and useful counterpart behavior, at moderate utility cost. These results establish persona unlearning as a distinct behavior-level editing problem and a practical route toward persistent control of latent LLM response policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PaCE：通过对比同一问题下的目标人格回答与期望回答定位内部行为方向，再把目标提示下的隐状态推离目标模式、靠近期望响应，从而在权重层面实现人格遗忘 (persona unlearning)。在覆盖 3 个模型家族 6 个 LLM、5 种人格的 PersonaUnlearnBench 上，PaCE 一致压制目标人格且保持较高回答质量与对应行为，效用代价中等。
Motivation: 开放权重场景下运行时控制可被移除，post-training 只教会模型默认扮演 Assistant 而未从权重中抹除替代人格，显式提示即可反复唤起影响判断与行为的人格，需要权重级的持久遗忘手段。
Method: 提出 PaCE：对同一问题比较目标回答与期望回答以定位内部行为方向，再训练目标提示状态远离目标模式、靠近期望响应；配套提出模型专属配对基准 PersonaUnlearnBench，含对齐的 forget/retain 集、held-out 指令改写与四轴评测。
Result: PersonaUnlearnBench 覆盖 3 个家族共 6 个 LLM、5 种人格；评测显示标准遗忘方法无法在不牺牲有意义生成或总体效用的前提下可靠抹除目标人格，而 PaCE 一致压制目标人格、保持高回答质量与有用对应行为，效用代价中等。
Conclusion: 人格遗忘是一个独立的行为级编辑问题，PaCE 提供了在开放权重模型上持久控制潜在响应策略的可行路径，但需接受中等程度的效用损失。

papers.title: Pretext: Defeating Malicious Skill Detection Frameworks for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Skills extend an agent's capabilities by injecting instructions and information into the context, and are widely used by agents such as OpenClaw and Claude Code. Prior work shows third-party marketplaces host malicious skills that give attackers direct influence over the victim's agent. The emerging defense scans skills before installation, pairing deterministic static checks with an LLM-based semantic judge, as in NVIDIA's SkillSpector. We show that such defenses fall to an attacker who knows the detector. Our white-box LLM attacker, Pretext, iteratively crafts skills that evade detection while still delivering the payload and performing the benign task: moving the payload from code into natural language leaves static analysis inert, while framing it as the skill's legitimate purpose and splitting instructions across files keeps the LLM stage below its blocking threshold. Across three open-source models, Pretext achieves up to 97\% and 77\% against a frozen detector and a co-adaptive one, respectively, revealing major gaps in current skill scanners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pretext 是一个白盒 LLM 攻击者，针对 SkillSpector 一类「静态检查 + LLM 语义裁判」的技能扫描器迭代生成既能绕过检测、又能完成恶意载荷与正常任务的 skill。把载荷从代码搬进自然语言使静态分析失效，把指令伪装成 skill 的正当用途并跨文件拆分则让 LLM 阶段低于拦截阈值；在三个开源模型上，对冻结检测器最高 97%、对协同适应检测器最高 77% 成功。
Motivation: 第三方 skill 市场已被证明存在恶意技能，安装前扫描是新兴防线；但若攻击者知道检测器，静态与语义两阶段是否仍可靠尚不清楚。
Method: 白盒 LLM 攻击者 Pretext 对检测器迭代优化生成的 skill：将载荷从代码改写为自然语言以绕过确定性静态检查，再把恶意指令框定为 skill 的合法用途并跨多个文件拆分，使 LLM 语义裁判的评分低于其拦截阈值，同时保留载荷执行与正常任务完成。
Result: 在三个开源模型上，Pretext 对冻结 (frozen) 检测器最高达到 97% 成功率，对协同适应 (co-adaptive) 检测器最高达到 77%。
Conclusion: 只要攻击者知道检测器，现有「静态 + LLM 语义」技能扫描框架存在重大缺口，检测器需按对抗自适应攻击者重新设计。

papers.title: Structural Limits of the Information-Theoretic Uncertainty Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty estimation in machine learning typically decomposes uncertainty into aleatoric uncertainty (AU) and epistemic uncertainty (EU) using the standard information-theoretic framework. However, in practice, two critical issues arise: entanglement (AU and EU are highly correlated) and epistemic collapse (EU magnitude shrinks with increasing model capacity). We analyze this framework on a functional level and discover that significant portions of the assumed AU, EU range are infeasible in finite settings, and cannot be attained with any class probabilities. We characterize how this infeasible region scales with the number of classes and Monte Carlo samples $N$ (e.g., from ensembles with $N$ members), revealing it is bounded by $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$. Crucially, the infeasible region's boundary helps explain epistemic collapse: when model confidence is high, $\text{AU} > \text{EU}$ is guaranteed by this fundamental structural limitation. Our findings show that increasing ensemble size mitigates epistemic collapse by reducing the infeasible area. Lastly, we caution against interpreting AU and EU as independent quantities in low AU regimes, since we show they are coupled when $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在标准信息论不确定性分解中，有限 Monte Carlo 样本数 N 下 AU 与 EU 的可实现区域存在结构性不可行区，其边界为 AU ≤ log(2)/N。模型置信度高时该限制保证 AU > EU，从而解释 epistemic collapse；增大 ensemble 规模 N 会缩小不可行区、缓解 collapse，而在 AU ≤ log(2)/N 的低 AU 区不应把 AU 与 EU 当作独立量解读。
Motivation: 标准 AU/EU 分解在实践中出现 entanglement（两者高度相关）与 epistemic collapse（EU 随模型容量增大而收缩），作者要在功能层面找出这一框架本身的结构性成因。
Method: 在功能层面分析标准信息论 AU/EU 分解，刻画有限设定下不可实现的 AU–EU 区域如何随类别数与 Monte Carlo 样本数 N（如 N 成员 ensemble）变化，并据此推导 AU 与 EU 的耦合条件。
Result: 不可行区由 AU ≤ log(2)/N 界定；模型置信度高时 AU > EU 被该结构性限制保证；增大 ensemble 规模 N 通过缩小不可行面积缓解 epistemic collapse；当 AU ≤ log(2)/N 时 AU 与 EU 耦合而非独立。
Conclusion: epistemic collapse 与 AU/EU 纠缠部分源于分解自身的有限样本结构限制，因此低 AU 区不应把两者当作独立量解读，增大 ensemble 规模是缓解 collapse 的直接手段。

summary_sections.conclusion: epistemic collapse 与 AU/EU 纠缠部分源于分解自身的有限样本结构限制，因此低 AU 区不应把两者当作独立量解读，增大 ensemble 规模是缓解 collapse 的直接手段。

papers.title: Growing an Agent/Prover Interface: Evolutionary Tool Design for Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving in Rocq and Lean
papers.abstract_en: Recent achievements in AI-assisted mathematics require intensive interaction of agents with proof assistants to generate machine-checked proof certificates. Agents interact with proof assistants such as Rocq or Lean through an interface that controls what the agent receives from the prover and the cost of these interactions. Today, these interfaces are adapted from tools designed for humans and not optimized for agents. We propose an evolutionary method where a frontier model incrementally proposes new features and only keeps the ones that improve the overall performance of smaller models. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by growing, on a curated set of mathematical problems, ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE, a new MCP server for the Rocq prover. On the held-out test split of miniF2F-Rocq, an agent equipped with ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE outperforms both the baseline that only exposes the Rocq compiler and an established MCP server, across four models from two families, in success rate, cost per solve, and time per solve. Although evolved for Rocq, the resulting server transfers to Lean, improving cost and time per solve on a subset of PutnamBench. We release ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE and its port to Lean.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出进化式工具设计方法：由前沿模型增量提出 MCP server 新功能，只保留能让小模型整体性能提升的改动，据此在精选数学问题集上生长出 ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE。在 miniF2F-Rocq 留出测试集上，配备该 server 的 agent 在成功率、单题成本、单题耗时三项指标上同时超过仅暴露 Rocq 编译器的基线和既有 MCP server，覆盖两个模型家族共四个模型；该 server 还可迁移到 Lean，在 PutnamBench 子集上降低单题成本与耗时。
Motivation: AI 辅助数学需要 agent 与 Rocq、Lean 等证明器高频交互以产出机器校验证书，但现有交互接口是为人类设计的，未针对 agent 的成本与信息需求优化。
Method: 进化式方法：前沿模型增量提出接口新功能，逐个筛选只保留能提升较小模型整体性能的改动，最终生长出面向 Rocq prover 的 MCP server ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE；在精选数学问题集上进行，并在留出测试集上检验。
Result: 在 miniF2F-Rocq 留出测试集上，ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE 使 agent 在成功率、cost per solve、time per solve 三项上均优于仅暴露 Rocq 编译器的基线和一个既有 MCP server，且在两个模型家族的四个模型上一致成立；迁移到 Lean 后在 PutnamBench 子集上降低 cost per solve 与 time per solve。
Conclusion: 面向 agent 而非人类设计证明器交互接口能同时改善成功率与成本效率，且这种进化出的接口设计可跨证明器（Rocq 到 Lean）迁移；作者已发布 ROCQ-MCP-EVOLVE 及其 Lean 移植。

papers.title: Beyond the Remembered World: Predictive 4D Belief for Persistent Navigation in Evolving Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Persistent spatial memory enables embodied agents to navigate familiar environments across repeated visits. However, targets may move while unobserved, including during navigation, making remembered locations unreliable by the time an agent arrives. Despite advances in memory retrieval and state prediction, accounting for continued hidden world evolution and revising beliefs under limited visibility remain challenging. We study Evolving-World Navigation, where agents infer target locations from intermittent observations, predict their states at inspection time, and revise beliefs using visual evidence. We propose EvolvingNav, which constructs a time-indexed belief from timestamped 3D object histories through a structured persistence-relocation model. The belief distinguishes persistence at the last observed location from relocation to alternative locations and retains probability mass outside the known candidate set. An event-driven filter propagates the current belief as time elapses, forecasts target occupancy at candidate inspection times, and incorporates new RGB-D evidence. Negative observations downweight location hypotheses according to calibrated, visibility-conditioned detection probabilities, while evidence tracking prevents repeated use of the same observations. A frozen, zero-shot vision-language controller uses the updated belief to choose actions and replan. We further introduce EvoWorld-Bench, a benchmark grounded in human activity traces, comprising 54 scenes and 803,680 tasks with controlled changes before and during navigation. In simulation and real-robot experiments, EvolvingNav improves navigation success and search efficiency over the evaluated baselines. Paired experiments show the clearest gains under learnable temporal patterns, while ablations demonstrate the value of preserving uncertainty and incorporating visibility-aware evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvolvingNav 为持续导航构建时间索引的 4D belief：由带时间戳的 3D 物体历史经 persistence-relocation 模型区分原地留存与迁移，并在已知候选集之外保留概率质量；事件驱动滤波随时间传播信念、按可见性标定的检测概率下调负观测权重，再交给冻结的零样本视觉-语言控制器执行。在 EvoWorld-Bench（54 个场景、803,680 个任务）仿真与真机实验中，其导航成功率与搜索效率优于所评测基线，且在可学习时间模式下增益最明显。
Motivation: 目标在未被观测期间会移动，记忆中的位置到到达时已不可靠；现有记忆检索与状态预测难以刻画世界的持续隐性演化，也不便在有限可见性下修正信念。
Method: 由带时间戳的 3D 物体历史经结构化 persistence-relocation 模型构建时间索引 belief，区分原地留存与向备选位置迁移并在候选集外保留概率质量；事件驱动滤波随时间传播信念、在候选检查时刻预测目标占据，并用可见性条件化的标定检测概率下调负观测，配合证据追踪避免重复使用同一观测；冻结的零样本 VLM 控制器据更新后的 belief 选动作并重规划。
Result: 在仿真与真机实验中，EvolvingNav 相对所评测基线提升导航成功率与搜索效率；配对实验显示在可学习时间模式下增益最清晰，消融表明保留不确定性与纳入可见性感知证据均有贡献。基准 EvoWorld-Bench 含 54 个场景、803,680 个任务，覆盖导航前与导航中的受控变化。
Conclusion: 把隐性世界演化显式建模为可随时间传播、可被负观测修正的 belief，并保留候选集之外的不确定性，能在目标移动的持续导航中取得更可靠的成功率与搜索效率。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Hear the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent joint video-audio generation models have achieved strong semantic correspondence and temporal synchronization. However, applications such as AR/VR and interactive gaming further require stereo audio to provide an immersive sense, which remains largely overlooked. Effective stereo audio requires the perceived sound location to evolve consistently with the motion of its corresponding visual source. We refer to this property as Dynamic Spatial Correspondence and propose StereoBind, a framework that binds visual source motion to stereo sound generation. StereoBind uses motion tracks to coordinate visual motion and stereo audio through three complementary mechanisms. Visual Motion Binding establishes source-aware audiovisual correspondence, the Spatial Track Encoder captures absolute source positions, and Residual Track RoPE models relative motion. For supervision and evaluation, we construct StereoWorld-29K, a large-scale stereo audio-video dataset with paired motion tracks, and StereoWorldBench for measuring audiovisual spatial consistency. Experiments show that StereoBind substantially improves spatial alignment in stereo audio generation over existing models while preserving overall audiovisual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StereoBind 把视觉源的运动轨迹绑定到立体声生成，用 Visual Motion Binding 建立源感知的音画对应、Spatial Track Encoder 编码绝对位置、Residual Track RoPE 建模相对运动，使声源听感位置随画面中物体运动一致变化。配套构建 StereoWorld-29K 数据集与 StereoWorldBench 评测，实验显示其在保持整体音画质量的同时显著优于现有模型的空间对齐。
Motivation: 联合视频-音频生成已解决语义对应与时间同步，但 AR/VR 与交互游戏需要的立体声沉浸感被忽视：声源的感知位置必须随其视觉源运动一致演化，现有模型做不到。
Method: 提出 StereoBind 框架，用运动轨迹协调视觉运动与立体声，含三个互补机制——Visual Motion Binding 建立源感知音画对应、Spatial Track Encoder 捕获源的绝对位置、Residual Track RoPE 建模相对运动；并构建带配对运动轨迹的大规模立体音视频数据集 StereoWorld-29K 与评测基准 StereoWorldBench。
Result: 实验表明 StereoBind 在立体声生成的空间对齐上显著优于现有模型，同时保持整体音画质量；评测在 StereoWorldBench 上进行，训练/数据规模为 StereoWorld-29K。
Conclusion: 把视觉源运动显式绑定进立体声生成是解决动态空间对应 (Dynamic Spatial Correspondence) 的有效路径，绝对位置与相对运动需分别建模。

papers.title: Parameter-Free Zeroth-Order Optimization with Ellipsoidal Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order optimization methods are essential for solving black-box problems where gradient information is unavailable or expensive to compute. This paper presents POEM-ES, a novel parameter-free stochastic zeroth-order algorithm that extends the recent POEM method by integrating subspace preconditioning with ellipsoidal randomized sampling. In contrast to traditional zeroth-order approaches that rely on isotropic random directions, POEM-ES performs anisotropic sampling guided by a fixed structural symmetric positive semi-definite (SPSD) preconditioner $\hatΣ$ that encodes the underlying low-dimensional geometry. Under a standard structural spectral normalization where $λ_{\max}(\hatΣ) = 1$, we introduce the use of the empirical effective dimension $d^* = \operatorname{tr}(\hatΣ)$, which reflects the intrinsic dimensionality of the problem and guides both the sampling and randomized smoothing parameter schedules. In practice, such a preconditioner can be effectively obtained via pilot sampling, historical trajectories, or domain-specific expert knowledge. We prove that POEM-ES achieves a dimension-reduced convergence rate under low-rank structural assumptions, requiring only $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left( \frac{\left( r^2 κ(\hatΣ) + d^* \right) L^2 D_{\mathcal{X}}^2}{\varepsilon^2} \right)$ stochastic zeroth-order oracle queries. The method remains fully parameter-free and demonstrates significant improvements over the original POEM in problems with low-rank structure where $d^* \ll d$. Numerical experiments on hinge-loss binary classification tasks using LibSVM datasets confirm the practical superiority of the proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出参数无关的随机零阶优化算法 POEM-ES：用固定 SPSD 预条件器 hatΣ 做椭球各向异性采样，并以经验有效维数 d* = tr(hatΣ) 同时驱动采样与随机平滑参数调度。在低秩结构假设下证明维数约减收敛率 Õ((r²κ(hatΣ)+d*)L²D_X²/ε²) 次零阶 oracle 查询，当 d* ≪ d 时显著优于原 POEM。
Motivation: 传统零阶优化用各向同性随机方向采样，在目标具有低秩结构时浪费查询预算，收敛率只随环境维数 d 而不随内在维数增长。
Method: POEM-ES 在 POEM 基础上结合子空间预条件与椭球随机采样：固定结构 SPSD 预条件器 hatΣ（可由 pilot sampling、历史轨迹或领域先验得到）编码低维几何，谱归一化取 λ_max(hatΣ)=1，经验有效维数 d* = tr(hatΣ) 指导采样与随机平滑参数调度，算法本身无需调参。
Result: 低秩结构假设下证明维数约减收敛率，随机零阶 oracle 查询复杂度为 Õ((r²κ(hatΣ)+d*)L²D_X²/ε²)；在 d* ≪ d 的低秩问题上相对原 POEM 有显著改进，并在 LibSVM 数据集的 hinge-loss 二分类任务上数值实验确认其实际优势。
Conclusion: 把椭球采样与有效维数 d* 引入零阶随机优化，可在保持参数无关的同时把查询复杂度从环境维数降到内在维数，前提是低秩结构预条件器可得。

papers.title: CompOrca: Corpus-Scale Compliance Labelling of Instruction-Tuning Data
papers.abstract_en: Studying how fine-tuning shapes refusal and noncompliance behaviour requires knowing which training examples refuse or otherwise fail to fulfil the request. Existing annotations cover evaluation sets, which are far smaller than training corpora. We present CompOrca, compliance labels for all 4,233,923 examples of the OpenOrca corpus. Every example was classified as compliant or noncompliant by five passes of an open-weight LLM judge (LongCat-2.0, 1.6T parameters). The corpus is released as unanimous compliance (94.75%), unanimous noncompliance (1.28%), and nonunanimous rows (3.97%), with the raw vote counts. A single pass flags 2.7-3.2% of the corpus as noncompliant, while only 1.28% is flagged by all five, so the most ambiguous rows can be filtered out. Against 450 human-annotated examples (150 annotated twice; human-human $κ=0.93$), the unanimous compliance and noncompliance labels are 97.3% and 86.7% precise. The noncompliance label is a high-precision subset of the corpus's noncompliance. Published refusal-detection methods recall between 0.4% and 94.1% of human-labelled noncompliance. We release the full corpus with its per-row labels and vote counts at https://huggingface.co/datasets/cemiu/CompOrca
papers.comment: Accepted to PlurVA-LLM Workshop @ AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Dataset available on HuggingFace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompOrca 为 OpenOrca 全部 4,233,923 条指令微调样本打上合规/不合规标签：用开源权重 LLM 判官 LongCat-2.0（1.6T 参数）五次投票，按一致性分层发布。全票合规占 94.75%、全票不合规 1.28%、非全票 3.97%；单次判官只标出 2.7–3.2% 不合规，五票全票可滤掉最歧义样本。
Motivation: 研究微调如何塑造拒绝与不合规行为，需要知道每条训练样本是否拒绝或未完成请求，但现有标注只覆盖远小于训练语料的评测集。
Method: 对 OpenOrca 全语料每条样本跑五遍开源权重 LLM 判官 LongCat-2.0（1.6T 参数）做合规/不合规二分类，按五票一致性分三档（全票合规、全票不合规、非全票）连同原始票数发布；用 450 条人工标注样本（其中 150 条标两次，human-human κ=0.93）核验精度。
Result: 全语料 4,233,923 条中全票合规 94.75%、全票不合规 1.28%、非全票 3.97%；单次判官标出 2.7–3.2% 不合规，五票全票仅 1.28%。对 450 条人工标注，全票合规与全票不合规标签精度分别为 97.3% 与 86.7%；已发表的拒绝检测方法对人工标注不合规的召回率介于 0.4% 与 94.1% 之间。
Conclusion: 多票 LLM 判官加一致性分层能在语料规模上产出高精度合规标签，全票不合规是语料不合规的高精度子集，可按需过滤最歧义样本。
