papers.title: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tasks require LLM agents to continually draw on information from earlier interactions. However, retaining the full history increases context costs, while compressing it risks losing details needed later, and the relevance of historical information often becomes apparent as the task progresses. To address these challenges, we propose FlowState, which treats execution state as memory that can be retained and revisited across requests, unifying current decision-making with the reuse of historical information. FlowState preserves semantically typed state nodes, their relations, and references to raw tool observations, separating persistent retention from on-demand access. Within a single execution loop, Incremental State Update (ISU) maintains the current state based on new inputs and feedback, while Progressive State Access (PSA) progressively reveals historical states and supporting evidence as needed during reasoning. Together, these mechanisms enable agents to reassess prior decisions in light of new information and guide subsequent actions. Compared with a full-context baseline using the same DeepSeek-V4-Flash model, FlowState improves the average success rate on MemoryArena and the average pass rate on $τ^3$-Bench by 4.55 and 13.95 percentage points, respectively, while reducing total token consumption by 43.2% and 40.6%. These results demonstrate the performance and efficiency advantages of FlowState on long-horizon tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowState 把 LLM agent 的执行状态本身当作跨请求可保留、可回访的记忆：语义类型化状态节点连同其关系与对原始工具观测的引用被持久保存，推理时按需渐进取用。相比使用同一 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的全上下文基线，MemoryArena 平均成功率提升 4.55 个百分点、τ³-Bench 平均通过率提升 13.95 个百分点，同时总 token 消耗分别下降 43.2% 与 40.6%。
Motivation: 长程任务要求 agent 持续调用早期交互信息：保留全部历史推高上下文成本，压缩又会丢掉后续才用得上的细节，而历史信息的相关性往往随任务推进才显现。
Method: 将执行状态建模为可跨请求保留与回访的记忆，保存语义类型化状态节点、节点间关系以及指向原始工具观测的引用，把持久保留与按需访问分离。单个执行循环内由 Incremental State Update (ISU) 依据新输入与反馈维护当前状态，Progressive State Access (PSA) 在推理中按需逐步揭示历史状态与支撑证据。
Result: 与使用同一 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 模型的全上下文基线相比，FlowState 使 MemoryArena 平均成功率提高 4.55 个百分点，τ³-Bench 平均通过率提高 13.95 个百分点，总 token 消耗分别减少 43.2% 和 40.6%。
Conclusion: 把执行状态当作记忆并按需取用，能在长程任务上同时取得性能与效率优势：成功率、通过率上升而 token 消耗大幅下降。

papers.title: WorldWeave: Growing Persistent Geometric Worlds for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress, world models still lack explicit, persistent structural memory, making it difficult to preserve consistent world structure during continual scene expansion and cross-view revisits. To address this limitation, we present WorldWeave, a world generation framework that decouples world-state maintenance from visual rendering. Specifically, WorldWeave combines continual elevation-map generation with agent-guided scene organization and stitching to build an expandable explicit 3D world that incrementally extends structural memory while preserving existing structure. First, its terrain module uses diffusion-based image outpainting to generate continuous metric elevation maps under neighborhood conditioning and boundary constraints. Next, an agent integrates user intent, terrain evidence, and cross-region connectivity constraints to construct scenes through hierarchical semantic planning, deterministic geometry compilation, and local revision. Finally, during visual generation, planned camera trajectories query world geometry through a read-only interface, producing depth sequences that guide video synthesis without writing the generated results back into the world state. As a result, structural memory remains independent of short-window video generation, enabling continual expansion without predefined map boundaries and providing a consistent geometric basis for observations across trajectories and repeated visits.
papers.comment: Project page: https://laiyindagm.github.io/WorldWeave/ . Code repository: https://github.com/laiyindagm/WorldWeave (implementation coming soon)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldWeave 把世界状态维护与视觉渲染解耦：用扩散式图像外推持续生成带邻域条件与边界约束的度量高程图，由 agent 做层级语义规划与确定性几何编译，渲染时相机轨迹只读查询几何得到深度序列引导视频合成，生成结果不回写世界状态。由此结构记忆与短窗口视频生成相互独立，可在无预设地图边界下持续扩张并在跨视角重访时保持一致几何。
Motivation: 现有世界模型缺少显式、持久的结构记忆，连续场景扩张与跨视角重访时难以保持一致的世界结构。
Method: 三层管线：地形模块用 diffusion-based image outpainting 在邻域条件与边界约束下生成连续度量高程图；agent 整合用户意图、地形证据与跨区域连通约束，做层级语义规划、确定性几何编译与局部修订；视觉生成阶段规划好的相机轨迹经只读接口查询世界几何，产出深度序列引导视频合成，不回写世界状态。
Result: 产出一个可扩张的显式 3D 世界框架，结构记忆独立于短窗口视频生成，支持无预设地图边界的持续扩张，并为跨轨迹与重复访问的观测提供一致几何基准。
Conclusion: 把世界状态与渲染解耦、以只读几何接口约束视频生成，是维持持久结构记忆并允许持续场景扩张的可行设计路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Efficient Reasoning via Constrained Optimization in Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet they still suffer from overthinking, generating redundant reasoning steps which incur substantial token consumption. Existing methods, such as suppressing reflective keywords or forcing shorter reasoning lengths, attempt to mitigate this issue but inevitably truncate necessary steps and induce underthinking, thereby compromising performance. To address this dilemma, we investigate the latent representations and observe that efficient reasoning steps naturally cluster into a concentrated region in latent space, while those deviating from this region tend to produce verbose sequences. To leverage this, we keep reasoning focused within this region via a quadratic program which projects deviating hidden states back into the region. Then we propose a novel training-free framework to achieve efficient reasoning that reduces token generation costs without sacrificing performance. Extensive experiments conducted on four models ranging from 1.5B to 14B, and across six benchmarks in math reasoning, coding, and scientific QA, validate the effectiveness of our method, up to a 12.1\% improvement in accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 11.8\% to 52.8\%. Codes are available at \href{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对大推理模型 (LRM) 的过度思考，提出训练无关的潜在空间约束优化：把偏离高效推理聚集区的隐状态用二次规划 (quadratic program) 投影回该区域，从而在减少 token 生成的同时不牺牲性能。在 1.5B–14B 共四个模型、数学/代码/科学 QA 六个基准上，准确率最高提升 12.1%，生成 token 减少 11.8% 至 52.8%。
Motivation: LRM 存在过度思考，生成冗余推理步骤带来大量 token 开销；而压制反思关键词或强制缩短长度等现有方法会截断必要步骤，转为 underthinking 并损害性能。
Method: 先观察到高效推理步骤在潜在空间中聚集于一个集中区域，偏离该区域的隐状态倾向产生冗余序列；训练时无关的框架用二次规划把偏离的隐状态投影回该区域，使推理保持聚焦。
Result: 在四个模型（1.5B 到 14B）与六个覆盖数学推理、代码、科学 QA 的基准上验证：准确率最高提升 12.1%，同时生成 token 减少 11.8% 到 52.8%。
Conclusion: 过度思考与 underthinking 的取舍可以在潜在空间用约束优化解决：把隐状态限制在高效推理聚集区内，即可同时降 token 成本并保住甚至提高准确率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Budgeted Cache Repair for Cross-Context KV-Cache Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Cross-context KV-cache reuse predicts a shared segment's keys and values under a new prefix instead of recomputing them, and has been reported to do so without quality loss. We find otherwise, and identify two problems. (1) A hidden cost: on MMLU and GSM8K, reuse costs substantial accuracy. (2) A decision at the wrong unit: no rule for deciding whether to reuse a cache removes that cost. What does help is choosing which parts of the cache to recompute, and the value of choosing well falls as the unit of choice grows: informed selection removes 49.5% of the cache error beyond chance at single rows (one token's keys and values), 10.6% at 64-token chunks, and nothing at the level of whole calls. Budgeted Cache Repair (BCR) acts at the unit where selection still pays. It drafts two tokens from the assembled cache, ranks cache rows by the attention those tokens pay them, and recomputes a fixed budget of rows exactly, in one of three layouts. The cost is paid rather than predicted away, and the draft that fails as a gate succeeds as a selector. BCR restores GSM8K to dense-prefill accuracy while still serving most calls from cache, and its best layout outperforms every reuse baseline's mean in the reference grid. The draft also beats a coin-flip selector at the same budget - a control prior evaluations lack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨上下文 KV-cache 复用在 MMLU 与 GSM8K 上实际损失精度，且按整次调用决定复用与否无法消除该代价。选择粒度越细价值越大：单行（一个 token 的 K/V）可消除超出随机的 49.5% 缓存误差，64-token 块仅 10.6%，整次调用层面为零。BCR 在行级起草两个 token、按其注意力给缓存行排序、在固定预算内精确重算，把 GSM8K 恢复到 dense-prefill 精度，同时多数调用仍由缓存服务。
Motivation: 跨上下文 KV-cache 复用被报告可在不损失质量的前提下预测共享段的 K/V，但作者发现它在 MMLU 和 GSM8K 上代价可观，且以整次调用为单位的复用决策规则无法消除这一代价。
Method: Budgeted Cache Repair (BCR)：从拼装好的缓存起草两个 token，按这两个 token 对各行的注意力给缓存行排序，在固定预算内精确重算选中的行，支持三种布局；起草结果既作门控失败也可作选择器成功。
Result: 在 MMLU 与 GSM8K 上复用带来可观精度损失；知情选择在单行粒度消除超出随机 49.5% 的缓存误差，64-token 块粒度为 10.6%，整次调用粒度为零。BCR 把 GSM8K 恢复到 dense-prefill 精度，同时多数调用仍由缓存服务；其最佳布局在参考网格中超过所有复用基线的均值，且同预算下起草选择器胜过掷硬币选择器。
Conclusion: 复用的代价要靠选择重算哪些缓存行来偿还，而不是靠决定是否复用；选择的收益随决策单元变大而消失，因此 BCR 固定在仍有收益的行级单元上操作。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 复用的代价要靠选择重算哪些缓存行来偿还，而不是靠决定是否复用；选择的收益随决策单元变大而消失，因此 BCR 固定在仍有收益的行级单元上操作。

papers.title: MA-JEPA: Joint-Embedding World Models for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: World models improve sample efficiency by training policies on imagined trajectories, but their usefulness depends on learning representations that capture the information needed for future control. We study whether self-supervised joint-embedding prediction (JEPA) can provide this learning signal for multi-agent reinforcement learning. We introduce MA-JEPA, a stochastic world model that replaces observation reconstruction with prediction of target representations, enabling model-based multi-agent reinforcement learning with centralized training and decentralized execution. A categorical latent state and a causal Transformer are trained with posterior and action-conditioned dynamics prediction objectives and are then used for actor-critic learning from latent imagination. A training-only joint predictor conditions on all agents' local states and actions to predict each agent's next local observation embedding. These predictions are passed through the same local posterior used during real interaction with a centralized critic that is used only for value learning, with execution remaining decentralized. Our experiments show that this architecture performs strongly on SMAC, matching or exceeding the strongest reported comparator mean win rate on four of eight evaluated maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MA-JEPA 用自监督 joint-embedding 预测替代观测重建，构建支持中心化训练、去中心化执行 (CTDE) 的多智能体世界模型：类别隐状态加因果 Transformer 学后验与动作条件动力学，再从隐想象做 actor-critic。在 SMAC 八张地图中四张匹配或超过最强已报告对比方法的平均胜率。
Motivation: 世界模型的样本效率取决于表征是否保留控制所需信息，而观测重建目标未必对齐这一需求；多智能体场景还需在去中心化执行下学习可用的隐动力学。
Method: MA-JEPA 以目标表征预测取代观测重建：类别隐状态 (categorical latent state) 与因果 Transformer 联合训练后验预测和动作条件动力学预测目标，随后在隐想象 (latent imagination) 上做 actor-critic。训练期的 joint predictor 读入所有智能体的局部状态与动作，预测各智能体下一局部观测嵌入，再送入与真实交互相同的局部后验；中心化 critic 仅用于价值学习，执行保持去中心化。
Result: 在 SMAC 上评测，八张地图中有四张匹配或超过最强已报告对比方法的平均胜率 (mean win rate)。
Conclusion: 以 joint-embedding 预测作为多智能体世界模型的学习信号，可在 CTDE 框架下支撑有竞争力的模型基多智能体 RL，且执行端无需中心化信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SMAT: Simple and Efficient Merge-Aware Training
papers.abstract_en: Model merging integrates the capabilities of multiple experts without joint retraining, but standard expert training optimizes task loss alone and does not guarantee good performance after merging. Merge-aware training (MAT) aims to improve merged performance, but existing methods do not fully account for common merging operations and add training cost. We observe that, from an expert's perspective, common merging methods can be described by three operations: Scale reweights its own update, Mask removes selected coordinates, and Perturb adds updates from other experts. Based on this view, we introduce SMAT (Simple MAT), which jointly optimizes expert loss and expected loss at simulated merged parameters generated by sampling scaling coefficients, masks, and additive noise. We further introduce periodic scheduling, kernel fusion, and parameter storage switching to make SMAT efficient, with one forward and one backward pass per step. Across four language and vision-language backbones, SMAT improves the mean score across five merging methods by 1.07-2.16 points over the strongest baseline for each backbone, with less than 2% training-time overhead over standard fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMAT 把常见模型合并算子统一成专家视角下的三种操作——Scale 重缩放自身更新、Mask 删坐标、Perturb 叠加他人更新——训练时同时优化专家损失与在采样缩放系数、掩码、加性噪声生成的合并参数上的期望损失。在四个语言与视觉语言 backbone 上，对五种合并方法的平均分相对各 backbone 最强基线提升 1.07–2.16 分，训练开销不到标准微调的 2%。
Motivation: 标准专家训练只优化任务损失，不保证合并后表现好；已有 merge-aware training 方法未充分覆盖常见合并操作，还额外增加训练成本。
Method: SMAT 将合并抽象为 Scale、Mask、Perturb 三类操作，联合优化专家损失与在采样得到的合并参数处的期望损失；用周期调度、kernel fusion 与参数存储切换实现每步一次前向一次反向。
Result: 在四个语言与视觉语言 backbone 上，SMAT 对五种合并方法的平均分相对每个 backbone 的最强基线提升 1.07–2.16 分，训练时间开销低于标准微调的 2%。
Conclusion: 把常见合并操作显式纳入训练目标，可以在几乎不增加训练成本的前提下提升合并后模型的平均表现。

papers.title: When to Evict, Not What to Keep: Draft-Guided Eviction for Training-Free KV-Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Training-free KV-cache compression methods such as SnapKV, H2O, and PyramidKV evict tokens at the end of prefill, aiming to preserve the attention mass that future queries are expected to use -optimizing what to keep. We show that this objective fails in two distinct ways. (1) Compensation: restoring the evicted attention mass can recover the attention-level target without recovering task quality. (2) Selection: covering more of the true decode-query mass can hurt quality when the recovered mass is fragmented rather than concentrated in coherent spans. These failures share a common cause: eviction occurs before the queries that determine the answer trajectory exist. We propose Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE), which defers eviction until after drafting the first k=2 answer tokens using the full cache - just one decode step beyond prefill. Because the draft is generated from the answer's own prefix, no cache entries are discarded before this trajectory signal becomes available. The per-head cache budget remains unchanged, and DGE can be applied directly to SnapKV, PyramidKV, H2O, and StreamingLLM without modifying their eviction scores. Unlike extra-pass methods, DGE changes when eviction occurs rather than what cache entries are selected. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGE outperforms prior methods at every evaluated budget on five of six instruct-tuned backbones, achieving 44.2 on LongBench, nearly matching FullKV at 44.3. The timing-only control DGE-W achieves the same score, demonstrating that the gain comes from when eviction occurs rather than what is selected - an effect we term trajectory anchoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练无关的 KV-cache 压缩在 prefill 末尾就驱逐 token，此时决定答案轨迹的 query 尚不存在。Draft-Guided Eviction (DGE) 把驱逐推迟到用完整 cache 起草前 k=2 个答案 token 之后，只改时机不改打分；在六个 instruct-tuned backbone 中的五个上、各评测预算下超过既有方法，LongBench 达 44.2，几乎追平 FullKV 的 44.3。
Motivation: SnapKV、H2O、PyramidKV 等方法在 prefill 结束时优化“保留什么”，但摘要指出两类失败：恢复被驱逐的注意力质量可在注意力层面达标却恢复不了任务质量；覆盖更多真实 decode-query 质量在碎片化而非连贯片段时反而降低质量。
Method: DGE 在 prefill 后先用完整 cache 起草前 k=2 个答案 token，使轨迹信号出现后再驱逐；每头 cache 预算不变，可直接套用到 SnapKV、PyramidKV、H2O、StreamingLLM 而不改其驱逐打分。对照组 DGE-W 只改驱逐时机，用于分离时机与选择的贡献。
Result: 在六个 instruct-tuned backbone 中的五个上，DGE 在每个评测预算下都优于既有方法；LongBench 得分 44.2，几乎追平 FullKV 的 44.3。仅改时机的 DGE-W 取得相同分数，说明增益来自驱逐时机而非选择内容。
Conclusion: 作者把该效应命名为 trajectory anchoring：KV-cache 压缩的关键变量是何时驱逐而非保留什么，把驱逐推迟一个 decode step 即可恢复接近 FullKV 的任务质量。

papers.title: READ-Bench: Benchmarking Historical Instance Retrieval for Time-Series Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Time-series diagnostic systems rarely rely on retrieving relevant historical cases, and when they do, retrieval is evaluated only indirectly through downstream prediction. We introduce READ-Bench, a benchmark for historical-case retrieval across 12 diagnostic datasets, centered on multivariate time series, that defines relevance by shared fault or event type rather than signal shape, so visually different traces of the same fault count as relevant while similar-looking traces of different faults do not. Treating retrieval as a base retriever followed by a reranker, we evaluate classical distances, symbolic retrievers, self-supervised and foundation-model embedders, and their fusion, plus label-aware and language-model rerankers, under one protocol that varies supervision, pollution, and corpus scale with significance testing. Under a common channel-independent interface, pretrained representations offer no statistically detectable advantage over strong classical and symbolic baselines for search alone. The decisive factor is a small amount of resolved-case supervision at reranking, namely a Gaussian-process reranker that propagates a few neighbor labels in embedding space, which helps far more than more sophisticated representations or language-model reasoning and holds under pollution and at full corpus scale. Guided by these findings, we fuse a normal-residual-scored embedder with a dynamic time warping leg via reciprocal-rank fusion, then rerank with the Gaussian-process reranker, improving NDCG@10 over its own search stage on all 12 datasets, by +0.11 from reranking and +0.16 over the strongest single base retriever.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: READ-Bench 是面向时间序列故障诊断的历史案例检索基准，覆盖 12 个诊断数据集，按共享故障/事件类型而非信号形状定义相关性。结论是：预训练表征在纯检索阶段相对经典与符号基线无可检测优势，决定性因素是重排阶段少量已解决案例监督——高斯过程重排器在嵌入空间传播少量邻居标签，使 NDCG@10 在全部 12 个数据集上提升 +0.11（相对自身检索阶段）、较最强单一基础检索器提升 +0.16。
Motivation: 时间序列诊断系统很少真正调用历史案例检索，即便使用也只通过下游预测间接评估检索质量，缺少按故障语义而非波形相似度定义相关性的专用基准。
Method: 将检索拆为基础检索器加重排器两级：基础侧评估经典距离、符号检索器、自监督与基础模型嵌入器及其融合；重排侧评估标签感知与语言模型重排器；统一协议在通道无关接口下变化监督量、污染与语料规模并做显著性检验。最终系统用正常残差打分的嵌入器与动态时间规整 (DTW) 分支做倒数排名融合 (reciprocal-rank fusion)，再接高斯过程重排器。
Result: 在 12 个诊断数据集上，纯检索阶段预训练表征相对强经典与符号基线无可统计检测的优势；高斯过程重排器（传播少量邻居标签）带来的提升超过更复杂表征与语言模型推理，且在污染与全语料规模下保持。最终融合系统 NDCG@10 在全部 12 个数据集上均高于自身检索阶段：重排贡献 +0.11，较最强单一基础检索器提升 +0.16。
Conclusion: 历史案例检索的瓶颈不在更强的表示或语言模型推理，而在重排阶段少量已解决案例的监督；据此的实践建议是把预算投给高斯过程标签传播式重排，而非升级嵌入器。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Evaluating Budgeted Context Projection with Unexecuted Companion Runs
papers.abstract_en: Context projection can shorten individual requests while changing whether an agent finishes within its budget. We examine how sequential evaluation obscures this trade-off when a capped first continuation prevents its companion from running. In a recorded ReVerPi source-reading campaign, 15 pairs with two final answers yield 12 historically scored successes per arm. Retaining all 27 intervention boundaries distinguishes observed failures from ten unexecuted companions and bounds projected-minus-full success between $-9$ and $+1$ tasks. Under the archived scoring contract, a frozen projection selector has a success difference from full context of $[-3,0]$; outside four fitting tasks, it is $[-4,-1]$ across 23 boundaries. Excluding one task whose platform premise is not established by retained actor-input evidence changes the nonfitting range to $[-3,0]$ across 22 boundaries, so strict inferiority is not robust to that exclusion. Among eleven historically joint-success pairs, projection uses 25% fewer aggregate logical tokens but more tokens for the median pair and 55 rather than 35 suffix requests. These retrospective results concern one adaptively assembled campaign, not population performance. The case motivates accounting that retains every boundary, preserves unknown outcomes and policy dependencies, checks task premises, and separates bounded completion from success-conditioned resource use.
papers.comment: 23 pages. Revised analysis and presentation; expanded sensitivity analyses and offline reproducibility materials. Project code: https://github.com/timwhitez/ReVer_Pi. Source archive includes ancillary data and offline reanalysis scripts
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ReVerPi 源码阅读活动中检验 context projection 的预算权衡：顺序评估会因首个 continuation 被截断而掩盖 companion 未执行的失败。保留全部 27 个干预边界后，投影相对全上下文的成功差被界定在 -9 到 +1 之间；冻结选择器在归档评分契约下为 [-3,0]，排除 4 个拟合任务后为 [-4,-1]（23 个边界），再排除 1 个平台前提未确立的任务后变为 [-3,0]（22 个边界），说明严格劣于并不稳健。
Motivation: 顺序评估在首个 continuation 被上限截断时不会运行其 companion，导致未执行的配对被当作已观测结果，掩盖 context projection 是否让 agent 在预算内完成任务的真实权衡。
Method: 在一次记录式的 ReVerPi 源码阅读活动中，对 15 对产生两个最终答案的配对保留全部 27 个干预边界，区分观测失败与 10 个未执行的 companion，并用冻结的 projection selector 在归档评分契约下界定投影减全上下文的成功差，同时做拟合任务与平台前提的敏感性排除。

papers.title: CCRV-Bench: Constraint-Based Evaluation of Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated excellent performance in visual tasks, but their visual causal reasoning capabilities still lack reliable evaluation. Existing evaluations struggle to distinguish whether a model is performing causal reasoning based on visual evidence or relying on statistical correlations for shortcut learning, thereby potentially overestimating their actual capabilities. This paper proposes CCRV-Bench, a constraint-driven visual causal reasoning benchmark for single-image physical scenarios. We construct an orthogonal framework that evaluates four causal task dimensions: causal relation discovery, state prediction, causal diagnosis, and intervention-outcome prediction. We further introduce entity symbolization, spatial grounding, the factual adversarial constraint, and minimalist output constraints to reduce shortcut cues while preserving the physical commonsense required by the task. Experiments across 14 multimodal models show that constraint sensitivity is task- and model-dependent: intervention-outcome prediction has the largest average effective degradation among the four causal tasks, spatial grounding is the most damaging constraint on average, and the factual adversarial constraint improves DCR for all evaluated models. These results show that unconstrained performance does not determine constrained robustness and that a single aggregate score can obscure distinct failures in causal identification, spatial grounding, and constraint-compliant expression. CCRV-Bench provides a standardized framework for diagnosing image-grounded causal reasoning under controlled constraints. The code is available at https://github.com/0815linyuan/CCRVBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CCRV-Bench 提出约束驱动的单图物理场景视觉因果推理基准，用实体符号化、空间落地、事实对抗约束和极简输出约束压掉捷径线索。在 14 个多模态模型上，约束敏感度随任务与模型而变：干预-结果预测的平均有效退化最大，空间落地约束平均破坏性最强，事实对抗约束对所有被测模型都提升 DCR。
Motivation: 现有视觉因果推理评测无法区分模型是在依据视觉证据做因果推理，还是靠统计相关性走捷径，从而高估 VLM 的真实能力。
Method: 构建正交框架评测四个因果任务维度：因果关系发现、状态预测、因果诊断、干预-结果预测；引入实体符号化 (entity symbolization)、空间落地 (spatial grounding)、事实对抗约束 (factual adversarial constraint) 与极简输出约束以减少捷径线索，同时保留任务所需物理常识。
Result: 在 14 个多模态模型上的实验显示约束敏感度呈任务与模型依赖：四类因果任务中干预-结果预测的平均有效退化最大，空间落地是平均破坏性最强的约束，事实对抗约束对全部被测模型均提升 DCR。
Conclusion: 无约束性能不能决定约束下的鲁棒性，单一综合分数会掩盖因果识别、空间落地与约束遵从表达这三类不同失败；CCRV-Bench 提供受控约束下诊断图像 grounding 因果推理的标准化框架。

papers.title: ExplorationBench: Measuring AI Systems' Exploration in Verifiable Alien Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery begins where known problems end. There, AI systems must engage in exploration: framing hypotheses, designing experiments, and iterating on the results. However, evaluating this ability is difficult: (1) how to verify whether a genuinely new hypothesis holds, and (2) how to determine whether a system has discovered it through exploration or merely recalled related knowledge from pre-training data. To this end, we introduce ExplorationBench, which turns the wicked problem of evaluating scientific exploration into a concrete and tractable framework built on verifiable Alien Worlds: their rules are executable, so every answer can be checked exactly, and they conflict with familiar knowledge, so recall alone cannot solve the tasks. The benchmark contains two sandboxes, AlienCode (31 discovery targets, 70 tasks) and AlienLogic (24 discovery targets, 70 tasks). Each sandbox provides a flawed manual, task-specific environmental feedback, and a dedicated tool-call schema. Systems use these resources to explore the sandbox, then solve held-out tasks. We evaluate 10 AI systems and find that the strongest systems can acquire and apply unfamiliar rules, while performance varies substantially across trajectories and continued exploration can stall or reverse earlier gains. ExplorationBench represents a step towards AI systems that can acquire and apply genuinely new knowledge through exploration in unknown environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ExplorationBench 用规则可执行、且与预训练常识冲突的 Alien Worlds 来度量 AI 的科学探索能力：含 AlienCode（31 个发现目标、70 个任务）与 AlienLogic（24 个发现目标、70 个任务）两个沙盒，各配一份有缺陷的手册、任务级环境反馈和专用 tool-call schema，系统靠探索学会规则再解 held-out 任务。评测 10 个 AI 系统，最强者能习得并应用陌生规则，但表现随轨迹大幅波动，持续探索可能停滞甚至回吐先前收益。
Motivation: 评估科学探索有两个卡点：一是无法验证一个真正新的假设是否成立，二是无法区分系统是靠探索发现的还是从预训练数据里回忆出来的。
Method: 构建两个可验证 Alien Worlds 沙盒 AlienCode 与 AlienLogic，规则可执行使答案可精确核验、且与熟悉知识冲突使纯回忆无法奏效；每个沙盒提供有缺陷的 manual、任务专属环境反馈和专用 tool-call schema，系统用这些资源探索后求解 held-out 任务，并对 10 个 AI 系统做评测。
Result: 基准含 AlienCode（31 个 discovery targets、70 个任务）与 AlienLogic（24 个 discovery targets、70 个任务）；对 10 个 AI 系统的评测显示最强系统能习得并应用不熟悉的规则，但成绩在不同轨迹间差异显著，持续探索可能停滞或反转先前的收益。
Conclusion: 可执行且反常识的合成世界能把科学探索变成可精确核验的评测对象；探索式习得新知识在当前系统上尚不稳定，收益可能随探索推进而丢失。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ELF-REG: Scaling Continuous Diffusion Language Models to Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Fully continuous diffusion language models (dLMs) denoise continuous representations without intermediate discretization, then decode all response tokens in parallel at the final step. Their performance on challenging reasoning tasks remains less established than that of autoregressive (AR) LLMs and masked dLMs. We scale Embedded Language Flows (ELF) to mathematical reasoning and code generation on GSM8K, MATH-500, HumanEval, and MBPP. We introduce ELF-REG, which improves learning with representation alignment and entanglement (REPA+REG), where a frozen AR teacher supervises intermediate denoiser features and supplies a global representation that is jointly denoised with the response. ELF-REG-L achieves 55.96% pass@1 on GSM8K at 64 network function evaluations (NFE), and 13.39% on MATH-500 and 22.56% on HumanEval at 128 NFE. It outperforms the evaluated comparable-scale dLMs in pass@1 on GSM8K and code, and improves MATH-500 pass@1 from 10.55% for the ELF-L baseline to 13.39% with ELF-REG-L. Without few-step training, the same task-specific checkpoints support strong low-NFE performance through early-stop, which decodes an intermediate clean prediction without completing the denoising trajectory. At 16 NFE, ELF-REG-L reaches 41.21% HumanEval pass@10, outperforming recent continuous dLMs of comparable scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Embedded Language Flows (ELF) 扩到数学与代码推理，用 REPA+REG（冻结 AR teacher 监督去噪器中间特征，并提供与响应联合去噪的全局表示）训练 ELF-REG-L。GSM8K pass@1 达 55.96%（64 NFE），MATH-500 13.39%、HumanEval 22.56%（128 NFE），且不加 few-step 训练即可靠 early-stop 在 16 NFE 拿到 HumanEval pass@10 41.21%。
Motivation: 全连续扩散语言模型 (dLM) 在中间不离散化、最后并行解码全部 token，但在数学推理与代码生成这类难任务上的表现仍不如自回归 (AR) LLM 与 masked dLM。
Method: 把 Embedded Language Flows (ELF) 扩到 GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval、MBPP；提出 REPA+REG：冻结的 AR teacher 监督去噪器中间层特征，并给出一个与响应一起被联合去噪的全局表示。另用 early-stop 直接解码中间干净预测，不走完去噪轨迹，以支持低 NFE 推理。
Result: ELF-REG-L 在 GSM8K 上 pass@1 55.96%（64 NFE），MATH-500 13.39%、HumanEval 22.56%（128 NFE）；MATH-500 pass@1 从 ELF-L 基线 10.55% 提到 13.39%。在 GSM8K 与代码上 pass@1 超过所评估的同规模 dLM。16 NFE 下 early-stop 达 HumanEval pass@10 41.21%，超过近期同规模连续 dLM。
Conclusion: 用冻结 AR teacher 做表示对齐与联合去噪，能把全连续 dLM 推到可用的推理与代码水平；early-stop 让同一任务检查点在不重训的情况下支持低 NFE 强性能。

papers.title: Benchmarking Hyperspectral Foundation Models for Hyperspectral Unmixing
papers.abstract_en: Several foundation models dedicated to hyperspectral images have recently been made available. These models are trained on large unlabeled datasets and exhibit strong performance on many hyperspectral imaging tasks, such as classification or denoising. Nonetheless, their performance for hyperspectral unmixing -- the task of separating mixed spectra of overlapping materials in a hyperspectral image -- remain understudied. This might partly be due to the fact that most of them rely on vision transformer backbones, including patchification, leading to a feature resolution problem. While hyperspectral unmixing already arises from the low resolution of hyperspectral images, this patchification step potentially makes the problem even more ill-posed. Therefore, in this work, we aim to answer two questions: 1) how do foundation models perform in hyperspectral unmixing?; 2) how to tackle the feature-level loss of resolution? To answer the first question, we benchmark foundation models for unmixing, showing that they can reach state-of-the-art performance on four hyperspectral unmixing datasets. To answer the second question, we compare several feature upsampling approaches and empirically show that using a simple one can lead to high performance results. The code is available at https://gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/hfm-hsu.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对高光谱基础模型在光谱解混 (hyperspectral unmixing) 上做基准测试，指出 ViT 式 patchification 会进一步恶化本已因图像低分辨率而病态的解混问题。在四个高光谱解混数据集上，基础模型可达到 state-of-the-art 表现；对比多种特征上采样方案后发现，简单的一种即可取得高性能结果。
Motivation: 高光谱基础模型在分类、去噪等任务上表现强，但在解混上研究不足；其 vision transformer backbone 的 patchification 造成特征级分辨率损失，使本就 ill-posed 的解混问题更难求解。
Method: 对多个高光谱基础模型在解混任务上做统一 benchmark，并系统比较多种特征上采样 (feature upsampling) 方法以缓解 patchification 带来的分辨率损失；代码开源于 gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/hfm-hsu。
Result: 在四个高光谱解混数据集上，基础模型可达到 state-of-the-art 性能；特征上采样对比显示简单方案即可带来高性能结果。
Conclusion: 高光谱基础模型可直接用于解混并达到 SOTA，而 patchification 的分辨率损失用简单特征上采样即可有效缓解。

papers.title: Type-Safe Is Not Error-Free: Typed Decision Models Follow the Option Name, Not the Definition Bound to It
papers.abstract_en: Typed decision models return structured results, but output-type correctness alone does not ensure that decisions follow explicit option definitions. Each option pairs a name with a definition that defines its intended meaning; the name, however, can provide a competing semantic cue. We study this conflict in Jev and two open-weight models by changing only the name-definition mapping, leaving the question, state, and the names and definition texts themselves unchanged. We measure decision flips at the level of the selected definition, rather than the returned name. On 1200 decision tasks with task-specific definitions, decision-flip rates are up to 70.4 pp higher with yes/no names than with the 0/1 control. This gap holds across all 4 binary decision rules. With yes/no names, reassignment also lowers their mean AUC from 93.8% to a below-chance 23.2%. In the binary evaluations, random strings used as option names yield mean flip rates close to those of neutral controls across all three models, with comparable balanced accuracy before reassignment. Together, these results support option-name polarity as a contributor to decision instability beyond reassignment alone. The type-error rate remains 0% throughout, showing that type-correct outputs can still fail to follow explicit option definitions.

papers.title: IndustrialVLA-Bench: A Traceable Multi-Axis Evaluation of Open Robot Policy Models
papers.abstract_en: Open robot policies increasingly follow two paradigms: vision-language-action models (VLAs) directly map observations and instructions to actions, whereas world-action models (WAMs) incorporate learned video or world dynamics into policy learning or action generation. Although both target the same manipulation tasks and represent alternative design choices, they are commonly reported under different evaluation protocols, leaving their capability, robustness, language sensitivity, and deployment-cost trade-offs unclear. We present IndustrialVLA-Bench, an evidence-aware evaluation of six released VLA and WAM systems under a unified reporting schema. It separately evaluates clean capability on LIBERO, non-language robustness on LIBERO-Plus, instruction sensitivity on LIBERO-Para, and observed execution cost. Reported task scores aggregate three complete evaluations with distinct random seeds under a fixed checkpoint and inference configuration. Across all six systems, clean LIBERO averages differ by only 1.58 points, whereas robustness and paraphrase summaries span 14.62 and 31.08 points. Restricting every comparison to the three protocol-faithful systems preserves the effect (1.36, 14.62 and 23.10 points), so the diagnostic separation reported here does not depend on the weaker evidence tiers. We additionally report observed inference latency, peak memory, runtime mode, and an evidence status for every system. Protocol-faithful, near-reproduction, and pending-verification entries remain visibly separated; only protocol-faithful entries support strict comparisons. Rather than claiming universal superiority of either paradigm, IndustrialVLA-Bench provides traceable evidence for comparing released robot policies on shared practical criteria. Code and evaluation records are available at https://github.com/xiaoqi-7/IndustrialVLA-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IndustrialVLA-Bench 用统一报告规范评测六个已发布的 VLA 与 WAM 机器人策略：干净能力在 LIBERO 上平均仅差 1.58 分，而鲁棒性 (LIBERO-Plus) 与改写敏感度 (LIBERO-Para) 分别相差 14.62 和 31.08 分。结论是两种范式在干净任务上几乎打平，真正的区分度在非语言扰动与指令改写上，且该分离在三个协议忠实系统上仍成立（1.36 / 14.62 / 23.10 分）。
Motivation: VLA 与 WAM 面向相同操作任务却各自用不同评测协议上报结果，导致能力、鲁棒性、语言敏感度与部署成本的取舍无法横向比较。
Method: 构建 evidence-aware 的统一评测框架，分四个轴：LIBERO 测干净能力、LIBERO-Plus 测非语言鲁棒性、LIBERO-Para 测指令敏感度、外加实测执行开销（推理延迟、峰值显存、运行模式）；任务分数在固定 checkpoint 与推理配置下聚合三次不同随机种子的完整评测，并为每个系统标注 protocol-faithful、near-reproduction、pending-verification 三档证据状态。
Result: 六个系统在 LIBERO 上干净能力平均仅差 1.58 分，而鲁棒性与改写敏感度分别相差 14.62 和 31.08 分；限制到三个协议忠实系统后仍为 1.36、14.62、23.10 分。同时上报每个系统的推理延迟、峰值内存与运行模式。
Conclusion: VLA 与 WAM 之间不存在可宣称的普遍优劣，评测应把干净能力与鲁棒性、语言敏感度分开报告；只有 protocol-faithful 条目支持严格对比。代码与评测记录已公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MemCalib: Benchmarking and Optimizing Memory Use in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: The effectiveness of agent memory ultimately depends on whether the underlying LLM gives each memory in context an appropriate degree of influence over its response. Yet this capability has remained largely overlooked. To assess this capability, we introduce MemCalib, a benchmark grounded in realistic memory-system scenarios for evaluating memory use and advancing optimization algorithms. Results on the MemCalib test set reveal that frontier open- and closed-source models struggle to use memory appropriately. They frequently over-use or under-use memory rather than matching each proposition's actual use to its target level, leading to biased, low-quality responses. Experiments with common post-training algorithms, including group relative policy optimization and on-policy self-distillation, further reveal a clear directional skew: trained models improve in one direction while deteriorating in the other. We therefore propose MemCalib-RL, an ordered bidirectional counterfactual credit-assignment algorithm that separates over- and under-use signals and localizes their credit to response tokens through exact atom ablation. Results across model families and scales (Qwen3-8B, Ministral-3-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) show that MemCalib-RL achieves the best overall performance while better balancing over-use and under-use, with gains generalizing beyond MemCalib in external benchmark evaluation. Further experiments support its design choices and robustness and provide insight into its training dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemCalib 提出面向 LLM agent 记忆使用的基准与优化算法 MemCalib-RL：用有序双向反事实信用分配分离过度使用与不足使用信号，并通过精确原子消融 (exact atom ablation) 把信用定位到响应 token。在 Qwen3-8B、Ministral-3-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上取得最佳总体表现并更好平衡两个方向，增益在外部基准上泛化。
Motivation: LLM 对上下文中每条记忆应赋予的影响程度这一能力长期被忽视，前沿开源与闭源模型常过度或不足使用记忆，导致有偏、低质量的回答。
Method: 构建基于真实记忆系统场景的 MemCalib 基准与测试集；针对 GRPO 与 on-policy self-distillation 暴露的单向偏移，提出 MemCalib-RL——有序双向反事实信用分配，分离 over-use 与 under-use 信号，并用 exact atom ablation 将信用定位到响应 token。
Result: MemCalib 测试集显示前沿开源与闭源模型普遍过度或不足使用记忆，未使各命题的实际使用匹配目标水平；常见后训练算法（GRPO、on-policy self-distillation）呈明显方向性偏移：一个方向改善而另一方向恶化。MemCalib-RL 在 Qwen3-8B、Ministral-3-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上总体表现最佳且更好地平衡两方向，增益在外部基准评测中泛化。
Conclusion: 记忆使用偏差需按方向分别归因并定位到 token 才能同时改善过度与不足使用；MemCalib-RL 在跨模型家族与规模上验证了这一设计，并给出训练动态与鲁棒性证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoboTalk: Learning Multi-Robot Communication and Coordination from Multimodal Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Multi-robot collaboration could enable more efficient and scalable solutions to complex robotic tasks, but collaboration under partial observability remains challenging. Natural-language communication offers a promising approach to coordinating robots under partial observability. However, in decentralized manipulation, jointly learning explicit inter-robot communication and skill-level action selection from multimodal demonstrations remains underexplored for small vision-language models (VLMs) intended for on-device deployment. To address this gap, we introduce RoboTalk, a synthetic data-generation pipeline and dataset of 7,950 multimodal trajectories spanning 53 mobile-manipulation kitchen tasks for training small VLMs to communicate and coordinate. The dataset includes a leader-follower planning protocol, tool calls (perception, manipulation, navigation, and communication), rationale traces, and diversified natural-language communication. Fine-tuning open-source models on our dataset can reach 77% success on novel held-out tasks, a significant improvement over the untuned open source models, which had a success rate of around ~2%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboTalk 用合成数据管线造出 7,950 条多模态轨迹、覆盖 53 个移动操作厨房任务的数据集，训练小规模 VLM 在部分可观测下同时学显式自然语言通信与技能级动作选择。微调开源模型后在未见过的 held-out 任务上成功率达 77%，而未微调的开源模型仅约 2%。
Motivation: 部分可观测下的多机器人协作仍困难；在去中心化操作中联合学习显式机间通信与技能级动作选择，对面向端侧部署的小 VLM 而言基本未被探索。
Method: 提出合成数据生成管线与数据集，内含 leader-follower 规划协议、四类工具调用（perception、manipulation、navigation、communication）、rationale 轨迹与多样化的自然语言通信；用该数据集微调开源小 VLM。
Result: 数据集含 7,950 条多模态轨迹、53 个移动操作厨房任务；微调后的开源模型在 novel held-out 任务上达到 77% 成功率，未微调开源模型约 2%。
Conclusion: 用带通信协议与工具调用的合成多模态演示微调小 VLM，可以在未见过的任务上同时学会通信与协调，且适合端侧部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CTRL: Control-Based Time Series Forecasting with LLM-Guided Residual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting underpins critical decision-making across diverse domains. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising reasoning capabilities, existing LLM-based time series forecasting approaches either reduce them to numerical predictors that bypass their strengths, or allow direct forecast generation that destabilizes predictions in non-stationary settings. We introduce CTRL, a framework that decouples semantic reasoning from quantitative prediction. A frozen backbone generates base forecasts, while specialized LLM agents function as controllers that analyze backbone prediction errors through decomposed trend, seasonal, and irregular components, grounding reasoning in interpretable temporal structure. Each agent outputs compact control signals that a lightweight residual decoder translates into forecast corrections. CTRL incorporates label-free test-time adaptation that detects distribution shift from input statistics alone and readapts control signals with only 3-24 LLM calls via caching. CTRL is explicitly designed to improve robustness under non-stationary temporal dynamics and distribution shift, while remaining competitive on highly stationary time series where adaptive correction provides limited additional benefit.
papers.comment: Published in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026. 18 pages, 9 figures, 22 tables
papers.journal_ref: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026, pages 21952-21968
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CTRL 把时序预测解耦为冻结骨干出基线预报、LLM 智能体按趋势/季节/不规则分量分析误差并输出控制信号、轻量残差解码器转成修正项；非平稳与分布偏移下靠仅 3–24 次 LLM 调用的免标签测试时自适应重调控制信号，平稳序列上则只保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 时序预测要么把 LLM 降为纯数值预测器、绕开其推理能力，要么让 LLM 直接生成预报，在非平稳场景下导致预测不稳定。
Method: CTRL 解耦语义推理与定量预测：冻结骨干产生 base forecast，专用 LLM agent 把骨干预测误差分解为 trend、seasonal、irregular 三部分做可解释分析，各 agent 输出紧凑 control signal，由轻量 residual decoder 转成预报修正；另含免标签 test-time adaptation，仅凭输入统计量检测分布偏移，靠缓存把 LLM 调用控制在 3–24 次。
Result: 在非平稳时序动态与分布偏移下提升鲁棒性，在高度平稳的时序上保持竞争力（自适应修正带来的额外收益有限）；测试时自适应仅需 3–24 次 LLM 调用。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 用作误差控制器而非直接预报器，配合轻量残差解码与免标签测试时自适应，可在非平稳场景改善稳健性，同时不牺牲平稳场景的表现。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: SparkDiffusion: Mitigating the High-Sparsity Trap --- A Unified Framework for up to $265\times$ Single-GPU Acceleration of Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion transformers are expensive because attention dominates long spatiotemporal token sequences. We identify the \emph{high-sparsity trap}: at extreme attention sparsity, step-local training losses keep decreasing while terminal generation quality stagnates or degrades. The trap is one of supervision: the dominant terminal errors originate in the high-noise structure-generation stage, and terminal-aligned training corrects terminal errors that substantially extended step-local training cannot. This yields a simple staging principle: \emph{first adapt the sparse architecture into a coarse prior, then correct the terminal distribution}. We instantiate the principle as \method, a unified acceleration framework for visual generation that combines a short sparse warm-up, few-step trajectory-mixed distillation, and FP8 quantization with fused kernels. \method sustains $97\%$ attention sparsity with strong visual quality on long-sequence 720P generation across Wan2.1/Wan2.2 backbones and T2V/I2V tasks, and $90\%$ sparsity on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P. With 3-step CFG-free inference, \method achieves a $265\times$ end-to-end speedup over the 50-step CFG dense baseline for Wan2.1-T2V-14B-720P on a single RTX~5090 ($220\times$ on H100), and denoises a Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P video in $1.3$s.
papers.comment: Code and weights are available at:https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/SparkDiffusion and https://huggingface.co/collections/alibabagroup/sparkdiffusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SparkDiffusion 指出视频扩散 Transformer 的高稀疏度陷阱：注意力稀疏到极端时，step-local 训练损失仍在下降，但最终生成质量停滞甚至变差，因为主要误差来自高噪声结构生成阶段，只有 terminal-aligned 训练能纠正。据此提出先用短稀疏 warm-up 把稀疏架构适配成粗先验、再校正终端分布的分阶段原则，落地为稀疏 warm-up + 少步轨迹混合蒸馏 + FP8 融合算子量化。在 Wan2.1/Wan2.2 的 T2V/I2V 上维持 97% 注意力稀疏度，3 步无 CFG 推理对 Wan2.1-T2V-14B-720P 单卡 RTX 5090 相对 50 步 CFG 稠密基线取得 265× 端到端加速（H100 上 220×）。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型的注意力在长时空 token 序列上占主导开销；把注意力稀疏度推到极端后，按步计的训练损失与最终生成质量脱钩，出现高稀疏度陷阱，加速与质量不可兼得。
Method: 把分阶段原则实例化为 SparkDiffusion：短稀疏 warm-up 先把稀疏架构适配为粗先验，再用 few-step trajectory-mixed distillation 校正终端分布，配合 FP8 量化与融合 kernel；训练监督对齐终端误差而非 step-local 损失。
Result: 在 Wan2.1/Wan2.2 骨干的 T2V/I2V 任务上维持 97% 注意力稀疏度并保持长序列 720P 生成质量，Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P 上为 90% 稀疏度；3 步 CFG-free 推理对 Wan2.1-T2V-14B-720P 在单张 RTX 5090 上相对 50 步 CFG 稠密基线取得 265× 端到端加速（H100 上 220×），Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P 单条视频去噪耗时 1.3 秒。
Conclusion: 高稀疏度下的质量瓶颈是监督错配而非容量不足：先适配稀疏架构为粗先验、再对齐终端分布校正，就能在 97% 稀疏度下同时拿到强视觉质量与最高 265× 的单卡加速。

papers.title: DENSE: Distilling Agent Trajectories into Evidence-Grounded Shortcut Trees for Self-Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Online agent deployments accumulate execution trajectories at massive scale and behavioral diversity, for which predefined annotation criteria hardly exist. Extracting useful evidence therefore demands costly manual annotation or verifier signals that fail to scale, leaving valuable evidence buried among redundant, incomplete, and failed executions. This raises a question: without post-execution rewards or correctness labels, how can reusable experience be distilled from the trajectories themselves? To address this challenge, we introduce DENSE (Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions), which organizes trajectory-derived evidence into nested shortcut trees. By consolidating redundant attempts, identifying resolved subtasks, and retaining useful steps alongside outstanding requirements, DENSE transforms noisy execution traces into structured and reusable task-solving feedback. To evaluate whether such feedback helps agents retry the same task, we design REFIT, which measures success-rate changes between the initial attempt and feedback-guided retries. Among feedback methods without external outcome supervision, DENSE achieves the highest strict pass rate across four agent models on Terminal-Bench 2.1, improving over initial attempts by 7.12-21.81 percentage points with 19.0-43.6% fewer agent tokens on retries. In addition, on hard tasks DENSE consistently outperforms self-reflection in cumulative pass rate across multiple feedback iterations on all four models, demonstrating its strong potential for continual agent self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DENSE 把 agent 执行轨迹蒸馏成嵌套 shortcut tree 形式的证据，无需执行后奖励或正确性标签即可转成可复用的自改进反馈。在 REFIT 协议下，四个 agent 模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上严格通过率较首次尝试提升 7.12–21.81 个百分点，重试 token 消耗减少 19.0–43.6%。
Motivation: 线上 agent 部署积累了大规模、行为多样的执行轨迹，但缺少预定义标注标准，抽取有用证据要么依赖昂贵人工标注，要么依赖无法规模化的 verifier 信号，导致冗余、不完整、失败的执行把有效经验埋没。
Method: DENSE（Distilling Evidence from Nested Subtask Executions）把轨迹证据组织成嵌套 shortcut tree：合并冗余尝试、识别已解决的 subtask、保留有用步骤与未完成需求，将噪声执行轨迹转为结构化任务求解反馈。评测用自设计的 REFIT 协议，度量首次尝试与反馈引导重试之间的成功率变化，且限定为无外部结果监督的反馈方法。
Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，DENSE 在四个 agent 模型中取得最高严格通过率，较首次尝试提升 7.12–21.81 个百分点，同时重试所用 agent token 减少 19.0–43.6%。在困难任务上，多个反馈迭代中 DENSE 的累积通过率在全部四个模型上一致超过 self-reflection。
Conclusion: 无需执行后奖励或正确性标签，轨迹自身蒸馏出的结构化证据即可同时提高重试成功率并降低 token 成本，支撑 agent 的持续自我改进。

papers.title: Embedding Models Measure in Peculiar Ways
papers.abstract_en: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. We find that physical measurement is only weakly modeled in the embedding space, and that instead quite peculiar measurement patterns can be observed. Further analysis indicates that embedding representations of physical measurements are strongly influenced by superficial string similarity, and recalibration of similarity does not substantially improve the alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究文本嵌入空间是否编码质量、距离、时间、体积等物理量的客观度量语义，发现嵌入对物理测量的建模很弱，且相似度主要被表层字符串相似性主导；对相似度做重标定也无法显著改善对齐。
Motivation: 物理量有唯一、客观的等价与距离定义，若嵌入空间不能反映这种度量结构，基于嵌入的语义相似度在涉及数值量的下游任务中就不可靠。
Method: 以质量、距离、时间、体积等物理测量为对象，检验嵌入空间中的语义相似度与距离是否符合客观度量关系，并分析表层字符串相似性的影响，再对相似度做重标定测试对齐是否改善。
Result: 物理测量在嵌入空间中仅被弱建模，并出现相当奇特的度量模式；表征强烈受表层字符串相似性影响，相似度重标定不能显著提升对齐程度。
Conclusion: 嵌入相似度不能可靠反映物理量的客观度量结构，且瓶颈不在相似度函数本身，重标定无法解决。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models provide powerful priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them to a specific deployment remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on task-specific demonstrations provides a step toward deployment, but faces two persistent limitations: static data provide limited coverage of out-of-distribution states, and standard imitation objectives do not distinguish progressing behavior from less useful data. Interactive post-training can address these limitations, but typically requires repeated policy execution and human intervention on a physical robot. We introduce HIL-UMI, a policy-guided Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) framework for robot-free human-in-the-loop VLA post-training. During handheld UMI demonstrations, HIL-UMI queries the current policy on the same observation stream without executing its predictions. The Energy Score compares the human action trajectory with policy inference and triggers collection when their discrepancy indicates an out-of-distribution region. In a separate feedback loop, low online advantage predictions identify essential segments for refining a progress-based advantage estimator. The updated estimator then guides advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning using a balanced mixture of base demonstrations and new policy data. This design preserves the iterative and policy-aware nature of human-in-the-loop learning while decoupling data collection from robot deployment. Experiments on four real-world tasks spanning long-horizon and precise manipulation show that HIL-UMI achieves consistent improvement over SFT and benefits from both targeted collection and advantage refinement. Moreover, HIL-UMI outperforms HG-DAgger on Clean Up Table with lower per-frame collection time, suggesting a scalable path for VLA post-training across operators and locations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HIL-UMI 把 human-in-the-loop 后训练搬进免机器人 (robot-free) 的手持 UMI 示范流程：采集时用当前策略对同一观测流做推理但不执行，Energy Score 比较人类动作与策略输出，偏差指示 OOD 时触发补采；另一条反馈回路用低 online advantage 预测挑出关键片段来改进 progress-based advantage estimator，再引导 advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning。在四个真实任务（含长程与精细操作）上一致优于 SFT，并在 Clean Up Table 上以更低的每帧采集时间超过 HG-DAgger。
Motivation: VLA 模型适配到具体部署时，SFT 受限于静态示范对 OOD 状态覆盖不足、且模仿目标无法区分有进展的行为与低价值数据；交互式后训练虽能弥补，却通常需要在实体机器人上反复执行与人工介入。
Method: HIL-UMI 是 policy-guided 的 UMI 框架：手持示范过程中对同一观测流查询当前策略（不执行其预测），用 Energy Score 度量人类轨迹与策略推理的差异并触发 OOD 区域的数据采集；独立反馈回路中，低 online advantage 预测识别关键片段以精化 progress-based advantage estimator，更新后的 estimator 引导 advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning，训练数据为基础示范与新策略数据的均衡混合。
Result: 在四个真实任务（覆盖长程与精细操作）上，HIL-UMI 相对 SFT 取得一致提升，且同时受益于定向采集与 advantage 精化；在 Clean Up Table 上超过 HG-DAgger，且每帧采集时间更低。
Conclusion: 把 human-in-the-loop 的迭代与策略感知特性保留下来、同时将数据采集与机器人部署解耦，为跨操作者、跨地点的 VLA 后训练提供了一条可扩展路径。

papers.title: MiX: Micro-Inverted-Scaling for End-to-End Low-Bit Vision-Language Model Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on edge devices is severely bottlenecked by memory bandwidth, necessitating aggressive sub-8-bit quantization. Since edge accelerators are strictly constrained by area and power, they require end-to-end quantized models. However, the extreme dynamic range gap between multi-modal tokens causes standard block formats to suffer "microscaling collapse," where a single massive outlier hijacks the shared exponent, underflowing surrounding elements and destroying attention maps. To break this bottleneck, we propose Micro-Inverted-Scaling (MiX), a novel format that mathematically inverts the microscaling paradigm: rather than grouping multiple mantissas under one shared exponent, MiX groups private, per-element exponents under a single shared mantissa. To handle asymmetric VLM outlier topologies, we introduce an adaptive dual-format (MiX-MX) inference framework. By algebraically factoring out the shared MiX mantissa, this framework maps to a custom accelerator, replacing multipliers with efficient shifters. Evaluated end-to-end on multiple VLMs, our 4.5-bit MiX formulation exhibits equivalent or superior accuracy on multi-modal benchmarks compared to NVFP4. Simultaneously, the MiX accelerator delivers a 25% improvement in area efficiency over the NVFP4 baseline and a 2.3-4.5x speedup with 1.4-2.9x energy reduction across models compared to the state-of-the-art accelerator Focus, proving the inverted-scaling datapath is physically superior for efficient VLM deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiX 把 microscaling 的共享指数结构倒过来，让每个元素持有私有指数、共享一个 mantissa，从而绕开多模态 token 极端动态范围导致的 microscaling collapse。4.5-bit MiX 在多模态 benchmark 上达到与 NVFP4 相当或更好的精度，配套加速器相对 Focus 实现 2.3–4.5 倍加速与 1.4–2.9 倍能耗下降。
Motivation: 边缘设备部署 VLM 受内存带宽限制，需要 sub-8-bit 量化；但多模态 token 间动态范围差距极大，标准 block 格式会因单个 outlier 劫持共享指数而使邻近元素下溢、破坏 attention map。
Method: 提出 Micro-Inverted-Scaling (MiX) 数值格式：多个私有逐元素指数共享单一 mantissa；针对非对称 VLM outlier 拓扑引入自适应双格式推理框架 MiX-MX，代数上提取共享 mantissa 后映射到定制加速器，用移位器替代乘法器。
Result: 端到端在多个 VLM 上评测：4.5-bit MiX 在多模态 benchmark 上精度相对 NVFP4 相当或更优；MiX 加速器面积效率比 NVFP4 基线高 25%，相对 SOTA 加速器 Focus 在不同模型上提速 2.3–4.5 倍、能耗降低 1.4–2.9 倍。
Conclusion: 倒置缩放的数据通路在物理实现上优于共享指数的 microscaling，可在端到端量化约束下支撑高效 VLM 部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EconSkills: Studying Skill Transfer and Retrieval for Web Agents on Live Economic Data
papers.abstract_en: Web agents often revisit the same sites, yet most evaluations discard the procedures learned in earlier successful interactions. We introduce EconSkills, a skill library and evaluation framework that distills verified EconWebArena trajectories into parameterized standard operating procedures for retrieving live economic data. Each skill records its scope, navigation procedure, site-specific guidance, verification checks, and recovery steps while replacing source-instance values with placeholders. EconSkills separates two questions: whether a known relevant procedure transfers to a held-out task, and whether an agent can retain that benefit when selecting from a library. In controlled transfer, matched skills improve success over no-skill prompting and require fewer steps on paired successes. Under the evaluated prompt formats, the parameterized skill prompt substantially outperforms the corresponding raw-trajectory prompt. With the full 50-skill library, retrieval is competitive with the no-skill baseline overall and performs best on tasks with a direct family match; approximate matches on other tasks offset these gains. Browser trajectories further identify when procedural guidance shortens portal-specific navigation and when semantic verification remains necessary. These results establish that reusable economic web procedures can transfer across task instances and provide a concrete design target for match-aware selection and context delivery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EconSkills 把 EconWebArena 中已验证成功的网页交互轨迹蒸馏成带占位符的参数化标准操作流程 (SOP) 技能库，用于抓取实时经济数据，并把「已知技能能否迁移到留出任务」与「从库中检索后能否保住收益」拆成两个问题评测。受控迁移中匹配技能比无技能提示成功率更高、配对成功样本所需步数更少；在所测提示格式下参数化技能提示显著优于原始轨迹提示；50 个技能全库检索整体只与无技能基线相当，直接家族匹配的任务表现最好，其他任务上的近似匹配抵消了这部分收益。
Motivation: 网页 agent 反复访问同一批站点，但现有评测把早期成功交互中学到的操作流程全部丢弃，无法区分「过程可迁移」与「检索后仍能保住收益」这两个问题。
Method: 从 EconWebArena 已验证轨迹蒸馏参数化 SOP 技能，每条技能记录适用范围、导航流程、站点特定指引、验证检查与恢复步骤，并把源实例值替换为占位符；评测分受控迁移（匹配技能 vs 无技能提示、参数化技能提示 vs 原始轨迹提示）与全 50 技能库检索两条线，并用浏览器轨迹定位过程指引何时缩短门户导航、何时仍需语义验证。
Result: 受控迁移中匹配技能相对无技能提示提高成功率，并在配对成功样本上减少步数；在所评测的提示格式下参数化技能提示大幅优于对应原始轨迹提示；50 技能全库检索整体与无技能基线持平，直接家族匹配任务上最佳，其他任务的近似匹配抵消了这些增益。
Conclusion: 可复用的经济类网页流程确实能跨任务实例迁移，但检索收益取决于匹配精度，因此设计目标是 match-aware 的技能选择与上下文投放。

papers.title: PointZero: 3D Point Track Completion for Learning Transferable 3D Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: World models endow perceptual systems with the ability to predict how scenes evolve under interaction. They are most beneficial when trained on diverse volumes of data, to instill a rich prior into downstream applications. Existing methods typically require robot action labels to learn action-conditioned 3D dynamics, which excludes web video data from the training pool. We study 3D point track completion as a pre-training objective for learning transferable 3D dynamics without robot data. Given a single RGB-D observation and sparse partial 3D trajectories (tracks), we predict future 3D tracks of all observed points. We show this objective produces a rich 3D dynamics prior, without requiring robot action labels. We contribute a diverse dataset of 2.9 million synthetic frames spanning deformable, articulated, and rigid objects, and use it to train PointZero. We show that a flexible and expressive transformer, PointZero, outperforms prior methods on the same data. We demonstrate the utility of our pre-training objective by post-training PointZero for two downstream applications: (1) action-conditioned 3D dynamics prediction and (2) imitation learning. When fine-tuned to condition on end-effector pose, PointZero outperforms the baselines on the recent PGND 3D dynamics benchmark. When fine-tuned to predict robot actions and 3D tracks, PointZero outperforms or matches the baselines on 6/7 simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks. We furthermore evaluate training PointZero from scratch to isolate the benefits of our proposed architecture from those of our proposed pre-training objective and dataset. We release the dataset, checkpoints, and full training recipe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PointZero 用 3D 点轨迹补全 (3D point track completion) 作为预训练目标，从单帧 RGB-D 与稀疏部分 3D 轨迹预测所有观测点的未来轨迹，从而在不依赖机器人动作标签的前提下学到可迁移的 3D 动力学先验。在 290 万合成帧上训练后，微调到以末端执行器位姿为条件时在 PGND 3D 动力学基准上超过基线，微调预测机器人动作与 3D 轨迹时在 7 项仿真与真实机器人操作任务中的 6 项上超过或匹配基线。
Motivation: 现有动作条件 3D 动力学方法必须有机器人动作标签，把海量网络视频排除在训练数据之外，而世界模型恰恰最需要多样数据来形成可迁移先验。
Method: 以 3D 点轨迹补全为预训练目标：输入单个 RGB-D 观测与稀疏部分 3D 轨迹，用灵活且表达力强的 Transformer（PointZero）预测所有观测点的未来 3D 轨迹；配套贡献覆盖可变形、铰接与刚体物体的 290 万合成帧数据集，并开源数据集、检查点与完整训练配方。
Result: 在相同数据上 PointZero 超过先前方法；微调到以末端执行器位姿为条件后在 PGND 3D 动力学基准上超过基线；微调到预测机器人动作与 3D 轨迹后，在 7 项仿真与真实机器人操作任务中的 6 项上超过或匹配基线；另从零训练 PointZero 以分离架构与预训练目标/数据集各自的贡献。
Conclusion: 不依赖机器人动作标签的 3D 轨迹补全预训练能产出可迁移的 3D 动力学先验，可经后训练迁移到动作条件动力学预测与模仿学习两类下游任务。

papers.title: Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces
papers.abstract_en: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) enables models to improve their reasoning without relying on labeled training data, but existing approaches typically optimize a large fraction of the model parameters. This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudolabels as rewards and optimizes only ~100K bias parameters while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. On MATH-500, our approach reaches 76.67% accuracy with Qwen2.5-7B, slightly exceeding our own labeled bias-steering reproduction while optimizing 76,000x fewer parameters than full-parameter TTRL. The same training procedure improves performance across vision-language and audio reasoning tasks, including MathVista, AI2D, LogicVista, and MMAU. We further show that the learned steering vectors transfer to 4,500 held-out MATH problems, indicating that the adaptation is not limited to the problems used during test-time optimization. Finally, we analyze why this highly restricted adaptation can work, showing that majority-vote reliability improves with rollout consensus and that bias subspaces with greater accessible gradient energy exhibit stronger downstream trainability. These results demonstrate that substantial test-time adaptation can emerge from optimizing a tiny bias-only subspace using entirely label-free rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无标签测试时强化学习 (TTRL) 中只优化约 100K 个 bias 参数、冻结预训练主干，用多数投票伪标签当奖励，MATH-500 上 Qwen2.5-7B 达到 76.67% 准确率，略超作者自己的有标签 bias-steering 复现，且比全参数 TTRL 少优化 76,000 倍参数。同一训练过程在 MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista、MMAU 等视觉-语言与音频推理任务上也提升性能，学到的 steering vector 可迁移到 4,500 道留出 MATH 题目。
Motivation: 现有 TTRL 通常要优化很大一部分模型参数，代价高；作者要检验当奖励信号和优化空间都被严重限制时，有效的测试时适应是否仍能出现。
Method: label-free bias-only TTRL：以多数投票伪标签作为奖励，只优化约 100K 个 bias 参数并冻结预训练 backbone；进一步分析多数投票可靠性随 rollout 共识提升，以及可访问梯度能量更大的 bias 子空间具有更强的下游可训练性。
Result: MATH-500 上 Qwen2.5-7B 达 76.67% 准确率，略高于作者自己的有标签 bias-steering 复现，优化参数比全参数 TTRL 少 76,000 倍；同一过程在 MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista、MMAU 上均有提升；学到的 steering vector 迁移到 4,500 道留出 MATH 题目仍有效。
Conclusion: 完全无标签的奖励加上极小的 bias-only 子空间就足以产生可观的测试时适应，且适应不限于测试时优化所用的题目。

papers.title: Salesforce Koa: An Enterprise Language Model for Agentic Tool Use
papers.abstract_en: We present Salesforce Koa, an enterprise language model built by post-training the open-weight Nemotron-3-Super-120B foundation model with reinforcement learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and deployed in FP8 for production. Koa is trained only on public and synthetically generated data, and specialized for the agentic tool use that enterprise workflows demand: routing a request to the correct action, invoking the right tool with valid arguments, and completing multi-turn business tasks. The distinctive component of our pipeline is specification-driven task construction: declarative Agent Script specifications are expanded into persona-conditioned multi-turn environments whose rewards are grounded in successful tool use. Applied to enterprise CRM specifications, the same pipeline produces the in-domain training distribution on which Koa is specialized. On CRMAgentBench and the human-labeled production tool-calling set, Koa outperforms both its untuned open-weight base and GPT-4.1 and is competitive with the strongest frontier models. It reaches 87% Task Success Rate on CRMAgentBench (vs. GPT-4.1 at 82% and the base at 79%), is at or near the top of every metric on the human-labeled portion of an internal production benchmark, and preserves the base model's general capability on public benchmarks (Tau2Bench, BFCL). A controlled comparison with architecture and RL recipe held fixed shows that the additional in-domain RL stage improves argument accuracy and full tool-call success on the human-labeled enterprise benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Salesforce Koa 是把开源 Nemotron-3-Super-120B 用 GRPO 后训练、FP8 部署的企业级工具调用语言模型，靠声明式 Agent Script 规格展开成带人物设定的多轮环境，奖励锚定在工具调用成功上。在 CRMAgentBench 上 Task Success Rate 达 87%，超过 GPT-4.1 的 82% 与未调基座的 79%，且在 Tau2Bench、BFCL 上保住基座通用能力。
Motivation: 企业工作流需要模型把请求路由到正确动作、用合法参数调用工具并完成多轮业务任务，而通用开源模型在这一域内能力不足，且缺少可规模化的域内训练数据构造方式。
Method: 以 Nemotron-3-Super-120B 为基座做 GRPO 强化学习后训练，FP8 生产部署，训练数据仅用公开与合成数据；核心是规格驱动的任务构造：声明式 Agent Script 展开为 persona 条件的多轮环境，奖励以工具成功调用为依据，同一管线套用企业 CRM 规格即产出域内训练分布。
Result: CRMAgentBench Task Success Rate 87%（GPT-4.1 为 82%，未调基座为 79%）；在内部生产基准的人工标注部分上多项指标居首或接近居首；Tau2Bench、BFCL 等公开基准上保持基座通用能力；固定架构与 RL 配方的受控对比显示，额外的域内 RL 阶段提升了人工标注企业基准上的参数准确率与完整工具调用成功率。
Conclusion: 规格驱动的任务构造加域内 RL 阶段，能在只用公开与合成数据的条件下把开源基座推到与前沿模型相当的企业工具调用水平，同时不牺牲通用能力。

papers.title: SlideLab: Audience-Centered Scientific Slide Generation and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Scientific presentations are more than summaries of research papers. They need to present the work in a coherent sequence, explain the main ideas clearly, and help the audience follow the presentation. We present SlideLab, a training-free multi-agent framework for generating scientific presentations from research papers. SlideLab first plans the presentation narrative, then builds and iteratively refines a shared slide deck using agents for content planning, visual generation, layout refinement, and grounding verification. In a blind human preference study, SlideLab was preferred over both open-source and commercial systems on 77% of papers while using roughly 4 times fewer inference tokens than the strongest open-source baseline. We also introduce ConfArena, an audience-oriented evaluation framework that simulates a conference room and assesses presentations slide by slide. ConfArena matches human system rankings and detects injected presentation problems, including falsified numbers, degraded figures, dropped slides, and shuffled slide order.
papers.comment: Update Appendix and add few more ablations, ConfArena architecture
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SlideLab 是一个免训练的多智能体框架，先规划演讲叙事，再由内容规划、视觉生成、版式精修与 grounding 校验等智能体共同构建并迭代打磨共享幻灯片。盲测中它在 77% 的论文上胜过开源与商业系统，且推理 token 约为最强开源基线的 1/4；配套的 ConfArena 逐页评估能对齐人类系统排名并检出注入的演示缺陷。
Motivation: 科学演讲不是论文摘要的堆砌，需要连贯叙事与观众可跟随的讲解，而现有生成系统在叙事质量与推理成本上都不理想，也缺少面向观众的自动评估手段。
Method: 训练-free 多智能体流水线：先做演讲叙事规划，再用内容规划、视觉生成、版式精修 (layout refinement)、grounding 校验四类智能体共同构建并迭代精修同一份幻灯片；另提出 ConfArena，模拟会议室环境逐页评估演示。
Result: 盲测人类偏好研究中，SlideLab 在 77% 的论文上优于开源与商业系统，同时推理 token 约为最强开源基线的 4 倍更少；ConfArena 的系统排名与人类排名一致，并能检出注入的问题，包括伪造数字、劣化图像、删页与乱序。
Conclusion: 把叙事规划与多智能体精修结合可在更低推理成本下产出更受人类偏好的科学演讲，而 ConfArena 这类面向观众的逐页评估能替代部分人工评审并识别具体演示缺陷。

papers.title: Meddies-PII: A Multilingual Framework for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction in Clinical De-identification
papers.abstract_en: Clinical de-identification relies on accurately identifying personally identifiable information (PII). However, manually annotated datasets are costly to construct, while existing synthetic alternatives often provide limited details about their generation process or rely on relatively simple synthesis strategies. We introduce Meddies-PII-Dataset, a corpus of one million synthetic clinical documents spanning seventeen languages and nine PII labels. The documents are generated using attribute-conditioned prompts and validated through thirteen deterministic gates that enforce structural and annotation consistency. To evaluate the dataset's utility, we train Meddies-PII-Model, a BIOES token classifier, and compare it with existing PII extraction systems using exact-match entity-level F1. Meddies-PII-Model achieves the highest performance among the evaluated systems on all reported benchmarks, with a mean F1 of 0.827 across fifteen external benchmarks, compared with 0.658 for the strongest baseline. Upon acceptance, we will publicly release the dataset, benchmark suite, model, generation framework, and evaluation code to support research on multilingual clinical de-identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Meddies-PII 提出多语临床去标识框架：用属性条件提示生成一百万份合成临床文档（17 种语言、9 类 PII 标签），经 13 道确定性门控校验结构与标注一致性，再训练 BIOES 标注的 token 分类器 Meddies-PII-Model。在 15 个外部基准上平均实体级 exact-match F1 达 0.827，最强基线为 0.658，且在所有已报告基准上均居首。
Motivation: 临床去标识依赖准确识别 PII，人工标注数据集构建成本高，而现有合成数据往往生成过程不透明或合成策略过于简单，难以支撑多语种 PII 抽取研究。
Method: 以属性条件提示 (attribute-conditioned prompts) 生成 Meddies-PII-Dataset（一百万份合成临床文档、17 语言、9 类 PII 标签），用 13 道确定性门控 (deterministic gates) 强制结构与标注一致；据此训练 Meddies-PII-Model，一个 BIOES 序列标注 token 分类器，并以实体级 exact-match F1 与现有 PII 抽取系统对比。
Result: Meddies-PII-Model 在全部已报告基准上性能最高：15 个外部基准上平均实体级 exact-match F1 为 0.827，最强基线为 0.658。数据集规模为 1,000,000 份文档、17 种语言、9 类 PII 标签，生成流程含 13 道确定性校验门控。
Conclusion: 带确定性校验门控的属性条件合成语料可训练出在多语临床 PII 抽取上全面领先现有系统的模型；作者计划公开数据集、基准套件、模型、生成框架与评测代码。

papers.title: Reading the Whole Heart: Latent-Attention Masked Autoencoders for Multimodal Cardiac Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cardiovascular diagnosis and treatment rest on integrating complementary modalities, such as electrocardiogram, echocardiography, and chest X-rays, each capturing distinct but complementary aspects of cardiac pathophysiology. Yet most medical foundation models remain modality-specific, combining modalities only for finetuning or post-training. This discards the cross-modal evidence clinicians naturally integrate and ignores the structure within each modality. We introduce Latent-Attention Masked Autoencoder (LAMAE), a multimodal, structure-aware masked autoencoder that jointly learns patient-level representations during self-supervised pretraining. Instead of fusing modalities post hoc, LAMAE exchanges information directly in the latent space through a shared latent-attention module operating over a study-view-entity hierarchy, enabling aggregation of variable observations and handling of missing modalities. Pretrained on over 500'000 MIMIC-IV hospital stays, LAMAE outperforms modality-specific pretraining and strong contrastive and vision-language baselines across multimodal hospital-stay tasks, such as in-hospital mortality, ICD-10 and DRG coding, and length of stay, while remaining competitive on unimodal tasks. Modeling this structure also pays off within a single modality: even without cross-modal information, the latent-attention module improves representations over modality-specific pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Latent-Attention Masked Autoencoder (LAMAE)，在自监督预训练阶段就通过共享 latent-attention 模块在 study-view-entity 层级的隐空间里直接交换 ECG、超声、胸片等模态信息，而非事后融合。在超过 500,000 条 MIMIC-IV 住院记录上预训练后，LAMAE 在院内死亡、ICD-10 与 DRG 编码、住院时长等多模态住院任务上超过模态专属预训练及对比学习与视觉-语言基线，单模态任务仍具竞争力。
Motivation: 多数医学基础模型是模态专属的，只在微调或后训练阶段才融合多模态，丢掉了临床医生本会整合的跨模态证据，也忽略各模态内部结构。
Method: LAMAE 是结构感知的多模态 masked autoencoder，在自监督预训练中联合学习患者级表示；共享 latent-attention 模块在 study-view-entity 层级的隐空间直接交换信息，从而聚合数量可变的观测并处理缺失模态；预训练数据为超过 500,000 条 MIMIC-IV 住院记录。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 上预训练后，LAMAE 在院内死亡、ICD-10 与 DRG 编码、住院时长等多模态住院任务上优于模态专属预训练以及强对比学习与视觉-语言基线，同时在单模态任务上保持竞争力；即使不使用跨模态信息，latent-attention 模块也比模态专属预训练学到更好的表示。
Conclusion: 把跨模态融合放进预训练的隐空间并显式建模 study-view-entity 结构，可同时提升多模态住院任务与单模态表示质量。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: The Truth Was Never Gone: Perfect Aliasing in Compliant-Context Truth Probes
papers.abstract_en: Linear probes that decode the truth from a language model's activations have been proposed as deception monitors, and a truth probe scoring below chance on a model trained to deceive is naturally read as evidence that the model hid or stopped representing the truth. We show that a fitting-label ambiguity can produce the same readout. In a controlled game, a model should report a secret bit to an ally and its complement to a rival. On compliant (ally) contexts the true bit and the answer the task prescribes are identical labels, so a probe fitted there cannot tell which of the two it measures. We call this complete agreement perfect aliasing. The labels are complements on rival contexts, so one ally-fitted probe scored against each has rival AUROCs that sum to one. Mixed fitting, on ally and rival contexts together, makes the two labels differ; randomized output codebooks also decouple the prescribed answer from the output letter. For a reward-trained Gemma-2-9B policy that answers falsely on every evaluated rival trial, the ally-fitted probe scores $0.006 \pm 0.005$ AUROC at the final layer (mean $\pm$ sample SD over three RL training seeds), while mixed-fit probes score 1.000 on the same held-out activations. Mixed fitting also uses more examples and labelled rival data, so this shows the true bit remains linearly recoverable, not that separating the labels alone explains the gain. In instructed Llama-3.1-8B, a probe refitted on one prompt variant and one frozen from a reference variant both have held-out ally accuracy 1.000 but rival truth AUROCs of 0.080 and 0.986 on the same trials. Our main experiments use one single-token game that states the bit in the prompt, so the recovered direction may read a retained copy of it; where the model must infer the bit, no tested arm deceives reliably. We study what a probe measures, not whether the model uses that information.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 17 figures. v2: substantially revised and corrected. Code and aggregate results: https://github.com/dylanjayabahu/perfect-aliasing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 线性探针在欺骗模型上低于随机水平并不等于模型隐藏了真值：在「对盟友报真值、对对手报补码」的单 token 博弈中，盟友语境下真值标签与任务规定答案完全一致（perfect aliasing），盟友拟合的探针因此无法区分自己在测哪一个。Gemma-2-9B 上该探针在末层 AUROC 仅 0.006±0.005（3 个 RL 种子），而混合拟合探针在同一批留出激活上达 1.000，说明真值仍线性可恢复。
Motivation: 用线性探针解码激活中的真值被当作欺骗监测手段，但低于随机的读数会被直接解读为模型停止表征真值；需要区分「真值消失」与「拟合标签歧义」这两种成因。
Method: 构造受控博弈：模型须向盟友报告秘密比特、向对手报告其补码；分别在盟友语境、对手语境、盟友+对手混合语境上拟合探针，并引入随机化输出码本使规定答案与输出字母解耦。对象为 reward 训练的 Gemma-2-9B 策略与指令版 Llama-3.1-8B，跨 3 个 RL 训练种子取均值与样本标准差。
Result: Gemma-2-9B 在全部被评估对手试次上说谎，盟友拟合探针末层 AUROC 0.006±0.005，混合拟合探针在同一批留出激活上 1.000；对手语境上两个盟友拟合探针的 AUROC 之和为 1。Llama-3.1-8B 中，单个 prompt 变体重拟合的探针与从参考变体冻结的探针留出盟友准确率同为 1.000，但对手真值 AUROC 分别为 0.080 与 0.986。
Conclusion: 低于随机的探针读数可以完全由拟合标签歧义产生，真值比特在激活中仍线性可恢复；但主实验的比特在 prompt 中明示，恢复方向可能只是其副本，且在需要模型自行推断比特的设置下没有哪个测试臂能可靠欺骗。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: X2Streaming-ASR: wait when uncertain, emit when ready for streaming ASR
papers.abstract_en: Streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) for real-time voice agents and full-duplex dialogue must provide accurate partial transcripts with low commit latency. Existing systems commonly use a fixed chunk size, look-ahead, or target delay, or encourage emissions near estimated acoustic boundaries. These approaches do not directly optimize how much additional context to use at each output position under a single-pass, hard-commit constraint. We propose X2Streaming-ASR, which decomposes streaming recognition into when to commit and what to commit. Its three-stage training procedure first establishes streaming recognition ability, then warm-starts the commit policy with automatically probed trajectories, and finally refines the policy using character-level, segment-assigned group-relative rewards for recognition accuracy and latency. Across ten Chinese and English test sets, X2Streaming-ASR attains the lowest mean commit latency relative to forced-aligned endpoints, 32--109ms on Chinese characters and 12--85ms on English words, while recognition accuracy remains comparable to existing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: X2Streaming-ASR 把流式识别拆成「何时提交」与「提交什么」两个决策，用三阶段训练（先建立流式识别能力，再用自动探测轨迹热启提交策略，最后以字符级、按段分配的 group-relative 奖励同时优化准确率与延迟）学习逐位置的提交时机。在中英文共十个测试集上，相对强制对齐端点的平均提交延迟最低：中文字符 32–109ms、英文词 12–85ms，识别准确率与现有系统相当。
Motivation: 实时语音 agent 与全双工对话需要低提交延迟的准确部分转写，但现有系统依赖固定 chunk、look-ahead 或目标延迟，或鼓励在估计声学边界附近出字，没有在单遍硬提交约束下直接优化每个输出位置该用多少额外上下文。
Method: 将流式识别分解为 when to commit 与 what to commit；三阶段训练：先建立流式识别能力，再用自动探测得到的轨迹热启提交策略，最后用字符级、按段分配的 group-relative 奖励（针对识别准确率与延迟）精调该策略。
Result: 在十个中文与英文测试集上取得相对强制对齐 (forced-aligned) 端点的最低平均提交延迟：中文字符 32–109ms，英文词 12–85ms；同时识别准确率与现有系统相当。

papers.title: Risk-Conditioned Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where rare but severe harmful generations can have significant consequences. Existing Risk-Averse RLHF addresses this issue by optimizing Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), but it trains policies for fixed risk levels and therefore cannot adjust the desired degree of risk aversion at inference time. In this paper, we propose risk-conditioned RLHF, a framework that trains a single policy that provides a continuous risk-control interface, enabling users to select different degrees of risk aversion without retraining or deploying multiple risk-specific models. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that a single risk-conditioned policy can adapt to different risk levels at inference time, enabling more flexible and risk-aware LLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 risk-conditioned RLHF：把固定风险水平的 Risk-Averse RLHF 改成以 CVaR 目标水平为条件训练单一策略，推理时无需重训或部署多个模型即可连续调节风险厌恶程度。在多个 benchmark 上，单一风险条件化策略能按推理时选定的风险水平自适应，实现更灵活的风险感知部署。
Motivation: 现有 Risk-Averse RLHF 用 CVaR 优化但只针对固定风险水平训练，推理时无法调整风险厌恶程度，只能为每个水平重训或部署多个专用模型。
Method: 提出 risk-conditioned RLHF 框架，以 CVaR 风险水平为条件训练单一策略，输出连续的风险控制接口，替代按固定风险水平分别训练的做法。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上的实验显示，单一 risk-conditioned 策略可在推理时适配不同风险水平；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把风险水平作为训练条件可以让一个 LLM 策略在部署后连续调节风险厌恶，无需重训或维护多个风险专用模型。

papers.title: A Network Science Perspective on Evaluating Deep Graph Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Traditional network models from network science, such as the Erdos-Renyi and configuration models, generate random networks that reproduce few selected topological properties observed in real-world networks. Deep graph generative models emerge as a data-driven approach, leveraging deep neural network architectures to learn complex structural distributions directly from real-world networks to generate more realistic synthetic networks. Because real social contact networks cannot be shared due to privacy risks, synthetic networks serve as an alternative for developing and evaluating epidemic mitigation strategies. In this work, we evaluate deep graph generative models as well as the configuration from a network science perspective by assessing both the topological similarity between generated and real-world networks and their utility in identifying effective node immunization strategies to sup- press epidemic/misinformation spreading. It is found that two deep graph generative models produce synthetic networks that closely resemble the structural properties of real-world networks, enabling them to identify effective immunization strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从网络科学视角评估深度图生成模型：既比较生成网络与真实网络的拓扑相似度，又检验其能否用于识别有效的节点免疫策略以抑制疫情/谣言传播。发现两个深度图生成模型生成的合成网络在结构属性上接近真实网络，并能识别出有效的免疫策略。
Motivation: 真实社交接触网络因隐私风险无法共享，合成网络成为开发和评估疫情缓解策略的替代品，但需要判断深度图生成模型产出的网络是否真的可用。
Method: 将深度图生成模型与网络科学中的 configuration model 一同评估，从两方面检验：生成网络与真实网络的拓扑相似性，以及用这些网络识别有效节点免疫策略以抑制疫情/谣言传播的效用。
Result: 两个深度图生成模型生成的合成网络在结构属性上与真实网络高度相似，并能识别出有效的免疫策略。
Conclusion: 深度图生成模型产出的合成网络可作为隐私受限下评估疫情/谣言缓解策略的可信替代，其拓扑保真度足以支撑免疫策略识别。

papers.title: A Score Is Not a Policy: Measuring the Value of Adaptive Revision
papers.abstract_en: As agentic systems become compound systems, increasingly important decisions move above task execution itself: when should a higher-level controller preserve the strategy guiding another process, and when should it revise it? We study this meta-level control problem in a hierarchical latent reasoner whose manager can retain or replace a commitment governing lower-level computation. Across three precommitted training seeds, learned revision timing produces qualitatively different policies, ranging from an almost deterministic early clock to substantially more state conditioned schedule distributions, yet none outperforms the best forced timing policy evaluated on the same frozen checkpoint. This separates state dependence from decision value: a controller can vary its actions with internal state without turning that variation into a reproducible task-performance benefit. A deeper intervention study on the original checkpoint shows that timing itself is consequential and order-sensitive, while exhaustive enumeration reveals that a strong fixed schedule captures most of the measurable value available from timing at this decision budget. Counterfactual PERSIST/REPLAN diagnostics further show why score-level evidence can be misleading when predictability is dominated by decision position rather than within-position discrimination. Together, these results argue that learned meta-level control should be evaluated along three separate axes: whether its score depends on state, whether that dependence changes realized behavior, and whether those changes capture outcome value beyond a strong non-adaptive policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在分层隐变量推理器 (hierarchical latent reasoner) 中研究元层控制：manager 何时保留、何时替换支配底层计算的 commitment。三个预设训练种子下，学习到的修订时机 (revision timing) 产生从近乎确定的早期时钟到强状态条件化调度分布的多样策略，但没有一个在同冻结 checkpoint 上超过最佳强制时机策略。作者据此主张把元层控制沿三条独立轴评估：分数是否依赖状态、该依赖是否改变实际行为、这些改变是否捕获超越强非自适应策略的结果价值。
Motivation: 复合式 agentic 系统中越来越多决策上移到任务执行之上，但缺少判据区分「控制器按内部状态改变动作」与「这种改变真正带来可复现的任务收益」。
Method: 在 manager 可保留或替换 commitment 的分层隐变量推理器中，跨三个预设训练种子比较学习到的修订时机与强制时机策略（同一冻结 checkpoint）；辅以对原 checkpoint 的深入干预研究、穷举枚举固定调度，以及反事实 PERSIST/REPLAN 诊断。
Result: 学习到的修订时机策略从近乎确定的早期时钟到强状态条件化调度分布不等，但均不优于同 checkpoint 上的最佳强制时机策略；干预研究显示时机本身有影响且具顺序敏感性；穷举枚举显示在该决策预算下强固定调度捕获了时机可用的大部分可测价值；PERSIST/REPLAN 诊断显示可预测性由决策位置而非位置内判别主导。
Conclusion: 状态依赖不等于决策价值：分数层面的证据在可预测性被决策位置主导时会误导，元层控制必须分三轴评估而非只看分数是否随状态变化。
Relevance: 2
