papers.title: mAVE: A Watermark for Joint Audio-Visual Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking joint audio-visual generation supports vendor copyright protection and content provenance. However, independently valid audio and video watermarks do not establish a shared generation session. An adversary can splice watermarked modalities from different sessions, causing the pair to be mistaken for the vendor's original joint output. We introduce mAVE (Manifold Audio-Visual Entanglement), a training-free watermarking framework that strengthens vendor attribution through session binding in native joint audio-visual diffusion transformers. mAVE separates public record retrieval from secret session authentication: a fixed public index locates the server record, while a randomized payload binds audio bits to a session-keyed video grid through a cryptographic digest. One prompt-conditioned joint inversion supports provider-assisted verification of both modalities against a session record, without modifying generator weights or training auxiliary watermark networks. Our analysis establishes implementation-matched distribution preservation and a full-initialization routing/clipping budget, alongside adaptive session-pool security and stable local-perturbation bounds. Experiments on LTX-2 and MOVA show comparable generation quality. mAVE achieves 99.8\% true-positive rate and 0\% observed false-positive rate in the evaluated swap test, and retains 99.2\% true-positive rate under FrameAvg temporal averaging. Same-prompt and similarity-selected swaps further test session authentication beyond perceptual compatibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: mAVE 是面向联合音视频生成模型的免训练水印框架，用固定公开索引定位服务器记录、用随机化 payload 经密码学摘要把音频比特绑定到会话密钥化的视频网格，从而把音视频两个模态绑到同一生成会话。在 LTX-2 与 MOVA 上，交换测试中真阳性率 99.8%、观测假阳性率 0%，FrameAvg 时间平均下仍保持 99.2% 真阳性率，生成质量相当。
Motivation: 音频与视频各自独立有效的水印无法证明二者来自同一次生成会话，攻击者可把不同会话的含水印模态拼接，使这对内容被误判为厂商原始联合输出。
Method: mAVE（Manifold Audio-Visual Entanglement）在原生联合音视频 diffusion transformer 上做免训练水印：公开记录检索与秘密会话认证分离，固定公开索引定位服务器记录，随机化 payload 通过密码学摘要把音频比特绑定到 session-keyed 视频网格；一次 prompt 条件的联合反演支持厂商对两个模态对照会话记录做验证，不改动生成器权重、不训练辅助水印网络。分析给出实现匹配的分布保持性、全初始化路由/裁剪预算，以及自适应会话池安全性与局部扰动稳定界。
Result: 在 LTX-2 与 MOVA 上生成质量相当；交换测试中真阳性率 99.8%、观测假阳性率 0%；FrameAvg 时间平均下真阳性率 99.2%；同 prompt 与相似度筛选的交换进一步检验超越感知兼容性的会话认证。
Conclusion: 会话绑定能把音视频水印从单模态归属提升为联合生成会话归属，在不改生成器权重的前提下抵抗跨会话拼接攻击。

papers.title: Multimodal Large Language Models as Image Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) classification performance depends critically on evaluation protocol and ground truth quality. Studies comparing MLLMs with supervised and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) report conflicting conclusions, and we show these conflicts stem from protocols that either inflate or underestimate performance. Across the most common evaluation protocols, we identify and fix key issues: model outputs that fall outside the provided class list and are discarded, inflated results from weak multiple-choice distractors, and open-world setting that underperforms only due to poor output mapping. We additionally quantify the impact of commonly overlooked design choices - batch size, image ordering, and text encoder selection - showing they substantially affect accuracy. Evaluating on ReGT, our multilabel reannotation of 625 ImageNet-1k classes, reveals that MLLMs benefit most from corrected labels (up to +10.8%), substantially narrowing the perceived gap with supervised models. Much of the reported MLLM underperformance on classification is thus an artifact of noisy ground truth and flawed evaluation protocol rather than genuine model deficiency. Models less reliant on supervised training signals prove most sensitive to annotation quality. Finally, we show that MLLMs can assist human annotators: in a controlled case study, annotators confirmed or integrated MLLM predictions in approximately 50% of difficult cases, demonstrating their potential for large-scale dataset curation. This work is part of the Aiming for Perfect ImageNet-1k project, see https://klarajanouskova.github.io/ImageNet/.

TL;DR: MLLM 在 ImageNet-1k 分类上的落后主要是评测协议与标注噪声造成的假象：修正输出映射、多选干扰项与 ReGT 重标注后，MLLM 在 625 类上最多提升 +10.8%，与监督模型的差距大幅收窄。作者建议分类评测先修协议与 ground truth 再谈模型能力。
Motivation: MLLM 与监督模型、VLM 的分类对比结论互相矛盾，因为协议会虚高或低估性能，且 ImageNet-1k 标签本身含噪。
Method: 逐项修复常见评测协议：保留落在类别列表外的模型输出、替换过弱的多选 distractors、修正 open-world 输出映射；量化 batch size、图像顺序、text encoder 选择的影响；提出 ReGT——对 625 个 ImageNet-1k 类的多标签重标注。
Result: 在 ReGT 上评测，MLLM 得到修正标签后准确率最多提高 +10.8%，与监督模型的感知差距大幅收窄；batch size、图像顺序、text encoder 选择被显示对准确率有实质影响；受控案例研究中，标注者在约 50% 的困难样本上确认或采纳了 MLLM 预测。
Conclusion: MLLM 在分类上的多数落后是噪声 ground truth 与缺陷评测协议的产物而非真实能力不足；依赖较少监督信号的模型对标注质量最敏感，MLLM 可用于大规模数据集的人机协同标注。

papers.title: 3BASiL: An Algorithmic Framework for Sparse plus Low-Rank Compression of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Sparse plus Low-Rank $(\mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$ decomposition of Large Language Models (LLMs) has emerged as a promising direction in model compression, aiming to decompose pre-trained model weights into a sum of sparse and low-rank matrices $(\mathbf{W} \approx \mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$. Despite recent progress, existing methods often suffer from substantial performance degradation compared to dense models. In this work, we introduce 3BASiL-TM, an efficient one-shot post-training method for $(\mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$ decomposition of LLMs that addresses this gap. Our approach first introduces a novel 3-Block Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) method, termed 3BASiL, to minimize the layer-wise reconstruction error with convergence guarantees. We then design an efficient transformer-matching (TM) refinement step that jointly optimizes the sparse and low-rank components across transformer layers. This step minimizes a novel memory-efficient loss that aligns outputs at the transformer level. Notably, the TM procedure is universal as it can enhance any $(\mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$ decomposition, including pure sparsity. Our numerical experiments show that 3BASiL-TM reduces the WikiText2 perplexity gap relative to dense LLaMA-8B model by over 30% under a (2:4 Sparse + 64 LR) configuration, compared to prior methods. Moreover, our method achieves over 2.5x faster compression runtime on an A100 GPU compared to SOTA $(\mathbf{S} + \mathbf{LR})$ method. Our code is available at https://github.com/mazumder-lab/3BASiL.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3BASiL-TM 是一次性的 LLM 后训练压缩框架：用带收敛保证的 3-Block ADMM 做逐层稀疏+低秩 (S+LR) 分解，再用跨 transformer 层联合优化的 transformer-matching (TM) 精修对齐层输出。在 (2:4 Sparse + 64 LR) 配置下，相对 dense LLaMA-8B 的 WikiText2 perplexity 差距比既有方法缩小超过 30%，A100 上压缩耗时比 SOTA (S+LR) 方法快 2.5 倍以上。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 稀疏+低秩分解方法相对 dense 模型性能损失明显，且压缩耗时高，缺少既有收敛保证又高效的后训练方案。
Method: 3BASiL-TM 分两步：先用 3-Block ADMM 最小化逐层重构误差（带收敛保证），再设计 transformer-matching (TM) 精修步，跨 transformer 层联合优化稀疏与低秩分量，使用一个显存高效的层输出对齐损失；TM 可叠加到任意 (S+LR) 分解上，包括纯稀疏。
Result: 在 (2:4 Sparse + 64 LR) 配置下，相对 dense LLaMA-8B 的 WikiText2 perplexity 差距较既有方法缩小超过 30%；在 A100 GPU 上压缩运行时比 SOTA (S+LR) 方法快 2.5 倍以上。
Conclusion: 逐层 ADMM 分解加跨层 transformer 输出对齐的精修，可以在保持收敛保证的同时显著缩小与 dense 模型的困惑度差距并大幅提速，且 TM 对任意 (S+LR) 分解通用。

papers.title: V-ECE: Estimating General Expected Calibration Errors
papers.abstract_en: In probabilistic classification, calibration error (CE) measures the average divergence of predicted probabilities $f(X)$ from $\mathbb{P}(Y|f(X))$, the true class distribution for that predicted probability. While being a useful diagnostic tool, it is hard to estimate: popular binning-based estimators are often inconsistent and scale poorly beyond two classes. Recent work rewrites the CE as the excess risk of a model compared to the best recalibration of its own predictions, measured with a proper loss. However, this only works for Bregman-divergence-based calibration errors like the squared error, excluding the more popular $L_1$-distance-based CE. We show that using prediction-dependent proper scores can alleviate this restriction, allowing us to estimate CEs with general convex divergences, including $L_p$ distances with closed-form losses in the binary and multiclass settings. To estimate the excess risk, we introduce a more accurate recalibrator that fits a residual to temperature scaling with gradient boosting. The resulting variational estimator, V-ECE, needs no bins or clusters and lower-bounds the true calibration error in expectation. On a benchmark of semi-synthetic tasks built from real classifiers, with known true CE, V-ECE is among the most accurate binary estimators for every calibration error and significantly outperforms all multiclass estimators. Our results are accompanied by additional theory on $L_p$ CE, estimator bias, and over- or under-confidence estimation.
papers.comment: Re-worked version with a new metric benchmark and new mathematical results on the bias of the estimator
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: V-ECE 把校准误差 (CE) 写成相对最优重校准的超额风险，用依赖预测的 proper score 打破只能处理 Bregman 散度的限制，从而支持含 L_p 距离的一般凸散度，且无需分箱或聚类。重校准器用梯度提升拟合温度缩放的残差，估计量在期望意义下给出真实 CE 的下界。在由真实分类器构建、真值 CE 已知的半合成基准上，V-ECE 对每种校准误差都是最准确的二分类估计量之一，并显著优于所有多分类估计量。
Motivation: 分箱式 CE 估计量常不一致且在多分类下难以扩展；把 CE 改写为超额风险的近期做法只适用于 Bregman 散度（如平方误差），排除了更常用的 L1 距离 CE。
Method: 用依赖预测的 proper score 构造变分估计量 V-ECE，使超额风险框架覆盖一般凸散度，包括二分类与多分类下有闭式损失的 L_p 距离；重校准器在温度缩放之上用梯度 boosting 拟合残差以更准地估计超额风险，全程不需分箱或聚类。
Result: 在由真实分类器构建、真值 CE 已知的半合成任务基准上，V-ECE 对每一种校准误差都是最准确的二分类估计量之一，并显著优于全部多分类估计量；估计量在期望意义下下界真实校准误差。
Conclusion: 依赖预测的 proper score 能把超额风险式 CE 估计推广到 L_p 等一般凸散度，配上更强的重校准器即可在二分类与多分类上都给出更准的估计，并附带关于 L_p CE、估计偏差与过/欠自信的理论结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling with Diffusion Language Models via Reward-Guided Stitching
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning with large language models often benefits from generating multiple chains-of-thought, but existing aggregation strategies are typically trajectory-level (e.g., selecting the best trace or voting on the final answer), discarding useful intermediate work from partial or "nearly correct" attempts. We propose Stitching Noisy Diffusion Thoughts, a self-consistency framework that turns cheap diffusion-sampled reasoning into a reusable pool of step-level candidates. Given a problem, we (i) sample many diverse, low-cost reasoning trajectories using a masked diffusion language model, (ii) score every intermediate step with an off-the-shelf process reward model (PRM), and (iii) stitch these highest-quality steps across trajectories into a composite rationale. This rationale is then used to recompute only the final answer. This modular pipeline separates exploration (diffusion) from evaluation and solution synthesis, avoiding monolithic unified hybrids while preserving broad search. Across math reasoning benchmarks, we find that step-level recombination is most beneficial on harder problems, and ablations highlight the importance of the final solver in converting stitched but imperfect rationales into accurate answers. Using low-confidence diffusion sampling with parallel, independent rollouts, our training-free framework improves average accuracy by up to 23.8% across six math and coding tasks. At the same time, it achieves up to a 1.8x latency reduction relative to both traditional diffusion models (e.g., Dream, LLaDA) and unified architectures (e.g., TiDAR). The code is available https://github.com/roymiles/diffusion-stitching
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Stitching Noisy Diffusion Thoughts：用掩码扩散语言模型低成本采样多条推理轨迹，以 process reward model (PRM) 逐步打分，把跨轨迹的高质量步骤拼接成复合 rationale，再只重算最终答案。训练无关框架在六个数学与编码任务上平均准确率最高提升 23.8%，相对传统扩散模型 (Dream、LLaDA) 与统一架构 (TiDAR) 延迟最高降低 1.8 倍。
Motivation: 现有推理聚合策略停留在轨迹级（选最优链或对最终答案投票），丢弃了部分正确或接近正确尝试中的中间步骤工作，探索与评估耦合在单一模型里也限制了搜索广度。
Method: 三段式流水线：先用掩码扩散语言模型并行独立 rollout 采样大量多样、低成本的推理轨迹；再用现成的 process reward model (PRM) 给每个中间步骤打分；随后跨轨迹拼接最高质量步骤构成复合 rationale，交由最终 solver 重算答案。探索 (diffusion)、评估 (PRM) 与解题合成分离，训练无关。
Result: 在六个数学与编码任务上平均准确率最高提升 23.8%；相对传统扩散模型 (Dream、LLaDA) 与统一架构 (TiDAR) 延迟最高降低 1.8 倍。步骤级重组在更难的问题上收益最大，消融显示最终 solver 对把拼接但不完美的 rationale 转成正确答案至关重要。
Conclusion: 把扩散采样当作可复用的步骤级候选池、用 PRM 做跨轨迹拼接，比轨迹级聚合更划算：既保住广泛搜索，又靠轻量的最终答案重算拿到更高准确率与更低延迟。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PaReGTA: A Temporally Aware LLM-Based Patient Representation Framework for EHR Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Temporal information in structured electronic health records (EHRs) is often lost in sparse one-hot or count-based representations, while sequence models can be costly and data-hungry. We propose PaReGTA, an LLM-based encoding framework that (i) converts longitudinal EHR events into visit-level templated text with explicit temporal cues, (ii) learns domain-adapted visit embeddings via lightweight contrastive fine-tuning of a sentence-embedding model, and (iii) aggregates visit embeddings into a fixed-dimensional patient representation using hybrid temporal pooling that captures both recency and globally informative visits. The resulting fixed-dimensional patient representations can be used with conventional downstream machine-learning models. To examine factor-level sensitivity, we use PaReGTA-RSS (Representation Shift Score), a prespecified factor-removal analysis that recomputes patient representations after removing clinically defined factor groups and quantifies the resulting change in the fitted logit of a fixed logistic-regression model. We evaluated PaReGTA in a cohort of 39,088 patients with migraine from the All of Us Research Program (AoU) on a retrospective patient-level classification task with an EHR-derived target. In an exploratory comparison on the fixed held-out test cohort of 7,818 patients, PaReGTA-Gap + LightGBM, used as a post hoc analytical reference, had the highest reported AUC, accuracy, and F1 values among the evaluated sparse, BERT-based EHR, and recurrent approaches in this cohort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PaReGTA 把纵向 EHR 事件转成带显式时间线索的就诊级模板文本，用轻量对比微调得到就诊嵌入，再以混合时间池化（hybrid temporal pooling，兼顾近期与全局重要就诊）聚合成固定维患者表示，接常规下游模型做分类。在 All of Us 39,088 名偏头痛患者的回顾性分类任务中，固定 7,818 人留出测试集上，PaReGTA-Gap + LightGBM 的 AUC、准确率与 F1 在所评稀疏、BERT 类 EHR 与循环方法中最高。
Motivation: 结构化 EHR 的稀疏 one-hot 或计数表示丢失时间信息，而序列模型训练成本高、数据需求大，需要一种保留时序且轻量的患者表示方案。
Method: 三段式编码框架：就诊级模板文本化并注入时间线索；对句嵌入模型做轻量对比微调得到就诊嵌入；用混合时间池化聚合成固定维患者表示。另提出 PaReGTA-RSS（Representation Shift Score），按预设的临床因子组移除后重算表示，并量化固定 logistic 回归拟合 logit 的变化，做因子级敏感性分析。
Result: 回顾性患者级分类队列 39,088 名偏头痛患者（All of Us Research Program），固定留出测试集 7,818 人；探索性比较中 PaReGTA-Gap + LightGBM 的 AUC、准确率与 F1 在所评稀疏、BERT-based EHR 与循环方法中最高。
Conclusion: 带显式时间线索的 LLM 就诊级编码加混合时间池化，可作为 EHR 患者表示的轻量替代，并在该偏头痛队列的探索性比较中取得最高报告指标。

summary_sections.motivation: 结构化 EHR 的稀疏 one-hot 或计数表示丢失时间信息，而序列模型训练成本高、数据需求大，需要一种保留时序且轻量的患者表示方案。

papers.title: Similarity-as-Evidence: Calibrating Overconfident VLMs for Interpretable and Label-Efficient Medical Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: Active Learning (AL) reduces annotation costs in medical imaging by selecting only the most informative samples for labeling, but suffers from cold-start when labeled data are scarce. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) address the cold-start problem via zero-shot predictions, yet their temperature-scaled softmax outputs treat text-image similarities as deterministic scores while ignoring inherent uncertainty, leading to overconfidence. This overconfidence misleads sample selection, wasting annotation budgets on uninformative cases. To overcome these limitations, the Similarity-as-Evidence (SaE) framework calibrates text-image similarities by introducing a Similarity Evidence Head (SEH), which reinterprets the similarity vector as evidence and parameterizes a Dirichlet distribution over labels. In contrast to a standard softmax that enforces confident predictions even under weak signals, the Dirichlet formulation explicitly quantifies lack of evidence (vacuity) and conflicting evidence (dissonance), thereby mitigating overconfidence caused by rigid softmax normalization. Building on this, SaE employs a dual-factor acquisition strategy: high-vacuity samples (e.g., rare diseases) are prioritized in early rounds to ensure coverage, while high-dissonance samples (e.g., ambiguous diagnoses) are prioritized later to refine boundaries, providing clinically interpretable selection rationales. Experiments on ten public medical imaging datasets with a 20% label budget show that SaE attains state-of-the-art macro-averaged accuracy of 82.57%. On the representative BTMRI dataset, SaE also achieves superior calibration, with a negative log-likelihood (NLL) of 0.425.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Similarity-as-Evidence (SaE) 框架，用 Similarity Evidence Head (SEH) 把 VLM 的文本-图像相似度向量重解释为证据并参数化标签上的 Dirichlet 分布，从而显式量化 vacuity（证据不足）与 dissonance（证据冲突），抑制温度缩放 softmax 的过自信。采集策略双因子分轮：前期优先高 vacuity 样本（如罕见病）保证覆盖，后期优先高 dissonance 样本（如模糊诊断）细化边界。在十个公开医学影像数据集、20% 标签预算下取得 82.57% 的宏平均准确率 SOTA，BTMRI 上 NLL 为 0.425。
Motivation: 医学影像主动学习在标注稀缺时有冷启动问题；VLM 零样本预测虽能缓解，但温度缩放 softmax 把相似度当确定性分数、忽略不确定性而过自信，误导样本选择、浪费标注预算。
Method: SaE 用 Similarity Evidence Head (SEH) 将相似度向量作为证据，参数化标签上的 Dirichlet 分布，取代强制自信的 softmax 归一化；在此基础上采用双因子采集策略，前期按高 vacuity、后期按高 dissonance 排序选样，给出可解释的临床选择理由。
Result: 在十个公开医学影像数据集、20% 标签预算下，SaE 取得 state-of-the-art 宏平均准确率 82.57%；在代表性 BTMRI 数据集上校准更优，negative log-likelihood (NLL) 为 0.425。
Conclusion: 把相似度当作证据而非确定分数、用 Dirichlet 显式表达 vacuity 与 dissonance，可在低标签预算下同时改善主动学习的样本选择与预测校准，并提供可解释的选择依据。

papers.title: ActionCodec: What Makes for Good Action Tokenizers
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leveraging the native autoregressive paradigm of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated superior instruction-following and training efficiency. Central to this paradigm is action tokenization, yet its design has primarily focused on reconstruction fidelity, failing to address its direct impact on VLA optimization. Consequently, the fundamental question of \textit{what makes for good action tokenizers} remains unanswered. In this paper, we bridge this gap by establishing design principles specifically from the perspective of VLA optimization. We identify a set of best practices based on information-theoretic insights, including maximized temporal token overlap, minimized vocabulary redundancy, enhanced multimodal mutual information, and token independence. Guided by these principles, we introduce \textbf{ActionCodec}, a high-performance action tokenizer that significantly enhances both training efficiency and VLA performance across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks. Notably, on LIBERO, a SmolVLM2-2.2B fine-tuned with ActionCodec achieves a 95.5\% success rate without any robotics pre-training. With advanced architectural enhancements, this reaches 97.4\%, representing a new SOTA for VLA models without robotics pre-training. We believe our established design principles, alongside the released model, will provide a clear roadmap for the community to develop more effective action tokenizers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActionCodec 从 VLA 优化（而非重建保真度）出发，给出动作分词器的设计原则：最大化时间 token 重叠、最小化词表冗余、增强多模态互信息、保持 token 独立性。按此实现的分词器让 SmolVLM2-2.2B 在 LIBERO 上无需机器人预训练即达 95.5% 成功率，加架构增强后 97.4%，成为该设定下的 SOTA。
Motivation: 动作分词化设计一直只追求重建保真度，忽略了它对 VLA 优化的直接影响，导致“什么样的动作分词器才算好”这一根本问题没有答案。
Method: 从信息论视角推导一组设计原则（最大化时间 token 重叠、最小化词表冗余、增强多模态互信息、token 独立性），据此实现高性能动作分词器 ActionCodec，并在仿真与真实基准上配合 SmolVLM2-2.2B 微调检验。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上，用 ActionCodec 微调的 SmolVLM2-2.2B 在完全不做机器人预训练的条件下取得 95.5% 成功率；加入架构增强后达到 97.4%，为无机器人预训练 VLA 的新 SOTA。
Conclusion: 好的动作分词器应按 VLA 优化目标而非重建精度来设计，这套信息论原则加发布模型可作为社区开发分词器的路线图。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Federated Granger Causality Learning
papers.abstract_en: Granger causality identifies predictive dependencies in multivariate time series. In distributed settings where parties cannot share data, federated causal learning enables joint analysis. Most federated causal methods assume that clients observe the same features and infer causal relationships as point estimates, with little formal uncertainty quantification. These assumptions do not hold in many industrial systems, where clients observe different features, and the objective is to estimate cross-client dependencies (edges). These dependencies must be estimated indirectly through repeated client-server iterations. Uncertainty from client data and model parameters propagates through this process, making point estimates alone insufficient for assessing cross-client edges. This paper characterizes this uncertainty propagation and uses edge-specific variances to distinguish genuine cross-client dependencies from spurious estimated edges. We consider aleatoric uncertainty from client data variability and epistemic uncertainty from model parameters. We derive closed-form variance recursions and steady-state variances for the client-server iterations. We prove that the propagated contribution of the initial model-parameter uncertainty vanishes asymptotically. These variances enable statistically principled selection of cross-client edges. Synthetic experiments show that our approach improves cross-client edge recovery over competing baselines. On real-world industrial datasets, it achieves high root-cause identification accuracy while yielding interpretable dependency structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在客户端特征不一致、数据不可共享的联邦 Granger 因果学习中，把客户端数据的 aleatoric 不确定性与模型参数的 epistemic 不确定性显式传播到跨客户端边估计，得到闭式方差递推与稳态方差，用边级方差区分真实依赖与伪边。合成实验中跨客户端边恢复优于对比基线，真实工业数据集上根因识别准确率高且依赖结构可解释。
Motivation: 多数联邦因果方法假设各客户端观测相同特征、且只输出点估计，缺少正式的不确定性量化；而工业系统中客户端特征各异，跨客户端边只能经多轮客户端-服务器迭代间接估计，点估计不足以判断边是否真实。
Method: 刻画客户端-服务器迭代中的不确定性传播：区分来自客户端数据变异的 aleatoric 不确定性与来自模型参数的 epistemic 不确定性，推导方差的闭式递推与稳态方差，并证明初始模型参数不确定性的传播贡献渐近消失；再用边级方差做统计上合理的跨客户端边选择。
Result: 合成实验中该方法的跨客户端边恢复优于对比基线；在真实工业数据集上取得高的根因识别准确率，并给出可解释的依赖结构。
Conclusion: 跨客户端因果边必须带方差来判定真伪：方差递推使点估计升级为可统计检验的边选择，且初始参数不确定性在迭代中渐近消散。

papers.title: Rethinking Latency Denial-of-Service: Attacking the LLM Serving Framework, Not the Model
papers.abstract_en: LLM inference is inherently expensive, even a modest slowdown can translate into substantial operating costs and severe availability risks. Recently, a growing body of research known as latency attacks focuses on crafting inputs to trigger worst-case output lengths. However, we report a contrary finding that these algorithmic-level latency attacks are largely ineffective against modern LLM serving systems. We reveal that system-level optimization such as continuous batching provides a logical isolation to mitigate contagious latency impact on co-located users. Thus, in this paper, we shift our focus from the algorithm to the system layer, and introduce a new Fill and Squeeze attack strategy targeting the state transition of the scheduler. ``Fill'' first exhausts the global KV cache to induce Head-of-Line blocking, while ``Squeeze'' forces the system into repetitive preemption. By manipulating output lengths using different attack prompts, and leveraging side-channel probing of memory status, we demonstrate that the attack can succeed in a practical black-box setting with much less cost. Extensive evaluations on vLLM indicate up to $75-742\times$ TTFT degradation relative to benign baselines and $1.5-4\times$ average slowdown on Time Per Output Token compared to existing attacks with 30-40% lower attack cost. Code: https://github.com/Phil-Fan/FS-attack
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 服务框架的延迟 DoS，提出 Fill and Squeeze 攻击：先耗尽全局 KV cache 触发队首阻塞 (Head-of-Line Blocking)，再迫使调度器反复抢占。在 vLLM 上黑盒实测 TTFT 相对良性基线恶化 75–742×，TPOT 相比已有攻击再慢 1.5–4×，攻击成本低 30–40%。
Motivation: 现有 latency attack 都在算法层构造触发最长输出的输入，但 continuous batching 提供逻辑隔离，使这类攻击对现代 LLM serving 系统基本失效；真正的脆弱点在系统层调度器。
Method: Fill and Squeeze 策略针对调度器状态转换：Fill 阶段耗尽全局 KV cache 诱发 Head-of-Line blocking，Squeeze 阶段迫使系统进入重复 preemption；用不同攻击 prompt 操纵输出长度，并通过内存状态的 side-channel 探测在黑盒设置下实施。
Result: 在 vLLM 上评测：TTFT 相对良性基线最高恶化 75–742×；Time Per Output Token 相比已有攻击平均再慢 1.5–4×；攻击成本比已有攻击低 30–40%。
Conclusion: 算法层的最长输出延迟攻击对现代 serving 系统基本无效，攻击面应转向调度器的 KV cache 与抢占状态转换，且黑盒下即可低成本得手。

papers.title: Bi-temporal Image-driven Acute Stroke Evolution Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Acute ischemic stroke requires rapid treatment decisions that are strongly guided by emergency imaging. Admission computed tomography perfusion (CTP) is commonly used to estimate the ischemic core, representing irreversibly damaged tissue, and the penumbra, representing hypoperfused but potentially salvageable tissue. Follow-up diffusion-weighted MRI (DWI) is then used to define the final infarct. Existing imaging approaches primarily focus on core--penumbra segmentation or final-infarct prediction, but provide limited insight into how heterogeneous penumbral tissue evolves after treatment. We propose a bi-temporal tissue phenotyping framework that links admission CTP signatures with follow-up DWI-defined tissue outcome using six outcome-aware region-of-interest classes. Admission tissue signatures are characterized using statistical, radiomic, and deep-learning features extracted from mJ-Net and nnU-Net representations. On an internal cohort (SUH), salvaged and infarcted penumbra showed consistent feature-space separation ($\tildeΔ{\cos}=0.146$, $p<0.05$), while core tissue showed minimal separation by subsequent fate. The largest separation was observed between initially non-hypoperfused tissue that later infarcted and healthy contralateral tissue ($\tildeΔ{\cos}=0.460$, $p<0.05$). Cross-dataset evaluation on the publicly available ISLES'24 dataset showed similar trends, supporting the consistency of the observed feature-space patterns. These findings suggest that admission CTP contains outcome-associated tissue information beyond conventional core-penumbra delineation. The code is available at https://github.com/yokko123/bi-temporal-ctp-dwi-code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出双时相组织表型框架，把入院 CTP 特征与随访 DWI 定义的组织结局用六类结局感知 ROI 关联起来，发现入院灌注里已含超出常规 core-penumbra 划分的结局信息：内部队列 SUH 中被挽救与梗死的半暗带特征空间可分（$	ildeΔ{\cos}=0.146$，$p<0.05$），而最初非低灌注却随后梗死的组织与健康对侧分离最大（$\tildeΔ{\cos}=0.460$，$p<0.05$）。
Motivation: 现有 CTP/DWI 影像方法集中在 core–penumbra 分割或最终梗死预测，对治疗后异质半暗带组织如何演变缺少刻画。
Method: 双时相组织表型框架：用六类结局感知 ROI 把入院 CTP 特征与随访 DWI 结局配对；入院组织签名由统计、radiomic 与深度学习特征构成，深度特征取自 mJ-Net 与 nnU-Net 表征；在内部队列 SUH 上检验，并在公开 ISLES'24 上做跨数据集评估。
Result: 内部队列 SUH 中，被挽救与梗死的半暗带特征空间稳定分离（$\tildeΔ{\cos}=0.146$，$p<0.05$），core 组织按后续命运分离最小；最大分离出现在最初非低灌注但随后梗死的组织与健康对侧之间（$\tildeΔ{\cos}=0.460$，$p<0.05$）。ISLES'24 跨数据集评估呈相似趋势。

papers.title: Constrained Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: While Dynamic Gaussian Splatting enables high-fidelity 4D reconstruction, its deployment is severely hindered by a fundamental dilemma: unconstrained densification leads to excessive memory consumption incompatible with edge devices, whereas heuristic pruning fails to achieve optimal rendering quality under preset Gaussian budgets. In this work, we propose Constrained Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (CDGS), a novel framework that formulates dynamic scene reconstruction as a budget-constrained optimization problem to enforce a strict, user-defined Gaussian budget during training. Our key insight is to introduce a differentiable budget controller as the core optimization driver. Guided by a multi-modal unified importance score, this controller fuses geometric, motion, and perceptual cues for precise capacity regulation. To maximize the utility of this fixed budget, we further introduce an adaptive static-dynamic allocation strategy that separates the Gaussian representation into static and dynamic branches and distributes the shared global capacity between them according to motion complexity. Furthermore, we implement a three-phase training strategy to seamlessly integrate these constraints, ensuring precise adherence to the target count. After training, a dual-mode hybrid compression scheme further reduces storage overhead. CDGS therefore not only strictly adheres to the specified Gaussian-count budget (error<2%) but also achieves favorable rate-distortion performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CDGS delivers optimal rendering quality under varying capacity limits and favorable rate-distortion performance, achieving over 3x model compression compared with the state-of-the-art method Ex4DGS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CDGS 把动态高斯泼溅 (Dynamic Gaussian Splatting) 的 4D 重建改写成带预算约束的优化问题：可微预算控制器按几何、运动、感知统一重要性分数调节容量，静态/动态分支按运动复杂度分配共享预算，三阶段训练保证高斯数量严格达标（误差 <2%），训练后再做双模式混合压缩，相对 SOTA 方法 Ex4DGS 实现 3 倍以上模型压缩。
Motivation: 动态高斯泼溅的无约束增密导致显存占用过高、无法部署到边缘设备，而启发式剪枝在固定高斯预算下拿不到最优渲染质量。
Method: 核心是可微预算控制器，由多模态统一重要性分数（几何、运动、感知线索融合）驱动容量调节；自适应静态-动态分配把高斯分成静态与动态分支、按运动复杂度分配全局容量；三阶段训练策略整合约束以精确命中目标数量；训练后用双模式混合压缩进一步降低存储。
Result: 严格遵守指定高斯数量预算，计数误差 <2%；在不同容量限制下取得有利的率失真 (rate-distortion) 表现；相对 SOTA 方法 Ex4DGS 实现超过 3 倍模型压缩。

papers.title: Handling Covariate Mismatch in Collaborative Linear Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Training predictive models across multiple centers typically assumes that all centers collect the same set of covariates. In practice, however, they may record different features of their observations, a setting we refer to as covariate mismatch. We study linear prediction under this challenging setting, assuming center-wise MCAR missingness patterns, and develop estimators that exploit information across centers despite heterogeneous feature sets. In the low-dimensional regime, we propose a plug-in estimator of the oracle linear predictor based on component-wise aggregation of covariance and cross-moment estimates. In higher dimensions, we study an impute-then-regress strategy that first completes the missing covariates using an exchangeability-preserving imputation procedure and then fits a ridge-regularized linear model. All proposed estimators are compatible with federated learning constraints: individual-level data remain local to each center, and only aggregated quantities are exchanged. We provide asymptotic and finite-sample learning rates for our predictors, explicitly characterizing their behaviour with the global dimension, the center-specific feature partition, and the distribution of samples across centers, and validate our approach through numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多中心协作线性预测中各中心记录的协变量集合不同（covariate mismatch），论文在中心级 MCAR 缺失下给出低维的 plug-in 估计器（对协方差与 cross-moment 做分量级聚合）和高维的 impute-then-regress 策略（保持 exchangeability 的插补 + ridge 回归），并证明其渐近与有限样本学习率随全局维度、各中心特征划分和样本分布变化。
Motivation: 多中心联合训练通常假设所有中心采集同一组协变量，实际中各中心记录的特征不同，直接套用会失效；需要在个体数据不出本地的前提下利用跨中心信息。
Method: 低维：基于协方差与 cross-moment 估计的分量级聚合，构造 oracle 线性预测器的 plug-in 估计；高维：先用 exchangeability-preserving 插补补全缺失协变量，再拟合 ridge 正则线性模型。全部估计器兼容联邦约束，仅交换聚合量。
Result: 给出预测器的渐近与有限样本学习率，显式刻画其随全局维度、中心特征划分与各中心样本分布的行为，并通过数值实验验证。
Conclusion: 在中心级 MCAR 缺失与异质特征集下，通过聚合矩估计或插补后回归可以在不共享个体数据的情况下做协作线性预测，其速率由维度与中心划分共同决定。

papers.title: FreshMem: Brain-Inspired Frequency-Space Hybrid Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Transitioning Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) from offline to online streaming video understanding is essential for continuous perception. However, existing methods lack flexible adaptivity, leading to irreversible detail loss and context fragmentation. To resolve this, we propose FreshMem, a Frequency-Space Hybrid Memory network inspired by the brain's logarithmic perception and memory consolidation. FreshMem reconciles short-term fidelity with long-term coherence through two synergistic modules: Multi-scale Frequency Memory (MFM), which projects overflowing frames into representative frequency coefficients, complemented by residual details to reconstruct a global historical "gist"; and Space Thumbnail Memory (STM), which discretizes the continuous stream into episodic clusters by employing an adaptive compression strategy to distill them into high-density space thumbnails. Extensive experiments show that FreshMem significantly boosts the Qwen2-VL baseline, yielding gains of 5.20%, 4.52%, and 2.34% on StreamingBench, OV-Bench, and OVO-Bench, respectively. As a training-free solution, FreshMem outperforms several fully fine-tuned methods, offering a highly efficient paradigm for long-horizon streaming video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreshMem 为流式视频理解的 MLLM 提出频域-空间混合记忆：MFM 把溢出帧投影为多尺度频率系数并补残差细节重建全局 gist，STM 用自适应压缩把连续流离散成情景簇并蒸馏为高密度空间缩略图。作为 training-free 方案，它在 Qwen2-VL 基线上于 StreamingBench、OV-Bench、OVO-Bench 分别提升 5.20%、4.52%、2.34%，并超过若干全量微调方法。
Motivation: MLLM 从离线转向在线流式视频理解时，现有记忆方法缺乏灵活自适应，导致不可逆的细节丢失与上下文碎片化，长时程感知难兼顾短期保真与长期连贯。
Method: 两个模块协同：Multi-scale Frequency Memory (MFM) 将溢出帧投影为具代表性的频率系数并补充残差细节以重建全局历史 gist；Space Thumbnail Memory (STM) 采用自适应压缩策略把连续视频流离散为情景簇 (episodic clusters)，蒸馏成高密度空间缩略图。整体为 training-free，接入 Qwen2-VL 基线。
Result: 在 Qwen2-VL 基线上，StreamingBench 提升 5.20%，OV-Bench 提升 4.52%，OVO-Bench 提升 2.34%；作为 training-free 方案，其表现超过若干完全微调 (fully fine-tuned) 的方法。
Conclusion: 频域 gist 与空间缩略图的混合记忆可在不训练的前提下同时保住短期细节与长期连贯，为长时程流式视频理解提供高效范式。

papers.title: MissMAC-Bench: Building Solid Benchmark for Missing Modality Issue in Robust Multimodal Affective Computing
papers.abstract_en: Current Multimodal Affective Computing (MAC) systems heavily rely on the completeness of multiple modalities to accurately understand human's affective state. However, in real-world scenarios, the availability of modality data is often dynamic and uncertain, leading to substantial performance fluctuations due to the distribution shifts and semantic deficiencies of the incomplete multimodal inputs. Known as the missing modality issue, this challenge poses a critical barrier to the robustness and practical deployment of MAC models. To systematically quantify this issue, we introduce \textbf{MissMAC-Bench}, a comprehensive benchmark designed to establish fair and unified evaluation standards from the perspective of cross-modal synergy. Two guiding principles are proposed, including no missing prior during training, and one single model capable of handling both complete and incomplete modality scenarios, thereby ensuring better generalization. Moreover, to bridge the gap between academic research and real-world applications, our benchmark integrates evaluation protocols with both fixed and random missing patterns at the dataset and instance levels. Extensive experiments conducted on 3 widely-used language models across 4 datasets validate the effectiveness of diverse MAC approaches in tackling the missing modality issue. Our benchmark provides a solid foundation for advancing robust MAC and promotes the development of multimedia data mining. Our code is released in https://github.com/RH-Lin/MissMAC-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MissMAC-Bench 从跨模态协同视角为多模态情感计算 (MAC) 的缺失模态问题建立统一评测基准，提出两条指导原则：训练阶段不使用缺失先验，且单一模型同时处理完整与不完整模态输入。评测协议覆盖数据集级与实例级的固定及随机缺失模式，在 3 个广泛使用的语言模型与 4 个数据集上验证了各类 MAC 方法处理缺失模态的有效性。
Motivation: 真实场景中模态数据可得性动态且不确定，不完整多模态输入带来分布偏移与语义缺失，导致 MAC 系统性能大幅波动，成为其鲁棒性与实际部署的关键障碍；现有评测缺少公平统一的标准。
Method: 提出 MissMAC-Bench 基准，以跨模态协同为评测视角，设定两条原则（训练时无缺失先验、单一模型兼顾完整与不完整模态），并设计数据集级与实例级的固定/随机缺失模式两套评测协议；在 4 个广泛使用的数据集上对 3 个语言模型开展实验，代码发布于 GitHub。
Result: 在 3 个广泛使用的语言模型和 4 个数据集上的大量实验验证了多种 MAC 方法在处理缺失模态问题上的有效性；评测协议同时覆盖固定与随机缺失模式、数据集级与实例级两个层面。
Conclusion: 以跨模态协同为统一视角、配合无缺失先验训练与单一模型原则的标准化评测，可为鲁棒 MAC 提供可比的量化基础，并推动多媒体数据挖掘发展。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Synthetic Time Series Generation via Complex Networks
papers.abstract_en: Time series data are essential for a wide range of applications, yet access to high-quality datasets is often constrained by privacy concerns, acquisition costs, and labelling challenges. Synthetic time series generation has emerged as a promising approach to address these limitations. In this work, we investigate the use of complex network mappings for synthetic time series generation, focusing on the Quantile Graph (QG) representation and its inverse. While the inverse QG mapping has been previously proposed, its potential as a general-purpose data generator has not been systematically evaluated. We address this gap through a comprehensive empirical study assessing both the fidelity and utility of synthetic time series generated by the Inverse Quantile Graph (InvQG) framework. The evaluation combines statistical feature analysis, network-based topological characteristics, and performance in downstream clustering and classification tasks, using simulated and real-world datasets. The results show that InvQG effectively preserves marginal distributions and short-term temporal dependencies across a wide range of models, while exhibiting predictable limitations in capturing long-range or higher-order dynamics.
papers.journal_ref: International Journal of Data Science and Analytics 22, 299 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InvQG（Inverse Quantile Graph）把时间序列经 Quantile Graph 映射的逆变换生成合成数据，在模拟与真实数据集上保住了边缘分布与短程时间依赖，但对长程与高阶动态有可预期的损失。
Motivation: 高质量时间序列数据常受隐私、采集成本与标注困难限制，而逆 QG 映射此前虽被提出，却未被系统评估为通用数据生成器。
Method: 围绕 Quantile Graph (QG) 表示及其逆映射，构建 Inverse Quantile Graph (InvQG) 框架，用统计特征分析、网络拓扑特征以及下游聚类与分类任务表现三类证据，综合评估合成序列的保真度与可用性，覆盖模拟与真实数据集。
Result: InvQG 在多类模型上有效保留边缘分布与短程时间依赖，同时在捕捉长程依赖和高阶动态上表现出可预期的局限；评估由统计特征、拓扑特征与下游聚类/分类任务共同构成。
Conclusion: 逆 QG 映射可作为通用合成时间序列生成器使用，适用边界是短程依赖与边缘分布，长程和高阶动态需另行处理。

papers.title: Mechanistic Evidence for Spectral Structures in Prior-Data Fitted Networks
papers.abstract_en: Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) perform approximate Bayesian inference in a single forward pass, and tabular foundation models (TFMs) built on them are now widely used. To understand what networks infer internally, recent mechanistic studies of TFMs locate where predictions form, but treat these models as tabular predictors rather than as PFNs. It therefore remains unknown whether PFNs represent the spectral content of their context, the quantity that specifies a stationary kernel, and whether this content can be read out as an explicit kernel. We answer both questions. First, across seven PFNs, including four pretrained TFMs and a model trained only on a decision-tree prior, a linear probe on the residual stream recovers the frequency of the context with $R^2 \geq 0.95$. This structure is led by a single principal direction. Second, activation and subspace patching show that the network uses the structure through a low-dimensional subspace, where a few spectral directions move predictions far more than random ones. This holds even for the decision-tree model, so a spectral training prior is not required. On real datasets with up to 499 features, 64 of the 192 directions of TabPFN, chosen without labels, carry 85 to 95\% of the causal effect of the context in all but one pair. Third, we introduce a Filter Bank Decoder that turns frozen PFN representations into an explicit stationary kernel through Bochner's theorem. Without any test-time optimization, the decoded kernel supports Gaussian process regression competitive with deep kernel learning and random Fourier features at about $200\times$ lower cost. PFN latents therefore hold spectral structure that is causally used and recoverable as a portable kernel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PFN 的隐层残差流里线性探针即可恢复上下文频率（R²≥0.95），且该谱结构经低维子空间因果地参与预测；再用 Filter Bank Decoder 依 Bochner 定理把冻结表示解码为显式平稳核，无需测试时优化即可支撑与 deep kernel learning、random Fourier features 相当的 GP 回归，成本约低 200 倍。
Motivation: 现有对表格基础模型 (TFM) 的机理研究只把它们当表格预测器，不按 PFN（单次前向做近似贝叶斯推断）来看，因此 PFN 是否在内部表示上下文的谱内容、以及能否读出为显式核，一直未知。
Method: 在七个 PFN（含四个预训练 TFM 和一个仅用决策树先验训练的模型）上对残差流做线性探针读出频率；用 activation patching 与 subspace patching 检验该结构是否被因果使用；提出 Filter Bank Decoder，借 Bochner 定理把冻结 PFN 表示转成显式平稳核，直接用于高斯过程回归。
Result: 线性探针恢复上下文频率 R²≥0.95，结构由单一主方向主导；在最多 499 特征的真实数据集上，TabPFN 的 192 个方向中无标签选出的 64 个承载了除一对之外所有配对中 85%–95% 的因果效应；解码核支撑的 GP 回归与 deep kernel learning、random Fourier features 竞争，成本约低 200 倍，且无需任何测试时优化。
Conclusion: PFN 的隐表示携带被因果使用、且可恢复为可移植核的谱结构，谱训练先验并非必需（决策树先验模型同样成立），冻结 PFN 加解码器即可低成本替代深度核方法。

papers.title: Solving the Offline and Online Min-Max Problem of Non-smooth Submodular-Concave Functions: A Zeroth-Order Approach
papers.abstract_en: We consider max-min and min-max problems with objective functions that are possibly non-smooth, submodular with respect to the minimiser and concave with respect to the maximiser. We investigate the performance of a zeroth-order method applied to this problem. The method is based on the subgradient of the Lovász extension of the objective function with respect to the minimiser and based on Gaussian smoothing to estimate the smoothed function gradient with respect to the maximiser. In expectation sense, we prove the convergence of the algorithm to an $ε$-saddle point in the offline case. Moreover, we show that, in the expectation sense, in the online setting, the algorithm achieves $O(\sqrt{N(1+\bar{P}_N)})$ online duality gap, where $N$ is the number of iterations and $\bar{P}_N$ is the path length of the sequence of optimal decisions. The complexity analysis and hyperparameter selection are presented for all the cases. The theoretical results are illustrated via numerical examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对极小极大目标中关于极小化变量 submodular、关于极大化变量 concave 且可能非光滑的问题，提出零阶 (zeroth-order) 算法：极小侧用 Lovász 扩展的次梯度，极大侧用高斯平滑估计平滑函数梯度。理论上证明离线情形期望意义下收敛到 ε-鞍点，在线情形期望意义下达到 O(√(N(1+P̄_N))) 的 online duality gap，其中 P̄_N 为最优决策序列的路径长度。
Motivation: 非光滑 submodular-concave 的 min-max 问题在离线与在线两种设定下都缺少可分析的零阶求解方法，尤其在线情形需要在只有函数值查询时给出随迭代数与路径长度增长的 duality gap 保证。
Method: 零阶方法：对极小化变量取目标函数 Lovász 扩展的次梯度，对极大化变量用高斯平滑 (Gaussian smoothing) 估计平滑后函数的梯度；给出全部情形的复杂度分析与超参数选择，并用数值例子说明理论结果。
Result: 离线情形证明算法在期望意义下收敛到 ε-鞍点；在线情形期望意义下 online duality gap 为 O(√(N(1+P̄_N)))，N 为迭代次数、P̄_N 为最优决策序列的路径长度；复杂度分析与超参数选择覆盖所有情形，并以数值例子说明理论结果。
Conclusion: 零阶次梯度加高斯平滑的组合足以处理非光滑 submodular-concave 的离线与在线 min-max 问题，并给出可随路径长度自适应的在线 duality gap 保证。

papers.title: Trust, Don't Trust, or Flip: Robust Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Expert Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PBRL) offers a promising alternative to explicit reward engineering by learning from pairwise trajectory comparisons. However, real-world preference data often comes from heterogeneous annotators with varying reliability; some accurate, some noisy, and some systematically adversarial. Existing PBRL methods either treat all feedback equally or attempt to filter out unreliable sources, but both approaches fail when faced with adversarial annotators who systematically provide incorrect preferences. We introduce TriTrust-PBRL (TTP), a unified framework that jointly learns a shared reward model and expert-specific trust parameters from multi-expert preference feedback. The key insight is that trust parameters naturally evolve during gradient-based optimization to be positive (trust), near zero (ignore), or negative (flip), enabling the model to automatically invert adversarial preferences and recover useful signal rather than merely discarding corrupted feedback. We provide theoretical analysis establishing identifiability guarantees and detailed gradient analysis that explains how expert separation emerges naturally during training without explicit supervision. Empirically, we evaluate TTP on four diverse domains spanning manipulation tasks (MetaWorld) and locomotion (DM Control) under various corruption scenarios. TTP achieves state-of-the-art robustness, maintaining near-oracle performance under adversarial corruption while standard PBRL methods fail catastrophically. Notably, TTP outperforms existing baselines by successfully learning from mixed expert pools containing both reliable and adversarial annotators, all while requiring no expert features beyond identification indices and integrating seamlessly with existing PBRL pipelines.
papers.comment: Equal contribution: Seyed Amir Hosseini and Maryam Abdolali. Corresponding author: Maryam Abdolali (maryam.abdolali@kntu.ac.ir)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TriTrust-PBRL (TTP) 在多专家偏好反馈下联合学习共享奖励模型与专家级 trust 参数，trust 值在梯度优化中自然演化为正（信任）、近零（忽略）或负（翻转），从而主动反转对抗标注者的错误偏好而非丢弃。在 MetaWorld 操作与 DM Control 运动控制四类任务、多种污染设定下，TTP 在对抗污染中保持接近 oracle 的性能，而标准 PBRL 出现灾难性失败。
Motivation: 真实偏好数据来自可靠性异质的标注者，其中一部分系统性给出错误偏好；现有 PBRL 要么等权对待所有反馈，要么直接过滤不可靠来源，面对对抗标注者时两者都失效。
Method: TTP 联合训练共享 reward model 与每个专家的 trust 参数，trust 符号决定采纳、忽略或翻转该专家的偏好；作者给出可辨识性 (identifiability) 理论分析与梯度分析，说明专家分离在无显式监督下自然涌现；只需专家识别索引，无需专家特征，可嵌入现有 PBRL 流程。
Result: 在 MetaWorld（操作）与 DM Control（运动控制）共四个多样域、多种污染场景下评测，TTP 达到 SOTA 鲁棒性，在对抗污染下维持接近 oracle 的性能，而标准 PBRL 灾难性失败；在混合了可靠与对抗标注者的专家池上仍能成功学习。
Conclusion: 把标注者可靠性建模为可正可负的连续 trust 参数，比等权或过滤更能抵抗系统性对抗偏好，且无需专家先验特征即可在既有 PBRL 管线中落地。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Obscuring Data Contamination Through Translation: Evidence from Arabic Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Data contamination can invalidate benchmark evaluation when a model benefits from memorized evaluation content rather than genuine generalization. Yet contamination is difficult to audit when the exposed content differs in language from the evaluation benchmark. We study this failure mode by deliberately exposing four open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs to Arabic translations of MMLU and XQuAD evaluation items at increasing exposure levels, then evaluating them on the original English tasks. This controlled setup is a proxy for contamination rather than a reconstruction of real-world pretraining leakage. We first test two English-centric post-hoc probes, TS-Guessing and Min-K%++, and find that their signals largely disappear under translated exposure: TS-Guessing remains weak except for model-specific positional recall on MMLU, while Min-K%++ stays at or below chance. At the same time, English MMLU performance increases with Arabic exposure, showing that the absence of an English contamination signal does not imply the absence of an exposure effect. We then introduce Translation-Aware Contamination Detection (TACD), a training-data-free diagnostic based on cross-lingual prediction consistency and choice reordering. Cross-lingual consistency is substantially higher than an independence baseline and generally increases relative to the clean condition, although its magnitude is model-dependent and not strictly monotonic. These results show that translation can conceal contamination-related effects from English-only probes and motivate multilingual diagnostics that are explicitly framed as evidence of contamination-consistent behavior rather than definitive membership tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 MMLU 与 XQuAD 评测条目的阿拉伯语译文按递增暴露量喂给四个开源指令微调 LLM 后再测英文原题，英文中心的事后探针 TS-Guessing 与 Min-K%++ 的信号基本消失（Min-K%++ 处于或低于随机水平），而英文 MMLU 成绩随阿拉伯语暴露上升。作者据此提出无训练的 TACD（Translation-Aware Contamination Detection），用跨语言预测一致性与选项重排做诊断，其一致性显著高于独立性基线且相对干净条件普遍升高。结论是翻译能让英文探针漏检污染效应，多语言诊断应表述为“污染一致行为的证据”而非确定性的成员关系判定。
Motivation: 当暴露内容与评测基准语言不一致时，污染难以审计：英文探针可能在模型确实因记忆而受益时给出阴性信号，使基准评测失效。
Method: 受控实验：刻意让四个开源指令微调 LLM 接触 MMLU、XQuAD 评测条目的阿拉伯语翻译，暴露量分档，再在英文原任务上评测；先跑英文中心的事后探针 TS-Guessing 与 Min-K%++，再提出 TACD——基于跨语言预测一致性和选项重排 (choice reordering) 的免训练诊断。作者明确该设置是污染的代理而非对真实预训练泄漏的重构。
Result: 翻译暴露下 TS-Guessing 信号基本消失，仅在 MMLU 上保留模型特有的位置记忆 (positional recall)；Min-K%++ 处于或低于随机水平。英文 MMLU 成绩随阿拉伯语暴露量增加而上升，说明英文污染信号缺失不等于无暴露效应。TACD 的跨语言一致性显著高于独立性基线，且相对干净条件普遍升高，但幅度依模型而异、非严格单调。
Conclusion: 翻译会把污染相关效应从英文探针下藏起来，因此污染检测需要显式面向多语言的诊断，并把结论限定为污染一致行为的证据而非确定的成员关系测试。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 翻译暴露下 TS-Guessing 信号基本消失，仅在 MMLU 上保留模型特有的位置记忆 (positional recall)；Min-K%++ 处于或低于随机水平。英文 MMLU 成绩随阿拉伯语暴露量增加而上升，说明英文污染信号缺失不等于无暴露效应。TACD 的跨语言一致性显著高于独立性基线，且相对干净条件普遍升高，但幅度依模型而异、非严格单调。
summary_sections.conclusion: 翻译会把污染相关效应从英文探针下藏起来，因此污染检测需要显式面向多语言的诊断，并把结论限定为污染一致行为的证据而非确定的成员关系测试。

papers.title: Non-stationary time series attribution for heatwaves over Europe
papers.abstract_en: The increasing occurrence of extreme weather events since the beginning of the 21st century has led to the development of new methods to attribute extreme events to anthropogenic climate change. The way in which the extreme event is defined has a major influence on the attribution result. A frequently overlooked aspect concerns the temporal dependence of extremes. This study presents an approach for attributing complete time series during extreme events to anthropogenic forcing. The approach is based on a non-stationary Markov process using bivariate extreme value theory to model the temporal dependence of the time series. We calculate the likelihood ratio of an observational time series from ERA5 given the distributions as estimated from CMIP6 simulations with historical natural-only and natural and anthropogenic forcing scenarios. The spatial fields are condensed by the extremal pattern index (EPI) as a compact description of spatial extremes. In addition, the study examines the extent to which attribution statements about the occurrence of extreme heat events change when the effect of the mean warming is eliminated. The resulting attribution statement provides very strong evidence for the scenario with anthropogenic drivers over Europe, especially since the beginning of the 21st century. For central and southern Europe, the influence of anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions on heatwaves could already have been proven in the 1960s using today's knowledge. There is no reliable signal apart from a general shift in the temperature distribution, neither in terms of the temporal dependence of extreme heat days nor in terms of the shape of the extreme value distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用非平稳 Markov 过程加双变量极值理论 (bivariate extreme value theory) 对整段热浪时间序列做归因：以 ERA5 观测序列在 CMIP6 自然强迫与自然+人为强迫分布下的似然比为判据，空间场压缩为 extremal pattern index (EPI)。结果对欧洲人为驱动给出 very strong evidence，且剔除平均增暖后，极端高温日的时间依赖与极值分布形状均无可靠信号。
Motivation: 极端事件归因通常只看单一指标，事件定义方式会显著改变结论；极端的时间依赖性长期被忽视，而热浪归因需要说明整段序列而非单个极值。
Method: 构建基于非平稳 Markov 过程、用双变量极值理论刻画时间依赖的模型；计算 ERA5 观测序列在 CMIP6 historical natural-only 与 natural+anthropogenic 两种强迫分布下的似然比；用 extremal pattern index (EPI) 压缩空间极值场，并对比剔除平均增暖前后的归因陈述。
Result: 归因结论对欧洲人为驱动给出 very strong evidence，尤其自 21 世纪初起；以今日知识，中欧与南欧热浪的人为温室气体影响在 1960 年代即可被证明；剔除平均增暖后，除温度分布整体平移外，极端高温日的时间依赖与极值分布形状均无可靠信号。
Conclusion: 欧洲热浪的归因证据主要来自温度分布的整体平移，而非时间依赖或分布形状的改变；平均增暖一旦被消除，这两方面都不再提供独立信号。

papers.title: SRUG: A Fusion-Driven Generator Network for Medical Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: MRI sequence synthesis aims to recover missing image contrast while preserving patient-specific anatomy. The choice of generation mechanism affects both optimization and the way source information reaches the synthesized image. In this study, we propose SRUG, a supervised standalone fusion-driven generator that learns a deterministic source-to-target mapping for paired MRI synthesis. Its direct reconstruction formulation removes generator-discriminator competition and requires neither variational latent sampling nor iterative diffusion denoising. To support structural fidelity within this formulation, SRUG uses a residual encoder adapted for image reconstruction, with a full-resolution convolutional stem, pooling-separated feature stages, and channel recalibration embedded in the residual branches. A nested multi-scale decoder (NMD) repeatedly fuses the resulting spatial features and predicts the target sequence through a single output head. L1 loss and Multi-Scale Structural Loss (MSS loss) jointly supervise the prediction, connecting the direct generation objective to anatomical detail recovery. Experiments on BraTS 2023 show competitive reconstruction fidelity and structural consistency across three MRI translation tasks. Architecture ablations assess the effects of channel recalibration, NMD, and structural supervision within the same generator framework. Additional evaluation on IXI supports applicability to another dataset and modality pair, while zero-shot testing on BraTS 2019 provides preliminary evidence of cross-dataset transferability. These results support direct supervised generation as a practical approach to paired MRI sequence synthesis, with the adapted encoding and reconstruction pathway providing the basis for structural preservation. The SRUG implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/RisingRich/SRUG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRUG 是用于配对 MRI 序列合成的监督式融合驱动生成器，直接学习源到目标的确定性映射，去掉生成器-判别器对抗、变分潜变量采样与扩散迭代去噪。残差编码器加嵌套多尺度解码器 (NMD) 配合 L1 与 Multi-Scale Structural Loss 联合监督，在 BraTS 2023 三个 MRI 转换任务上取得有竞争力的重建保真度与结构一致性。
Motivation: MRI 序列合成要补回缺失对比度并保住患者特异解剖，而生成机制的选择同时影响优化难度与源信息到达合成图像的路径；对抗、变分与扩散方案各自带来训练竞争或迭代开销。
Method: 监督式 standalone 融合驱动生成器：残差编码器采用全分辨率卷积 stem、池化分离的特征阶段与残差分支内的通道重标定 (channel recalibration)；嵌套多尺度解码器 (NMD) 反复融合空间特征并经单一输出头预测目标序列；损失为 L1 与 Multi-Scale Structural Loss (MSS) 联合监督，并在同一框架内做架构消融。
Result: 在 BraTS 2023 的三个 MRI 转换任务上取得有竞争力的重建保真度与结构一致性；消融评估通道重标定、NMD 与结构监督各自的作用；在 IXI 上补充评估以支持跨数据集与模态对的适用性，并在 BraTS 2019 上做零样本测试，给出跨数据集可迁移性的初步证据。
Conclusion: 直接监督生成是配对 MRI 序列合成的可行路线，改造后的编码与重建通路是结构保持的基础；跨数据集迁移目前只有初步证据。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Comparing Object Detection Models for Electrical Substation Component Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Electrical substations are a significant component of an electrical grid. Indeed, the assets at these substations (e.g., transformers) are vulnerable to hazards such as hurricanes, flooding, earthquakes, and geomagnetically induced currents (GICs). Because failures can have significant economic and public safety implications, identifying key substation components is essential for quantifying vulnerability. Unfortunately, traditional manual mapping of substation infrastructure is time-consuming and labor-intensive. Therefore, an autonomous solution utilizing computer vision models is preferable, as it offers greater convenience and efficiency. In this study, we train and compare 16 models on a manually labeled dataset of US substation images. These models include 12 You Only Look Once (YOLO) models, 2 Roboflow Detection Transformer (RF-DETR) models, and 2 Cascade R-CNN models. RF-DETR-large achieved the highest overall detection performance with mAP@50 and mAP@50:95 scores of 0.881 and 0.632, respectively. Across all models, alternate energy systems were detected most accurately, while transformers and reactors were more difficult to identify due to their smaller size and greater visual variability. Applying our best-performing model to nationwide imagery yielded approximately 22,591 component detections across 11,083 unique substations within the United States. These detections were broken down by state and Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) regions, with Florida (2,478 detections) and Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO; 4,329 detections) having the largest number of detections in their respective categories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 16 个目标检测模型在美国变电站航拍图像上做设备识别，RF-DETR-large 以 mAP@50 0.881、mAP@50:95 0.632 居首；把该模型跑遍全美影像，在 11,083 座变电站上得到约 22,591 个部件检测，替代能源设备最准、变压器与电抗器因尺寸小和外观差异大最难识别。
Motivation: 变电站资产面临飓风、洪水、地震与地磁感应电流 (GIC) 威胁，量化脆弱性需要识别关键部件，但人工标注变电站设施耗时费力，需要自主的计算机视觉方案。
Method: 在人工标注的美国变电站图像数据集上训练并比较 16 个检测模型：12 个 YOLO、2 个 Roboflow Detection Transformer (RF-DETR)、2 个 Cascade R-CNN；再把最优模型应用到全美影像，并按州与 FERC 区域统计检测数。
Result: RF-DETR-large 综合检测性能最高，mAP@50 为 0.881、mAP@50:95 为 0.632；全部模型中替代能源系统检测最准，变压器与电抗器因尺寸更小、视觉变化更大更难识别。全美影像上得到约 22,591 个部件检测，覆盖 11,083 座唯一变电站；佛罗里达州 2,478 个检测、MISO 区域 4,329 个检测，分别为各自类别最多。
Conclusion: RF-DETR-large 可作为变电站部件自动测绘的首选模型，检测结果能按州和 FERC 区域拆分以支撑电网脆弱性量化；小尺寸、高外观变异的部件仍是识别难点。

papers.title: GPF-Net: Gated Progressive Fusion Learning for Polyp Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Colonoscopic Polyp Re-Identification (ReID) aims to match the same polyp across a large gallery of images captured from different viewpoints and with different cameras, playing a critical role in computer-aided diagnosis for the prevention and treatment of colorectal cancer. However, the coarse granularity of high-level features often limits performance on small polyps, where fine-grained details are essential for accurate matching. To address this challenge, we propose a novel multimodal feature fusion architecture, termed the Gated Progressive Fusion Network, which selectively integrates features from multiple levels through fully connected gating mechanisms. Building on this framework, we introduce a gated progressive fusion strategy that enables layer-wise refinement of semantic information, facilitating multi-level feature interactions to enhance both generalization ability and robustness. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate the advantages of the multimodal setting over state-of-the-art unimodal ReID models, particularly when combined with the proposed fusion strategy tailored for general-purpose scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GPF-Net 用全连接门控把多层级特征选择性融合，逐层细化语义以补足高层特征在小息肉上的细粒度缺失。在标准息肉 ReID 基准上，多模态设定配合该融合策略优于最先进单模态 ReID 模型。
Motivation: 结肠镜息肉 ReID 需跨视角、跨相机匹配同一息肉，但高层特征粒度粗，小息肉的细粒度细节丢失导致匹配不准。
Method: 提出门控渐进融合网络 (Gated Progressive Fusion Network)：用全连接门控机制选择性整合多层级特征，并以门控渐进融合策略逐层细化语义信息，促进多层级特征交互。
Result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，多模态设定优于最先进单模态 ReID 模型，且与面向通用场景设计的融合策略结合时优势尤为明显。
Conclusion: 多层级门控渐进融合能提升息肉 ReID 的泛化能力与鲁棒性，多模态设定在通用场景下比单模态更有效。

papers.title: MatLat: Material Latent Space for PBR Texture Generation
papers.abstract_en: We propose a generative framework for producing high-quality PBR textures on a given 3D mesh. As large-scale PBR texture datasets are scarce, our approach focuses on effectively leveraging the embedding space and diffusion priors of pretrained latent image generative models while learning a material latent space, MatLat, through targeted fine-tuning. Unlike prior methods that freeze the embedding network, which leads to distribution shifts when encoding additional PBR channels and hinders subsequent diffusion training, we fine-tune the pretrained VAE so that new material channels can be incorporated with minimal latent distribution deviation. We further show that correspondence-aware attention alone is insufficient for cross-view consistency unless the latent-to-image mapping preserves locality. To enforce this locality, we introduce a regularization in the VAE fine-tuning that crops latent patches, decodes them, and aligns the corresponding image regions to maintain strong pixel-latent spatial correspondence. Ablation studies and comparison with previous baselines demonstrate that our framework improves PBR texture fidelity and that each component is critical for achieving state-of-the-art performance.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2026, pp. 4602-4612
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MatLat 针对给定 3D mesh 生成高质量 PBR 纹理：通过定向微调预训练 VAE 学到材质隐空间，使新增 PBR 通道以最小隐分布偏移被编码，并加入隐 patch 裁剪-解码-对齐正则来保持 latent-to-image 的局部性。消融与基线对比表明各组件对达到 SOTA 的 PBR 纹理保真度都不可或缺。
Motivation: 大规模 PBR 纹理数据稀缺，且既有方法冻结预训练 VAE 的 embedding 网络，在编码额外 PBR 通道时产生分布偏移，阻碍后续 diffusion 训练。
Method: 复用预训练 latent 图像生成模型的 embedding 空间与 diffusion 先验，定向微调 VAE 以纳入新材质通道并最小化隐分布偏移；引入正则：裁剪 latent patches、解码后与对应图像区域对齐，保证 pixel-latent 空间对应，从而让 correspondence-aware attention 真正支撑跨视图一致性。
Result: 消融研究与既有基线对比显示该框架提升 PBR 纹理保真度，且每个组件对达到 state-of-the-art 性能都关键。
Conclusion: 微调 VAE 保持隐空间局部性，是把预训练 diffusion 先验迁移到 PBR 纹理生成并取得 SOTA 的必要条件。

summary_sections.motivation: 大规模 PBR 纹理数据稀缺，且既有方法冻结预训练 VAE 的 embedding 网络，在编码额外 PBR 通道时产生分布偏移，阻碍后续 diffusion 训练。
summary_sections.method: 复用预训练 latent 图像生成模型的 embedding 空间与 diffusion 先验，定向微调 VAE 以纳入新材质通道并最小化隐分布偏移；引入正则：裁剪 latent patches、解码后与对应图像区域对齐，保证 pixel-latent 空间对应，从而让 correspondence-aware attention 真正支撑跨视图一致性。
summary_sections.result: 消融研究与既有基线对比显示该框架提升 PBR 纹理保真度，且每个组件对达到 state-of-the-art 性能都关键。
summary_sections.conclusion: 微调 VAE 保持隐空间局部性，是把预训练 diffusion 先验迁移到 PBR 纹理生成并取得 SOTA 的必要条件。

papers.title: Predictive Inorganic Synthesis based on Machine Learning using Small Data sets: a case study of Hydrodynamic Diameter-controlled Cu Nanoparticles
papers.abstract_en: Cu NPs have a broad applicability, yet their synthesis is sensitive to subtle changes in reaction parameters. This sensitivity, combined with the time- and resource-intensive nature of experimental optimization, poses a major challenge in achieving reproducible and size-controlled synthesis. While ML shows promise in materials research, its application is often limited by scarcity of large high-quality experimental data sets. This study explores ML to predict the DLS-derived hydrodynamic diameter of Cu NPs using a small data set of 25 syntheses. Latin Hypercube Sampling is used to efficiently cover the parameter space while creating the experimental data set. Ensemble regression models successfully predict hydrodynamic diameters with good predictive performance given the limited dataset. Since quantitative regression requires a unique DLS-derived hydrodynamic diameter, the regression model is restricted to mono-modal DLS distributions, while a complementary classification model identifies synthesis conditions for which quantitative prediction is applicable. Using equivalent out-of-sample validation, the ML and DoE models showed comparable generalization. The final ensemble model achieved an R2=0.74 compared to 0.60 for the DoE model, while retaining the complete synthesis parameter space, making it better suited for synthesis guidance. Additionally, classification models using both random forests and LLMs are evaluated to distinguish between large and small particles. These classification models exhibited only modest predictive performance, indicating that this small dataset is insufficient to fully exploit the capabilities of complex LLMs. Overall, this study demonstrates that carefully curated small data sets, paired with robust classical ML, can effectively support the synthesis of Cu NPs and highlights that for lab-scale studies, complex models like LLMs may offer limited benefits.
papers.comment: 15 pages (+16 pages SI), 5 figures (+16 SI), 4 tables (+11 SI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 25 组合成的极小数据集训练集成回归模型预测 Cu 纳米粒子的 DLS 流体力学直径，最终集成模型 R²=0.74，优于 DoE 模型的 0.60，且保留完整合成参数空间更适合指导合成。随机森林与 LLM 分类器区分大小粒子的表现平平，说明实验室规模下复杂模型收益有限。
Motivation: Cu 纳米粒子合成对反应参数的细微变化极为敏感，实验优化耗时耗资源；而 ML 在材料研究中的应用常受限于缺乏大规模高质量实验数据集。
Method: 用 Latin Hypercube Sampling 设计实验覆盖参数空间，构建 25 组合成的小数据集；以集成回归模型预测 DLS 流体力学直径，回归仅限单峰 DLS 分布，另配分类模型判断哪些合成条件适用定量预测；用等价样本外验证与 DoE 模型对比，并评估随机森林与 LLM 的大小粒子二分类。
Result: 最终集成模型 R²=0.74，DoE 模型 R²=0.60；等价样本外验证下 ML 与 DoE 泛化能力相当。随机森林与 LLM 分类器仅表现平平，表明该小数据集不足以发挥复杂 LLM 的能力。
Conclusion: 精心构建的小数据集配合稳健的经典 ML 即可有效支持 Cu 纳米粒子合成；对实验室规模研究，LLM 等复杂模型收益有限。

papers.title: HistCAD: Constraint-Aware Parametric CAD Histories for Evaluating Editability
papers.abstract_en: Sketch constraints specify geometric conditions for constructing and modifying parametric CAD models. We study whether predicted constraints allow a given history to reproduce the required initial model and support prescribed dimensional edits. We introduce HistCAD, an executable representation and dataset whose Academic and Industrial collections contain 180,495 parametric construction histories with entity-referenced sketch constraints and retained feature operations. Predictors receive these histories with the geometry and feature definitions retained and explicit sketch constraints removed. They generate constraints for every sketch without seeing the edit request. The benchmark compares models built with alternative constraint sets for the same history under the same dimensional edit. An edit succeeds when the model reproduces the required initial geometry, reaches the target value, preserves specified relations and unedited dimensions in the target sketch, and rebuilds through the complete history. A predictor trained on both collections and supplied with descriptions of the input histories achieves overall edit success of 52.4% on Academic and 29.0% on Industrial. Models retaining only endpoint-connectivity constraints in the target sketch and the history's constraints elsewhere can reach the target and rebuild while failing preservation. For all-sketch predictions, we retain the target-sketch prediction and restore the history's constraints in other sketches. More models then reproduce the required initial geometry, and some of these newly matched models complete the edit. HistCAD connects constraint learning to the construction and revision of parametric CAD models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HistCAD 提出可执行的参数化 CAD 历史表示与数据集，用「保留几何与特征、删去显式草图约束」的输入让预测器为每个草图补全约束，且不看编辑请求。在两集合上训练并给定历史描述的预测器，编辑成功率 Academic 52.4%、Industrial 29.0%；只留端点连接约束能到达目标并重建，但保不住未编辑尺寸与关系。
Motivation: 参数化 CAD 的草图约束决定历史能否复现初始模型并完成指定尺寸编辑，但现有学习工作缺少可执行、带约束与特征操作的历史级基准来判定编辑是否真正成功。
Method: 构建 HistCAD：Academic 与 Industrial 两集合共 180,495 条参数化构造历史，含实体引用的草图约束与保留的特征操作；预测器输入保留几何与特征、去掉显式约束的历史，为每个草图生成约束且不接触编辑请求。评测在同一历史、同一尺寸编辑下比较不同约束集，成功判据包括复现初始几何、到达目标值、保持目标草图中指定关系与未编辑尺寸、并能完整重建历史；对全草图预测只保留目标草图预测、其余草图恢复历史约束。
Result: 在两集合上训练并提供输入历史描述的预测器，整体编辑成功率 Academic 52.4%、Industrial 29.0%。目标草图只保留端点连接约束、其余历史用原约束的模型能到达目标并重建，但保不住 preservation。对全草图预测改为保留目标草图预测、其余恢复历史约束后，更多模型复现了所需初始几何，其中一部分还完成了编辑。
Conclusion: 约束学习可直接接到参数化 CAD 的构造与修改上，而编辑成功必须同时满足复现初始几何、到达目标、保持未编辑尺寸与关系、完整重建，单看能否到达目标会高估可用性。

papers.title: Learning Projection-Aware 360-Degree Image Rectification via Dual-Projection Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic cameras provide a 360° field of view and are widely used in panoramic vision, immersive visual computing, and robotic perception. However, changes in camera orientation can produce non-upright panoramas, introducing geometric variations that can complicate downstream visual analysis. Existing vision-based rectification methods usually operate within a single projection domain, limiting their ability to jointly exploit local geometric structures and global contextual information. To address this, we formulate 360° image rectification as a projection-aware representation learning problem and propose a dual-projection framework for upright panoramic rectification. A convolutional neural network branch captures local geometric structures from equirectangular projection (ERP) inputs, while a vision transformer branch models global contextual cues from cubemap projections. Cross-projection feature transformation and multi-level feature fusion enable effective interaction between these complementary representations. The learned representation supports collaborative inclination estimation and upright panorama generation, with the two tasks providing complementary geometric and appearance supervision. Experiments on SUN360 and M3D show consistent improvements over existing methods, achieving accuracies within a 1° error threshold of 65.9% and 85.2% and Fréchet Inception Distance scores of 5.87 and 3.26, respectively. Ablation studies verify the contributions of dual-projection representation, cross-projection feature transformation and fusion, and collaborative multi-task learning. The proposed framework provides a projection-aware visual computing approach for panoramic rectification. Code, pretrained models, and training/testing scripts are available at https://github.com/YuhaoShine/DualProjectionFusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 360° 全景矫正 (panorama rectification) 建模为投影感知表征学习：CNN 分支从 equirectangular projection (ERP) 提取局部几何，Vision Transformer 分支从 cubemap 建模全局上下文，经跨投影特征变换与多层融合后联合估计倾角并生成正立全景。在 SUN360 与 M3D 上，1° 误差阈值内的倾角准确率分别为 65.9% 与 85.2%，FID 为 5.87 与 3.26，均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 相机姿态变化会产生非正立全景，给下游视觉分析带来几何扰动；现有矫正方法多局限在单一投影域，无法同时利用局部几何结构与全局上下文。
Method: 双投影框架：CNN 分支吃 ERP 输入抓局部几何，Vision Transformer 分支吃 cubemap 抓全局线索，用跨投影特征变换与多级特征融合打通两种表征；表征同时支撑倾角估计与正立全景生成两个任务，二者提供几何与外观的互补监督。
Result: 在 SUN360 上倾角准确率（1° 阈值）65.9%、FID 5.87；在 M3D 上分别为 85.2% 与 3.66 以下的 3.26，均较现有方法一致提升；消融实验验证了双投影表征、跨投影变换与融合、以及协同多任务学习各自的贡献。
Conclusion: 投影感知的双投影融合加上几何与外观的双任务监督，是全景正立矫正的有效路径；代码、预训练模型与训练测试脚本已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Self-sufficient Independent Component Analysis for Demixing Flows
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning disentangled signals from data using non-linear Independent Component Analysis (ICA). Motivated by advances in self-supervised learning, we propose to learn self-sufficient signals: Given the remaining values of a recovered signal, observing other signals should not change the conditional distribution of its missing value. We formulate this problem as the minimization of a conditional KL divergence. Our algorithm is prior-free and likelihood-free in the sense that it prescribes neither parametric source densities nor an observation likelihood. To tackle the KL divergence minimization problem, we propose a sequential algorithm that learns a de-mixing flow model at each iteration, and prove local descent of the total correlation for its idealized Wasserstein-gradient-flow variant with exact velocities and a population projection condition. This approach completely avoids the unstable adversarial training, a common issue in minimizing the KL divergence. Experiments on toy and real-world datasets show the effectiveness of our method.
papers.comment: Added identifiability theorem, columnwise projection step, and additional experiments. Revised positioning of the method
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自足独立成分分析 (self-sufficient ICA)：要求恢复出的信号在给定自身其余取值时，观测其他信号不改变其缺失值的条件分布，并把该条件化为条件 KL 散度最小化。算法逐轮学习一个 de-mixing flow，避免对抗训练，在 toy 与真实数据集上验证有效。
Motivation: 非线性 ICA 的可辨识性通常依赖参数化源密度或观测似然，而用 KL 散度做解耦时常需不稳定的对抗训练。
Method: 以条件 KL 散度最小化刻画 self-sufficiency，提出逐轮训练 de-mixing flow 的序列式算法；对理想化的 Wasserstein 梯度流变体（精确速度 + population projection 条件）证明 total correlation 局部下降，并给出可辨识性定理与 columnwise projection 步骤。方法 prior-free、likelihood-free，不设参数化源密度或观测似然，也完全避开对抗训练。
Result: 在 toy 与真实世界数据集上的实验显示方法有效；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 用条件自足性替代源密度假设，可以在不引入对抗训练的前提下做非线性 ICA 解耦，并有 total correlation 局部下降与可辨识性保证。

papers.title: HENet++: Hybrid Encoding and Multi-task Learning for 3D Perception and End-to-end Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional feature extraction and multi-task perception are fundamental components of modern autonomous driving systems. Although large image encoders, high-resolution inputs, and long temporal contexts can substantially improve representation quality and overall performance, jointly leveraging these strategies remains challenging due to prohibitive computational costs during both training and inference. Furthermore, different perception tasks often require distinct feature representations, making it difficult for a unified architecture to achieve end-to-end multi-task performance comparable to specialized single-task systems. To address these challenges, we propose HENet++, a unified framework for multi-task 3D perception and end-to-end autonomous driving that employs a hybrid image encoding strategy, using a large encoder for short-term frames and a lightweight encoder for long-term temporal context to strike a favorable balance between accuracy and efficiency. The framework jointly extracts dense background features and sparse foreground features, enabling task-specific representations that reduce cumulative errors and provide richer information for downstream prediction and planning modules. HENet++ is compatible with diverse 3D feature extraction pipelines and supports multi-modal inputs, including camera and radar data. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the nuScenes multi-task 3D perception benchmark, achieving the lowest collision rate on the nuScenes planning benchmark and higher PDMS on the NAVSIM benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IJCV. Project Page: https://github.com/VDIGPKU/HENet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HENet++ 用混合图像编码（短期帧走大编码器、长时序上下文走轻量编码器）统一 3D 感知与端到端自动驾驶多任务学习，联合提取稠密背景与稀疏前景特征以压低累积误差。在 nuScenes 多任务 3D 感知基准上达到 SOTA，并在 nuScenes planning 基准取得最低碰撞率、在 NAVSIM 取得更高 PDMS。
Motivation: 大编码器、高分辨率输入与长时序上下文能提升表征质量，但三者联用的训练与推理开销过高；且不同感知任务需要不同特征，统一架构难以追平专用单任务系统。
Method: 混合图像编码策略：短期帧用大编码器、长时序上下文用轻量编码器；联合提取稠密背景特征与稀疏前景特征，形成任务特定表征供下游预测与规划模块使用；框架兼容多种 3D 特征提取管线，支持相机与雷达多模态输入。
Result: 在 nuScenes 多任务 3D 感知基准上达到 state-of-the-art；在 nuScenes planning 基准取得最低碰撞率 (lowest collision rate)；在 NAVSIM 基准取得更高 PDMS。

papers.title: AyurParam: A State-of-the-Art Bilingual Language Model for Ayurveda
papers.abstract_en: Current large language models excel at broad, general-purpose tasks, but consistently underperform when exposed to highly specialized domains that require deep cultural, linguistic, and subject-matter expertise. In particular, traditional medical systems such as Ayurveda embody centuries of nuanced textual and clinical knowledge that mainstream LLMs fail to accurately interpret or apply. We introduce AyurParam-2.9B, a domain-specialized, bilingual language model fine-tuned from Param-1-2.9B using an extensive, expertly curated Ayurveda dataset spanning classical texts and clinical guidance. AyurParam's dataset incorporates context-aware, reasoning, and objective-style Q&A in both English and Hindi, with rigorous annotation protocols for factual precision and instructional clarity. Benchmarked on BhashaBench-Ayur, AyurParam not only surpasses all open-source instruction-tuned models in its size class (1.5--3B parameters), but also demonstrates competitive or superior performance compared to much larger models. The results from AyurParam highlight the necessity for authentic domain adaptation and high-quality supervision in delivering reliable, culturally congruent AI for specialized medical knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AyurParam-2.9B 是从 Param-1-2.9B 微调出的阿育吠陀 (Ayurveda) 双语（英语+印地语）领域模型，训练数据由专家整理，覆盖经典文本与临床指导，含语境感知、推理与客观题式 Q&A。在 BhashaBench-Ayur 上，它在 1.5–3B 参数档超过全部开源指令微调模型，并与远大于它的模型相当或更优。
Motivation: 主流 LLM 在需要深厚文化、语言与专业领域知识的传统医学（如阿育吠陀）上持续表现不佳，无法准确解读与应用经典文本和临床知识。
Method: 以 Param-1-2.9B 为基座做领域微调，训练集为专家整理的阿育吠陀数据，含英语与印地语双语的语境感知、推理与客观题式 Q&A，并采用严格标注规范保证事实准确性与教学清晰度；评测基准为 BhashaBench-Ayur。
Result: 在 BhashaBench-Ayur 上，AyurParam 超过同规模（1.5–3B 参数）的全部开源指令微调模型，且与参数量大得多的模型相比表现相当或更优。
Conclusion: 可靠且文化契合的专业医学 AI 依赖真实领域适配与高质量监督，而非通用模型规模。

papers.title: Deep reinforcement learning for optimal trading with partial information
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has attracted increasing interest in financial applications, including optimal trading and execution. However, the use of RL for optimal trading strategies that exploit latent information in the market has been, to the best of our knowledge, subject to little attention. In this paper, we consider an optimal trading problem in which the trading signal follows an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with regime switching parameters. The problem is naturally formulated as a partially observable Markov decision problem, requiring a trader to infer latent information directly from the history of the observable process. We combine recurrent neural networks (RNN) with RL to address both the filtering and trading components of the problem. More specifically, we propose three distinct RL-based approaches, on top of which we incorporate RNN to filter the latent state of the environment where the agent is trading. The first, a one-step approach, directly encodes hidden states from the GRU into the RL trader. The second and third are two-step methods: one that uses posterior regime probability estimates for the mean reverting regimes, while the other relies on forecasts of the next signal value. Through extensive simulations with increasingly complex Markovian regime dynamics for the trading signal's parameters, as well as an empirical application to equity pairs trading, we find that feeding posterior probability estimates on the latent long-run mean reversion regime achieves superior cumulative rewards and exhibits more interpretable strategies, in contrast with the other two approaches. Overall, our results show that the quality and structure of the information supplied to the agent are important for trading performance and policy interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把带 regime switching 的 OU 交易信号写成部分可观测 MDP，用 RNN(GRU) 做滤波、RL 做交易，提出三种方案：一步法直接把 GRU 隐状态喂给 RL 交易器，两步法分别喂后验 regime 概率或下一步信号预测。在逐级复杂的 Markov regime 仿真与股票配对交易实盘应用中，喂后验长期均值回复 regime 概率的方案累计回报最高且策略更可解释。
Motivation: RL 在最优交易与执行中已被广泛研究，但利用市场潜在 (latent) 信息的 RL 交易策略几乎无人处理；信号参数带 regime switching 时，交易者只能从可观测过程历史中推断隐状态。
Method: 将问题建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程 (POMDP)，交易信号服从参数带 regime switching 的 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程；用 GRU 循环网络做隐状态滤波，叠加三种 RL 方案：一步法直接编码 GRU 隐状态，两步法之一用均值回复 regime 的后验概率估计，另一用下一步信号值预测。
Result: 在逐级复杂的 Markov regime 动态仿真与股票配对交易 (equity pairs trading) 实证中，喂入隐含长期均值回复 regime 后验概率估计的方案取得更优累计回报，且策略更具可解释性，优于一步法与信号预测法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 喂给 agent 的信息的质量与结构同时决定交易绩效与策略可解释性，因此在 POMDP 交易中应优先输入结构化的后验 regime 概率而非原始隐状态或原始信号预测。

papers.title: RT-DETRv4: Painlessly Furthering Real-Time Object Detection with Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Real-time object detection has achieved substantial progress through meticulously designed architectures and optimization strategies. However, the pursuit of high-speed inference via lightweight network designs often leads to degraded feature representation, which hinders further performance improvements and practical on-device deployment. In this paper, we propose a cost-effective and highly adaptable distillation framework that harnesses the rapidly evolving capabilities of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to enhance lightweight object detectors. Given the significant architectural and learning objective disparities between VFMs and resource-constrained detectors, achieving stable and task-aligned semantic transfer is challenging. To address this, on one hand, we introduce a \textbf{Deep Semantic Injector (DSI)} module that facilitates the integration of high-level representations from VFMs into the deep layers of the detector. On the other hand, we devise a \textbf{Gradient-guided Adaptive Modulation (GAM)} strategy, which dynamically adjusts the intensity of semantic transfer based on gradient norm ratios. Without increasing deployment and inference overhead, our approach painlessly delivers striking and consistent performance gains across diverse DETR-based models, underscoring its practical utility for real-time detection. Our new model family, RT-DETRv4, achieves state-of-the-art results on COCO, attaining AP scores of $49.8/53.7/55.4/57.0$ at corresponding speeds of $273/169/124/78$ FPS. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/RT-DETRs/RT-DETRv4.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RT-DETRv4 用蒸馏框架把 Vision Foundation Models 的高层语义注入轻量 DETR 系检测器：DSI 模块把 VFM 高层表征送进检测器深层，GAM 按梯度范数比动态调节迁移强度，且不增加部署与推理开销。COCO 上 AP 达 49.8/53.7/55.4/57.0，对应速度 273/169/124/78 FPS。
Motivation: 轻量网络设计换取高速推理会削弱特征表征，制约实时检测的进一步提升与端侧部署；而 VFM 与资源受限检测器在架构和学习目标上差异大，语义迁移难以稳定且对齐任务。
Method: 提出面向 DETR 系检测器的蒸馏框架：Deep Semantic Injector (DSI) 将 VFM 高层表征整合进检测器深层；Gradient-guided Adaptive Modulation (GAM) 依据梯度范数比动态调整语义迁移强度，不引入部署与推理开销。
Result: RT-DETRv4 在 COCO 上取得 AP 49.8/53.7/55.4/57.0，对应速度 273/169/124/78 FPS；在多种 DETR 系模型上给出一致的性能提升，代码已公开。
Conclusion: 借助 VFM 做免改造（painless）蒸馏可在不增加推理开销的前提下持续提升实时目标检测，使 RT-DETRv4 家族在 COCO 达到 state-of-the-art。
