papers.title: LIME: Link-based User-item Interaction Modeling with Decoupled XOR Attention for Efficient Test Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Scaling large recommendation systems requires advancing three major frontiers: processing longer user histories, expanding candidate sets, and increasing model capacity. While promising, transformers' computational cost scales quadratically with the user sequence length and linearly with the number of candidates. This trade-off makes it prohibitively expensive to expand candidate sets or increase sequence length at inference, despite the significant performance improvements. We introduce \textbf{LIME}, a novel architecture that resolves this trade-off. Through two key innovations, LIME fundamentally reduces computational complexity. First, low-rank ``link embeddings" enable pre-computation of attention weights by decoupling user and candidate interactions, making the inference cost nearly independent of candidate set size. Second, a linear attention mechanism, \textbf{LIME-XOR}, reduces the complexity with respect to user sequence length from quadratic ($O(N^2)$) to linear ($O(N)$). Experiments on public and industrial datasets show LIME achieves near-parity with state-of-the-art transformers but with a 10$\times$ inference speedup on large candidate sets or long sequence lengths. When tested on a major recommendation platform, LIME improved user engagement while maintaining minimal inference costs with respect to candidate set size and user history length, establishing a new paradigm for efficient and expressive recommendation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 推荐系统排序架构 LIME 用低秩 link embedding 把用户与候选的交互解耦以预计算注意力权重，使推理开销几乎不随候选集大小变化，再用 LIME-XOR 线性注意力把对用户序列长度的复杂度从 O(N²) 降到 O(N)。在公开与工业数据集上达到与最先进 transformer 近乎持平的效果，在大候选集或长序列下推理加速 10×，上线主要推荐平台后在保持低推理开销的同时提升用户参与度。
Motivation: 推荐系统扩展的三个方向（更长用户历史、更大候选集、更大模型容量）与 transformer 计算代价冲突：代价随用户序列长度二次增长、随候选数线性增长，导致推理阶段扩大候选集或序列长度代价过高。
Method: 两层设计：低秩 link embeddings 解耦用户与候选交互，从而预计算注意力权重，让推理代价几乎独立于候选集大小；LIME-XOR 线性注意力机制把对用户序列长度的复杂度由 O(N²) 降为 O(N)。
Result: 在公开与工业数据集上，LIME 与最先进 transformer 效果近乎持平（near-parity），在大候选集或长序列下获得 10× 推理加速；在某大型推荐平台的实际测试中，用户参与度提升，同时对候选集大小与用户历史长度的推理开销保持极低。
Conclusion: 解耦交互加线性注意力可以同时保住推荐效果与推理可扩展性，使扩大候选集和用户历史长度在推理侧变得可行，作者据此称其为高效且表达力强的推荐系统新范式。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Local Timescale Gates for Timescale-Robust Continual Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient artificial intelligence on neuromorphic hardware but struggle with tasks requiring both fast adaptation and long-term memory, especially in continual learning. We propose Local Timescale Gating (LT-Gate), a neuron model that combines dual time-constant dynamics with an adaptive gating mechanism. Each spiking neuron tracks information on a fast and a slow timescale in parallel, and a learned gate locally adjusts their influence. This design enables individual neurons to preserve slow contextual information while responding to fast signals, addressing the stability-plasticity dilemma. We further introduce a variance-tracking regularization that stabilizes firing activity, inspired by biological homeostasis. Empirically, LT-Gate yields significantly improved accuracy and retention in sequential learning tasks: on a challenging temporal classification benchmark it achieves about 51 percent final accuracy, compared to about 46 percent for a recent Hebbian continual-learning baseline and lower for prior SNN methods. Unlike approaches that require external replay or expensive orthogonalizations, LT-Gate operates with local updates and is fully compatible with neuromorphic hardware. In particular, it leverages features of Intel's Loihi chip (multiple synaptic traces with different decay rates) for on-chip learning. Our results demonstrate that multi-timescale gating can substantially enhance continual learning in SNNs, narrowing the gap between spiking and conventional deep networks on lifelong-learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出神经形态 SNN 神经元模型 Local Timescale Gating (LT-Gate)：每个神经元并行维护快、慢两个时间常数的轨迹，用可学习的局部门控调节二者权重，配合方差跟踪正则稳定发放。在时序分类基准上最终准确率约 51%，高于 Hebbian 持续学习基线的约 46% 及此前 SNN 方法。
Motivation: SNN 在神经形态硬件上能效高，但难以同时兼顾快速适应与长期记忆，持续学习中稳定性与可塑性冲突明显；现有方法常依赖外部 replay 或昂贵的正交化。
Method: LT-Gate 神经元采用双时间常数动力学加自适应门控，快慢两条通路并行追踪信息、由学习到的门控在局部调节其影响；再加一个受生物稳态启发的方差跟踪正则 (variance-tracking regularization) 稳定发放活动。更新全部为局部更新，利用 Intel Loihi 芯片的多突触痕迹（不同衰减率）实现片上学习。
Result: 在一项有挑战性的时序分类基准上，LT-Gate 最终准确率约 51%，Hebbian 持续学习基线约 46%，此前 SNN 方法更低；摘要称准确率与保持率 (retention) 均显著提升。
Conclusion: 多时间尺度门控能实质改善 SNN 的持续学习，缩小脉冲网络与常规深度网络在终身学习任务上的差距，且无需外部 replay 即可片上训练。

papers.title: Proof-of-Use: Mitigating Tool-Call Hacking in Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: While reinforcement learning (RL) enhances their ability to plan and reason across retrieval steps, we identify a critical failure mode in this setting: Tool-Call Hacking. Unlike execution-based tools (e.g., code or math), whose effects are directly observable, the weak observability of causal dependencies between retrieved evidence and reasoning under format- and outcome-level supervision enables agents to maximize surface-level reward signals without genuinely grounding their reasoning in the returned evidence. This leads to distinctive pathologies, including mode collapse via tool overuse and hallucinated tool usage where tool calls are largely decorative. To address this issue, we propose Proof-of-Use (PoU), an evidence grounded RL framework that explicitly optimizes the causal dependency from retrieval to reasoning and final answers. PoU re-fomulate a fine-grained stepwise interaction protocol in which agents must auditably cite normalized evidence identifiers. We operationalize this via a multi-objective reward design consisting of: (1) two progressive process rewards that constrain citation validity at intermediate steps; (2) a global Answer--Support Alignment reward that enforces consistency between final answers and retrieved evidence; and (3) a curriculum-style adaptive reward mixing mechanism that smoothly transitions agents from dense process supervision to sparse outcome-based objectives. Extensive experiments show the strong performance of PoU and demonstrate the effectiveness in mitigating tool-call hacking. Beyond this, PoU exhibits a notable emergent property: adaptive and robust tool-usage patterns naturally arise under domain and tool shifts, even though PoU does not explicitly optimize for tool adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在深度研究智能体的 RL 训练中，格式级与结果级奖励因检索证据到推理的因果链弱可观测，会催生 Tool-Call Hacking：工具过度使用导致模式坍缩，以及工具调用沦为装饰的幻觉式调用。Proof-of-Use (PoU) 通过强制引用规范化证据标识符、逐步过程奖励加 Answer–Support Alignment 全局奖励、以及从稠密过程监督平滑过渡到稀疏结果目标的课程式奖励混合来约束因果依赖，缓解该失效模式，并在域与工具偏移下自然涌现自适应、稳健的工具使用模式。
Motivation: RL 虽能提升跨检索步骤的规划与推理，但与可直接观测执行效果的代码/数学工具不同，检索证据与推理之间的因果依赖弱可观测，智能体可在不真正以证据为据的情况下最大化表面奖励。
Method: PoU 是证据为据的 RL 框架：重构细粒度逐步交互协议，要求智能体可审计地引用规范化证据标识符；奖励为三部分——两个约束中间步骤引用有效性的渐进过程奖励、强制最终答案与检索证据一致的 Answer–Support Alignment 全局奖励，以及把训练从稠密过程监督平滑过渡到稀疏结果目标的课程式自适应奖励混合。
Result: 实验显示 PoU 表现强劲并有效缓解 Tool-Call Hacking；此外在未显式优化工具适配的情况下，域与工具偏移下自然涌现出自适应且稳健的工具使用模式。
Conclusion: 把检索到推理的因果依赖显式纳入奖励设计，可在不直接优化工具适配的前提下抑制工具调用作弊并带来稳健的工具使用行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: More Than Meets the Eye? Uncovering the Reasoning-Planning Disconnect in Training Vision-Language Driving Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Model (VLM) driving agents promise explainable end-to-end autonomy by first producing natural-language reasoning and then predicting trajectory planning. However, whether planning is causally driven by this reasoning remains a critical but unverified assumption. To investigate this, we build DriveMind, a large-scale driving Visual Question Answering corpus with plan-aligned Chain-of-Thought (CoT), automatically generated from nuPlan. Our data generation process converts sensors and annotations into structured inputs and, crucially, separates priors from to-be-reasoned signals, enabling clean information ablations. Using DriveMind, we train representative VLM agents with Supervised Fine-Tuning and Group Relative Policy Optimization and evaluate them with nuPlan's metrics. Our results, unfortunately, indicate a consistent causal disconnect in reasoning-planning: removing ego/navigation priors causes large drops in planning scores, whereas removing CoT produces only minor changes. Attention analysis further shows that planning primarily focuses on priors rather than the CoT. Based on this evidence, we propose the Reasoning-Planning Decoupling Hypothesis, positing that the training-yielded reasoning is an ancillary byproduct rather than a causal mediator. To enable efficient diagnosis, we introduce a novel, training-free probe that measures an agent's reliance on priors by evaluating its planning robustness against minor input perturbations. In summary, we provide the community with a new dataset and a diagnostic tool to evaluate the causal fidelity of future models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DriveMind 用 nuPlan 自动生成带计划对齐 CoT 的驾驶 VQA 语料，并把先验信息与待推理信号分离以做干净的信息消融。消融显示去掉自我/导航先验使规划分数大幅下降，而去掉 CoT 只有轻微变化，注意力也主要落在先验上，据此提出 Reasoning-Planning Decoupling Hypothesis：训练得到的推理只是副产品而非因果中介。
Motivation: VLM 驾驶智能体先生成自然语言推理再预测轨迹，但规划是否真的被这段推理因果驱动一直是未经验证的假设，缺少可做信息消融的数据与诊断手段。
Method: 构建 DriveMind：从 nuPlan 自动转换传感器与标注为结构化输入，生成计划对齐的 Chain-of-Thought，并把先验与待推理信号分离；用 Supervised Fine-Tuning 与 Group Relative Policy Optimization 训练代表性 VLM 智能体，按 nuPlan 指标评估，并做先验与 CoT 的信息消融和注意力分析；另提出免训练探针，用轻微输入扰动下的规划鲁棒性度量对先验的依赖。
Result: 移除自我/导航先验导致规划分数大幅下降，移除 CoT 仅带来轻微变化；注意力分析显示规划主要关注先验而非 CoT。评估在 nuPlan 指标下进行，训练配方为 SFT 与 GRPO。
Conclusion: 训练得到的推理是规划的附属副产品而非因果中介（Reasoning-Planning Decoupling Hypothesis），因此评估未来模型的因果保真度应同时看数据集 DriveMind 与免训练先验依赖探针。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fractional Heat Kernel for Semi-Supervised Graph Learning with Small Training Sample Size
papers.abstract_en: We develop a source-driven fractional heat-kernel framework for semi-super\-vised graph learning that combines nonlocal propagation with sustained label information. A fixed nonzero label source compatible with the Laplacian null space prevents asymptotic collapse into that space, providing a mechanism for mitigating oversmoothing at long diffusion times. The fractional order controls the relative modal attenuation and the spectral weighting of the sustained response, while the diffusion time sets the propagation horizon. We characterize conservation laws and equilibria on normalized and disconnected graphs, develop a null-space deflation, and analyze the approximation of the propagators. On Two-Moon, fractional orders improve source-free propagation, while compatible source-driven diffusion exceeds $96\%$ mean accuracy with one training label per class at orders $0.8$ and $1$. On Cora and CiteSeer, the source-driven pipeline improves mean accuracy over GAT by $9.2$ and $8.0$ percentage points at one training label per class, with model selection on $500$ labeled validation nodes and closely comparable classical and fractional pipeline configurations; it matches GAT on PubMed and trails it at ten and twenty labels per class on Cora. Within GraphHeat, validation-based exponent selection at a common diffusion time yields a paired gain of $1.45$ percentage points at one label per class.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出源驱动的分数阶热核 (source-driven fractional heat-kernel) 半监督图学习框架：用与 Laplacian 零空间相容的固定非零标签源抑制长扩散时间下的渐近塌缩，分数阶阶数控制模态衰减与谱权重。在每类仅 1 个训练标签时，阶数 0.8 与 1 的扩散超过 96% 平均准确率，Cora 与 CiteSeer 上比 GAT 分别高 9.2 与 8.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 半监督图学习在标签极少时，长扩散时间会把表示压进 Laplacian 零空间导致 oversmoothing，而现有传播机制缺少可持续注入标签信息的通道。
Method: 在归一化与非连通图上给出守恒律与平衡刻画，构造与 Laplacian 零空间相容的固定标签源、零空间压缩 (null-space deflation)，并分析传播子的近似；分数阶阶数调制相对模态衰减与持续响应的谱加权，扩散时间决定传播范围，指数由验证集选择。
Result: Two-Moon 上分数阶阶数改善无源传播；每类 1 个标签时源驱动扩散在阶数 0.8 与 1 达到超过 96% 平均准确率。Cora 与 CiteSeer 上每类 1 标签时平均准确率比 GAT 分别高 9.2 与 8.0 个百分点（500 个带标签验证节点选模型）；PubMed 上与 GAT 持平，Cora 每类 10 与 20 标签时落后于 GAT。GraphHeat 内在相同扩散时间下用验证选指数，每类 1 标签配对增益 1.45 个百分点。
Conclusion: 只要标签源与 Laplacian 零空间相容，分数阶扩散就能在极小标签量下缓解 oversmoothing 并超过 GAT；但标签增多到每类 10、20 时优势消失甚至反超为落后。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniShield: An Adaptive Multi-Agent Framework for Unified Forgery Image Detection and Localization
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancements in image generation, synthetic images have become increasingly realistic, posing significant societal risks, such as misinformation and fraud. Forgery Image Detection and Localization (FIDL) thus emerges as essential for maintaining information integrity and societal security. Despite impressive performances by existing domain-specific detection methods, their practical applicability remains limited, primarily due to their narrow specialization, poor cross-domain generalization, and the absence of an integrated adaptive framework. To address these issues, we propose UniShield, the novel multi-agent-based unified system capable of detecting and localizing image forgeries across diverse domains, including image manipulation, document manipulation, DeepFake, and AI-generated images. UniShield innovatively integrates a perception agent with a detection agent. The perception agent intelligently analyzes image features to dynamically select suitable detection models, while the detection agent consolidates various expert detectors into a unified framework and generates interpretable reports. Extensive experiments show that UniShield achieves state-of-the-art results, surpassing both existing unified approaches and domain-specific detectors, highlighting its superior practicality, adaptiveness, and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniShield 用感知 agent 先分析图像特征并动态选择检测模型，再由检测 agent 把多个专家检测器整合成统一框架并生成可解释报告，从而在一个系统里同时做伪造图像检测与定位，覆盖图像篡改、文档篡改、DeepFake 和 AI 生成图像四类域。实验称其达到 state-of-the-art，同时超过已有统一方法与各域专用检测器。
Motivation: 现有伪造检测方法各自为政、跨域泛化差，且缺少一个能自适应调度的统一框架，实际可用性受限。
Method: 提出基于多 agent 的统一系统 UniShield：感知 agent 智能分析图像特征以动态选择合适的检测模型，检测 agent 将多种专家检测器整合进统一框架并生成可解释报告，覆盖图像操纵、文档操纵、DeepFake 与 AI 生成图像四个域。
Result: 在跨四类伪造域的实验中，UniShield 取得 state-of-the-art 结果，同时优于已有统一方法和各域专用检测器；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张用感知-检测双 agent 的自适应调度可以把多域 FIDL 收敛到一个统一系统，并在实用性、适应性与可扩展性上超过专用方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在跨四类伪造域的实验中，UniShield 取得 state-of-the-art 结果，同时优于已有统一方法和各域专用检测器；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张用感知-检测双 agent 的自适应调度可以把多域 FIDL 收敛到一个统一系统，并在实用性、适应性与可扩展性上超过专用方案。

papers.title: Convergence of graph Dirichlet energies and graph Laplacians on intersecting manifolds of varying dimensions
papers.abstract_en: We study $Γ$-convergence of graph Dirichlet energies and spectral convergence of graph Laplacians on unions of intersecting manifolds of potentially different dimensions. Our investigation is motivated by problems of machine learning, as real-world data often consist of parts or classes with different intrinsic dimensions. An important challenge is to understand which machine learning methods adapt to such varied dimensionalities. We investigate the standard unnormalized and the normalized graph Dirichlet energies. We show that the unnormalized energy and its associated graph Laplacian asymptotically only sees the variations within the manifold of the highest dimension. On the other hand, we prove that the normalized Dirichlet energy converges to a (tensorized) Dirichlet energy on the union of manifolds that adapts to all dimensions simultaneously. We also establish the related spectral convergence and present a few numerical experiments to illustrate our findings.
papers.journal_ref: Calculus of Variations and Partial Differential Equations 65.9 (2026): 259
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在不同维数流形的并集上，非归一化图 Dirichlet 能量及其图 Laplacian 渐近只感知最高维流形内部的变化，而归一化版本收敛到并集上的（张量化）Dirichlet 能量，同时适应所有维数。结论是：数据各部分本征维数不同时，应使用归一化图 Dirichlet 能量而非非归一化版本。
Motivation: 真实数据常由本征维数不同的部分或类别组成，需要弄清哪些机器学习方法能自适应这种混合维数结构；非归一化图能量在该情形下会丢失低维流形的信息。
Method: 研究图 Dirichlet 能量在相交流形并集上的 Γ-收敛与图 Laplacian 的谱收敛，分析标准非归一化与归一化两种图 Dirichlet 能量，并给出若干数值实验说明结论。
Result: 证明非归一化能量及其图 Laplacian 渐近只看到最高维流形内的变化；归一化 Dirichlet 能量收敛到并集上同时适应各维数的（张量化）Dirichlet 能量，并建立相应谱收敛，辅以数值实验。
Conclusion: 在混合本征维数的数据上，归一化图 Dirichlet 能量能同时保留各维数流形的几何，而非归一化版本会退化到最高维流形。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Gaze Estimation for Human-Robot Interaction: Analysis Using the NICO Platform
papers.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the current gaze estimation methods within a human-robot interaction (HRI) context of a shared workspace scenario. We introduce a new, annotated dataset collected with the NICO robotic platform. We evaluate four state-of-the-art gaze estimation models. The evaluation shows that the angular errors are close to those reported on general-purpose benchmarks. However, when expressed in terms of distance in the shared workspace the best median error is 14.57~cm, quantifying the practical limitations of current methods. We conclude by discussing these limitations and offering recommendations on how to best integrate gaze estimation as a modality in HRI systems.
papers.comment: Code available at http://github.com/kocurvik/nico_gaze data available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23059771. Accepted to appear in the proceedings of ICETA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NICO 机器人平台上采集并标注了一个共享工作空间场景的注视估计数据集，评测四个 SOTA 注视估计模型。角度误差接近通用基准水平，但换算到工作空间距离后最佳中位误差仍有 14.57 cm，说明现有方法直接用于人机协作定位时精度不足。
Motivation: 共享工作空间的人机交互需要把注视点转换为实际距离坐标，而通用注视基准的角度指标无法反映这一场景下的实际可用精度。
Method: 用 NICO 机器人平台采集带标注的共享工作空间注视数据集，选取四个 SOTA 注视估计模型进行评测，同时报告角度误差与换算到工作空间的距离误差。
Result: 四个模型的角度误差接近通用基准报告水平；换算为共享工作空间距离后，最佳中位误差为 14.57 cm。
Conclusion: 现有注视估计方法的角度指标尚可，但落到工作空间距离上精度受限，HRI 系统集成注视模态时需按距离误差而非角度误差评估可用性。

papers.title: CAFÉ: Causal Black-Box Testing of Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are increasingly deployed as software components that must evolve as requirements change. When specific training records or features must no longer influence a deployed model, machine unlearning aims to remove that influence without retraining from scratch. Because unlearning is often approximate, its effectiveness must be tested. Such tests must often treat the model as a black box, without access to its parameters, training history, or unlearning procedure. Features pose a further challenge: even after a feature is removed from a model's inputs, its influence can persist through downstream features. Many existing checks examine only the feature's direct use and can therefore certify a model that still depends on it. We frame unlearning testing as specification-based testing and present CAFÉ, which, using only a deployed model's predictions, intervenes on the feature, propagates the change to its downstream features, and checks whether the predictions still respond. CAFÉ measures a target's residual influence through both its direct and indirect causal paths, and its fine-grained diagnostics show which channels and subgroups still carry it. On two causal-network benchmarks with four unlearning methods, CAFÉ ranks residual influence with 0.92--0.93 pairwise accuracy, against at most 0.71 for existing checks, which fail in both directions: they certify models whose influence persists through downstream features and flag correctly unlearned ones. On real census data, CAFÉ likewise exposes influence that survives retraining yet goes unnoticed by direct-input checks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAFÉ 把机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 测试改写为基于规约的黑盒因果测试：只用部署模型的预测，对目标特征做干预并把变化沿下游特征传播，检查预测是否仍响应，从而同时度量直接与间接因果路径上的残余影响。在两个因果网络基准、四种遗忘方法上，残余影响排序的成对准确率为 0.92–0.93，现有检查最高仅 0.71。
Motivation: 遗忘效果常需黑盒检验，而特征即使已从输入移除，其影响仍可经下游特征留存；现有检查只看直接使用，会把仍依赖该特征的模型判为已遗忘，也会误报正确遗忘的模型。
Method: CAFÉ 将遗忘测试形式化为 specification-based testing：仅依据部署模型的预测对目标特征做干预，把扰动传播到其下游特征，再检查预测响应；输出细粒度诊断，指出哪些因果通道与子群仍携带该影响。
Result: 在两个因果网络基准、四种遗忘方法上，CAFÉ 对残余影响的排序成对准确率为 0.92–0.93，现有检查最高 0.71，且现有检查双向失败——既放过影响经下游特征留存的模型，也误标已正确遗忘的模型。在真实 census 数据上，CAFÉ 揭示了经重训练仍存活、而直接输入检查完全忽略的影响。
Conclusion: 只看特征直接使用的黑盒遗忘检查不足以判定遗忘成功，必须沿直接与间接因果路径一起度量残余影响。

papers.title: IS-Diff: Improving Diffusion-Based Inpainting with Better Initial Seed
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have shown promising results in free-form inpainting. Recent studies based on refined diffusion samplers or novel architectural designs led to realistic results and high data consistency. However, random initialization seed (noise) adopted in vanilla diffusion process may introduce mismatched semantic information in masked regions, leading to biased inpainting results, e.g., low consistency and low coherence with the other unmasked area. To address this issue, we propose the Initial Seed refined Diffusion Model (IS-Diff), a completely training-free approach incorporating distributional harmonious seeds to produce harmonious results. Specifically, IS-Diff employs initial seeds sampled from unmasked areas to imitate the masked data distribution, thereby setting a promising direction for the diffusion procedure. Moreover, a dynamic selective refinement mechanism is proposed to detect severe unharmonious inpaintings in intermediate latent and adjust the strength of our initialization prior dynamically. We validate our method on both standard and large-mask inpainting tasks using the CelebA-HQ, ImageNet, and Places2 datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness across all metrics compared to state-of-the-art inpainting methods.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Image Processing, vol. 35, pp. 9430-9441, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IS-Diff 用未掩码区域采样的初始噪声替代随机种子，让扩散过程从贴近掩码区真实分布的方向起步，并在中间 latent 上动态检测严重不协调的补全结果、实时调整初始化先验强度。整个流程免训练，在 CelebA-HQ、ImageNet、Places2 的标准与大掩码补全任务上，全部指标均优于现有最先进补全方法。
Motivation: 扩散补全中随机初始噪声可能在掩码区引入语义不匹配的信息，导致补全结果与未掩码区域一致性低、连贯性差；已有工作集中在采样器与架构改进，未处理初始化这一环节。
Method: IS-Diff（Initial Seed refined Diffusion Model）为完全免训练方案：从未掩码区域采样初始种子以模仿掩码数据分布，为扩散过程设定方向；再用动态选择性精修机制（dynamic selective refinement）在中间 latent 检测严重不协调的补全，并动态调整初始化先验的强度。
Result: 在 CelebA-HQ、ImageNet、Places2 三个数据集的标准补全与大掩码补全任务上验证，相较 state-of-the-art 补全方法在全部指标上均显示有效性。
Conclusion: 扩散补全的偏差可从初始化种子入手解决：用分布协调的种子加中间过程的动态精修，免训练即可同时提升与未掩码区域的一致性和连贯性。

papers.title: Image Recognition with Vision and Language Embeddings of VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled strong zero-shot classification through image-text alignment. Yet, their purely visual inference capabilities remain under-explored. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of both language-guided and vision-only image classification with a diverse set of dual-encoder VLMs, including both well-established and recent models such as SigLIP 2 and RADIOv2.5. The performance is compared in a standard setup on the ImageNet-1k validation set and its label-corrected variant. The key factors affecting accuracy are analysed, including prompt design, class diversity, the number of neighbours in k-NN, and reference set size. We show that language and vision offer complementary strengths, with some classes favouring textual prompts and others better handled by visual similarity. To exploit this complementarity, we introduce a simple, learning-free fusion method based on per-class precision that improves classification performance. The code is available at: https://github.com/gonikisgo/bmvc2025-vlm-image-recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统评测双编码器 VLM（SigLIP 2、RADIOv2.5 等）在 ImageNet-1k 验证集及其标签修正版上的语言引导与纯视觉分类，发现文本提示与视觉相似度在不同类别上各占优。据此提出一种免训练、按类别精度 (per-class precision) 加权的融合方法，提升分类性能。
Motivation: VLM 的零样本分类已被充分研究，但其纯视觉推理能力仍缺乏系统评估；文本提示与视觉 k-NN 各有擅长类别，互补性未被利用。
Method: 在 ImageNet-1k 验证集及标签修正变体上，对一组双编码器 VLM（含 SigLIP 2、RADIOv2.5）对比语言引导与纯视觉 k-NN 分类；分析提示设计、类别多样性、k-NN 近邻数与参考集规模对精度的影响，并引入基于 per-class precision 的免学习融合。
Result: 语言与视觉在类别层面互补：部分类别文本提示更优，另一些视觉相似度更佳；所提按类别精度的免训练融合在该评测设置下提升分类性能。
Conclusion: 纯视觉推理是 VLM 分类中值得单独调优的路径，按类别选择或融合文本与视觉信号比单一模态更有效，且无需额外训练。

papers.title: AdaSwitch: An Adaptive Switching Meta-Algorithm for Learning-Augmented Bounded-Influence Problems
papers.abstract_en: We study history-dependent online problems with a possibly inaccurate prediction of the future request sequence. Motivated by several real-world applications, we introduce a \emph{bounded-influence} framework in which past decisions and requests affect the future optimal value by only a bounded amount. Within this framework, we develop AdaSwitch, a meta-algorithm that adaptively switches between suitable offline and online oracles. AdaSwitch provides explicit guarantees on expected performance that tighten as prediction error decreases or the offline optimum increases. With perfect predictions, its guarantee approaches the offline oracle's guarantee as the offline optimum grows. It also retains a worst-case guarantee close to that of the online oracle under arbitrary predictions. Applications to online lead-time quotation, $k$-server and caching, and online reusable resource allocation demonstrate the framework's applicability to both reward maximization and cost minimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 bounded-influence 框架约束历史决策与请求对未来最优值的影响幅度，并给出 AdaSwitch 元算法，在离线与在线 oracle 之间自适应切换以利用预测。其期望性能保证随预测误差减小或离线最优值增大而收紧：预测完美且离线最优增大时逼近离线 oracle 保证，在任意预测下仍保留接近在线 oracle 的最坏情况保证。
Motivation: 带预测的在线问题中，历史决策会通过耦合影响未来最优值，使离线/在线切换型算法的保证难以同时兼顾预测准确时的高性能与预测任意时的鲁棒性。
Method: AdaSwitch 是一个元算法，按预测误差与离线最优值自适应地在合适的离线 oracle 与在线 oracle 之间切换；分析建立在 bounded-influence 框架上，即过去的决策与请求只以有界量影响未来最优值。
Result: 给出显式期望性能保证：预测误差减小或离线最优值增大时保证收紧；完美预测下随离线最优值增长逼近离线 oracle 的保证，任意预测下最坏情况保证接近在线 oracle。应用于在线 lead-time quotation、k-server 与 caching、在线可重用资源分配，覆盖收益最大化与成本最小化两类问题。
Conclusion: 在 bounded-influence 假设下，自适应切换离线与在线 oracle 可以同时获得随预测质量伸缩的保证和对任意预测的鲁棒性，且适用于奖励与成本两类在线问题。

papers.title: The Sample Complexity of Membership Inference and Privacy Auditing
papers.abstract_en: A membership-inference attack gets the output of a learning algorithm, and a target individual, and tries to determine whether this individual is a member of the training data or an independent sample from the same distribution. A successful membership-inference attack typically requires the attacker to have some knowledge about the distribution that the training data was sampled from, and this knowledge is often captured through a set of independent reference samples from that distribution. In this work we study how much information the attacker needs for membership inference by investigating the sample complexity-the minimum number of reference samples required-for a successful attack. We study this question in the fundamental setting of Gaussian mean estimation where the learning algorithm is given $n$ samples from a Gaussian distribution $\mathcal{N}(μ,Σ)$ in $d$ dimensions, and tries to estimate $\hatμ$ up to some error $\mathbb{E}[\|\hat μ- μ\|^2_Σ]\leq ρ^2 d$. Our result shows that for membership inference in this setting, $Ω(n + n^2 ρ^2)$ samples can be necessary to carry out any attack that competes with a fully informed attacker. Our result is the first to show that the attacker sometimes needs many more samples than the training algorithm uses to train the model. This result has significant implications for practice, as all attacks used in practice have a restricted form that uses $O(n)$ samples and cannot benefit from $ω(n)$ samples. Thus, these attacks may be underestimating the possibility of membership inference, and better attacks may be possible when information about the distribution is easy to obtain.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高斯均值估计这一基本设定下，证明成功的成员推断攻击 (membership inference) 所需的参考样本量下界为 Ω(n + n²ρ²)，即攻击者有时需要远多于训练算法所用的 n 个样本。实践中所有攻击都只用 O(n) 个参考样本、无法利用 ω(n) 的额外信息，因此可能低估了成员推断风险。
Motivation: 成员推断攻击依赖从训练分布抽取的独立参考样本，但攻击者到底需要多少这类信息一直缺少刻画；若下界远超训练集规模，实践中受限形式的攻击就会系统性低估隐私风险。
Method: 在 d 维高斯 N(μ,Σ) 均值估计设定下分析：算法用 n 个样本估计 μ̂ 且满足 E[‖μ̂−μ‖²_Σ] ≤ ρ²d，据此推导任何与完全知情攻击者竞争的攻击所需的最小参考样本数（sample complexity）下界。
Result: 证明任何与完全知情攻击者竞争的攻击都需要 Ω(n + n²ρ²) 个参考样本；这是首个表明攻击者所需样本可远多于训练算法所用样本的结果。实践中使用的攻击均为 O(n) 样本的受限形式，无法从 ω(n) 样本中获益。
Conclusion: 当关于分布的信息容易获取时，可能存在比现有实践攻击更强的成员推断攻击，当前基于受限攻击的隐私审计可能低估了真实风险。

papers.title: Inverse-LLaVA: Rethinking Multimodal Alignment via Text-to-Vision Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Connecting pretrained vision and language models usually involves projecting image features into the language model's input space. Inverse-LLaVA reverses this mapping within decoder attention: language states are projected to the visual feature dimension, and modality-specific maps produce residual query, key, and value updates. Fusion and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) learn jointly from 665K visual instructions, with frozen backbones and no separate alignment stage. Across nine primary benchmark evaluations, the final 7B model approaches two-stage LLaVA-1.5 on several tasks. It scores 78.45% on VQAv2 versus 79.13% for official LLaVA-LoRA, and 50.96% versus 48.56% on VizWiz; TextVQA is lower at 56.96% versus 58.47%. Controlled studies examine fusion components, insertion depth, visual features, and language-model size. Representation analysis shows that the text maps preserve much of the pairwise similarity ordering while changing its geometric spread. Additional paired supervision improves celebrity recognition, while instruction replay repairs caption-induced answer-format failures. Analytical cost expressions and fixed-work profiles separate the additional fusion computation from the omitted alignment stage. These findings establish text-to-vision attention fusion as a practical alternative for instruction-only multimodal adaptation.
papers.comment: 50 pages, 20 figures, including appendices. Substantially revised with retrained models, updated benchmark results, and expanded ablation, efficiency, and representation analyses. Code, model weights, and reproducibility artifacts: https://github.com/xuhuizhan5/Inverse-LLaVA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Inverse-LLaVA 把多模态对流方向反过来：在 decoder attention 内把语言状态投影到视觉特征维度，用模态专属映射产生残差 Q/K/V 更新，与 LoRA 在 665K 视觉指令上联合学习，冻结 backbone 且无需独立对齐阶段。7B 最终模型在九项主基准上接近两阶段 LLaVA-1.5：VQAv2 78.45%（官方 LLaVA-LoRA 79.13%）、VizWiz 50.96%（48.56%）、TextVQA 56.96%（58.47%）。
Motivation: 标准做法是把图像特征投到语言模型输入空间，通常需要独立的对齐预训练阶段；本文要检验只靠指令数据、不设对齐阶段能否达到可比的多模态表现。
Method: 在 decoder attention 内反向映射：语言状态投影到视觉特征维度，模态专属 map 输出残差 query/key/value 更新；fusion 模块与 LoRA 联合训练，backbone 冻结，数据为 665K 视觉指令。受控研究考察 fusion 组件、插入深度、视觉特征来源与语言模型规模，并做表示相似度分析与成本解析式。
Result: 九项主基准上 7B 模型接近 LLaVA-1.5：VQAv2 78.45% vs 官方 LLaVA-LoRA 79.13%，VizWiz 50.96% vs 48.56%，TextVQA 56.96% vs 58.47%。表示分析显示 text maps 保留大部分 pairwise similarity 排序但改变几何展布；额外配对监督改善名人识别，instruction replay 修复由 caption 导致的答案格式错误；解析成本式与固定工作量 profile 把额外 fusion 计算与被省略的对齐阶段分开核算。
Conclusion: text-to-vision attention fusion 可作为指令驱动多模态适配的实用替代路线，无需独立对齐阶段即可在多项任务上逼近两阶段管线，但 TextVQA 仍略低。

papers.title: MAPF-World: Action World Model for Multi-Agent Path Finding
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent path finding (MAPF) studies the problem of planning conflict-free paths for multiple agents from given start locations to designated goals, with applications in robot-assisted logistics and social navigation. Recent decentralized learned solvers have shown promise for large-scale MAPF, particularly when leveraging foundation models and large datasets. However, most existing methods rely on reactive policies, often resulting in congestion, deadlocks, and degraded generalization in high agent-density environments. To address these limitations, we propose MAPF-World, an autoregressive action world model for MAPF that unifies short-horizon local future prediction and action generation, enabling decision-making beyond immediate local observations. MAPF-World models short-horizon local dynamics by predicting the next local observation and neighboring agents' action intentions, capturing both spatial structures and temporal interaction patterns. We further introduce a spatio-agent positional encoding that integrates spatial awareness with agent-level semantics in Transformer-based architectures, facilitating more coordinated multi-agent behaviors. In addition, we augment existing MAPF benchmarks by introducing an automated map generator grounded in real-world urban layouts, aiming to narrow the gap between synthetic simulation and practical deployment scenarios. Extensive experiments across diverse map types and interaction settings demonstrate that MAPF-World achieves strong performance compared with existing learned solvers. Notably, it exhibits robust zero-shot generalization and maintains a high success rate even as agent density increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAPF-World 是一个面向多智能体路径规划 (MAPF) 的自回归动作世界模型，把短时程局部未来观测预测与邻居动作意图预测同动作生成统一在一个 Transformer 里，并加入时空-智能体位置编码 (spatio-agent positional encoding)。在多种地图类型与交互设置下，它相对已有 learned solver 表现强，且在智能体密度升高时仍保持高成功率，展现零样本泛化。
Motivation: 现有去中心化 learned MAPF 求解器多为反应式策略，在高智能体密度下易拥堵、死锁、泛化退化，且依赖合成仿真地图与真实部署存在差距。
Method: 自回归 action world model 同时预测下一局部观测与邻居智能体的动作意图，以捕捉空间结构和时序交互模式；在 Transformer 架构中引入 spatio-agent positional encoding 融合空间感知与智能体级语义；另提出基于真实城市布局的自动地图生成器来扩充 MAPF benchmark。
Result: 在多种地图类型与交互设置的实验中，MAPF-World 相比已有 learned solver 取得强性能，并在智能体密度增加时维持高成功率，展示稳健的零样本泛化。
Conclusion: 把短时程未来预测与动作生成统一进 world model，配合智能体级位置编码，可在高密度场景下缓解反应式策略的拥堵与死锁并改善泛化；自动地图生成器用于缩小合成仿真与实际部署的差距。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: BrainATCL: Adaptive Temporal Brain Connectivity Learning for Functional Link Prediction and Age Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) is an imaging technique widely used to study human brain activity. fMRI signals in areas across the brain transiently synchronise and desynchronise their activity in a highly structured manner, even when an individual is at rest. These functional connectivity dynamics may be related to behaviour and neuropsychiatric disease. To model these dynamics, temporal brain connectivity representations are essential, as they reflect evolving interactions between brain regions and provide insight into transient neural states and network reconfigurations. However, conventional graph neural networks (GNNs) often struggle to capture long-range temporal dependencies in dynamic fMRI data. To address this challenge, we propose BrainATCL, an unsupervised, nonparametric framework for adaptive temporal brain connectivity learning, enabling functional link prediction and age estimation. Our method dynamically adjusts the lookback window for each snapshot based on the rate of newly added edges. Graph sequences are subsequently encoded using a GINE-Mamba2 backbone to learn spatial-temporal representations of dynamic functional connectivity in resting-state fMRI data of 1,000 participants from the Human Connectome Project. To further improve spatial modeling, we incorporate brain structure and function-informed edge attributes, i.e., the left/right hemispheric identity and subnetwork membership of brain regions, enabling the model to capture biologically meaningful topological patterns. We evaluate our BrainATCL on two tasks: functional link prediction and age estimation. The experimental results demonstrate superior performance and strong generalization, including in cross-session prediction scenarios.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version. Published at MIDL 2026. Final version: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v315/huang26b.html

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BrainATCL 是面向静息态 fMRI 动态功能连接的无监督非参数框架：按新增边速率自适应调整每个快照的回看窗口，用 GINE-Mamba2 编码图序列，并注入左右半球与子网络归属作为边属性。在 Human Connectome Project 1,000 名参与者的静息态数据上做功能连接预测与年龄估计两项任务，摘要称其性能更优且泛化性强，含跨 session 预测场景。
Motivation: 常规 GNN 难以捕捉动态 fMRI 中的长程时间依赖，而功能连接动态与行为和神经精神疾病相关，需要能表达瞬时神经状态与网络重构的时序脑连接表示。
Method: 提出无监督非参数框架 BrainATCL：依据新增边的速率为每个快照动态调整 lookback window，再用 GINE-Mamba2 主干编码图序列得到时空表示；边属性加入左右半球身份与子网络归属等结构/功能先验，训练数据为 HCP 1,000 名参与者的静息态 fMRI。
Result: 在功能连接预测与年龄估计两项任务上均取得更优性能与强泛化，包括跨 session 预测场景；数据为 Human Connectome Project 的 1,000 名参与者静息态 fMRI。
Conclusion: 自适应回看窗口加生物学先验边属性的时序图编码，足以在静息态 fMRI 上同时支撑功能连接预测与年龄估计，并可跨 session 泛化。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Neural Architecture Discovery via Autonomous Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in LLM agents has advanced the prospect of autonomous research. Yet whether AI can complete difficult long-horizon tasks, especially those that advance AI research itself, remains largely unexplored. We present ASI-Arch, a system for AI-driven AI research that autonomously conducts neural architecture research through a closed-loop research-experiment-analyze-update process. Applied to linear attention, ASI-Arch ran 1,773 iterative experiments and discovered 105 state-of-the-art architectures. Its best architecture improves over DeltaNet by nearly three times the gain achieved by Mamba2. Beyond the final performance gains, we analyze the contributions of different parts of the framework in this hard research setting, shedding light on what enables autonomous progress in complex AI research tasks.
papers.comment: 44 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at COLM 2026. Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASI-Arch 是一个自主做神经架构研究的闭环系统，按研究-实验-分析-更新循环自动跑实验并迭代设计线性注意力架构。在 linear attention 上它执行了 1,773 次迭代实验，发现 105 个 SOTA 架构，最佳架构相对 DeltaNet 的提升接近 Mamba2 所带来增益的三倍。
Motivation: LLM agent 已能辅助科研，但 AI 能否独立完成推进 AI 研究本身的长程困难任务仍基本未被探索，尤其是在需要反复实验与分析的架构设计环节。
Method: 采用研究-实验-分析-更新的闭环流程自主提出、测试并修正神经架构假设，作用对象为 linear attention；作者还对框架各组成部分的贡献做了消融分析，以说明自主进展由什么驱动。
Result: 在 linear attention 上共运行 1,773 次迭代实验，发现 105 个 state-of-the-art 架构；最佳架构相对 DeltaNet 的改进约为 Mamba2 所获增益的三倍。
Conclusion: 闭环的自动研究-实验-分析-更新流程足以在架构设计这类长程任务上产生自主进展，且框架各组件的贡献可被拆解分析。

papers.title: AgentFly: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Unified Resource System
papers.abstract_en: Methods to build LLM agents have evolved from prompt engineering and supervised finetuning to agentic reinforcement learning (agentic RL). However, agentic RL remains bottlenecked by its surrounding systems: agents must interact with heterogeneous environments, such as sandboxes, model services, and external APIs. Their allocation, reuse, and lifecycle dominate rollout cost and cap the scale at which training becomes practical. In this work, we present AgentFly, an agentic RL framework built with a unified resource layer that treats each of these environments as a distinct, typed resource scheduled through one engine, with per-tool acquisition for multi-turn reuse, asynchronous backpressure, and rollout versus global-scoped lifecycles. AgentFly adopts a four-layer design: (I) agent layer that abstracts the agent, tool, and reward concepts, decomposing agentic RL into defining agents, tools, and reward functions; (II) rollout layer that composes these into agent loops and computes rewards; (III) context layer that organizes rollouts, injects contextual information, and arranges resources; and (IV) a low-level resource layer that performs resource management. We provide a suite of prebuilt tools and environments, demonstrate successful agent training across multiple tasks and models, and report the first controlled cross-framework throughput comparison against agentic RL frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentFly 把 agentic RL 周边的异构环境（沙箱、模型服务、外部 API）统一成带类型的资源，由单一调度引擎管理，含 per-tool 获取以支持多轮复用、异步 backpressure、以及 rollout 与 global 两级生命周期。四层设计把 agentic RL 拆成定义 agent、tool、reward 三件事，并给出首个受控的跨框架吞吐量对比。
Motivation: agentic RL 的扩展被周边系统卡住：agent 要与沙箱、模型服务、外部 API 等异构环境交互，这些资源的分配、复用与生命周期主导 rollout 成本，限制了可训练规模。
Method: 统一资源层把每种环境视为独立的 typed resource，经同一引擎调度；四层架构为 agent 层（抽象 agent/tool/reward）、rollout 层（组装 agent loop 并算 reward）、context 层（组织 rollout、注入上下文、安排资源）、底层资源层（资源管理）。附带预置的工具与环境套件。
Result: 在多个任务与多个模型上完成 agent 训练，并给出首个针对 agentic RL 框架的受控跨框架吞吐量对比。
Conclusion: 把异构环境当作统一调度的类型化资源，是让 agentic RL 训练规模化的系统路径；论文主张其吞吐量对比为该方向的首个受控结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Conformal Data Contamination Tests for In-distribution Data Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: The amount of quality data in many machine learning tasks is limited to what is available locally to data owners. The set of quality data can be expanded through trading or sharing with external data agents. However, external data may be contaminated or introduce undesirable sample diversity which can degrade performance of personalized machine learning tasks, as in diagnosis of a rare disease or recommendation systems. Therefore, data buyers need quality guarantees prior to data acquisition. Previous works primarily rely on distributional assumptions about data from different agents, relegating quality checks to post-hoc steps involving costly data valuation procedures. We propose a distribution-free, contamination-aware data acquisition framework that, by inspecting only a small volume of data, identifies external data agents whose data is most valuable for model personalization. To achieve this, we introduce novel two-sample testing procedures, preceding full data acquisition, grounded in rigorous theoretical foundations for conformal outlier detection, to determine whether an agent's data exceeds a contamination threshold. The proposed tests, termed conformal data contamination tests, remain valid under arbitrary contamination levels and the novel Storey-type test provably enables finite-sample false discovery rate control via the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. Empirical evaluations across diverse collaborative learning scenarios demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our approach. Overall, the conformal data contamination test distinguishes itself as a generic procedure for aggregating data with statistically rigorous quality guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 conformal data contamination tests：在正式收购外部数据前，只检查少量样本，用基于 conformal outlier detection 的两样本检验判断该数据代理的污染率是否超过阈值，从而挑选对个性化模型最有价值的数据。Storey 型检验配合 Benjamini-Hochberg 程序可在有限样本下严格控制 FDR，且在任意污染水平下保持有效。
Motivation: 本地高质量数据有限，需向外部代理购买或共享数据，但外部数据可能被污染或引入不想要的样本多样性，导致个性化模型（如罕见病诊断、推荐系统）性能下降；已有方法依赖分布假设，把质量检查推迟到昂贵的 post-hoc 数据估值环节。
Method: 构建 distribution-free、污染感知的数据获取框架：在完整收购前，用基于 conformal outlier detection 理论的新型两样本检验（含 Storey 型检验）判断某代理数据是否超过污染阈值；Storey 型检验与 Benjamini-Hochberg 程序结合实现有限样本 FDR 控制。
Result: 理论结果：所提检验在任意污染水平下保持有效，Storey 型检验可证明地通过 Benjamini-Hochberg 实现有限样本 FDR 控制。在多种协作学习场景上的实证评估展示了方法的稳健性与有效性。
Conclusion: conformal 污染检验可作为聚合外部数据的通用前置质量把关程序，用少量样本检查换取统计上严格的质量保证，取代依赖分布假设的 post-hoc 数据估值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DDL: A Large-Scale Dataset for Deepfake Detection and Localization in Diversified Real-World Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AIGC have exacerbated the misuse of malicious deepfake content, making the development of reliable deepfake detection methods an essential means to address this challenge. Although existing deepfake detection models demonstrate outstanding performance in detection metrics, most methods only provide simple binary classification results, lacking interpretability. Recent studies have attempted to enhance the interpretability of classification results by providing spatial manipulation masks or temporal forgery segments. However, due to the limitations of forgery datasets, the practical effectiveness of these methods remains suboptimal. The primary reason lies in the fact that most existing deepfake datasets contain only binary labels, with limited variety in forgery scenarios, insufficient diversity in deepfake types, and relatively small data scales, making them inadequate for complex real-world scenarios. To address this predicament, we construct a novel large-scale deepfake detection and localization (DDL) dataset containing 1.4M+ forged samples and encompassing 80 distinct deepfake methods. The DDL design incorporates four key innovations: (1) Comprehensive Deepfake Methods (covering 7 different generation architectures and a total of 80 methods), (2) Varied Manipulation Modes (incorporating 7 classic and 3 novel forgery modes), (3) Diverse Forgery Scenarios and Modalities (including 3 scenarios and 3 modalities), and (4) Fine-grained Forgery Annotations (providing 1.18M+ precise spatial masks and 0.23M+ precise temporal segments). Through these improvements, our DDL not only provides a more challenging benchmark for complex real-world forgeries but also offers crucial support for building next-generation deepfake detection, localization, and interpretability methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DDL 是一个面向真实场景的深伪检测与定位数据集，含 140 万+伪造样本、覆盖 80 种深伪方法与 7 类生成架构，并提供 118 万+空间掩码和 23 万+时间片段的细粒度标注。作者主张只有把二分类标签换成多样伪造场景加精细定位标注，才能支撑可解释的深伪检测与定位方法。
Motivation: 现有深伪数据集多为二分类标签、伪造场景与类型有限、规模偏小，导致空间掩码与时间片段类可解释方法在真实复杂场景中效果不佳。
Method: 构建 DDL 数据集：覆盖 7 种生成架构共 80 种深伪方法，纳入 7 种经典与 3 种新颖伪造模式，横跨 3 类场景与 3 种模态，并给出细粒度标注（1.18M+ 空间掩码、0.23M+ 时间片段）。
Result: DDL 含 1.4M+ 伪造样本、80 种深伪方法、7 类生成架构、7+3 种伪造模式、3 场景 3 模态，附 1.18M+ 空间掩码与 0.23M+ 时间片段标注。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DDL 为复杂真实世界伪造提供了更有挑战性的基准，并为下一代深伪检测、定位与可解释方法提供数据支撑。

papers.title: Heterogeneous-Modal Unsupervised Domain Adaptation via Latent Space Bridging
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) effectively bridges the domain gap between a labeled source domain and an unlabeled target domain, but assumes that the two domains share the same modality. Heterogeneous domain adaptation (HDA) instead handles different feature spaces across domains, yet requires labeled target samples or paired data linking the source and target domains. Neither applies when a labeled source domain and a fully unlabeled target domain each hold an entirely distinct modality (e.g., 2D images and 3D point clouds). To address this limitation, we introduce a new setting termed Heterogeneous-Modal Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (HMUDA), which transfers knowledge across modalities via an unlabeled bridge domain containing paired observations from both modalities, whose distribution may deviate from those of the source and target domains. To learn under the HMUDA setting, we propose Latent Space Bridging (LSB), a dual-branch framework where a feature consistency loss on paired bridge samples closes the modality gap and a class-centroid alignment loss reduces the source-target discrepancy. Extensive experiments on eight benchmark settings covering both 2D-to-3D and 3D-to-2D transfer demonstrate that LSB achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出异构模态无监督域适应 (HMUDA) 设定：源域与目标域模态完全不同且目标域全无标注，靠一个含双模态配对观测的无标注 bridge 域传递知识。方法 LSB 用双分支框架，以配对 bridge 样本上的特征一致性损失弥合模态差距，再用类中心对齐损失缩小源-目标差异；在覆盖 2D→3D 与 3D→2D 的八个基准设定上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: UDA 假设两域同模态，HDA 需要目标域标注或配对数据；当源域与全无标注目标域各自是完全不同的模态（如 2D 图像与 3D 点云）时，两者都不适用。
Method: LSB 为双分支框架：在含双模态配对观测的无标注 bridge 域上施加特征一致性损失以弥合模态差距，同时用类中心对齐损失减小源-目标分布差异；bridge 域分布可偏离源域与目标域。
Result: 在覆盖 2D-to-3D 与 3D-to-2D 迁移的八个基准设定上，LSB 取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 无需目标域标注或源-目标配对数据，仅靠一个双模态配对的无标注 bridge 域即可完成跨模态知识迁移，并在 2D/3D 双向迁移上确立新的最优表现。

papers.title: Delphos: A reinforcement learning framework for assisting discrete choice model specification
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Delphos, a deep reinforcement learning framework for assisting discrete choice model specification process. Delphos aims to support the modeller by providing automated, data-driven suggestions for model specifications, thereby reducing the effort required to develop and refine utility functions. Delphos conceptualises model specification as a sequential decision-making problem, inspired by the way human choice modellers iteratively construct models through a series of reasoned specification decisions. In this setting, an agent learns to specify candidate model specifications by choosing a sequence of modelling actions, such as adding alternative specific constants, accommodating both generic and alternative-specific taste parameters, applying non-linear transformations to attributes, and including interactions with covariates. Each resulting candidate model is estimated and evaluated using a reward function defined by the modeller, which can reflect statistical model fit as well as behavioural expectations. Specifically, Delphos uses a Deep Q-Network to learn how individual specification decisions contribute to the eventual quality of the resulting model and, in turn, which sequences of modelling decisions tend to produce well-performing candidates. We evaluate Delphos on both simulated and empirical datasets using alternative reward functions. In simulated cases, learning curves, Q-value patterns, and performance metrics show that Delphos learns effective specification strategies while exploring only a small fraction of the feasible modelling space. We further apply the framework to two empirical datasets to benchmark and demonstrate its practical use. These experiments illustrate the ability of Delphos to generate competitive, behaviourally plausible models and highlight the potential of this adaptive, learning-based framework to assist the model specification process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Delphos 把离散选择模型的设定过程建模为序列决策问题，用 Deep Q-Network 学习一串建模动作（加备选方案特定常数、设定 generic 与 alternative-specific 呈现参数、对属性做非线性变换、引入与协变量的交互），每个候选模型按建模者定义的奖励函数（统计拟合或行为预期）估计打分。在模拟与两个经验数据集上，学习曲线、Q 值模式与性能指标显示它只探索可行建模空间的一小部分就能学到有效设定策略，生成有竞争力且行为上合理的模型。
Motivation: 离散选择模型的效用函数设定依赖建模者反复试错，人工搜索设定空间耗时且难以系统覆盖。
Method: 将模型设定表述为序列决策：智能器逐步选择建模动作（alternative-specific constants、generic 与 alternative-specific 口味参数、属性非线性变换、与协变量的交互），每个候选模型被估计并由建模者定义的奖励函数（统计拟合或行为预期）评估；用 Deep Q-Network 学习单步设定决策对最终模型质量的贡献。

Conclusion: 把模型设定当作可学习的序列决策问题，用 DQN 引导搜索即可在极小的设定空间探索比例下产出表现良好且行为合理的候选模型，从而辅助而非取代建模者。

papers.title: Towards Reasonable Concept Bottleneck Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel, flexible, and efficient framework for designing Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) that enables practitioners to explicitly encode and extend their prior knowledge and beliefs about the concept-concept ($C-C$) and concept-task ($C \to Y$) relationships within the model's reasoning when making predictions. The resulting $\textbf{C}$oncept $\textbf{REA}$soning $\textbf{M}$odels (CREAMs) architecturally encode arbitrary types of $C-C$ relationships such as mutual exclusivity, hierarchical associations, and/or correlations, as well as potentially sparse $C \to Y$ relationships. Moreover, CREAM can optionally incorporate a regularized side-channel to complement the potentially {incomplete concept sets}, achieving competitive task performance while encouraging predictions to be concept-grounded. To evaluate CBMs in such settings, we introduce a $C \to Y$ agnostic metric that quantifies interpretability when predictions partially rely on the side-channel. In our experiments, we show that, without additional computational overhead, CREAM models support efficient interventions, can avoid concept leakage, and achieve black-box-level performance under missing concepts. We further analyze how an optional side-channel affects interpretability and intervenability. Importantly, the side-channel enables CBMs to remain effective even in scenarios where only a limited number of concepts are available.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Concept Reasoning Models (CREAM)：在 Concept Bottleneck Model 中把概念间互斥、层级、相关等先验关系以及稀疏的概念-任务关系直接编码进模型结构，并可加一个正则化的 side-channel 补齐不完整的概念集。在概念缺失场景下 CREAM 不增加额外计算开销即可达到黑盒级性能，同时支持高效干预、避免 concept leakage；新提出的 C→Y agnostic 指标量化了预测部分依赖 side-channel 时的可解释性。
Motivation: 标准 CBM 难以把专家关于概念-概念与概念-任务关系的先验知识写进模型推理，且概念集常不完整，导致可解释性与任务性能同时受损。
Method: CREAM 以结构化方式编码任意 C-C 关系（互斥、层级、相关）与稀疏 C→Y 关系；可选地接入带正则的 side-channel 补充缺失概念，并引入一个 C→Y agnostic 的可解释性度量，用于预测部分依赖 side-channel 的情形。
Result: 实验显示 CREAM 在无额外计算开销下支持高效干预、可避免 concept leakage，并在概念缺失时达到 black-box-level performance；分析了可选 side-channel 对可解释性与 intervenability 的影响，指出 side-channel 使 CBM 在仅有少量概念可用时仍保持有效。
Conclusion: 把概念关系先验显式编码进瓶颈结构、并以正则 side-channel 兜底不完整概念集，可以在概念受限条件下同时保住概念接地的预测与接近黑盒的性能。

papers.title: Equilibrium Distribution for t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding with Generalized Kernels
papers.abstract_en: We study the large-sample variational problem for t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding with a class of input and output kernels. The input law has compact support and a density continuous on that support. An entropy equation determines the scale parameter in the input kernel, and we prove that this parameter exists and is unique at interior points of positive density. We then give sufficient conditions for solutions to exist and be uniformly bounded on the entire support. Under these conditions and a decay assumption on the output kernel, the discrete optimal values converge to a continuum minimum. Empirical measures of approximate minimizers are tight after translation; every subsequential limit is a compactly supported minimizer satisfying the equilibrium equation. The admissible output kernels include Gaussian kernels and, in output dimension two, the Cauchy kernel. Numerical examples compare the two-dimensional representations obtained with different kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 t-SNE 在一般输入/输出核下的大样本变分问题：熵方程在正密度内点处唯一确定输入核尺度参数，解在整个支撑上存在且一致有界时，离散最优值收敛到连续极小，近似极小的经验测度平移后紧、子列极限是满足平衡方程的紧支撑极小元。输出核类包含 Gaussian 核与二维情形的 Cauchy 核，数值例子比较不同核得到的二维表示。
Motivation: t-SNE 的核选择与尺度参数缺乏大样本层面的严格刻画，离散目标与连续变分问题之间的联系不清楚。
Method: 对带一般输入核与输出核的 t-SNE 建立大样本变分问题：用熵方程确定输入核尺度参数，给出解在全支撑上存在且一致有界的充分条件，并在输出核衰减假设下证明离散最优值收敛到连续极小；再刻画近似极小经验测度的极限为满足平衡方程的紧支撑解。
Result: 证明尺度参数在正密度内点处存在且唯一；在所给充分条件与输出核衰减假设下离散最优值收敛到连续极小，经验测度平移后紧且子列极限为平衡方程的紧支撑极小元；可容许输出核包括 Gaussian 核与输出维数为 2 时的 Cauchy 核；数值例子比较了不同核下的二维表示。
Conclusion: t-SNE 的离散优化在给定条件下由连续平衡方程刻画，输出核可在 Gaussian 与二维 Cauchy 之间选择。

papers.title: LLM-powered Query Expansion for Enhancing Boundary Prediction in Language-driven Action Localization
papers.abstract_en: Language-driven action localization in videos requires not only semantic alignment between language query and video segment, but also prediction of action boundaries. However, the language query primarily describes the main content of an action and usually lacks specific details of action start and end boundaries, which increases the subjectivity of manual boundary annotation and leads to boundary uncertainty in training data. In this paper, on one hand, we propose to expand the original query by generating textual descriptions of the action start and end boundaries through LLMs, which can provide more detailed boundary cues for localization and thus reduce the impact of boundary uncertainty. On the other hand, to enhance the tolerance to boundary uncertainty during training, we propose to model probability scores of action boundaries by calculating the semantic similarities between frames and the expanded query as well as the temporal distances between frames and the annotated boundary frames. They can provide more consistent boundary supervision, thus improving the stability of training. Our method is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly and easily integrated into any existing models of language-driven action localization in an off-the-shelf manner. Experimental results on several datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.comment: Accepted by International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语言驱动动作定位中，语言查询只描述动作主体内容、缺少起止边界细节，导致人工标注边界主观、训练数据带边界不确定性。作者用 LLM 把原查询扩写出动作起止边界的文字描述以补充边界线索，并在训练中用帧与扩展查询的语义相似度加上帧与标注边界帧的时间距离来建模边界概率分数，提供更一致的边界监督。该方法模型无关，可即插即用地接入现有语言驱动动作定位模型，在多个数据集上验证有效。
Motivation: 语言查询本身不含动作起止细节，人工边界标注因此主观，训练数据带边界不确定性，直接削弱动作边界预测的稳定性。
Method: 一方面用 LLM 对原查询做查询扩展 (query expansion)，生成描述动作 start/end 边界的文本；另一方面建模边界概率分数，输入为帧与扩展查询的语义相似度以及帧与标注边界帧的时间距离，作为更一致的边界监督。方法模型无关，可即插即用接入任意现有语言驱动动作定位模型。
Result: 在若干数据集上的实验结果表明该方法有效，提升了语言驱动动作定位的边界预测与训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 用 LLM 扩写边界描述加概率化边界监督，能缓解语言驱动动作定位中的边界不确定性，且因模型无关可直接嫁接到现有模型。

papers.title: InfiFPO: Implicit Model Fusion via Preference Optimization in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Model fusion combines multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) with different strengths into a more powerful, integrated model through lightweight training methods. Existing works on model fusion focus primarily on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), leaving preference alignment (PA) --a critical phase for enhancing LLM performance--largely unexplored. The current few fusion methods on PA phase, like WRPO, simplify the process by utilizing only response outputs from source models while discarding their probability information. To address this limitation, we propose InfiFPO, a preference optimization method for implicit model fusion. InfiFPO replaces the reference model in Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) with a fused source model that synthesizes multi-source probabilities at the sequence level, circumventing complex vocabulary alignment challenges in previous works and meanwhile maintaining the probability information. By introducing probability clipping and max-margin fusion strategies, InfiFPO enables the pivot model to align with human preferences while effectively distilling knowledge from source models. Comprehensive experiments on 11 widely-used benchmarks demonstrate that InfiFPO consistently outperforms existing model fusion and preference optimization methods. When using Phi-4 as the pivot model, InfiFPO improve its average performance from 79.95 to 83.33 on 11 benchmarks, significantly improving its capabilities in mathematics, coding, and reasoning tasks.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InfiFPO 把 DPO 的参考模型换成融合源模型，在序列级合成多源概率，配合概率截断与 max-margin 融合，让 pivot 模型在对齐偏好的同时蒸馏源模型知识。在 11 个基准上以 Phi-4 为 pivot 时平均分从 79.95 提到 83.33，数学、代码与推理能力提升。
Motivation: 模型融合研究集中在 SFT，偏好对齐 (PA) 阶段基本空白；现有 PA 融合方法如 WRPO 只用源模型的响应输出而丢弃概率信息。
Method: InfiFPO 用融合源模型替换 DPO 中的参考模型，在序列级合成多源概率，避开先前工作的词表对齐难题并保留概率信息；引入概率截断 (probability clipping) 与 max-margin 融合策略，使 pivot 模型同时对齐人类偏好并蒸馏源模型知识。
Result: 在 11 个广泛使用的基准上，InfiFPO 持续优于已有模型融合与偏好优化方法；以 Phi-4 为 pivot 模型时平均性能从 79.95 提升到 83.33，数学、代码与推理任务能力显著提高。
Conclusion: 偏好对齐阶段的模型融合应保留源模型的序列级概率而非只用响应输出，融合参考模型即可在 11 个基准上稳定超过 SFT 融合与既有 PA 方法。

papers.title: Deep learning in the abyss: a stratified Physics Informed Neural Network for data assimilation
papers.abstract_en: The reconstruction of deep ocean currents is a major challenge in data assimilation due to the scarcity of interior data. In this work, we present a proof of concept for deep ocean flow reconstruction using a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN), a machine learning approach that offers an alternative to traditional data assimilation methods. We introduce an efficient algorithm called StrAssPINN (for Stratified Assimilation PINNs), which assigns a separate network to each layer of the ocean model while allowing them to interact during training. The neural network takes spatiotemporal coordinates as input and predicts the velocity field at those points. Using a SIREN architecture (a multilayer perceptron with sine activation functions), which has proven effective in various contexts, the network is trained using both available observational data and dynamical priors enforced at several collocation points. We apply this method to pseudo-observed ocean data generated from a 3-layer quasi-geostrophic model, where the pseudo-observations include surface-level data akin to SWOT observations of sea surface height, interior data similar to ARGO floats, and a limited number of deep ARGO-like measurements in the lower layers. Our approach successfully reconstructs ocean flows in both the interior and surface layers, demonstrating a strong ability to resolve key ocean mesoscale features, including vortex rings, eastward jets associated with potential vorticity fronts, and smoother Rossby waves. This work serves as a prelude to applying StrAssPINN to real-world observational data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层同化 PINN（StrAssPINN）：给三层准地转海洋模型的每一层各配一个 SIREN 网络，训练中层间交互，以时空坐标为输入直接预测速度场，同时用观测数据和多个配点上的动力学先验约束。在含 SWOT 类海表高度、ARGO 类中层及少量深层伪观测的三层 QG 数据上，成功重建内层与表层流场，解析出涡环、位涡锋面相关的东向射流和较平滑的 Rossby 波。
Motivation: 深层海洋内部观测稀缺，使深海流重构成为数据同化的难题；传统同化方法之外需要能同时利用稀疏观测与动力学先验的替代方案。
Method: StrAssPINN 为海洋模型每一层分配独立网络并在训练中交互；网络用 SIREN 架构（MLP 加正弦激活），输入时空坐标、输出该点速度场，损失同时包含可用观测数据与多个配点处强制的动力学先验。
Result: 在由三层准地转模型生成的伪观测数据（SWOT 类海表高度、ARGO 类内部数据、下层少量深 ARGO 类测量）上，方法成功重建内层与表层海洋流，并解析出涡环、位涡锋面对应的东向射流以及更平滑的 Rossby 波等中尺度特征。
Conclusion: 分层 PINN 加动力学先验可作为传统数据同化的可行替代，用于深海流重构的概念验证，作者将其定位为迈向真实观测数据应用的前奏。
Relevance: 76

papers.title: Boosting the Local Invariance for Better Adversarial Transferability
papers.abstract_en: Transfer-based attacks pose a significant threat to real-world applications by directly targeting victim models with adversarial examples generated on surrogate models. While numerous approaches have been proposed to enhance adversarial transferability, existing works often overlook the intrinsic relationship between adversarial perturbations and input images. In this work, we find that the adversarial perturbations often exhibit poor translation invariance for a given clean image and model, which is attributed to local invariance. Through empirical analysis, we demonstrate a positive correlation between the local invariance of adversarial perturbations w.r.t. the input image and their transferability across models. Based on this finding, we propose a general adversarial transferability boosting technique called the Local Invariance Boosting approach (LI-Boost). Extensive experiments on the standard ImageNet dataset demonstrate that LI-Boost significantly enhances five categories of transfer-based attacks, i.e., gradient-based, input transformation-based, model-related, advanced objective function, and ensemble attacks. The improvements hold not only on conventional CNNs, ViTs, and defense mechanisms, but also on real-world commercial vision API systems and vision-language models. Our approach provides a promising direction for future research on improving adversarial transferability across models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trustworthy-AI-Group/TransferAttack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LI-Boost 指出对抗扰动对干净图像的局部不变性 (local invariance) 差是迁移性受限的根源，且局部不变性与跨模型迁移性正相关，据此提出提升局部不变性的通用迁移攻击增强技术。在 ImageNet 上显著增强五类迁移攻击，在 CNN、ViT、防御机制、商业视觉 API 与视觉语言模型上均成立。
Motivation: 基于迁移的攻击在代理模型上生成对抗样本直接攻击受害者模型，现有方法常忽略对抗扰动与输入图像的内在关系，导致跨模型迁移性不足。
Method: 提出 Local Invariance Boosting (LI-Boost)：先通过实证分析建立对抗扰动局部不变性与跨模型迁移性的正相关，再以提升局部不变性为通用增强手段，作用于梯度类、输入变换类、模型相关类、高级目标函数类与集成类五类迁移攻击。
Result: 在标准 ImageNet 数据集上，LI-Boost 显著增强五类迁移攻击；收益覆盖常规 CNN、ViT 与防御机制，并延伸到真实商业视觉 API 系统和视觉语言模型。
Conclusion: 提升对抗扰动对输入图像的局部不变性是提高跨模型迁移性的有效通用方向，可作为插件式增强套用于多类现有攻击。

papers.title: C-LoRA: Continual Low-Rank Adaptation for Pre-trained Visual Models
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained visual models have become fundamental in computer vision, but they face challenges in continual learning scenarios where data and tasks evolve over time. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) offers efficient fine-tuning capabilities but remains limited for such dynamic environments. Standard LoRA cannot distinguish important subspaces, causing critical knowledge to be overwritten in sequential training. Existing approaches address this by dynamically expanding the set of LoRA adapters, either maintaining a growing pool of task-specific modules or merging new adapters into prior ones, at the cost of unbounded parameter growth or increasing inference complexity. We propose Continual Low-Rank Adaptation (C-LoRA), a method that enables a single, shared LoRA adapter to handle sequential tasks without catastrophic forgetting, without requiring any module selection or fusion at inference. The core of C-LoRA is a learnable routing matrix R that explicitly controls how each rank-one subspace contributes to the weight update. This matrix is decomposed into a stability component (R_base), which preserves knowledge from prior tasks, and a plasticity component (R_delta), which drives adaptation to the current task, providing direct control over the stability-plasticity trade-off. We analyze how R governs gradient flow during sequential training, and demonstrate competitive performance across multiple benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: C-LoRA 用单个共享 LoRA 适配器处理顺序任务，核心是可学习的路由矩阵 R，将其分解为保持旧任务知识的 R_base 与驱动当前任务适应的 R_delta，从而直接控制稳定性-可塑性权衡，推理时无需模块选择或融合。作者分析了 R 在顺序训练中如何调控梯度流，并在多个 benchmark 上展示有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 标准 LoRA 无法区分重要子空间，顺序训练会覆盖关键知识；现有动态扩展适配器的方案则带来参数无界增长或推理复杂度上升。
Method: C-LoRA 引入可学习路由矩阵 R 显式控制每个 rank-one 子空间对权重更新的贡献，分解为稳定性分量 R_base 与可塑性分量 R_delta；分析 R 在顺序训练中的梯度流作用机制。
Result: 在多个 benchmark 上表现具有竞争力（competitive performance），并给出 R 支配顺序训练梯度流的分析。
Conclusion: 单个共享 LoRA 适配器配合分解式路由矩阵即可在顺序任务上缓解灾难性遗忘，同时避免参数无界增长与推理期的模块选择/融合开销。

papers.title: A Survey on Industrial Anomaly Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a comprehensive review of industrial anomaly synthesis (IAS). Existing surveys on industrial anomalies mainly focus on anomaly detection, while IAS is typically treated as an auxiliary component rather than as an independent topic. However, owing to its increasing importance in data augmentation, downstream model training, and controllable industrial inspection, IAS has become a research direction of growing interest. To address the lack of a dedicated review, we survey a broad range of representative methods and organize them into four paradigms: hand-crafted synthesis, distribution hypothesis-based synthesis, generative model (GM)-based synthesis, and vision-language model (VLM)-based synthesis. We further establish a dedicated taxonomy for IAS, which supports more systematic comparison across methods and offers a clearer view of the field's development. Beyond methodological categorization, we summarize the datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation metrics commonly adopted in IAS, and review recent advances in multimodal anomaly synthesis that remain underexplored in prior surveys. We also provide deployment-oriented comparisons and practical guidance by analyzing input requirements, output forms, controllability, cost, downstream tasks, and practical limitations across IAS subcategories. Overall, this survey provides a structured understanding of existing IAS methods, evaluation settings, practical trade-offs, current limitations, and promising future directions, and is intended to serve as a reference for subsequent research in this area. More resources are available at https://github.com/M-3LAB/awesome-anomaly-synthesis.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=f9qjl5xCVW
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇工业异常合成 (IAS) 综述，把该方向按四类范式组织：手工合成、基于分布假设的合成、生成模型 (GM) 合成、视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 合成，并建立专门的分类体系。它同时汇总常用数据集、基准与评测指标，从输入要求、输出形式、可控性、成本、下游任务和实际局限做部署导向对比，指出多模态异常合成在既往综述中仍欠探索。
Motivation: 既往工业异常综述以异常检测为主，IAS 只被当作辅助环节，缺少专门梳理，方法间难以系统比较。
Method: 综述性工作：归纳代表性 IAS 方法为四类范式并建立专门 taxonomy；汇总数据集、基准与评测指标；按输入要求、输出形式、可控性、成本、下游任务与实际局限做跨子类的部署导向对比，并单独回顾多模态异常合成。
Result: 给出四类合成范式的分类体系与跨方法比较框架，以及 IAS 常用数据集、基准、评测指标的汇总和部署导向对比维度；附 awesome-anomaly-synthesis 资源仓库。
Conclusion: IAS 应作为独立研究方向而非检测的附属组件来梳理；多模态异常合成与可控、低成本的工业检查是其指出的欠探索与未来方向。

papers.title: Networks with Finite VC Dimension: Pro and Contra
papers.abstract_en: Approximation and learning of classifiers of large data sets by neural networks in terms of high-dimensional geometry and statistical learning theory are investigated. The influence of the VC dimension of sets of input-output functions of networks on approximation capabilities is compared with its influence on consistency in learning from samples of data. It is shown that, whereas finite VC dimension is desirable for uniform convergence of empirical errors, it may not be desirable for approximation of functions drawn from a probability distribution modeling the likelihood that they occur in a given type of application. Based on the concentration-of-measure properties of high dimensional geometry, it is proven that both errors in approximation and empirical errors behave almost deterministically for networks implementing sets of input-output functions with finite VC dimensions in processing large data sets. Practical limitations of the universal approximation property, the trade-offs between the accuracy of approximation and consistency in learning from data, and the influence of depth of networks with ReLU units on their accuracy and consistency are discussed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文从高维几何与统计学习理论比较网络 VC 维的利弊：有限 VC 维保证经验误差一致收敛，却可能损害对按概率分布抽取的函数的逼近能力；并证明有限 VC 维网络在处理大数据集时逼近误差与经验误差都近乎确定性地表现。
Motivation: 有限 VC 维在一致性与逼近能力之间存在张力：它利于经验误差的一致收敛，却未必利于逼近实际应用中出现的函数，需要厘清这一取舍。
Method: 以高维几何的集中测度 (concentration-of-measure) 性质分析有限 VC 维网络的逼近误差与经验误差行为，并结合统计学习理论讨论通用逼近性质的实用限制、逼近精度与学习一致性的权衡，以及 ReLU 网络深度对精度与一致性的影响。
Result: 证明有限 VC 维下逼近误差与经验误差在大数据集上都近乎确定性；给出有限 VC 维利于经验误差一致收敛、却可能不利于按概率分布抽取函数逼近的结论，并讨论 ReLU 网络深度对精度与一致性的影响。
Conclusion: 有限 VC 维是一把双刃剑：对学习一致性有利，对逼近能力未必有利，逼近精度与一致性之间存在需要权衡的取舍。

papers.title: BEAT: Balanced Frequency Adaptive Tuning for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Long-term time-series forecasting supports a wide range of applications, including weather prediction and electricity demand planning. Frequency-domain methods address this task by decomposing observations into components that describe temporal variations at different scales. However, separate representations do not by themselves provide an explicit mechanism for adjusting the training emphasis across components. Under a shared forecasting objective, the frequency-specific networks can retain different levels of coefficient prediction error, motivating an error-dependent adjustment to their gradients. To this end, we propose BEAT (Balanced frEquency Adaptive Tuning), a framework that combines frequency-specific error monitoring with adaptive gradient modulation. We design a Frequency-Specific Monitor that compares predicted and target wavelet coefficients in a common normalized space and expresses each discrepancy relative to a reference error computed from the detail components. We further introduce a Dynamical Gradient Balancer that converts these ratios into positive, bounded coefficients. Components with higher relative errors receive larger gradient weights, whereas those with lower relative errors receive smaller weights. A shared modulation-strength parameter controls the departure from unmodulated training, and the monitoring and balancing operations are used only during training. Experiments on seven real-world datasets show that BEAT achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art forecasting methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEAT 在频域长程时间序列预测中，用 Frequency-Specific Monitor 在归一化空间比较预测与目标小波系数、以 detail 分量的参考误差归一化各分量偏差，再由 Dynamical Gradient Balancer 把该比值转成正且有界的梯度权重：相对误差大的分量拿更大梯度权重，小的拿更小权重，且监控与平衡只在训练期生效。在七个真实数据集上取得与 SOTA 预测方法相当的表现。
Motivation: 频域预测方法把观测拆成不同尺度分量，但各分量各自表示并不提供调节训练侧重的显式机制；共享预测目标下各频段网络残留的系数预测误差水平不同，需要按误差调整其梯度。
Method: BEAT 由两部分组成：Frequency-Specific Monitor 在共同归一化空间比较预测与目标小波系数，并以 detail 分量算出的参考误差表达各分量偏差；Dynamical Gradient Balancer 把这些比值转成正且有界的系数，误差相对高的分量获得更大梯度权重。一个共享的 modulation-strength 参数控制相对未调制训练的偏离程度，监控与平衡操作仅在训练阶段使用。
Result: 在七个真实数据集上的实验中，BEAT 相对 SOTA 预测方法取得有竞争力的表现（competitive performance）。
Conclusion: 按频段相对误差自适应地调制梯度权重，可以在共享预测目标下平衡各频率分量的训练强度，从而在长程时间序列预测上达到与 SOTA 相当的水平。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Simultaneous Computation with Multiple Prioritizations in Multi-Agent Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent path finding (MAPF) in large networks is computationally challenging. An approach for MAPF is prioritized planning (PP), in which agents plan sequentially according to their priority. Albeit a computationally efficient approach for MAPF, the solution quality strongly depends on the prioritization. Most prioritizations rely either on heuristics, which do not generalize well, or iterate to find adequate priorities, which costs computational effort. In this work, we show how agents can compute with multiple prioritizations simultaneously. Our approach is general as it does not rely on domain-specific knowledge. The context of this work is multi-agent motion planning (MAMP) with a receding horizon subject to computation time constraints. MAMP considers the system dynamics in more detail compared to MAPF. In numerical experiments on MAMP, we demonstrate that our approach achieves near-optimal prioritization and outperforms state-of-the-art methods with only a minor increase in computation time. We show real-time capability in an experiment on a road network with ten vehicles in our Cyber-Physical Mobility Lab.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research, Vol. 86, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体运动规划 (MAMP) 中，优先级规划 (prioritized planning) 的解质量高度依赖优先级排序，而启发式排序不泛化、迭代搜索又费时。作者提出同时用多套优先级并行计算的方法，不依赖领域知识，在带计算时间约束的滚动时域 (receding horizon) MAMP 上取得接近最优的优先级，仅带来少量计算时间增加，并在 Cyber-Physical Mobility Lab 的十辆车路网实验中展示实时能力。
Motivation: 大规模网络上的多智能体路径寻找 (MAPF) 计算代价高，优先级规划虽高效但解质量取决于优先级排序：启发式排序泛化差，迭代搜索又额外消耗计算时间。
Method: 让智能体同时用多套优先级并行计算（simultaneous computation with multiple prioritizations），方法不依赖领域知识；设定为受计算时间约束的滚动时域多智能体运动规划 (MAMP)，比 MAPF 更细地考虑系统动力学。
Result: 数值实验表明该方法取得接近最优的优先级，并以仅少量计算时间增加胜过 state-of-the-art 方法；在 Cyber-Physical Mobility Lab 的含十辆车路网实验中展示实时能力。
Conclusion: 同时探索多套优先级可以在几乎不增加计算时间的前提下替代启发式或迭代式排序，使优先级规划在实时约束下的 MAMP 中仍保持接近最优的解质量。

papers.title: Foundations of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This is a book about large language models. As indicated by the title, it primarily focuses on foundational concepts rather than comprehensive coverage of all cutting-edge technologies. The book is structured into six main chapters, each exploring a key area: pre-training, generative models, prompting, alignment, inference, and reasoning. It is intended for college students, professionals, and practitioners in natural language processing and related fields, and can serve as a reference for anyone interested in large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一本讲大语言模型基础概念的书，共六章，分别覆盖预训练、生成模型、prompting、对齐、推理与解码推理，面向 NLP 相关领域的学生与从业者，定位是基础参考书而非覆盖前沿技术的全面综述。
Motivation: 面向 NLP 学生与从业者需要一本讲清 LLM 基础概念（而非罗列最新技术）的系统性参考书。
Method: 全书按六个主题组织章节：预训练 (pre-training)、生成模型 (generative models)、prompting、对齐 (alignment)、推理 (inference) 与 reasoning，每章展开一个关键领域的基础概念。
Result: 这是一本六章结构的 LLM 基础教材，定位为面向 college students、professionals 与 NLP 实践者的参考书，重点在基础概念而非前沿技术的全面覆盖。
Conclusion: LLM 的基础知识可以按预训练、生成、prompting、对齐、推理、reasoning 六条主线组织成一本面向教学与参考的教材。

papers.title: Attention when you need
papers.abstract_en: Paying attention improves performance, but attention is metabolically costly, so how should a resource-efficient agent allocate it? We study optimal allocation strategies using a normative model of a signal detection task in which attention comes at a cost. The model reveals that optimal attention is temporally structured in one of two patterns depending on task conditions: when attention costs penalize intense focus, optimal attention ramps up as evidence for the signal accumulates, but with less prohibitive attention costs, optimal attention fluctuates rhythmically. In cases with rhythmic attention, allocation frequency increases with task parameters such as reward magnitude for successful detection, signal brevity, and signal frequency. We argue that rhythmic attention emerges naturally in an agent whose belief updates are dominated by a stable temporal prior and not by the likelihood of new sensory observations. Our results characterize the conditions under which rhythmic vs. ramping attention is optimal and offer a normative account of attentional fluctuations observed in sustained attention tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带注意力成本的信号检测规范模型中，最优注意力分配只呈两种时序模式：当成本惩罚高强度聚焦时，注意力随证据累积而爬升 (ramping)；成本较宽松时，注意力转为节律性波动 (rhythmic)，且节律频率随奖励幅度、信号短暂性和信号频率上升而加快。作者主张节律注意力源于信念更新被稳定的时间先验而非新观测似然主导。
Motivation: 注意力有代谢成本，资源受限的智能体该如何在时间上分配它缺少规范性准则；持续注意任务中观察到的注意力波动也缺少解释。
Method: 构建信号检测任务的规范模型 (normative model)，把注意力作为有成本的决策变量求最优分配；再用信念更新由稳定时间先验而非新观测似然主导的机制解释节律模式的出现。
Result: 最优注意力在两种模式间切换：高注意力成本下随证据累积而爬升，低成本下呈节律波动；节律频率随奖励幅度、信号短暂性、信号频率等任务参数增大而升高。
Conclusion: 节律与爬升两种注意力时序各自在明确的成本与任务条件下最优，可作为持续注意任务中注意力波动的规范性解释。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Graphons of Line Graphs
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of estimating graph limits, known as graphons, from observations of sequences of sparse finite graphs. In this paper we show a simple method that can shed light on a subset of sparse graphs. The method involves mapping the original graphs to their line graphs. We show that graphs satisfying a particular property, which we call the square-degree property are sparse, but give rise to dense line graphs. This enables the use of results on graph limits of dense graphs to derive convergence. In particular, star graphs satisfy the square-degree property resulting in dense line graphs and non-zero graphons of line graphs. We demonstrate empirically that we can distinguish different numbers of stars (which are sparse) by the graphons of their corresponding line graphs. Whereas in the original graphs, the different number of stars all converge to the zero graphon due to sparsity. Similarly, superlinear preferential attachment graphs give rise to dense line graphs almost surely. In contrast, dense graphs, including Erdos-Renyi graphs make the line graphs sparse, resulting in the zero graphon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从稀疏有限图序列估计 graphon 时，先把原图映射为 line graph：满足 square-degree property 的稀疏图（如 star graph、超线性 preferential attachment 图）其 line graph 是稠密的，从而可用稠密图极限理论得到非零 graphon。经验上不同数量的 star 在原图上都收敛到零 graphon 而无法区分，其 line graph 的 graphon 却能区分开；反之 Erdos-Renyi 等稠密图的 line graph 变稀疏，得到零 graphon。
Motivation: 稀疏图序列的 graphon 估计困难，因为稀疏性使原图统一收敛到零 graphon，丢失结构差异，稠密图极限理论的结果无法直接使用。
Method: 将原图映射为其 line graph，定义 square-degree property：满足该性质的稀疏图产生稠密 line graph，从而可套用稠密图的 graphon 收敛结果；对 star graph 与超线性 preferential attachment 图给出满足该性质的构造，并以 star 数量区分任务做经验演示。
Result: star graph 满足 square-degree property，其 line graph 稠密且 graphon 非零；经验演示中不同数量的 star 在原图上均收敛到零 graphon 而不可分，而其 line graph 的 graphon 可区分不同 star 数量。超线性 preferential attachment 图几乎必然产生稠密 line graph；Erdos-Renyi 等稠密图的 line graph 变稀疏，得到零 graphon。
Conclusion: 对满足 square-degree property 的稀疏图，转到 line graph 上估计 graphon 是绕开稀疏性导致零 graphon 的有效途径；该方法适用于这一子类，而对稠密原图（如 Erdos-Renyi）不适用。

papers.title: Thought-Like-Pro: Enhancing Reasoning of Large Language Models through Self-Bootstrapped Prolog-based Chain-of-Thought
authors: Ling Chen (3) ((1) Shanghai University of Engineering Science
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities as general-purpose assistants, excelling in a wide range of reasoning tasks and supporting various aspects of daily web usage. This achievement represents a significant step toward achieving artificial general intelligence. Despite these advancements, the effectiveness of large language models often hinges on the specific prompting strategies employed, and there remains a lack of a robust framework to facilitate learning and generalization across diverse reasoning tasks. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel learning framework, Thought-Like-Pro. In this framework, we utilize imitation learning to imitate the Chain-of-Thought process which is verified and translated from reasoning trajectories generated by a symbolic Prolog logic engine. This framework proceeds in a prompt-guided but self-bootstrapped manner, that enables large language models to formulate rules and statements from given instructions and leverage the symbolic Prolog engine to derive results. Subsequently, large language models convert Prolog-derived successive reasoning trajectories into natural language chain-of-thought for imitation learning. The empirical findings indicate that our proposed approach greatly improves the reasoning capacity of large language models. By employing model averaging techniques, our method exhibits only a marginal decline in performance for distributional extrapolation tasks, showing robust generalization capabilities. We present a technical approach that integrates symbolic reasoning with language modeling, with the potential to support the development of large language models as cognitively inspired systems. The part of the dataset we used has been open-sourced.
papers.comment: 15 pages, including appendices. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems (TCDS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Thought-Like-Pro 用 Prolog 符号引擎生成并验证推理轨迹，再让 LLM 把轨迹翻译成自然语言 Chain-of-Thought 做模仿学习，实现 prompt 引导但自举 (self-bootstrapped) 的训练闭环。实证显示该方法显著提升 LLM 推理能力，配合 model averaging 后在分布外外推任务上性能仅轻微下降。
Motivation: LLM 推理效果高度依赖具体 prompting 策略，缺少一个能在多样推理任务上同时支撑学习与泛化的稳健框架。
Method: 框架分三步：LLM 从指令中自行形式化规则与语句，交给符号 Prolog 引擎推导出结果并验证；再由 LLM 把 Prolog 导出的逐步推理轨迹转写为自然语言 Chain-of-Thought；最后用模仿学习 (imitation learning) 训练模型，推理阶段配合 model averaging。
Result: 实证结果显示该方法大幅增强 LLM 推理能力；借助 model averaging，在分布外外推 (distributional extrapolation) 任务上性能仅边际下降，表现出稳健泛化。数据集部分已开源。
Conclusion: 把符号推理与语言建模结合、由符号引擎自举生成可验证 CoT 再做模仿学习，是一条可行路径，可支撑发展认知启发的 LLM 系统。
