papers.title: StoreBench: A Live-Commerce Environment for Evaluating and Training Autonomous Operator Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning environments are now a primary lever for improving large language model (LLM) capabilities in post-training, yet most agentic benchmarks remain static: the world moves only when the agent acts, the reward is a terminal verdict, and the pass bar is set arbitrarily. We introduce StoreBench, a live-commerce environment in which an agent runs a mid-size online apparel store on a production-grade commerce backend, testing long-horizon planning and economic judgment under uncertainty. Customers order around the clock, suppliers reprice and fail, and market shocks arrive with partial or no warning. The agent acts through the same 29 merchant tools a human operator would use, under a windowed operation budget that makes simulated time a function of actions taken, so model latency cannot influence simulated time. Pass thresholds are calibrated against scripted anchor policies, the reward is hardened against a catalogue of reward hacks, and every episode replays identically given a sequence of actions. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs on 11 scenarios of 30 to 45 days and a full simulated year, over three world seeds at matched reasoning effort. No model matches the scripted smart-triage policy on average: the best, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, passes 49% of task-seed cells against the heuristic's 97%. Human experts working through the same tools and budgets outscore every model (mean composite 0.708 vs. 0.700). Over a full simulated year under the Claude Code harness, most models show dramatic performance improvement. In a GRPO post-training run, Qwen3.5-27B trained on only five disjoint tasks raises its mean composite on the held-out evaluation tasks from 0.136 to 0.373. We release five example training-split tasks, ten sample trajectories, and the scoring and verification tooling; the full environment and evaluation suite are withheld to keep the benchmark uncontaminated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StoreBench 是一个直播电商 (live-commerce) 强化学习环境：智能体在生产级电商后端上经营一家中型服装店，通过 29 个人类商家工具操作，客户全天下单、供应商会改价与断供、市场冲击带部分或无预警到来。七个前沿 LLM 在 11 个场景（30–45 天及一个完整模拟年）、3 个世界种子上评测，最好的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 任务-种子格通过率 49%，而脚本化 smart-triage 策略为 97%；GRPO 后训练让 Qwen3.5-27B 在留出任务上的平均综合分从 0.136 升到 0.373。
Motivation: 现有 agentic 基准大多是静态的：世界只在智能体行动时才变化，奖励是终局判定，及格线是任意设定的，无法衡量长时程规划与不确定性下的经济判断。
Method: 环境让智能体在生产级电商后端上运营服装店，用与人类运营者相同的 29 个商家工具；采用窗口化操作预算使模拟时间成为动作数的函数（模型延迟不影响模拟时间），通过脚本化锚定策略校准通过阈值，奖励针对 reward hack 目录加固，且给定动作序列每局可完全重放。评测在匹配推理强度下比较七个前沿 LLM，并在 Claude Code harness 下做整年模拟，另做一次 GRPO 后训练。
Result: 七个前沿 LLM 在 11 个场景、3 个世界种子上无一平均追平脚本化 smart-triage 策略：最佳 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 通过 49% 的任务-种子格，启发式策略为 97%。使用相同工具与预算的人类专家平均综合分 0.708，高于所有模型的 0.700。在 Claude Code harness 下整年模拟中多数模型表现大幅提升。GRPO 后训练中，Qwen3.5-27B 仅用五个互不相交的训练任务，将留出评测任务的平均综合分从 0.136 提升到 0.373。
Conclusion: 在带持续客户流、供应商失效与市场冲击的长时程经济决策上，前沿 LLM 仍明显落后于简单脚本策略和人类专家，但少量任务上的 GRPO 后训练能显著抬高留出任务表现。作者只发布五个训练切分任务、十条示例轨迹与评分/校验工具，完整环境与评测套件保留以防基准污染。

papers.title: Higher-Order Morphology Priors for Quadruped Reinforcement Learning Under Actuator Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Actuator degradation turns quadruped locomotion into a coordination problem requiring joints to compensate for lost actuation. Prior work suggests that morphology-aware graph policies improve learning and generalization under body perturbations. We ask whether these benefits can be strengthened by explicitly modeling higher-order mechanical structure. We represent the Unitree Go1 as a cell complex with limb- and body-level rank-2 cells and apply Hodge-based message passing. Under degradation training, the node-edge-face Hodge actor achieves the highest return on unseen actuator degradations, with higher survival and lower velocity-tracking error. These results support higher-order morphology as a useful inductive bias for whole-body compensation under actuator degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Unitree Go1 四足机器人表示为带肢体级与躯干级 rank-2 cell 的 cell complex，用基于 Hodge 分解的消息传递 (Hodge-based message passing) 构造 node-edge-face 策略，在执行器退化训练下让关节互相补偿失失的驱动力。该 Hodge actor 在未见过的执行器退化上取得最高回报，同时存活率更高、速度跟踪误差更低。
Motivation: 执行器退化使四足运动变成需要关节互相补偿的协调问题；已有 morphology-aware 图策略在身体扰动下有收益，但高阶机械结构能否进一步增强这种收益尚不清楚。
Method: 将 Unitree Go1 建模为 cell complex，节点、边、面分别对应肢体级与躯干级 rank-2 cell，在其上施加 Hodge-based message passing 得到 node-edge-face actor，并在执行器退化条件下训练。
Result: 在退化训练设置下，node-edge-face Hodge actor 在未见过的执行器退化 (unseen actuator degradations) 上取得最高回报 (highest return)，并伴随更高的存活率 (survival) 与更低的速度跟踪误差 (velocity-tracking error)；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 高阶形态 (higher-order morphology) 可作为归纳偏置，支撑执行器退化下的全身补偿 (whole-body compensation)。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Rethinking the Tradeoff Between Temporal Encoding and Nonlinear Computation in Spiking Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Spiking language models face a tradeoff between representing continuous semantic features over short temporal windows and retaining costly nonlinear attention operations. We introduce Spora, which jointly designs spike encodings and attention operators. Binary temporal weights let $T$ spikes represent compositional values with up to $T$ bits of capacity, compared with $O(\log_2 T)$ bits for spike-count readout. Unipolar Binary Spiking (UBS) uses thresholds and spike-triggered residual decay to produce non-negative integer codes; Bipolar Binary Spiking (BBS) separates sign and magnitude and learns a scale for signed activations. These representations support accumulation-and-shift dot products and integer-exponent mappings in attention. With four time steps, Spora achieves 76.6 average GLUE score and 44.1 CoLA MCC, improving over SpikeLM by 1.2 and 6.2 points, respectively. Extending BBS to six steps raises these scores to 78.2 and 47.4. Conditional-decay analysis, matched-budget activation-quantization comparisons, event-workload statistics, and fixed-point evaluation further characterize the connection between encoding fidelity and computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spora 联合设计脉冲编码与注意力算子，用二值时间权重让 T 个脉冲承载至多 T 比特容量（spike-count 读出仅 O(log₂T) 比特）。UBS 用阈值与脉冲触发残差衰减产生非负整数码，BBS 分离符号与幅值并学习缩放，支撑累加-移位点积与整数指数映射。4 个时间步下 GLUE 平均 76.6、CoLA MCC 44.1，较 SpikeLM 分别高 1.2 与 6.2 分；BBS 延至 6 步升至 78.2 与 47.4。
Motivation: 脉冲语言模型需在短时间窗内表示连续语义特征与保留高成本非线性注意力之间取舍：时间编码容量有限，而注意力运算开销大。
Method: Spora 联合设计脉冲编码与注意力算子：二值时间权重提升容量；Unipolar Binary Spiking (UBS) 以阈值与 spike-triggered residual decay 生成非负整数码；Bipolar Binary Spiking (BBS) 分离符号与幅值并为有符号激活学习缩放；在此表示上实现累加-移位点积与整数指数映射的注意力。
Result: 4 个时间步下 Spora GLUE 平均 76.6、CoLA MCC 44.1，较 SpikeLM 分别提升 1.2 与 6.2 分；BBS 扩展到 6 个时间步后两项升至 78.2 与 47.4。另以 conditional-decay 分析、匹配预算的激活量化对比、event-workload 统计与定点评估刻画编码保真度与计算成本的关系。
Conclusion: 联合设计脉冲编码与注意力算子可在较少时间步下同时提高语义表示容量与下游语言任务表现，编码保真度与计算成本可一并量化。

papers.title: World-Model Policy Arbiter for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) has produced a diverse set of goal-reaching algorithms, yet no single algorithm performs best across environments, goals, and even different phases of the same task. Rather than deploying only the best-performing policy, we ask whether a set of frozen goal-conditioned policies can be used collectively as a portfolio, deciding at every state which policy should act. Choosing a policy at each state is not straightforward. The policies' own value functions cannot be compared directly: they may use different scales, and some policies have no value function. We need to judge each policy by the states it is likely to reach, even though we can execute only one policy at a time. We also need to avoid switching so often that control becomes unstable. To address these challenges, we introduce World-Model Policy Arbiter (WMPA), a test-time framework that, given a set of frozen policies as input, rolls out each frozen policy in a learned state-space world model, evaluates the imagined futures with a shared goal-conditioned value function, and executes the highest-scoring policy for a short commitment interval before the next round of arbitration (policy selection). WMPA assumes access to a bank of frozen goal-conditioned policies and requires neither policy retraining nor privileged task-specific knowledge. Under the official OGBench evaluation protocol on 18 state-based datasets spanning maze navigation as well as cube, scene, and puzzle manipulation, WMPA improves the macro-average success rate from the 44% achieved by the best policy selected per dataset to 58%, with statistically significant gains on 12 datasets. These gains include +33 percentage points on cube-double-play and +36 percentage points on scene-play.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://junwei0102.github.io/wmpa-webpage/ Code: https://github.com/junwei0102/World-Model-Policy-Arbiter
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WMPA 在测试时把一组冻结的目标条件策略当作组合，用学到的 state-space world model 对每个策略做短程 rollout，以共享的目标条件价值函数给想象未来打分，每隔一个短承诺区间执行得分最高者。在 OGBench 官方协议、18 个 state-based 数据集上，宏平均成功率从按数据集选最优策略的 44% 提到 58%，其中 12 个数据集增益统计显著，cube-double-play +33 个百分点、scene-play +36 个百分点。
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习 (GCRL) 没有单一算法在所有环境、目标乃至同一任务的不同阶段都最优，而各策略的价值函数量纲不同甚至缺失，无法直接比较，频繁切换又会让控制不稳。
Method: WMPA 是测试时框架：输入一组冻结的目标条件策略，在学到的 state-space world model 中分别 rollout 每个策略，用共享的目标条件价值函数评估想象未来，执行得分最高的策略一个短承诺区间后再重新仲裁；不需要策略重训，也不需要特权的任务特定知识。
Result: 在 OGBench 官方评估协议的 18 个 state-based 数据集（maze 导航与 cube、scene、puzzle 操作）上，宏平均成功率由按数据集选最优策略的 44% 提升至 58%，12 个数据集上增益统计显著；单数据集增益包括 cube-double-play +33 个百分点、scene-play +36 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把冻结策略当组合、用 world model rollout 加共享价值函数在每个状态仲裁，比在整数据集上固定部署单个最优策略更有效，且无需重训策略。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Coefficient Calibration as Selection Pressure in Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: In memetic symbolic regression, candidate structures are compared after coefficient calibration, so the calibration protocol itself contributes to evolutionary selection. Standard centralized calibration evaluates each structure at its pooled-sample optimum, ignoring how stable this calibration is under covariate shifts, and can thus favor structures whose fit relies on sample-specific coefficients. We propose Dirichlet-Sinkhorn Constant Averaging (DSCA), a calibration strategy that partitions the optimization data into equally sized subsets with different covariate distributions, calibrates each candidate independently on every partition, and evaluates it at the mean of the resulting parameters. We show that the excess loss of DSCA relative to centralized calibration vanishes at the population level for correctly specified, identifiable expressions, whereas under misspecification it persists when partition-specific calibrations do not aggregate to the pooled optimum. On synthetic benchmarks and ten real-world datasets, DSCA improves functional recovery and the accuracy-complexity trade-off over centralized Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno and Levenberg-Marquardt calibration, under selection by negative log-likelihood and by the Akaike and Bayesian information criteria. Mechanism analyses associate the DSCA excess loss with the generalization gap and show that the effect is not reproduced by repeated centralized fitting. These results indicate that controlled heterogeneous calibration provides a complementary source of selection pressure in symbolic-regression search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 memetic 符号回归中，把系数校准协议本身当作选择压力：DSCA 将优化数据按协变量分布切成等量子集，每个候选结构在各子集上独立校准后取参数均值来评估。合成基准与十个真实数据集上，DSCA 相对集中式 BFGS 与 Levenberg-Marquardt 校准提升了函数恢复与精度-复杂度权衡，且该效应无法由重复集中式拟合复现。
Motivation: 集中式校准在全样本最优点上比较候选结构，忽略校准在协变量偏移下的稳定性，容易偏爱那些系数依赖特定样本、泛化差的结构。
Method: 提出 Dirichlet-Sinkhorn Constant Averaging (DSCA)：把优化数据划分为协变量分布不同的等大小子集，每个候选表达式在每个子集上独立校准，再以参数均值作为评估点；选择准则用负对数似然、AIC 与 BIC。理论上给出 DSCA 相对集中式校准的超额损失分析。
Result: 在合成基准与十个真实数据集上，DSCA 在负对数似然、AIC、BIC 三种选择准则下均改进函数恢复与精度-复杂度权衡，优于集中式 BFGS 与 Levenberg-Marquardt 校准；机制分析把 DSCA 超额损失与泛化间隙关联，且重复集中式拟合不能复现该效应。理论上，正确设定且可辨识时 DSCA 相对集中式校准的超额损失在总体层面消失，误设时若各子集校准无法聚合到池化最优点则持续存在。
Conclusion: 受控的异质化校准为符号回归搜索提供了集中式校准之外的补充选择压力，其收益来自校准在协变量偏移下的稳定性而非拟合次数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Speedbumps: Rejection Attacks on Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding is a popular technique for increasing the speed and reducing the costs of large language model (LLM) inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model forward pass. The resulting benefit depends on the ability of the drafter to approximate the target model's distribution. In this work, we study Speculative Rejection Attacks (SRAs), a novel class of attacks that cause draft and target models to disagree more often, resulting in fewer draft tokens being accepted per draft cycle. This leads to more target model forward passes needed per generated token, slowing down inference and increasing costs for the victim. We introduce two attacks which append an adversarial suffix to attacker-controlled content to degrade speculative decoding on a victim's prompts. Both attacks optimise the expected length of the accepted speculative prefix, estimating per-depth acceptance from the target's probability of the drafted proposals (Speedbump-P) or from the overlap between the draft and target distributions (Speedbump-D). In some cases, attacks degrade speculative decoding to the point of being slower than autoregressive decoding. The degradation reduces the output quality - regularisation restores output quality but gives up most of the degradation, trading effectiveness for stealthiness. Additionally, the suffixes remain effective under sampling, and transfer across drafters (Speedbump-P) or across target models sharing a drafter (Speedbump-D). These findings identify the draft-target interaction of speculative decoding as a realistic attack surface through which adversarial inputs can inflate inference costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对投机解码 (speculative decoding) 提出 Speculative Rejection Attack：在攻击者可控内容后附加对抗后缀，使草稿模型与目标模型更频繁不一致、每轮被接受的草稿 token 变少，从而增加目标模型前向次数、拖慢推理并抬高受害者的成本。两个变体 Speedbump-P（按目标模型对草稿提议的概率估计逐深度接受率）与 Speedbump-D（按草稿与目标分布的重叠估计）直接优化被接受投机前缀的期望长度；部分情形下解码比自回归还慢，且后缀在采样下仍有效并可跨 drafter 或跨共享 drafter 的目标模型迁移。
Motivation: 投机解码的加速收益依赖草稿模型逼近目标模型分布，而 draft-target 交互此前未被视为可被对抗输入利用的攻击面；攻击者可通过污染受害者提示中的可控内容抬高 LLM 推理成本。
Method: 提出两类 Speculative Rejection Attack (SRA)，在攻击者可控内容后拼接对抗后缀，目标函数为最大化（等价于优化）被接受投机前缀的期望长度：Speedbump-P 用目标模型对草稿提议的概率估计每个深度的接受率，Speedbump-D 用草稿与目标分布的重叠来估计；并考察正则化、采样条件与跨 drafter/跨目标模型的迁移。
Result: 两个攻击在部分情形下使投机解码比自回归解码更慢；攻击降低输出质量，正则化可恢复质量但放弃大部分降速效果（有效性与隐蔽性 trade-off）；后缀在采样下仍保持有效，Speedbump-P 跨 drafter 迁移、Speedbump-D 跨共享 drafter 的目标模型迁移。
Conclusion: 投机解码的 draft-target 交互是一个现实攻击面，对抗输入可以借此膨胀 LLM 推理成本；正则化能在质量与攻击隐蔽性之间取舍。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: 投机解码的加速收益依赖草稿模型逼近目标模型分布，而 draft-target 交互此前未被视为可被对抗输入利用的攻击面；攻击者可通过污染受害者提示中的可控内容抬高 LLM 推理成本。
summary_sections.method: 提出两类 Speculative Rejection Attack (SRA)，在攻击者可控内容后拼接对抗后缀，目标函数为最大化（等价于优化）被接受投机前缀的期望长度：Speedbump-P 用目标模型对草稿提议的概率估计每个深度的接受率，Speedbump-D 用草稿与目标分布的重叠来估计；并考察正则化、采样条件与跨 drafter/跨目标模型的迁移。
summary_sections.result: 两个攻击在部分情形下使投机解码比自回归解码更慢；攻击降低输出质量，正则化可恢复质量但放弃大部分降速效果（有效性与隐蔽性 trade-off）；后缀在采样下仍保持有效，Speedbump-P 跨 drafter 迁移、Speedbump-D 跨共享 drafter 的目标模型迁移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 投机解码的 draft-target 交互是一个现实攻击面，对抗输入可以借此膨胀 LLM 推理成本；正则化能在质量与攻击隐蔽性之间取舍。

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Discriminator WGAN Framework for Resource-Constrained Internet of Vehicles Using Reinforcement Learning and Game Theory
papers.abstract_en: Managing machine learning workloads as a network service introduces a resource-orchestration problem distinct from conventional model training; which nodes should be allocated to a task, how communication and computation budgets should be divided among them, and how service quality should be sustained as connectivity and node availability change with mobility. Deploying Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in Internet of Vehicles (IoV) environments is a demanding instance of this problem; resource constraints, dynamic network topologies, and competing optimization objectives mean that traditional GAN architectures cannot simultaneously achieve high accuracy, efficient resource use, low delay, and low communication overhead. This paper introduces an adaptive multi-discriminator Wasserstein GAN (MD-WGAN) framework that integrates reinforcement learning with game-theoretic coordination to address these challenges jointly. In our framework, roadside units host generators paired with Deep Q-Network (DQN) agents that select discriminator subsets and manage distributed training across mobile vehicular nodes, while a game-theoretic coordination step allocates training epochs between generators and discriminators. A unified optimization objective ties adversarial learning quality to resource efficiency, communication overhead, and latency under vehicular constraints, allowing the framework to continuously adapt its training behavior as network conditions change. Evaluation on real-world NGSIM trajectory data shows that the framework attains prediction accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art GAN baselines - the lowest RMSE (1.029) and MAE (0.894) among all evaluated methods - while markedly improving resource efficiency: average CPU utilization is reduced by roughly 28% and mean memory usage by roughly 6%, at competitive communication overhead and latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在车联网 (IoV) 中把 GAN 训练当作网络服务来做资源编排：路侧单元上的生成器配 DQN 智能体选择判别器子集并调度分布式训练，博弈论步骤在生成器与判别器之间分配训练轮次。在真实 NGSIM 轨迹数据上，该 MD-WGAN 框架取得所有评估方法中最低的 RMSE 1.029 与 MAE 0.894，同时平均 CPU 利用率降约 28%、内存降约 6%，通信开销与延迟保持相当。
Motivation: 把机器学习工作负载当作网络服务时，需要同时决定节点分配、通信与算力预算划分，并在移动导致连接与节点可用性变化时维持服务质量；传统 GAN 架构无法同时兼顾精度、资源效率、低延迟与低通信开销。
Method: 提出自适应多判别器 Wasserstein GAN (MD-WGAN)：路侧单元承载生成器并配 Deep Q-Network (DQN) 智能体，选择判别器子集并在移动车辆节点上管理分布式训练；博弈论协调步骤在生成器与判别器间分配训练轮次；统一优化目标把对抗学习质量与资源效率、通信开销、延迟绑定，随网络状况持续调整训练行为。
Result: 在真实 NGSIM 轨迹数据上，预测精度与最先进 GAN 基线相当，且在所有评估方法中 RMSE 最低 (1.029)、MAE 最低 (0.894)；平均 CPU 利用率降低约 28%，平均内存使用降低约 6%，通信开销与延迟保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把 GAN 的对抗训练质量与资源、通信、延迟放进同一个优化目标并用 RL 加博弈论协调，可以在车联网资源受限条件下同时保住预测精度并显著降低 CPU 与内存开销。

papers.title: The Missing Fourth Term for the Emulation Tensor Memory Equilibrium (TME) Model: The Residue Deconstruction Cost
papers.abstract_en: The Tensor-Memory Equilibrium (TME) model of "FP8 is All You Need (Part 1)" calculates the execution time of Ozaki Scheme II emulation of fp64 as the maximum of a tensor-core term and a High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM) traffic term, plus a per-output reconstruction term. However, it omits the per-input deconstruction cost: every streamed fp64 operand must be scaled, rounded, and reduced modulo each of the $r$ moduli on SIMT pipes before any matrix multiply can issue. In this note we add this fourth term, calibrate its constant from the cuBLAS emulation path, and derive a closed-form operational-intensity threshold $\mathrm{OI}^{*} = c_q r P_{\mathrm{fp64}}/(8P_{\mathrm{int}})$ below which emulation cannot match native fp64 regardless of tensor-core throughput. On the NVIDIA B300 GPU the threshold is $\mathrm{OI}^{*}\approx 0.56$ FLOP/B. As a result, GEMV, SpMV, and low-batch GEMV, which are the memory-bound kernels the original paper claims to accelerate, are limited to 0.3-0.9x of native performance, and the 7-point stencil to 1.8x rather than the claimed 3.1x. Dense GEMM is unaffected as expected. We also show that precomputing and storing the residues moves the same cost into the bandwidth term, and we state the instruction count that an implementation would have to achieve to invalidate the bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TME 模型遗漏了 fp64 操作数的逐输入 residue 解构开销：每个流式操作数须在 SIMT 管线上缩放、取整并对 r 个模数取模，矩阵乘才能发射。补上第四项后导出闭式 operational-intensity 阈值 OI* = c_q r P_fp64/(8P_int)，NVIDIA B300 上 OI*≈0.56 FLOP/B；低于该阈值时无论 tensor core 吞吐多高，Ozaki Scheme II 模拟 fp64 都无法追平原生 fp64。
Motivation: TME 模型把 Ozaki Scheme II 模拟 fp64 的执行时间算作 tensor-core 项与 HBM 流量项的最大值加逐输出重构项，漏掉了逐输入解构成本，导致对 memory-bound kernel 的加速预测失真。
Method: 在 TME 中加入第四项（逐输入 residue 解构成本），从 cuBLAS 模拟路径标定其常数，并推导 operational-intensity 阈值 OI* = c_q r P_fp64/(8P_int)；同时说明预计算并存储 residues 会把同一成本移入带宽项，并给出使该界失效所需的指令数。
Result: NVIDIA B300 上 OI*≈0.56 FLOP/B；GEMV、SpMV 与低 batch GEMV 这些原论文声称加速的 memory-bound kernel 被限制在原生 fp64 的 0.3–0.9x，7 点 stencil 从原声称的 3.1x 降为 1.8x，dense GEMM 不受影响。
Conclusion: 低于 OI* 阈值时，Ozaki Scheme II 模拟 fp64 存在与 tensor-core 吞吐无关的硬上限，原 TME 对 memory-bound kernel 的加速主张不成立；dense GEMM 不受该第四项影响。

papers.title: Language Models for Page-Level Layout Decisions in E-commerce Search
papers.abstract_en: E-commerce search pages are critical touchpoints for millions of online shoppers. While traditional search engines return a ranked list of results, modern E-commerce search pages increasingly incorporate recommender system modules -- for example, secondary stacks that surface alternative product groupings at specific positions. When introduced appropriately, secondary stacks can improve user engagement; however, suboptimal placement may disrupt browsing flow and degrade the primary results. Unlike traditional search ranking, where evaluation techniques such as interleaving are well established, evaluating page-level layout changes e.g., when and where to insert a secondary stack remains challenging without costly online A/B testing. To address this, we study offline methods for evaluating whether a given layout decision -- specifically, the inclusion of a secondary stack at a particular position -- is beneficial to users. We investigate language models as scalable evaluators by comparing direct prompt-based, prompt-derived feature, and representation-based methods. Our results show that representation-based approaches consistently outperform prompt-based judging in predicting user engagement, suggesting they provide a reliable foundation for offline layout evaluation in E-commerce search.
papers.comment: Accepted at the OARS Workshop, ACM RecSys 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用语言模型做电商搜索页级布局决策的离线评估，判断在某位置插入 secondary stack 是否对用户有利；对比直接 prompt 判分、prompt 抽取特征、基于表示三类方法，基于表示的方法在预测用户参与度上稳定优于 prompt 判分。
Motivation: 电商搜索页级布局改动（如 secondary stack 插入位置）缺少类似 interleaving 的成熟离线评估手段，只能依赖成本高的在线 A/B 测试。
Method: 把布局决策是否有益表述为评估任务，比较三种语言模型评估器：直接 prompt-based 判分、prompt-derived feature、representation-based 方法，以预测用户参与度作为评判目标。
Result: 基于表示的方法在预测用户互动 (user engagement) 上稳定优于 prompt-based 判分，被作者视为离线页级布局评估的可靠基础。
Conclusion: 语言模型可作为页级布局改动的可扩展离线评估器，其中表示式判分比直接 prompt 判分更可靠。

papers.title: Implementation Guidelines for Data Quality Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Despite decades of data quality (DQ) research, a gap remains between DQ dimensions, such as accuracy or completeness, which the literature defines in textual form, and DQ tools, which typically implement low-level checks that are not aligned with these dimensions. ISO/IEC 25024 and ISO/IEC 5259 attempt to bridge this gap by defining DQ metrics for each dimension. However, these DQ metrics are hardly used, because the standards leave open how to implement them: for example, the metric for syntactic accuracy counts syntactically accurate values, but does not state how to decide that a value is syntactically accurate. This simply moves the problem to another level without solving it. As a result, DQ assessment currently cannot build on the standards. In this paper, we make the ISO DQ metrics executable. We classify all data-level metrics of both standards into (i) generalizable metrics that need no input beyond the data, (ii) parameterized metrics whose parameters can be learned from clean reference data or set by an expert, and (iii) non-generalizable metrics that need qualitative judgment and cannot be automated. For the metrics that can be automated, i.e., categories (i) and (ii), we propose implementation guidelines that resolve what the standards leave open. We realize the guidelines in dqmeasure, an open-source library of 20 metrics that learns these parameters from reference data instead of relying on manually defined rules. Our experiments on real-world and synthetic datasets show that the metric scores decrease monotonically with an increasing number of injected errors, decline together with downstream ML performance, and scale linearly with the number of rows, which enables automated DQ monitoring based on the standards.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to EDBT 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ISO/IEC 25024 与 ISO/IEC 5259 的数据质量 (DQ) 指标做成可执行实现：先按是否需要额外输入把两标准的数据级指标分为可泛化、参数化、不可泛化三类，再为可自动化的前两类给出实现指南，并落地为开源库 dqmeasure（20 个指标，参数从干净参考数据学习而非手写规则）。在真实与合成数据集上，指标分数随注入错误数增加单调下降、与下游 ML 性能同步下降、随行数线性扩展，从而支持基于标准的自动化 DQ 监控。
Motivation: 文献用文字定义 DQ 维度，DQ 工具却只做与维度不对齐的底层检查；ISO 标准虽给出各维度的 DQ 指标，但未说明如何判定（例如一个值是否语法正确），等于把问题挪到另一层，导致这些指标几乎不被使用。
Method: 将两标准的所有数据级指标分类为 (i) 只需数据本身的可泛化指标、(ii) 参数可从干净参考数据学习或由专家设定的参数化指标、(iii) 需要定性判断、无法自动化的不可泛化指标；对 (i)(ii) 给出填补标准空白的实现指南，并实现为开源库 dqmeasure，含 20 个指标，参数从参考数据学习而非依赖人工规则。
Result: 在真实与合成数据集上的实验显示：指标分数随注入错误数量增加而单调下降，与下游 ML 性能一同下降，并随数据行数线性扩展（线性可扩展性）。
Conclusion: ISO 的 DQ 指标在补齐实现细节并用参考数据学参数后可以变成可执行、可自动化的数据质量监控；不可泛化的指标仍需定性判断、无法自动化。

papers.title: When Listening Becomes Easier: Scrubbing Visual Cues for Shortcut-Free VLAs
papers.abstract_en: Shortcut learning is a prevalent issue in robot learning. The limited diversity of robot demonstration datasets can mislead policies into exploiting spurious correlations between tasks and irrelevant features, such as viewpoint or background. Collecting sufficiently diverse robot demonstrations is costly and inefficient, motivating algorithmic alternatives. We focus on vision-language-action (VLA) models and discover that different vision-language model backbones exhibit substantially different levels of susceptibility to visual shortcut learning. We find that model behavior correlates with our proposed representation-level metric, action margin, which requires no policy rollouts. Visual shortcuts consistently enter action representations in early layers, with models differing in the extent to which later layers correct them by incorporating language information. To boost models' attention to language, we introduce task scrubbing, a new domain-adversarial training method that decreases models' likelihood of using visual shortcuts and improves VLAs' generalization. Experiments in both simulation and the real world across multiple VLAs and visual cues show that task scrubbing improves out-of-distribution robustness and often eliminates visual shortcut learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 VLA 中视角、背景等视觉捷径，提出表征级度量 action margin（无需策略 rollout）与域对抗训练方法 task scrubbing，压低模型依赖视觉捷径的概率、把注意力拉回语言。仿真与真机多 VLA、多视觉线索实验显示其提升分布外鲁棒性，并常消除视觉捷径学习。
Motivation: 机器人演示数据多样性有限，策略会利用任务与视角、背景等无关特征的伪相关；补充采集演示成本高，需要算法层面的替代方案。
Method: 提出表征级度量 action margin，用于刻画不同 VLM backbone 对视觉捷径的易感性且无需策略 rollout；再引入域对抗训练方法 task scrubbing，抑制早期层进入动作表征的视觉捷径、促使后续层更多借助语言信息纠正。

papers.title: Power Side-Channel Membership Inference Attack on Embedded Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) threaten the privacy of machine learning (ML) training data by determining whether a sample was used to train a target model. Existing MIAs rely on model outputs, ranging from prediction probabilities to predicted labels, an assumption that can be restrictive for on-device ML systems with limited or inaccessible outputs. However, suppressing model outputs does not eliminate the data-dependent computations that produce them, which may remain observable through physical side channels. We present PSCMIA, a power side-channel membership inference attack against embedded ML models that can infer membership directly from power traces without requiring prediction probabilities or even the predicted labels. We evaluate PSCMIA across multiple datasets (MNIST, FMNIST, CIFAR10, CINIC10), fully connected (FC) and convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, and two embedded platforms (STM32F3, XMEGA). PSCMIA achieves ROC-AUC values of up to 0.907 on FC models. For CNN models, the ROC-AUC gap between PSCMIA and probability vector-based shadow MIA ranges from 0.006 to 0.116. Across the FC and CNN evaluations, PSCMIA outperforms label-only MIA in 11 of 16 model-dataset-hardware configurations, demonstrating that physical execution can expose membership information even when conventional model outputs are unavailable through unintended power side-channel leakage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PSCMIA 直接从嵌入式 ML 推理的功耗轨迹推断训练样本成员身份，无需预测概率甚至预测标签。在 MNIST/FMNIST/CIFAR10/CINIC10 上的 FC 与 CNN 模型、STM32F3 与 XMEGA 两个平台上，FC 模型 ROC-AUC 最高 0.907；相对基于概率向量的 shadow MIA，CNN 上 ROC-AUC 差距为 0.006–0.116；在 16 个模型-数据集-硬件配置中的 11 个上胜过 label-only MIA。
Motivation: 现有成员推断攻击 (MIA) 依赖模型输出（预测概率或标签），而设备端 ML 常限制或屏蔽这些输出；但产生输出的数据依赖计算仍可通过物理侧信道观测。
Method: 提出功耗侧信道成员推断攻击 PSCMIA：从目标模型执行时的功耗轨迹直接推断成员身份，绕过概率与标签；在 MNIST、FMNIST、CIFAR10、CINIC10 上覆盖全连接 (FC) 与卷积 (CNN) 架构，并在 STM32F3、XMEGA 两个嵌入式平台上评测，与基于概率向量的 shadow MIA 和 label-only MIA 对比。
Result: FC 模型上 PSCMIA 的 ROC-AUC 最高达 0.907；CNN 模型上 PSCMIA 与概率向量 shadow MIA 的 ROC-AUC 差距为 0.006 至 0.116；在 FC 与 CNN 评测的 16 个模型-数据集-硬件配置中，PSCMIA 在 11 个上优于 label-only MIA。
Conclusion: 即使常规模型输出不可用，物理执行过程的功耗侧信道泄漏仍会暴露训练数据成员信息，屏蔽输出不足以保护成员隐私。

papers.title: Reading the Room: Foundations, Design, and Challenges of Normative Competence in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Human communities are governed by normative systems: shared standards that produce \textit{norms} dictating acceptable behavior, enforced through community sanctioning. Aligning increasingly autonomous AI systems with these norms is a central alignment challenge, complicated by the fact that norms are vast in number, change quickly, and are often arbitrary (e.g., dress or language conventions). Thus, alignment requires \textit{normative competence}: the ability to discern from interaction alone what norms a community enforces without relying on static pretrained knowledge. We introduce a multi-agent community debate setting, where access to debate is governed by synthetic norms, to study normative competence in isolation from pretraining exposure. We show that baseline LLM agents fail to learn norms even when doing so would improve their accuracy. We then experiment with various \textit{normative modules} -- architectural components for norm inference -- finding that norm-following is highly sensitive to both the style of norm and the model powering the normative module, suggesting a lack of generalizability. Furthermore, when idiosyncratic, non-normative behaviors accompany the true norm, LLM agents exhibit an unselective attribution failure: they indiscriminately copy idiosyncratic noise alongside enforced rules, a pattern that persists even when imitating unnecessary behaviors is explicitly penalized. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to operationalize and evaluate normative competence in LLMs, demonstrating that current AI systems excel at behavioral mimicry but lack the capacity to discern socially enforced order.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多智能体社区辩论设定，用合成规范控制辩论准入，把 LLM 的规范能力 (normative competence) 从预训练暴露中剥离出来单独评测。基线 LLM 即使学习规范能提高准确率也不学；加入各类 normative module 后，规范遵循表现对规范风格和驱动模型高度敏感，且当真实规范伴随非规范的特异行为时，模型会无差别复制噪声，即使模仿冗余行为被显式惩罚也持续存在。
Motivation: 自主 AI 系统要与人类社区规范对齐，但规范数量庞大、变化快、常任意（如着装或语言惯例），静态预训练知识无法覆盖，需要从交互中推断当前社区实际执行的规范。
Method: 构建多智能体社区辩论设定，准入规则由合成规范决定，从而在隔离预训练暴露的条件下评测规范推断；对比基线 LLM 与多种 normative module（用于规范推断的架构组件），并让真实规范与非规范特异行为共现以测试归因选择性。
Result: 基线 LLM 即使学习规范能提升准确率也不去学；normative module 的规范遵循对规范风格与驱动模型高度敏感，缺乏泛化性；当特异的非规范行为伴随真实规范出现时，模型无差别复制这些噪声，即使显式惩罚模仿冗余行为该模式仍持续。
Conclusion: 当前 AI 系统擅长行为模仿 (behavioral mimicry)，但缺乏辨别社会强制秩序的能力；这是首个将 LLM 的规范能力操作化并评测的工作。

papers.title: How Hackable Is Your Speech Quality Metric? A Corrected Protocol, a Benchmark, and What Patching Buys
papers.abstract_en: Speech quality predictors are increasingly used as rewards, yet no agreed measure of their hackability exists. The usual measurement has two flaws. First, the perturbation reaches the predictor through a processing chain -- here a neural codec -- that shifts the score on its own, which scoring against the raw input charges to the attack. Referencing the unperturbed round trip instead changes measured hackability by up to a factor of four (0.31 to 0.08 for one defence). Second, one trained attacker is a sample, not a measurement: five attackers differing only in random seed reach success rates from 0.00 to 0.38 against one fixed predictor, so a defence claim needs the worst case over several. Under this protocol, four published predictors differ widely: NISQA is hacked on 90% of utterances, SSL-MOS on 21%, DNSMOS on 14% and UTMOS on 6%. We then audit a closed attack-detect-patch loop. It hardens the predictor only in its own attack space, by less than the spread between attackers; a random-perturbation baseline matches it; and it costs up to 0.30 system SRCC out of domain. Enhancers post-trained against patched predictors hack them far less (PESQ -0.03 versus -0.23). Code, preregistration and run outputs are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语音质量预测器被当作奖励使用时，其可被攻击程度 (hackability) 缺乏公认度量；作者修正测量协议后发现，用未扰动的神经编解码器往返做参照会把测得的 hackability 改变最多 4 倍（某防御从 0.31 降到 0.08），且单个攻击者只是样本——5 个仅随机种子不同的攻击者对同一预测器成功率从 0.00 到 0.38。按修正协议，NISQA 在 90% 语句上被攻破，SSL-MOS 21%、DNSMOS 14%、UTMOS 6%；闭环 patch 只在自身攻击空间内加固，代价是域外系统 SRCC 最多降 0.30。
Motivation: 语音质量预测器越来越多被当作 RL 奖励，但没有公认的 hackability 度量；现有测量把神经编解码器处理链自身造成的分数偏移算到攻击头上，且只用单个攻击者，无法支撑防御结论。
Method: 提出修正协议：以未扰动的编解码器往返分数为参照，隔离处理链偏移；对每个防御取多个（此处 5 个仅随机种子不同）攻击者中的最坏情形而非单样本；在此协议下评测 4 个已发表预测器 (NISQA、SSL-MOS、DNSMOS、UTMOS)，并审计一个闭环 attack-detect-patch 流程，附随机扰动基线。
Result: 参照未扰动往返使测得 hackability 变化最多 4 倍（0.31→0.08）；5 个攻击者对同一固定预测器成功率 0.00–0.38；NISQA 90% 语句被攻破，SSL-MOS 21%、DNSMOS 14%、UTMOS 6%；闭环 patch 的加固幅度小于攻击者间差距，随机扰动基线与之持平，且域外系统 SRCC 最多损失 0.30；针对 patched 预测器后训练的 enhancer 被攻破程度低得多（PESQ 下降 -0.03 对 -0.23）。
Conclusion: hackability 必须按往返参照加多攻击者最坏情形来测，否则防御声明不成立；闭环 patch 只在自身攻击空间内有效且有域外代价，而针对 patched 预测器后训练 enhancer 才真正降低被攻击程度。

papers.title: Gen-PINNs: Generative Adversarial Physics Informed Neural Networks for solving partial differential equations
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a widely used data-free method for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) using machine learning. With recent advances in Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), adversarial learning has shown strong capabilities for modeling complex data-driven problems; however, the use of GANs in deterministic physics-informed PDE solutions remains limited. In this work, we first identify limitations of standard PINNs for solving PDEs, including spectral bias, loss imbalance, and optimizer stagnation. We then propose Generative Adversarial Physics-Informed Neural Networks (Gen-PINNs), a unified deterministic residual-adversarial framework designed to improve data-free solutions of PDEs with sharp or shock-front behavior. The generator learns the underlying PDE solution using dynamically weighted physics-informed loss components, while separate discriminators evaluate complementary PDE residual features against ideal zero-residual states. The framework further develops and adapts several methodological components, including a Fourier representation for resolving high-frequency spatial content, an orthonormal spectral diagnostic for quantifying frequency-dependent solution errors, and a modified gradient-based dynamic weighting system for physics, initial-condition, boundary-condition, and adversarial loss objectives. Gen-PINNs is tested against standard PINNs on nonlinear and higher-order PDEs, including the Burgers, Allen-Cahn, and Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equations. The results demonstrate substantial improvements in accuracy and convergence across sharp-front, stiff, and higher-order PDE solutions, highlighting the potential of deterministic residual-adversarial learning as an effective approach for solving challenging nonlinear PDEs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Gen-PINNs 把 GAN 式对抗训练引入确定性 PINN：生成器用动态加权的物理损失学习 PDE 解，多个判别器分别评估 PDE 残差特征与理想零残差状态的差距，并用 Fourier 表示缓解谱偏置。在 Burgers、Allen-Cahn、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 等含激波前沿、刚性与高阶方程上，相比标准 PINN 在精度与收敛性上均有明显提升。
Motivation: 标准 PINN 求解含尖锐前沿或激波的 PDE 时受谱偏置、损失项失衡与优化器停滞限制，数据自由的确定性求解精度不足。
Method: 提出 Gen-PINNs 残差-对抗框架：生成器以动态加权的物理、初值、边界与对抗损失学习 PDE 解；独立判别器针对互补的 PDE 残差特征与理想零残差状态做判别；辅以 Fourier 表示捕捉高频空间内容、正交谱诊断量度频率相关误差，以及基于梯度的动态权重系统。
Result: 在 Burgers、Allen-Cahn、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 等非线性与高阶 PDE 上对照标准 PINN 测试，结果显示在尖锐前沿、刚性与高阶解的精度与收敛性均有显著提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 确定性残差-对抗学习可作为求解困难非线性 PDE 的有效途径，缓解标准 PINN 的谱偏置与损失失衡问题。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Gen-PINNs 残差-对抗框架：生成器以动态加权的物理、初值、边界与对抗损失学习 PDE 解；独立判别器针对互补的 PDE 残差特征与理想零残差状态做判别；辅以 Fourier 表示捕捉高频空间内容、正交谱诊断量度频率相关误差，以及基于梯度的动态权重系统。
summary_sections.result: 在 Burgers、Allen-Cahn、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 等非线性与高阶 PDE 上对照标准 PINN 测试，结果显示在尖锐前沿、刚性与高阶解的精度与收敛性均有显著提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 确定性残差-对抗学习可作为求解困难非线性 PDE 的有效途径，缓解标准 PINN 的谱偏置与损失失衡问题。

papers.title: Less from More: Reinforcing Sparse Video Reasoning from Dense References
papers.abstract_en: Video-language models commonly assume that more temporal observations lead to more reliable reasoning. We question this assumption and argue that the key challenge is not merely processing more video frames efficiently, but learning to reason reliably under limited temporal evidence. We propose SAVER, a dense-to-sparse post-training framework that uses dense video views as training-time references for sparse-frame inference. During reinforcement post-training, paired dense and sparse views are optimized with grounding rewards and a reliability-gated reference reward, encouraging sparse view predictions to preserve task-relevant temporal evidence. Notably, SAVER is trained only on 1,250 randomly sampled temporal grounding examples, without using any video question answering annotations. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks and six video question-answering benchmarks, SAVER consistently improves performance across frame budgets. In particular, SAVER can match or surpass dense-frame Qwen3.5 baselines while using substantially fewer frames. These results show that temporal grounding can serve as an effective evidence-localization proxy for learning sparse video reasoning that transfers to broader video understanding tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAVER 用稠密视频视图作训练期参考、稀疏帧作推理输入，通过 grounding 奖励与可靠性门控的参考奖励做强化后训练，使稀疏视图预测保留任务相关的时间证据。仅用 1,250 条随机采样的 temporal grounding 样本、不使用任何视频问答标注，在三个 temporal grounding 基准与六个视频问答基准上跨帧预算一致提升，能以远少于稠密帧的帧数匹配或超过 Qwen3.5 稠密帧基线。
Motivation: 视频-语言模型默认观测帧越多推理越可靠，但真正的难点不是高效处理更多帧，而是在有限时间证据下可靠推理。
Method: SAVER 是 dense-to-sparse 后训练框架：训练时配对稠密与稀疏视图，用 grounding 奖励加可靠性门控的 reference reward 做强化后训练，促使稀疏视图预测保留任务相关时间证据；训练数据为 1,250 条随机采样的 temporal grounding 样本，不含视频问答标注。
Result: 在三个 temporal grounding 基准和六个视频问答基准上，SAVER 在各帧预算下均一致提升性能；以远少于稠密帧的帧数匹配或超过稠密帧 Qwen3.5 基线。
Conclusion: temporal grounding 可作为有效的时间证据定位代理，学到的稀疏视频推理能迁移到更广的视频理解任务，且不必依赖视频问答标注。

papers.title: SPLIT-RL: Staged Perception-Language Reasoning Training with Claim-Level Advantages
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language (VL) reasoning requires a model to both extract relevant and accurate information from an image (visual reasoning, VR), and to infer the answer from it (language reasoning, LR). Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards typically trains both through a single chain-of-thought with a final-answer reward. This gives every CoT token the same sequence-level advantage, failing to distinguish capability specific errors. We propose SPLIT-RL, a staged post-training approach that trains VR and LR in disjoint phases. Because a group's rollouts differ along one capability at a time, the group-relative advantage isolates it, and each phase is optimized using phase-specific reward. We further introduce Claim-Level Advantage (CLA-GRPO), which decomposes VR-phase rollouts into atomic visual claims and provides a fine-grained advantage at claim level based on visual-type group formation. Although trained in two phases, trained policy is evaluated like GRPO model, with a single CoT call at inference time. Under this protocol, SPLIT-RL improves average accuracy over GRPO by 1.4-6.1 points across Qwen3-VL models from 2B to 30B-A3B and InternVL3.5-8B. Evaluating each capability using an oracle based diagnostic shows that answer-only GRPO leaves perception unchanged, whereas SPLIT-RL improves both VR and LR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPLIT-RL 把视觉推理 (VR) 与语言推理 (LR) 拆成不相交的后训练阶段，使组相对优势一次只隔离一种能力，并用阶段专属奖励优化；再提出 Claim-Level Advantage (CLA-GRPO)，把 VR 阶段的 rollout 分解为原子视觉 claim、按视觉类型分组给出 claim 级细粒度优势。在单次 CoT 推理协议下，相对 GRPO 平均准确率提升 1.4–6.1 个百分点，覆盖 Qwen3-VL 2B 到 30B-A3B 及 InternVL3.5-8B；oracle 诊断显示 answer-only GRPO 不改变感知，SPLIT-RL 则同时改善 VR 与 LR。
Motivation: 可验证奖励的 RL 通常用单一 CoT 加最终答案奖励同时训练 VR 与 LR，整条序列共享同一个序列级优势，无法区分是感知出错还是推理出错。
Method: 分阶段后训练：VR 与 LR 在不相交阶段分别训练，同组 rollout 只沿一种能力变化，组相对优势据此隔离该能力，每阶段用阶段专属奖励优化；CLA-GRPO 将 VR 阶段 rollout 分解为原子视觉 claim，按 visual-type 分组给出 claim 级优势。推理时与 GRPO 相同，单次 CoT 调用。
Result: 在该协议下，SPLIT-RL 相对 GRPO 平均准确率提升 1.4–6.1 点，覆盖 Qwen3-VL 2B、30B-A3B 与 InternVL3.5-8B；基于 oracle 的能力诊断显示 answer-only GRPO 使感知保持不变，SPLIT-RL 同时提升 VR 与 LR。
Conclusion: 把 VR 与 LR 分阶段并下放到 claim 级优势，能在不增加推理开销的前提下同时改善感知与推理，而单一序列级奖励的 GRPO 只动推理不动感知。

papers.title: Stochastic Teacher Intervention for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from a stronger teacher to a student language model through dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts and has shown promise on complex tasks such as mathematical reasoning. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student decisions shape subsequent observations, causing early errors to accumulate across turns. The resulting trajectories can drift away from the teacher's rollout distribution, making the teacher's token-level supervision less reliable or even counterproductive for OPD training. To address this issue, we introduce STI-OPD, a stochastic teacher intervention framework for multi-turn agentic OPD. During multi-turn interaction, STI-OPD uses teacher intervention guided by teacher-student policy discrepancy to replace the student's proposed action with a teacher-generated one to maximize the acquisition of reliable supervision. We further develop a stochastic intervention strategy, addressing the limitations of previous threshold-based or fixed-schedule approaches, that estimates policy discrepancy using KL divergence and maps it to an intervention probability. By sampling whether to intervene from this probability, STI-OPD adaptively balances teacher control with student exploration. To learn from the resulting mixed-policy trajectories, we introduce an Importance-Weighted Reverse KL objective that corrects the token sampling mismatch between teacher-generated responses and the student policy to preserve the original OPD objective. Across tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon interaction, STI-OPD outperforms the strongest prior OPD baseline on every evaluated benchmark and student size. Ablations further show that both discrepancy-guided intervention and importance weighting contribute to these gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STI-OPD 在多轮 agentic on-policy 蒸馏中用 KL 散度衡量师生策略差异并映射为干预概率，随机决定是否用教师动作替换学生动作，再用 Importance-Weighted Reverse KL 校正混合策略轨迹上的 token 采样失配。在工具集成推理与长程交互任务上，它在每个评测 benchmark 和每种学生规模上都超过最强的既有 OPD 基线，消融显示差异引导干预与重要性加权各自贡献了增益。
Motivation: 多轮 agentic 任务中学生决策决定后续观测，早期错误跨轮累积，使轨迹偏离教师 rollout 分布，教师的 token 级监督因此变得不可靠甚至有害。
Method: STI-OPD 在多轮交互中用师生策略差异引导教师干预，把学生提出的动作替换为教师生成的动作；用 KL 散度估计差异并映射为干预概率，按该概率采样是否干预，以在教师控制与学生探索之间自适应平衡。为学习由此产生的混合策略轨迹，引入 Importance-Weighted Reverse KL 目标，校正教师生成响应与学生策略之间的 token 采样失配，以保持原始 OPD 目标。
Result: 在工具集成推理与长程交互两类任务上，STI-OPD 在每一个评测 benchmark、每一种学生规模上都优于最强的既有 OPD 基线；消融实验表明差异引导干预与重要性加权都对这些增益有贡献。
Conclusion: 按策略差异随机干预并配合重要性加权，可以在多轮 agentic 蒸馏中既保住可靠监督又保留学生探索，从而全面超过阈值式或固定调度的干预方案。

papers.title: Barron Optimal Transport I: Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by recent applications in generative modeling and sampling, we introduce a framework for optimal measure transport where cost captures the notion of neural network complexity. In transport-based generative models, samples from a reference distribution (e.g. Gaussian) are mapped to samples of a target distribution along ordinary or stochastic differential equations. These are implemented as deep residual networks when discretized in time, where each hidden layer approximates the associated instantaneous velocity. Thus, given a pair of target and reference measures, a natural question is to search for the most efficient neural representation that implements this transport. Our starting point is the kinetic formulation of OT, due to Benamou and Brenier. We replace the average kinetic $L^2$ energy by the \emph{Barron} energy \cite{bach2017breaking, ma2022barron}, a natural norm which measures the complexity of representing a given vector field with a neural hidden layer, and which captures the adaptive properties of feature learning. This defines a metric on the space of probability measures, complementing existing Wasserstein and Stein geometries. In this work we examine the properties of this metric in the context of generative modeling. As a first application, we quantify the suboptimality of diffusion generative modeling in the Barron geometry by establishing super-polynomial score approximation lower bounds for data generated by neural network pushforwards of the Gaussian. We then investigate the benefit of adaptivity as a way to study alternative generative models. In a companion paper \cite{companionpaper} we leverage the Barron transport geometry for sampling applications, extending the scope of Stein variational gradient methods via feature adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Benamou–Brenier 动力学形式的最优传输代价从平均动能 L² 换成 Barron 能量，得到一种度量神经网络表示复杂度的概率测度度量，并用它证明扩散生成模型在 Barron 几何下的次优性：对高斯的神经网络推前数据，score 近似存在超多项式下界。
Motivation: 传输式生成模型把参考分布经 ODE/SDE 映到目标分布，时间离散后即深度残差网络，但现有 OT 几何（Wasserstein、Stein）只度量传输代价，不反映实现该传输的神经表示复杂度，无法刻画自适应特征学习带来的收益。
Method: 以 Benamou–Brenier 动力学 OT 为出发点，用衡量向量场经单隐层神经网络表示复杂度的 Barron 范数替换平均动能 L² 项，由此在概率测度空间上定义新的度量，与既有 Wasserstein 和 Stein 几何互补；在此几何下分析生成建模。
Result: 对由高斯分布经神经网络推前生成的数据，建立了 score 近似的超多项式下界 (super-polynomial score approximation lower bounds)，从而量化扩散生成模型在 Barron 几何下的次优性；并把自适应性作为研究替代生成模型的工具。
Conclusion: 以 Barron 能量定义的传输几何能刻画神经表示复杂度，并给出扩散模型 score 匹配路线的超多项式下界，说明自适应特征学习是绕开该下界的路径；采样应用（经特征自适应扩展 Stein 变分梯度方法）留给配套论文。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Transformed Samplers with Variance Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods are the standard tool for computing expectations under complex probability distributions. Control variates reduce the variance of the resulting estimates, but a good control variate requires solving the Poisson equation of the sampler, which rarely admits a closed-form solution. Exact solutions are available when the sampler's kernel has a known spectral decomposition on a simple reference density. In our work, we extend these solutions to general targets through a learned change of variables. A bijection, such as a normalizing flow, is trained so that the target becomes close to the reference in a latent space, and we show that Markov kernels and their Poisson solutions are transformed by any bijection. Running such samplers in the latent space then yields explicit control variates, and the estimator is consistent under mild tail conditions on the map and target. Importance sampling (IS) from the flow is the limiting case of the same construction and the control variates apply to it as well. Experiments on synthetic targets and real posteriors compare the procedure against state-of-the-art samplers and control variates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 MCMC 控制变量 (control variate) 的求解从简单参考密度推广到一般目标分布：训练一个双射（如 normalizing flow）把目标变换到潜空间，使 Markov 核与 Poisson 方程解在该双射下可解析变换，从而在潜空间运行采样器时得到显式控制变量。在温和的尾部条件下估计量一致，importance sampling 是该构造的极限情形且同样适用控制变量。
Motivation: 控制变量能降低 MCMC 期望估计的方差，但好的控制变量需要解采样器的 Poisson 方程，而该方程通常没有闭式解；只有当核在简单参考密度上有已知谱分解时才有精确解。
Method: 训练一个双射（normalizing flow）使目标在潜空间中接近参考密度；证明 Markov 核及其 Poisson 解在任意双射下按相应方式变换，在潜空间运行采样器得到显式控制变量；把从 flow 出发的 importance sampling 视为同一构造的极限情形并同样施加控制变量。
Result: 在合成目标与真实后验上，将该流程与 state-of-the-art 的采样器和控制变量作比较；估计量在对映射与目标的温和尾部条件下一致。
Conclusion: 经学习的变量变换可以把原本只在简单参考密度上可解的 Poisson 方程控制变量搬到一般目标分布上，importance sampling 被纳入同一框架。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Conversational Voice Aesthetic Model with Reinforcement Learning from Human Listeners
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Conversational Voice Aesthetic Model, a speech large language model for describing the voice aesthetics of real or synthetic speech responses in natural conversational contexts. Given a context and a response speech, CVAM describes salient moments that characterize the voice and predicts nine categorical attributes spanning gender, pitch, pacing, emotion, and delivery. The key challenge lies in perceptual fields such as emotion and delivery, which are inherently subjective and lack definitive ground truth. Therefore, we collect ~10 human annotations for each of 3k real and synthetic responses derived from the CANDOR corpus. CVAM is supervised finetuned on synthesized aesthetic descriptions and labels, then optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization on human judgments. Experiments show that CVAM better agrees with human listeners than Gemini 3.1 Pro and open-source speech LLMs, and outperforms single-human-vs.-rest agreement. Together, we demonstrate the importance of grounding voice aesthetics in human perception and propose a principled framework for human alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CVAM 是一个语音大语言模型，用自然对话上下文描述真实或合成语音的嗓音美学，并预测性别、音高、节奏、情绪、表达方式等九类属性。它先在合成美学描述与标签上做监督微调，再用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 依据人类听者判断优化，最终与人类听者的一致性超过 Gemini 3.1 Pro、开源语音 LLM，以及单人对 rest 的一致性。
Motivation: 情绪与表达方式等感知字段主观、没有确定 ground truth，通用语音 LLM 与人工单点标注都难以稳定对齐人类听者判断。
Method: 从 CANDOR 语料取 3k 条真实与合成回复，每条约 10 条人工标注；CVAM 先在合成美学描述与标签上监督微调，再用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 以人类判断为奖励优化。
Result: 实验显示 CVAM 与人类听者的一致性优于 Gemini 3.1 Pro 与开源语音 LLM，并超过单人对 rest 的一致性；数据规模为 3k 条回复、每条约 10 条标注、九类属性。
Conclusion: 把嗓音美学锚定在人类感知上，并用 RLHF 式优化对齐听者判断，是比通用多模态模型更可靠的人类对齐框架。

papers.title: Shape irregularity of Life-Like Network Automaton rules as an indicator of classification performance
papers.abstract_en: Complex Network (CN) classification requires high-level structural characterizations that are both scale-invariant and computationally efficient. Methods based on Life-Like Network Automata (LLNA) offer an interesting way to extract network descriptors by leveraging emergent temporal patterns without requiring provided features, but their efficacy is bottlenecked by a high-cost combinatorial optimization problem: the selection of the automaton transition rule. While current literature relies on exhaustive searches that are unfeasible for large-scale applications, this work reveals that the rule space is fundamentally structured by a property we term ``jaggedness'', that quantifies the resemblance of a LLNA transition function with a sawtooth shape. We demonstrate that this metric acts as a theoretical proxy for chaoticity and sensitivity -- properties essential for generating discriminative dynamic behaviors among network categories. Moreover, we introduce a heuristic search strategy that uses jaggedness to guide the rule selection. Experimental results show that our approach achieves classification accuracies within 5% of the global optimum while reducing computational overhead by 90% compared to exhaustive approach. Our findings provide a novel, efficient, framework for optimizing automata-based methods for pattern recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用 jaggedness（锯齿度）刻画 Life-Like Network Automaton (LLNA) 转移规则的形状不规则性，作为混沌性与敏感性的理论代理，并据此引导规则选择的启发式搜索。在复杂网络分类任务上，该方法精度落在全局最优的 5% 以内，同时比穷举搜索降低 90% 计算开销。
Motivation: LLNA 网络描述子依赖转移规则选择，而这本质是高成本组合优化；现有文献靠穷举搜索，无法扩展到大规模应用。
Method: 定义 jaggedness 度量 LLNA 转移函数与锯齿形状的相似度，论证其可作为混沌性与敏感性的理论代理；再用该指标引导启发式规则搜索，替代穷举。
Result: 分类精度在全局最优的 5% 以内，计算开销相比穷举方法降低 90%。
Conclusion: 规则空间由 jaggedness 这一结构性质组织，用它引导搜索即可在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅削减自动机规则选择的计算量。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: A mesh-based neural energy method for the simulation of heterogeneous composites
papers.abstract_en: Modeling heterogeneous materials remains a challenge for physics-informed neural networks such as the deep energy method (DEM). The DEM and its variants, here collectively referred to as the neural energy method (NEM), offer a differentiable variational framework. However, their conventional collocation-based implementation (C-NEM) often suffers from physically inadmissible displacement oscillations, integration errors, and high computational costs from automatic differentiation. This work introduces the mesh-based neural energy method (M-NEM), extending the NEM through a mesh-based discretization of the displacement field. By interpolating nodal displacements via shape functions, the M-NEM imposes a kinematic constraint that suppresses oscillations. Furthermore, the method replaces automatic differentiation with algebraic shape function derivatives for strain computation and employs high-order Gaussian quadrature for accurate energy integration. On a directly comparable benchmark problem, the M-NEM reduces stress errors by up to three orders of magnitude relative to the C-NEM while being one to two orders of magnitude faster. On two further benchmarks involving extreme stiffness contrasts, only the M-NEM converges. A comparative study of neural architectures reveals that radial basis function neural networks (RBFNNs) yield optimal performance within the M-NEM, resolving sharp gradients at material interfaces with higher accuracy than multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) with random Fourier feature (RFF) mapping and faster convergence than Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把深度能量法 (DEM) 的配点实现改为基于网格的位移场离散：用形函数插值节点位移施加运动学约束抑制非物理位移振荡，用代数形函数导数替代自动微分算应变，并用高阶 Gaussian 积分算能量。在可直接对比的基准上应力误差比 C-NEM 最多降三个数量级、速度快一到两个数量级；两个极端刚度对比基准中只有 M-NEM 收敛。
Motivation: 物理信息神经网络尤其是 DEM 处理非均质材料时，配点式实现 (C-NEM) 出现物理上不可接受的位移振荡、积分误差，且自动微分带来高昂计算成本。
Method: 提出 mesh-based neural energy method (M-NEM)：对位移场做基于网格的离散，用形函数插值节点位移以施加运动学约束；应变计算改用代数形函数导数取代自动微分，能量积分用高阶 Gaussian quadrature。另比较神经架构，考察 RBFNN、MLP 加 random Fourier feature (RFF) 映射以及 Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs)。
Result: 在可直接对比的基准问题上，M-NEM 相对 C-NEM 应力误差最多降低三个数量级，同时快一到两个数量级；在两个涉及极端刚度对比的进一步基准上，只有 M-NEM 能收敛。架构对比中 RBFNN 在 M-NEM 内表现最优，比 MLP+RFF 更高精度地分辨材料界面处的陡峭梯度，且比 KAN 收敛更快。
Conclusion: 把位移场离散化和积分方式换掉，可以让神经能量方法在非均质、极端刚度对比的复合材料上既消振荡又收敛提速；在该框架内 RBFNN 是优于 MLP+RFF 与 KAN 的架构选择。

papers.title: Enabling Preference-driven Unlearning in Few-step Distilled Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models are increasingly distilled into few-step variants and being deployed to enable fast inference. However, their ability to generate harmful or undesired content poses significant safety risks. Data-driven unlearning methods suppress targeted generations by fine-tuning model weights using specialized unlearning objectives. Crucially, these objectives implicitly rely on multi-step denoising dynamics, an assumption that breaks down for few-step distilled (FSD) models, resulting in ineffective forgetting. Furthermore, performing unlearning on the non-distilled base model and subsequently re-distilling it to obtain an unlearned FSD model incurs substantial computational and time overhead, making it impractical in many settings. Hence, we address this limitation with a preference-driven unlearning framework that revisits Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for diffusion models. We show that standard DPO and its unlearning derivatives, formulated around noise-prediction error, transfer poorly to FSD models due to their altered generation dynamics. To overcome this, we introduce a modified preference optimization formulation explicitly aligned with the few-step generation properties, enabling direct concept removal in FSD models while preserving few-step efficiency and maintaining strong retention of desirable (non-targeted) capabilities. We evaluate our framework primarily on identity and NSFW (nudity) removal tasks and also extend our method to object-level unlearning. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent and effective forgetting, and strong retention performance, establishing our method as a practical and principled solution for unlearning in FSD models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 少步蒸馏 (few-step distilled, FSD) 文本到图像扩散模型的生成动力学被改变，基于噪声预测误差的 DPO 及其遗忘变体迁移失效。作者提出与少步生成性质对齐的改进偏好优化形式，直接在 FSD 模型上做概念移除，同时保住少步推理效率与非目标能力。
Motivation: 数据驱动遗忘依赖多步去噪动力学的隐含假设，在 FSD 模型上失效导致遗忘无效；先在基座模型上遗忘再重新蒸馏则带来大量计算与时间开销。
Method: 以 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) 为基础，指出标准 DPO 及其围绕 noise-prediction error 的遗忘变体在 FSD 上迁移差，进而给出与少步生成性质显式对齐的改进偏好优化形式，直接在 FSD 模型上做概念移除。
Result: 在 identity 与 NSFW (nudity) 移除任务上评测，并扩展到 object-level unlearning；大量实验显示一致有效的遗忘与强保留表现。
Conclusion: 对齐少步生成动力学的偏好优化，是 FSD 模型上既实用又有原则的直接遗忘方案，无需先遗忘基座再重新蒸馏。

papers.title: RFChipAgent: Multi-Agentic AI Flow for Analog/RF Chip Design
papers.abstract_en: Analog/RF circuits remain the critical interface between digital computation and the physical world, and emerging standards from Wi-Fi 7 to 6G place stringent demands on them, yet analog/RF design remains one of the most labor-intensive steps in chip development. We present RFChipAgent, a first-of-its-kind multi-agent flow of large language model (LLM) agents for end-to-end analog/RF circuit design automation, in which AI agents collaboratively orchestrate the complete design flow under human supervision. RFChipAgent is built around four technical pillars. First, a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) subsystem with private per-document FAISS indexing extracts design knowledge from existing engineering documentation. Second, a topology agent drives topology selection, and a schematic and testbench agent automates circuit and testbench assembly. Third, a closed-loop hybrid circuit-sizing engine combines Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) and CMA-ES optimization, evaluating every candidate in a simulator-in-the-loop framework. Fourth, a trust-scored simulation database accumulates verified performance data and builds an adaptive optimization model that informs subsequent trials. We validate RFChipAgent on a family of GF22FDSOI 60 GHz wideband mm-wave low-noise amplifier (LNA) topologies, demonstrating automated topology generation, specification-driven design-space exploration, and simulator-guided optimization. Experimental results show substantial reductions in design effort while maintaining signoff-quality verification. This work establishes a foundation for LLM-driven multi-agent electronic design automation (EDA) for analog/RF circuits.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to ACM/IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RFChipAgent 用四个 LLM agent 组成的多智能体流程端到端自动化模拟/射频电路设计：FAISS 逐文档 RAG 取设计知识，拓扑与原理图/测试台 agent 负责选型与搭建，TPE+CMA-ES 混合 sizing 引擎在 simulator-in-the-loop 中闭环迭代，信任评分的仿真数据库再反哺后续寻优。在 GF22FDSOI 60 GHz 宽带 mm-wave LNA 拓扑族上验证了自动拓扑生成、规格驱动设计空间探索与仿真引导优化，在保持 signoff 级验证的同时大幅降低设计工作量。
Motivation: 模拟/射频设计是芯片开发中最耗人力的环节之一，Wi-Fi 7 到 6G 等新标准又对电路指标提出更严要求，人工驱动的设计流程难以跟上。
Method: 四个技术支柱：多模态 RAG 子系统对每份工程文档单独建 FAISS 索引；topology agent 做拓扑选择，schematic 与 testbench agent 自动组装电路和测试台；闭环混合 sizing 引擎结合 Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) 与 CMA-ES，每个候选方案都在 simulator-in-the-loop 框架中评估；信任评分的仿真数据库积累已验证性能数据并构建自适应优化模型，指导下一轮试验。全程在 human supervision 下由 agent 协作编排。
Result: 在 GF22FDSOI 60 GHz 宽带 mm-wave 低噪声放大器 (LNA) 拓扑族上验证，实现自动拓扑生成、规格驱动的设计空间探索与仿真引导优化；实验结果显示设计工作量大幅下降，同时保持 signoff 级验证质量。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Horizon-Invariant Behavior Cloning
papers.abstract_en: Behavior cloning (BC) in non-Markovian environments is a challenging problem because policies have to reason over contextual information over long horizons. Existing policy architectures rely on recurrent or attention-based mechanisms to capture long-term dependencies. However, recurrent models suffer from hidden-state collapse and gradient instability under backpropagation through time, while attention-based models are fundamentally limited by context length. To address these issues, we propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a novel self-supervised method that $\textit{discovers}$ a set of information-critical observations ($\textit{mnemonics}$) by learning an objective from randomly sampled past observations and using it as a reward for keyframe selection. We then train a BC policy that conditions on the discovered keyframes to model the action distribution. Under certain task-structure assumptions, our formulation provides context retention guarantees over an infinite horizon, while maintaining a small set of decision-relevant keyframes in the policy's working memory. We evaluate our method on synthetic memory domains, where mnemonic-conditioned BC policies achieve $100$% success rates (SR) and generalize to horizons orders of magnitude beyond training without performance degradation. Additionally, we evaluate on memory-intensive robot manipulation benchmark, achieving a $13.9$% average absolute SR improvement over the strongest baseline across $23$ tasks and retaining $80$% SR at $20\times$ longer horizons on a real robot. Code and videos are available at https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Keyframe Mnemonics：用自监督目标从随机采样的历史观测中发现信息关键帧 (keyframe)，再让行为克隆 (BC) 策略只以这些关键帧为条件建模动作分布，在任务结构假设下给出无限时域的上下文保持保证。合成记忆域上 mnemonic 条件 BC 达到 100% 成功率并泛化到比训练长数个量级的时域；记忆密集机器人操作基准上比最强基线平均绝对 SR 高 13.9%（23 个任务），真机在 20× 更长时域仍保持 80% SR。
Motivation: 非马尔可夫环境中 BC 策略需跨越长时程依赖：循环模型有隐状态坍缩与 BPTT 梯度不稳定，注意力模型受上下文长度硬限制，两者都无法在工作记忆里长期保留决策相关信息。
Method: Keyframe Mnemonics 分两步：先从随机采样的历史观测学一个自监督目标，并把它当作关键帧选择的 reward 来发现信息关键观测 (mnemonics)；再训练以这些关键帧为条件的 BC 策略建模动作分布。在一定任务结构假设下给出无限时域上下文保持保证，同时策略工作记忆只保留少量决策相关关键帧。
Result: 合成记忆域上 mnemonic 条件 BC 成功率 (SR) 达 100%，并泛化到比训练时域长数个量级而性能不下降；在含 23 个任务的记忆密集机器人操作基准上，比最强基线平均绝对 SR 提升 13.9%；真机上时域拉长到 20× 仍保持 80% SR。
Conclusion: 用自监督发现的关键帧替代循环或全注意力历史，可以在长时域 BC 中同时保住上下文与小工作记忆；上下文保持保证依赖于任务结构假设。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: KDFP: A first-principles approach to knowledge distillation in large language models
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation is an established technique for improving the capabilities of small, efficient student models by training them with the representations of larger, more capable teacher models. Much of the recent work in the distillation of large language models (LLMs) has focused on distilling abilities learned during post-training, such as instruction following, chain-of-thought reasoning, and tool usage. This has left a large research gap in general knowledge distillation for LLMs, which is essential for developing efficient and private systems suitable for deployment on edge devices. We take a first-principles approach, evaluating previous lessons from prior works and conducting new explorations to develop a distillation methodology suitable for modern LLMs. We present KDFP, a novel methodology for white-box general knowledge distillation in LLMs. We demonstrate that KDFP outperforms existing methods by 1.6% $-$ 4.9% across 9 benchmarks while increasing training efficiency by up to 99.1% through ephemeral parameter reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KDFP 是面向大语言模型白盒通用知识蒸馏 (white-box general knowledge distillation) 的第一性原理方法论，把既有蒸馏工作的经验重新梳理并做新探索，得到适配现代 LLM 的蒸馏流程。在 9 个 benchmark 上比现有方法高 1.6%–4.9%，并通过 ephemeral parameter reduction 把训练效率提升最多 99.1%。
Motivation: 近期 LLM 蒸馏研究集中在蒸馏后训练阶段学到的能力（指令跟随、思维链推理、工具使用），通用知识蒸馏这一基础方向留下明显空白，而它正是构建可在边缘设备上部署的高效、隐私友好系统所需。
Method: 以第一性原理方式评估先前工作的经验并做新探索，提出 KDFP：面向现代 LLM 的白盒通用知识蒸馏方法论，训练时利用教师模型的表示，并通过 ephemeral parameter reduction 降低训练开销。
Result: 在 9 个 benchmark 上，KDFP 比现有蒸馏方法高 1.6%–4.9%；训练效率提升最高达 99.1%，来自 ephemeral parameter reduction。
Conclusion: 通用知识蒸馏在现代 LLM 上仍可系统改进：按第一性原理重构蒸馏流程，能在 9 个 benchmark 上稳定超过现有方法，同时大幅削减训练开销。

papers.title: Similar Predictive Fit but Different Latent Dynamics: Characterizing Learned Dynamical Structure in Personalized Models of Brain Disorders
papers.abstract_en: As AI models move toward clinical decision-making and personalized treatment, understanding \emph{what} a model learns is important beyond predictive accuracy alone. We investigate whether personalized latent dynamics reveal clinically associated differences even when predictive fit is similar. A lightweight CNN--Transformer EEG foundation model pretrained on the Temple University EEG Corpus (TUEG) extracts segment-level representations. Using the Temple University Epilepsy Corpus (TUEP), representations are mapped to a shared latent-state space, and sparse multinomial logistic transition distributions (mLTD) are fit independently to each subject to obtain personalized transition-dependency graphs $W_n$. Analyses include $n{=}198$ subjects (99 epilepsy / 99 non-epilepsy). At $k{=}4$, epilepsy subjects exhibit substantially denser learned dependency structure ($p{=}1.1\times10^{-7}$), with the same pattern at $k{=}6$ (19.90 vs. 13.46; $p{=}5.2\times10^{-5}$). Graph-derived features provide moderate group discrimination under 5-fold subject-wise cross-validation (AUROC 0.68 at $k{=}4$; 0.65 at $k{=}6$). In contrast, held-out log-likelihood is nearly identical between groups at $k{=}4$ ($-0.992$ vs. $-0.991$; $p{=}0.95$), with similarly matched next-state prediction (AUROC 0.855 vs. 0.861; $p{=}0.54$). Thus, similar predictive fit does not imply similar learned dynamics: groups can be comparably predictable while differing substantially in the internal dynamical structure learned by personalized models. This distinction motivates evaluating learned structure alongside predictive performance in personalized clinical models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 EEG 个性化模型中，癫痫组与非癫痫组的预测拟合几乎相同（k=4 留出 log-likelihood −0.992 vs −0.991，p=0.95），但学到的潜在动力学结构显著不同：癫痫组的转移依赖图明显更稠密（k=4，p=1.1×10⁻⁷；k=6 为 19.90 vs 13.46，p=5.2×10⁻⁵）。结论是预测性能相当不代表学到的动力学相同，个性化临床模型应同时评估学到的结构。
Motivation: 面向临床决策与个性化治疗的模型只看预测精度不够：两组可能同样可预测，但内部学到的动力学结构不同，仅凭留出似然会掩盖这种临床相关差异。
Method: 用在 Temple University EEG Corpus (TUEG) 上预训练的轻量 CNN–Transformer EEG foundation model 提取段级表示；在 Temple University Epilepsy Corpus (TUEP) 上把表示映射到共享 latent-state space，再对每个被试独立拟合稀疏多项式逻辑转移分布 (mLTD)，得到个性化转移依赖图 W_n；分析 n=198 名被试（99 癫痫 / 99 非癫痫），并用 5 折 subject-wise cross-validation 从图特征做组间判别。
Result: k=4 时癫痫组依赖结构显著更稠密（p=1.1×10⁻⁷），k=6 同样模式（19.90 vs 13.46，p=5.2×10⁻⁵）；图特征在 5 折 subject-wise CV 下组间判别 AUROC 为 k=4 0.68、k=6 0.65；而 k=4 留出 log-likelihood 两组几乎相同（−0.992 vs −0.991，p=0.95），下一状态预测 AUROC 0.855 vs 0.861（p=0.54）。
Conclusion: 相似的预测拟合不等于相似的学到动力学：两组可以同样可预测，却在个性化模型学到的内部动力学结构上差异显著，因此个性化临床模型应在预测性能之外同时评估学到的结构。

papers.title: Amortized Off-Policy Evaluation for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Accurate evaluation is central to selecting which LLM to deploy, yet testing a candidate on live traffic exposes real users to an unvetted model. Teams therefore evaluate candidates offline, on data produced by already-deployed models. This is off-policy evaluation (OPE), and it faces two distribution shifts: as a model is updated in post-training, its responses diverge from the logged ones (policy shift), and the reward definition under which it is judged changes with business requirements (reward shift). Classical OPE methods are ill-suited to this continual-deployment setting because they are defined per task and require fitting from scratch on every new logged dataset or reward definition. To address this, we propose PFN-OPE, a prior-data fitted network that amortizes OPE across a distribution of contextual-bandit tasks. We pretrain it once on tasks constructed from a pool of LLM responses scored by several reward functions, in which both shifts occur. At test-time it maps a logged dataset and one sampled target response per prompt to a value estimate in a single forward pass, with no per-task fitting. On HelpSteer2 and UltraFeedback with Qwen, Llama, and Gemma policies, PFN-OPE achieves 2.0 to 9.3 times lower error than the best baselines across all tested configurations in the reward-shifted settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PFN-OPE：把 off-policy evaluation (OPE) 做成 prior-data fitted network 的摊销推断，在 contextual-bandit 任务分布上一次性预训练，测试时对每个 logged dataset 和每条采样响应只需一次前向即给出价值估计，无需按任务重训。在 HelpSteer2 与 UltraFeedback、Qwen/Llama/Gemma 策略上，reward-shift 设置下误差比最优基线低 2.0 至 9.3 倍。
Motivation: LLM 上线前只能在已部署模型的日志数据上做离线评估，而 post-training 造成 policy shift、业务改 reward 定义造成 reward shift；经典 OPE 每换一个数据集或 reward 定义都要从头拟合，不适配这种持续部署场景。
Method: PFN-OPE 是 prior-data fitted network，把 OPE 摊销到一组 contextual-bandit 任务分布上：预训练数据由一池 LLM 响应经多个 reward 函数打分构造，池中同时包含 policy shift 与 reward shift；测试时输入 logged dataset 与每个 prompt 采样的一条目标响应，单次前向输出价值估计。
Result: 在 HelpSteer2 和 UltraFeedback 上，以 Qwen、Llama、Gemma 为策略，reward-shifted 设置中 PFN-OPE 的误差比最优基线低 2.0 至 9.3 倍，覆盖全部被测配置。
Conclusion: 把 OPE 预训练成一次性摊销的网络，可在 reward 定义与策略同时漂移的持续部署下免去逐任务拟合，并显著压低价值估计误差。

papers.title: Real Long-Term Memory for AI: A 50-Million-Token Window That Is Faster and Cheaper Than Recompute
papers.abstract_en: A large language model can only use the text that fits in its context window, and it recomputes its internal key-value (KV) state for a prompt every time the prompt is sent. We test a memory layer, the public package galahad-kv, that saves the KV state of each block of about 16,000 tokens to encrypted local NVMe disk and loads it back later, byte-exact, without recomputing it. We ran it on 50,000,000 tokens of real public text, served through vLLM on one NVIDIA H100, with Gemma 4 12B and Gemma 4 31B. Every block we probed was loaded back from the encrypted store with no recompute (100 of 100, at depths from 0 to 50M tokens) on both models. Loading a block was 2.8x to 4.3x faster than recomputing it and used 8.8x to 12.3x less GPU energy, and GPU memory stayed flat over the whole 50M-token stream. Asked about facts planted millions of tokens earlier, the 12B model gave the right answer 82 times out of 100 and the 31B model 98 times out of 100. Neither model made up an answer. The limits are as follows. This is reuse of stored state, not a wider attention window: one block is loaded at a time, and how well a question is answered depends on the model. Writing the memory is a one-time cost, and the store takes terabytes of local NVMe disk. We describe the test protocol, which is built to resist common ways of gaming long-context benchmarks, and give a single-GPU reproduction that uses public software and a free licence for the package.

papers.title: On the Clock: Towards Punctual and Productive Time-Budgeted AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: We study whether small LLM agents can operate effectively under explicit wall-clock time budgets by both respecting the allocated runtime and using available time productively. We evaluate Qwen3.6-27B on five competitions from MLE-Bench Lite and Qwen3-4B on Zork I (Jericho), two agentic benchmarks where additional computational time can meaningfully improve performance. In the simplest setting, where the budget is stated only in the prompt, agents fail to translate the stated budget into controlled use of time. These failures arise from gaps in time awareness, since the harness provides no timing feedback, but also because they cannot reliably anticipate the duration of actions, and do not have a learned mapping from available time to an appropriate strategy. We investigate two complementary classes of interventions: harness-based mechanisms that expose timing information and enforce deadlines, and reinforcement learning with budget-aware rewards. Injecting timing information through the harness substantially improves budget adherence for Qwen3.6-27B without measurable loss in performance, while enforcement hooks tighten adherence further. RL with GRPO achieves near-perfect budget adherence on Zork I and generalizes to held-out budgets not seen during training, but does not improve task performance over the untrained harness on MLE-Bench. Once agents are made to respect the budget, they still fail to use additional time to improve task performance. RL-trained policies learn when to stop but often fill extra time with repeated actions, and GRPO training on multiple budgets tends to collapse toward the strategy learned for the shortest budget. Our results reveal a gap between time adherence and productive time allocation, which remains a central challenge for budget-conditioned agents.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI. 23 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在显式墙钟时间预算下，小 LLM agent 既不守时也不会用富余时间：仅在 prompt 里写预算时，Qwen3.6-27B 在 MLE-Bench Lite 五个竞赛、Qwen3-4B 在 Zork I (Jericho) 上都无法把预算转成受控的时间使用。harness 注入计时信息显著提升预算遵守且性能无可测损失，GRPO 配预算感知奖励在 Zork I 上把遵守率推到接近完美并泛化到未见预算，但两者都没让任务成绩变好，多预算训练还会坍缩到最短预算学到的策略。
Motivation: 小 LLM agent 在墙钟预算下既不守时也不懂得把额外算力换成更好结果；harness 不给计时反馈，模型也预估不了动作耗时、没有从剩余时间到策略的映射。
Method: 评测 Qwen3.6-27B 于 MLE-Bench Lite 的五个竞赛、Qwen3-4B 于 Zork I (Jericho)；对比两类干预：harness 侧暴露计时信息并加 enforcement hooks，以及用 GRPO 做带预算感知奖励的强化学习（含多预算训练与 held-out 预算泛化）。
Result: 仅在 prompt 中写预算时 agent 无法受控用时；harness 注入计时信息显著改善 Qwen3.6-27B 的预算遵守且性能无可测损失，enforcement hooks 进一步收紧遵守；GRPO 在 Zork I 上达到接近完美的预算遵守并泛化到训练未见的预算，但在 MLE-Bench 上任务性能不优于未训练的 harness；RL 策略学会何时停止却常以重复动作填满富余时间，多预算 GRPO 训练倾向坍缩到最短预算的策略。
Conclusion: 时间遵守与时间的生产性分配是两个可分离的问题：让 agent 守住预算已可由 harness 与 RL 解决，但把富余时间转成任务收益仍是 budget-conditioned agent 的核心挑战。

papers.title: MotherTree: Meta-learning on synthetic data improves decision tree training
papers.abstract_en: Conventional decision tree algorithms produce effective, transparent models that can be audited, communicated, and deployed independently of the training data, but require learning every new task from scratch. In contrast, tabular foundation models demonstrate that meta-learning from a synthetic prior distribution enables strong in-context prediction for previously unseen tasks, especially in small-sample regimes. However, this approach does not produce a standalone model that can be inspected in isolation. We introduce MotherTree, a tabular transformer that meta-learns decision tree induction: given a training set for a new task, it outputs a hard, axis-aligned decision tree, equivalent in form to classically trained trees, in a single forward pass. MotherTree is pre-trained on a synthetic prior using stochastic gradient descent without requiring reference trees for supervision. On established benchmarks with controlled sample size, the approach is competitive with size-matched trees from common algorithms: recursive partitioning, gradient-based tree learning, globally optimal trees, and distillation from tabular foundation models. Notably, MotherTree consistently improves over from-scratch gradient-based learning and acts as a strong initializer: task-specific tuning of the generated tree outperforms the corresponding from-scratch learner on all benchmarks and sample sizes. These results show that meta-learning can provide effective inductive biases for learning stand-alone, small decision tree classifiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MotherTree 是一个表格 Transformer，通过在合成先验分布上元学习决策树归纳，对新任务一次前向输出硬的、轴对齐的独立决策树，无需参考树监督。在受控样本量的既有基准上，其生成树经任务内调优后在所有基准与样本量上都超过从头训练的梯度式树学习器。
Motivation: 传统决策树透明可审计但每个任务都要从头训练；表格基础模型靠合成先验元学习实现小样本上下文预测，却无法产出可独立检视的模型。
Method: MotherTree 用 tabular transformer 元学习决策树归纳：输入新任务训练集，单次前向输出硬的轴对齐决策树；在合成先验分布上用 SGD 预训练，不需要参考树作为监督。
Result: 在受控样本量的既有基准上，与规模匹配的 recursive partitioning、梯度式树学习、全局最优树、以及从表格基础模型蒸馏的树相当；相对从头梯度式学习一致改进，作为强初始化器时对生成树做任务内调优在所有基准和样本量上都优于对应从头学习器。
Conclusion: 元学习可以为独立的、小型决策树分类器提供有效的归纳偏置，且生成树保留经典树的形式与可检视性。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction under Partial Verification
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction provides prediction sets with finite-sample guarantees, but the label verification required for calibration can be expensive. We develop a partial verification method that returns exactly the same prediction sets as complete verification. We characterize calibration certificates, the verified information sufficient to determine the conformal threshold, and design a procedure that coordinates verification across calibration examples. For finite thresholds at high coverage, its verification cost is less than twice the minimum certificate cost when candidates are checked in order. Across retrieval, mathematical solutions, and configuration evaluation, it reduces verification cost by 15-82% compared with verifying calibration examples one at a time, while producing identical prediction sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在标签验证昂贵的场景下，提出部分验证 (partial verification) 的 conformal prediction 校准方法：刻画足以确定 conformal 阈值的 calibration certificate，并跨校准样本协调验证顺序，使预测集与完全验证完全一致。在高覆盖率的有限阈值下，按序检查候选时验证成本不到最小 certificate 成本的两倍；在检索、数学解与配置评估三类任务上，相比逐个验证校准样本降低 15–82% 验证成本，且预测集完全相同。
Motivation: Conformal prediction 的有限样本保证依赖校准集标签验证，而验证成本可能很高；需要在不改变预测集的前提下减少验证开销。
Method: 刻画 calibration certificate（足以确定 conformal 阈值的已验证信息），并设计跨校准样本协调验证的程序，按序检查候选以在高覆盖率下控制验证成本。
Result: 高覆盖率有限阈值下，按序检查候选时验证成本小于最小 certificate 成本的两倍；在 retrieval、mathematical solutions、configuration evaluation 三类任务上，相比逐个验证校准样本降低 15–82% 验证成本，预测集与完全验证完全一致。
Conclusion: 部分验证可以做到与完全验证产生完全相同的预测集，同时把校准验证成本压到逐个验证的 15–82% 降幅水平。

papers.title: Grammar Concept Annotation at Scale: Deployed Fine-Tuned Small Language Models Outperform Prompted Frontier Models
papers.abstract_en: Corrective feedback is among the best-evidenced drivers of second-language acquisition, yet corrections delivered during lessons rarely accumulate into an actionable view of grammar mastery. Prompted frontier models can provide such a view from learner--tutor lesson transcripts, but they are costly at scale. We close this gap by fine-tuning Qwen3.5 small language models (SLMs) on filtered and rebalanced teacher-generated supervision, then deploying an efficient 0.8B model in an end-to-end grammar mastery tracker for all English learners on our platform. Internalizing the annotation contract into adapter weights enables pairing the 0.8B model with a compact matched prompt rather than verbose instructions. On two human-curated benchmarks, both the deployed 0.8B model and a 4B reference comparator outperform prompted GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6 Sol in precision and recall under nested matching criteria of increasing strictness: concept, evidence span, and correctness. The deployed 0.8B SLM reduces serving cost by approximately 16$\times$. A feature-level online experiment shows significant gains in learner engagement ($+15.8\%$) and key business metrics, including scheduled hours ($+2.1\%$) and GMV from new lessons ($+13.2\%$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把语法概念标注合同微调进 Qwen3.5 小模型权重，部署 0.8B 模型做端到端语法掌握追踪，在两个人工基准的嵌套匹配准则（concept、evidence span、correctness）上精确率与召回率均超过提示式 GPT-5.4 和 GPT-5.6 Sol，服务成本约降 16 倍。线上实验显示学习者参与度 +15.8%、排课时长 +2.1%、新课 GMV +13.2%。
Motivation: 课内纠错很少沉淀为可操作的语法掌握视图；用提示式前沿模型从师生对话转录中生成这种视图在规模化时成本过高。
Method: 在经筛选与重平衡的教师生成监督上微调 Qwen3.5 SLM，把标注合同内化进 adapter 权重，使 0.8B 模型只需配一个紧凑匹配 prompt 而非冗长指令；部署为端到端语法掌握追踪器，并与 4B 参照模型及提示式 GPT-5.4、GPT-5.6 Sol 在两个人工整理基准上按逐级严格的嵌套匹配准则比较。
Result: 在两个人工基准上，部署的 0.8B 与 4B 参照模型在 precision 和 recall 上均超过 prompted GPT-5.4 与 GPT-5.6 Sol，覆盖 concept、evidence span、correctness 三级准则；0.8B 模型服务成本约降低 16 倍。特征级线上实验中学习者参与度 +15.8%、排课时长 +2.1%、新课 GMV +13.2%。
Conclusion: 把标注合同微调进小模型权重可以取代冗长提示，在精度、召回与成本三方面同时胜过提示式前沿模型，并直接带来参与度与业务指标的显著提升。
